CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "IDCHAMBRE", "CHAMBRE") AS
SELECT
    a.ID,
    a.DATY,
    a.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.LIBELLE AS libelleproduit,
    a.QTE,
    a.PU,
    a.PU * a.QTE AS montant,
    a.LIBELLE,
    a.IDCLIENT,
    c.NOM AS idclientlib,
    a.IDRESERVATION,
    a.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN a.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,
    ai.COMPTE_ACHAT,
    a.IDPRODUIT as IDCHAMBRE,
    ai.LIBELLE as chambre
FROM ACTE a
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai  ON ai.id = a.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = a.IDCLIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_A" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT 
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al 
WHERE al.etat = 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_C" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT 
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al 
WHERE al.etat = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_FACT" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al 
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT f.idacte FROM FACTURECLIENTDETAILS f WHERE f.idacte = al.id );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_NONFACT" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al 
WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT f.idacte FROM FACTURECLIENTDETAILS f WHERE f.idacte = al.id );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_V" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT 
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al 
WHERE al.etat = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDACTIONFORMATION", "IDTYPECOUT", "COUT", "IDDEVISE", "IDTYPECOUTLIB", "IDDEVISELIB") AS
SELECT
    afd.ID,afd.IDACTIONFORMATION,afd.IDTYPECOUT,afd.COUT,afd.IDDEVISE,
    tcf.VAL AS idTypeCoutLib,
    dev.VAL AS idDeviseLib
FROM ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL afd
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COUT_FORMATION tcf
                   ON afd.IDTYPECOUT = tcf.ID
         LEFT JOIN DEVISE dev
                   ON afd.IDDEVISE = dev.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTION_FORMATION_LIB" ("ID", "IDPLANFORMATION", "IDPLANFORMATIONLIB", "IDTYPEFORMATION", "IDTYPEFORMATIONLIB", "IDCATEGORIEFORMATION", "IDCATEGORIEFORMATIONLIB", "FORMATEUR", "REFERENCE", "INTITULE", "TYPEPRESTATAIRE", "IDSEMESTRE", "IDSEMESTRELIB", "NBSESSIONPREVUS", "DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE", "NBOUVRIERSPREVUE", "NBCADREPREVUE", "OBJECTIF", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "ESTREALISEELIB") AS
SELECT
    af.ID,
    af.IDPLANFORMATION,
    pf.LIBELLE AS IDPLANFORMATIONLIB,
    af.IDTYPEFORMATION,
    tf.VAL AS IDTYPEFORMATIONLIB,
    af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION,
    cf.VAL AS IDCATEGORIEFORMATIONLIB,
    af.FORMATEUR,
    af.REFERENCE,
    af.INTITULE,
    CASE
        WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '1' THEN 'INTERNE'
        WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '0' THEN 'EXTERNE'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS TYPEPRESTATAIRE,
    af.IDSEMESTRE,
    s.VAL AS IDSEMESTRELIB,
    af.NBSESSIONPREVUS,
    af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,
    af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,
    af.NBCADREPREVUE,
    af.OBJECTIF,
    af.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN af.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN af.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN af.ETAT = 0 THEN 'Annule'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS ETATLIB,
     CASE
        WHEN af.estRealisee = '1' THEN 'OUI'
        WHEN af.estRealisee = '0' THEN 'NON'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS estRealiseelib
FROM ACTION_FORMATION af

         LEFT JOIN PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pf
                   ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pf.ID

         LEFT JOIN TYPE_FORMATION tf
                   ON af.IDTYPEFORMATION = tf.ID

         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_FORMATION cf
                   ON af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION = cf.ID

         LEFT JOIN SEMESTRE s
                   ON af.IDSEMESTRE = s.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ALIMENTPOUSSIN_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QUANTITE", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "IDUNITE") AS
select rec."ID",rec."IDPRODUITS",rec."IDINGREDIENTS",rec."UNITE",rec."QUANTITE", ing.LIBELLE as libIngredients, u.VAL as idUnite
from AlimentPoussin rec
         left join as_ingredients ing on
    ing.id=rec.idingredients
left join as_UNITE u on u.id = rec.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ANOMALIETRANSFERT" ("IDTRANSFERT", "MAGASINDEPART", "MAGASINDEPARTLIB", "MAGASINARRIVE", "MAGASINARRIVELIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "MONTANT", "ENVOYE", "MONTANTENVOYE", "RECU", "MONTANTRECU", "ECART", "MONTANTECART", "RESTE") AS
SELECT 
t.id as idTransfert,
t.IDMAGASINDEPART AS magasinDepart,
t.IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB AS  magasinDepartLib,
t.IDMAGASINARRIVE AS magasinArrive,
t.IDMAGASINARRIVELIB AS magasinArriveLib,
t.daty,
t.designation,
td.idproduit,
td.idproduitlib,
CAST(nvl(td.quantite,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS quantite ,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(td.quantite,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montant , 
CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as envoye,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantEnvoye, 
CAST(nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as recu ,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantRecu,
CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) - nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as ecart,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) - nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantEcart ,
CAST(nvl(td.quantite,0) - nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as reste
FROM transfertstockdetailscpl td
LEFT JOIN transfertstockcpl t ON t.id = td.idtransfertstock 
LEFT JOIN mvtstockfilletransfert m ON m.idtransfertdetail = td.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ASBLCLIENTCPLASINGREDIENTS" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER") AS
SELECT
	abcf.ID,
	abcf.PRODUIT,
	abcf.NUMBL,
	abcf.QUANTITE,
	abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
	abcf.UNITE,
	abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
	p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS idproduitlib,
	vd.idvente,
	abc.idbc,
	CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
	CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.id = abcf.produit
LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BC_FILLE_AVEC_PRIX" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "PU", "TVA", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT
    bl.ID,bl.PRODUIT,bl.NUMBL,CAST(bl.QUANTITE AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS  QUANTITE,bl.IDVENTEDETAIL,bl.UNITE,bl.IDBC_FILLE,
    CAST(ai.PV AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS pu,
    CAST(ai.TVA AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS tva,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,ai.COMPTE_ACHAT
FROM
    AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE bl
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
    ON ai.ID = bl.PRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BC_RESTE_A_FACTURER" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "QTELIVRER", "QTEFACTURER", "FOURNISSEUR", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "DATY") AS
SELECT
    bc.id,
    bc.idbc,
    bc.produitlib,
    bc.unitelib,
    bc.produit,
    nvl(bc.quantite,0) AS quantite,
    nvl(bl.qte,0) AS qtelivrer,
    --nvl(ff.qte + ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
    nvl(ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer,
    FOURNISSEUR,
    FOURNISSEURLIB,
    DATY
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL bc
         LEFT JOIN ff_fillebl_grp bl ON bc.id = bl.IDBC_FILLE
         --LEFT JOIN ff_fillebc_grp ff ON bc.id = ff.IDBCDETAIL
        left join FF_FILLEBC_GRP_MERE ffm on ffm.IDBC = bc.IDBC and ffm.IDPRODUIT = bc.PRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCF_VENTE_RESTE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS
SELECT 
v.id,
v.idproduit,
v.qte -nvl(b.quantite,0) AS quantite,
v.id AS idventedetail,
NULL AS unite,
NULL AS idbc_fille 
FROM VENTE_DETAILS v
LEFT JOIN blcf_grpventedet b ON  b.idventedetail=v.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLFILLEGRP_VENTE_CPL_V" ("PRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "DATY", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "ID") AS
SELECT
	    a.PRODUIT ,
	    a.IDPRODUITLIB,
	    a.IDVENTE,
	    abc.daty,
	    nvl( sum(QUANTITE) ,0) AS QUANTITE,
	    a.UNITE,
	    u.VAL AS unitelib,
	    abc.id
	FROM AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL a
	         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = a.numbl
	         left join AS_UNITE u on u.id = a.unite
	WHERE abc.etat = 11
	GROUP BY a.IDPRODUITLIB,
	         a.IDVENTE,a.PRODUIT,abc.daty
	        , a.UNITE,u.val, abc.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLFILLEGRP_VENTE_CPL_V2" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "DATY", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB") AS
SELECT
    a.numbl as id ,
    a.PRODUIT ,
    a.IDPRODUITLIB,
    a.IDVENTE,
    abc.daty,
    nvl( sum(QUANTITE) ,0) AS QUANTITE,
    a.UNITE,
    u.VAL AS unitelib
FROM AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL2 a
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = a.numbl
         left join AS_UNITE u on u.id = a.unite
WHERE abc.etat = 11
GROUP BY a.IDPRODUITLIB,
         a.IDVENTE,a.PRODUIT,abc.daty
        , a.UNITE,u.val, a.numbl;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLIENTFILLEGRPBCFILLE" ("PRODUIT", "IDBC_FILLE", "QUANTITE") AS
select produit,IDBC_FILLE,sum(QUANTITE) as quantite from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE f
                                                             join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT m on m.ID=f.NUMBL where m.ETAT>=11
group by produit, IDBC_FILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLIENTFILLEINSERTION" ("PRODUITLIB", "ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "UNITELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS
SELECT
pl.VAL AS PRODUITLIB,
bl.id,
bl.PRODUIT,
bl.NUMBL,
bl.QUANTITE,
pl.IDUNITELIB AS UNITELIB,
bl.IDVENTEDETAIL,
bl.UNITE,
bl.IDBC_FILLE
FROM 
AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE bl
JOIN PRODUIT_LIB pl ON bl.PRODUIT = pl.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENTFILLE_BC_RESTE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE") AS
SELECT 
bc.ID,
b.PRODUIT,
b.NUMBL,
nvl((bc.QUANTITE - b.QUANTITE),0) AS QUANTITE,
b.IDVENTEDETAIL,
b.UNITE
FROM BCClient_Fille_GRP bc 
JOIN BLClient_Fille_GRP b ON b.IDBC = bc.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENT_CPL_ASINGREDIENTS" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER") AS
SELECT
	abcf.ID,
	abcf.PRODUIT,
	abcf.NUMBL,
	abcf.QUANTITE,
	abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
	abcf.UNITE,
	abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
	p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS idproduitlib,
	vd.idvente,
	abc.idbc,
	CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
	CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.id = abcf.produit
LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENT_FILLE_VISE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS
select acf."ID",acf."PRODUIT",acf."NUMBL",acf."QUANTITE",acf."IDVENTEDETAIL",acf."UNITE",acf."IDBC_FILLE" from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE acf
left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc on abc.ID = NUMBL
where ETAT = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONCOMMANDE_FILLE_AVEC_PRIX" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDMERE", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "PU", "TVA", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT
    bc.ID,
    bc.PRODUIT,
    bc.IDMERE,
    bc.QUANTITE,
    bc.UNITE,
    CAST(ai.PV AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS pu,
    CAST(ai.TVA AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS tva,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,ai.COMPTE_ACHAT
FROM
    BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bC
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
    ON ai.ID = bl.PRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDEFILLE_CPL" ("IDBC", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "REMISEMONTANT", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
SELECT
abf.IDBC ,
CAST(nvl(sum(montantht),0) AS NUMBER(30,2))  AS montantHT,
CAST(nvl(sum(montanttva),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttva,
CAST(nvl(sum(remiseMontant),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS remiseMontant,
abf.TAUXDECHANGE
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL abf
GROUP BY abf.IDBC,abf.TAUXDECHANGE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "MONTANT", "PU", "TVA", "UNITE", "REMISE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHT", "REMISEMONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select bcf.ID,bcf.PRODUIT,bcf.IDBC,bcf.QUANTITE,bcf.QUANTITE*bcf.PU AS montant,bcf.PU,bcf.TVA,bcf.UNITE,bcf.REMISE,
       ab.DATY,
       ab.ETAT,
       ab.REMARQUE,
       ab.DESIGNATION,
       ab.MODEPAIEMENT,
       ab.FOURNISSEUR,
       ab.REFERENCE,
       p.LIBELLE  as produitlib,
       u.VAL  as unitelib,
       mp.VAL as MODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       F.nom  AS FOURNISSEURLIB,
       CAST (((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttva,
       CAST( (((((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))-(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)))))+(((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100)))) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc,
       CAST (((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantht,
       CAST(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS remiseMontant,
       bcf.iddevise,
       CAST(bcf.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE,
       CAST( (((((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))-(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)))))+(((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100))))* bcf.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR
from AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE bcf
         left outer join AS_BONDECOMMANDE AB on AB.ID = bcf.IDBC
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS P on bcf.PRODUIT = P.ID
         left join AS_UNITE u on bcf.UNITE = u.id
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on AB.MODEPAIEMENT = mp.id
         left join fournisseur F on AB.fournisseur = F.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPT" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "QTELIVRER", "QTEFACTURER") AS
SELECT
    bc.id,
    bc.idbc,
    bc.produitlib,
    bc.unitelib,
    bc.produit,
    nvl(bc.quantite,0) AS quantite,
    nvl(bl.qte,0) AS qtelivrer,
    --nvl(ff.qte + ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
    nvl(ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL bc
         LEFT JOIN ff_fillebl_grp bl ON bc.id = bl.IDBC_FILLE
         --LEFT JOIN ff_fillebc_grp ff ON bc.id = ff.IDBCDETAIL
        left join FF_FILLEBC_GRP_MERE ffm on ffm.IDBC = bc.IDBC and ffm.IDPRODUIT = bc.PRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPTGRP" ("IDBC", "TOTALCOMMANDE", "TOTALRECEPT") AS
SELECT bc.idbc, sum (bc.quantite ) AS totalCommande , sum (bc.qtelivrer ) AS totalRecept FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPT bc GROUP BY bc.idbc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "UNITE", "IDUNITE", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "PRODUITLIB") AS
(
SELECT asbc."ID",
       asbc."PRODUIT",
       asbc."IDBC",
       asbc."QUANTITE",
       asbc."PU",
       asbc."MONTANT",
       asbc."TVA",
       asbc."UNITE",
       au.VAL        as IDUNITE,
       asbc."REMISE",
       asbc."IDDEVISE",
       asbc."TAUXDECHANGE",
       asing.libelle AS PRODUITLIB
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE asbc
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS asing ON asbc.PRODUIT = asing.ID
         left join as_unite au on au.ID = asbc.UNITE
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_LIVRE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "UNITE", "REMISE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "QTE_COMMANDE", "QTE_LIVRE", "QTE_RESTE", "PRODUITLIB", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
select bc."ID",bc."PRODUIT",bc."IDBC",bc."QUANTITE",bc."PU",bc."MONTANT",bc."TVA",bc."UNITE",bc."REMISE",bc."DATY",bc."ETAT",bc."REMARQUE",bc."DESIGNATION",bc."MODEPAIEMENT",bc."FOURNISSEUR",bc."REFERENCE",
       BC.QUANTITE as qte_commande,
       nvl(AB.qte_livre, 0)               as qte_livre,
       BC.QUANTITE - nvl(AB.qte_livre, 0) AS QTE_reste,
       p.LIBELLE as produitlib,
       bc.TAUXDECHANGE
from AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MF bc
         left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIVRE AB on AB.IDBC_FILLE = bc.id
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS p on p.id=bc.PRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MERECPL" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "DATELIMITE", "IDDMDACHAT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCARIARY", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDDEVISE", "ETATLIB", "IDSERVICELIB", "REFPROFORMA", "NB", "SOMMEACOMPTE", "REMISE") AS
SELECT
    ab.ID,
    ab.DATY,
    ab.ETAT,
    ab.REMARQUE,
    ab.DESIGNATION,
    ab.MODEPAIEMENT,
    ab.FOURNISSEUR,
    ab.REFERENCE,
    ab.dateLimite,
    ab.iddmdachat AS IDDMDACHAT,
    mp.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    F.NOM AS FOURNISSEURLIB,
    CAST(abf.montantTVA*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTVA,
    cast(abf.montantHT*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,
    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA - abf.remiseMontant)*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC ,
    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA- abf.remiseMontant) * abf.TAUXDECHANGE*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAriary,
    d.val AS idDeviselib,
    d.id AS IDDEVISE,
    CASE
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    s.VAL AS idServiceLib,
    ab.refproforma,
    1 AS nb,
    vw.TOTAL_DEBIT as sommeAcompte,
    ab.REMISE
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE AB
    LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT mp ON AB.MODEPAIEMENT = mp.id
    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR F ON AB.FOURNISSEUR = F.id
    LEFT JOIN AS_BONDECOMMANDEFILLE_CPL abf ON abf.IDBC = ab.ID
    LEFT JOIN DEVISE d ON d.id = ab.IDDEVISE
    LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT s ON ab.SERVICE = s.ID
    LEFT JOIN vw_mouvementcaisse_total_debit vw on VW.IDBC = ab.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MERETRAITE" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "DATELIMITE", "IDDMDACHAT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCARIARY", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDDEVISE", "ETATLIB", "IDSERVICELIB", "REFPROFORMA", "SOMMEACOMPTE", "REMISE", "IDTRAITE", "TRAITE") AS
SELECT
    abm."ID",abm."DATY",abm."ETAT",abm."REMARQUE",abm."DESIGNATION",abm."MODEPAIEMENT",abm."FOURNISSEUR",abm."REFERENCE",abm."DATELIMITE",abm."IDDMDACHAT",abm."MODEPAIEMENTLIB",abm."FOURNISSEURLIB",abm."MONTANTTVA",abm."MONTANTHT",abm."MONTANTTTC",abm."MONTANTTTCARIARY",abm."IDDEVISELIB",abm."IDDEVISE",abm."ETATLIB",abm."IDSERVICELIB",abm."REFPROFORMA",
    abm.SOMMEACOMPTE,abm.remise,
    CASE
      WHEN abrcp.totalRecept = 0 THEN '0'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande > abrcp.totalRecept THEN '1'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande = abrcp.totalRecept THEN '2'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande < abrcp.totalRecept THEN '3'
      END AS IDTRAITE,
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalRecept = 0 THEN 'Non Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande > abrcp.totalRecept  THEN 'Traité Partiellement'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande = abrcp.totalRecept THEN 'Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande < abrcp.totalRecept THEN 'Traité avec surplus'
        END AS TRAITE
  FROM As_BonDeCommande_MERECPL abm
  left join AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPTGRP abrcp on abrcp.idbc = abm.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MF" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "UNITE", "REMISE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
select bcf."ID",bcf."PRODUIT",bcf."IDBC",bcf."QUANTITE",bcf."PU",bcf."MONTANT",bcf."TVA",bcf."UNITE",bcf."REMISE",
       ab.DATY,
       ab.ETAT,
       ab.REMARQUE,
       ab.DESIGNATION,
       ab.MODEPAIEMENT,
       ab.FOURNISSEUR,
       ab.REFERENCE,
       bcf.TAUXDECHANGE
from AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE bcf
         left outer join AS_BONDECOMMANDE AB on AB.ID = bcf.IDBC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIB" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
select bl.ID,
       bl.REMARQUE,
       bl.IDBC,
       bl.DATY,
       bl.ETAT,
       bl.MAGASIN,
       m.VAL as MAGASINlib,
       case
           when bl.etat = 1 then 'CREE(E)'
           when bl.etat = 11 then 'VISE(E)'
           end as etatlib
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl
    left join MAGASIN m on bl.MAGASIN = m.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIBCPL" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS SELECT AB.ID, AB.REMARQUE, AB.IDVENTE, AB.IDBC, AB.DATY, AB.ETAT, AB.MAGASIN, AB.IDORIGINE, AB.IDCLIENT, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, CASE WHEN AB.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉ' WHEN AB.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN AB.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ' END AS ETATLIB, ( AB.ID || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL || ' | ' || AB.REMARQUE ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT AB LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON AB.MAGASIN = M.ID LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = AB.IDCLIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_lib" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
select bl.ID,
       bl.REMARQUE,
       bl.IDBC,
       bl.DATY,
       bl.ETAT,
       bl.MAGASIN,
       m.VAL as MAGASINlib,
       case
           when bl.etat = 1 then 'CREE(E)'
           when bl.etat = 11 then 'VISE(E)'
           end as etatlib
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl
    left join MAGASIN m on bl.MAGASIN = m.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONC_LIBCPL_A" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT "ID","REMARQUE","IDVENTE","IDBC","DATY","ETAT","MAGASIN","IDORIGINE","IDCLIENT","IDMAGASINLIB","IDCLIENTLIB","ETATLIB" FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIBCPL WHERE etat=0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONC_LIBCPL_C" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT v."ID",v."REMARQUE",v."IDVENTE",v."IDBC",v."DATY",v."ETAT",v."MAGASIN",v."IDORIGINE",v."IDCLIENT",v."IDMAGASINLIB",v."IDCLIENTLIB",v."ETATLIB",v."MOTSCLESSS"
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIBCPL v
WHERE ETAT = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONC_LIBCPL_V" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT v."ID",v."REMARQUE",v."IDVENTE",v."IDBC",v."DATY",v."ETAT",v."MAGASIN",v."IDORIGINE",v."IDCLIENT",v."IDMAGASINLIB",v."IDCLIENTLIB",v."ETATLIB",v."MOTSCLESSS"
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIBCPL v
WHERE ETAT = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_CPL" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDMAGASIN", "MAGASIN", "IDRESERVATION", "IDCLIENTLIB", "VEHICULE", "CHAUFFEUR", "DESCRIPTION", "IDCLIENT") AS
SELECT bl.id, bl.remarque,
v.id AS idvente,
v.designation,
bl.idbc, bl.daty, bl.etat,
m.id AS idmagasin,
m.val AS magasin,
v.IDRESERVATION,
c.nom AS IDCLIENTlib,
bl.vehicule,
bl.chauffeur,
bl.description,
c.id AS idClient
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl
LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON bl.magasin=m.id
LEFT JOIN vente v ON v.id=bl.idvente
LEFT JOIN client c ON c.ID = bl.IDCLIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_CPL2" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDMAGASIN", "MAGASIN", "IDRESERVATION", "IDCLIENTLIB", "VEHICULE", "CHAUFFEUR", "DESCRIPTION", "IDCLIENT") AS
SELECT bl.id, bl.remarque,
       v.id AS idvente,
       v.designation,
       bl.idbc, bl.daty, bl.etat,
       m.id AS idmagasin,
       m.val AS magasin,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       c.nom AS IDCLIENTlib,
       bl.vehicule,
       bl.chauffeur,
       bl.description,
       c.id AS idClient
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON bl.magasin=m.id
         LEFT JOIN vente v ON v.idOrigine=bl.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN client c ON c.ID = bl.IDCLIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_MF" ("IDMERE", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDFILLE", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS
SELECT 
m.id AS idmere, m.remarque, m.idvente, m.idbc, m.daty, m.etat, m.magasin,
f.id AS idfille, f.produit, f.numbl, f.quantite, f.idventedetail, f.unite, f.idbc_fille 
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT m,AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE f WHERE m.id=f.numbl;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE_LIB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS
select bl.ID,
       p.VAL as PRODUIT,
       bl.NUMBL,
       bl.QUANTITE,
       bl.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       u.VAL as UNITE,
       bl.IDBC_FILLE
from As_BonDeLivraison_Fille bl
         left join PRODUIT p on bl.PRODUIT = p.ID
         left join UNITE u on bl.UNITE = u.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE_VIDE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "PRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "NUMBL", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "PU", "DESIGNATION", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
SELECT
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS ID,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS PRODUIT,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS PRODUITLIB ,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS QUANTITE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS UNITE,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS NUMBL,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDBC_FILLE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(200)) AS REMARQUE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDBC ,
	    cast(NULL as DATE ) AS DATY ,
	    cast(-1 as int ) AS ETAT,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(500)) AS MAGASIN ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS UNITELIB ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS MAGASINLIB,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS pu ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS designation,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS tauxdechange
	FROM dual;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR") AS
select bl.ID,
       bl.REMARQUE,
       bl.IDBC,
       bl.DATY,
       bl.ETAT,
       bl.MAGASIN,
       m.VAL as MAGASINlib,
       case
           when bl.etat = 1 then 'CRÉÉ(E)'
           when bl.etat = 11 then 'VISÉ(E)'
           end as etatlib,
       bl.idfournisseur,
       f.nom AS idfournisseurlib,
       bl.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON bl
         left join MAGASIN2 m on bl.MAGASIN = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN fournisseur f ON f.id=bl.idfournisseur;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIBCPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "DESIGNATION", "MONTANT", "PUAR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR") AS
SELECT
	    bl.ID,
	    bl.PRODUIT,
	    bl.NUMBL,
	    bl.QUANTITE,
	    bl.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	    bl.UNITE,
	    bl.IDBC_FILLE,
	    AB.REMARQUE,
	    AB.IDBC,
	    AB.DATY,
	    AB.ETAT,
	    AB.MAGASIN,
	    p.libelle AS PRODUITlib,
	    u.VAL AS UNITElib,
	    m.VAL AS magasinlib,
	    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
	    bl.pu,
	    bl.DESIGNATION,
	    cast(nvl(bl.QUANTITE*bl.PU,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANT,
	    cast(nvl(bl.tauxdechange*bl.PU,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS PUAR,
	    bl.tauxdechange,
        AB.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR -- nanampy colonne IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR pour rapprochement BL - FF
	FROM
	    As_BonDeLivraison_Fille bl
	        LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON AB ON
	        AB.ID = bl.NUMBL
	        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON
	        bl.PRODUIT = p.ID
	        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE  u ON
	        bl.UNITE = u.ID
	        LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON
	        ab.MAGASIN = m.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIVRE" ("IDBC_FILLE", "QTE_LIVRE") AS
select IDBC_FILLE, sum(QUANTITE) as qte_livre
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_MF
group by IDBC_FILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_MF" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT") AS
select blf."ID",blf."PRODUIT",blf."NUMBL",blf."QUANTITE",blf."IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",blf."UNITE",blf."IDBC_FILLE",
       AB.REMARQUE,
       AB.IDBC,
       AB.DATY,
       AB.ETAT

from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE blf
         left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON AB on AB.ID = blf.NUMBL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_TRAITE" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDTRAITE", "TRAITE") AS
SELECT
    abm."ID",abm."REMARQUE",abm."IDBC",abm."DATY",abm."ETAT",abm."MAGASIN",abm."MAGASINLIB",abm."ETATLIB",abm."IDFOURNISSEUR",abm."IDFOURNISSEURLIB",abm."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer > abrcp.totalFacturer THEN '1'
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = abrcp.totallivrer THEN '2'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer < abrcp.totalFacturer THEN '3'
    END AS IDTRAITE,
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = 0 THEN 'Non Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer > abrcp.totalFacturer  THEN 'Traité Partiellement'
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = abrcp.totallivrer THEN 'Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer < abrcp.totalFacturer THEN 'Traité avec surplus'
    END AS TRAITE
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB abm
         left join RAPPROCHEMENT_FFOURNISSEURGRP abrcp on abrcp.NUMBL = abm.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER", "UNITELIB", "PU", "QTEVENTE") AS
SELECT
    abcf.ID,
    abcf.PRODUIT,
    abcf.NUMBL,
    abcf.QUANTITE,
    abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    abcf.UNITE,
    abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
    nvl(p.LIBELLEVENTE,p.libelle) AS idproduitlib,
    vd.idvente,
    abc.idbc,
    CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
    CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer,
    u.val AS uniteLib,
    vd.PU,
    vd.qte as qtevente
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf
         LEFT JOIN as_ingredients p ON p.id = abcf.produit
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL and vd.IDPRODUIT = abcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
         LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON u.id = abcf.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL2" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER", "UNITELIB", "PU", "QTEVENTE") AS
SELECT
    abcf.ID,
    abcf.PRODUIT,
    abcf.NUMBL,
    abcf.QUANTITE,
    vd.id as IDVENTEDETAIL,
    abcf.UNITE,
    abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
    abc.IDVENTE as idvente,
    abc.idbc,
    CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
    CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer,
    u.val AS uniteLib,
    vd.PU,
    vd.qte as qtevente
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf
         LEFT JOIN as_ingredients p ON p.id = abcf.produit
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_CPL2 abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.IDVENTE = abc.IDVENTE and vd.IDPRODUIT = abcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON u.id = abcf.UNITE
where p.ACTIF = 1;

SELECT ing.id,
       ing.LIBELLE,
       ing.PARFUMS,
       CAST(ing.SEUIL AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS SEUIL ,
       au.VAL AS unite,
       CAST(ing.QUANTITEPARPACK AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS QUANTITEPARPACK,
       CAST(ing.pu AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS pu,
       ing.ACTIF,
       ing.PHOTO,
       ing.CALORIE,
       ing.DURRE,
       ing.COMPOSE,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
                   WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 0 THEN 'NON'
                   END AS VARCHAR2(100)
       ) AS COMPOSELIB,
       cating.id AS IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,
       catIng.VAL AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS idcategorie,
       ing.idfournisseur,
       ing.daty,
       catIng.desce as bienOuServ,
       CASE WHEN ing.id IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
                THEN 'INDISPONIBLE'
            WHEN ing.id NOT IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
                THEN 'DISPONIBLE'
           END AS etatlib,
       ing.COMPTE_VENTE,
       ing.COMPTE_ACHAT,
       CAST(ing.pv AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS pv,
       CAST(ing.tva AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS tva,
       ing.TYPESTOCK,
       ing.UNITE as idunite,
       ing.REFPOST,

       eq.QUANTITE as nbpiece,
       tp.val AS typeproduitLib,
       ing.COMPTE_RISTOURNE,
       ing.isAchat

         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON ing.UNITE = AU.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB catIng
                   ON catIng.id = ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN POSTE p ON p.id = ing.REFPOST
         LEFT JOIN FAMILLEPRODUIT fp ON fp.id=ing.idfamille
         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.id = ing.REFQUALIFICATION
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID=ing.typeProduit
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON ing.idFournisseur = f.id
         LEFT JOIN departement dep ON dep.id=ing.parfums
         Left join EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT1 = ing.ID;

SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.LIBELLE,SQ.PARFUMS,SQ.SEUIL,SQ.UNITE,SQ.QUANTITEPARPACK,SQ.PU,SQ.ACTIF,SQ.PHOTO,SQ.CALORIE,SQ.DURRE,SQ.COMPOSE,SQ.COMPOSELIB,SQ.IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT,SQ.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,SQ.IDCATEGORIE,SQ.IDFOURNISSEUR,SQ.DATY,SQ.BIENOUSERV,SQ.ETATLIB,SQ.COMPTE_VENTE,SQ.COMPTE_ACHAT,SQ.PV,SQ.TVA,SQ.TYPESTOCK,SQ.IDUNITE,SQ.REFPOST,SQ.REFQUALIFICATION,SQ.REFPOSTLIB,SQ.REFQUALIFICATIONLIB,SQ.IDFAMILLELIB,SQ.TYPEPRODUIT,SQ.IDLIGNE,SQ.COMPTE_STOCK,SQ.COMPTE_SORTIE_STOCK,SQ.IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PARFUMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SEUIL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(UNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QUANTITEPARPACK),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ACTIF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PHOTO),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CALORIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DURRE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPOSE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPOSELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CATEGORIEINGREDIENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDCATEGORIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFOURNISSEUR),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(BIENOUSERV),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETATLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE_VENTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE_ACHAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PV),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TVA),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TYPESTOCK),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDUNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REFPOST),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REFQUALIFICATION),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REFPOSTLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REFQUALIFICATIONLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFAMILLELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TYPEPRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDLIGNE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE_STOCK),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE_SORTIE_STOCK),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFOURNISSEURLIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT ing.id,
	                ing.LIBELLE,
	                ing.PARFUMS,
	                ing.SEUIL,
	                au.VAL AS unite,
	                ing.QUANTITEPARPACK,
	                ing.pu,
	                ing.ACTIF,
	                ing.PHOTO,
	                ing.CALORIE,
	                ing.DURRE,
	                ing.COMPOSE,
	                CAST(
	                        CASE
	                            WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
	                            WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 0 THEN 'NON'
	                            END AS VARCHAR2(100)
	                ) AS COMPOSELIB,
	                cating.id AS IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,
	                catIng.VAL AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
	                ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS idcategorie,
	                ing.idfournisseur,
	                ing.daty,
	                catIng.desce as bienOuServ,
	                CASE WHEN ing.id IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
	                         THEN 'INDISPONIBLE'
	                     WHEN ing.id NOT IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
	                         THEN 'DISPONIBLE'
	                    END AS etatlib,
	                ing.COMPTE_VENTE,
	                ing.COMPTE_ACHAT,
	                ing.pv,
	                ing.tva,
	                ing.TYPESTOCK,
	                ing.UNITE as idunite,
	                ing.REFPOST,
	                ing.REFQUALIFICATION ,
	                p.VAL AS REFPOSTLIB,
	                qp.VAL AS REFQUALIFICATIONLIB,
	                fp.val AS idfamilleLib,
	                ing.typeProduit,
	                tp.idligne,
	                ing.compte_stock,
	                ing.compte_sortie_stock,
	                f.nom as idFournisseurLib
	         FROM as_ingredients ing
	                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON ing.UNITE = AU.ID
	                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB catIng
	                            ON catIng.id = ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
	                  LEFT JOIN POSTE p ON p.id = ing.REFPOST
	                  LEFT JOIN FAMILLEPRODUIT fp ON fp.id=ing.idfamille
	                  LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.id = ing.REFQUALIFICATION
	                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID=ing.typeProduit
	                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON ing.idFournisseur = f.id
	                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim ON aim.IDINGREDIENT=ing.id
	         WHERE aim.IDINGREDIENT IS NOT NULL AND aim.identite='ENT000004'
	     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE_LIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENT", "IDENTITE", "REFERENCEOBJET", "MARQUEOBJET", "MODELEOBJET", "NUMEROSERIEOBJET", "DESCRIPTIONOBJET", "QUALITEOBJET", "ETATOBJET", "LOCALISATIONOBJET", "PUISSANCEOBJET", "OBSERVATIONOBJET", "TYPERATTACHEMENT", "ESTENGIN", "LIBELLE", "DATEAQUISITION", "INGREDIENTLIB", "IDENTITELIB", "QUALITEOBJETLIB", "ETATOBJETLIB", "LOCALISATIONOBJETLIB", "ESTENGINLIB", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB", "PU", "MOTSCLESSS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    am.ID,
    am.IDINGREDIENT,
    am.IDENTITE,
    am.REFERENCEOBJET,
    am.MARQUEOBJET,
    am.MODELEOBJET,
    am.NUMEROSERIEOBJET,
    am.DESCRIPTIONOBJET,
    am.QUALITEOBJET,
    am.ETATOBJET,
    am.LOCALISATIONOBJET,
    am.PUISSANCEOBJET,
    am.OBSERVATIONOBJET,
    am.TYPERATTACHEMENT,
    am.ESTENGIN,
    am.LIBELLE,
    am.DATEAQUISITION,

    ai.libelle AS INGREDIENTLIB,
    am.IDENTITE AS IDENTITELIB,
    qo.VAL AS QUALITEOBJETLIB,
    eo.VAL AS ETATOBJETLIB,
    ld.val AS localisationObjetLib,

    CASE
        WHEN am.ESTENGIN = 1 THEN 'Oui'
        ELSE 'Non'
        END AS ESTENGINLIB,

    l.id AS idligne,
    l.val AS idlignelib,
    am.pu AS PU,

    (
        NVL(am.ID, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(ai.libelle, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(am.IDENTITE, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(qo.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(eo.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(ld.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(l.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(am.LIBELLE, '')
        ) AS MOTSCLESSS,
    ai.parfums AS iddepartement,
    de.val AS iddepartementlib

FROM AS_INGREDIENTS ai
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE am ON ai.ID = am.IDINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN QUALITESOBJETMAINTENANCE qo ON am.QUALITEOBJET = qo.ID
         LEFT JOIN ETATOBJETMAINTENANCE eo ON am.ETATOBJET = eo.ID
         LEFT JOIN LOG_DEPARTEMENT ld ON am.LOCALISATIONOBJET = ld.ID
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE l ON l.ID = am.IDLIGNE
         LEFT JOIN departement de ON de.id=ai.parfums;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_INGREDIENT_PIECE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENT", "IDENTITE", "REFERENCEOBJET", "MARQUEOBJET", "MODELEOBJET", "NUMEROSERIEOBJET", "DESCRIPTIONOBJET", "QUALITEOBJET", "ETATOBJET", "LOCALISATIONOBJET", "PUISSANCEOBJET", "OBSERVATIONOBJET", "TYPERATTACHEMENT", "ESTENGIN", "LIBELLE", "DATEAQUISITION", "INGREDIENTLIB", "IDENTITELIB", "QUALITEOBJETLIB", "ETATOBJETLIB", "LOCALISATIONOBJETLIB", "ESTENGINLIB", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB", "PU") AS
SELECT "ID","IDINGREDIENT","IDENTITE","REFERENCEOBJET","MARQUEOBJET","MODELEOBJET","NUMEROSERIEOBJET","DESCRIPTIONOBJET","QUALITEOBJET","ETATOBJET","LOCALISATIONOBJET","PUISSANCEOBJET","OBSERVATIONOBJET","TYPERATTACHEMENT","ESTENGIN","LIBELLE","DATEAQUISITION","INGREDIENTLIB","IDENTITELIB","QUALITEOBJETLIB","ETATOBJETLIB","LOCALISATIONOBJETLIB","ESTENGINLIB","IDLIGNE","IDLIGNELIB","PU" FROM As_ingredient_maintenance_lib WHERE IDENTITE = 'ENT000004';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_INGREDIENT_VENTE_LIB" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "TVA", "FILEPATH", "RESTE", "TYPESTOCK", "REFPOST", "REFQUALIFICATION", "IDCHAMBRE", "ISPERISHABLE", "PV2", "IDMAGASIN", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "POIDS", "QUANTITE", "TARIFMAGASIN", "UNITE2") AS
select ing.ID,
	       --concat(concat(ing.LIBELLE, ' '), ing.PARFUMS) as LIBELLE,
  	   nvl(ing.LIBELLEVENTE, ing.libelle) as LIBELLE,
       CAST(ing.SEUIL AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS  SEUIL,
       ing.UNITE,
       CAST(ing.QUANTITEPARPACK AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS QUANTITEPARPACK ,
       CAST(ing.PU AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU,
       ing.ACTIF,
       ing.PHOTO,
       ing.CALORIE,
       ing.DURRE,
       ing.COMPOSE,
       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
       ing.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       ing.DATY,
       CAST(ing.QTELIMITE AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS QTELIMITE,
       CAST(ing.PV AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PV,
       ing.LIBELLEVENTE,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.SEUILMIN,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMIN,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.SEUILMAX,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMAX,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUACHATUSD,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATUSD,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUACHATEURO,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATEURO,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUVENTEUSD,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEUSD,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUVENTEEURO,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEEURO,
       CAST(COALESCE(ing.PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE,
       ing.ISVENTE,
       ing.ISACHAT,
       ing.COMPTE_VENTE,
       ing.COMPTE_ACHAT,
       ing.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
       CAST(ing.TVA AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS TVA,
       ing.FILEPATH,
       CAST(ing.RESTE AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS RESTE,
       ing.TYPESTOCK,
       ing.REFPOST,
       ing.REFQUALIFICATION,
       ing.IDCHAMBRE,
       ing.ISPERISHABLE,
       ing.PV2,
       ing.IDMAGASIN,
       CAST(nvl(ting.PRIXUNITAIRE,ing.PV)  AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PRIXUNITAIRE,
       tc.ID as IDTYPECLIENT,
       tc.VAL as idtypeclientlib,
       nvl(un.id,un2.id) as idunite,
       nvl(un.VAL,un2.val) as idunitelib,
       CAST(eq.POIDS  AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS POIDS,
       CAST(eq.QUANTITE AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QUANTITE,
       ting.IDMAGASIN as TARIFMAGASIN,
       nvl(un.VAL,un2.val) as UNITE2
from AS_INGREDIENTS ing
         cross join TYPECLIENT tc
         left join TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX ting on ing.ID = TING.IDINGREDIENT AND ting.IDTYPECLIENT=tc.id
         left join AS_UNITE un on un.ID = TING.UNITE
         left join AS_UNITE un2 on un2.ID = ing.UNITE
         left join EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT2 = ting.IDINGREDIENT
WHERE ing.ISVENTE = 1 AND ing.ACTIF=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_MACHINE" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "PARFUMS", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "COMPOSELIB", "IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "BIENOUSERV", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "PV", "TVA", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITE", "REFPOST", "REFQUALIFICATION", "REFPOSTLIB", "REFQUALIFICATIONLIB", "IDFAMILLELIB") AS
SELECT "ID","LIBELLE","PARFUMS","SEUIL","UNITE","QUANTITEPARPACK","PU","ACTIF","PHOTO","CALORIE","DURRE","COMPOSE","COMPOSELIB","IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT","CATEGORIEINGREDIENT","IDCATEGORIE","IDFOURNISSEUR","DATY","BIENOUSERV","ETATLIB","COMPTE_VENTE","COMPTE_ACHAT","PV","TVA","TYPESTOCK","IDUNITE","REFPOST","REFQUALIFICATION","REFPOSTLIB","REFQUALIFICATIONLIB","IDFAMILLELIB" FROM AS_INGREDIENTS_LIB ai WHERE ai.IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT005';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_PRODUITS" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
select "ID","LIBELLE","SEUIL","UNITE","QUANTITEPARPACK","PU","ACTIF","PHOTO","CALORIE","DURRE","COMPOSE","CATEGORIEINGREDIENT","IDFOURNISSEUR","DATY","QTELIMITE","PV","LIBELLEVENTE","SEUILMIN","SEUILMAX","PUACHATUSD","PUACHATEURO","PUACHATAUTREDEVISE","PUVENTEUSD","PUVENTEEURO","PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE","ISVENTE","ISACHAT","COMPTE_VENTE","COMPTE_ACHAT" from AS_INGREDIENTS where pv>0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEBC" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "COMPOSE") AS
select offi.id,offi.idbc as IDPRODUITS,offi.PRODUIT as idingredients,
cast(cast(offi.quantite as number(20,2))*cast(nvl(e.qte,1) as number(20,2)) as number(20,2)) as quantite,ing.unite,ing.compose from BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE offi left join equivalence e
on e.idproduit=offi.PRODUIT and e.idunite=offi.unite
left join as_ingredients ing on ing.id=offi.PRODUIT
union all
select "ID","IDPRODUITS","IDINGREDIENTS",cast (QUANTITE as number(20,2))as quantite,"UNITE","COMPOSE" from AS_RECETTECOMPOSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTECOMPOSE" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "COMPOSE", "TYPESTOCK", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT") AS
select r.ID,
       r.IDPRODUITS,
       r.IDINGREDIENTS,
       CAST(r.QUANTITE AS NUMBER(30,
                                 10)) AS quantite,
       nvl(r.UNITE, u.VAL) as unite,
       ing.compose,
       ing.TYPESTOCK,
       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
FROM
    as_recette r,
    as_ingredients ing,
    as_unite u
WHERE
    r.IDINGREDIENTS = ing.id(+)
  and ing.UNITE=u.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEFAB" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "VAL", "COMPOSE") AS
select offi.id,offi.idMere as IDPRODUITS,offi.idingredients,
cast(offi.qte*nvl(e.qte,1) as number(30,10))as quantite,u.val,ing.compose from FabricationFille offi left join equivalence e
on e.idproduit=offi.idingredients and e.idunite=offi.idunite
left join as_ingredients ing on ing.id=offi.idingredients
left join as_unite u on ing.UNITE=u.id
union all
select "ID","IDPRODUITS","IDINGREDIENTS",cast (QUANTITE as number(30,10))as quantite,"UNITE","COMPOSE" from AS_RECETTECOMPOSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEFABLIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QTEAV", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITS", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "TYPESTOCK", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "PU", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS
select 
	arf.ID,
	arf.IDINGREDIENTS,
	arf.UNITE,
	arf.QTEAV,
	arf.QUANTITE,
	arf.IDPRODUITS,
	i.LIBELLE ||' ('||u.VAL||')' as libIngredients,
	i.TYPESTOCK,
	i.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
	i.pu,
	cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from as_recettefabrication arf
left join AS_INGREDIENTS i 
on arf.idingredients=i.id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat 
ON cat.id=i.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT  
left join AS_UNITE u on i.UNITE=u.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEFABLIBSERVICE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QTEAV", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITS", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "TYPESTOCK", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT") AS
SELECT ID,IDINGREDIENTS,UNITE,QTEAV,QUANTITE,IDPRODUITS,LIBINGREDIENTS,TYPESTOCK,categorieingredient FROM As_recetteFabLib WHERE TYPESTOCK IS NULL AND UNITE = 'UNT003' AND CATEGORIEINGREDIENT!='CAT002';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEOF" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "COMPOSE") AS
SELECT
    id,
    IDPRODUITS,
    IDINGREDIENTS,
    CAST(quantite AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS quantite,
    unite,
    compose
FROM (
    SELECT
        offi.id,
        offi.idMere AS IDPRODUITS,
        offi.idingredients AS IDINGREDIENTS,
        CAST(offi.qte AS NUMBER(30,10)) * CAST(NVL(e.qte, 1) AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS quantite,
        ing.unite,
        ing.compose
    FROM
        OFFille offi
    LEFT JOIN equivalence e ON
        e.idproduit = offi.idingredients
        AND e.idunite = offi.idunite
    LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ing ON
        ing.id = offi.idingredients
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
        ID,
        IDPRODUITS,
        IDINGREDIENTS,
        QUANTITE,
        UNITE,
        COMPOSE
    FROM
        AS_RECETTECOMPOSE
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEOFABRICATION" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "COMPOSE") AS
select offi.id,fab.ID as IDPRODUITS,offi.IDINGREDIENTS as idingredients,
cast(cast(offi.QTE as number(20,2))*cast(nvl(e.qte,1) as number(20,2)) as number(20,2)) as quantite,ing.unite,ing.compose from OFFILLE offi left join equivalence e
on e.idproduit=offi.IDINGREDIENTS and e.idunite=offi.IDUNITE
left join as_ingredients ing on ing.id=offi.IDINGREDIENTS
left join OFAB fab on offi.IDMERE=fab.ID
union all
select ID,IDPRODUITS,IDINGREDIENTS,cast (QUANTITE as number(20,2))as quantite,UNITE,COMPOSE from AS_RECETTECOMPOSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEOFF" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "COMPOSE") AS
select offi.id,offi.ID as IDPRODUITS,offi.IDINGREDIENTS as idingredients,
cast(cast(offi.QTE as number(30,10))*cast(nvl(e.qte,1) as number(30,10)) as number(30,10)) as quantite,ing.unite,ing.compose from OFFILLE offi left join equivalence e
on e.idproduit=offi.IDINGREDIENTS and e.idunite=offi.IDUNITE
left join as_ingredients ing on ing.id=offi.IDINGREDIENTS
union all
select ID,IDPRODUITS,IDINGREDIENTS,cast (QUANTITE as number(30,10))as quantite,UNITE,COMPOSE from AS_RECETTECOMPOSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTEREC" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "VAL", "COMPOSE") AS
select offi.id,offi.id as IDPRODUITS,offi.idingredients,
cast(offi.quantite*nvl(e.qte,1) as number(30,10))as quantite,u.val,ing.compose from as_recette offi left join equivalence e
on e.idproduit=offi.idingredients and e.idunite=offi.unite
left join as_ingredients ing on ing.id=offi.idingredients
left join as_unite u on ing.UNITE=u.id
union all
select "ID","IDPRODUITS","IDINGREDIENTS",cast (QUANTITE as number(30,10))as quantite,"UNITE","COMPOSE" from AS_RECETTECOMPOSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTE_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "LIBELLEINGREDIENT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "IDUNITE", "VALUNITE", "PU") AS
select rec."ID",rec."IDPRODUITS",rec."IDINGREDIENTS",rec."QUANTITE",ing."UNITE",
ing.LIBELLE as libelleingredient,
       ing2.libelle as libelleproduit,
un.id as idunite,
un.val as valunite,
ing.pu
from as_recette rec
left join as_ingredients ing on
ing.id=rec.idingredients
left join as_ingredients ing2 on
ing2.id=rec.IDPRODUITS
left join as_unite un on
un.id=ing.unite
order by rec.id asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTE_LIB_CAT" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "LIBELLEINGREDIENT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "IDUNITE", "VALUNITE", "PU", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIELIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS
SELECT arl."ID",arl."IDPRODUITS",arl."IDINGREDIENTS",arl."QUANTITE",arl."UNITE",arl."LIBELLEINGREDIENT",arl."LIBELLEPRODUIT",arl."IDUNITE",arl."VALUNITE",arl."PU",c.ID AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT , c.VAL AS categorielib, ai.COMPTE_VENTE ,ai.COMPTE_ACHAT  FROM 
	AS_RECETTE_LIBCOMPLET arl 
	JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = arl.IDINGREDIENTS 
	JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON c.ID = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECETTE_MAINTENANCE_LIB" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITSLIB", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "IDINGREDIENTSMAINTENANCE", "UNITELIB") AS
select
             ar."ID",ar."IDPRODUITS",ar."IDINGREDIENTS",ar."UNITE",ar."QUANTITE" ,
             ai2.LIBELLE AS idProduitslib,
             ai.LIBELLE  AS idIngredientsLib,
             aim.id AS idIngredientsMaintenance,
             au.val AS uniteLib
         FROM AS_recette ar
                  LEFT JOIN As_ingredients ai ON ai.id = ar.IDINGREDIENTS
                  LEFT JOIN As_ingredients ai2 ON ai2.id = ar.IDPRODUITS
                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON ai.unite = au.id
                  JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim ON aim.IDINGREDIENT  = ai2.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECFOFABLIBGROUPE" ("IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QUANTITE", "QTEAV", "PU", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS
select 
	fille.IDMERE as IDPRODUITS,
	a.idingredients,
	max(a.unite) as unite,
	sum(quantite) as quantite,
	avg(a.qteav) as qteav,
	CAST(avg(a.pu) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
	a.libIngredients,
	a.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
	a.CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from as_recetteFabLib a 
left join fabrication fab on a.IDPRODUITS=fab.ID
left join OFFILLE fille on fab.IDOFFILLE=fille.id
group by fille.idMere, a.idingredients, a.libIngredients, a.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, a.CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECOFFVUE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QTEAV", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITS", "IDUNITE", "COMPOSE", "NIVEAU", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "RESTESTOCK", "TYPESTOCK") AS
SELECT
    ar.ID,ar.IDINGREDIENTS,ar.UNITE,ar.QTEAV,ar.QUANTITE,ar.IDPRODUITS,ar.IDUNITE,ar.COMPOSE,ar.NIVEAU,
    ai.LIBELLE AS libIngredients,cast(0 as number(30,10)) as resteStock,ai.TYPESTOCK
FROM AS_RECETTEOFFFABTABLE ar
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ar.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECOFFVUERESTEST" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QTEAV", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITS", "IDUNITE", "COMPOSE", "NIVEAU", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "RESTESTOCK", "RAF", "TYPESTOCK") AS
SELECT 
a.ID,a.IDINGREDIENTS,a.UNITE,a.QTEAV,a.QUANTITE,a.IDPRODUITS,a.IDUNITE,a.COMPOSE,a.NIVEAU,a.LIBINGREDIENTS,
a.resteStock,
CAST( nvl(a.QUANTITE,0) - nvl(a.RESTESTOCK,0) AS NUMBER(30,10))  AS raf,a.TYPESTOCK
FROM as_recOffVue a;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_RECOFFVUESTFAB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QTEAV", "QUANTITE", "IDPRODUITS", "IDUNITE", "COMPOSE", "NIVEAU", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "RESTESTOCK", "RAF", "FABENCOURS", "TYPESTOCK") AS
SELECT
    a."ID",
    a."IDINGREDIENTS",
    a."UNITE",
    a."QTEAV",
    a."QUANTITE",
    a."IDPRODUITS",
    a."IDUNITE",
    a."COMPOSE",
    a."NIVEAU",
    a."LIBINGREDIENTS",
    a."RESTESTOCK",
    CAST(a.RAF AS NUMBER(30,10)) AS RAF,
    NVL(f.FabEncours,0) AS FabEncours,
    a.TYPESTOCK
  FROM as_recOffVueResteSt a
  LEFT JOIN FabricationEncours f
    ON f.IDINGREDIENTS = a.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_UNITE_ACTIF" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "ACTIF") AS
select "ID","VAL","DESCE","ACTIF" from AS_UNITE where ACTIF=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ATTRIBUTIONELEMENTLIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCE", "IDPERSONNEL", "DATY", "ETATELEMENT", "TYPEATTRIBUTION", "IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCELIB", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "QUALITEOBJETMAINTENANCELIB", "TYPEATTRIBUTIONLIB", "QTE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
select
	    attr.ID,attr.IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCE,attr.IDPERSONNEL,attr.DATY,attr.ETATELEMENT,attr.TYPEATTRIBUTION,
	    asing.LIBELLE as IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCELIB,
	    pers.NOM as idPersonnelLib,
	    qom.VAL as qualiteObjetMaintenanceLib,
	    case
	        when attr.TYPEATTRIBUTION = 0 then 'Sortie'
	        when attr.TYPEATTRIBUTION = 1 then 'Retour'
	        else 'Inconnu'
	        end as typeAttributionLib,
	    attr.qte AS qte,
	    attr.etat,
	    case
	        when attr.etat = 1 then 'Creee'
	        when attr.etat = 11 then 'Visee'
	        when attr.etat = 0 then 'Annulee'
	        end as etatLib,
	    attr.id || asing.libelle || pers.nom || qom.val AS motsclesss
	from
	    ATTRIBUTIONELEMENT attr
	        left join AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ingm on attr.IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCE = ingm.ID
	        left join AS_INGREDIENTS asing on ingm.IDINGREDIENT = asing.ID
	        left join PERSONNEL pers on attr.IDPERSONNEL = pers.ID
	        left join QUALITESOBJETMAINTENANCE qom on attr.ETATELEMENT = qom.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AUTOLIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENT", "DESCRIPTION", "NUMERODEPARC", "DATEPREMIEREMISEENCIRCULATION", "IMMATRICULATION", "NOTE", "FOURNISSEUR", "NUMERO", "VOLUME", "MONTANT", "TYPE", "VIN", "MARQUE", "MODELE", "ANNEE", "NOMBREDEPLACES", "NOMBREDEPORTES", "PUISSANCEFISCALE", "BAILLEUR", "VALEURINITIALE", "DATEDEBUT", "DURREEENMOIS", "MENSUALITE", "VENDEUR", "PRIX", "DATEDACHAT", "NUMERODIMMOBILISATION", "DUREEDAMORTISSEMENTENMOIS", "PNEUS", "BATTERIE", "HUILEMOTEUR", "HUILEBOITEDEVITESSE", "TYPEDECARBURANT", "CONSOMMATION", "UNITEDECONSOMMATION", "TYPECARBURANTLIB", "UNITEDECONSOMMATIONLIB") AS
select ia."ID",ia."IDINGREDIENT",ia."DESCRIPTION",ia."NUMERODEPARC",ia."DATEPREMIEREMISEENCIRCULATION",ia."IMMATRICULATION",ia."NOTE",ia."FOURNISSEUR",ia."NUMERO",ia."VOLUME",ia."MONTANT",ia."TYPE",ia."VIN",ia."MARQUE",ia."MODELE",ia."ANNEE",ia."NOMBREDEPLACES",ia."NOMBREDEPORTES",ia."PUISSANCEFISCALE",ia."BAILLEUR",ia."VALEURINITIALE",ia."DATEDEBUT",ia."DURREEENMOIS",ia."MENSUALITE",ia."VENDEUR",ia."PRIX",ia."DATEDACHAT",ia."NUMERODIMMOBILISATION",ia."DUREEDAMORTISSEMENTENMOIS",ia."PNEUS",ia."BATTERIE",ia."HUILEMOTEUR",ia."HUILEBOITEDEVITESSE",ia."TYPEDECARBURANT",ia."CONSOMMATION",ia."UNITEDECONSOMMATION", tc.val as typecarburantlib, uc.val as UNITEDECONSOMMATIONLIB from INFOSAUTO ia
                                                                                   left join Typecarburant tc on ia.TYPEDECARBURANT = tc.id
                                                                                   left join uniteconso uc on ia.UNITEDECONSOMMATION = uc.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AUTOMAINTENANCE" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE") AS
select
    im.ID,
    ai.LIBELLE as val,
    ' ' as desce
from AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE im
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ai on im.IDINGREDIENT = ai.ID
where im.IDENTITE = 'ENT000003';
