CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVANCE_LIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MONTANT", "NBREMBOURSEMENT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "DATEAVANCE", "INTERET", "ETAT", "IDTYPEAVANCE", "MATRICULE", "DATEDEBUTREMBOURSEMENT") AS
SELECT av.id,
       (log.nom || ' ') || log.prenom AS idpersonnel,
       av.montant,
       av.nbremboursement,
       av.remarque,
       av.daty,
       av.dateavance,
       av.interet,
       av.etat,
       ty.val AS idtypeavance,
       p.matricule,
       av.DATEDEBUTREMBOURSEMENT
FROM avance av
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel log ON av.idpersonnel = log.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel p ON p.id = log.id
         LEFT JOIN typeavance ty ON ty.id = av.idtypeavance;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVANCE_LIB2" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MONTANT", "NBREMBOURSEMENT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "DATEAVANCE", "INTERET", "ETAT", "DATEDEBLOCAGE", "DATEDEBUTREMBOURSEMENT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPEAVANCE", "IDTYPEAVANCELIB", "MATRICULE", "MOISLIB", "MOIS", "DATESAISIE") AS SELECT av.id, (log.nom || ' ') || log.prenom AS idpersonnel, av.montant, av.nbremboursement, av.remarque, av.daty, av.dateavance, av.interet, av.etat, av.DATEDEBLOCAGE, av.DATEDEBUTREMBOURSEMENT, CASE WHEN av.etat = 1 THEN 'creee' WHEN av.etat = 11 THEN 'validee et impayee' WHEN av.etat = 21 THEN 'validee et payee ' ELSE NULL END AS etatlib, av.idtypeavance, ty.val AS idtypeavancelib, p.matricule, TO_CHAR( TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(av.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'), 'FMMonth', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH' ) AS moisLib, av.MOIS, av.dateSaisie FROM avance av LEFT JOIN log_personnel log ON av.idpersonnel = log.id LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel p ON p.id = log.id LEFT JOIN typeavance ty ON ty.id = av.idtypeavance ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(matricule, '[^0-9]', ''));

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVANCE_LIB_CREE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MONTANT", "NBREMBOURSEMENT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "DATEAVANCE", "INTERET", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPEAVANCE", "IDTYPEAVANCELIB", "MATRICULE") AS
select "ID","IDPERSONNEL","MONTANT","NBREMBOURSEMENT","REMARQUE","DATY","DATEAVANCE","INTERET","ETAT","ETATLIB","IDTYPEAVANCE","IDTYPEAVANCELIB","MATRICULE" from AVANCE_LIB2 where etat = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVANCE_LIB_PAYE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MONTANT", "NBREMBOURSEMENT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "DATEAVANCE", "INTERET", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPEAVANCE", "IDTYPEAVANCELIB", "MATRICULE") AS
select "ID","IDPERSONNEL","MONTANT","NBREMBOURSEMENT","REMARQUE","DATY","DATEAVANCE","INTERET","ETAT","ETATLIB","IDTYPEAVANCE","IDTYPEAVANCELIB","MATRICULE" from AVANCE_LIB2 where etat = 21;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVANCE_LIB_VISEE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MONTANT", "NBREMBOURSEMENT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "DATEAVANCE", "INTERET", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPEAVANCE", "IDTYPEAVANCELIB", "MATRICULE") AS
select "ID","IDPERSONNEL","MONTANT","NBREMBOURSEMENT","REMARQUE","DATY","DATEAVANCE","INTERET","ETAT","ETATLIB","IDTYPEAVANCE","IDTYPEAVANCELIB","MATRICULE" from AVANCE_LIB2 where etat = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATCALC" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFACTURE", "REMISE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select v."ID",v."DESIGNATION",v."IDMAGASIN",v."DATY",v."REMARQUE",v."ETAT",v."IDFOURNISSEUR",v."IDFACTURE",v."REMISE", cast(montantRemiseSansTva+ (montantHT* (nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantRemise, montantNonRemise,
       cast(montantHT*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(montantTva*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(montantTTC*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC, montantTTCAr*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantTTCAr
from AVOIRACHAT v left join AvoirAChatFilleCalcGroupe vdcv on v.id=vdcv.idAvoirAchat;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATCALCGROUPEORIGINE" ("IDFACTURE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select aa.IDFACTURE ,cast(sum(montantNonRemise) as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,cast(sum(montantRemiseSansTva) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr
from AvoirAChatFilleCalc vdc left join avoirAchat aa on aa.id=vdc.IDMERE where aa.ETAT>=11   group by aa.IDFACTURE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATCALC_AVEC_LIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFACTURE", "REMISE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "ETATLIB", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB") AS
select a."ID",
       a."DESIGNATION",
       a."IDMAGASIN",
       a."DATY",
       a."REMARQUE",
       a."ETAT",
       a."IDFOURNISSEUR",
       a."IDFACTURE",
       a."REMISE",
       a."MONTANTREMISE",
       a."MONTANTNONREMISE",
       a."MONTANTHT",
       a."MONTANTTVA",
       a."MONTANTTTC",
       a."MONTANTTTCAR",
       case
           when a.etat = 1 then 'CRÉÉ(E)'
           when a.etat = 11 then 'VISÉ(E)'
           when a.etat = 11 then 'ANNULÉ(E)'
           end as etatlib,
       m.VAL AS idmagasinLib,
       f.nom AS idfournisseurLib
from AVOIRACHATCALC a
         left join AvoirAChatFilleCalcGroupe vdcv on a.id = vdcv.idAvoirAchat
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON a.IDMAGASIN = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON a.IDFOURNISSEUR = f.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATFILLECALC" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX", "DESIGNATION", "IDFACTUREDETAILS", "RISTOURNE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select vd."ID",vd."IDMERE",vd."IDPRODUIT",vd."QTE",vd."PU",vd."REMISE",vd."TVA",vd."IDDEVISE",vd."TAUX",vd."DESIGNATION",vd."IDFACTUREDETAILS",vd."RISTOURNE",vd."TAUXDECHANGE",cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*((nvl(vd.REMISE,0)+nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0))/100) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,
       cast(vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as puRemise,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1)*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr from AVOIRAchatFILLE vd;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATFILLECALCGROUPE" ("IDAVOIRACHAT", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select vdc.IDMERE as idAvoirAchat ,cast(sum(montantNonRemise) as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,cast(sum(montantRemiseSansTva) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr
from AvoirAChatFilleCalc vdc group by vdc.IDMERE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX", "DESIGNATION", "IDFACTUREDETAILS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDDEVISELIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC") AS
SELECT
    af.ID,
    af.IDMERE,
    af.IDPRODUIT,
    af.QTE,
    af.PU,
    af.REMISE,
    af.TVA,
    af.IDDEVISE,
    af.TAUX,
    af.DESIGNATION,
    af.IDFACTUREDETAILS,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    d.val AS iddeviseLib,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1 Montant HT brut
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST(af.QTE * af.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montant,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2 Montant remise (appliquee sur HT)
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3 Montant HT net apres remise
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantht,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4 TVA sur montant HT net
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST(((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU))) * af.TVA / 100 AS NUMBER(30, 2))AS montanttva,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5 Montant TTC net (HT net + TVA)
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST( ((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU))) + ( ((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU)))  * af.TVA / 100  ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc
FROM AVOIRACHATFILLE af
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON af.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
    LEFT JOIN DEVISE d ON af.IDDEVISE = d.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRACHATLIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFACTURE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB") AS
SELECT a.ID,a.DESIGNATION,a.IDMAGASIN,a.DATY,a.REMARQUE,a.ETAT,a.IDFOURNISSEUR,a.IDFACTURE, m.VAL AS idmagasinLib, f.nom AS idfournisseurLib
FROM AVOIRACHAT a
    LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON a.IDMAGASIN = m.ID
    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON a.IDFOURNISSEUR = f.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDAVOIRFC", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "IDVENTEDETAILS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CALORIE", "POIDS", "PTHT", "MONTANTTVA") AS
SELECT
    AF.ID,
    AF.IDAVOIRFC,
    AF.IDPRODUIT,
    AF.IDORIGINE,
    AF.QTE,
    AF.PU,
    AF.REMISE,
    AF.TVA,
    AF.PUACHAT,
    AF.PUVENTE,
    AF.IDDEVISE,
    AF.TAUXDECHANGE,
    AF.DESIGNATION,
    AF.IDVENTEDETAILS,
    nvl(P.libellevente,P.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    P.CALORIE,
    P.CALORIE * AF.QTE AS POIDS,
    AF.PU * AF.QTE AS PTHT,
    (NVL(AF.pu,0) * NVL(AF.QTE,0)) * NVL(AF.TVA,0) / 100 AS montantTVA
FROM
    AVOIRFCFILLE AF
        LEFT JOIN as_ingredients P ON
        P.id = AF.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCFILLELIB_PDF" ("ID", "IDAVOIRFC", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "IDVENTEDETAILS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CALORIE", "POIDS", "PTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "TAUX") AS
SELECT
    AF.ID,
    AF.IDAVOIRFC,
    AF.IDPRODUIT,
    AF.IDORIGINE,
    AF.QTE,
    AF.PU,
    AF.REMISE,
    AF.TVA,
    AF.PUACHAT,
    AF.PUVENTE,
    AF.IDDEVISE,
    AF.TAUXDECHANGE,
    AF.DESIGNATION,
    AF.IDVENTEDETAILS,
    P.LIBELLEVENTE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    P.CALORIE,
    P.CALORIE * AF.QTE AS POIDS,
    AF.PU * AF.QTE AS PTHT,
    (NVL(AF.pu,0) * NVL(AF.QTE,0)) * NVL(AF.TVA,0) / 100 AS montantTVA,
    AF.TAUX
FROM
    AVOIRFCFILLE AF
        LEFT JOIN as_ingredients P ON
        P.id = AF.IDPRODUIT
order by P.LIBELLEVENTE asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCFILLE_GRP" ("IDAVOIRFC", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE") AS
SELECT a.idavoirfc,
       CAST(nvl(sum(a.QTE * a.PU), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                          AS montantht,
       CAST(nvl(sum(a.QTE * a.PU * a.TVA / 100), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                            AS montanttva,
       CAST(nvl(sum((a.QTE * a.PU) + (a.QTE * a.PU * a.TVA / 100)), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))         AS montantttc,
       CAST(nvl(sum(a.QTE * a.PU * nvl(a.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                 AS montanthtAR,
       CAST(nvl(sum((a.QTE * a.PU * a.TVA / 100) * nvl(a.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttvaAR,
       CAST(nvl(sum((a.QTE * a.PU * nvl(a.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) + (a.QTE * a.PU * a.TVA / 100) * nvl(a.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)),
                0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                             AS montantttcar,
       MAX(TAUXDECHANGE)                                                                         as tauxdechange,
       a.IDDEVISE
FROM AVOIRFCFILLE a
GROUP BY a.idavoirfc, a.IDDEVISE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCFILLE_GRP_VISEEE" ("IDVENTEDETAILS", "QTE") AS
SELECT
IDVENTEDETAILS,
SUM(qte) AS qte
FROM
AvoirFCFille abcf
left join AvoirFC b on b.id=abcf.idAvoirFC
where b.ETAT>=11
GROUP BY IDVENTEDETAILS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCLIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDMOTIF", "IDMOTIFLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR", "IDRESERVATION", "TYPEAVOIR", "CLIENTLIB", "NUMAVOIR", "IDRISTOURNE", "MONTANTRESTE", "NUMFACT") AS
SELECT a.ID,
       a.DESIGNATION,
       a.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL         AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       a.DATY,
       a.REMARQUE,
       a.ETAT,
       a.IDORIGINE,
       a.IDCLIENT,
       t.COMPTE,
       t.compteauxiliaire,
       a.IDVENTE,
       v.DESIGNATION AS IDVENTELIB,
       a.IDMOTIF,
       ma.VAL        AS IDMOTIFLIB,
       a.IDCATEGORIE,
       c.VAL         AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
       ag.IDDEVISE,
       ag.TAUXDECHANGE,
       ag.MONTANTHT,
       ag.MONTANTTVA,
       ag.MONTANTTTC,
       ag.MONTANTHTAR,
       ag.MONTANTTVAAR,
       ag.MONTANTTTCAR,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       ta.val        as Typeavoir,
       t.NOM         as clientlib,
       a.numavoir,
       a.idristourne,
       v.MONTANTRESTE,
       v.NUMFACT
FROM AVOIRFC a
         LEFT JOIN magasin2 m ON m.id = a.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_CPL_SANSAVOIR v ON v.id = a.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN MOTIFAVOIRFC ma ON ma.id = a.IDMOTIF
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEAVOIRFC c ON c.id = a.IDCATEGORIE
         JOIN AVOIRFCFILLE_GRP ag ON ag.idavoirfc = a.id
         LEFT JOIN TIERS T ON T.ID = A.IDCLIENT
         left join TYPEAVOIR ta on ta.id = a.IDTYPEAVOIR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCLIB_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDMOTIF", "IDMOTIFLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTPAYEAR", "MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE", "MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS", "RESTE_CALCULE", "EXCEDENT_AR", "RESTEAPAYER", "RESTEAPAYERAR", "CLIENTLIB", "TYPEAVOIR", "NUMFACT", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT AL.ID,
       AL.DESIGNATION,
       AL.IDMAGASIN,
       AL.IDMAGASINLIB,
       AL.DATY,
       AL.REMARQUE,
       AL.ETAT,
       AL.IDORIGINE,
       AL.IDCLIENT,
       AL.COMPTE,
       AL.IDVENTE,
       AL.IDVENTELIB,
       AL.IDMOTIF,
       AL.IDMOTIFLIB,
       AL.IDCATEGORIE,
       AL.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       AL.IDDEVISE,
       AL.TAUXDECHANGE,
       AL.MONTANTHT,
       AL.MONTANTTVA,
       AL.MONTANTTTC,
       AL.MONTANTHTAR,
       AL.MONTANTTVAAR,
       AL.MONTANTTTCAR,
       NVL(M.MONTANT, 0)                                        AS MONTANTPAYE,
       NVL(M.MONTANT, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)              AS MONTANTPAYEAR,

       NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0)                                  AS MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE,

       NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0)         AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           END                                                  AS RESTE_CALCULE,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) < 0
               THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                        NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
           ELSE 0
           END                                                  AS EXCEDENT_AR,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - NVL(M.MONTANT, 0)                             AS RESTEAPAYER,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - (NVL(M.MONTANT, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)) AS RESTEAPAYERAR,
       AL.CLIENTLIB,
       AL.TYPEAVOIR,
       VC.NUMFACT,
       (
           NVL(TO_CHAR(AL.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           AL.ID || ' | ' || CLIENTLIB || ' | ' ||  AL.IDMAGASINLIB || ' | ' || VC.NUMFACT || ' | ' ||
           TYPEAVOIR || ' | ' || IDMOTIFLIB || ' | ' || IDCATEGORIELIB
           )                                                    AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM AVOIRFCLIB AL
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGRPAVOIR_LP M
                   ON AL.ID = M.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_CPL_SANSAVOIR VC
                   ON VC.ID = AL.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT A2.IDVENTE,
                           A2.ID                AS IDCOURANT,
                           SUM(A1.MONTANTTTCAR) AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS
                    FROM AVOIRFCLIB A1
                             JOIN AVOIRFCLIB A2 ON A1.IDVENTE = A2.IDVENTE
                    WHERE A1.ETAT <> 0
                      AND (A1.DATY < A2.DATY OR (A1.DATY = A2.DATY AND A1.ID < A2.ID))
                    GROUP BY A2.IDVENTE, A2.ID) SUM_PRECEDENTS
                   ON SUM_PRECEDENTS.IDVENTE = AL.IDVENTE
                       AND SUM_PRECEDENTS.IDCOURANT = AL.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_V2" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDMOTIF", "IDMOTIFLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTPAYEAR", "MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE", "MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS", "RESTE_CALCULE", "EXCEDENT_AR", "RESTEAPAYER", "RESTEAPAYERAR", "CLIENTLIB", "TYPEAVOIR", "NUMFACT") AS
SELECT AL.ID,
       AL.DESIGNATION,
       AL.IDMAGASIN,
       AL.IDMAGASINLIB,
       AL.DATY,
       AL.REMARQUE,
       AL.ETAT,
       AL.IDORIGINE,
       AL.IDCLIENT,
       AL.COMPTE,
       AL.IDVENTE,
       AL.IDVENTELIB,
       AL.IDMOTIF,
       AL.IDMOTIFLIB,
       AL.IDCATEGORIE,
       AL.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       AL.IDDEVISE,
       AL.TAUXDECHANGE,
       AL.MONTANTHT,
       AL.MONTANTTVA,
       AL.MONTANTTTC,
       AL.MONTANTHTAR,
       AL.MONTANTTVAAR,
       AL.MONTANTTTCAR,
       nvl(M.montant, 0)                                        AS MONTANTPAYE,
       NVL(M.montant, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)              AS MONTANTPAYEAR,

       NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)                                  AS MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE ,

       0         AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS,
       -- Cas 1 : facture deja soldee -> chaque avoir = credit direct (exedent)
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           END                                                  AS RESTE_CALCULE,
       -- Excedent a rembourser ou a reporter
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) < 0
               THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                        NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
           ELSE 0
           END                                                  AS EXCEDENT_AR,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - NVL(M.montant, 0)                             AS resteapayer,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - (NVL(M.montant, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)) AS resteapayerar,
       AL.clientlib,
       AL.Typeavoir,
       AL.NUMFACT
FROM AVOIRFCLIB AL
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGRPAVOIR_LP M
                   ON AL.ID = M.IDORIGINE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIRFCLIB_PDF" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDMOTIF", "IDMOTIFLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR", "IDRESERVATION", "TYPEAVOIR", "CLIENTLIB", "NUMAVOIR", "IDRISTOURNE", "NUMFACT") AS
SELECT a.ID,
       a.DESIGNATION,
       a.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL         AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       a.DATY,
       a.REMARQUE,
       a.ETAT,
       a.IDORIGINE,
       a.IDCLIENT,
       t.COMPTE,
       t.compteauxiliaire,
       a.IDVENTE,
       v.DESIGNATION AS IDVENTELIB,
       a.IDMOTIF,
       ma.VAL        AS IDMOTIFLIB,
       a.IDCATEGORIE,
       c.VAL         AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
       ag.IDDEVISE,
       ag.TAUXDECHANGE,
       ag.MONTANTHT,
       ag.MONTANTTVA,
       ag.MONTANTTTC,
       ag.MONTANTHTAR,
       ag.MONTANTTVAAR,
       ag.MONTANTTTCAR,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       ta.val        as Typeavoir,
       t.NOM         as clientlib,
       a.numavoir,
       a.idristourne,
       v.NUMEROFACTURE as numfact
FROM AVOIRFC a
         LEFT JOIN magasin2 m ON m.id = a.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.id = a.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN MOTIFAVOIRFC ma ON ma.id = a.IDMOTIF
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEAVOIRFC c ON c.id = a.IDCATEGORIE
         JOIN AVOIRFCFILLE_GRP ag ON ag.idavoirfc = a.id
         LEFT JOIN TIERS T ON T.ID = A.IDCLIENT
         left join TYPEAVOIR ta on ta.id = a.IDTYPEAVOIR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AVOIR_MF" ("ID", "IDAVOIRFC", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "TAUXDECHANGE", "COMPTE") AS
select vd.ID,vd.idavoirfc,vd.IDPRODUIT,vd.IDORIGINE,vd.QTE,vd.PU,vd.REMISE,vd.TVA,vd.PUACHAT,vd.PUVENTE,
		v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       v.IDCLIENT,
         cast((vd.PU * vd.qte) as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantHT,
       cast((vd.PU * vd.qte*(vd.tva/100)) as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantTVA,
       cast(vd.PU * vd.qte + (vd.PU * vd.qte*(vd.tva/100))  as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantTTC,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE AS tauxdechange,
       p.COMPTE_VENTE AS compte
from avoirfcfille vd
 left outer join AVOIRFC  V on V.ID = vd.idavoirfc

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BALANCE_CLIENT" ("IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLE", "IDFAMILLE", "FAMILLE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "IDCLIENT", "IDPROVINCE", "VAL", "DATY", "REMISE") AS
select
    vd.IDPRODUIT,
    ing.LIBELLE,
    nvl(ing.IDFAMILLE,'AUTRE') as IDFAMILLE,
    nvl(fam.VAL,'AUTRE') as famille,
    sum(vd.QTE) as qte,
    sum(vd.PU*vd.QTE)/sum(vd.QTE) as pu,
    sum(vd.QTE * vd.PU) as montant,
    v.IDCLIENT,
    cl.IDPROVINCE,
    p.VAL,
    v.DATY,
    SUM(vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) AS remise
from VENTE_DETAILS vd
    join Vente v on vd.IDVENTE=v.id
    join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=vd.IDPRODUIT
    left join FAMILLEPRODUIT fam on fam.id=ing.IDFAMILLE
    join Client cl on cl.id=v.IDCLIENT
    left join Province p on p.id=cl.IDPROVINCE
group by vd.IDPRODUIT, ing.LIBELLE, nvl(ing.IDFAMILLE,'AUTRE'),nvl(fam.VAL,'AUTRE'), v.IDCLIENT, cl.IDPROVINCE, p.VAL, v.DATY;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "QTERESTE", "UNITELIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTDELAREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "RISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "POIDSTOTAL", "TAUX", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                  AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) -
            ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
             (bcf.ristourne / 100)) -
            nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       cast(((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
               100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                               (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                     ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                     100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                                nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                               nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)))*bcf.TAUX as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,bcf.taux,
       bcf.remiseArbiochem,
       bcf.ristourneArbiochem
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIB2" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "QTERESTE", "UNITELIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTDELAREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "RISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "POIDSTOTAL", "TAUX", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM", "QTELIVRE", "QTEFACTURE") AS
SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                  AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       -- montantRemise : remise classique (%) + remise Arbiochem (montant fixe par unite)
       cast((((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))+ (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem,0) * bcf.QUANTITE)) as number(30, 2))          as montantdelaremise,

       -- montantristourne : ristourne classique (%) + ristourne Arbiochem (montant fixe par unite)
       cast(
               ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                   + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              as montantristourne,

       -- montantremise : base HT nette = brut - remise% - ristourne% (incl. ristourneArbiochem) - frais transport - remiseArbiochem
       cast(
               NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                   - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                   - (
                   ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                    (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                       + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                   )
                   - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                   - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              as montantremise,

       -- MONTANTTVA : TVA calculee sur le nouveau montantremise (donc corrigee des montants Arbiochem)
       CAST(
               (
                   (NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                       - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                       - (
                        ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                         (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                            + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                        )
                       - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                       - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,

       -- MONTANTTTC : montantremise (corrige) + MONTANTTVA (corrigee)
       cast(
               (
                   NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                       - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                       - (
                       ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                        (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                           + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       )
                       - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                       - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                   )
                   + (
                   (
                       NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                           - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                           - (
                           ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                            (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                               + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           )
                           - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                           - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                   )
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTTC,

       -- MONTANTTTCAR : simplifie, les montants Arbiochem sont deja pris en compte en amont dans montantremise
       cast(
               (
                   (
                       NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                           - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                           - (
                           ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                            (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                               + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           )
                           - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                           - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       )
                       + (
                       (
                           NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                               - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                               - (
                               ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                                (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                                   + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                               )
                               - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                               - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                       )
                   ) * bcf.TAUX
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTTCAR,

       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,bcf.taux,
       nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem,0) as remiseArbiochem,
       nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem,0) as ristourneArbiochem,
       cast(nvl(blf.QUANTITE,0) as number(30,2)) as qtelivre, cast(nvl(vdbc.qte,0) as number(30,2)) as qteFacture
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC
         left join as_BLClientFilleGrpBCFille blf on blf.IDBC_FILLE=bcf.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIBB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANT", "TVA", "MONTANTTVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "QTERESTE") AS
SELECT
    bcf.ID,
    bcf.PRODUIT,
    bcf.IDBC,
    bcf.QUANTITE,
    bcf.PU,
    (nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100 as montantremise,
    nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-((nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)+((((nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-(nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)*bcf.tva)/100)) as montanttotal,
    bcf.MONTANT as montant,
    bcf.TVA,
    (((nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-(nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)*bcf.tva)/100) as montanttva,
    bcf.REMISE,
    bcf.IDDEVISE,
    bcf.UNITE,
    un.VAL as unitelib,
    i.LIBELLE AS PRODUITlib,
    i.compte_vente AS compte,
    GREATEST(NVL(bcf.quantite, 0) - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0), 0) AS qtereste
FROM
bondecommande_client_fille bcf
JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
    left join AS_UNITE un on un.id=bcf.UNITE
LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIB_PDF" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "QTERESTE", "UNITELIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTDELAREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "RISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "POIDSTOTAL", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE", "UNITE2", "REMISEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                                      AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,
       CAST((bcf.pu/nvl(eq.QUANTITE,1)) AS NUMBER (30,2)) as puingredient,
       nvl(eq.QUANTITE,1) as contenue,
       i.UNITE2,
       bcf.REMISEARBIOCHEM 
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT1=i.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIB_VISEE" ("ID", "IDBC", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANT", "PRODUIT", "PU", "QUANTITE", "REMISE", "TVA", "UNITE", "QTEOF", "QTEOFRESTANTE", "QTEFAB", "QTEFABRESTANTE", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "PRODUITLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONCOMMANDEDETAILSCARTON_CPL" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITEBF", "QUANTITECF", "RESTECF") AS
SELECT 
bc.ID ,
bc.idbc AS idbc ,
ai.LIBELLE AS produitlib,
ai.id AS produit,
nvl(bc.QUANTITE,0) AS quantitebf ,
nvl(c.QUANTITE,0) AS quantitecf,
nvl(bc.QUANTITE,0) - nvl(c.QUANTITE,0) AS restecf
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bc 
LEFT JOIN CARTONFILLE c  ON c.IDBCFILLE = bc.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONCOMMANDEFABDETAILS" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "IDBC", "QTE", "IDFABRICATION") AS
SELECT
	fl.IDINGREDIENTS ,
	i.LIBELLE,
	bc.ID,
	sum(fl.QTE) qte,
	fl.IDMERE AS IDFABRICATION
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE fl
LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf ON bcf.ID = fl.IDBCFILLE
LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc ON bc.ID = bcf.IDBC
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f
ON f.ID = fl.IDMERE
JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i
ON fl.IDINGREDIENTS = i.ID
WHERE f.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY fl.IDINGREDIENTS ,i.LIBELLE,bc.ID, fl.IDMERE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENTF_TAUX" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "TAUX") AS
SELECT bcc.ID,bcc.PRODUIT,bcc.IDBC,bcc.QUANTITE,bcc.PU,bcc.MONTANT,bcc.TVA,bcc.REMISE,bcc.IDDEVISE,bcc.UNITE, CASE WHEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDPROFORMA", "NBFACTURE", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "DATELIVRAISON", "LIEULIVRAISON", "NUMEROBC", "FRAISLIVRAISON") AS SELECT bc.ID, bc.DATY, bc.ETAT, bc.REMARQUE, bc.DESIGNATION, bc.MODEPAIEMENT, m.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB, bc.IDCLIENT, c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, bc.REFERENCE, m2.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, CASE WHEN bc.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉ' WHEN bc.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN bc.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ' END AS ETATLIB, bc.IDPROFORMA, nvl(vo.nombre,0) as nbfacture, CASE WHEN bc.modelivraison = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN bc.modelivraison = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS modelivraisonlib, bc.dateLivraison, bc.lieuLivraison, bc.NUMEROBC, FRAISLIVRAISON FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = bc.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.id = bc.MODEPAIEMENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m2 ON m2.id = bc.IDMAGASIN left join vente_origine vo on vo.IDORIGINE=bc.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL_A" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "REFERENCE", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT "ID","DATY","ETAT","REMARQUE","DESIGNATION","MODEPAIEMENT","MODEPAIEMENTLIB","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","REFERENCE","ETATLIB" FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL WHERE etat=0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL_C" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "REFERENCE", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT "ID","DATY","ETAT","REMARQUE","DESIGNATION","MODEPAIEMENT","MODEPAIEMENTLIB","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","REFERENCE","ETATLIB" FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL WHERE etat=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL_M" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDPROFORMA", "NBFACTURE", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "DATELIVRAISON", "LIEULIVRAISON", "NUMEROBC", "QTERESTE", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "FACTURELIB", "MOTSCLESSS", "IDMAGASIN", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "IDDEVISE") AS SELECT BC.ID, BC.DATY, CASE WHEN (SUM(BCF.QTERESTE)) = 0 THEN 12 ELSE BC.ETAT END AS ETAT, BC.REMARQUE, BC.DESIGNATION, BC.MODEPAIEMENT, M.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB, BC.IDCLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, BC.REFERENCE, M2.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, CASE WHEN (SUM(BCF.QTERESTE)) = 0 THEN 'Validée' WHEN BC.ETAT = 0 THEN 'Annulée' WHEN BC.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Créé' WHEN BC.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Validée' WHEN BC.ETAT = 12 THEN 'Validée' END AS ETATLIB, BC.IDPROFORMA, NVL(VO.NOMBRE, 0) AS NBFACTURE, CASE WHEN BC.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN BC.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RÉCUPÉRATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, BC.DATELIVRAISON, BC.LIEULIVRAISON, BC.NUMEROBC, SUM(BCF.QTERESTE) AS QTERESTE, sum(BCF.MONTANTTTC) as montantTTC,sum(BCF.MONTANTTTCAR) as montantTTCAR, CASE WHEN NVL(VO.NOMBRE, 0) > 0 THEN 'FACTURÉ' WHEN NVL(VO.NOMBRE, 0) = 0 THEN 'NON FACTURÉ' END AS FACTURELIB, ( BC.id || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || designation || ' | ' || reference || ' | ' || M.VAL || ' | ' || BC.remarque || ' | ' || numeroBc ) AS MOTSCLESSS, BC.IDMAGASIN, cast(sum(bcf.montantremise) as number(30,2)) as montantHT, cast(sum(bcf.montantdelaremise) as number(30,2)) as montantremise,cast(sum(bcf.MONTANTTVA) as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA, bc.IDDEVISE FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT BC LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = BC.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT M ON M.ID = BC.MODEPAIEMENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M2 ON M2.ID = BC.IDMAGASIN LEFT JOIN VENTE_ORIGINE VO ON VO.IDORIGINE = BC.ID LEFT JOIN BC_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL_LIB2 BCF ON BCF.IDBC = BC.ID GROUP BY BC.ID, BC.DATY, BC.ETAT, BC.REMARQUE, BC.DESIGNATION, BC.MODEPAIEMENT, M.VAL, BC.IDCLIENT, C.NOM, BC.REFERENCE, M2.VAL, BC.IDPROFORMA, VO.NOMBRE, BC.DATELIVRAISON, BC.LIEULIVRAISON, BC.NUMEROBC, BC.MODELIVRAISON, BC.IDMAGASIN, bc.IDDEVISE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL_V" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "REFERENCE", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT "ID","DATY","ETAT","REMARQUE","DESIGNATION","MODEPAIEMENT","MODEPAIEMENTLIB","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","REFERENCE","ETATLIB" FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_CPL WHERE etat=11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE_CPL" ("ID", "IDBC", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANT", "PRODUIT", "PU", "QUANTITE", "REMISE", "TVA", "UNITE", "QTEOF", "QTEOFRESTANTE", "QTEFAB", "QTEFABRESTANTE", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "ETAT", "DATY", "IDCLIENT", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ."ID",SQ."IDBC",SQ."IDDEVISE",SQ."MONTANT",SQ."PRODUIT",SQ."PU",SQ."QUANTITE",SQ."REMISE",SQ."TVA",SQ."UNITE",SQ."QTEOF",SQ."QTEOFRESTANTE",SQ."QTEFAB",SQ."QTEFABRESTANTE",SQ."QTELIVRE",SQ."QTENONLIVRE",SQ."LIBELLEPRODUIT",SQ."ETAT",SQ."DATY",SQ."IDCLIENT",
       (NVL(TO_CHAR("ID"),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDBC),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEVISE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QUANTITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMISE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TVA),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(UNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEOF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEOFRESTANTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFAB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFABRESTANTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTELIVRE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTENONLIVRE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLEPRODUIT),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT
             bcf.id,
             bcf.IDBC,
             bcf.IDDEVISE,
             avg(bcf.MONTANT) as montant,
             bcf.PRODUIT,
             avg(bcf.PU) as pu,
             avg(bcf.QUANTITE) as quantite,
             avg(bcf.REMISE) as remise,
             avg(bcf.TVA) as tva,
             ing.UNITE as unite,

             nvl(avg(o.QTE),0) AS QTEOF,
             NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(o.QTE),0), 0) AS QTEOFRESTANTE,

             nvl(avg(f.QTE),0) AS QTEFAB,
             NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(f.QTE),0), 0) AS QTEFABRESTANTE,

             AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE, 0)) AS QTELIVRE,
             NVL(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) - AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE,0)), 0) AS QTENONLIVRE,
             ing.LIBELLE as libelleProduit,
             bccli.ETAT,
             bccli.daty,
             bccli.idclient

         FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf



                  LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bccli ON bccli.id = bcf.IDBC
                  LEFT JOIN OfGroupByIdbc o ON o.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID


                  LEFT JOIN fabrGroupByIdbc f ON f.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID

                  LEFT JOIN BLGroupByIdbc abcf ON abcf.IDBC_FILLE = bcf.ID

                  left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=bcf.PRODUIT

         GROUP BY
             bcf.IDBC,
             bcf.id,
             bcf.IDDEVISE,
             bcf.PRODUIT,
             ing.LIBELLE, ing.UNITE,
             bccli.ETAT,
             bccli.DATY,
             bccli.idclient
     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE_V" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "DESIGNATION", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "RISTOURNE", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM", "REMISEARBIOCHEM") AS
select p.ID,
       p.PRODUIT,
       p.IDBC,
       p.QUANTITE,
       p.PU,
       p.MONTANT,
       p.TVA,
       p.REMISE,
       p.IDDEVISE,
       p.UNITE,
       p.DESIGNATION,
       uni.val as unitelib,
       0  as punet,
       0  as montantht,
       0  as montantttc,
       p.RISTOURNE,
       ing.calorie,
       p.ristourneArbiochem,
       p.remiseArbiochem

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CAISSECPL" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "IDTYPECAISSE", "IDTYPECAISSELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDPOMPISTE", "ETAT", "COMPTE", "ETATLIB", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.VAL,SQ.DESCE,SQ.IDTYPECAISSE,SQ.IDTYPECAISSELIB,SQ.IDPOINT,SQ.IDPOINTLIB,SQ.IDPOMPISTE,SQ.ETAT,SQ.COMPTE,SQ.ETATLIB,SQ.IDCATEGORIECAISSE,SQ.IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB,SQ.IDMAGASIN,SQ.IDMAGASINLIB,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(VAL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DESCE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPECAISSE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPECAISSELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPOINT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPOINTLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPOMPISTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETATLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDCATEGORIECAISSE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMAGASIN),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMAGASINLIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT c.ID,
	                c.VAL,
	                c.DESCE,
	                c.IDTYPECAISSE,
	                t.VAL   AS IDTYPECAISSELIB,
	                c.IDPOINT,
	                p.VAL   AS IDPOINTLIB,
	                c.IDPOMPISTE,
	                c.ETAT,
	                cop.LIBELLE||'('||cop.COMPTE||')' as compte ,
	                CASE
	                    WHEN c.ETAT = 0
	                        THEN 'ANNULÉ'
	                    WHEN c.ETAT = 1
	                        THEN 'CRÉÉ'
	                    WHEN c.ETAT = 11
	                        THEN 'VISÉ'
	                    END AS ETATLIB,
	                c.idCategorieCaisse,
	                c2.VAL  AS idCategorieCaisseLib,
	                c.IDMAGASIN ,
	                m.val AS idMagasinLib
	         FROM CAISSE c
	                  LEFT JOIN TYPECAISSE t ON t.ID = c.IDTYPECAISSE
	                  LEFT JOIN POINT p ON p.ID = c.IDPOINT
	                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIECAISSE c2 ON c2.ID = c.idCategorieCaisse
	                  LEFT JOIN COMPTA_COMPTE cop ON cop.COMPTE = c.COMPTE
	                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID =c.IDMAGASIN
	
	
	     ) SQ;

c.DESCE ,
c.IDTYPECAISSE ,
t.VAL AS IDTYPECAISSELIB,

    c.raisonRefus

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CATEG_QUALI_CONTRAT" ("ID", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDQUALIFICATION", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "AVENANT") AS
SELECT cq.id,
       cq.idcategorie,
       cq.idqualification,
       cq.remarque,
       cq.etat,
       cq.montant,
       cq.date_debut,
       cq.date_fin,
       cq.avenant
FROM categorie_qualification cq

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CATEG_QUALI_CONTRAT_2" ("ID", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDQUALIFICATION", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "DATEFIN", "AVENANT", "NUMERO") AS
SELECT
    cq.id,
    cq.idcategorie,
    cq.idqualification,
    cq.remarque,
    cq.etat,
    cq.montant,
    cq.date_debut,
    cq.date_fin,

    -- Utilisation de LEAD pour datefin
    NVL(
            LEAD(cq.date_debut) OVER (PARTITION BY cq.remarque ORDER BY cq.date_debut) - 1,
            cq.date_fin
    ) AS datefin,

    -- Generation de l''avenant
    CASE
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cq.remarque ORDER BY cq.date_debut) = 1 THEN 'initial'
        ELSE 'Avenant N?' || (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cq.remarque ORDER BY cq.date_debut) - 1)
        END AS avenant,

    -- Numero de l''avenant
    CASE
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cq.remarque ORDER BY cq.date_debut) = 1 THEN '0'
        ELSE TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cq.remarque ORDER BY cq.date_debut) - 1)
        END AS numero

FROM categ_quali_contrat cq;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CA_ANNEE_MOIS" ("ANNEE", "JANVIER", "FEVRIER", "MARS", "AVRIL", "MAI", "JUIN", "JUILLET", "AOUT", "SEPTEMBRE", "OCTOBRE", "NOVEMBRE", "DECEMBRE") AS
SELECT
    annee,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 1 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS janvier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 2 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS fevrier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 3 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS mars,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 4 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS avril,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 5 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS mai,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 6 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS juin,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 7 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS juillet,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 8 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS aout,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 9 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS septembre,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 10 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS octobre,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 11 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS novembre,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mois = 12 THEN montant ELSE 0 END) AS decembre
FROM CA_ANNEE_VIEW
GROUP BY annee
ORDER BY annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CA_ANNEE_VIEW" ("MONTANT", "ANNEE", "MOIS") AS
WITH deja AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(montant) AS montant,
    TO_NUMBER(annee) AS annee,
    TO_NUMBER(mois)  AS mois
  FROM ca_annee_anterieur
  GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(annee), TO_NUMBER(mois)
),
recalc AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM daty) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daty) AS mois,
    SUM(putotal) AS montant
  FROM vente_details_cpl_2_visee
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM daty), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daty)
),
manquants AS (
  SELECT r.montant, r.annee, r.mois
  FROM recalc r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM deja d
    WHERE d.annee = r.annee
      AND d.mois  = r.mois
  )
)
SELECT montant, annee, mois FROM deja
UNION ALL
SELECT montant, annee, mois FROM manquants;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CA_JOURNALIER" ("MONTANT", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "MOISLIB", "DATY") AS
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(daty) AS jour,
    SUM(putotal) AS montant
  FROM vente_details_cpl_2_visee
  GROUP BY TRUNC(daty)
)
SELECT
    a.montant,
    EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM a.jour) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a.jour) AS mois,
    TO_CHAR(a.jour, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS moislib,
    a.jour AS daty
FROM agg a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ca_jour j
    WHERE j.daty = a.jour
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CA_MENSUEL" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "MOISLIB", "MONTANT") AS
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(daty) AS jour,
    CAST(SUM(putotal) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS montant
  FROM vente_details_cpl_2_visee
  GROUP BY TRUNC(daty)
),
agg_mois AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM jour)  AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM jour) AS mois,
    TO_CHAR(jour, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS moislib,
    CAST(SUM(montant)AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montant
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM jour),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM jour),
    TO_CHAR(jour, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH')
)
SELECT ANNEE,MOIS,MOISLIB,MONTANT
FROM agg_mois m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ca_jour j
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM j.daty) = m.annee
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM j.daty) = m.mois
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHARGEGROUPBYOFF" ("IDOFF", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS
select ofile.id as idoff, cast(0 as number(30,3)) as montantentree,cast(nvl(sum(c.pu*c.qte),0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie
from charge c
         left join fabrication fabb on c.IDFABRICATION=fabb.id
         left join OFFILLE ofile on fabb.IDOFFILLE=ofile.ID
where c.etat>=11 group by ofile.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHARGEGROUPEBYOFF" ("IDOFF", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS
SELECT ofile.id AS idoff , CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS montantentree  ,

LEFT JOIN fabrication fabb ON c.IDFABRICATION=fabb.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHARGE_CPL" ("ID", "DATY", "LIBELLE", "PU", "QTE", "TYPE", "IDFABRICATION", "ETAT", "TYPELIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	    c.ID,
	    c.DATY,
	    c.LIBELLE,
	    c.PU,
	    c.QTE,
	    c.TYPE,
	    c.IDFABRICATION,
	    c.ETAT,
	    t.val AS typelib,
	    CASE
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 0
	            THEN 'ANNULEE'
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 1
	            THEN 'CREEE'
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 11
	            THEN 'VISEE'
	        ELSE 'INCONNU'
	        END AS etatlib
	FROM
	    CHARGE c
	        LEFT JOIN TYPECHARGE t ON t.id = c.TYPE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHARGE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "LIBELLE", "PU", "TYPE", "IDFABRICATION", "ETAT", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QTE", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "MOTSCLESSS", "TYPECHARGELIB", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.DATY,SQ.LIBELLE,SQ.PU,SQ.TYPE,SQ.IDFABRICATION,SQ.ETAT,SQ.IDINGREDIENTS,SQ.QTE,SQ.IDOFFILLE,SQ.IDOF,
	  (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TYPE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFABRICATION),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDINGREDIENTS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDOFFILLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDOF),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS,typechargelib,idingredientslib,montant
	FROM (
	  SELECT 
	c.id ,
	c.daty ,
	c.libelle,
	c.pu ,
	c.type ,
	c.idfabrication,
	c.etat , 
	c.idingredients,
	c.qte ,
	f.IDOFFILLE,
	f.IDOF,
	tc.val AS typechargelib,
	ing.libelle AS idingredientslib,
	CAST(NVL(c.pu * c.qte, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant
	FROM CHARGE c 
	LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = c.idfabrication  
	LEFT JOIN typecharge tc ON c.TYPE=tc.id
	LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ing ON c.idingredients=ing.id 
	) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKINAVECCHEKOUT" ("ID", "RESERVATION", "DATY", "HEURE", "REMARQUE", "CLIENT", "IDPRODUIT", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT", "QTE", "CHECKOUT") AS
select c."ID",c."RESERVATION",c."DATY",c."HEURE",c."REMARQUE",c."CLIENT",c."IDPRODUIT",c."ETAT",c."IDCLIENT", c.qte,o.id as checkOut from CHECKIN c left join CHECKOUT o on c.id=o.RESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKINAVECCHEKOUTCOMPLET" ("RESERVATION", "ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "HEURE", "REMARQUE", "CHECKOUT") AS
select c.RESERVATION ,o.id,o.DATY,o.ETAT,  o.HEURE,o.REMARQUE, o.RESERVATION as checkOut from CHECKIN c left join CHECKOUT o on c.id=o.RESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKINLIBELLE" ("ID", "RESERVATION", "DATY", "HEURE", "REMARQUE", "CLIENT", "IDPRODUIT", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT", "CHECKOUT", "PRODUITLIBELLE", "PU", "TVA", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	c.ID,
	c.RESERVATION,
	c.DATY,
	c.HEURE,
	c.REMARQUE,
	cl.nom AS CLIENT,
	c.IDPRODUIT,
	c.ETAT,
	c.IDCLIENT,
	c.CHECKOUT,
	i.LIBELLE AS produitLibelle,
	i.pu,
	i.tva,
	CASE
	WHEN c.ETAT = 0
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN c.ETAT = 1
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN c.ETAT = 11
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS ETATLIB
FROM
	checkInAvecChekOut c
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON c.IDPRODUIT = i.id
LEFT JOIN CLIENT cl ON c.IDCLIENT=cl.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKINSANSCHEKOUT" ("ID", "RESERVATION", "DATY", "HEURE", "REMARQUE", "CLIENT", "IDPRODUIT", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT") AS
select c."ID",c."RESERVATION",c."DATY",c."HEURE",c."REMARQUE",c."CLIENT",c."IDPRODUIT",c."ETAT",c."IDCLIENT" from CHECKIN c where c.id not in (select o.reservation from CHECKOUT o where o.ETAT>=11);

select
    ch."ID",ch."RESERVATION",ch."DATY",ch."HEURE",ch."REMARQUE",ch."CLIENT",ch."IDPRODUIT",ch."ETAT",ch."IDCLIENT",
    ing.LIBELLE as chambre
from CHECKINSANSCHEKOUT ch
         join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ch.idproduit = ing.id
where ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT001';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKLIST_MERE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPERSONNEL", "TYPECHECKLISTE", "TYPECHECKLISTELIB", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "MATRICULE", "IDFONCTION", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDSERVICE", "IDSERVICELIB", "IDDIRECTION", "IDDIRECTIONLIB") AS
SELECT cm.ID,
       cm.DATY,
       cm.IDPERSONNEL,
       cm.TYPECHECKLISTE,
       -- typeCheckListeLib (0 => entree, 1 => sortie)
       CASE cm.TYPECHECKLISTE
           WHEN 0 THEN 'entree'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'sortie'
           ELSE 'Inconnu'
           END AS typeCheckListeLib,
       -- idPersonnelLib : Nom + prenom depuis table log_personnel
       lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM AS idPersonnelLib,
       -- Matricule et idFonction depuis paie_info_personnel
       pip.MATRICULE,
       pip.IDFONCTION,
       -- idFonctionLib : Recuperer val depuis table paie_fonction
       pf.VAL AS idFonctionLib,
       -- idService depuis log_personnel et idServiceLib depuis log_service
       lp.SERVICE AS idService,
       ls.LIBELLE AS idServiceLib,
       -- idDirection depuis log_personnel et idDirectionLib depuis log_direction
       lp.DIRECTION AS idDirection,
       ld.VAL AS idDirectionLib
FROM CHECKLIST_MERE cm
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON lp.ID = cm.IDPERSONNEL
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.ID = lp.ID
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf ON pf.ID = pip.IDFONCTION
         LEFT JOIN LOG_SERVICE ls ON ls.ID = lp.SERVICE
         LEFT JOIN LOG_DIRECTION ld ON ld.ID = lp.DIRECTION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHECKOUTLIB" ("ID", "RESERVATION", "DATY", "HEURE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "PRODUITLIBELLE", "ETATLIB") AS
select
    ch."ID",ch."RESERVATION",ch."DATY",ch."HEURE",ch."REMARQUE",ch."ETAT",
    ci.PRODUITLIBELLE,
    case when ch.ETAT = 1 then 'CREE'
    when ch.ETAT = 11 then 'VALIDEE'
    END as etatlib
from CHECKOUT ch
join CHECKINLIBELLE ci on ci.ID = ch.RESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHEQUECPL" ("ID", "REFERENCE", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REMARQUE") AS
SELECT 
c.ID ,
c.REFERENCE ,
c.IDCAISSE ,
c2.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
c.MONTANT ,
c.DATY ,
c.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN c.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN c.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
	WHEN c.ETAT = 20 
	THEN 'TOUCHEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
c.REMARQUE 
FROM CHEQUE c 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c2 ON c2.ID = c.IDCAISSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHEQUECPL_CREE" ("ID", "REFERENCE", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHEQUECPL_TOUCHEE" ("ID", "REFERENCE", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CHEQUECPL_VISEE" ("ID", "REFERENCE", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CLIENTLIB" ("ID", "NOM", "TELEPHONE", "MAIL", "ADRESSE", "REMARQUE", "COMPTE", "IDNATIONALITE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "CODECLIENT", "DATECARTE", "TAXE", "IDPROVINCE", "ECHEANCE", "TELFIXE", "NIF", "STAT", "CARTE", "PROVINCELIB", "SEUIL") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CLOTURECAISSE_CPL" ("ID", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "ETATLIB") AS

    cc.ID,cc.DATY,cc.REMARQUE,cc.ETAT,cc.IDPOINT,
    p.val AS idpointlib,
    CASE
        WHEN cc.etat = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN cc.etat >= 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE' end as etatLib
