LEFT JOIN "QUALITEECLOSION" qe ON qe."ID" = d."IDQUALITEECLOSION";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECLOSION_LIB" ("ID", "IDLOT", "DATEECLOSION", "NOMBREOEUFINITIAL", "IDECLOSOIR", "IDINCUBATEUR", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "ETAT", "IDINCUBATEURLIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDECLOSOIRLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT e."ID",
       e."IDLOT",
       e."DATEECLOSION",
       e."NOMBREOEUFINITIAL",
       e."IDECLOSOIR",
       e."IDINCUBATEUR",
       e."IDBATIMENT",
       e."IDPARQUET",
       e."ETAT",
       inc."VAL"       AS "IDINCUBATEURLIB",
       b."NOMBATIMENT" AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",
       p."VAL"         AS "IDPARQUETLIB",
       ec."VAL"        AS "IDECLOSOIRLIB",
       CASE e."ETAT"
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
           END              AS "ETATLIB"
FROM "ECLOSION" e
         LEFT JOIN "INCUBATEUR" inc ON inc."ID" = e."IDINCUBATEUR"
         LEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = e."IDBATIMENT"
         LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" p ON p."ID" = e."IDPARQUET"
         LEFT JOIN ECLOSOIR ec ON ec.ID = e.IDECLOSOIR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_DELA_PAIE" ("IDELEMENTPAIE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDEDITION", "COMPTEGEN_DB", "COMPTEGEN_CR", "COMPTEANA_DB", "COMPTEANA_CR", "TYPERUBRIQUE", "RUBRIQUE_LIBELLE", "IDDIRECTION", "IMPOSABLE") AS
SELECT peel.idelementpaie,
       peel.mois,
       peel.annee,
       sum(peel.gain) AS gain,
       sum(peel.retenue) AS retenue,
       peel.idedition,
       peel.comptegen_db,
       peel.comptegen_cr,
       peel.compteana_db,
       peel.compteana_cr,
       peel.typerubrique,
       peel.rubrique_libelle,
       peel.iddirection,
       peel.imposable
FROM paie_edition_ecriture_ligne peel
GROUP BY peel.idelementpaie, peel.mois, peel.annee, peel.idedition, peel.comptegen_db, peel.comptegen_cr, peel.compteana_db, peel.compteana_cr, peel.typerubrique, peel.rubrique_libelle, peel.iddirection, peel.code, peel.imposable
ORDER BY peel.typerubrique DESC, peel.code;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_DELA_PAIE_CREDIT" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDEDITION", "COMPTEGEN_DEBIT", "COMPTEGEN_CREDIT", "TYPERUBRIQUE", "IDDIRECTION") AS
SELECT e.mois,
       e.annee,
       sum(e.gain) AS gain,
       sum(e.retenue) AS retenue,
       e.idedition,
       CAST('''' AS varchar(250)) AS comptegen_debit,
       e.comptegen_cr AS comptegen_credit,
       e.typerubrique,
       e.iddirection
FROM ecriture_dela_paie e
WHERE e.comptegen_cr IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.mois, e.annee, e.idedition, e.comptegen_cr, e.typerubrique, e.iddirection;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_DELA_PAIE_DEBIT" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDEDITION", "COMPTEGEN_DEBIT", "COMPTEGEN_CREDIT", "TYPERUBRIQUE", "IDDIRECTION") AS
SELECT e.mois,
       e.annee,
       sum(e.gain) AS gain,
       sum(e.retenue) AS retenue,
       e.idedition,
       e.comptegen_db AS comptegen_debit,
       CAST('''' AS varchar(250)) AS comptegen_credit,
       e.typerubrique,
       e.iddirection
FROM ecriture_dela_paie e
WHERE e.comptegen_db IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.mois, e.annee, e.idedition, e.comptegen_db, e.typerubrique, e.iddirection;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_DELA_PAIE_REGR" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDEDITION", "COMPTEGEN_DEBIT", "COMPTEGEN_CREDIT", "TYPERUBRIQUE", "IDDIRECTION") AS
SELECT ed.mois,
       ed.annee,
       ed.gain,
       ed.retenue,
       ed.idedition,
       ed.comptegen_debit,
       ed.comptegen_credit,

SELECT ec.mois,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_DELA_PAIE_REGR_COMPTE" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDEDITION", "COMPTEGEN_DEBIT", "COMPTEGEN_CREDIT", "TYPERUBRIQUE", "IDDIRECTION", "COMPTELIBELLE") AS
SELECT edpr.mois,
       edpr.annee,
       edpr.gain,
       edpr.retenue,
       edpr.idedition,
       edpr.comptegen_debit,
       edpr.comptegen_credit,
       edpr.typerubrique,
       edpr.iddirection,
       cc.libelle AS comptelibelle

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ECRITURE_IMPOT" ("ID", "COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLEPIECE", "IDMERE", "REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT", "COMPTE_AUX", "LETTRAGE", "JOURNAL", "EXERCICE", "ETAT", "DATY", "FOLIO", "ANALYTIQUE", "SOURCE", "DATYMERE", "CODEIMPOT", "MOISDECLARATION") AS
select
    se.ID,
    se.COMPTE,
    se.DEBIT,
    se.CREDIT,
    se.REMARQUE,
    se.LIBELLEPIECE,
    se.IDMERE,
    se.REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT,
    se.COMPTE_AUX,
    se.LETTRAGE,
    se.JOURNAL,
    se.EXERCICE,
    se.ETAT,
    se.DATY,
    se.FOLIO,
    se.ANALYTIQUE,
    se.SOURCE,
    ce.daty as datymere,
    cc.COMPTE as codeimpot,
    sed.MOISDECLARATION
from COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE se
         join COMPTA_ECRITURE ce on ce.id=se.IDMERE
         join COMPTA_COMPTE cc on cc.COMPTE=se.COMPTE
         JOIN SOUSECRITUREDECLARER sed ON sed.IDSOUSECRITURE = se.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EFFECTIF_LOG_PERSONNEL" ("SEXE", "NOMBRE", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN sexe = 'Masculin' THEN 'Masculin'
        WHEN sexe = 'Feminin' THEN 'Feminin'
        ELSE 'Non defini'
    END AS sexe,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre,
    idCategorie,
    idCategorieLib,
    IDDEPARTEMENT AS idDepartement,
    departementLib
FROM LOG_PERSONNEL_GRAPHE
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN sexe = 'Masculin' THEN 'Masculin'
        WHEN sexe = 'Feminin' THEN 'Feminin'
        ELSE 'Non defini'
    END,
    idCategorie,
    idCategorieLib,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ELEMENTINSPECTIONMACHINELIB" ("ID", "IDELEMENTINSPECTION", "IDMACHINE", "IDELEMENTINSPECTIONLIB", "IDMACHINELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDELEMENTINSPECTION,SQ.IDMACHINE,SQ.IDELEMENTINSPECTIONLIB,SQ.IDMACHINELIB,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDELEMENTINSPECTION),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMACHINE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDELEMENTINSPECTIONLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMACHINELIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT
	             eim.id,
	             eim.idElementInspection as idElementInspection,
	             eim.idMachine as idMachine,
	             ei.val      AS idElementInspectionLib,
	             m.DESCRIPTIONOBJET       AS idMachineLib
	         FROM ElementInspectionMachine eim
	                  LEFT JOIN ElementInspection ei
	                            ON eim.idElementInspection = ei.id
	                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m
	                            ON eim.idMachine = m.id
	
	     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EMPLOI_LIB" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "IDMETIER", "IDMETIERLIB", "IDCODEROMELIB", "IDSOUSFAMILLEPROLIB", "IDFAMILLEPROLIB") AS
(
       select
       e.ID,e.VAL,e.DESCE,e.IDMETIER,
       m.val as idmetierlib,
       m.idcoderomelib,
       m.idsousfamilleprolib,
       m.idfamilleprolib
       from
       emploi e
       left join metierlib m on e.idmetier=m.id
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EMPLOYEEONBOARDINGCHECKLISTCPL" ("ID", "IDSESSIONONBOARDING", "IDONBOARDINGITEM", "ESTTERMINER", "DATEFIN", "REMARQUE", "ESTTERMINERLIB", "IDSESSION", "PROGRESSION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDONBOARDINGITEMLIB") AS
SELECT
    c.ID,c.IDSESSIONONBOARDING,c.IDONBOARDINGITEM,c.ESTTERMINER,c.DATEFIN,c.REMARQUE,
    CASE
        WHEN c.estTerminer = 0 THEN 'Non'
        WHEN c.estTerminer = 1 THEN 'Oui'
        END AS estTerminerLib,

    s.id AS idSession,
    s.progression,
    s.etat,
    CASE
        WHEN s.etat = 1  THEN 'En cours'
        WHEN s.etat = 11 THEN 'Termine'
        END AS etatlib,

    ofi.titre AS idOnboardingItemlib

FROM employee_onboarding_checklist c
         JOIN employee_onboarding_sessions s
              ON c.idSessionOnboarding = s.id
         JOIN onboarding_fille ofi
              ON c.idOnboardingItem = ofi.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EMPLOYEEONBOARDINGSESSIONSCPL" ("ID", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "PROGRESSION", "IDPERSONNEL", "PERSONNELLIB", "IDONBOARDING", "ONBOARDINGLIB") AS
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.dateDebut,
    s.dateFin,
    s.etat,
    s.progression,

    p.id AS idPersonnel,
    p.nom as personnelLib,

    o.id AS idOnboarding,
    o.nom as onboardinglib
FROM employee_onboarding_sessions s

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENTCPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDPOINT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DATY", "IDORIGINE", "IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT", "IDTYPEENCAISSEMENTLIB", "MONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX") AS
SELECT 
e.ID ,
e.DESIGNATION ,
e.IDCAISSE ,
c.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
c.IDPOINT ,
e.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN e.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
e.DATY ,
e.IDORIGINE,
e.IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT,
te.val AS IDTYPEENCAISSEMENTLIB,
e.montant,
nvl(e.iddevise,'AR') AS iddevise,
e.taux
FROM ENCAISSEMENT e 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID  = e.IDCAISSE 
LEFT JOIN TYPE_ENCAISSEMENT te ON te.id = e.IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENTVENTE" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "VENTECARBURANT") AS
SELECT 
pe.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
sum( nvl(v.QTE * v.PU ,0) ) AS ventecarburant 
FROM PRELEVEMENT_ENCAISSE pe 
LEFT JOIN vente_validee v ON v.IDORIGINE =  pe.IDPRELEVEMENT 
GROUP BY pe.IDENCAISSEMENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_BON" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "MONTANTCATEGORIE") AS

FROM ENCAISSEMENT_DETAILS ed

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_DETAILS_LIB" ("ID", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_LIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DATY", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPISTELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "VENTECARBURANT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT", "DEPENSE", "TOTALRECETTE", "TOTALENCAISSEMENT", "TOTALVERSEMENT", "ECART", "TOTALESPECE", "TOTALORANGEMONEY") AS
SELECT 
e.ID ,
e.DESIGNATION ,
e.IDCAISSE ,
c.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
e.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN e.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
END AS ETATLIB, 
e.DATY ,
c.IDPOMPISTE ,
p.NOMUSER AS IDPOMPISTELIB,
c.IDPOINT ,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB ,
c.IDCATEGORIECAISSE ,
nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) AS ventecarburant ,
nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) AS ventelubrifiant ,
nvl(dv.depense,0) AS depense ,
nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) + nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) AS totalrecette ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) AS totalencaissement ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) - nvl(dv.depense,0) AS totalversement ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) - ( nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) + nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) ) AS ecart ,
nvl(ee.montantcategorie , 0) AS totalEspece,
nvl(eo.montantcategorie , 0) AS totalOrangeMoney
FROM ENCAISSEMENT e 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = e.IDCAISSE 
LEFT JOIN POMPISTELIB p ON p.REFUSER = c.IDPOMPISTE 
LEFT JOIN encaissementvente ev ON ev.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID 
LEFT JOIN ventelubrifiant_validee vv ON vv.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN depense_validee dv ON dv.IDORIGINE = e.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_validee ev2 ON ev2.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON p2.ID = c.IDPOINT 
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT_ESPECES ee ON ee.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT_ORANGEMONEY eo ON eo.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_RESUME" ("ID", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "DATY", "VENTECARBURANT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT", "BON", "CHEQUE", "MVOLA", "ESPECES", "ORANGEMONEY", "FANILO", "TPE", "VISA", "DEPENSE", "TOTALRECETTE", "TOTALENCAISSEMENT", "TOTALVERSEMENT") AS
SELECT 
el.ID ,
el.IDPOINT,
el.IDPOINTLIB ,
el.DATY,
el.ventecarburant,
el.ventelubrifiant,
nvl(eb.montantcategorie,0) AS bon ,
nvl(ec.montantcategorie,0) AS cheque ,
nvl(em.montantcategorie,0) AS mvola ,
nvl(ee.montantcategorie,0) AS especes ,
nvl(eo.montantcategorie,0) AS orangemoney ,
nvl(ef.montantcategorie,0) AS fanilo,
nvl(et.montantcategorie,0) AS tpe ,
nvl(ev.montantcategorie,0) AS visa ,
el.depense ,
el.totalrecette ,
el.totalencaissement ,
el.totalversement 
FROM ENCAISSEMENT_LIB el 
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIECAISSE c ON c.ID = el.IDCATEGORIECAISSE 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_bon eb ON eb.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_cheque ec ON ec.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_mvola em ON em.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_especes ee ON ee.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_orangemoney eo ON eo.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_fanilo ef ON ef.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_tpe et ON et.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_visa ev ON ev.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_TEMP" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "ETAT", "DATY", "IDENCAISSEMENT") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENTRETIENRH_LIB" ("ID", "TYPEENTRETIENT", "NOMPRENOMCANDIDAT", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDFONCTION", "IDDIRECTION", "IDEVALUATEUR", "MOTIVATIONCANDIDAT", "AMBITIONPROFESSIONEL", "PRETENTIONSALARIALE", "REMUNERATIONACTUEL", "APPRECIATIONCANDIDAT", "COMMENTAIRES", "EXPERIENCECANDIDAT", "ATOUT", "FAIBLESSES", "POINTVIGILANCE", "CONCLUSTION", "TYPEENTRETIENTLIB", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDDIRECTIONLIB", "IDEVALUATEURLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ETATRECAPITULATIFCOMMANDE" ("IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DATY", "MONTANT", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTANT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) as MONTANT,
    SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) as qteLivre,
    SUM(bcg.QTENONLIVRE) as qteNonLivre,
    COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0) as montantPaye,
    COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0) as montantRestant,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 22
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 2
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 111
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 11
        ELSE 1
        END as etat,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Payé'
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 'Accompte'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Livré'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 'non livré en totalité'
        ELSE 'non livré'
        END as etatLib
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_GLOBALE bcg
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_accompte ON mc_accompte.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_paye ON mc_paye.IDORIGINE = v.ID
WHERE bcg.ETAT = 11
GROUP BY
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    bcg.IDBC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ETATSTOCKLIB" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDTYPEPRODUIT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "REPORT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "DATY") AS
SELECT 
e.ID ,
e.IDPRODUIT ,
p.VAL AS IDPRODUITLIB,
e.IDMAGASIN ,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
e.IDPOINT ,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
e.IDTYPEPRODUIT ,
tp.VAL AS IDTYPEPRODUITLIB,
e.IDUNITE ,
u.VAL AS IDUNITELIB,
e.REPORT ,
e.ENTREE ,
e.SORTIE ,
e.RESTE ,
e.DATY 
FROM ETATSTOCK e 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = e.IDPRODUIT 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = e.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON p2.ID = e.IDPOINT 
LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID = e.IDTYPEPRODUIT 
LEFT JOIN UNITE u ON u.ID = e.IDUNITE;

SELECT dp.id,
       dp.mois,

       dp.matricule,

       dp.indemnitedepresentationbrut + dp.indemnite_de_transport AS indemnite,
       dp.avantages_en_nature AS avantages_en_nature,
       dp.montant_brut AS montant_brut,
       dp.cnaps,
       dp.net_a_payer,
       dp.imposable,

       dp.reductionpourpersonnesacharge,

       TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(dp.mois, 'MM'), 'MONTH', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS MOIS_LIB

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ETAT_VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "POIDS", "RESTE", "FRAIS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "IDCLIENTLIB", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "IDCLIENT", "IDPROVINCE", "ETAT", "IDPROVINCELIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB") AS
SELECT V.ID,
       V.IDVENTE,
       V.IDPRODUIT,
       V.IDORIGINE,
       CAST(V.QTE AS NUMBER(38, 2))        AS QTE,
       V.PU,
       V.REMISE,
       V.TVA,
       V.PUACHAT,
       V.PUVENTE,
       V.IDDEVISE,
       V.TAUXDECHANGE,
       V.DESIGNATION,
       V.COMPTE,
       V.PUREVIENT,
       V.IDBCFILLE,
       V.UNITE,
       V.UNITELIB,
       V.PUNET,
       V.MONTANTHT,
       CAST(V.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       CAST(V.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA,
       V.MONTANTREMISE,
       V.MONTANT,
       V.POIDS,
       VC.RESTE                            AS RESTE,
       V.FRAIS                             AS FRAIS,
       V.IDPRODUITLIB,
       V.DATY,
       V.DATYPREVU                         AS DATYPREVU,
       V.IDDEVISE                          AS IDDEVISELIB,
       V.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       V.CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,
       MONTANTTTC                          AS PUTOTAL,
       V.IDCLIENTLIB,
       V.RISTOURNE                         AS RISTOURNE,
       V.IDPREVISION,
       VE.IDCLIENT,
       C.IDPROVINCE,
       VE.ETAT,
       PRO.VAL                             AS IDPROVINCELIB,

       M.ID                                AS IDMAGASIN,
       M.VAL                               AS IDMAGASINLIB,

       P1.ID                               AS IDPOINT,
       P1.VAL                              AS IDPOINTLIB,

       TP.ID                               AS TYPEPRODUIT,
       TP.VAL                              AS TYPEPRODUITLIB

FROM VENTE_DETAILS_VIDE V
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCE E
                   ON E.IDPRODUIT = V.IDPRODUIT
                       AND E.IDUNITE = V.UNITE

         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS_RESTE VC
                   ON VC.ID = V.ID

         LEFT JOIN VENTE VE
                   ON VE.ID = V.IDVENTE

         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS P
                   ON P.ID = V.IDPRODUIT

         LEFT JOIN CLIENT C
                   ON C.ID = VE.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN PROVINCE PRO ON PRO.ID = C.IDPROVINCE
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = VE.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT P1 ON P1.ID = M.IDPOINT
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT TP ON TP.ID = P.TYPEPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EVALUATION_ANNUELLE_LIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "MATRICULE", "IDFONCTION", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "ANNEE", "NOTEGLOBALE", "COMMENTAIRE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    ea.ID,
    ea.IDPERSONNEL,
    lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM AS IDPERSONNELLIB,
    pip.MATRICULE AS MATRICULE,
    pip.IDFONCTION AS IDFONCTION,
    pf.VAL AS IDFONCTIONLIB,
    ea.ANNEE,
    ea.NOTEGLOBALE,
    ea.COMMENTAIRE,
    ea.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN ea.ETAT = 1 THEN 'En cours'
        WHEN ea.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Terminée'
        WHEN ea.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM EVALUATION_ANNUELLE ea
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL_V2 lp
                   ON ea.IDPERSONNEL = lp.ID
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON ea.IDPERSONNEL = pip.ID
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf
                   ON pip.IDFONCTION = pf.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EVALUATION_A_CHAUD_FILLE_LIB" ("ID", "IDEVALUATIONCHAUD", "IDEVALUATIONCRITERE", "NOTE", "IDEVALUATIONCRITERELIB") AS
(

		eacf.ID,eacf.IDEVALUATIONCHAUD,eacf.IDEVALUATIONCRITERE,eacf.NOTE,
		ceac.val AS idevaluationcriterelib

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EVALUATION_A_CHAUD_LIB" ("ID", "IDFORMATIONSUIVIE", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDINTERVENANT", "DATEFORMATION", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDFORMATIONSUIVIELIB", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "MATRICULEPERSONNEL", "IDFONCTION", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDINTERVENANTLIB", "IDFONCTIONINTERVENANT", "IDFONCTIONINTERENANTLIB") AS
(
	SELECT
		eac.ID,eac.IDFORMATIONSUIVIE,eac.IDPERSONNEL,eac.IDINTERVENANT,eac.DATEFORMATION,eac.DATY,eac.REMARQUE,
		af.intitule AS idformationsuivielib,
		lp.nom||lp.prenom AS idpersonnellib,
		pip.matricule AS matriculepersonnel,
		pip.idfonction AS idfonction,
		pf.val AS idfonctionlib,
		lpintervenant.nom || lpintervenant.prenom AS idintervenantlib,
		pipintervenant.idfonction AS idfonctionintervenant,
		pfintervenant.val AS idfonctioninterenantlib
	FROM evaluation_a_chaud eac
	LEFT JOIN action_formation af ON af.id=eac.idformationsuivie
	LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id=eac.idpersonnel
	LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=eac.idpersonnel
	LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pf.id=pip.idfonction
	LEFT JOIN log_personnel lpintervenant ON lpintervenant.id=eac.idintervenant
	LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pipintervenant ON pipintervenant.id=eac.idintervenant
	LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pfintervenant ON pfintervenant.id=pipintervenant.idfonction
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EVALUATION_DETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDEVALUATION", "IDCRITERE", "IDTYPECOMPETENCEFP", "IDTYPECOMPETENCEFPLIB", "COMPETENCE", "AUTOEVALUATION", "EVALUATIONSUPERIEUR", "SYNTHESE", "APPRECIATION", "NOTE", "COMMENTAIRE", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."EVALUATION_FROID_LIB" ("ID", "IDFORMATIONSUIVI", "IDPERSONNEL", "NOTE", "COMMENTAIRE", "DATEEVALUATION", "PERSONNEL", "MATRICULE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABNONRATTACHE" ("IDFABRICATION", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "QTEPETRI", "IDLIGNE", "LIGNE") AS
SELECT
	f.id AS idfabrication,
	f.daty AS daty,
	ffille.IDINGREDIENTS AS idproduit,
	ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
	ffille.qte AS qte,
	ffille.qte AS qtepetri,
	l.id AS idligne,
	l.VAL AS ligne
FROM 
FABRICATIONCPL f
LEFT JOIN FABRICATIONFILLE ffille ON f.ID =FFILLE.IDMERE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id=ffille.IDINGREDIENTS
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim ON aim.id=ffille.IDMACHINE
LEFT JOIN LIGNE l ON l.id=aim.IDLIGNE
LEFT JOIN RELEVEFAB rfab ON RFAB.IDFAB = f.id
where ai.ispetri=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRGROUPBYIDBC" ("IDBCFILLE", "QTE") AS

FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION m ON m.ID = f.IDMERE
WHERE m.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY f.IDBCFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDBC", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV", "EQUIPE", "LANCEUR") AS
SELECT 
f.ID,
f.LANCEPAR,
f.CIBLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.LIBELLE,
f.BESOIN,
f.DATY,
f.ETAT,
f.IDBC,
f.IDOFFILLE,
f.IDOF,
f.FABRICATIONPREC,
f.FABRICATIONSUIV,
f.EQUIPE,
CASE 
	WHEN f.LANCEUR IS NOT NULL 
	THEN f.LANCEUR||'---'||lp.nom||' '||lp.prenom 
END AS LANCEUR
FROM FABRICATION f 
LEFT JOIN OFFILLE o ON o.id = f.idOffille
LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON lp.id = f.LANCEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPL" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "LANCEUR", "LANCEURLIB", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT F.ID,
       F.LANCEPAR,
       F.CIBLE,
       F.REMARQUE,
       F.LIBELLE,
       F.BESOIN,
       F.DATY,
       F.IDOFFILLE,
       NVL(F.IDOF, OFF.IDMERE) AS IDOF,
       P.VAL                   AS LANCEPARLIB,
       P2.VAL                  AS CIBLELIB,
       F.ETAT                  AS ETAT,
       F.LANCEUR,
       LP.PRENOM || LP.NOM     AS LANCEURLIB,
       CASE
           WHEN F.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 21 THEN 'ENTAME'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 31 THEN 'BLOQUE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 41 THEN 'TERMINE'
           END                 AS ETATLIB,
       F.FABRICATIONPREC,
       F.FABRICATIONSUIV,
       (
           F.ID || ' | ' || P.VAL || ' | ' || P2.VAL || ' | ' || F.REMARQUE || ' | ' || IDOF || ' | ' || IDOFFILLE
           )                   AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM FABRICATION F
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P ON P.ID = F.LANCEPAR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P2 ON P2.ID = F.CIBLE
         LEFT JOIN OFFILLE OFF ON F.IDOFFILLE = OFF.ID
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL LP ON LP.ID = F.LANCEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPLANNULE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPLCREE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPLENTAMEE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPLVISEE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONENCOURS" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "FABENCOURS") AS
SELECT 
    fab.IDINGREDIENTS, 
    CAST(
        GREATEST(
            NVL(SUM(fab.QTE), 0) - NVL(SUM(mvt.ENTREE), 0), 
            0
        ) 
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FabEncours
FROM fabricationFilleFabriqueVise fab
LEFT JOIN MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE mvt 
    ON mvt.IDFAB = fab.IDMERE 
    AND mvt.IDPRODUIT = fab.IDINGREDIENTS
GROUP BY fab.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "IDUNITE", "IDBCFILLE", "OPERATEUR", "NIVEAU", "IDMACHINE", "PU", "QTE") AS
SELECT 
f.ID,
CASE 
	WHEN f.IDINGREDIENTS IS NOT NULL 
	THEN f.IDINGREDIENTS||'---'||ai.libelle 
	ELSE f.IDINGREDIENTS
END AS IDINGREDIENTS ,
f.LIBELLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.IDMERE,
f.DATYBESOIN,
f.IDUNITE,
f.IDBCFILLE,
f.OPERATEUR,
f.NIVEAU,
f.IDMACHINE,
f.PU,
f.QTE
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id =  f.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "OPERATEUR", "IDUNITELIB", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "ISPETRI", "IDOFFILLE", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDINGREDIENTS,
	f.LIBELLE,
	f.REMARQUE,
	f.IDMERE,
	f.DATYBESOIN,
	f.QTE,
	f.IDUNITE,
	f.PU,
	ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
	p.NOM || ' - ' || p.TELEPHONE AS operateur,
	au.val AS IDUNITELIB,
	f.IDBCFILLE ,
	f.IDMACHINE,
	m.descriptionobjet AS IDMACHINELIB,
	ai.ISPETRI ,
	f2.IDOFFILLE ,
	CAST( (f.QTE * f.PU ) AS NUMBER(30,5) ) AS MONTANT 
FROM
	FABRICATIONFILLE f
JOIN FABRICATION f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDMERE 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
	ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS
LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON
	p.ID = f.OPERATEUR
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
	au.id = f.IDUNITE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MACHINE m ON m.ID = f.IDMACHINE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLECPL2" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "REVIENT", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "DATY") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDINGREDIENTS,
    f.LIBELLE,
    f.REMARQUE,
    f.IDMERE,
    f.DATYBESOIN,
    f.QTE,
    f.IDUNITE,
    f.PU,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS revient,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
    ff.DATY
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = f.IDINGREDIENTS
JOIN FABRICATION ff ON f.IDMERE = ff.ID
WHERE ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEFABRIQUEVISE" ("IDMERE", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QTE") AS
SELECT 
f.idMere,
f.IDINGREDIENTS,
sum(f.qte) AS qte
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = f.idMere
WHERE fab.etat >=11
GROUP BY f.idMere,
f.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEPETRI" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDBCFILLE", "OPERATEUR", "NIVEAU", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "LIGNE", "DATY") AS
SELECT
f.ID,f.IDINGREDIENTS,f.LIBELLE,f.REMARQUE,f.IDMERE,f.DATYBESOIN,f.QTE,f.IDUNITE,f.PU,f.IDBCFILLE,f.OPERATEUR,f.NIVEAU,f.IDMACHINE, l.id AS idligne,
        l.VAL AS ligne, fab.daty
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
JOIN fabrication fab ON f.idmere = fab.id
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS  
LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.id = ai.typeproduit
LEFT JOIN LIGNE l ON l.id=tp.IDLIGNE
WHERE ai.ispetri = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEPRATIQUE" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "IDOFFILLE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB") AS
SELECT 
    idingredient AS idingredients ,
    idingredientlib AS libIngredients,
    IDOFFILLE,
    (sortie - entree) AS qte,
    pu,
    (sortie - entree) * pu AS montant ,
    unite AS idunite ,
    au.val AS idunitelib
FROM 
    mvtstockproduit
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = mvtstockproduit.unite
WHERE 
    (sortie - entree) > 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONMEREFILLE" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LIBELLE", "DATY", "IDBCFILLE") AS
SELECT
	ff.IDINGREDIENTS,
	ff.IDINGREDIENTSLIB ,
	sum(ff.QTE) qte,
	ff.IDUNITE ,
	f.idOffille,
	f.IDOF,
	f.LIBELLE,
	f.DATY,
	ff.IDBCFILLE 
FROM
	FabricationFilleCpl ff
JOIN FABRICATION f ON
	f.id = ff.IDMERE
WHERE
	f.etat = 11
GROUP BY
	ff.IDINGREDIENTS,
	ff.IDINGREDIENTSLIB ,
	ff.IDUNITE ,
	f.idOffille,
	f.LIBELLE,
	f.DATY,
	ff.IDBCFILLE,
	f.IDOF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONOFFILLE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "IDBCFILLE", "IDFAB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATION_OF" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF") AS
(

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTFOURNISSEURCALC" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASIN", "IDDEVISE", "ESTPREVU", "DATYPREVU", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDDMDACHAT", "IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE", "SERVICE", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ECHEANCEFACTURE", "REMISE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTHTAR") AS
select v."ID",v."IDFOURNISSEUR",v."IDMODEPAIEMENT",v."DATY",v."DESIGNATION",v."DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT",v."ETAT",v."REFERENCE",v."IDBC",v."DEVISE",v."TAUX",v."IDMAGASIN",v."IDDEVISE",v."ESTPREVU",v."DATYPREVU",v."NUMERO",v."TYPEACHAT",v."IDTYPEFACTURE",v."IDOBJET",v."IDREF",v."IDDMDACHAT",v."IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE",v."SERVICE",v."TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",v."ECHEANCEFACTURE",v."REMISE", cast(montantRemiseSansTva+ (montantHT* (nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantRemise, montantNonRemise,
       cast(montantHT*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(montantTva*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(montantTTC*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC, montantTTCAr*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantTTCAr, MONTANTHTAR*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantHtAr
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR v left join FFFilleCalcGroupeFF vdcv on v.id=vdcv.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTFRNSFILLEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION") AS
SELECT 
ff.ID,
ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
	THEN ff.IDPRODUIT||'---'||ai.LIBELLE
	ELSE ff.IDPRODUIT
END AS IDPRODUIT,
ff.PU,
ff.REMISES,
ff.IDBCDETAIL,
ff.TVA,
ff.DEVISE,
ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
ff.IDDEVISE,
ff.DESIGNATION,
ff.COMPTE,
ff.MOIS,
ff.ANNEE,
ff.QTE,
ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPREVISION IS NOT NULL 
	THEN ff.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.DESIGNATION  
	ELSE ff.IDPREVISION
END AS IDPREVISION
FROM FactureFournisseurFille ff 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ff.IDPRODUIT 
LEFT JOIN PREVISION p ON p.id = ff.IDPREVISION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTCPL" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDCLIENTLIB", "NUMEROCLIENT", "MONTANTPAYE", "IDRESERVATION", "RESTEAPAYERTTC") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,f.IDCLIENT,f.DATY,f.DESIGNATION,f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,f.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN f.etat=0 THEN 'ANNULE'
        WHEN f.etat=1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN f.etat=11 THEN 'VISEE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE'
        END AS etatlib,
    fm.montanttotal,
    fm.montanttotal - fm.montantTva AS montantHT,
    fm.montantTva,
    fm.montantTTC,
    c.NOM AS idClientLib,
    c.TELEPHONE AS numeroClient,
    nvl(fp.credit,0) as montantPaye,
    f.idreservation,
    (fm.montantTTC - nvl(fp.credit,0)) as resteapayerTTC
FROM FactureClient f
         LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENTMONTANT fm ON fm.id = f.id
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = f.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN factureclientpaye fp ON fp.IDORIGINE = f.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTDETAILSLIB" ("ID", "IDFACTURECLIENT", "IDACTE", "LIBELLE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "TVA", "COMPTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDFACTURECLIENT,
	f.idacte,
	a.libelle,
	f.QTE,
	f.PU,
	f.REMISES,
	f.TVA,
	f.COMPTE,
	f.IDPRODUIT,
	p.val AS idproduitlib,
	CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) )  AS number(30,2)) + CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(f.tva,0) /100)  AS number(30,2)) AS montant
FROM
	FACTURECLIENTDETAILS f
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON
	p.id = f.idproduit
LEFT JOIN acte a ON a.id = f.idacte;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC") AS
SELECT 
f.id ,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttotal,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttva,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2)) + CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montantttc
FROM FACTURECLIENTDETAILS fc 
LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENT f ON f.id = fc.idfactureclient
GROUP BY f.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTPAYE" ("IDORIGINE", "CREDIT") AS
SELECT
m.IDORIGINE, 
sum(m.credit) AS credit
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m 
WHERE m.ETAT = 11 
GROUP BY m.IDORIGINE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONCPL" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "COMPTE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT") AS
SELECT
             f.ID,
             f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
             f2.NOM AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,

             f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
             m.VAL AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,

             f.DATY,
             f.DESIGNATION,
             f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,

             f.ETAT,
             CASE
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CREE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULEE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
                 END AS ETATLIB,

             f.REFERENCE,
             f.IDBC,
             f.IDMAGASIN,
             f.DEVISE,
             f2.COMPTE,

             NVL(NULLIF(f.TAUX,0),1) AS TAUX,

             p.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,

             f.IDDEVISE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTVA,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTTC,

             CAST(
                     NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) * NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1)
                 AS NUMBER(30,2)
             ) AS MONTANTTTCAR,

             CAST(NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTRESTE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE,

             prev.ID AS IDPREVISION,

             CASE
                 WHEN f.estprevu = 0 THEN 'NON'
                 ELSE 'OUI'
                 END AS ESTPREVULIB,

             f.IDOBJET,
             f.IDREF,
             f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
             tf.VAL AS TYPEFACTURE,
             f.NUMERO,
             f.TYPEACHAT

         FROM FACTUREDECLARATION f
                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
                  LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATIONMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE mv ON f.ID = mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN PREVISION prev ON prev.IDFACTURE = f.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_FACTURE tf ON tf.ID = f.IDTYPEFACTURE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "FRAISACCESOIRE", "MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "LIBELLEEXACTE") AS
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)                                          AS fraisaccesoire,

       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte
FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
SELECT v.ID,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))) as number(30,2)) AS montanttotal,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.REMISES /100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100) as number(30,2)) AS montantTva,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100)+SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0)))as number(30,2))  as montantTTC,
                NVL (vd.IDDEVISE,'AR') AS IDDEVISE,
                nvl (vd.tauxdechange,1) AS tauxdechange
         FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE vd LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATION v ON v.ID = vd.idfacturefournisseur
         GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE,vd.tauxdechange;

       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       ff.etat,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE) as number(30, 2))                            as montantht,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2))              as montanttva,
       cast(sum((pu * QTE) + pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2)) as montantttc,
       ff.iddevise,
       ff.tauxdechange
from FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECPL ff
group by COMPTE, IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, ff.etat,ff.iddevise,ff.tauxdechange;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURAVECMACHINE" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDOBJETLIB", "IDENTITE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB") AS
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
       m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VISEE'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.DEVISE,
       case
           when f.TAUX=0 then 1
           else f.TAUX
           end as taux,
       p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
       f3.IDDEVISE,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       CAST(f3.MONTANTTTC-f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
       prev.id as idPrevision,
       CASE
           WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
           ELSE 'OUI'
           END
           AS estprevulib,
       f.IDOBJET,
       f.IDREF,
       machine.LIBELLE AS idObjetLib,
       machine.IDENTITE,
       ligne.id AS idligne,
       ligne.val AS idlignelib
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.id
         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON f.id=mv.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE machine ON machine.ID = f.IDOBJET
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE ligne ON ligne.id=machine.idLIGNE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTPAYEAR", "MONTANTRESTEAR", "MONTANTRESTE", "MONTANTAVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE", "IDSERVICELIB", "SERVICE", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDECRITURE", "TYPEACHATLIB", "REMISE") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
    f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    f.DATY,
    f.DESIGNATION,
    f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
    f.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    nvl(f.REFERENCE, reff.reference) as reference,
    f.IDBC,
    f.IDMAGASIN,
    f.DEVISE,
    case
        when f.TAUX=0 then 1
        else f.TAUX
        end as taux,
    p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
    f.IDDEVISE,
    cast(f.MONTANTTVA as number(30,5)) as MONTANTTVA,
    CAST(f.MONTANTHT as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTHT,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC as number(30,5)) as montantttc,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,5)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpaye,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)*nvl(f.TAUX,1) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpayeAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR-((nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0))*nvl(f.TAUX,1)) AS number(30,5)) AS montantresteAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantreste,
    cast(av.montantTTC as number(30,2)) as montantAvoir,
    cast(f.TAUX AS  number(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
    prev.id as idPrevision,
    CASE
        WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
        ELSE 'OUI'
        END
        AS estprevulib,
    f.IDOBJET,
    f.IDREF,
    f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
    tf.VAL as typefacture,
    f.numero,
    f.typeachat,
    f.idfactureprincipale,
    s.libelle AS idServiceLib,
    f.SERVICE,
    f.TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    tff.DESCE AS TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEURLIB,
    ce.id AS idecriture,
    ta.VAL AS typeachatlib,
    f.REMISE
FROM FactFournisseurCalc f
    LEFT JOIN TYPEACHAT ta ON ta.DESCE = f.TYPEACHAT
    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
    LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
    LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON f.id=mv.ID2
    left join AvoirAChatCalcGroupeOrigine av on av.IDFACTURE=f.ID
    LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
    left join type_facture tf on tf.id = f.IDTYPEFACTURE
    LEFT JOIN SERVICE s ON f.SERVICE = s.COMPTE
    LEFT JOIN referencefacture reff ON f.id=reff.idfacture
    LEFT JOIN typefacturefournisseur tff ON tff.id = f.TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ce ON ce.idobjet=f.id;

       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
       prev.id as idPrevision,
       CASE
           WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
           ELSE 'OUI'
           END
           AS estprevulib,
       f.IDOBJET,
       f.IDREF
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.id
         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON f.id=mv.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_MONTANT" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTPAYER", "MONTANTRESTE") AS
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       f2.NOM                                                                      AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
       m.VAL                                                                       AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 9
               THEN 'ENCAISEE'
           END                                                                     AS ETATLIB,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.DEVISE,
       f.TAUX,
       p.VAL                                                                       AS idMagasinLib,
       cast(mon.montant as NUMBER(30, 2))                                          as montant,
       cast(nvl(m.montantapayer, 0) as NUMBER(30, 2))                              as montantpayer,
       case
           when mon.montant < nvl(m.montantapayer, 0) then 0
           else cast((mon.montant - nvl(m.montantapayer, 0)) as NUMBER(30, 2)) end as montantreste
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
         left join FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_montant mon on mon.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR = f.id
         LEFT JOIN montantapayer m ON f.ID = m.idfacturefournisseur;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TRAVAUX" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDTRAVAUX") AS
SELECT f.ID,
	       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
	       f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
	       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
	       m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
	       f.DATY,
	       f.DESIGNATION,
	       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
	       f.ETAT,
	       CASE
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
	               THEN 'CREEE'
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
	               THEN 'ANNULEE'
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
	               THEN 'VISEE'
	           END AS ETATLIB,
	       f.REFERENCE,
	       f.IDBC,
	       f.IDMAGASIN,
	       f.DEVISE,
	       case
	           when f.TAUX=0 then 1
	           else f.TAUX
	           end as taux,
	       p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
	       f3.IDDEVISE,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
	       CAST(f3.MONTANTTTC-f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
	       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
	       cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
	       prev.id as idPrevision,
	       CASE
	           WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
	           ELSE 'OUI'
	           END
	           AS estprevulib,
	       f.IDOBJET,
	       f.IDREF,
	       f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
	       tf.VAL as typefacture,
	       f.numero,
	       f.typeachat,
	       t.id AS idTravaux
	FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
	         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
	         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
	         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
	         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.id
	         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON f.id=mv.IDORIGINE
	         LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
	         left join type_facture tf on tf.id = f.IDTYPEFACTURE
	         LEFT JOIN dmdAchat d ON f.idDmdAchat = d.id
	         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUX t ON d.idObjet = t.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "FRAISACCESOIRE", "MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DESIGNATION") AS
(
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.COMPTE,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 1 Montant HT brut
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montanttotal,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 2 Montant remise (appliquee sur HT)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 3 Montant HT net apres remise
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 4 TVA sur montant HT net
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 5 Montant TTC net (HT net + TVA)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 6 Frais accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(r.montant, 0)                                                 AS fraisaccesoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 7 Montant total avec frais (TTC + accessoires)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(r.montant, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 8 PU unitaire HT + accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(r.montant, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- Info produit & localisation
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte,
       f.IDPREVISION,
       p2.ID                                                             AS idpoint,
       p2.VAL                                                            AS idpointlib,
       m.ID                                                              AS idmagasin,
       m.VAL                                                             AS idmagasinlib,
       c.ID                                                              AS idcategorie,
       c.VAL                                                             AS idcategorielib,
       f.designation

FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m
                   ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT p2
                   ON p2.ID = m.IDPOINT
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON c.ID = p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN REPARTIRIONPGGROUPEE r
                   ON r.IDFACTUREFILLE = f.ID
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPLC" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "FRAISACCESOIRE", "MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "IDPREVISION", "COMPTE") AS
SELECT
    f."ID",f."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",f."IDPRODUIT",f."IDPRODUITLIB",f."QTE",f."PU",f."REMISES",f."IDBCDETAIL",f."TVA",f."IDDEVISE",f."DATY",f."MONTANT",f."MONTANTREMISE",f."MONTANTHT",f."MONTANTTVA",f."MONTANTTTC",f."FRAISACCESOIRE",f."MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE",f."PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE",f."LIBELLEEXACTE",f."IDPREVISION" ,
    f2.COMPTE
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPL f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f2
                   ON f.ID  = f2.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLEVALIDE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION") AS
SELECT ff."ID",ff."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",ff."IDPRODUIT",ff."PU",ff."REMISES",ff."IDBCDETAIL",ff."TVA",ff."DEVISE",ff."TAUXDECHANGE",ff."IDDEVISE",ff."DESIGNATION",ff."COMPTE",ff."MOIS",ff."ANNEE",ff."QTE",ff."MONTANTPERTEGAIN",ff."IDPREVISION" FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff JOIN facturefournisseur f ON f.id=ff.idfacturefournisseur WHERE f.etat>=11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE_PAYE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "COMPTEREGR", "ETAT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTC", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "DATY", "POURCENTAGEPAYE", "MONTANTFILLEPAYE", "RESTEAPAYERFILLE", "MONTANTFILLEPAYEAR", "MONTANTFILLE", "SERVICE") AS
SELECT FFF.ID,
	       FFF.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	       FFF.IDPRODUIT,
	       FFF.QTE,
	       FFF.PU,
	       FFF.REMISES,
	       FFF.IDBCDETAIL,
	       FFF.TVA,
	       FFF.PRODUITLIB,
	       FFF.COMPTE,
	       FFF.COMPTE                                                               AS compteregr,
	       FFF.ETAT,
	       FFF.IDDEVISE,
	       FFF.TAUXDECHANGE,
	       FF.MONTANTTTC,
	       FFF.MOIS,
	       FFF.ANNEE,
	       FF.DATY,
	       FF.MONTANTPAYE * 100 / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)                                                     AS pourcentagepaye,
	       (FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)                                    AS MontantFillePaye,
	       (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU) - ((FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU))             AS resteapayerfille,
	       ((FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)) * FFF.TAUXDECHANGE               AS MontantFillePayeAr,
	       (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)                                                                                   AS montantfille,
	       FF.SERVICE
	FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLECPL FFF
	         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL FF ON FF.ID = FFF.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE_U" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION", "REMISE", "RISTOURNE", "COMPTEANALYTIQUE", "UNITE", "IDUNITE") AS
(
select f."ID",f."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",f."IDPRODUIT",f."PU",f."REMISES",f."IDBCDETAIL",f."TVA",f."DEVISE",f."TAUXDECHANGE",f."IDDEVISE",f."DESIGNATION",f."COMPTE",f."MOIS",f."ANNEE",f."QTE",f."MONTANTPERTEGAIN",f."IDPREVISION",f."REMISE",f."RISTOURNE",f."COMPTEANALYTIQUE", au.id as UNITE, au.val as IDUNITE
from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         left join AS_ingredients ai on ai.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         left join as_unite au on au.ID = ai.UNITE
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
SELECT v.ID,
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))) as number(30,2)) AS montanttotal, 
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.REMISES /100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100) as number(30,2)) AS montantTva,
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100)+SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0)))as number(30,2))  as montantTTC,
            NVL (vd.IDDEVISE,'AR') AS IDDEVISE,
            nvl (vd.tauxdechange,1) AS tauxdechange
            FROM FactureFournisseurFille vd LEFT JOIN facturefournisseur v ON v.ID = vd.idfacturefournisseur
   GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE,vd.tauxdechange;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_COMPTEREGR" ("COMPTEREGR", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MONTANT", "MONTANTPAYE", "RESTEAPAYER") AS
select compteregr,
	       mois,
	       annee,
	       sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
	       sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
	       sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
	from facturefournisseurfille_paye
	group by compteregr, mois, annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_CPL" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASIN", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MODEDEPAIMENTLIB", "COMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE") AS
select ff."ID",ff."IDFOURNISSEUR",ff."IDMODEPAIEMENT",ff."DATY",ff."DESIGNATION",ff."DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT",ff."ETAT",ff."REFERENCE",ff."IDBC",ff."DEVISE",ff."TAUX",ff."IDMAGASIN",
       f.NOM as fournisseurlib,
       mp.VAL as modedepaimentlib,
       f.COMPTE,
       f.compteauxiliaire
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR ff
         left join FOURNISSEUR f on ff.IDFOURNISSEUR = f.ID
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on ff.IDMODEPAIEMENT = mp.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLECOMPTE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS
select ff.COMPTE,
       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.etat,
       cast(sum(MONTANTHT) as number(30, 2))                            as montantht,
       cast(sum(MONTANTTVA) as number(30, 2))              as montanttva,
       cast(sum(MONTANTTTC) as number(30, 2)) as montantttc,
       cast(sum(MONTANTTTCAr) as number(30, 2)) as montantttcAr,
       ff.iddevise,
       ff.tauxdechange
from FFFILLECALC ff join FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f on f.id=ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
group by COMPTE, IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, f.etat,ff.iddevise,ff.tauxdechange;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "ETAT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MOIS", "ANNEE") AS
select ff.ID,
	       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	       ff.IDPRODUIT,
	       ff.QTE,
	       ff.PU,
	       ff.REMISES,
	       ff.IDBCDETAIL,
	       ff.TVA,
	       p.LIBELLE as produitlib,
	       ff.compte,

	from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLE_CREE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC") AS
select "COMPTE","IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR","ETAT","MONTANTHT","MONTANTTVA","MONTANTTTC"
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLECOMPTE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLE_ECR" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPRODUIT") AS
select ff.COMPTE,
       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       ff.etat,
       cast(sum(ff.pu * ff.QTE) as number(30, 2))                            as montantht,
       cast(sum(ff.pu * ff.QTE * (ff.tva / 100)) as number(30, 2))              as montanttva,
       cast(sum((ff.pu * ff.QTE) + ff.pu * ff.QTE * (ff.tva / 100)) as number(30, 2)) as montantttc,
       ff.iddevise,
       ff.tauxdechange,
       ing.ID as IDPRODUIT
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLECPL ff left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=ff.IDPRODUIT
group by COMPTE, IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, ff.etat,ff.iddevise,ff.tauxdechange, ing.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLE_MERE" ("IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FILLE_VISE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FL_COMPTE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANTHT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_FL_ERITURE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANTHT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_LIVRENONPAY" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTPAYER", "MONTANTRESTE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_MERECMPT" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASIN", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MODEDEPAIMENTLIB", "COMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_MF" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "DATY", "PUREMISE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_MONTANT" ("IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_PAYENOLIVRE" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTPAYER", "MONTANTRESTE") AS
SELECT "ID","IDFOURNISSEUR","IDFOURNISSEURLIB","IDMODEPAIEMENT","IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB","DATY","DESIGNATION","DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT","ETAT","ETATLIB","REFERENCE","IDBC","IDMAGASIN","DEVISE","TAUX","IDMAGASINLIB","MONTANT","MONTANTPAYER","MONTANTRESTE"
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_montant
WHERE ETAT = 12;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_PERTE" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASIN", "IDDEVISE", "ESTPREVU", "DATYPREVU", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDDMDACHAT", "IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE", "SERVICE", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR") AS
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.DEVISE,
       f.TAUX,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f.ESTPREVU,
       f.DATYPREVU,
       cast (nvl(p.MONTANTAR, 0) as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN,
       f.numero ,
       f.TYPEACHAT ,
       f.IDTYPEFACTURE ,
       f.IDOBJET ,
       f.IDREF ,
       f.IDDMDACHAT ,
