         left JOIN perte_grporigine_fact p ON p.idorigine = f.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_RECAP_JOUR" ("DATY", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "NOMBRE", "MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR") AS
WITH BORNES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-06-01' AS DATE_MIN,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATE_MAX
    FROM DUAL
),
CALENDRIER AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
FACTURE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS NOMBRE
    FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TOUS_FAE
    WHERE IDTYPEFACTURE = 'TPF0002'
      AND ETAT = 11
      AND DATY >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY TRUNC(DATY)
)
SELECT
    c.DATY,

    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTTTC, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTRESTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    CAST(NVL(f.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(f.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,5)
    ) AS MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR

FROM CALENDRIER c
LEFT JOIN FACTURE_JOUR f
    ON c.DATY = f.DATY;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURESTANDARD" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DEVISE", "IDDEVISE", "ETAT", "TAUX", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "TYPEACHAT", "IDECRITURE", "COMPTE", "NUMERO") AS
SELECT
    fcpl.id,
    fcpl.idfournisseur,
    fcpl.idfournisseurlib,
    fcpl.idmodepaiement,
    fcpl.idmodepaiementlib,
    fcpl.daty,
    fcpl.designation,
    fcpl.dateecheancepaiement,
    fcpl.etatlib,
    fcpl.reference,
    fcpl.idbc,
    fcpl.idmagasin,
    fcpl.idmagasinlib,
    fcpl.devise,
    fcpl.iddevise,
    fcpl.etat,
    fcpl.taux,
    fcpl.montanttva,
    fcpl.montantht,
    fcpl.tauxdechange,
    fcpl.montantttc AS MONTANTTTC,
    nvl((fcpl.montantpaye * fcpl.TAUXDECHANGE), 0) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    nvl((fcpl.montantreste * fcpl.TAUXDECHANGE), 0) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    fcpl.IDOBJET,
    fcpl.IDREF,
    fcpl.typeachat,
    ce.id AS idecriture,
    '-' AS compte,
    fcpl.numero AS numero
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL fcpl
        LEFT JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON
        ce.idobjet = fcpl.id
/*  LEFT JOIN compta_compte cc ON cc.idjournal=ce.journal */
WHERE
    fcpl.typeachat = 'PS';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFAVECPERTE_FF" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "DATY", "PUPERTEGAIN", "MONTANTAVECPERTEGAIN", "LIBELLEPRODUIT") AS
SELECT
    ff.ID,
    ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.IDPRODUIT,
    ff.QTE,
    ff.PU,
    ff.REMISES,
    ff.IDBCDETAIL,
    ff.TVA,
    ff.DEVISE,
    ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
    ff.IDDEVISE,
    ff.DESIGNATION,
    ff.COMPTE,
    CAST(nvl(rep.montant,0) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN ,
    ff.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.ETAT,ff.DATY,
    CAST(((ff.PUREMISE*TAUXDECHANGE)+(nvl(rep.MONTANT,0)/qte)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS pupertegain ,
    CAST(((qte*ff.PUREMISE*TAUXDECHANGE)+nvl(rep.montant,0)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantavecpertegain,
    asi.LIBELLE AS LIBELLEPRODUIT
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_mf ff
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS asi ON ASI.ID = ff.IDPRODUIT
        left join RepartirionPG rep on rep.IDFACTUREFILLE=ff.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFAVECPERTE_FF_IDPG" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "DATY", "PUPERTEGAIN", "MONTANTAVECPERTEGAIN", "LIBELLEPRODUIT") AS
SELECT
    ff.ID,
    ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.IDPRODUIT,
    ff.QTE,
    ff.PU,
    ff.REMISES,
    p.IDBCDETAIL as IDBCDETAIL,
    ff.TVA,
    ff.DEVISE,
    ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
    ff.IDDEVISE,
    ff.DESIGNATION,
    ff.COMPTE,
    CAST( nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),(p.montantAr*qte*p.TAUX*ff.pu/fg.montanttotal)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN ,
    ff.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.ETAT,ff.DATY,
    CAST( (qte*ff.pu*TAUXDECHANGE+nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),0))/qte AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS pupertegain ,
    CAST( (qte*ff.pu*TAUXDECHANGE+nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),0)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantavecpertegain,
    asi.LIBELLE AS LIBELLEPRODUIT
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_mf ff
        left JOIN perte_grporigine_fact p ON p.idorigine=ff.idfacturefournisseur
        LEFT JOIN ff_grpmere fg ON fg.idfacturefournisseur=ff.idfacturefournisseur
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS asi ON ASI.ID = ff.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECALC" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION", "REMISE", "RISTOURNE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select vd."ID",vd."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",vd."IDPRODUIT",vd."PU",vd."REMISES",vd."IDBCDETAIL",vd."TVA",vd."DEVISE",vd."TAUXDECHANGE",vd."IDDEVISE",vd."DESIGNATION",vd."COMPTE",vd."MOIS",vd."ANNEE",vd."QTE",vd."MONTANTPERTEGAIN",vd."IDPREVISION",vd."REMISE",vd."RISTOURNE",cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*((nvl(vd.REMISE,0)+nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0))/100) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,
cast(vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as puRemise,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1)*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE vd;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECALCGROUPEFF" ("IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS
select vdc.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,cast(sum(montantNonRemise) as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,cast(sum(montantRemiseSansTva) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr
from FFFilleCalc vdc group by vdc.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECPL_MONTANT" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTTC", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDDEVISE") AS
SELECT 
f.ID ,
f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
f.IDPRODUIT ,
nvl(i.LIBELLE,p.VAL) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
f.QTE ,
CAST(f.PU AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU ,
CAST(f.REMISES AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS REMISES ,
f.IDBCDETAIL,
CAST(f.TVA AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS TVA,
CAST(nvl(f.QTE*f.PU,0)  AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS MONTANTTOTAL,
CAST(
    nvl(
        ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
        + (((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))) * NVL(f.TVA, 0) / 100)
    , 0) 
AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
p2.ID AS IDPOINT,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
m.ID AS IDMAGASIN,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
c.ID AS IDCATEGORIE,
c.VAL AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
f2.DATY AS daty,
f.IDDEVISE
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON m.IDPOINT = p2.ID  
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE c ON p.IDCATEGORIE = c.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON i.ID = f.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECPL_VISEE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "IDPREVISION") AS
SELECT
    f.ID ,
    f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
    f.IDPRODUIT ,
    nvl(i.LIBELLE,p.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    f.QTE ,
    f.PU ,
    f.REMISES ,
    f.IDBCDETAIL ,
    f.TVA ,
    f.IDDEVISE,
    f2.DATY,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantht,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU + (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TVA/100) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantttc,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU * f.TVA/100 AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttva,
    CAST((nvl(f.remises/100,0))*(f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantRemise,
    CAST((1-nvl(f.remises/100,0))*(f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    f.idprevision
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON i.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
where f2.ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLERESTEALIVRER" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDUNITE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PUPERTEGAIN") AS
SELECT f.id,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       cast(f.QTE - nvl(sum(abf.QUANTITE), 0) as number(38, 2)) AS qte,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       au.id as idunite,
       ai.LIBELLE as idproduitlib,
       au.val as unitelib,
       cast(fac.PUPERTEGAIN as number(38, 2)) as PUPERTEGAIN
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE abf ON f.ID = abf.IDBC_FILLE
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai on ai.id = f.idproduit
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au on au.id = ai.UNITE
    LEFT JOIN FFAVECPERTE_ff fac on fac.id = f.id
GROUP BY f.id, f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, f.IDPRODUIT, f.QTE, f.PU, f.REMISES, f.IDBCDETAIL, f.TVA, ai.LIBELLE, au.val, au.id, ai.id, fac.PUPERTEGAIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLERESTEALIVRERLIB" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDUNITE") AS
SELECT 
f.ID ,
f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
f.IDPRODUIT ,
p.VAL AS IDPRODUITLIB,
f.QTE ,
f.PU ,
f.REMISES ,
f.IDBCDETAIL ,
f.TVA , 
p.idunite
FROM FFFILLERESTEALIVRER f 
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FF_FILLEBC_GRP" ("IDPRODUIT", "IDBCDETAIL", "QTE") AS
SELECT
	ff.idproduit,
	ff.IDBCDETAIL,
	sum(ff.qte) AS qte
	FROM (SELECT ff.* FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff JOIN facturefournisseur f ON f.id=ff.idfacturefournisseur WHERE f.etat>=11  ) ff
GROUP BY idproduit,IDBCDETAIL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FF_FILLEBC_GRP_MERE" ("IDPRODUIT", "IDBC", "QTE") AS
SELECT
	ff.idproduit,
	ff.idbc,
	sum(ff.qte) AS qte
	FROM (SELECT ff.*, f.IDBC FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff JOIN facturefournisseur f ON f.id=ff.idfacturefournisseur WHERE f.etat>=11) ff
GROUP BY idproduit, ff.idbc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FF_FILLEBL_GRP" ("PRODUIT", "IDBC_FILLE", "QTE") AS
SELECT
	produit,
	IDBC_FILLE,
	sum(quantite) AS qte
	FROM (SELECT blf.* FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE blf JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON bl ON bl.id=blf.NUMBL WHERE bl.etat>=11  )
GROUP BY produit,IDBC_FILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FF_GRPMERE" ("IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN") AS
SELECT
idfacturefournisseur,
sum(qte*pu) AS montanttotal,
sum(MONTANTPERTEGAIN) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN
FROM facturefournisseurfille
GROUP BY idfacturefournisseur;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES_LIB" ("ID", "IDFICHEPOSTE", "IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP", "IDTYPECOMPETENCESFPLIB", "DESCRIPTION", "NIVEAU", "NIVEAULIB") AS
SELECT
    fpc.ID,
    fpc.IDFICHEPOSTE,
    fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP,
    t.VAL AS IDTYPECOMPETENCESFPLIB,
    fpc.DESCRIPTION,
    fpc.NIVEAU,

    CASE
        WHEN fpc.NIVEAU = 0 THEN 'Non acquis'
        WHEN fpc.NIVEAU = 1 THEN 'En cours d''acquisition'
        WHEN fpc.NIVEAU = 2 THEN 'Acquis'
        WHEN fpc.NIVEAU = 3 THEN 'Maitrise'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS NIVEAULIB

FROM FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES fpc
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COMPETENCES_FP t
                   ON t.ID = fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES_VIDE" ("ID", "IDFICHEPOSTE", "IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP", "DESCRIPTION", "NIVEAU") AS
SELECT
    ID,
    IDFICHEPOSTE,
    IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP,
    DESCRIPTION,
    NIVEAU
FROM FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FICHE_POSTE_LIB" ("ID", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDTYPECONTRAT", "TITRE", "REFERENCE", "DESCRIPTION", "MISSIONS", "EXIGENCEPOSTE", "SALAIREMIN", "SALAIREMAX", "ETAT", "DATY", "LIEUTRAVAIL", "MATERIELDOCUMENT", "OUTILS", "CONDITIONTRAVAIL", "MODECONTROLE", "IDNIVEAUFORMATION", "IDPERMIS", "IDFONCTION", "IDBU", "AUTRE", "IDCATEGORIEPAIE", "IDQUALIFICATIONPAIE", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "IDTYPECONTRATLIB", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDNIVEAUFORMATIONLIB", "IDPERMISLIB", "IDBULIB", "IDCATEGORIEPAIELIB", "IDQUALIFICATIONPAIELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFAMILLEPROFESSIONELLIB", "IDMETIERLIB", "IDEMPLOILIB", "IDCODEROMELIB") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,f.IDDEPARTEMENT,f.IDTYPECONTRAT,f.TITRE,f.REFERENCE,f.DESCRIPTION,f.MISSIONS,f.EXIGENCEPOSTE,f.SALAIREMIN,f.SALAIREMAX,f.ETAT,f.DATY,f.LIEUTRAVAIL,f.MATERIELDOCUMENT,f.OUTILS,f.CONDITIONTRAVAIL,f.MODECONTROLE,f.IDNIVEAUFORMATION,f.IDPERMIS,f.IDFONCTION,f.IDBU,f.AUTRE,f.IDCATEGORIEPAIE,f.IDQUALIFICATIONPAIE,
    d.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,
    t.VAL AS IDTYPECONTRATLIB,
    pf.VAL AS IDFONCTIONLIB,
    nf.DESCE AS idNiveauFormationLib,
    p.DESCE AS idPermisLib,
    bu.VAL AS idBuLib,
    cp.VAL AS idCategoriePaieLib,
    qp.VAL AS idQualificationPaieLib,

    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT = '1'  THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN f.ETAT = '11' THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN f.ETAT = '0'  THEN 'Annule'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    fp.val AS idFamilleProfessionelLib,
    m.val AS idMetierLib,
    em.val AS idEmploiLib,
    cr.code AS idCodeRomeLib
FROM FICHE_POSTE f
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT d ON d.ID = f.IDDEPARTEMENT
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_CONTRAT t ON t.ID = f.IDTYPECONTRAT
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf ON pf.ID = f.IDFONCTION
         LEFT JOIN FORMATION_DIPLOME nf ON nf.ID = f.idNiveauFormation
         LEFT JOIN PERMIS p ON p.ID = f.idPermis
         LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_UNITE bu ON bu.ID = f.idBu
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE cp ON cp.ID = f.idCategoriePaie
         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.ID = f.idQualificationPaie
         LEFT JOIN FAMILLE_PROFESSIONNELLE fp ON fp.id = f.idFamilleProfessionel
         LEFT JOIN METIER m ON m.id = f.idMetier
         LEFT JOIN emploi em ON em.id = f.idEmploi
         LEFT JOIN code_rome cr ON cr.id = f.idCodeRome;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FOURNISSEURCPL" ("ID", "NOM", "NIF", "STAT", "ADRESSE", "CONTACT", "CODEPOSTAL", "COMPTE", "IDTYPEFOURNISSEUR", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "ESTACTIF", "NB") AS
SELECT f."ID",f."NOM",f."NIF",f."STAT",f."ADRESSE",f."CONTACT",f."CODEPOSTAL",f."COMPTE",f."IDTYPEFOURNISSEUR",f."COMPTEAUXILIAIRE",f."ESTACTIF",
       1 as nb
FROM FOURNISSEUR f;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FRAIS_MEDICAUXMOIS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TOTAL_BRUT", "FRAIS_MEDICAUX") AS
SELECT pe.idpersonnel,
       pe.mois,
       pe.annee,
       sum(pe.gain) AS total_brut,
       COALESCE(prfrm.gain, 0) AS frais_medicaux
FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_edition prfrm ON pe.idpersonnel = prfrm.idpersonnel AND pe.mois = prfrm.mois AND pe.annee = prfrm.annee AND prfrm.idelementpaie = 'PR000FRM'
WHERE (pe.idelementpaie IN ( SELECT pr.id
                             FROM paie_rubrique pr
                             WHERE pr.typerubrique = 'G' AND (pr.id NOT IN ('PR000210A', 'PR000FRM', 'PR000181'))))
GROUP BY pe.idpersonnel, pe.mois, pe.annee, prfrm.gain;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FRAIS_MEDICAUX_ALL" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "POSTE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "TOTAL_BRUT", "FRAIS_MEDICAUX", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TEST", "MOISLIB") AS
SELECT pip.id,
       pip.matricule,
       lp.nom || lp.prenom AS nom,
       pf.desce AS poste,
       pip.dateembauche,
       pip.numero_cnaps,
       frm.total_brut,
       frm.frais_medicaux,
       frm.mois,
       frm.annee AS annee,
       (frm.total_brut * 0.06) AS test,
       mo.val AS moislib
FROM paie_info_personnel pip
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pip.idfonction = pf.id
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id = pip.id
         LEFT JOIN frais_medicauxmois frm ON frm.idpersonnel = pip.id
         LEFT JOIN moiscp mo ON mo.id = frm.mois;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FREQUENCE_PANNE_MACHINE" ("ID", "IDENTITE", "IDSITUATION", "IDMACHINE", "DATY", "DATEBESOIN", "PRIORITE", "ESTEXISTANT", "DESCRIPTION", "ETAT", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "CAUSE", "DEMANDEUR", "IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE", "IDMACHINELIB", "QTE") AS
SELECT
    d."ID",d."IDENTITE",d."IDSITUATION",d."IDMACHINE",d."DATY",d."DATEBESOIN",d."PRIORITE",d."ESTEXISTANT",d."DESCRIPTION",d."ETAT",d."IDDEPARTEMENT",d."CAUSE",d."DEMANDEUR",d."IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE" ,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idMachineLib,
    1 AS qte
FROM DEMANDETRAVAUX d
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m
                   ON d.IDMACHINE = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
                   ON m.IDINGREDIENT = ai.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FRM_MOIS_ANNEE" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "TOTAL_FRM") AS
SELECT fma.mois,
       fma.annee AS annee,
       CAST(sum(fma.frais_medicaux) AS NUMBER(15,2)) AS total_frm
FROM frais_medicaux_all fma
GROUP BY fma.mois, fma.annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FUMIGATION_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDNUMEROVAGUE", "IDOPERATEUR", "IDLOT", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "NOMBREOAC", "HEUREDEBUTFUMIGATION", "HEUREFINFUMIGATION", "HEUREDEBUTEXTRACTION", "HEUREFINEXTRACTION", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "TEMPERATUREMIN", "TEMPERATUREMAX", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROVAGUELIB", "IDOPERATEURLIB", "IDLOTLIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT f.ID,
       f.DATY,
       f.IDNUMEROVAGUE,
       f.IDOPERATEUR,
       f.IDLOT,
       f.IDBATIMENT,
       f.IDPARQUET,
       f.NOMBREOAC,
       f.HEUREDEBUTFUMIGATION,
       f.HEUREFINFUMIGATION,
       f.HEUREDEBUTEXTRACTION,
       f.HEUREFINEXTRACTION,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       f.QTE,
       f.TEMPERATUREMIN,
       f.TEMPERATUREMAX,
       f.ETAT,
       nc.VAL                          AS IDNUMEROVAGUELIB,
       op.NOM || ' ' || op.PRENOM    AS IDOPERATEURLIB,
       l.NOMLOT                        AS IDLOTLIB,
       b.NOMBATIMENT                   AS IDBATIMENTLIB,
       p.VAL                           AS IDPARQUETLIB,
       ai.LIBELLE                      AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       CASE f.ETAT
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
           END                                AS ETATLIB
FROM FUMIGATION f
         LEFT JOIN NUMEROCOLLECTE nc ON nc.ID = f.IDNUMEROVAGUE
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL op ON op.ID = f.IDOPERATEUR
         LEFT JOIN LOT l ON l.ID = f.IDLOT
         LEFT JOIN BATIMENT b ON b.ID = f.IDBATIMENT
         LEFT JOIN PARQUET p ON p.ID = f.IDPARQUET
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = f.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."GETNUMERO_CARTON_NEXT" ("ID", "IDBC", "ETAT", "IDBL", "NUMERO", "DATECREATION", "REMARQUE", "NUMEROCARTON") AS
SELECT 
    c.ID,
    c.IDBC,
    c.ETAT,
    c.IDBL,
    c.NUMERO,
    c.DATECREATION,
    c.REMARQUE,
    COUNT(*) AS NUMEROCARTON
FROM CARTON c 
WHERE c.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY 
    c.ID,
    c.IDBC,
    c.ETAT,
    c.IDBL,
    c.NUMERO,
    c.DATECREATION,
    c.REMARQUE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HEURENORMALE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "DATEFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "MONTANT", "IDQUALIFICATION", "MONTANTJF", "MONTANTHD", "MONTANTIF", "MONTANTMN", "MONTANTHN", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB", "POSTE", "POSTELIB", "DATEIMPORT", "MONTANTHEURESUPP") AS
SELECT
    h.ID,h.IDRESSPARFAB,h.HEURENORMALE ,h.HS,h.MN,h.JF,h.HD,h.IF,h.ETAT,h.REMARQUE,
    p.id AS  idPersonne,
    h.idFabrication,
    h.daty as dateFabrication,
    CASE
        WHEN h.etat=0
            THEN 'ANNULE'
        WHEN h.etat=1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN h.etat=11
            THEN 'VISE'
        END AS etatlib,
    pm.NOM || ' ' || pm.PRENOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    h.TAUXHORAIRE,
    CAST(nvl(c.montant,0)/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    p.temporaire,
    h.MONTANT,
    r.IDQUALIFICATION,
    NVL(h.montantJF, 0) as montantJF,
    NVL(h.montantHD, 0) as montantHD,
    NVL(h.montantIF,0) as montantIF,
    NVL(h.montantMN, 0) as montantMN,
    NVL(h.MONTANTHN, 0) as montantHN,
    p.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    d.val as departementLib,
    h.poste,
    pf.val as PosteLib,
    h.DATEIMPORT,
    h.MONTANTHEURESUPP
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c
                   ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = r.IDQUALIFICATION
                       AND c.IDCATEGORIE = r.IDCATEGORIE
                       AND (
                          (c.REMARQUE IS NULL)
                              OR (c.REMARQUE = r.IDRESSOURCE)
                          ) AND c.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT d on d.id = p.IDDEPARTEMENT
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf on pf.id = h.poste;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL_VISEE" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HEURENORMALE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "DATEFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDQUALIFICATION", "VALEURJF", "VALEURHD", "VALEURIF", "VALEURMN", "VALEURHN", "VALEURHS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    hs.ID,
    hs.IDRESSPARFAB,
    hs.HEURENORMALE,
    hs.HS,
    hs.MN,
    hs.JF,
    hs.HD,
    hs.IF,
    hs.ETAT,
    hs.REMARQUE,
    hs.IDPERSONNE,
    hs.IDFABRICATION,
    hs.DATEFABRICATION,
    hs.ETATLIB,
    hs.IDPERSONNELIB,
    hs.MATRICULE,
    CAST(hs.TAUXHORAIRE AS NUMBER(30,2)) as TAUXHORAIRE,
    hs.TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    hs.TEMPORAIRE,
    CAST(hs.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTotal,
    hs.IDQUALIFICATION,
    hs.MONTANTJF AS valeurJF,
    hs.MONTANTHD AS valeurHD,
    hs.MONTANTIF AS valeurIF,
    hs.MONTANTMN AS valeurMN,
    hs.MONTANTHN AS valeurHN,
    hs.MONTANTHEURESUPP AS valeurHS,
    hs.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    hs.DEPARTEMENTLIB
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hs
WHERE hs.ETAT = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CUMUL" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "SEMAINE", "JOUR", "HEUREJOUR", "HEUREDEJACUMULEES") AS
SELECT
    p.id AS idPersonne,
    pm.NOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    h.daty AS jour,
    SUM(h.HS) AS heureJour,
    SUM(SUM(h.HS)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.id, TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW')
        ORDER BY h.daty
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) - SUM(h.HS) AS heureDejaCumulees
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL_MATRICULE pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
WHERE h.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY p.id, pm.NOM, p.MATRICULE, h.daty;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_TOTAL" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "SEMAINE", "TOTALHEURESEMAINE") AS
SELECT
    p.id AS idPersonne,
    pm.NOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    r.TAUXHORAIRE,
    CAST(NVL(c.montant,0)/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    p.temporaire,
    TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    SUM(h.HS) AS totalHeureSemaine
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = p.IDQUALIFICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL_MATRICULE pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
GROUP BY p.id, pm.NOM, p.MATRICULE, r.TAUXHORAIRE, p.temporaire,
         TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW'), c.montant;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTOINSERTVUE" ("IDHISTORIQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "OBJET", "ACTION", "IDUTILISATEUR", "REFOBJET", "REMARQUE") AS
SELECT 
h.IDHISTORIQUE,
h.DATEHISTORIQUE,
h.HEURE,
h.OBJET,
h.ACTION,
h.IDUTILISATEUR,
h.REFOBJET,
h.REMARQUE||' '||h.REFOBJET AS REMARQUE
FROM HISTOINSERT h;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEAVECUSER" ("IDHISTORIQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "OBJET", "ACTION", "IDUTILISATEUR", "REFOBJET") AS
select
    idhistorique,
    datehistorique,
    heure,
    SUBSTR(objet, INSTR(objet, '.', -1) + 1) as objet,
    action,
    u.LOGINUSER as idutilisateur,
    refobjet
from HISTORIQUE h
         join UTILISATEUR u on u.REFUSER = h.IDUTILISATEUR
order by h.DATEHISTORIQUE desc, h.heure desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEDEMANDEMAX" ("IDDEMANDE", "DATY", "HEURE") AS
SELECT h.iddemande,
       max(h.daty) AS daty,
       max(h.heure) AS heure
FROM historiquedemande h
GROUP BY h.iddemande;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEINSPECTIONFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDELEMENT", "ETATINSPECTION", "REMARQUE", "IDELEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    hif.id,
    hif.idmere,
    hif.idelement,
    hif.etatinspection,
    hif.remarque,
    eim.IDELEMENTINSPECTIONLIB AS idElementLib
FROM historiqueinspectionfille hif
         LEFT JOIN ELEMENTINSPECTIONMACHINELIB eim
                   ON hif.idelement = eim.IDELEMENTINSPECTION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEINSPECTIONLIB" ("ID", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDINSPECTEUR", "IDELEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDINSPECTEURLIB", "IDELEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    hi.id,
    hi.daty,
    hi.heure,
    hi.idinspecteur,
    hi.idelement,
    hi.remarque,
    hi.etat,
    p.nom AS idInspecteurLib,
    aim.libelle AS idElementLib
FROM HISTORIQUEINSPECTIONMERE hi
         JOIN personnel p
              ON hi.idinspecteur = p.id
         JOIN as_ingredient_maintenance aim
              ON hi.idelement = aim.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEPRIXLIB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "DATY", "PV", "IDPRODUIT", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT 
  	h.ID,
  	ing.LIBELLE AS produit,
	h.DATY,
	h.PV,
	h.idProduit,
	h.idFacturefournisseurfille,
	h.REMARQUE,
	h.ETAT,
	CASE
		WHEN h.ETAT=1
		THEN 'CRÉÉ'
		WHEN h.ETAT=11
		THEN 'VALIDÉ'
		WHEN h.ETAT=0
		THEN 'ANNULÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=21
		THEN 'ENTAMÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=31
		THEN 'BLOQUÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=41
		THEN 'TERMINÉ'
	END AS ETATLIB
FROM HISTORIQUEPRIX h 
	LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = h.idProduit;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEPUINGTRIE" ("ID", "DATY", "PU", "REMARQUE", "IDINGREDIENTS") AS
select "ID","DATY","PU","REMARQUE","IDINGREDIENTS" from HISTORIQUEPUING order by DATY desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEPVINGTRIE" ("ID", "DATY", "PU", "REMARQUE", "IDINGREDIENTS") AS
select "ID","DATY","PU","REMARQUE","IDINGREDIENTS" from HISTORIQUEPVING order by DATY desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUE_PRODUIT_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE") AS
SELECT 
hp.ID ,
hp.DATY ,
hp.IDPRODUIT ,
p.VAL AS IDPRODUITLIB,
hp.PUACHAT ,
hp.PUVENTE 
FROM HISTORIQUE_PRODUIT hp 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = hp.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HSMOIS_CPL" ("ID", "IDCATEGORIE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "DATY", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "ETAT", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    hs."ID",hs."IDCATEGORIE",hs."MOIS",hs."ANNEE",
    TO_CHAR(

            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(hs.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),

            'FMMonth',

            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'

    ) AS moisLib,
    hs."DATY",hs."IDDEPARTEMENT",hs."ETAT",
    c.val AS idCategorieLib,
    d.val AS idDepartementLib,
    CASE
        WHEN hs.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN hs.etat = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
        ELSE 'INCONNU'
        END AS etatLib
FROM
    HSMOIS hs
        LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE c ON hs.idCategorie = c.id
        LEFT JOIN departement d ON hs.idDepartement = d.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FABBRICATION_SEMAINECPL" ("ID", "IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "SEMAINE", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "MATRICULE", "NOMPERSONNEL", "DATEDEBUTSEMAINE", "DATEFINSEMAINE", "IF", "JF", "MN", "HD", "HS") AS
SELECT
    hs."IDPERSONNE" as id, hs."IDPERSONNE",hs."ANNEE",hs."MOIS",hs."SEMAINE",hs."HS_TOTAL",hs."HS30",hs."HS50",
    pip.matricule,
    log.nom || ' ' || log.prenom as nomPersonnel,
    CAST(
            TRUNC(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 1, 4) || '-01-04', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'IW')
                + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 6, 2)) - 1) * 7
        AS DATE
    ) AS DATEDEBUTSEMAINE,
    CAST(
            TRUNC(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 1, 4) || '-01-04', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'IW')
                + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 6, 2)) - 1) * 7
                + 6
        AS DATE
    ) AS DATEFINSEMAINE,
    hs.IF AS IF,
    hs.JF AS JF,
    hs.MN AS MN,
    hs.HD AS HD,
    hs.hs_total AS HS
FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs

         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.id = hs.IDPERSONNE

         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL log ON log.id = hs.IDPERSONNE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE" ("IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "SEMAINE", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "IF", "JF", "MN", "HD") AS
SELECT
    hp.idPersonne,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    TO_CHAR(hp.DATEFABRICATION, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,
    LEAST(SUM(hp.HS), 8) AS hs30,
    GREATEST(SUM(hp.HS) - 8, 0) AS hs50,
    SUM( hp.IF) AS if, sum(hp.JF) as JF, SUM(hp.MN) as MN , SUM( hp.HD) as HD
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hp
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p ON hp.DATEFABRICATION BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
GROUP BY hp.idPersonne, p.annee, p.mois, TO_CHAR(hp.DATEFABRICATION, 'IYYY-IW');

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FAB_SEMAINE_PARTRANCHE" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDRESSPARFAB", "SEMAINE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "MONTANT_TOTAL", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS
SELECT
    pip.id as idpersonne,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,

    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN SUM(hp.HS)
        ELSE 8
        END AS hs30,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(hp.HS) - 8
        END AS hs50,

    SUM(hp.MONTANT) AS montant_total,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE AS idCategorie

FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hp
         JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p
                   ON f.daty BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATION ress ON ress.id = hp.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = ress.IDRESSOURCE

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW'),
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_GROUPE" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "RETENUE", "REMARQUE", "NOMPERSONNEL", "ETAT", "ID_OBJET", "IDUSER", "MOISREGULARISATION", "ANNEEREGULARISATION", "IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION", "IDFONCTION", "POURCENTAGE", "ETATLIB", "HS_30_NI", "HS_30_I", "HS_50_NI", "HS_50_I") AS
SELECT "ID","MATRICULE","DATE_DEBUT","DATE_FIN","RETENUE","REMARQUE","NOMPERSONNEL","ETAT","ID_OBJET","IDUSER","MOISREGULARISATION","ANNEEREGULARISATION","IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION","IDFONCTION","POURCENTAGE","ETATLIB","HS_30_NI","HS_30_I","HS_50_NI","HS_50_I"
FROM (
         SELECT
             p.idpersonnel as id,
             p.matricule,
             p.id_code_rubrique,
--         p.nomRubrique,
             p.date_debut,
             p.date_fin,
             p.gain,
             p.retenue,
             p.remarque,
             p.nomPersonnel,
             p.etat,
             p.id_objet,
             p.iduser,
             p.moisregularisation,
             p.anneeregularisation,
             p.idcategorie_qualification,
             p.idfonction,
             p.pourcentage,
             p.etatLib
         FROM PAIEPERS_ELP_CPL p
     )
         PIVOT (
                SUM(gain)
    FOR id_code_rubrique IN (
        'PR0000130'  AS "HS_30_NI",
        'PR0000130I' AS "HS_30_I",
        'PR0000150'  AS "HS_50_NI",
        'PR0000150I' AS "HS_50_I"
        )
        ) ORDER BY matricule ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_MOIS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS30_MOIS", "HS50_MOIS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS
SELECT
    IDPERSONNE as idPersonnel,
    annee,
    mois,
    SUM(hs30) AS hs30_mois,
    SUM(hs50) AS hs50_mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE as idCategorie
FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip on pip.id = hs.idPersonne
GROUP BY idPersonne, annee, mois, pip.IDDEPARTEMENT, pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_MOIS_PARTRANCHE" ("IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS30_MOIS", "HS50_MOIS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS
SELECT
    idPersonne,
    annee,
    mois,

    SUM(hs30) AS hs30_mois,
    SUM(hs50) AS hs50_mois,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE AS idCategorie

FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = hs.idPersonne

GROUP BY
    idPersonne,
    annee,
    mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_NON_PAYE" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MONTANTJF", "MONTANTHD", "TOTAL", "MATRICULE") AS
SELECT hs.ID,hs.IDRESSPARFAB,hs.HS,hs.MN,hs.JF,hs.HD,hs.IF,hs.ETAT,hs.IDPERSONNE,hs.IDFABRICATION,hs.ETATLIB,hs.IDPERSONNELIB AS nomPersonnel,hsf.MONTANTJF ,hsf.MONTANTHD ,hsf.MONTANTJF+hsf.MONTANTHD AS total,hsf.MATRICULE
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL_VISEE hs
         LEFT JOIN HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hsf ON hsf.id=hs.id
WHERE hs.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT IDHS
    FROM PAIEMENTHEURESUP
    WHERE IDHS IS NOT NULL
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_PAR_FAB" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIE", "MONTANTPERSONNEL") AS
SELECT
    fab.id AS idMere,
    'CATING000001' AS CATEGORIE,
    CAST(SUM(hs.MONTANT) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantPersonnel
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hs
         JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = hs.IDFABRICATION
GROUP BY fab.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_PAR_FABRICATION" ("IDFABRICATION", "IDPERSONNE", "DATY", "HS30", "HS50", "MOIS", "ANNEE") AS
SELECT
    d.IDFABRICATION,
    d.idPersonne,
    d.daty,
    d.hs30,
    d.hs50,
    d.mois,
    d.annee
FROM V_HS_FABRICATION_DETAIL d
ORDER BY d.idPersonne, d.daty;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_PAR_OF" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIE", "MONTANTPERSONNEL") AS
SELECT
    fille.IDMERE AS idMere,
    'CATING000001' AS CATEGORIE,
    CAST(SUM(hs.MONTANT) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantPersonnel
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hs
         JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = hs.IDFABRICATION
         JOIN OFFILLE fille ON fille.id = fab.IDOFFILLE
GROUP BY fille.IDMERE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_PAR_OFFILLE" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIE", "MONTANTPERSONNEL") AS
SELECT
    fille.id AS idMere,
    'CATING000001' AS CATEGORIE,
    CAST(SUM(hs.MONTANT) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantPersonnel
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hs
         JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = hs.IDFABRICATION
         JOIN OFFILLE fille ON fille.id = fab.IDOFFILLE
GROUP BY fille.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTOAC" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDPROVENANCELIB") AS
SELECT rl."ID",
       rl."DATERECEPTION",
       rl."DATEPONTE",
       rl."DATECOLLECTE",
       rl."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",
       rl."HEUREDEPARTFERME",
       rl."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",
       rl."IDRESPONSABLE",
       rl."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",
       rl."IDCHAUFFEUR",
       rl."IDVEHICULE",
       rl."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTOAC_LIB" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB") AS
SELECT r."ID",
       r."DATERECEPTION",
       r."DATEPONTE",
       r."DATECOLLECTE",
       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",
       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",
       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",
       r."IDRESPONSABLE",
       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",
       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",
       r."IDVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",
       r."IDPROVENANCE",
       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",
       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",
       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",
       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",
       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB"
FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r
         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"
         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"
         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE" WHERE r.IDPROVENANCE IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTRECEPTIONOAC" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT r."ID",
       r."DATERECEPTION",
       r."DATEPONTE",
       r."DATECOLLECTE",
       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",
       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",
       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",
       r."IDRESPONSABLE",
       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",
       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",
       r."IDVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",
       r."IDPROVENANCE",
       r."ETAT",
       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",
       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",
       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",
       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",
       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB",
       CASE r."ETAT"
            WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
            WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
            WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
       END                                AS "ETATLIB"
FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r
         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"
         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"
         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INFOSAUTOLIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENT", "DESCRIPTION", "NUMERODEPARC", "DATEPREMIEREMISEENCIRCULATION", "IMMATRICULATION", "NOTE", "FOURNISSEUR", "NUMERO", "VOLUME", "MONTANT", "TYPE", "VIN", "MARQUE", "MODELE", "ANNEE", "NOMBREDEPLACES", "NOMBREDEPORTES", "PUISSANCEFISCALE", "BAILLEUR", "VALEURINITIALE", "DATEDEBUT", "DURREEENMOIS", "MENSUALITE", "VENDEUR", "PRIX", "DATEDACHAT", "NUMERODIMMOBILISATION", "DUREEDAMORTISSEMENTENMOIS", "PNEUS", "BATTERIE", "HUILEMOTEUR", "HUILEBOITEDEVITESSE", "TYPEDECARBURANT", "CONSOMMATION", "UNITEDECONSOMMATION", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "TYPEDECARBURANTLIB", "UNITEDECONSOMMATIONLIB") AS
(
    select
    ia."ID",ia."IDINGREDIENT",ia."DESCRIPTION",ia."NUMERODEPARC",ia."DATEPREMIEREMISEENCIRCULATION",ia."IMMATRICULATION",ia."NOTE",ia."FOURNISSEUR",ia."NUMERO",ia."VOLUME",ia."MONTANT",ia."TYPE",ia."VIN",ia."MARQUE",ia."MODELE",ia."ANNEE",ia."NOMBREDEPLACES",ia."NOMBREDEPORTES",ia."PUISSANCEFISCALE",ia."BAILLEUR",ia."VALEURINITIALE",ia."DATEDEBUT",ia."DURREEENMOIS",ia."MENSUALITE",ia."VENDEUR",ia."PRIX",ia."DATEDACHAT",ia."NUMERODIMMOBILISATION",ia."DUREEDAMORTISSEMENTENMOIS",ia."PNEUS",ia."BATTERIE",ia."HUILEMOTEUR",ia."HUILEBOITEDEVITESSE",ia."TYPEDECARBURANT",ia."CONSOMMATION",ia."UNITEDECONSOMMATION",

select 
    ifl.id,
    ifl.idMere,
    ifl.idElement ,
    ifl.idEtatInspection,
    ifl.idEtatInspectionlib ,
    ifl.idElementLib,
    ifl.remarque,
    ifl.idMachineLib,
    ifl.idMachine,
    l.id AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib
from inspectionFIlleLib ifl 
join inspectionMere im on ifl.idMere = im.id

left join ligne l on am.IDLIGNE = l.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INSPECTIONFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDELEMENT", "IDELEMENTLIB", "IDETATINSPECTION", "REMARQUE", "IDETATINSPECTIONLIB", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB") AS
(
SELECT
    ifi.id,
    ifi.idmere,
    ifi.idElement,
    eis.val     AS idElementlib,
    ifi.idEtatInspection,
    ifi.remarque,
    ei.val    AS idEtatInspectionlib,
    m.libelle AS idMachinelib,
    m.id AS idMachine,
     l.id AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib
FROM InspectionFille ifi
         LEFT JOIN ElementInspection eis
                   ON ifi.idElement = eis.id
         LEFT JOIN ElementInspectionMachine ai

         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m

                   ON ifi.idEtatInspection = ei.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLEAVECVIDE" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLECOMPLET" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "PU", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "IDMAGASIN", "RESTE", "MVTENTREE") AS
SELECT
	i."ID",i."IDINVENTAIRE",i."IDPRODUIT",i."EXPLICATION",i."IDJAUGE",i."PU",i."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",i."QUANTITE",i."MVTSRC",i."IDMAGASIN",
	vee.RESTE , vee.MVTSRC AS mvtentree
FROM

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "EXPLICATION", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "ECART", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    i.ID ,
    i.IDINVENTAIRE ,
    i.IDPRODUIT ,
    p.libelle AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    i.EXPLICATION ,
    i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE ,
    i.QUANTITE,
    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
    i.pu,
    cast((i.QUANTITE - i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE) as decimal(30,2)) AS ecart,
    i.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN i.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VALIDÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM INVENTAIREFILLE i
     LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS  p ON p.ID  = i.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLEMERE" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "PU", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "IDMAGASIN") AS
SELECT
	i."ID",i."IDINVENTAIRE",i."IDPRODUIT",i."EXPLICATION",i."IDJAUGE",i."PU",i."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",i."QUANTITE",i."MVTSRC",
	i2.IDMAGASIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLETYPEMVT" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "TYPESTOCK") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLEUPDATE" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY") AS

    inf.idinventaire,
    CASE
        WHEN inf.idproduit IS NOT NULL
            THEN inf.idproduit||'---'||ai.libelle
        END AS idproduit,
    ai.LIBELLE ||' - '|| inf.explication AS explication,
    inf.idjauge,
    inf.quantitetheorique,
    inf.quantite,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIRELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "HEURE", "ETATLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "MOTSCLESSS", "REMARQUE", "MONTANTQUANTITE") AS
SELECT
    i.ID ,
    i.DATY ,
    i.DESIGNATION ,
    i.IDMAGASIN ,
    m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
    i.ETAT , i.heure,
    CASE
        WHEN i.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉ'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉ'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VALIDÉ'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    i.idcategorie,
    c.VAL AS idcategorieLib,
    UPPER(
            NVL(i.DESIGNATION, '') || ' ' ||
            NVL(m.VAL, '') || ' ' ||
            NVL(c.VAL, '') || ' ' ||
            NVL(i.ID, '') || ' ' ||
            TO_CHAR(i.DATY, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' ' ||
            NVL(
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉ'
                        WHEN i.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ'
                        WHEN i.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ'
                        END
                , '')
    ) AS MOTSCLESSS,
    i.REMARQUE,
    CAST(ifgm.montantQuantite AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantQuantite
FROM INVENTAIRE i
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = i.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON c.id = i.idcategorie
         LEFT JOIN INVENTAIREFILLEGROUPEMERE ifgm ON ifgm.IDINVENTAIRE = i.id
order by daty desc;

i.IDINVENTAIRE ,
i.IDPRODUIT ,
p.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."JAUGELIB" ("ID", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "QTE", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT 
j.ID ,
j.IDMAGASIN ,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
j.QTE ,
j.DATY ,
j.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN j.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN j.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN j.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
END AS ETATLIB
FROM JAUGE j 
JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID  = j.IDMAGASIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."JOURS_PAR_MOIS" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "NB_JOUR", "CONGE_JOURNALIER") AS
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)) AS mois,
    TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)), 'DD')) AS nb_jour,
    ROUND(2.5 / TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)), 'DD')), 6) AS conge_journalier
FROM dual
    CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1) < SYSDATE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LISTECOLONNETABLE" ("OWNER", "TABLE_NAME", "COLUMN_NAME", "DATA_TYPE", "DATA_TYPE_MOD", "DATA_TYPE_OWNER", "DATA_LENGTH", "DATA_PRECISION", "DATA_SCALE", "NULLABLE", "COLUMN_ID", "DEFAULT_LENGTH", "DATA_DEFAULT", "NUM_DISTINCT", "LOW_VALUE", "HIGH_VALUE", "DENSITY", "NUM_NULLS", "NUM_BUCKETS", "LAST_ANALYZED", "SAMPLE_SIZE", "CHARACTER_SET_NAME", "CHAR_COL_DECL_LENGTH", "GLOBAL_STATS", "USER_STATS", "AVG_COL_LEN", "CHAR_LENGTH", "CHAR_USED", "V80_FMT_IMAGE", "DATA_UPGRADED", "HISTOGRAM") AS

select tc.OWNER,syn.SYNONYM_NAME as table_name, tc.COLUMN_NAME,tc.DATA_TYPE,tc.DATA_TYPE_MOD,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LOG_PERS_NON_VALIDE_LIB" ("ID", "IDLOGPERS", "SEXE", "DATEAPPLICATION", "IDTYPEDEBAUCHE", "ETAT", "IDUSER", "MATRICULE", "DATE_DECISION", "REFDECISION", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	    lpnv.id,
	    lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom AS idlogpers,
	    lp.sexe,
	    lpnv.dateapplication,
	    td.val AS idtypedebauche,
	    lpnv.etat,
	    lpnv.iduser,
	    pif.matricule,
	    lpnv.date_decision,
	    lpnv.refdecision,
	    CASE
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 1 THEN
	            'Cree'
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 11 THEN
	            'Valide'
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 0 THEN
	            'Annule'
	        ELSE
	            'Inconnu'
	        END AS etatLib
	FROM log_personnel_non_valide lpnv
	         LEFT JOIN type_depart td
	                   ON td.id = lpnv.idtypedebauche
	         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pif
	                   ON pif.id = lpnv.idlogpers
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp
	                   ON lp.id = lpnv.idlogpers
	WHERE lpnv.date_reintegration IS NULL;

    lpnv.idavancement,
    lpnv.motif,
    lp.sexe,
    lpnv.etat,
    (lp.nom || ' ') || lp.prenom AS personnelid,
    (lp2.nom || ' ') || lp2.prenom AS passationib,
    pif.matricule,
    lpnv.idpassation
   FROM log_personnel_non_valide lpnv
     LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pif ON pif.id = lpnv.idlogpers
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lpnv.idlogpers = lp.id
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp2 ON lpnv.idpassation = lp2.id
     LEFT JOIN type_depart ddt ON ddt.id = lpnv.idtypedebauche
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LOT_LIB" ("ID", "NOMLOT", "REFERENCE", "DATEECLOSION", "DATEARRIVEE", "SOURCE", "IDFERME", "IDARTICLE", "IDORIGINE", "IDPROGRAMME", "ETAT", "IDFERMELIB", "IDARTICLELIB", "IDORIGINELIB", "IDPROGRAMMELIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDCATEGORIELOTLIB", "DATECLOTURE", "AGEJOUR", "AGESEMAINE") AS
SELECT l.ID,l.NOMLOT,l.REFERENCE,l.DATEECLOSION,l.DATEARRIVEE,l.SOURCE,l.IDFERME,l.IDARTICLE,l.IDORIGINE,l.IDPROGRAMME,l.ETAT,
       m.VAL      AS IDFERMELIB,
       ai.LIBELLE AS IDARTICLELIB,
       o.VAL      AS IDORIGINELIB,
       pz.CODE || '-' || pz.IDSOUCHELIB AS IDPROGRAMMELIB,
       s.val AS idsouchelib,
       CASE l.ETAT
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CRÉÉ'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ'
           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLÉ'
           WHEN 17  THEN 'CLÔTURÉ'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       cl.val AS idcategorielotlib,
       l.datecloture AS datecloture,
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(dateEclosion) + 1 AS ageJour,
       FLOOR((TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(dateEclosion) + 1 - 1) / 7) + 1 AS ageSemaine
FROM LOT l
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = l.IDFERME
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = l.IDARTICLE
         LEFT JOIN ORIGINELOT o ON o.ID = l.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN PROGRAMMEZOOTECHNIQUE_LIB pz ON pz.ID = l.IDPROGRAMME
         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE s ON s.id=l.idsouche
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIELOT cl ON cl.id=l.idcategorielot;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MAGASINPOINT" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "IDPOINT", "ETAT") AS

    m.DESCE,
    m.IDPRODUIT,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANTAPAYER" ("MONTANTAPAYER", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDORIGINE") AS
SELECT 
 	sum(DEBIT) AS montantapayer,
 	f.id AS idfacturefournisseur,
 	m.IDORIGINE AS IDORIGINE 
 FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m 
 LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f ON m.IDORIGINE =f.ID 
 GROUP BY f.ID , m.IDORIGINE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANTCAISSE" ("CAISSELIB", "IDCAISSE", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "MONTANT", "DATEDERNIERREPORT", "EXPLICATION", "IDCLOTURE") AS
SELECT
    etatcaisse.idcaisseLib AS caisselib,
    etatcaisse.idcaisse,
    CAST(ROUND(etatcaisse.reste, 0) AS NUMBER(30,0)) AS montantTheorique,
    0 AS montant,
    etatcaisse.dateDernierReport AS dateDernierReport,
    '' AS explication,
    '' AS idcloture
FROM V_ETATCAISSE_CLOTURE etatcaisse
WHERE TRUNC(etatcaisse.dateDernierReport) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANTENCAISSEMENT" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDORIGINE", "MONTANTTOTALENCAISSEMENT") AS
SELECT 
ed.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
ed.IDORIGINE,
sum( nvl( ed.MONTANT ,0 ) ) AS montantTotalEncaissement
FROM ENCAISSEMENT_DETAILS ed 
GROUP BY ed.IDENCAISSEMENT,ed.IDORIGINE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANTPRECISIONENCAISSEMENT" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "MONTANTTOTALPRECISION") AS
SELECT 
pde.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
pde.IDCATEGORIECAISSE ,

FROM PRECISION_DETAIL_ENCAISSEMENT pde 
GROUP BY pde.IDENCAISSEMENT , pde.IDCATEGORIECAISSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANT_STOCK" ("IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDMAGASIN") AS
SELECT
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) AS ENTREE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS SORTIE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS quantite,
    cast(sum(mf.montantEntree) as number(30,2))  AS montantEntree,
    cast(sum(mf.montantSortie) as number(30,2))  AS montantSortie,
    CAST(NVL(ai.PU, 0) * (SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0))) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    m.IDMAGASIN
FROM
    mvtStockFilleMontant mf
        JOIN MVTSTOCK m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = mf.IDPRODUIT
WHERE
    m.ETAT >= 11
  AND mf.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.PU,m.IDMAGASIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANT_STOCK_ENG" ("IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMVTSTOCK") AS
SELECT
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) AS ENTREE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS SORTIE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS quantite,
    cast(sum(mf.montantEntree) as number(30,2))  AS montantEntree,
    cast(sum(mf.montantSortie) as number(30,2))  AS montantSortie,
    CAST(NVL(ai.PU, 0) * (SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0))) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    m.IDMAGASIN,
    MAX(mf.IDMVTSTOCK) AS IDMVTSTOCK
FROM
    mvtStockFilleMontant_eng mf
        JOIN MVTstock_eng m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = mf.IDPRODUIT
WHERE
    m.ETAT >= 11
  AND mf.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.PU,m.IDMAGASIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANT_TRAITE_FC" ("ID", "IDTRAITE", "MONTANTTRAITE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOTRAVAUXLIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTRAVAUX", "DUREEESTIMATIF", "TAUXHORAIRE", "DUREEESTIMATIFLIB", "MONTANT", "IDPERSONNELLIB") AS
SELECT
    mo."ID",mo."IDPERSONNEL",mo."IDTRAVAUX",mo."DUREEESTIMATIF",mo."TAUXHORAIRE",
    LPAD(FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF), 60), 2, '0')
                                               AS dureeEstimatifLib,
    ((mo.DUREEESTIMATIF/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE AS montant,
    p.NOM AS idPersonnelLib
FROM MOTRAVAUX mo
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON p.ID = mo.IDPERSONNEL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "UPDATED_AT", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "ACQUEREUR", "IDTYPEPAIEMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TAUX", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "IDCAISSIER", "MONTANTRETOURNER") AS
SELECT
    mc.ID,
    mc.DESIGNATION,
    mc.IDCAISSE,
    mc.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    mc.IDVIREMENT,
    mc.DATY,
    mc.ETAT,
    mc.IDOP,
    mc.IDORIGINE,
    mc.IDDEVISE,
    CASE
        WHEN mc.IDTIERS IS NOT NULL
            THEN mc.IDTIERS||'---'||c.nom
        END AS IDTIERS,
    mc.COMPTE,
    CASE
        WHEN mc.IDPREVISION IS NOT NULL
            THEN mc.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.designation
        END AS IDPREVISION,
    mc.IDTRAITE,
    mc.ETATVERSEMENT,
    mc.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    mc.IDMVTCAISSEMERE,
    mc.REFERENCE,
    mc.UPDATED_AT,
    mc.DATYCOMPTABILISATION,
    mc.ACQUEREUR,
    mc.IDTYPEPAIEMENT,
    mc.DEBIT,
    mc.CREDIT,
    mc.TAUX,
    mc.HEURE,
    mc.idReport,
    mc.idCaissier,
    mc.montantRetourner
FROM mouvementcaisse mc
     LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id=mc.IDTIERS
     LEFT JOIN prevision p ON p.id=mc.IDPREVISION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSEAVECHEURE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "UPDATED_AT", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "ACQUEREUR", "IDTYPEPAIEMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TAUX", "HEURE", "IDREPORT") AS
SELECT
    m.ID,
    m.DESIGNATION,
    m.IDCAISSE,
    m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    m.IDVIREMENT,
    CASE
        WHEN m.HEURE IS NOT NULL AND m.HEURE != '00:00:00'
        THEN m.DATY + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 1, 2)) / 24)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 4, 2)) / 1440)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 7, 2)) / 86400)
        ELSE m.DATY
    END AS DATY,
    m.ETAT,
    m.IDOP,
    m.IDORIGINE,
    m.IDDEVISE,
    m.IDTIERS,
    m.COMPTE,
    m.IDPREVISION,
    m.IDTRAITE,
    m.ETATVERSEMENT,
    m.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    m.IDMVTCAISSEMERE,
    m.REFERENCE,
    m.UPDATED_AT,
    m.DATYCOMPTABILISATION,
    m.ACQUEREUR,
    m.IDTYPEPAIEMENT,
    m.DEBIT,
    m.CREDIT,
    m.TAUX,
    m.HEURE,
    m.idReport
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESSS", "IDECRITURE", "IDBC") AS
SELECT m.ID,
       m.DESIGNATION,
       m.IDCAISSE,
       c.VAL   AS IDCAISSELIB,
       m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       m.IDVIREMENT,
       m.DEBIT,
       m.CREDIT,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.credit > 0 THEN NVL(m.CREDIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldecredit,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.debit > 0 THEN NVL(m.DEBIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldedebit,
       m.DATY,
       m.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN m.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CRÉÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VALIDÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 8
               THEN 'À COMPTABILISER'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       vd.IDVENTE,
       m.IDORIGINE as idorigine,
       m.idtiers,
       t.NOM AS tiers,
       m.idPrevision,
       m.idOP,
       m.taux,
       m.COMPTE,
       m.IDDEVISE,
       m.idtraite,
       mp.VAL as idModePaiementLib,
       m.idmvtcaissemere,
       m.reference,
       m.datycomptabilisation,
       m.UPDATED_AT, m.heure,
       m.IDREPORT,
       m.ID || '' || m.DATY || '' || m.DESIGNATION || '' || t.NOM || '' || m.IDCAISSE || '' || c.VAL AS MOTSCLESS,
       ce.id as idecriture,
       m.IDBC
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = m.IDCAISSE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.ID = m.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.ID = m.idtiers
         left join liaisonpaiementmvtcaissegrp l on l.idmvtcaisse=m.id
         left join modepaiement mp on m.idmodepaiement = mp.id
         left join COMPTA_ECRITURE ce on ce.IDOBJET=m.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL_CREE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "MOTSCLESSS") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL_VALIDER" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "MOTSCLESSS") AS

	FROM (

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL_UNIQUE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "NUMEROFACTURE", "UPDATED_AT", "TOTALIMPUTE", "REFERENCES_PAIEMENT") AS
SELECT
    v.ID,

    v.IDMAGASIN,
    v.IDMAGASINLIB,
    v.DATY,
    v.REMARQUE,
    v.ETAT,

    LISTAGG(v.designationpaiement ||' '|| v.referencepaiement, ' // ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.designationpaiement || v.referencepaiement) AS REFERENCES_PAIEMENT
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL v

    v.ID,

    v.IDMAGASIN,

    v.MONTANTRESTE,
    v.AVOIR,
    v.TAUXDECHANGE,

    v.IDRESERVATION, v.NUMEROFACTURE, v.UPDATED_AT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MTBFDETAIL" ("ID", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "DATY", "ECART") AS
select
    otf.id,
    otf.IDINGREDIENTS as idMachine,
    ai.LIBELLE as idMachineLib,
    ot.DATY,
    nvl(
            ot.DATY - lead(ot.DATY) over (
                partition by otf.IDINGREDIENTS
                order by ot.DATY desc
                ),
            0
    ) as ecart
from ORDRETRAVAUX ot
         left join ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE otf
                   on otf.IDMERE = ot.ID
         left join AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai
                   on ai.ID = otf.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSECPLORIGINE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESS", "IDECRITURE") AS
SELECT m.ID,

                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldecredit,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.debit > 0 THEN NVL(m.DEBIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldedebit,
       m.DATY,
       m.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN m.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VALIDEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 8
               THEN 'A COMPTABILISER'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       vd.IDVENTE,

       m.idtiers,

       m.idPrevision,
       m.idOP,
       m.taux,

       m.IDDEVISE,

       m.IDREPORT,
       m.ID || '' || m.DATY || '' || m.DESIGNATION || '' || t.NOM || '' || m.IDCAISSE || '' || c.VAL AS MOTSCLESS,
       cr.id as idecriture
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = m.IDCAISSE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.ID = m.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.ID = m.idtiers
         left join liaisonpaiementmvtcaissegrp l on l.idmvtcaisse=m.id
         left join modepaiement mp on m.idmodepaiement = mp.id
         LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE cr on cr.IDOBJET=m.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSECPLORIGINE_A" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESS", "IDECRITURE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSECPLORIGINE_VALIDER" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESS", "IDECRITURE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE_PDF" ("IDORIGINE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "MONTANTRETOURNER", "IDDEVISE") AS
select id2 AS idorigine, sum(l.MONTANT ) as debit, sum(m.credit) as credit, sum(m.montantretourner) as montantretourner, c.IDDEVISE
from LIAISONPAIEMENT l
         left join MOUVEMENTCAISSE m on m.id = l.id1
         left join caisse c on c.ID = m.idcaisse
where l.etat >= 11
  and id1 is not NULL
group BY id2, c.IDDEVISE, m.montantretourner;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSEPREVISIONVISE" ("ID", "ID1", "ID2", "MONTANTMERE", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "MONTANTCREDIT", "DEVISE", "TAUX") AS
select "ID","ID1","ID2","MONTANTMERE","ETAT","REMARQUE","MONTANTCREDIT","DEVISE","TAUX" from MVTCAISSEPREVISION where etat>=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCONGEBYMOISANNEE" ("IDPERSONNEL", "PLUS", "MOIS", "ANNEE") AS
SELECT
    m.IDPERSONNEL,
    SUM(m.PLUS) AS plus,

    m.ANNEE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATETRAITE", "DATEECHEANCE", "MONTANTTRAITE") AS
select
    mit.ID,mit.DATY,mit.CAISSEDEPART,mit.CAISSEARRIVEE,mit.MONTANT,mit.MODEPAIEMENT,mit.REMARQUE,mit.ETAT,mit.DESIGNATION,mit.IDTRAITE,mit.ETATVERSEMENT,mit.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.daty as datetraite,
    t.dateecheance,
    t.montant as montanttraite
from MvtIntraCaisse mit
         left join Traite t on t.id = mit.idtraite;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITENONVERSEE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATEECHEANCE") AS
SELECT
    mic.ID,mic.DATY,mic.CAISSEDEPART,mic.CAISSEARRIVEE,mic.MONTANT,mic.MODEPAIEMENT,mic.REMARQUE,mic.ETAT,mic.DESIGNATION,mic.IDTRAITE,mic.ETATVERSEMENT,mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.DATEECHEANCE
from mvtintracaisse mic
         JOIN traite t on t.id = mic.idtraite;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITEV" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATEECHEANCE", "REFERENCE", "TIERS", "CODECLIENT", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "FINALEDESTINATIONLIB", "FACTURE") AS
SELECT
    mic.ID,mic.DATY,mic.CAISSEDEPART,mic.CAISSEARRIVEE,mic.MONTANT,mic.MODEPAIEMENT,mic.REMARQUE,mic.ETAT,mic.DESIGNATION,mic.IDTRAITE,mic.ETATVERSEMENT,mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.Dateecheance,t.reference,t.tiers,t.CDCLT AS codeclient,
    c1.val AS caissedepartlib,
    c2.val AS caissearriveelib,
    m.Desce as modepaiementlib,
    case
        when mic.etat = 1 then 'CREE'
        when mic.etat >= 11 then 'VISE'
        else '' end                           as etatlib,
    case
        when mic.etatversement = -2 then 'encaissee'
        when mic.etatversement = 11 then 'versee'
        else '' end                           as etatversementlib,
    c3.val AS finaledestinationlib,
    grp.code AS facture
from mvtintracaisse mic
         JOIN traite_lib t on t.id = mic.idtraite
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE C1 on C1.id = mic.caissedepart
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE C2 on C2.id = mic.caissearrivee
         LEFT JOIN caisse C3 ON c3.id= mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m on m.id = mic.modepaiement
         LEFT JOIN TRAITELIB_GRP grp ON mic.IDTRAITE = grp.idTraite
where mic.etatversement = 11 AND mic.IDTRAITE NOT IN (SELECT IDTRAITE FROM mvtintracaisse WHERE ETATVERSEMENT  = -2);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITEVCAISSE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATEECHEANCE") AS
SELECT
    mic.ID,
    mic.DATY,
    mic.CAISSEDEPART,
    mic.CAISSEARRIVEE,
    CAST(mic.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANT,
    mic.MODEPAIEMENT,
    mic.REMARQUE,
    mic.ETAT,
    mic.DESIGNATION,
    mic.IDTRAITE,
    mic.ETATVERSEMENT,
    mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.DATEECHEANCE
FROM
    mvtintracaisse mic
        JOIN traite t ON
        t.id = mic.idtraite
WHERE
    mic.etatversement IN (11, -2);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION") AS

       daty,

       mv.CAISSEARRIVEE as caissearriveelib,
       ca.VAL as caissedepart,
       ca1.VAL as caissearrivee,
       montant,
       mp.VAL as modepaiement,
       remarque,

         left join CAISSE ca1 on ca1.id=mv.caissearrivee
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id=mv.modepaiement;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB") AS
select mv.ID,mv.DATY,mv.CAISSEDEPART,mv.CAISSEARRIVEE,mv.MONTANT,mv.MODEPAIEMENT,mv.REMARQUE,mv.ETAT,
       ca.VAL  as caissedepartlib,
       ca1.VAL as caissearriveelib,
       mp.VAL  as modepaiementlib
from mvtintracaisse mv
         left join CAISSE ca on ca.id = mv.caissedepart
         left join CAISSE ca1 on ca1.id = mv.caissearrivee
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = mv.modepaiement;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB_CREE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT") AS

from mvtintracaisse_lib
where ETAT=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB_VISEE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT") AS
select ID,DATY,CAISSEDEPART,CAISSEARRIVEE,MONTANT,MODEPAIEMENT,REMARQUE,ETAT
