    where
u.IDROLE = 'pompiste';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRECISDETENCAISSEMENT_LIB" ("ID", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANT", "REFERENCE", "DATY", "IDCAISSE") AS
SELECT
	pde.ID ,
	pde.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
	e.DESIGNATION AS IDENCAISSEMENTLIB,
	pde.IDCATEGORIECAISSE ,
	c.VAL AS IDCATEGORIECAISSELIB,
	pde.IDCLIENT ,
	c2.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
	pde.MONTANT ,
	pde.REFERENCE ,
	pde.DATY,
	e.IDCAISSE 
FROM
	PRECISION_DETAIL_ENCAISSEMENT pde
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT e ON
	e.ID = pde.IDENCAISSEMENT
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIECAISSE c ON
	c.ID = pde.IDCATEGORIECAISSE
LEFT JOIN CLIENT c2 ON
	c2.ID = pde.IDCLIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTCPL" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDCAISSE", "IDMAGASIN", "IDPRODUIT", "PUVENTE", "MAXPOMPE") AS
SELECT 
p.ID ,
p.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR ,
p.COMPTEUR ,
p.DATY ,
p.HEURE ,
p.IDPOMPISTE ,
p.IDPOMPE ,
p.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN p.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
c.ID AS IDCAISSE,
p2.IDMAGASIN ,
p3.ID AS IDPRODUIT , 
p3.PUVENTE,
p2.MAX AS maxPompe
FROM PRELEVEMENT p 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.IDPOMPISTE =  p.IDPOMPISTE 
LEFT JOIN POMPE p2 ON p2.ID = p.IDPOMPE 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = p2.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p3 ON p3.ID  = m.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION") AS
SELECT 
    p.ID AS ID,
    p.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR AS IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR,
    p.COMPTEUR AS COMPTEUR,
    CASE 
  		WHEN p.HEURE IS NULL AND p.DATY IS NOT NULL  
  		THEN TO_DATE((TO_CHAR(p.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ||' '||'00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')  
  		ELSE 
  		TO_DATE((TO_CHAR(p.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || p.HEURE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
    END AS DATY,
    p.HEURE AS HEURE,
    p.IDPOMPISTE AS IDPOMPISTE,
    p.IDPOMPE AS IDPOMPE,
    u.NOMUSER AS NOMUSER,
    u.IDROLE AS IDROLE,
    m.VAL AS NOMMAGASIN,
    m.DESCE AS DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN,
    p.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN p.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 22 
	THEN 'ENCAISSEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
p.DESIGNATION 
FROM 
    PRELEVEMENT p
JOIN 
    UTILISATEUR u ON u.REFUSER = p.IDPOMPISTE
JOIN 
    POMPE p2 ON p2.ID = p.IDPOMPE 
JOIN 
    MAGASINLIB m ON m.ID = p2.IDMAGASIN 
WHERE 
    u.IDROLE = 'pompiste';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_ANNULEE" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION") AS
SELECT 
p."ID",p."IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR",p."COMPTEUR",p."DATY",p."HEURE",p."IDPOMPISTE",p."IDPOMPE",p."NOMUSER",p."IDROLE",p."NOMMAGASIN",p."DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN",p."ETAT",p."ETATLIB",p."DESIGNATION"
FROM PRELEVEMENTLIB p 
WHERE p.ETAT = 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_CREE" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION") AS
SELECT 
p."ID",p."IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR",p."COMPTEUR",p."DATY",p."HEURE",p."IDPOMPISTE",p."IDPOMPE",p."NOMUSER",p."IDROLE",p."NOMMAGASIN",p."DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN",p."ETAT",p."ETATLIB",p."DESIGNATION"
FROM PRELEVEMENTLIB p

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_ENCAISSEE" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION") AS
SELECT 
p."ID",p."IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR",p."COMPTEUR",p."DATY",p."HEURE",p."IDPOMPISTE",p."IDPOMPE",p."NOMUSER",p."IDROLE",p."NOMMAGASIN",p."DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN",p."ETAT",p."ETATLIB",p."DESIGNATION"
FROM PRELEVEMENTLIB p 
WHERE p.ETAT = 22;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_VALIDE" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION", "IDPOMPELIB") AS

	p.IDPOMPISTE,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_VISEE" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION", "IDPOMPELIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB_VISEE_POP" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "IDPOMPELIB", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTEURINIT", "DATYINIT") AS
SELECT 
pv.ID,
pv.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR,
pv.COMPTEUR,
pv.DATY,
pv.HEURE,
pv2.IDPOMPISTE ,
pv2.IDPOMPE ,
pv2.IDPOMPELIB ,
pv2.NOMUSER  ,
pv.IDROLE ,
pv.NOMMAGASIN ,
pv.DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN ,
pv.ETAT ,

pv2.DATY AS datyinit
FROM PRELEVEMENTLIB_VALIDE pv

AND pv.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR IS NOT  NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENT_POMPISTE" ("INDEXF", "INDEXO", "VENTE", "PRODUIT", "PU", "MONTANT", "ID") AS
SELECT 
p2.compteur AS indexF,
p.compteur AS indexO,
p.compteur - p2.compteur AS vente ,
pro.val AS produit,
pro.puvente AS pu,
(p.compteur - p2.compteur) * pro.puvente AS montant,
pe.IDENCAISSEMENT AS ID
FROM PRELEVEMENT p 
JOIN PRELEVEMENT p2 ON p2.id = p.idprelevementanterieur 
JOIN POMPE po ON po.id = p.idpompe 
JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.id = po.idmagasin
JOIN PRODUIT pro ON pro.id = m.idproduit
JOIN PRELEVEMENT_ENCAISSE pe ON pe.IDPRELEVEMENT = p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONAVECMVTCAISSE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDFACTURE", "EFFECTIFDEB", "EFFECTIFCRED") AS
SELECT p."ID",p."DESIGNATION",p."IDCAISSE",p."IDVENTEDETAIL",p."IDVIREMENT",p."DEBIT",p."CREDIT",p."DATY",p."ETAT",p."IDOP",p."IDORIGINE",p."IDDEVISE",
  p."TAUX",p."IDTIERS",p."COMPTE",p."IDFACTURE",nvl(m.montantMere*nvl(m.taux,1),0) AS effectifdeb,nvl(m.montantCredit*nvl(m.taux,1),0) AS effectifCred 
FROM PREVISIONVALIDE p LEFT JOIN MvtCaisseSomPrevisionGroup m ON p.id=m.id2;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONFERMELIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMVTSTOCKFILLE", "PU", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDTIERSLIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "SORTIEEFFECTIVE", "ENTREEEFFECTIVE", "ECARTENTREE", "ECARTSORTIE") AS
select
    p.ID,
    p.DESIGNATION,
    p.IDMAGASIN,
    p.IDMVTSTOCKFILLE,
    p.PU,
    p.IDPRODUIT,
    p.ENTREE,
    p.SORTIE,
    p.DATY,
    p.ETAT,
    p.IDORIGINE,
    p.IDTIERS,
    m.VAL AS idMagasinLib,
    t.NOM as idTiersLib,
    ai.LIBELLE as idProduitLib,
    CAST(NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS SortieEffective,
    CAST(NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EntreeEffective,
    CAST(NVL(p.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EcartEntree,
    CAST(NVL(p.SORTIE, 0) - NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EcartSortie
FROM PREVISIONFERME p
LEFT JOIN magasin2 m ON m.id = p.IDMAGASIN
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = p.idProduit
LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON t.id = p.IDTIERS
LEFT JOIN MvtStockFilleParDate ms ON ms.DATY = p.DATY AND ms.IDMAGASIN = p.IDMAGASIN AND ms.IDPRODUIT = p.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONFERMEVIDE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "DATYDEBUT", "DATYFIN", "QTEINITIAL", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "QTEFINAL", "GROUPERPAR") AS
SELECT
    ''  AS id,
    ''  AS idProduit,
    ''  AS idProduitLib,
    ''  AS idMagasin,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS daty,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS datyDebut,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS datyFin,
    CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS qteInitial,
    CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS entree,
    CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS sortie,
    CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS qteFinal,
    '' AS grouperPar
FROM DUAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONGROUPE" ("IDFACTURE", "REFERENCE", "DATY", "DEBIT", "CREDIT") AS
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.id, ff.idFactureFournisseur) AS idFacture,
    CASE
        WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'vente/vente-fiche.jsp&id=' || v.id
        WHEN ff.idFactureFournisseur IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'facturefournisseur/facturefournisseur-fiche.jsp&id=' || ff.idFactureFournisseur
        ELSE NULL
        END AS reference,
    p.daty,
    SUM(p.debit)  AS debit,
    SUM(p.credit) AS credit

FROM prevision p

         LEFT JOIN vente v
                   ON v.id = p.idfacture

         LEFT JOIN facturefournisseurfille ff
                   ON ff.idFactureFournisseur = p.idfacture

GROUP BY
    v.id,
    ff.idFactureFournisseur,
    p.daty;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONVALIDE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDFACTURE") AS
SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDCAISSE","IDVENTEDETAIL","IDVIREMENT","DEBIT","CREDIT","DATY","ETAT","IDOP","IDORIGINE","IDDEVISE","TAUX","IDTIERS","COMPTE","IDFACTURE" FROM prevision WHERE etat>=1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "IDTIERSLIB", "COMPTE", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT", "DEPENSEECART", "RECETTEECART", "IDFACTURE", "IDFACTUREMERE") AS
SELECT p.ID,
       p.DESIGNATION,
       p.IDCAISSE,
       p.IDCAISSELIB,
       p.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       p.IDVENTE,
       p.IDVENTELIB,
       p.IDVIREMENT,
       p.DEBIT,
       p.CREDIT,
       p.DATY,
       p.ETAT,
       p.IDOP,
       p.IDOPLIB,
       p.IDORIGINE,
       p.IDDEVISE,
       p.IDDEVISELIB,
       p.TAUX,
       p.IDTIERS,
       t.NOM                                                     as IDTIERSLIB,
       p.COMPTE,
       cast(NVL(pe.effectifDeb, 0) as number(30, 2))             AS effectifDebit,
       cast(NVL(pe.effectifCred, 0) as number(30, 2))            AS effectifCredit,
       cast(p.debit - NVL(pe.effectifDeb, 0) as number(30, 2))   AS depenseEcart,
       cast(p.credit - nVL(pe.effectifCred, 0) as number(30, 2)) AS recetteEcart,
       p.idfacture,
       COALESCE(v.IDVENTE, f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR)               AS idfacturemere
FROM PREVISION_CPL p
         LEFT JOIN PrevisionAvecMvtCaisse pe ON pe.id = p.id
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS v ON v.id = p.idfacture
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f ON f.id = p.idfacture
         LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON t.id = p.IDTIERS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_COMPLET_CPLPOSITIF" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT", "DEPENSEECART", "RECETTEECART", "IDFACTURE", "IDFACTUREMERE") AS
SELECT "ID",
       "DESIGNATION",
       "IDCAISSE",
       "IDCAISSELIB",
       "IDVENTEDETAIL",
       "IDVENTE",
       "IDVENTELIB",
       "IDVIREMENT",
       "DEBIT",
       "CREDIT",
       "DATY",
       "ETAT",
       "IDOP",
       "IDOPLIB",
       "IDORIGINE",
       "IDDEVISE",
       "IDDEVISELIB",
       "TAUX",
       "IDTIERS",
       "COMPTE",
       "EFFECTIFDEBIT",
       "EFFECTIFCREDIT",
       cast (DEPENSEECART as  number(30,2)) as DEPENSEECART,
       cast(RECETTEECART as  number(30,2)) as RECETTEECART,
       "IDFACTURE",
       "IDFACTUREMERE"
from PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL pr
WHERE pr.DEPENSEECART > 0
   OR RECETTEECART > 0
order by daty asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL_NR" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT", "DEPENSEECART", "RECETTEECART", "IDFACTURE") AS
SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDCAISSE","IDCAISSELIB","IDVENTEDETAIL","IDVENTE","IDVENTELIB","IDVIREMENT","DEBIT","CREDIT","DATY","ETAT","IDOP","IDOPLIB","IDORIGINE","IDDEVISE","IDDEVISELIB","TAUX","IDTIERS","COMPTE","EFFECTIFDEBIT","EFFECTIFCREDIT","DEPENSEECART","RECETTEECART","IDFACTURE" FROM 
PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL_DEP
where depenseEcart > 0
UNION ALL 
 SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDCAISSE","IDCAISSELIB","IDVENTEDETAIL","IDVENTE","IDVENTELIB","IDVIREMENT","DEBIT","CREDIT","DATY","ETAT","IDOP","IDOPLIB","IDORIGINE","IDDEVISE","IDDEVISELIB","TAUX","IDTIERS","COMPTE","EFFECTIFDEBIT","EFFECTIFCREDIT","DEPENSEECART","RECETTEECART","IDFACTURE" FROM
PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL_REC
where recetteEcart > 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDFACTURE", "IDRESERVATION", "DATEINITIAL", "DUREERETARD", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "SERVICE", "IDSERVICELIB") AS
select
	    p.id,
	    p.designation,
	    p.idcaisse,
	    c.val as idcaisselib,
	    p.idventedetail,
	    v.IDVENTE,
	    v2.designation as idventelib,
	    p.idvirement,
	    p.debit,
	    p.credit,
	    p.daty,
	    p.etat,
	    p.idop,
	    o.DESIGNATION as idoplib ,
	    p.idorigine,
	    p.iddevise,
	    p.designation as iddeviselib,
	    p.taux,
	    p.idtiers,
	    p.compte,
	    p.idfacture,
	    v2.IDRESERVATION,
	    p.dateinitial,
	    p.dureeretard,
	    p.mois,
	    p.annee,
	    TO_CHAR(
	            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(p.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
	            'FMMonth',
	            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
	    ) AS moisLib,
	    p.SERVICE,
	    s.libelle AS idServiceLib
	from PREVISION p
	         left join caisse c on p.idcaisse = c.id
	         left join VENTE_DETAILS v on p.IDVENTEDETAIL=v.ID
	         left join vente v2 on v2.id=v.IDVENTE
	         left join ORDONNERPAIEMENT o on o.id=p.IDOP
	         LEFT JOIN SERVICE s ON p.SERVICE = s.COMPTE
	         left join devise d on d.id=p.IDDEVISE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_EFFECTIF" ("IDPREVISION", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT") AS
SELECT 
	p.id AS idprevision,   
	SUM(m.debit) as effectifDebit, 
	SUM(m.credit) as effectifCredit
FROM Prevision p 
join MOUVEMENTCAISSE m on m.idPrevision=p.id 
GROUP BY p.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_TIERS" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT", "DEPENSEECART", "RECETTEECART", "IDFACTURE", "TIERSLIB") AS
select p."ID",p."DESIGNATION",p."IDCAISSE",p."IDCAISSELIB",p."IDVENTEDETAIL",p."IDVENTE",p."IDVENTELIB",p."IDVIREMENT",p."DEBIT",p."CREDIT",p."DATY",p."ETAT",p."IDOP",p."IDOPLIB",p."IDORIGINE",p."IDDEVISE",p."IDDEVISELIB",p."TAUX",p."IDTIERS",p."COMPTE",p."EFFECTIFDEBIT",p."EFFECTIFCREDIT",p."DEPENSEECART",p."RECETTEECART",p."IDFACTURE", t.nom as tierslib from PREVISION_COMPLET_CPLPositif p LEFT JOIN TIERS t on t.id = p.IDTIERS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRIXTEMP" ("PUTEMP", "IDPRODUIT") AS
SELECT AVG(PU)AS putemp,IDPRODUIT FROM V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE vee GROUP BY IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRIX_MO_PRODUIT" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "PU", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIELIB") AS
SELECT a.IDPRODUITS AS ID ,a.LIBELLEPRODUIT AS LIBELLE  , SUM(PU) AS PU,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,CATEGORIELIB  FROM 
	AS_RECETTE_LIB_CAT a WHERE CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT002'
	GROUP BY IDPRODUITS , CATEGORIELIB ,LIBELLEPRODUIT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSFABPETRI" ("IDHISTORIQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "OBJET", "ACTION", "IDUTILISATEUR", "REFOBJET", "ACTEUR", "REMARQUE", "ECART") AS
SELECT 
p."IDHISTORIQUE",p."DATEHISTORIQUE",p."HEURE",p."OBJET",p."ACTION",p."IDUTILISATEUR",p."REFOBJET",p."ACTEUR",p."REMARQUE",p."ECART" 
FROM PROCESS p 
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.ID = p.REFOBJET 
LEFT JOIN FABRICATIONFILLE f2 ON f2.IDMERE = f.ID 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = f2.IDINGREDIENTS  
WHERE ai.IDFOURNISSEUR ='oui'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSLIB" ("IDHISTORIQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "OBJET", "REFOBJET", "REMARQUE", "IDUTILISATEUR", "ACTION", "ECART", "ECARTMINUTES", "ACTEUR") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSMAINTENANCEGLOBAL" ("IDTRAVAUX", "IDPERSONNEL", "DUREEREEL", "DUREEREELHMS") AS
SELECT
    pr.IDTRAVAUX,
    pr.IDPERSONNEL,
    sum(pr.ecart_seconde) as dureeReel,
    LPAD(FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)), 60), 2, '0')
                          AS dureeReelHMS
FROM PROCESSMAINTENANCELIB pr
group by pr.IDTRAVAUX, pr.IDPERSONNEL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSMAINTENANCELIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTRAVAUX", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "HEUREDEBUT", "HEUREFIN", "DATETIME_DEBUT", "DATETIME_FIN", "ECART_SECONDE", "ECART_HMS", "IDPERSONNELLIB") AS
SELECT
    prc."ID",prc."IDPERSONNEL",prc."IDTRAVAUX",prc."DATEDEBUT",prc."DATEFIN",prc."HEUREDEBUT",prc."HEUREFIN",prc."DATETIME_DEBUT",prc."DATETIME_FIN",
    /* Ecart en secondes */
    ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) AS ecart_seconde,
    /* Ecart format HH:MM:SS */
    LPAD(FLOOR(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) / 3600), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 3600) / 60), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 60), 2, '0')
                                                           AS ecart_hms,
    p.NOM AS idPersonnelLib
FROM (
         SELECT
             prc.*,

             /* Date + Heure debut */
             prc.DATEDEBUT
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_debut,

             /* Date + Heure fin */
             prc.DATEFIN
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_fin

         FROM ProcessMaintenance prc
     ) prc
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON p.ID = prc.IDPERSONNEL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRODUITCOMMANDECARTON" ("IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "QUANTITEBC", "QUANTITECARTON", "RESTECARTON") AS
SELECT 
pc.IDBC,
ai.LIBELLE AS produitlib,
nvl(pc.QUANTITEBC,0) AS QUANTITEBC,
nvl(ps.QUANTITEcarton,0) AS QUANTITEcarton,
nvl(pc.QUANTITEBC,0) - nvl(ps.QUANTITEcarton,0) AS restecarton
FROM produitcommande pc

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRODUITCOMMANDEFILLECARTON" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITEBCF", "QUANTITECARTONFILLE", "RESTECARTONFILLE") AS

bc.ID ,

ai.LIBELLE AS produitlib,
ai.id AS produit,
nvl(bc.QUANTITE,0) AS quantiteBCF ,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMACOMMADER" ("PRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "IDPROFORMA") AS
select PRODUIT, sum(QUANTITE) as quantite, bc.IDPROFORMA from BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf join BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id=bcf.IDBC where bc.ETAT>=11 group by PRODUIT, bc.IDPROFORMA;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "RESTEBC", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT vd.ID,
       vd.IDPROFORMA,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       vd.QTE,
       vd.PU,
       vd.REMISE,
       vd.TVA,
       vd.PUACHAT,
       vd.PUVENTE,
       v.IDDEVISE,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
       vd.DESIGNATION,
       vd.COMPTE,
       vd.PUREVIENT,
       vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,
       v.DESIGNATION                                                                                       AS IDPROFORMALIB,
       nvl(p.LIBELLEVENTE,p.libelle)                                                                                           AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) as NUMBER(30, 2))                                                             AS puTotal,
       vd.unite,
       au.val                                                                                              AS uniteLib,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2))                                 AS remisemontant,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
             100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                               as montantristourne,
       cast(nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                as fraistransport,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
              100)) -
            nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30 ,2))                                                       as montanttotal,
       cast((nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
            ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) -
             nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30,2))                                                     as montanttva,
       cast(((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) - nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                        ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                          (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                           nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)) -
                                                                         p.CALORIE * vd.QTE *
                                                                         v.fraislivraison) as number(30, 2))                      as montantttc,
       vd.datedebut,
       cast(nvl(p.calorie, 0) as number(10,2))                                                                                   as CALORIE,
       vd.ristourne                                                                                        as ristourne,
       cast(p.CALORIE as number(30, 2))                                                                    as poidsparkilo,
       cast(v.fraislivraison as number(30, 2))                                                             as fraislivraison,
       cast(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE as number(30, 2))                                                           as poidstotal,
       ((nvl(vd.qte,0) - nvl(pfc.QUANTITE,0) ) +  nvl(bcr.QUANTITE,0) )as restebc,
       vd.remiseArbiochem,
       vd.ristourneArbiochem
--       d2.id AS idDevis
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = vd.unite
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMACOMMADER pfc on pfc.IDPROFORMA=v.ID and vd.IDPRODUIT=pfc.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDEFACTURER bcr on v.id=bcr.IDPROFORMA and bcr.PRODUIT=vd.IDPRODUIT
order by p.LIBELLEVENTE asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL2" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "RESTEBC", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT vd.ID,
       vd.IDPROFORMA,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       vd.QTE,
       vd.PU,
       vd.REMISE,
       vd.TVA,
       vd.PUACHAT,
       vd.PUVENTE,
       v.IDDEVISE,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
       vd.DESIGNATION,
       vd.COMPTE,
       vd.PUREVIENT,
       vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,
       v.DESIGNATION AS IDPROFORMALIB,
       NVL(p.LIBELLEVENTE, p.libelle) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       CAST((vd.QTE * vd.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS puTotal,
       vd.unite,
       au.val AS uniteLib,
       CAST(((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0))) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS remisemontant,
       CAST((
           ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
               + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantristourne,
       CAST(NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS fraistransport,
       CAST((
           (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
               - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))
               - (
               ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
                   + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
               )
               - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttotal,
       CAST((
           (NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) * (
               (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                   - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))
                   - (
                   ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
                       + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
                   )
                   - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
               )
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttva,
       CAST((
           (
               (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                   - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))
                   - (
                   ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
                       + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
                   )
                   - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
               ) * (1 + NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100)
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc,
       vd.datedebut,
       CAST(NVL(p.calorie, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS CALORIE,
       vd.ristourne AS ristourne,
       CAST(p.CALORIE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS poidsparkilo,
       CAST(v.fraislivraison AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS fraislivraison,
       CAST(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS poidstotal,
       ((NVL(vd.qte, 0) - NVL(pfc.QUANTITE, 0)) + NVL(bcr.QUANTITE, 0)) AS restebc,
       CAST(NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS remiseArbiochem,
       CAST(NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS ristourneArbiochem
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = vd.unite
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMACOMMADER pfc ON pfc.IDPROFORMA = v.ID AND vd.IDPRODUIT = pfc.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDEFACTURER bcr ON v.id = bcr.IDPROFORMA AND bcr.PRODUIT = vd.IDPRODUIT
ORDER BY p.LIBELLEVENTE ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL_ING" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE") AS
SELECT vd.ID,
       vd.IDPROFORMA,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       vd.QTE,
       vd.PU,
       vd.REMISE,
       vd.TVA,
       vd.PUACHAT,
       vd.PUVENTE,
       v.IDDEVISE,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
       vd.DESIGNATION,
       vd.COMPTE,
       vd.PUREVIENT,
       vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,
       v.DESIGNATION                                                                                       AS IDPROFORMALIB,
       p.LIBELLEVENTE                                                                                           AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) as NUMBER(30, 2))                                                             AS puTotal,
       vd.unite,
       au.val                                                                                              AS uniteLib,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2))                                 AS remisemontant,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
             100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                               as montantristourne,
       cast(nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                as fraistransport,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
              100)) -
            nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30 ,2))                                                       as montanttotal,
       cast((nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
            ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) -
             nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30,2))                                                     as montanttva,
       cast(((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) - nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                        ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                          (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                           nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)) -
                                                                         p.CALORIE * vd.QTE *
                                                                         v.fraislivraison) as number(30, 2))                      as montantttc,
       vd.datedebut,
       cast(nvl(p.calorie, 0) as number(10,2))                                                                                   as CALORIE,
       vd.ristourne                                                                                        as ristourne,
       cast(p.CALORIE as number(30, 2))                                                                    as poidsparkilo,
       cast(v.fraislivraison as number(30, 2))                                                             as fraislivraison,
       cast(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE as number(30, 2))                                                           as poidstotal,
       p.pu as puingredient,
       nvl(eq.QUANTITE,1) as contenue
--       d2.id AS idDevis
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = vd.unite
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT1=p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL_ING_PDF" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE", "UNITE2", "REMISEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT
    vd.ID,
    vd.IDPROFORMA,
    vd.IDPRODUIT,
    vd.IDORIGINE,
    vd.QTE,
    vd.PU,
    vd.REMISE,
    vd.TVA,
    vd.PUACHAT,
    vd.PUVENTE,
    v.IDDEVISE,
    vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
    vd.DESIGNATION,
    vd.COMPTE,
    vd.PUREVIENT,
    vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,

    v.DESIGNATION AS IDPROFORMALIB,

    NVL(p.LIBELLEVENTE, p.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,

    CAST(
        vd.QTE * vd.PU
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUTOTAL,

    vd.UNITE,

    au.VAL AS UNITELIB,

    /* REMISE TOTALE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS REMISEMONTANT,

    /* RISTOURNE */
    CAST(
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
        ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE,

    /* FRAIS TRANSPORT */
    CAST(
        NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISTRANSPORT,

    /* MONTANT TOTAL HT */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
        - (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        )
        - (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
            ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        )
        - NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTOTAL,

    /* MONTANT REMISE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTREMISE,

    /* TVA */
    CAST(
        (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100) *
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
            - (
                (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                    - (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                    )
                ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
            )
            - NVL(
                p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                0
            )
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTVA,

    /* TTC */
    CAST(
        (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
                - (
                    (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                        - (
                            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                        )
                    ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
                )
                - NVL(
                    p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                    0
                )
            )
            * (1 + NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100)
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTTC,

    vd.DATEDEBUT,

    CAST(
        NVL(p.CALORIE,0)
        AS NUMBER(10,2)
    ) AS CALORIE,

    vd.RISTOURNE,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSPARKILO,

    CAST(
        v.FRAISLIVRAISON
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISLIVRAISON,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE * vd.QTE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSTOTAL,

    CAST(
        vd.PU / NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUINGREDIENT,

    NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1) AS CONTENUE,

    p.UNITE2,
    vd.remisearbiochem

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd

LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v
    ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA

LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
    ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT

LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au
    ON au.ID = vd.UNITE

LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
    ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANT2" ("ID", "POIDSTOTAL", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS
SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM(poidstotal) as number(30, 2))                            AS poidstotal,
       cast(SUM(puTotal) as number(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       cast(SUM(remisemontant) as number(30, 2))                         as montantremise,
       cast(SUM(montantristourne) as number(30, 2))                      as montantristourne,
       cast(SUM(vd.fraistransport) as number(30, 2))                     as fraistransport,
       cast(SUM(montanttotal) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2)) AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(montanttva) as number(30, 2))                            AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(montantttc) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                            AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                      AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM(montantttc * vd.TAUXDECHANGE) as number(30, 2))          as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                 as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION
FROM PROFORMADETAILS_CPL vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MONTANTRISTOURNE") AS
SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       cast(sum(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5)   )      as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast((SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))*NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) ) as number(30, 2)) as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(vd.QTE*ing.CALORIE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colis,
       cast(sum((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100  * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /100) as number(30, 2)) as montantristourne
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION order by v.id asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER2" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MONTANTRISTOURNE") AS
SELECT
    v.ID,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                - (
                (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                    + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                )
                - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotal,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantremise,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(v.fraislivraison,0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE,0) * NVL(vd.QTE,0)) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS frais,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PUACHAT,0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotalachat,

    CAST(SUM(
            NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTva,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC,

    NVL(v.IDDEVISE, 'AR') AS IDDEVISE,

    NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) AS tauxDeChange,

    CAST(
            SUM(
                    (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                        (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                            - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                            - (
                            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                            )
                            - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                        )
            ) * NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAR,

    CAST(SUM(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS montantRevient,

    v.IDRESERVATION,

    NVL(SUM(vd.QTE * ing.CALORIE), 0) AS poids,

    SUM(vd.QTE) AS colis,

    CAST(SUM(
            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantristourne

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, v.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION
ORDER BY v.id ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMA_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "CODECLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ADRESSE", "CONTACT", "POIDSTOTAL", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "IDORIGINE", "REMISE", "NUMEROPROFORMA", "IDCOMMANDE", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "REFERENCE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS SELECT V.ID, V.DESIGNATION, V.IDMAGASIN, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, V.DATY, V.REMARQUE, V.ETAT, CASE WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 12 THEN 'CLÔTURÉ' END AS ETATLIB, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.CODECLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, C.ADRESSE, C.TELEPHONE AS CONTACT, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS POIDSTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANT, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(V2.MONTANTRISTOURNE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE, CAST(NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, CAST(V2.FRAIS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS FRAISTRANSPORT, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRESTE, 0 AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((COALESCE(V2.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) - COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID;

COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER2 V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."QTEFABANDRESTFABBYIDBC" ("IDFABFILLE", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMERE", "QTEFAB", "QTEFABRESTANTE") AS
SELECT  
	f.ID AS IDFABFILLE,
	f.IDBCFILLE ,
	f.IDMERE ,
	f.QTE AS QTEFAB, 
    NVL(f.QTE, 0) - NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) AS QTEFABRESTANTE
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf 
	ON bcf.ID = f.IDBCFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."QTEOFANDRESTOFBYIDBC" ("IDOFFILLE", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMERE", "QTEOF", "QTEOFRESTANTE") AS
SELECT  
    o.ID AS IDOFFILLE, 
    o.IDBCFILLE, 
    o.IDMERE, 
    o.QTE AS QTEOF, 
    NVL(o.QTE, 0) - NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) AS QTEOFRESTANTE
FROM OFFILLE o 
LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf 
    ON bcf.ID = o.IDBCFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."QTE_DISPO_LOT_SEXE_QUALITELIB" ("IDLOT", "IDQUALITE", "IDSEXE", "QTE") AS
SELECT
    rpd.IDLOT              AS IDLOT,
    rpd.IDQUALITEPOUSSIN   AS IDQUALITE,
    rpd.IDSEXE             AS IDSEXE,
    SUM(rpd.QTE)           AS QTE
FROM RECEPTIONPOUSSINAEDETAIL_LIB rpd
GROUP BY rpd.IDLOT, rpd.IDQUALITEPOUSSIN, rpd.IDSEXE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENTBCETAT" ("ID", "IDSOUSECRITURE", "IDRELEVERDETAIL", "VALEURSOUSECRITURE", "VALEURRELEVERDETAIL", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDMERE") AS
select rp.id,rp.IDSOUSECRITURE,rp.IDRELEVERDETAIL,rp.VALEURSOUSECRITURE,rp.VALEURRELEVERDETAIL,rp.DATY,rpm.ETAT,rp.IDMERE from RapprochementBC rp join RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERE rpm on rp.IDMERE=rpm.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERELIB" ("ID", "IDBANQUE", "VALEUR", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDBANQUELIB", "ETATLIB") AS
select
    rp."ID",rp."IDBANQUE",rp."VALEUR",rp."DATY",rp."ETAT",
    ca.VAL as idbanquelib,
    CASE
        WHEN rp.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREEE'
        WHEN rp.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
        WHEN rp.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
        END
           AS ETATLIB
from RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERE rp join CAISSE ca on ca.id=rp.idBanque;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENTGLOBALE_PIE" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "MONTANT") AS
select c.id, c.VAL , c.DESCE ,sum(f.pu * f.qte) as montant from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE  f
                                                                    left join AS_INGREDIENTS a on f.IDPRODUIT = a.ID
                                                                    left join CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c on c.ID = a.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
where c.id is not null
group by c.id, c.VAL,c.DESCE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENTTRAVAUX" ("ID", "IDTRAVAUX", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS", "DUREEREEL_HMS", "ECART_HMS", "DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE", "DUREEREEL_SECONDE", "ECART_SECONDE", "MONTANTESTIMATIF", "MONTANTREEL", "MONTANTECART", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDTRAVAUX,SQ.IDPERSONNEL,SQ.IDPERSONNELLIB,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS,SQ.DUREEREEL_HMS,SQ.ECART_HMS,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE,SQ.DUREEREEL_SECONDE,SQ.ECART_SECONDE,SQ.MONTANTESTIMATIF,SQ.MONTANTREEL,SQ.MONTANTECART,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTRAVAUX),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNELLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTESTIMATIF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTREEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTECART),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT
	             '' AS ID,
	             mo.IDTRAVAUX,
	             mo.IDPERSONNEL,
	             mo.idPersonnelLib,
	             mo.dureeEstimatifLib AS dureeEstimatif_hms,
	             pr.dureeReelHMS AS dureeReel_hms,
	             -- Ecart HMS calcule avec ABS pour eviter le signe -
	             LPAD(FLOOR(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 60), 2, '0')
	                 AS ecart_hms,
	             mo.DUREEESTIMATIF AS dureeEstimatif_seconde,
	             pr.dureeReel AS dureeReel_seconde,
	             -- Ecart Seconde en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel) AS ecart_seconde,
	             mo.montant AS montantEstimatif,
	             ((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE AS montantReel,
	             -- Ecart Montant en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.montant - (((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE)) AS montantEcart
	         FROM MOTRAVAUXLIB mo
	                  LEFT JOIN ProcessMaintenanceGlobal pr ON pr.IDPERSONNEL = mo.IDPERSONNEL AND pr.IDTRAVAUX = mo.IDTRAVAUX
	     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_BF_CLIENT" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER", "QTESORTIE", "RESTEASORTIR", "PU", "UNITELIB") AS
SELECT abcc.ID,
       abcc.PRODUIT,
       abcc.NUMBL,
       abcc.QUANTITE,
       abcc.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       abcc.UNITE,
       abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
       abcc.IDPRODUITLIB,
       abcc.IDVENTE,
       abcc.IDBC,
       abcc.QTELIVREE,
       abcc.QTERESTEALIVRER,
       nvl(m.qteSortie, 0)                 AS qteSortie,
       least(abcc.qtevente - nvl(m.qteSortie, 0), abcc.QUANTITE) AS resteASortir,
       abcc.pu,
       au.val AS unitelib
FROM AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL abcc
         LEFT JOIN SORTIEPRODUITparventegrp m ON m.idproduit = abcc.produit and m.IDVENTE = abcc.idvente
         LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK mv ON mv.idobjet = abcc.numbl
         LEFT JOIN as_unite au ON au.id = abcc.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_BF_FOURNISSEUR" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "QTEENTREE", "RESTEASORTIR", "PU", "PUAR", "RESTEAENTRER") AS
SELECT
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS LIBELLEEXACTE,

        NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS QTEENTREE,

        NVL(abcc.QUANTITE,0) - NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS RESTEASORTIR,

        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar,

        NVL(abcc.QUANTITE,0) - NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS RESTEAENTRER

    FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIBCPL abcc
    LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKLIBVALIDER mv 
        ON mv.idobjet = abcc.numbl 
    LEFT JOIN mvtstockfille mvf 
        ON mv.id = mvf.idmvtstock  AND mvf.idproduit = abcc.produit

    GROUP BY 
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_BF_LIVREE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "QTEENTREE", "RESTEASORTIR", "PU", "PUAR", "RESTEAENTRER", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT 
    SQ.ID,
    SQ.PRODUIT,
    SQ.NUMBL,
    SQ.QUANTITE,
    SQ.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    SQ.UNITE,
    SQ.IDBC_FILLE,
    SQ.REMARQUE,
    SQ.IDBC,
    SQ.DATY,
    SQ.ETAT,
    SQ.MAGASIN,
    SQ.PRODUITLIB,
    SQ.UNITELIB,
    SQ.MAGASINLIB,
    SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE,
    SQ.QTEENTREE,
    SQ.RESTEASORTIR,
    SQ.PU,
    SQ.PUAR,
    SQ.RESTEAENTRER,

    (
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.ID),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PRODUIT),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.NUMBL),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.QUANTITE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.UNITE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDBC_FILLE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDBC),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.ETAT),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.MAGASIN),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PRODUITLIB),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.UNITELIB),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.MAGASINLIB),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.QTEENTREE),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.RESTEASORTIR),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PU),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUAR),'') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.RESTEAENTRER),'')
    ) AS MOTSCLESSS

FROM (
    SELECT
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS LIBELLEEXACTE,

        NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS QTEENTREE,

        NVL(abcc.QUANTITE,0) - NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS RESTEASORTIR,

        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar,

        NVL(abcc.QUANTITE,0) - NVL(SUM(mvf.entree),0) AS RESTEAENTRER

    FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIBCPL abcc
    LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKLIBVALIDER mv 
        ON mv.idobjet = abcc.numbl 
    LEFT JOIN mvtstockfille mvf 
        ON mv.id = mvf.idmvtstock  
       AND mvf.idproduit = abcc.produit

    GROUP BY 
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar
) SQ

WHERE SQ.RESTEAENTRER > 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_COMPLET" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTTH", "ECART") AS
SELECT
    st.idmere,
    st.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieIngredient,
    st.idcategorieingredient,
    CAST(SUM(montantsortie) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantSortie,
    CAST(SUM(montth) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
    CAST(SUM(montth)-SUM(montantsortie) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecart
FROM stockEtDepenseOfFabTheCat st
GROUP BY st.idmere, st.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, st.idcategorieingredient

UNION ALL

SELECT
    hs.idMere,
    'Charge personnelle' as CATEGORIE,
    hs.CATEGORIE as idCategorieIngredient,
    hs.montantPersonnel AS montantSortie,
    0 AS montth,
    -hs.montantPersonnel AS ecart
FROM HS_PAR_OF hs;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_FFOURNISSEUR" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "PU", "PUAR", "QUANTITE", "QTEFACTURER", "RESTEAFACTURER") AS
SELECT
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS LIBELLEEXACTE,
        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        NVL(SUM(ffv.qte),0) AS qtefacturer,
        abcc.QUANTITE - NVL(SUM(ffv.qte),0)  as resteAfacturer
    FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIBCPL abcc
    left join FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLEValide  ffv on ffv.idfacturefournisseur = abcc.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
    GROUP BY 
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
        abcc.pu,
        abcc.puar;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECAPITULATIF_ALL_FINAL" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "SALAIRE", "INDEMNITE", "AVANTAGE_EN_NATURE", "SALAIRE_BRUT", "IRSA", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "MONTANT_NET_PAYER", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR", "CNAPS_A_PAYER", "TOTAL_FRM", "ID", "MOISLIB") AS
SELECT rs.mois,
       rs.annee,
       rs.salaire,
       rs.indemnite,
       rs.avantage_en_nature,
       rs.salaire_brut,
       rs.irsa,
       rs.cnaps_travailleur,
       CAST(rs.montant_net_payer AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANT_NET_PAYER,
       rs.cnaps_employeur,
       rs.cnaps_a_payer,
       frm.total_frm,
       rs.id,
       TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rs.mois, 'MM'), 'MONTH', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS MOISLIB
FROM recapitulatif_salaire_all rs
         LEFT JOIN frm_mois_annee frm ON rs.mois = frm.mois AND rs.annee = frm.annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECAPITULATIF_SALAIRE_ALL" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "SALAIRE", "INDEMNITE", "AVANTAGE_EN_NATURE", "SALAIRE_BRUT", "IRSA", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "MONTANT_NET_PAYER", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR", "CNAPS_A_PAYER", "ID") AS
SELECT recap_sal_all.mois,
       recap_sal_all.annee,
       recap_sal_all.salaire AS salaire,
       recap_sal_all.indemnite AS indemnite,
       recap_sal_all.avantage_en_nature AS avantage_en_nature,
       recap_sal_all.salaire_brut AS salaire_brut,
       recap_sal_all.irsa AS irsa,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_travailleur AS cnaps_travailleur,
       CAST(recap_sal_all.montant_net_payer AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montant_net_payer,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_employeur AS cnaps_employeur,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_a_payer AS cnaps_a_payer,
       recap_sal_all.id
FROM recap_sal_all;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECAP_SAL_ALL" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "SALAIRE", "INDEMNITE", "AVANTAGE_EN_NATURE", "SALAIRE_BRUT", "IRSA", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "MONTANT_NET_PAYER", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR", "CNAPS_A_PAYER", "ID") AS
SELECT
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie IN ('PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001') THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS indemnite,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000201' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS avantage_en_nature,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PRUNI' THEN NVL(pegi.imposable, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire_brut,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000141' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS irsa,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur,

    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE
                       WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000210A' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                       ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS montant_net_payer,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 13, 2) AS cnaps_employeur,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 14, 2) AS cnaps_a_payer,
    pe.idedition AS id

FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_edition_gain_imp pegi
                   ON pe.idpersonnel = pegi.idpersonnel
                       AND pe.mois = pegi.mois
                       AND pe.annee = pegi.annee
                       AND pe.idelementpaie IN (
                                                'PR000041', 'PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001',
                                                'PR000201', 'PRUNI', 'PR000141', 'PR000101', 'PR000210A'
                           )
GROUP BY pe.annee, pe.mois, pe.IDEDITION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONOACDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDLOT", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUF", "QTERECUS", "IDLOTLIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUFLIB") AS
SELECT d."ID",
       d."IDMERE",
       d."IDLOT",
       d."IDBATIMENT",
       d."IDPARQUET",
       d."IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUF",
       d."QTERECUS",
       l."NOMLOT"       AS "IDLOTLIB",
       b."NOMBATIMENT"  AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",
       p."VAL"          AS "IDPARQUETLIB",
       qt."VAL"         AS "IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUFLIB"
FROM "RECEPTIONOACDETAIL" d
         LEFT JOIN "LOT" l ON l."ID" = d."IDLOT"
         LEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = d."IDBATIMENT"
         LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" p ON p."ID" = d."IDPARQUET"
         LEFT JOIN "QUALITETRIAGEOEUF" qt ON qt."ID" = d."IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUF";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONOAC_LIB" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT r."ID",
       r."DATERECEPTION",
       r."DATEPONTE",
       r."DATECOLLECTE",
       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",
       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",
       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",
       r."IDRESPONSABLE",
       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",
       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",
       r."IDVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",
       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",
       r."IDPROVENANCE",
       r."ETAT",
       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",
       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",
       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",
       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",
       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB",
       CASE r."ETAT"
            WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
            WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
            WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
       END                                AS "ETATLIB"
FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r
         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"
         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"
         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE" WHERE r.IDPROVENANCE IS NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONPOUSSINAEDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDQUALITEPOUSSIN", "IDSEXE", "QTE", "IDQUALITEPOUSSINLIB", "IDSEXELIB", "IDLOT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONPOUSSINAEROPORT_LIB" ("ID", "IDLOT", "DATY", "QTERECUS", "REMARQUE", "HEUREDEPART", "HEUREARRIVE", "IDLOTLIB", "NBRCARTONMALE", "NBRCARTONFEMELLE", "NBRCARTONTOTAL", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECETTEMONTANT" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "IDUNITE", "SOURCE", "COMPOSE", "QTEAV", "QTETOTAL", "TYPESTOCK", "REFPOST", "REFQUALIFICATION", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "NIVEAU") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECETTE_FILLE_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDINGREDIENT", "IDUNITE", "QTE", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "IDUNITELIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECETTE_MERE_LIB" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "DATY", "NOMRECETTE", "VERSION", "IDPRODUITLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECLAMATIONLIB" ("ID", "IDVENTEFILLE", "DATY", "IDTYPE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPELIB", "IDVENTE", "QTE") AS
SELECT
    r.ID,
    r.idVenteFille,
    r.daty,
    r.idType,
    r.etat,

    CASE r.etat
        WHEN 1  THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Cloture'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Rejete'
        ELSE 'Autre'
        END AS etatLib,

    tr.VAL AS idTypeLib,
    vd.IDVENTE,
    r.qte
FROM reclamation r
         LEFT JOIN TYPERECLAMATION tr
                   ON tr.ID = r.idType
         LEFT JOIN vente_details vd on vd.id = r.IDVENTEFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVECLIENT" ("ID", "JOURNAL", "REFERENCE", "DATY", "LIBELLE", "LETTRE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "IDCLIENT", "CLIENTLIB", "COMPTE", "UPDATED_AT", "SOLDE", "ANNEE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.JOURNAL,
       SQ.REFERENCE,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.LIBELLE,
       SQ.LETTRE,
       CAST(SQ.DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS DEBIT,
       CAST(SQ.CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS CREDIT,
       SQ.IDCLIENT,
       SQ.CLIENTLIB,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.UPDATED_AT,
       CAST(SQ.SOLDE AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS SOLDE,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || JOURNAL || ' | ' || REFERENCE || ' | ' || CLIENTLIB || ' | ' || LIBELLE || ' | ' || LETTRE
           )                            AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (SELECT RELEVER.ID,
             RELEVER.JOURNAL,
             RELEVER.REFERENCE,
             RELEVER.DATY,
             RELEVER.LIBELLE,
             RELEVER.LETTRE,
             RELEVER.DEBIT,
             RELEVER.CREDIT,
             RELEVER.IDCLIENT,
             T.NOM                           AS CLIENTLIB,
             NVL(RELEVER.COMPTE, T.COMPTE)   AS COMPTE,
             RELEVER.UPDATED_AT,
             RELEVER.SOLDE,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RELEVER.DATY) AS ANNEE,

             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY RELEVER.ID, RELEVER.JOURNAL, RELEVER.REFERENCE, RELEVER.DATY
                 ORDER BY
                     CASE
                         WHEN RELEVER.LETTRE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(RELEVER.LETTRE) IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                         ELSE 1
                         END
                 )                           AS RN

      FROM (

               /* NOTE DE CREDIT / AVOIR CLIENT */
               SELECT AV.ID                        AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')           AS JOURNAL,
                      AV.ID                        AS REFERENCE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS DATY,
                      'NOTE DE CREDIT : ' || AV.ID AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')          AS LETTRE,
                      0                            AS DEBIT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR              AS CREDIT,
                      AV.IDCLIENT                  AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                  AS COMPTE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS UPDATED_AT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR * -1         AS SOLDE
               FROM AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_VISEE AV
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = AV.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* FACTURE / VENTE CLIENT */
               SELECT MCD.ID                            AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')                AS JOURNAL,
                      MCD.NUMEROFACTURE                 AS REFERENCE,
                      MCD.DATY                          AS DATY,
                      NVL(MCD.REFERENCES_PAIEMENT, ' ') AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')               AS LETTRE,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS DEBIT,
                      0                                 AS CREDIT,
                      MCD.IDCLIENT                      AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                       AS COMPTE,
                      MCD.UPDATED_AT                    AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL_UNIQUE MCD
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MCD.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MCD.ETAT >= 7
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* REGLEMENT CLIENT */
               SELECT MC.ID                   AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')      AS JOURNAL,
                      MC.ID                   AS REFERENCE,
                      MC.DATYCOMPTABILISATION AS DATY,
                      MC.DESIGNATION          AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')     AS LETTRE,
                      0                       AS DEBIT,
                      MC.CREDIT               AS CREDIT,
                      MC.IDTIERS              AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE             AS COMPTE,
                      MC.UPDATED_AT           AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MC.CREDIT * -1          AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL MC
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MC.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MC.ETAT > 8
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%') RELEVER
               LEFT JOIN TIERS T ON T.ID = RELEVER.IDCLIENT) SQ
WHERE SQ.RN = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILCPL" ("ID", "IDMERE", "DATY", "DATYVALEUR", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE") AS
select rd."ID",rd."IDMERE",rd."DATY",rd."DATYVALEUR",rd."DESIGNATION",rd."DEBIT",rd."CREDIT" , r.IDCAISSE, cai.COMPTE from ReleverDetail rd join RELEVER r on rd.IDMERE = r.id left join CAISSE cai on cai.id=r.IDCAISSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILNR" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATYVALEUR", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE") AS
SELECT
    rd.ID,
    rd.DESIGNATION,
    rd.DEBIT,
    rd.CREDIT,
    rd.DATYVALEUR,
    r.IDCAISSE, cai.COMPTE
FROM RELEVERDETAIL rd
         JOIN RELEVER r ON r.ID = rd.IDMERE
         left join CAISSE cai on cai.id=r.IDCAISSE
WHERE
    r.ETAT >= 11
  AND rd.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT rpf.IDRELEVERDETAIL
    FROM RAPPROCHEMENTBC rpf join RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERE rp on rpf.idmere=rp.id
    WHERE rpf.IDRELEVERDETAIL IS NOT NULL AND rp.ETAT>=11
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILNRMVT" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATYVALEUR", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE", "MOUVEMENT") AS
SELECT
    ID,
    DESIGNATION,
    CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(32,2)) AS DEBIT,
    CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(32,2)) AS CREDIT,
    DATYVALEUR,
    IDCAISSE,
    COMPTE,
    CASE
        WHEN DEBIT > 0 THEN 1
        WHEN CREDIT > 0 THEN 2
        ELSE 0
        END AS MOUVEMENT
FROM RELEVERDETAILNR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILRMVT" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATYVALEUR", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE", "MOUVEMENT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERFABCPL" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFAB", "IDRELEVE", "ETAT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERLIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDCAISSE", "ETAT", "IDCAISSELIB", "DATYDEBUT", "DATYFIN", "ETATLIB") AS
select

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVER_CLIENT_OPT" ("DATY", "COMPTE_AUX", "LIBELLE", "SOLDE_INITIAL", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDE_FINAL") AS
SELECT
    e.DATY                  AS daty,
    se.COMPTE_AUX            AS compte_aux,
    se.LIBELLEPIECE          AS libelle,
    0                        AS solde_initial,
    se.DEBIT                 AS debit,
    se.CREDIT                AS credit,
    0                        AS solde_final
FROM COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE se
