WHERE se.COMPTE_AUX IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMBOURSEMENTLIB" ("ID", "IDAVANCE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MONTANT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "ETAT", "PERSONNEL", "TYPEAVANCELIB", "ETATLIB", "MATRICULE", "MOISLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDAVANCE,SQ.MOIS,SQ.ANNEE,SQ.MONTANT,SQ.REMARQUE,SQ.DATY,SQ.ETAT,SQ.PERSONNEL,SQ.TYPEAVANCELIB,SQ.ETATLIB,SQ.MATRICULE,SQ.MOISLIB,
	  (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDAVANCE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOIS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANNEE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PERSONNEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TYPEAVANCELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETATLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MATRICULE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOISLIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	  SELECT pr.id,
	       pr.idavance,
	       pr.mois,
	       pr.annee,
	       pr.montant,
	       pr.remarque,
	       pr.daty,
	       pr.etat,
	       lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom  AS personnel,
	       t.val AS typeavancelib,
	       CASE
	           WHEN pr.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
	           WHEN pr.etat = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
	           ELSE NULL
	           END AS etatlib,
	       pip.matricule,
	       TO_CHAR(
	               TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pr.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
	               'FMMonth',
	               'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
	       ) AS moisLib
	FROM remboursement pr
	         LEFT JOIN avance a ON a.id = pr.idavance
	         LEFT JOIN typeavance t ON t.id = a.idtypeavance
	         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = a.idpersonnel
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id=a.idpersonnel
	 
	) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLELIB" ("ID", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDCATEGORIECLIENTLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDREMISE") AS
SELECT 
	rf.id,
	rf.remise,
	rf.idCategorieClient,
	tp.val AS idCategorieClientlib,
	rf.idProduit,
	ai.libelle,
	rf.cateGorieProduit,
	cti.val AS CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,
	rf.idPoint,
	p.val AS idPointLib,
	rf.idRemise
FROM RemiseFille rf
LEFT JOIN typeclient tp ON tp.id = rf.idCategorieClient
LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai ON ai.id = rf.idProduit
LEFT JOIN point p ON p.id = rf.idPoint
LEFT JOIN categorieingredient cti ON cti.id = rf.CATEGORIEPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLEMERE" ("ID", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "IDPOINT", "IDREMISE", "NOM", "DATY", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLEMERELIB" ("IDMERE", "IDFILLE", "DATY", "NOM", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDCATEGORIECLIENTLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB") AS
SELECT 
r.id AS idmere,
rf.id AS idfille,
r.daty,
r.nom,
r.datedebut,
r.datefin,
r.etat,
rf.remise,
rf.idCategorieClient,
tp.val AS idCategorieClientLib,
rf.idProduit,
ai.libelle AS idProduitLib,
rf.cateGorieProduit,
cti.val AS cateGorieProduitLib,
rf.idPoint,
p.val AS idPointLib
FROM Remise r 
LEFT JOIN RemiseFille rf ON r.id = rf.idRemise
LEFT JOIN typeclient tp ON tp.id = rf.idCategorieClient
LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai ON ai.id = rf.idProduit

LEFT JOIN categorieingredient cti ON cti.id = rf.CATEGORIEPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLEMEREVISE" ("ID", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "IDPOINT", "IDREMISE", "NOM", "DATY", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "NOM", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	rem.ID , 
	rem.DATY , 
	rem.NOM, 
	rem.DATEDEBUT , 
	rem.DATEFIN , 
	rem.ETAT,
	CASE
		WHEN rem.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
		WHEN rem.ETAT = 0

		WHEN rem.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉE'
	END AS ETATLIB
FROM
	REMISE rem;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISELIB_V" ("ID", "DATY", "NOM", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTCAISSEAVECHEURE" ("ID", "IDCAISSE", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "HEURE") AS

       IDCAISSE,
       MONTANT,
       MONTANTTHEORIQUE,
       TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || NVL(HEURE, '00:00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as DATY,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTCAISSELIB" ("ID", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "DATY", "ETAT", "HEURE", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
r.ID ,
r.IDCAISSE ,
c.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
CAST(r.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANT ,
CAST(r.MONTANTTHEORIQUE AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTHEORIQUE ,
r.DATY ,
r.ETAT ,r.heure,
CASE
	WHEN r.ETAT = 0
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN r.ETAT = 1
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN r.ETAT = 11
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
END AS ETATLIB
FROM REPORTCAISSE r
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID  = r.IDCAISSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTCAISSE_DEVISE" ("ID", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDDEVISE", "ETATLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE" ("ID", "COMPTE", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE") AS
SELECT ce.id, cse.COMPTE, cc.libelle, cse.debit, cse.credit, ce.daty, cc.typecompte,

  and ce.etat = 11 and jrn.id = cse.journal

SELECT ce.id, cse.ANALYTIQUE, cc.libelle, cse.debit, cse.credit, ce.daty, cc.typecompte,
       EXTRACT(MONTH from ce.daty), EXTRACT(YEAR from ce.daty)
from
    compta_sous_ecriture cse, compta_ecriture ce, compta_compte cc, compta_journal jrn
where
    cse.idmere = ce.id and cc.COMPTE = cse.analytique and ce.journal = 'COMP000015'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_ANALYTIQUE" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "DATY", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS
SELECT
    COMPTE,
    LIBELLE,
    CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30,
                         2)),
    CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30,
                          2)),
    TYPECOMPTE,
    daty,
    CHIFFRE3,
    CHIFFRE2
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cse.ANALYTIQUE AS COMPTE,
            cc.libelle,
            sum(cse.debit) AS DEBIT,
            sum(cse.credit) AS CREDIT,
            cc.typecompte,
            cse.daty,
            substr(analytique, 1, 3)|| substr(analytique, 5, 1) AS chiffre3,
            substr(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse,
            compta_compte cc,
            compta_journal jrn
        WHERE
            cc.COMPTE = cse.ANALYTIQUE
          AND cse.etat = 11
          AND cse.JOURNAL = jrn.id
        GROUP BY
            cse.ANALYTIQUE,
            cc.libelle,
            cc.typecompte,
            cse.daty

    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_AUX_V1" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "DATY", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS
SELECT
	COMPTE,
	LIBELLE,
	CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS debit,
	CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS credit,
	TYPECOMPTE,
	daty,
	CHIFFRE3,
	CHIFFRE2
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE AS COMPTE,
		t.NOM AS LIBELLE,
		SUM(cse.debit) AS debit,
		SUM(cse.credit) AS credit,
		cc.typecompte,
		cse.daty,
		CASE
			WHEN SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
			ELSE SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 5, 1)
		END AS CHIFFRE3,
		SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 2) AS CHIFFRE2
	FROM
		compta_sous_ecriture cse
	JOIN compta_compte cc ON
		cc.COMPTE = cse.compte
	JOIN compta_journal jrn ON
		cse.JOURNAL = jrn.id
	JOIN TIERS t ON
		t.id = cse.COMPTE_AUX
	WHERE
		cse.etat = 11
	GROUP BY
		t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE,
		t.NOM,
		cc.typecompte,
		cse.daty

    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_GENERAL" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS

        2)),
    CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30,
        2)),

        SELECT

                WHEN substr(cse.compte, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'

        FROM

          AND cse.etat = 11

        GROUP BY

            cc.libelle,
            cc.typecompte,
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cse.daty),

    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_GENERAL_V1" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "DATY", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_JANVIER" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS
SELECT COMPTE,
       LIBELLE,
       CAST(sum(DEBIT) AS NUMBER(30, 2)),
       CAST(sum(CREDIT) AS NUMBER(30, 2)),
       TYPECOMPTE,
       MOIS,
       ANNEE,
       CHIFFRE3,
       CHIFFRE2
FROM (SELECT cse.COMPTE,
             cc.libelle,
             cse.debit,
             cse.credit,
             cc.typecompte,
             EXTRACT(MONTH from cse.daty)                                      AS MOIS,
             EXTRACT(YEAR from cse.daty)                                       AS ANNEE,
             CASE
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 3 THEN SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 3) || SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 5, 1)
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 1 AND SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
                 ELSE SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 5, 1) END as chiffre3,
             substr(cse.compte, 1, 2)                                          as chiffre2
      from compta_sous_ecriture cse,
           compta_compte cc,
           compta_journal jrn
      where cc.COMPTE = cse.compte
        and cse.journal = 'COMP000015'
        AND cse.etat = 11
        AND jrn.id = cse.journal
      UNION
      SELECT cse.ANALYTIQUE,
             cc.libelle,
             cse.debit                                                                 as debit,
             cse.credit                                                                as credit,
             cc.typecompte,
             EXTRACT(MONTH from cse.daty),
             EXTRACT(YEAR from cse.daty),
             CASE
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 3 THEN SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 3) || SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 5, 1)
                 ELSE SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 5, 1) END as chiffre3,
             substr(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2)                                              as chiffre2
      from compta_sous_ecriture cse,
           compta_compte cc,
           compta_journal jrn
      where cc.COMPTE = cse.analytique
        and cse.journal = 'COMP000015'
        and cse.etat = 11
        and jrn.id = cse.journal)
group by COMPTE, LIBELLE, TYPECOMPTE, MOIS, ANNEE, CHIFFRE3, CHIFFRE2;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONDETAILSMAXDATE" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "DATY", "PU", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "HEURE", "RN") AS

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IDMERE ORDER BY daty DESC) AS rn

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONDETAILS_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "QTE", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "HEURE") AS
SELECT
r.ID,
r.IDMERE,
r.QTE,
r.DATY,
r.IDPRODUIT,
ai.LIBELLE AS libelleproduit,
ai.idCATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieproduit,
r.PU,
r.QTE * r.PU AS  montant,
ai.tva as tva,
cast(r.qte*r.pu*(nvl(ai.tva,0)/100) as number(20,2)) as montantTva,
cast((r.QTE * r.PU)+(r.qte*r.pu*(nvl(ai.tva,0)/100)) as number(20,2)) as montantttc,
ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieproduitlib,
r.heure AS heure
FROM RESERVATIONDETAILS r
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS_LIB ai ON ai.id = r.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONDETAILS_LIBGROUPE" ("ID", "IDMERE", "QTE", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "HEURE") AS
SELECT
min(r.ID) as id,
r.IDMERE,
sum(r.QTE) as qte,
min(r.DATY) as daty,
r.IDPRODUIT,
r.libelleproduit AS libelleproduit,
r.categorieproduit AS categorieproduit,
avg(r.PU) as pu,
sum(r.QTE * r.PU) AS  montant,
avg(r.tva) as tva,
cast(sum(montantTva) as number(20,2)) as montantTva,
cast(sum(montantttc) as number(20,2)) as montantttc,
r.categorieproduitlib AS categorieproduitlib,
min(r.heure) AS heure
FROM RESERVATIONDETAILS_LIB r

group by r.idmere,r.idproduit,r.libelleproduit,r.categorieproduit,r.categorieproduitlib;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONDETSANSCI" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "DATY", "PU", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT") AS
SELECT
	rd."ID",
	rd."IDMERE",
	rd."IDPRODUIT",
	rd."QTE",
	rd."DATY",
	rd."PU",
	rd."REMARQUE",
	rd."ETAT",
	r."IDCLIENT"
FROM
	reservationDetails rd
	JOIN RESERVATION r
	ON rd.IDMERE = r.ID
WHERE
	rd.idmere NOT IN (
	SELECT
		c.reservation
	FROM
		checkin c
	WHERE
		c.etat >= 11

SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONSIMPLE" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATION_LIB" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "PAYE", "RESTEAPAYER") AS
SELECT 
r.id,
r.idClient,
c.NOM AS idclientlib,
r.daty,
r.remarque,
r.etat,
CASE 
	WHEN r.etat = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN r.etat = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN r.etat = 11 
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS etatlib,
rm.montant,
rm.MONTANTTTC,
rm.MONTANTTVA,
mvt.CREDIT as paye,
cast(rm.MONTANTTTC-mvt.CREDIT as number(20,2)) as resteAPayer
FROM RESERVATION r 
LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = r.idClient 
LEFT JOIN reservationmontant rm ON rm.idmere = r.id
left join MOUVEMENTCAISSEGROUPERESA mvt on mvt.IDORIGINE=r.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATION_LIB_AVECMAXDATE" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "PAYE", "RESTEAPAYER", "DATYFINPOTENTIEL") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESRECLAMATIONLIB" ("ID", "IDRECLAMATION", "DATY", "IDTYPE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPELIB", "QTE") AS
SELECT
    r.ID,
    r.IDRECLAMATION,
    r.daty,
    r.idType,
    r.etat,

    CASE r.etat
        WHEN 1  THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Rejete'
        ELSE 'Autre'
        END AS etatLib,

    tr.VAL AS idTypeLib,
    r.qte
FROM resreclamation r
         LEFT JOIN TYPEresRECLAMATION tr
                   ON tr.ID = r.idType;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESSOURCEPARFABCOMPLET_VISEE" ("ID", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPOSTEEFFECTIVE", "IDRESSOURCE", "MATRICULE", "IDOF", "ETAT", "TEMPORAIRE", "IDQUALIFICATIONEFFECTIVE", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDPOSTEDEFAUT", "IDQUALIFICATIONDEFAUT", "TAUXHORAIRE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT 
r."ID",r."IDFABRICATION",r."IDPOSTEEFFECTIVE",r."IDRESSOURCE",r."MATRICULE",r."IDOF",r."ETAT",r."TEMPORAIRE",r."IDQUALIFICATIONEFFECTIVE",r."IDCATEGORIE",r."IDPOSTEDEFAUT",r."IDQUALIFICATIONDEFAUT",r."TAUXHORAIRE",r."HS",r."MN",r."JF",r."HD",r."IF",r."ETATLIB"
FROM  ressourceParFabricationComplet r 
WHERE r.etat = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPOSTEDEFAUT", "IDRESSOURCE", "MATRICULE", "IDOF", "ETAT", "TEMPORAIRE", "IDQUALIFICATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDPOSTE", "IDPOSTELIB", "IDQUALIFICATIONEFFECTIVE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETATLIB", "IDRESSOURCELIB") AS
SELECT
    r.id,
    r.daty,
    r.idFabrication,
    r.idPoste AS idPosteDefaut,
    r.idRessource,
    p.matricule,
    f.IDOF,
    r.etat ,
    p.TEMPORAIRE,
    p.IDQUALIFICATION AS IdQualification,
    c.IDCATEGORIE,
    c.idPoste ,
    po.VAL AS idPostelib,
    p.IDQUALIFICATION AS IdQualificationEffective,
    CAST(c.montant/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS tauxhoraire,
    h.HS ,
    h.MN ,
    h.JF ,
    h.HD ,
    h.IF ,
    CASE
        WHEN r.etat = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN r.etat = 1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN r.etat = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS etatlib,
    p.MATRICULE AS idRessourcelib
FROM ressourceParFabrication r
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c
                   ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = r.IDQUALIFICATION
                       AND c.IDCATEGORIE = p.IDCATEGORIE
                       AND (
                          (c.REMARQUE IS NULL)
                              OR (c.REMARQUE = r.IDRESSOURCE)
                          ) AND c.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = r.idFabrication
         LEFT JOIN heureSupFabrication h ON h.idRessParFab = r.id
         LEFT JOIN POSTE po ON po.id =  c.idPoste;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESSOURCEPARFAB_CPL_RECTIF" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPOSTEDEFAUT", "IDRESSOURCE", "MATRICULE", "IDPOSTE", "IDPOSTELIB", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	    r.id,
	    r.daty,
	    r.idFabrication,
	    r.idPoste AS idPosteDefaut,
	    r.idRessource,
	    p.MATRICULE,
	    r.IDPOSTE,
	    poste.val as idPosteLib,
	    CASE
	        WHEN r.etat = 0
	            THEN 'ANNULEE'
	        WHEN r.etat = 1
	            THEN 'CREEE'
	        WHEN r.etat = 11
	            THEN 'VISEE'
	        END AS etatlib
	FROM ressourceParFabrication r
	         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
	         LEFT JOIN POSTE poste ON poste.id = r.IDPOSTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESULTATFABRICATION" ("ID", "IDOFFILLE", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QTEINGREDIENTS", "IDLIGNE", "DATY", "ENTREEDECHET") AS
SELECT
    OFF.IDMERE AS ID,
    OFF.ID AS IDOFFILLE,
    F.ID AS IDFABRICATION,
    OFF.IDINGREDIENTS AS IDPRODUIT,
    OFF.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    OFF.QTE AS QTE,
    FF.IDINGREDIENTS,
    FF.QTE AS QTEINGREDIENTS,
    M.IDLIGNE,
    F.DATY,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ENTREE)
              FROM MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE WHERE IDFAB = F.ID AND ENTREE > 0 and CATEGORIEINGREDIENT ='Dechets'
             ),0) AS ENTREEDECHET
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE FF
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION F ON F.ID = FF.IDMERE
         LEFT JOIN OFFILLELIBSTOCK OFF ON OFF.ID = F.IDOFFILLE
         LEFT JOIN MACHINE M ON M.ID = FF.IDMACHINE
WHERE F.ETAT = 11 AND OFF.IDINGREDIENTS IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RETRAIT_FRAIS_MEDICAUX_ANALYSE" ("DIRECTION", "DIRECTIONLIB", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "DATEVAL", "DATEDESC", "DATELIB", "GAIN", "DEPENSE") AS
SELECT
    ld.id AS direction,
    ld.val AS directionlib,
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN TO_DATE('01-12-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        ELSE TO_DATE('01-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') || '-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        END AS dateval,
    pe.annee || '-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') AS datedesc,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 1 THEN 'Janvier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 3 THEN 'Mars'
        WHEN pe.mois = 4 THEN 'Avril'
        WHEN pe.mois = 5 THEN 'Mai'
        WHEN pe.mois = 6 THEN 'Juin'
        WHEN pe.mois = 7 THEN 'Juillet'
        WHEN pe.mois = 8 THEN 'Aout'
        WHEN pe.mois = 9 THEN 'Septembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 10 THEN 'Octobre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 11 THEN 'Novembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 12 THEN 'Decembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN '13 eme'
        ELSE NULL
        END || '-' || pe.annee AS datelib,
    SUM(pe.gain) AS gain,
    NVL(SUM(rf.montant), 0) AS depense
FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pf ON pf.id = pe.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id = pf.direction
         LEFT JOIN retrait_frais_medicaux rf
                   ON pe.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM rf.daty)
                       AND pe.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rf.daty)
                       AND rf.etat >= 11
WHERE pe.idelementpaie NOT LIKE '%PR000FRM%'
GROUP BY
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    ld.id,
    ld.val;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RETRAIT_FRAIS_MEDICAUX_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPERSONNEL", "DESCRIPTION", "MONTANT", "ETAT", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "ETATLIB", "MATRICULE") AS
SELECT rfm.id,
       rfm.daty,
       pipl.id AS idpersonnel,
       rfm.description,
       rfm.montant,
       rfm.etat,
       (pipl.nom || ' ') || pipl.prenom AS idpersonnellib,
       CASE
           WHEN rfm.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE(E)'
           WHEN rfm.etat = 10 THEN 'VALIDE(E)'
           WHEN rfm.etat >= 11 THEN 'VISE(E)'
           ELSE NULL
           END AS etatlib,
       pipl.matricule
FROM retrait_frais_medicaux rfm
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl ON rfm.idpersonnel = pipl.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RETRAIT_FRAIS_MEDICAUX_RESTE" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPERSONNEL", "DESCRIPTION", "MONTANT", "ETAT", "RESTE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RISTOURNELIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCLIENT", "DATY", "DATEDEBUTRISTOURNE", "DATEFINRISTOURNE", "IDORIGINE", "ETAT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS

       SQ.DESIGNATION,
       SQ.IDCLIENT,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.DATEDEBUTRISTOURNE,
       SQ.DATEFINRISTOURNE,
       SQ.IDORIGINE,
       SQ.ETAT,
       SQ.IDCLIENTLIB,
       SQ.ETATLIB,
       (
           id || ' | ' || designation || ' | ' || SQ.IDCLIENTLIB
           ) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (SELECT R.ID,
             R.DESIGNATION,
             R.IDCLIENT,
             R.DATY,
             R.DATEDEBUTRISTOURNE,
             R.DATEFINRISTOURNE,
             R.IDORIGINE,
             R.ETAT,
             C.NOM   AS IDCLIENTLIB,
             CASE
                 WHEN R.ETAT = 0
                     THEN 'ANNULÉE'
                 WHEN R.ETAT = 1
                     THEN 'CRÉÉE'
                 WHEN R.ETAT = 11
                     THEN 'VISÉE'

      FROM RISTOURNE R
               LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON R.IDCLIENT = C.ID) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SESSION_FORMATION_LIB" ("ID", "IDACTIONFORMATION", "IDACTIONFORMATIONLIB", "INTITULE", "REFERENCE", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "NBHEUREPREVUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATIONDEMANDE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTYPEDEMANDE", "TITRE", "HORAIRENORMAL", "HEUREDEPART", "HEUREARRIVE", "IDTYPEABSENCE", "MOTIF", "NUMERO", "DESCE", "ETAT", "DATY", "DUREE", "DATEDEPART", "DATERETOUR", "OBSERVATION", "REMARQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEUREHISTORIQUE", "VALETATHIERARCHIE", "RANG") AS
SELECT d.id,
       d.idpersonnel,
       d.idtypedemande,
       d.titre,
       d.horairenormal,
       d.heuredepart,
       d.heurearrive,
       d.idtypeabsence,
       d.motif,
       d.numero,

       BC.QUANTITE - nvl(AB.qte_livre,0) AS QTE_reste

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_DEPENSES" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.COMPTE,SQ.SERVICE,SQ.MOIS,SQ.ANNEE,SQ.MOISLIB,SQ.BUDGET,SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,SQ.PAIEMENT,SQ.RESTEAPAYER,SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SERVICE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOIS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANNEE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOISLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(BUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTFACTURE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PAIEMENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(RESTEAPAYER),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTFACTUREBUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         select
	             '-' as id,
	             bdsv.COMPTE,
	             IDSERVICELIB as service,
	             bdsv.mois,
	             bdsv.annee,
	             bdsv.moislib,
	             bdsv.depenses as budget,
	             ffc.montant as montantfacture,
	             ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
	             ffc.resteapayer,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
	         from budget_depense_sum_view bdsv
	                  left join (
	             select
	                 SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
	                 mois,
	                 annee,
	                 SERVICE,
	                 sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
	                 sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
	                 sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
	             from facturefournisseurfille_paye ffp
	                      cross join (select distinct COMPTE from budget_depense_sum_view_budget) bdsv_inner
	             where SUBSTR(ffp.compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
	             group by SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee, SERVICE
	         ) ffc
	                            on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
	                                and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
	                                and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
	                                and ffc.SERVICE = bdsv.SERVICE
	     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_DEPENSES_VIDE" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "ANNEE", "MOISDEBUT", "MOISDEBUTLIB", "MOISFIN", "MOISFINLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT") AS
select id, compte, service, annee, 6 as moisdebut,moisdebutlib, 8 as moisfin,moisfinlib, budget, montantfacture, paiement, resteapayer, ECARTFACTUREBUDGET, ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT from
	    (select ID,
	            COMPTE,
	            SERVICE,
	            ANNEE,
	            sum(nvl(BUDGET, 0)) as budget,
	            sum(nvl(MONTANTFACTURE, 0)) as montantfacture,
	            sum(nvl(PAIEMENT, 0)) as paiement,
	            SUM(nvl(RESTEAPAYER, 0)) as resteapayer,
	            SUM(nvl(ECARTFACTUREBUDGET, 0)) as ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
	            SUM(nvl(ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT, 0)) as ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT,
	            TO_CHAR(
	                    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(6, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
	                    'FMMonth',
	                    'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
	            ) AS moisdebutlib,
	            TO_CHAR(
	                    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(8, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
	                    'FMMonth',
	                    'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
	            ) AS moisfinlib
	     from situation_budget_depenses where mois between 6 and 8 group by ID, COMPTE, SERVICE, ANNEE);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_RECETTES" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.SERVICE,
       SQ.MOIS,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       SQ.MOISLIB,
       SQ.BUDGET,
       SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,
       SQ.PAIEMENT,
       SQ.RESTEAPAYER,
       SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
       SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT
FROM (
  select
    '-' as id,
    bdsv.COMPTE,
    IDSERVICELIB as service,
    bdsv.mois,
    bdsv.annee,
    bdsv.moislib,
    bdsv.depenses as budget,
    ffc.montant as montantfacture,
    ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
    ffc.resteapayer,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW bdsv
    left join (
        select
            SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
            mois,
            annee,
            sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
            sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
            sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
        from VENTE_DETAILS_PAYE ffp
        cross join (select distinct COMPTE from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW) bdsv_inner
        where SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
        group by SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee
    ) ffc
    on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
        and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
        and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_RECETTES_VIDE" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "ANNEE", "MOISDEBUT", "MOISDEBUTLIB", "MOISFIN", "MOISFINLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.SERVICE,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       SQ.MOISDEBUT,
       SQ.MOISDEBUTLIB,
       SQ.MOISFIN,
       SQ.MOISFINLIB,
       SQ.BUDGET,
       SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,
       SQ.PAIEMENT,
       SQ.RESTEAPAYER,
       SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
       SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT
FROM (
select id, compte, service, annee, 6 as moisdebut,moisdebutlib, 8 as moisfin,moisfinlib, budget, montantfacture, paiement, resteapayer, ECARTFACTUREBUDGET, ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT from
(select ID,
    COMPTE,
    SERVICE,
    ANNEE,
    sum(nvl(BUDGET, 0)) as budget,
    sum(nvl(MONTANTFACTURE, 0)) as montantfacture,
    sum(nvl(PAIEMENT, 0)) as paiement,
    SUM(nvl(RESTEAPAYER, 0)) as resteapayer,
    SUM(nvl(ECARTFACTUREBUDGET, 0)) as ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
    SUM(nvl(ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT, 0)) as ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT,
    TO_CHAR(
        TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(6, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
        'FMMonth',
        'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisdebutlib,
    TO_CHAR(
        TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(8, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
        'FMMonth',
        'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisfinlib
    from SITUATION_BUDGET_RECETTES where mois between 6 and 8 group by ID, COMPTE, SERVICE, ANNEE)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_SALAIRE_AUTRE" ("IDPERSONNEL", "IDEDITION", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "HEURESUPP30NI", "HEURESUPP30I", "HEURESUPP50NI", "HEURESUPP50I", "MAJNUIT", "MAJFERIE", "MAJWEEKEND", "ABBATEMENT") AS
SELECT
    idpersonnel,
    idedition,
    mois,
    annee,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000130'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp30ni,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000130I' THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp30i,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000150'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp50ni,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000150I'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp50i,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000221' THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majnuit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000222'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majferie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000223'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majweekend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR000181'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS abbatement
FROM PAIE_EDITION pe
GROUP BY
    idpersonnel,idedition,mois,annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_SALAIRE_COMPLET" ("MATRICULE", "NOM", "ID", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "IDEDITION", "SALAIRE", "HS_M", "INDEM", "ANCIEN", "PRIME", "AUTRES", "TOTAL", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "IRSA_E", "IRSA_S", "AV_SPE", "AUTRES2", "A_PAYER", "HEURESUPP30NI", "HEURESUPP30I", "HEURESUPP50NI", "HEURESUPP50I", "MAJNUIT", "MAJFERIE", "MAJWEEKEND", "ABBATEMENT", "MOISLIB") AS
SELECT se.MATRICULE,se.NOM,(se.ID||'//'||sa.idedition) AS id,se.MOIS,se.ANNEE,se.IDEDITION,se.SALAIRE,se.HS_M,se.INDEM,se.ANCIEN,se.PRIME,se.AUTRES,se.TOTAL,se.CNAPS,se.OSTIE,se.IRSA_E,se.IRSA_S,se.AV_SPE,se.AUTRES2,se.A_PAYER,sa.heuresupp30ni,heuresupp30i,heuresupp50ni,heuresupp50i,majnuit,majferie,majweekend,abbatement,
	       CASE se.MOIS
	           WHEN 1 THEN 'Janvier'
	           WHEN 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
	           WHEN 3 THEN 'Mars'
	           WHEN 4 THEN 'Avril'
	           WHEN 5 THEN 'Mai'
	           WHEN 6 THEN 'Juin'
	           WHEN 7 THEN 'Juillet'
	           WHEN 8 THEN 'Aout'
	           WHEN 9 THEN 'Septembre'
	           WHEN 10 THEN 'Octobre'
	           WHEN 11 THEN 'Novembre'
	           WHEN 12 THEN 'Decembre'
	           END AS MOISLIB
	FROM SITUATION_SALAIRE_EDITION se
	         LEFT JOIN SITUATION_SALAIRE_AUTRE sa
	                   ON se.idedition =sa.idedition
	                       AND se.id = sa.idpersonnel;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_SALAIRE_EDITION" ("MATRICULE", "NOM", "ID", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "IDEDITION", "SALAIRE", "HS_M", "INDEM", "ANCIEN", "PRIME", "AUTRES", "TOTAL", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "IRSA_E", "IRSA_S", "AV_SPE", "AUTRES2", "A_PAYER") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_SALAIRE_EDITION_DIST" ("ID", "IDEDITION", "NBENFANT", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "PERSONNEL", "FONCTION", "IDFONCTION", "CLASSIFICATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDDIRECTION", "DIRECTION", "SECTION", "SECTION_NUMERO", "SECTION_LIBELLE", "SALAIRE", "SALAIREBRUTE", "HEUREMOIS", "HEUREPRESENCE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "SALAIREMOIS", "HEURESUP", "RAPPEL", "RETENUABSC", "PRIME", "CONGEPAYER", "PREAVIS", "NETPAYER", "NETPAYERARR", "INDAMDIVFIXE", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "NETIMPOSABLE", "NETIMPOSABLEARR", "IRSA", "IRSANET", "ALLOCATION", "AVANCESALAIRE", "AVANCEEXCEP", "ANNEE", "MOIS") AS
SELECT DISTINCT
    lp.ID,
    pe.idedition AS idedition,
    pip.nbenfant,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.NOM) AS nom,
    trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.PRENOM) AS prenom,
    trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.NOM)
        || ' '
        || trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.PRENOM) AS personnel,
    pf.desce AS fonction,
    pf.id AS idfonction,
    pc.VAL AS classification,
    pc.id AS idcategorie,
    ld.ID AS iddirection,
    ld.VAL AS direction,
    ls.ID AS SECTION,
    ls.CODE_SERVICE AS section_numero,
    ls.libelle AS section_libelle,
    nvl(SALAIREDEBASE.salairedebase, 0) AS salaire,
    nvl(totalgain.gain,0) as salairebrute,
    173.33 as heuremois,
    nvl(poi.HEURENORMAL, 0) AS heurepresence,
    nvl(pe.tauxhoraire, 0) AS tauxhoraire,
    nvl(salaire.gain, 0) AS salairemois,
    nvl(heuresup.gain, 0) AS heuresup,
    nvl(rappel.gain, 0) AS rappel,
    nvl(retenuabsc.retenue, 0) AS retenuabsc,
    nvl(prime.gain, 0) AS prime,
    nvl(congepayer.gain, 0) AS congepayer,
    nvl(preavis.gain, 0) AS preavis,
    nvl(netpayer.gain, 0) AS netpayer,
    nvl(netpayerarr.gain, 0) AS netpayerarr,
    nvl(indamdivfixe.gain, 0) AS indamdivfixe,
    nvl(cnaps.retenue, 0) AS cnaps,

    nvl(netimposable.retenue, 0) AS netimposable,
    nvl(netimposablearr.retenue, 0) AS netimposablearr,
    nvl(irsa.retenue, 0) AS irsa,
    nvl(irsanet.retenue, 0) AS irsanet,
    nvl(allocation.gain,0) as allocation,
    nvl(avancesalaire.retenue, 0) AS avancesalaire,
    nvl(avanceexcep.retenue, 0) AS avanceexcep,
    pe.annee,
    pe.mois
FROM -- select * from
     paie_edition pe
         INNER JOIN log_personnel lp ON
         lp.id = pe.idpersonnel
         INNER JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON
         pip.id = pe.idpersonnel
         INNER JOIN log_direction ld ON
         pe.DIRECTION = ld.ID
         INNER JOIN log_service ls ON

         INNER JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE pc ON

         INNER JOIN paie_fonction pf ON

         INNER JOIN POINTAGE poi ON

         LEFT JOIN (

         LEFT JOIN (

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SOLDE_CONGE_PERS" ("ID", "CONGEDROIT", "CONGEPRIS", "CONGERESTE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "MATRICULE", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    pip.id,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(mvt.plus, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congedroit,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congepris,
    CAST(
            SUM(NVL(mvt.plus, 0)) - SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS congereste,
    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTLib
FROM PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTABSENCE mvt
                   ON mvt.IDPERSONNEL = pip.id
                       AND mvt.IDTYPE = 'TYP000004'
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel_v log
                   ON log.id = pip.id
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT dep
                   ON dep.id = pip.IDDEPARTEMENT
GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SOLDE_FORMATION_SYNDICALE" ("ID", "ANNEE", "CONGEDROIT", "CONGEPRIS", "CONGERESTE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "MATRICULE", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    pip.id,
    NVL(mvt.ANNEE, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)) AS annee,
    CAST(15 AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congedroit,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congepris,

    CAST(
            15 - SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS congereste,

    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTLib

FROM PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip

         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTABSENCE mvt
                   ON mvt.IDPERSONNEL = pip.id
                       AND mvt.IDTYPE = 'TYPCOL0005'

         LEFT JOIN log_personnel_v log
                   ON log.id = pip.id

         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT dep
                   ON dep.id = pip.IDDEPARTEMENT

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    mvt.ANNEE,
    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SOUSECRITURENR" ("ID", "LIBELLEPIECE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE") AS
SELECT
    cse.ID,
    cse.LIBELLEPIECE,
    cse.DEBIT,
    cse.CREDIT,
    cse.DATY,
    cai.ID as IDCAISSE,
    cse.COMPTE
FROM COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse
         LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ce ON ce.ID = cse.idmere
         LEFT join CAISSE cai on cai.COMPTE=cse.COMPTE
WHERE
    cse.ID NOT IN (
        SELECT rpf.idSousEcriture
        FROM RAPPROCHEMENTBC rpf join RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERE rp on rpf.idmere=rp.id
        WHERE rpf.idSousEcriture IS NOT NULL AND rp.ETAT>=11
    )
AND ce.JOURNAL in (select id from COMPTA_JOURNAL cj where cj.COMPTE like '512%') AND cse.COMPTE like '5%';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STAT_DEPENSE_CAT" ("DATY", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB", "MOISINT", "MOISSTRING", "ANNEE", "DEPENSE") AS
SELECT
	    ffc.daty,
	    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,
	    cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB,
	    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ffc.daty) as MOISINT,
	    TRIM(TO_CHAR(ffc.daty, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH')) AS MOISSTRING,
	    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ffc.daty) as ANNEE,
	    CAST(sum(ffc.montant) / 1000000 AS NUMERIC(30,2)) AS depense
	FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPL  ffc
	         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR fc on fc.id = ffc.idfacturefournisseur and etat >= 11
	         JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ffc.IDPRODUIT = ai.id
	         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT  = cat.id
	GROUP BY
	    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
	    ffc.daty,
	    cat.val
	ORDER BY ANNEE, MOISINT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STAT_DEPENSE_MAT_PREM" ("ANNEE", "MOISINT", "MOIS", "ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEPENSE") AS
SELECT 
	EXTRACT (YEAR FROM f.DATY) AS annee,
	EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY) AS moisInt,
	TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS mois,
	ff.idproduit AS id,
	ai.LIBELLE AS designation,
	CAST(nvl(sum(ff.qte*ff.pu),0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS depense
FROM 
FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f 
ON f.ID = ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai 
ON ai.ID = ff.idproduit
WHERE f.etat >=11
GROUP BY 
	ff.idproduit, 
	ai.LIBELLE,
	EXTRACT (YEAR FROM f.DATY),
	EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY),
	TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH')
ORDER BY EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY) asc;

                                                                                                                                             sum(montantentree) as montanentree, sum(montantsortie) as montantsortie,idmere,'-' as id, sdf.categorieingredient, sdf.categorieingredientlib

       sum(montantentree) as montanentree, sum(montantsortie) as montantsortie,idmere,'-' as id, sdf.categorieingredient, sdf.categorieingredientlib
from STOCKETDEPENSEFAB sdf
group by sdf.IDPRODUIT,id, sdf.categorieingredient, sdf.categorieingredientlib,idmere;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STOCKETDEPENSEFAB" ("IDOBJET", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "IDMERE", "ID", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS
select idobjet,IDPRODUIT,cast(entree as number(30,5)) as entree,cast(sortie as number(30,5)) as sortie,cast(pu as number(30,5)) as pu,
       cast(montantentree as number(30,5)) as montantentree,cast(montantsortie as number(30,5)) as montantsortie,IDMERE,id, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from STOCKETDEPENSEFABNC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STOCKETDEPENSEFABNC" ("IDOBJET", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "IDMERE", "ID", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS
select mvt.IDOBJET, fille.IDPRODUIT,cast(sum(ENTREE) as number(15,2)) as entree, cast(sum(SORTIE) as number(15,2)) as sortie, cast(avg(fille.pu) as number(30,2)) as pu,
cast(nvl(avg(fille.pu)*sum(entree),0) as number(30,3)) as montantentree,cast(nvl(avg(fille.pu)*sum(sortie),0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie,ofille.IDMERE,ofille.id, cat.id AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from MVTSTOCKFILLE fille
left join MvtStockLib mvt on fille.IDMVTSTOCK=mvt.ID
left join FABRICATION fab on mvt.IDOBJET=fab.ID
left join OFFILLE ofille on fab.IDOFFILLE=ofille.ID
left join AS_INGREDIENTS ai on fille.IDPRODUIT=ai.id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON cat.id = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT 
where mvt.ETAT>=11  and ai.COMPOSE=0
group by fille.IDPRODUIT,mvt.IDOBJET,ofille.IDMERE,ofille.id,ai.COMPOSE, cat.id, cat.val
union all
select c.IDFABRICATION as idobjet,c.IDINGREDIENTS as IDPRODUIT,cast(0 as number(15,2)) as entree,cast(1 as number (15,2)) as sortie,cast(c.montant as number(30,2)) as pu,cast(0 as number(30,3)) as montantentree,cast(nvl(sum(c.montant),0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie
,ofile.IDMERE,ofile.id, cat.id AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from chargemontant c
left join fabrication fabb on c.IDFABRICATION=fabb.id
left join OFFILLE ofile on fabb.IDOFFILLE=ofile.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON c.IDINGREDIENTS = ai.id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON cat.id = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT 
where c.etat>=11 group by c.IDFABRICATION, c.IDINGREDIENTS,ofile.IDMERE,ofile.id, cat.id, cat.val,c.montant
UNION all
select 
    rsfab.IDFABRICATION as idobjet,
    'IG000364' as IDPRODUIT,
    cast(0 as number(15,2)) as entree,
    CAST(
        NVL(
            CASE 
                WHEN h.TEMPORAIRE = 0 THEN h.MN + h.JF + h.HD + h.IF + h.HEURENORMALE
                ELSE h.HS + h.MN + h.JF + h.HD + h.IF
            END,
        0) AS NUMBER(15,2)
    ) AS sortie,
    cast(rsfab.TAUXHORAIRE as number(30,2)) as pu,
    cast(0 as number(30,3)) as montantentree,
    cast(nvl(h.MONTANT, 0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie,
    off.IDMERE,
    off.ID,
    'CATING000001' as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    'Charge personnelle' as CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from HEURESUPFABRICATION h
left join RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET rsfab ON rsfab.IDRESSOURCE = h.IDRESSPARFAB
left join FABRICATION f on rsfab.idfabrication = f.ID
left join OFFILLE off on f.IDOFFILLE = off.ID
where h.ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STOCKETDEPENSEFABTHE" ("IDOBJET", "IDPRODUIT", "DESIGNATION", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "IDMERE", "ID", "QTETH", "PUTH", "MONTTH", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT") AS
SELECT
    sed.IDOBJET,
    sed.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.libelle AS designation,
    cast(sed.ENTREE as number(30,5)) as entree ,
    cast(sed.SORTIE as number(30,5)) as sortie,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0)
                END
        as number(30,2)) AS PU,
    cast(sed.MONTANTENTREE as number(30,5)) as MONTANTENTREE,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu * sed.SORTIE
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0) * sed.SORTIE
                END
        as number(30,2)) as MONTANTSORTIE ,
    sed.IDMERE,
    sed.ID,
    CAST(nvl(recFab.QUANTITE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,
                                           10)) AS qteTh,
    CAST(nvl(recFab.QTEAV, sed.pu) AS NUMBER(30,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ST_INGREDIENTSVENTEPOS" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "TVA", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "LIBELLECOMPOSANT", "COULEUR", "TAILLE", "CODEBARRE", "REFERENCE", "CODEGROS", "PVGROS", "UNITELIB", "DESIGNATION", "TYPESTOCK") AS
SELECT
    ai.ID,
    ai.LIBELLE as libelle,
    ai.SEUIL,
    ai.UNITE,
    ai.QUANTITEPARPACK,
    ai.PU,
    ai.ACTIF,
    ai.PHOTO,
    ai.CALORIE,
    ai.DURRE,
    ai.COMPOSE,
    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    ai.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ai.DATY,
    ai.QTELIMITE,
    ai.PV,
    ai.LIBELLEVENTE,
    ai.SEUILMIN,
    ai.SEUILMAX,
    ai.PUACHATUSD,
    ai.PUACHATEURO,
    ai.PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,
    ai.PUVENTEUSD,
    ai.PUVENTEEURO,
    ai.PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE,
    ai.ISVENTE,
    ai.ISACHAT,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,
    ai.COMPTE_ACHAT,
    ai.TVA,
    1 AS taux,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE AS compte,
    ai.LIBELLE || ' ' || ai.COULEUR || ' ' || ai.TAILLE AS libellecomposant,
    ai.COULEUR,
    ai.TAILLE,
    ai.codebarre,
    ai.REFERENCE,
    ai.codegros,
    ai.pvgros,
    u.VAL AS UNITELIB,
    CONCAT(concat(ai.libelle,' - '),u.val) AS designation,
    ai.TYPESTOCK
FROM
    AS_INGREDIENTS ai
        LEFT JOIN AS_RECETTE ar ON ar.IDPRODUITS = ai.ID
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS cps ON cps.ID  = ar.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.unite=u.id
where AI.PV != 0 AND ai.ACTIF = 1
GROUP BY
    ai.ID,
    ai.LIBELLE,
    ai.SEUIL,
    ai.UNITE,
    ai.QUANTITEPARPACK,
    ai.PU,
    ai.ACTIF,
    ai.PHOTO,
    ai.CALORIE,
    ai.DURRE,
    ai.COMPOSE,
    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    ai.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ai.DATY,
    ai.QTELIMITE,
    ai.PV,
    ai.LIBELLEVENTE,
    ai.SEUILMIN,
    ai.SEUILMAX,
    ai.PUACHATUSD,
    ai.PUACHATEURO,
    ai.PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ST_INGREDIENTSVENTEPOS_REM" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "TVA", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "LIBELLECOMPOSANT", "COULEUR", "TAILLE", "CODEBARRE", "REFERENCE", "CODEGROS", "PVGROS", "UNITELIB", "DESIGNATION", "REMISE", "PVREMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDPOINT", "IDREMISEFILLE", "IDREMISE", "REMISENOM", "DATYREMISE", "DATEDEBUTREMISE", "DATEFINREMISE", "TYPESTOCK") AS
SELECT

    ai.PU,
    ai.ACTIF,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVICHAMBREFROIDE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUF", "IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUFLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVIJOURNALIER_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFERME", "IDLOT", "IDFERMELIB", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS

       m.VAL    AS IDFERMELIB,
       l.NOMLOT AS IDLOTLIB,
       so.val AS idsouchelib,
       s.ETAT AS ETAT,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_DAY" ("JOUR", "AVG_HS_PER_DAY", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS

    dateFabrication AS jour,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_day,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,

GROUP BY dateFabrication, IDDEPARTEMENT, departementLib
ORDER BY dateFabrication;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_MONTH" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "AVG_HS_PER_MONTH", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication) AS mois,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_month,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL
GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication),

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_MONTH_LIB" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "MONTHLIB", "AVG_HS_PER_MONTH", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_YEAR" ("ANNEE", "AVG_HS_PER_YEAR", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TABLEAUBORDBC" ("PRODUIT", "MONTANT", "PU", "QUANTITE", "REMISE", "TVA", "UNITE", "QTEOF", "QTEOFRESTANTE", "QTEFAB", "QTEFABRESTANTE", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "DATY") AS
SELECT
 	bcf.PRODUIT,
    CAST(avg(bcf.MONTANT) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montant,
    CAST(avg(bcf.PU) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as pu,
    CAST(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) AS NUMBER(20,5)) as quantite,
    CAST(avg(bcf.REMISE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as remise,
    CAST(avg(bcf.TVA) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as tva,
    ing.UNITE as unite,
    CAST(nvl(avg(o.QTE),0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEOF,
    CAST(NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(o.QTE),0), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEOFRESTANTE,

    CAST(nvl(avg(f.QTE),0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEFAB,
    CAST(NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(f.QTE),0), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEFABRESTANTE,

    CAST(AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE, 0)) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTELIVRE,
	CAST(NVL(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) - AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE,0)), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTENONLIVRE,
	ing.LIBELLE as libelleProduit,
	bc.DATY 

FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf

LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc ON bc.ID = bcf.IDBC 

LEFT JOIN OfGroupByIdbc o ON o.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID


LEFT JOIN fabrGroupByIdbc f ON f.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID

LEFT JOIN BLGroupByIdbc abcf ON abcf.IDBC_FILLE = bcf.ID

left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=bcf.PRODUIT

GROUP BY
    bcf.PRODUIT,
    ing.LIBELLE, ing.UNITE,bc.DATY;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_LIB" ("ID", "IDTYPECLIENT", "IDINGREDIENT", "DATY", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT TI.ID,
       TI.IDTYPECLIENT,
       TI.IDINGREDIENT,
       TI.DATY,
       TI.PRIXUNITAIRE,
       T.VAL      AS IDTYPECLIENTLIB,
       AI.LIBELLE AS IDINGREDIENTLIB,
       TI.UNITE,
       U.VAL      AS UNITELIB,
       (
           TI.ID || ' | ' || T.VAL || ' | ' || AI.LIBELLE || ' | ' || U.VAL
           )      AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM TARIF_INGREDIENTS TI
         LEFT JOIN TYPECLIENT T
                   ON TI.IDTYPECLIENT = T.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI
                   ON TI.IDINGREDIENT = AI.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE U
                   ON U.ID = TI.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN") AS
WITH ranked_tarifs AS (
    SELECT
        IDINGREDIENT,
        UNITE,
        IDTYPECLIENT,
        CAST(PRIXUNITAIRE AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PRIXUNITAIRE,
        DATY,
        IDMAGASIN,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IDINGREDIENT, UNITE, IDTYPECLIENT, IDMAGASIN ORDER BY DATY DESC) as rn
    FROM TARIF_INGREDIENTS
)
SELECT
    IDINGREDIENT,
    UNITE,
    IDTYPECLIENT,
    PRIXUNITAIRE,
    DATY,
    IDMAGASIN
FROM ranked_tarifs
WHERE rn = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_LIB" ("IDTYPECLIENT", "IDINGREDIENT", "DATY", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "UNITE", "UNITELIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_MN" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "PRIXUNITAIRE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_MNN" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "PRIXUNITAIRE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TAUXABSENTEISME" ("HEURETHEORIQUE", "HEUREABSENCE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TAUXABSENCE", "MOISLIB", "IDDIRECTION") AS
SELECT
    CAST(nb.NBPERSONNELVALIDE * 173.33 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS heuretheorique,
    CAST(NVL(SUM(p.ABSENCE), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS heureabsence,
    p.mois,
    p.ANNEE,
    CAST(
            ROUND(
                    (NVL(SUM(p.ABSENCE), 0) / (nb.NBPERSONNELVALIDE * 173.33)) * 100,
                    2
            ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    ) AS tauxAbsence,
    TO_CHAR(
            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(p.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
            'FMMonth',
            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisLib,
    p.DIRECTION AS iddirection
FROM
    POINTAGE p,
    NB_PERS_VALIDE nb
GROUP BY
    nb.NBPERSONNELVALIDE, p.mois, p.ANNEE, p.DIRECTION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TAUXDECHANGE_MAXDATY" ("IDDEVISE", "TAUX") AS

  tc.IDDEVISE,
  tc.TAUX
FROM
(SELECT
IDDEVISE,
max(DATY) AS  DATY

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TAUXDISPONIBILITEMACHINE" ("IDMACHINE", "NOMMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB", "TAUXDISPONIBILITE") AS
SELECT
    m.IDMACHINE ,
    m.NOMMACHINE ,
    l.ID AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib,
    CASE
        WHEN m2.ECARTJOURS != 0 AND m.MOYENNEDUREE !=0 THEN (m2.ECARTJOURS * 24)/((m2.ECARTJOURS * 24)/m.MOYENNEDUREE)
		ELSE 0
END AS TauxDisponibilite
FROM MOYENNETRAVAUXMACHINE m
LEFT JOIN MOYENNEPANNESTRAVAUX m2
ON m.IDMACHINE = m2.IDMACHINE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
ON m.IDMACHINE = aim.ID
LEFT JOIN LIGNE l
ON aim.IDLIGNE = l.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TEMPSMOYENPANNES" ("IDMACHINE", "NOMMACHINE", "IDTRAVAUX", "DATY", "ECART_JOURS") AS
WITH ECARTS AS (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN ai.id IS NULL THEN aim.id
                ELSE ai.id
            END AS idMachine,
            CASE
                WHEN ai.libelle IS NULL THEN aim.descriptionObjet
                ELSE ai.libelle
            END AS nomMachine,
            t.ID AS IDTRAVAUX,
            t.DATY,
            NVL(
                t.DATY - LAG(t.DATY) OVER (PARTITION BY o.IDINGREDIENTS ORDER BY t.DATY),
                0
            ) AS ECART_JOURS
        FROM TRAVAUX t
        LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE o
            ON t.IDOFFILLE = o.ID
        LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai
            ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = ai.id
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
            ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = aim.id
    )
SELECT "IDMACHINE","NOMMACHINE","IDTRAVAUX","DATY","ECART_JOURS"
FROM ECARTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TEMPSOUVERTURELIB" ("ID", "IDMACHINE", "TEMPS", "CAPACITE", "IDUNITE", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDUNITELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT
    t.ID,t.IDMACHINE,t.TEMPS,t.CAPACITE,t.IDUNITE,
    aim.LIBELLE AS idmachinelib,
    au.VAL as idunitelib,
    
    t.ID || t.IDMACHINE || t.TEMPS || t.CAPACITE || t.IDUNITE ||

FROM tempsouverture t
         LEFT JOIN as_ingredient_maintenance aim

                   ON au.id = t.IDUNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TEST_SITUATION_SALAIRE_EDITION" ("ID", "IDEDITION", "NBENFANT", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "PERSONNEL", "FONCTION", "IDFONCTION", "CLASSIFICATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDDIRECTION", "DIRECTION", "SECTION", "SECTION_NUMERO", "SECTION_LIBELLE", "SALAIRE", "SALAIREBRUTE", "HEUREMOIS", "HEUREPRESENCE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "SALAIREMOIS", "HEURESUP", "RAPPEL", "RETENUABSC", "PRIME", "CONGEPAYER", "PREAVIS", "NETPAYER", "NETPAYERARR", "INDAMDIVFIXE", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "NETIMPOSABLE", "NETIMPOSABLEARR", "IRSA", "IRSANET", "ALLOCATION", "AVANCESALAIRE", "AVANCEEXCEP", "ANNEE", "MOIS") AS
SELECT

    ld.ID AS iddirection,
    ld.VAL AS direction,

    ls.CODE_SERVICE AS section_numero,
    ls.libelle AS section_libelle,
    nvl(SALAIREDEBASE.salairedebase, 0) AS salaire,
    nvl(totalgain.gain,0) as salairebrute,
    173.33 as heuremois,
    nvl(poi.HEURENORMAL, 0) AS heurepresence,
    nvl(pe.tauxhoraire, 0) AS tauxhoraire,
    nvl(salaire.gain, 0) AS salairemois,
    nvl(heuresup.gain, 0) AS heuresup,
    nvl(rappel.gain, 0) AS rappel,
    nvl(retenuabsc.retenue, 0) AS retenuabsc,
    nvl(prime.gain, 0) AS prime,

    nvl(preavis.gain, 0) AS preavis,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TIERS" ("ID", "NOM", "COMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TOUSLESDATE" ("DATY") AS
SELECT
    (TO_DATE('01/01/2000', 'DD/MM/YYYY') + level - 1) AS daty
FROM dual
CONNECT BY level <= 1 + (ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 120) - TO_DATE('01/01/2000', 'DD/MM/YYYY'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEETATVERSEMENT" ("IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT") AS
select IDTRAITE, cast(-2 as number) as etatversement
from MVTINTRACAISSE
where IDTRAITE is not null
  and ETATVERSEMENT = -2
group by IDTRAITE
UNION ALL
select idtraite, cast(11 as number) as etatversement
from MVTINTRACAISSE
where idtraite is not null
  and ETATVERSEMENT = 11
  and IDTRAITE not in
      (select IDTRAITE from MVTINTRACAISSE where IDTRAITE is not null and ETATVERSEMENT = -2 group by IDTRAITE)
group by idtraite;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMENT_PAIE_LIB" ("IDPERSONNEL", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "NETAPAYER", "IDEDITION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "NUMEROCOMPTE") AS
SELECT
    ec.id AS idpersonnel ,
    ec.nom || ' ' || ec.PRENOM AS nomPersonnel,
    ec.MATRICULE ,
    pe.GAIN AS netapayer,
    pe.IDEDITION ,
    ec.MODE_PAIEMENT AS modepaiement,
    ec.BANQUE_NUMERO_COMPTE AS numeroCompte
FROM PAIE_EDITION pe
         LEFT JOIN EMPLOYE_COMPLET ec ON ec.id = pe.IDPERSONNEL
WHERE pe.IDELEMENTPAIE ='PR000210A' AND pe.etat >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTFC" ("ID", "MONTANTENLEVETRAITE") AS
SELECT
    t.ID,
    cast(nvl(sum(f.montant),0) as number(30,2)) AS montantenlevetraite
FROM traite t
         LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENT f ON t.ID = f.ID2
GROUP BY t.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTRESTE" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "MONTANTRESTE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB") AS
SELECT t.ID,
       t.DATY,
       t.TIERS,
       t.BANQUE,
       t.DATEECHEANCE,
       t.ETAT,
       CAST(nvl(t.MONTANT,0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                          AS montant,
       t.ESCOMPTE,
       CAST(nvl(t.TOTAL,0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                            AS total,
       t.REFERENCE,
       CAST((nvl(t.total,0) - nvl(tf.montantenlevetraite, 0)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantreste,
       t.cdclt,
       t.idbanque,
       t.idtypepiece,
       t.typepiece,
       nvl(te.etatversement, 1)                                  as etatversement,
       case
           when te.etatversement = -2 then 'Encaissee'
           when te.etatversement = 11 then 'Versee'
           else
               'Non Versee' end                                  as etatversementlib
FROM TRAITE_LIBMTT t
         LEFT JOIN traitemttfc tf ON tf.id = t.id
         LEFT JOIN traiteetatversement te on te.IDTRAITE = t.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTRESTE_NONVERSEE" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "MONTANTRESTE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE") AS
SELECT ID,DATY,TIERS,BANQUE,DATEECHEANCE,ETAT,MONTANT,ESCOMPTE,TOTAL,REFERENCE,MONTANTRESTE,CDCLT,IDBANQUE FROM (
	SELECT t.ID,t.DATY,t.TIERS,t.BANQUE,t.DATEECHEANCE,t.ETAT,t.MONTANT,t.ESCOMPTE,t.TOTAL,t.REFERENCE,
 (t.total-tf. montantenlevetraite) AS montantreste, t.cdclt, t.idbanque
 FROM TRAITE_LIBMTT t 
 LEFT JOIN traitemttfc tf ON tf.id=t.id
) tmttrst WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT idtraite FROM MVTINTRACAISSE m WHERE m.idtraite IS NOT NULL AND m.ETATVERSEMENT = 11);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_FC" ("ID", "IDTRAITE", "IDFC", "MONTANTFACTURE", "MONTANTJC", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "CODE", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "FACTURECLIENTLIB", "TIERSLIB", "ETATLIB") AS
select
    fc.ID,tl.id AS IDTRAITE,fc.id AS IDFC, FC.MONTANTTTC as MONTANTFACTURE, j.CREDIT as MONTANTJC, pf.MONTANT,fc.DATY,fc.ETAT,'' as CODE,
    tl.tiers,
    tl.banque,
    fc.designation as factureclientlib,
    fc.IDCLIENTLIB as TIERSLIB,
    CASE
        WHEN j.etat = 1
            THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN j.ETAT >= 11
            THEN 'visee'
        WHEN j.ETAT =0
            THEN 'Annulee'
        END AS etatlib
from LIAISONPAIEMENT pf
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE j ON j.ID  = pf.id2
         JOIN traite tl on tl.id = j.idtraite
         left join VENTE_CPL fc on pf.id1  = fc.id;

FROM TRAITE_FC t

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_JC" ("ID", "IDTRAITE", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDJC", "DATESAISIE", "DATEEFFET", "FOLIO", "CAISSE", "NUMPIECE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "REMARQUE", "ETATJC", "TIERS", "IDTYPECHEQUE", "DESIGNATION", "IDORDRE", "IDDEVISE", "IDMODE", "NUMCHEQUE", "TYPEMVT", "IDPLACEMENT", "IDBANQUE", "IDPLACEMENTVRAI", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATLIB", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "VALCAISSE") AS
select
    jc.id,fc.ID AS idtraite,fc.MONTANT,fc.DATY,fc.ETAT,jc.id AS IDJC,
    jc.daty as datesaisie,
    jc.daty as DATEEFFET,
    '' as FOLIO,
    jc.IDCAISSE as caisse,
    '' as NUMPIECE,
    jc.DESIGNATION as libelle ,
    jc.DEBIT,
    jc.CREDIT,
    jc.DESIGNATION as REMARQUE,
    jc.ETAT AS etatjc,
    jc.IDTIERS as TIERS,
    '' as IDTYPECHEQUE,
    jc.DESIGNATION,
    '' as IDORDRE,
    jc.IDDEVISE,
    '' as IDMODE,
    '' as NUMCHEQUE,
    '' as TYPEMVT,
    '' as IDPLACEMENT,
    fc.BANQUE as IDBANQUE,
    '' as IDPLACEMENTVRAI,
    jc.ETATVERSEMENT,
    case
        when jc.etat = 1 then 'CREEE'
        when jc.etat >= 11 then 'VISEE'
        else '' end                           as etatlib,
    case
        when jc.etatversement = -2 then 'Encaissee'
        when jc.etatversement = 11 then 'Versee'
        else '' end                           as etatversementlib,
    c.VAL AS valcaisse
from MOUVEMENTCAISSE jc
         join traite fc on fc.id = jc.IDTRAITE
          LEFT JOIN caisse c ON c.id = jc.IDCAISSE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "REFERENCE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE") AS
select
    tr.id,
    tr.daty,
    ti.nom as tiers,
    ba.val as banque,
    tr.dateEcheance,
    tr.etat,
    tr.montant,
    tr.REFERENCE,
    '' as CDCLT,
    ba.ID AS idbanque,
    IDTYPEPIECE ,
    tp.val AS typepiece
from traite tr
         left join client ti on tr.tiers = ti.id
         left join banque ba on tr.banque = ba.id
         LEFT JOIN type_piece tp ON tp.id=tr.IDTYPEPIECE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIBC" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "MONTANTRESTE", "REFERENCE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIBESC" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "MONTANTRESTE", "REFERENCE") AS
select ID,DATY,TIERS,BANQUE,DATEECHEANCE,ETAT,MONTANT, etatversement, etatversementlib,MONTANTRESTE,reference from TRAITEMTTRESTE where id in (select idtraite from escompte where etat = 11);

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIBMTT" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE") AS
select t.ID,t.DATY,t.TIERS,t.BANQUE,t.DATEECHEANCE,t.ETAT,t.MONTANT,
       sum(nvl(e.FRAIS,0)) AS escompte,
       montant - sum(nvl(e.FRAIS, 0)) AS total, t.reference,
       t.CDCLT,
       t.idbanque,
       t.idtypepiece,
       t.typepiece
from traite_lib t
         LEFT JOIN ESCOMPTE_LIBV e ON e.IDTRAITE = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.DATY ,t.TIERS ,t.BANQUE ,t.DATEECHEANCE ,t.ETAT ,t.MONTANT,t.REFERENCE, t.CDCLT, t.idbanque,t.idtypepiece,
         t.typepiece;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIBNONENC" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "MONTANTRESTE", "REFERENCE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTPOULETDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDSEXE", "IDFERMEDEPART", "IDBATIMENTDEPART", "IDPARQUETDEPART", "QTE", "IDFERMEARRIVE", "IDBATIMENTARRIVE", "IDPARQUETARRIVE", "IDCONTROLEUR", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "IDSEXELIB", "IDFERMEDEPARTLIB", "IDBATIMENTDEPARTLIB", "IDPARQUETDEPARTLIB", "IDFERMEARRIVELIB", "IDBATIMENTARRIVELIB", "IDPARQUETARRIVELIB", "IDCONTROLEURLIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB") AS
SELECT
    td."ID",td."IDMERE",td."IDSEXE",td."IDFERMEDEPART",td."IDBATIMENTDEPART",td."IDPARQUETDEPART",td."QTE",td."IDFERMEARRIVE",td."IDBATIMENTARRIVE",td."IDPARQUETARRIVE",td."IDCONTROLEUR",td."IDCHAUFFEUR",td."IDVEHICULE",
    s.val                              AS idSexeLib,
    mFermeDep.val                      AS idFermeDepartLib,
    bDep.nomBatiment                   AS idBatimentDepartLib,
    pDep.val                           AS idParquetDepartLib,
    mFermeArr.val                      AS idFermeArriveLib,
    bArr.nomBatiment                   AS idBatimentArriveLib,
    pArr.val                           AS idParquetArriveLib,
    (ctrl.nom || ' ' || ctrl.prenom)   AS idControleurLib,
    (chauf.nom || ' ' || chauf.prenom) AS idChauffeurLib,
    v.val                              AS idVehiculeLib
FROM transfertPouletDetail td
     LEFT JOIN sexe s              ON td.idSexe = s.id
     LEFT JOIN magasin2 mFermeDep  ON td.idFermeDepart = mFermeDep.id
     LEFT JOIN batiment bDep       ON td.idBatimentDepart = bDep.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet pDep        ON td.idParquetDepart = pDep.id
     LEFT JOIN magasin2 mFermeArr  ON td.idFermeArrive = mFermeArr.id
     LEFT JOIN batiment bArr       ON td.idBatimentArrive = bArr.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet pArr        ON td.idParquetArrive = pArr.id
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel ctrl  ON td.idControleur = ctrl.id
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel chauf ON td.idChauffeur = chauf.id
     LEFT JOIN vehicule v          ON td.idVehicule = v.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTPOULET_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLOT", "REMARQUE", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    t."ID",t."DATY",t."IDLOT",t."REMARQUE",
    l.nomLot AS idLotLib,
    so.val AS idsouchelib,
    t.ETAT AS ETAT,
    CASE t.ETAT
        WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
        WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM transfertPoulet t
         LEFT JOIN lot l ON t.idLot = l.id
         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE so ON so.id=l.idsouche;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTSTOCKCPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASINDEPART", "IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB", "IDMAGASINARRIVE", "IDMAGASINARRIVELIB", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOF", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTQUANTITE") AS
SELECT
    t.ID ,
    t.DESIGNATION ,
    t.IDMAGASINDEPART ,
    m.VAL AS IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB,
    t.IDMAGASINARRIVE ,
    m2.VAL AS IDMAGASINARRIVELIB,
    t.DATY ,
    t.ETAT ,
    t.idof,
    CASE
        WHEN t.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉ'
        WHEN t.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉ'
        WHEN t.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉ'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    CAST(tgm.montantQuantite AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantQuantite
FROM TRANSFERTSTOCK t
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = t.IDMAGASINDEPART
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m2 ON m2.ID = t.IDMAGASINARRIVE
         LEFT JOIN TRANSTOCKDETAILSGROUPEMERE tgm ON tgm.IDTRANSFERTSTOCK = t.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTSTOCKDETAILSCPL" ("ID", "IDTRANSFERTSTOCK", "IDTRANSFERTSTOCKLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "PU", "IDSOURCE", "UNITE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXCPL" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV", "IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCE", "INGREDIENTMAINTENANCELIB") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,f.LANCEPAR,f.CIBLE,f.REMARQUE,f.LIBELLE,f.BESOIN,f.DATY,f.idOffille,nvl(f.idof, off.idmere) AS idof,
    p.val AS lanceparLib,
    p2.val AS cibleLib,
    f.etat AS etat,
    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT=1
            THEN 'CRÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=11
            THEN 'VALIDÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=21
            THEN 'ENTAMÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=31
            THEN 'BLOQUÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=41
            THEN 'TERMINÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    f.FABRICATIONPREC,
    f.FABRICATIONSUIV,
    off.idIngredients AS idIngredientMaintenance,
    off.remarque AS ingredientMaintenanceLib
FROM TRAVAUX f
         LEFT JOIN ENTITE p ON p.id = f.lancepar
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p2 ON p2.id = f.cible
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE off ON f.idoffille = off.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXCPLENTAMEE" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "OPERATEUR", "IDUNITELIB", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "OPERATEURLIB") AS
SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDINGREDIENTS,
    f.LIBELLE,
    f.REMARQUE,
    f.IDMERE,
    f.DATYBESOIN,
    f.QTE,
    f.IDUNITE,
    f.PU,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
    p.NOM || ' - ' || p.TELEPHONE AS operateur,
    au.val AS IDUNITELIB,
    f.IDBCFILLE ,
    f.IDMACHINE,
    m.val AS IDMACHINELIB,
    p2.NOM AS OPERATEURLiB
FROM
    TRAVAUXFILLE f
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai ON
        ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON
        p.ID = f.OPERATEUR
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
        au.id = f.IDUNITE
        LEFT JOIN MACHINE m ON

        LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p2 ON
        p2.id = f.OPERATEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXMEREFILLE" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LIBELLE", "DATY", "IDBCFILLE") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUX_RECAP" ("ID", "MONTANTCHARGEEXTERNE", "MONTANTPIECE", "MONTANTMAINDOEUVRE", "MONTANTTOTAL") AS
WITH fac_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantttc, 0)) AS montantChargeExterne
  FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
),
mvt_agg AS (
  SELECT idobjet,
         SUM(NVL(montantsortie, 0)) AS montantPiece
  FROM MVTSTOCKLIB
  GROUP BY idobjet
),
pm_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantreel, 0)) AS montantMainDoeuvre
  FROM RAPPROCHEMENTTRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
)
SELECT t.id,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0) AS montantChargeExterne,
       NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)         AS montantPiece,
       NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantMainDoeuvre,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0)
           + NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)
           + NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantTotal
FROM TRAVAUX t
         LEFT JOIN fac_agg ON fac_agg.idtravaux = t.id
         LEFT JOIN mvt_agg ON mvt_agg.idobjet   = t.id
         LEFT JOIN pm_agg  ON pm_agg.idtravaux  = t.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUET_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLOT", "DISPOMALE", "DISPOFEMELLE", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "ECARTFEMELLE", "ECARTMALE") AS
SELECT t.ID, t.DATY, t.IDLOT, t.DISPOMALE, t.DISPOFEMELLE,
       l.NOMLOT AS IDLOTLIB,
       s.val AS idsouchelib,
       t.etat AS etat,
       CASE
           WHEN t.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CRÉÉ'
           WHEN t.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       NVL(t.DISPOFEMELLE - (SELECT SUM(d.QTE)
            FROM TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUETDETAIL d
            WHERE d.IDMERE = t.ID
              AND d.IDQUALITE = 'QP000001'
              AND d.IDSEXE = '0'), 0) AS ecartFemelle,
       NVL(t.DISPOMALE - (SELECT SUM(d.QTE)
            FROM TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUETDETAIL d
            WHERE d.IDMERE = t.ID
              AND d.IDQUALITE = 'QP000001'
              AND d.IDSEXE = '1'), 0) AS ecartMale
FROM TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUET t
         LEFT JOIN LOT l ON l.ID = t.IDLOT
         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE s ON s.id = l.idsouche;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRIAGEBATPARQUETDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "IDSEXE", "IDQUALITE", "QTE", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDSEXELIB", "IDQUALITELIB", "IDLOT") AS
SELECT d."ID",d."IDMERE",d."IDBATIMENT",d."IDPARQUET",d."IDSEXE",d."IDQUALITE",d."QTE",
       b."NOMBATIMENT"  AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",
       p."VAL"  AS "IDPARQUETLIB",
       sx."VAL" AS "IDSEXELIB",
       q."VAL"  AS "IDQUALITELIB",
    	t.idlot AS idlot
FROM "TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUETDETAIL" d
         LEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = d."IDBATIMENT"
         LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" p ON p."ID" = d."IDPARQUET"
         LEFT JOIN "SEXE" sx ON sx."ID" = d."IDSEXE"
         LEFT JOIN "QUALITEPOUSSIN" q ON q."ID" = d."IDQUALITE"
		LEFT JOIN TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUET t ON t.id=d.idmere;

    t.ID,
    t.DATY,
    t.HEUREDEPART,
    t.IDOPERATEUR,
    t.IDNUMEROCOLLECTE,
    t.IDBATIMENT,
    t.IDPARQUET,
    t.OEUFTOTAL,
    t.POIDSMOYENOEUFS,
 
    lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM AS IDOPERATEURLIB,
 
    nc.VAL AS IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB,
 
    b.NOMBATIMENT AS IDBATIMENTLIB,

        WHEN t.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN t.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'

LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp

LEFT JOIN NUMEROCOLLECTE nc

LEFT JOIN BATIMENT b

LEFT JOIN PARQUET p

SELECT
    rownum as numero,
    lpad(pip.matricule,5,'0') as matricule,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.NOM)) as nom,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.prenom)) as prenoms,
    sexe.val as sexe,
    lp.date_naissance,
    pip.dateembauche,
    case
        when extract(year from pip.date_depart)=nvl(s3.annee,nvl(s2.annee,nvl(s1.annee,0)))
            and (
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 1
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 2
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 3
                 ) then pip.date_depart
        else
            null
        end as date_depart,
    upper(paf.desce) as fonction,
    upper(pip.NUMERO_CNAPS) as cnaps,
    lp.numero_cin as cin,
    nvl(s1.salairebase,0) as mois1,
    nvl(s2.salairebase,0) as mois2,
    nvl(s3.salairebase,0) as mois3,
    (nvl(s1.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s2.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s3.salairebase, 0)) as salaires_non_plafonnes,
    (
        case
            when nvl(s1.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s1.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s2.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s2.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s3.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s3.salairebase,0)
            end
        ) as salaires_plafonnes,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5 as employeur,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as travailleur,
    (nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5)+nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as total,
    ostie.annee,
    ostie.direction
FROM log_personnel lp
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=lp.id
         JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id=lp.direction
         JOIN paie_fonction paf ON paf.id = pip.idfonction
         JOIN sexe ON sexe.id = lp.sexe
         LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT sum(round(retenue,0)) as retenue,idpersonnel,annee,direction FROM paie_edition WHERE
         (mois = 1 or mois=2 or mois =3) AND etat=11 AND IDELEMENTPAIE ='PRU000I710'
      group by idpersonnel,annee,direction) ostie
     ON ostie.idpersonnel = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 1) s1
     ON lp.id = s1.idpersonnel and ostie.annee= s1.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 2) s2
     ON lp.id = s2.idpersonnel and ostie.annee = s2.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 3) s3
     ON lp.id = s3.idpersonnel and ostie.annee=s3.annee
WHERE nvl(ostie.retenue,0)!=0
ORDER BY annee,pip.matricule;
