CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V1_OSTIE_AFFICHE_T4" ("NUMERO", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOMS", "SEXE", "DATE_NAISSANCE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DATE_DEPART", "FONCTION", "CNAPS", "CIN", "MOIS1", "MOIS2", "MOIS3", "SALAIRES_NON_PLAFONNES", "SALAIRES_PLAFONNES", "EMPLOYEUR", "TRAVAILLEUR", "TOTAL", "ANNEE", "DIRECTION") AS
SELECT
    rownum as numero,
    lpad(pip.matricule,5,'0') as matricule,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.NOM)) as nom,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.prenom)) as prenoms,
    sexe.val as sexe,
    lp.date_naissance,
    pip.dateembauche,
    case
        when extract(year from pip.date_depart)=nvl(s3.annee,nvl(s2.annee,nvl(s1.annee,0)))
            and (
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 10
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 11
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 12
                 ) then pip.date_depart
        else
            null
        end as date_depart,
    upper(paf.desce) as fonction,
    upper(pip.NUMERO_CNAPS) as cnaps,
    lp.numero_cin as cin,
    nvl(s1.salairebase,0) as mois1,
    nvl(s2.salairebase,0) as mois2,
    nvl(s3.salairebase,0) as mois3,
    (nvl(s1.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s2.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s3.salairebase, 0)) as salaires_non_plafonnes,
    (
        case
            when nvl(s1.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s1.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s2.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s2.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s3.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s3.salairebase,0)
            end
        ) as salaires_plafonnes,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5 as employeur,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as travailleur,
    (nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5)+nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as total,
    ostie.annee,
    ostie.direction
FROM log_personnel lp
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=lp.id
         JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id=lp.direction
         JOIN paie_fonction paf ON paf.id = pip.idfonction
         JOIN sexe ON sexe.id = lp.sexe
         LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT sum(round(retenue,0)) as retenue,idpersonnel,annee,direction FROM paie_edition WHERE
         (mois = 10 or mois=11 or mois =12) AND etat=11 AND IDELEMENTPAIE ='PRU000I710'
      group by idpersonnel,annee,direction) ostie
     ON ostie.idpersonnel = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 10) s1
     ON lp.id = s1.idpersonnel and ostie.annee= s1.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 11) s2
     ON lp.id = s2.idpersonnel and ostie.annee = s2.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 12) s3
     ON lp.id = s3.idpersonnel and ostie.annee=s3.annee
WHERE nvl(ostie.retenue,0)!=0
ORDER BY annee,pip.matricule;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VACCINATIONPOUSSINDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "IDTYPEVACCINATION", "IDMALADIEPOUSSIN", "IDVACCIN", "IDMODEADMINISTRATION", "QTEDOSE", "HEUREDEBUT", "HEUREFIN", "DATEEXPIRATION", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDTYPEVACCINATIONLIB", "IDMALADIEPOUSSINLIB", "IDVACCINLIB", "IDMODEADMINISTRATIONLIB") AS
SELECT
    vd."ID",vd."IDMERE",vd."IDBATIMENT",vd."IDPARQUET",vd."IDTYPEVACCINATION",vd."IDMALADIEPOUSSIN",vd."IDVACCIN",vd."IDMODEADMINISTRATION",vd."QTEDOSE",vd."HEUREDEBUT",vd."HEUREFIN",vd."DATEEXPIRATION",
    b.nomBatiment  AS idBatimentLib,
    p.val          AS idParquetLib,
    tv.val         AS idTypeVaccinationLib,
    mp.val         AS idMaladiePoussinLib,
    vp.val         AS idVaccinLib,
    ma.val         AS idModeAdministrationLib
FROM vaccinationPoussinDetail vd
     LEFT JOIN batiment b               ON vd.idBatiment = b.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet p                ON vd.idParquet = p.id
     LEFT JOIN typeVaccination tv       ON vd.idTypeVaccination = tv.id
     LEFT JOIN maladiePoussin mp        ON vd.idMaladiePoussin = mp.id
     LEFT JOIN VaccinPoussin vp         ON vd.idVaccin = vp.id
     LEFT JOIN modeAdministrationVaccin ma ON vd.idModeAdministration = ma.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VACCINATIONPOUSSIN_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLOT", "REMARQUE", "IDLOTLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
    v."ID",v."DATY",v."IDLOT",v."REMARQUE",
    l.nomLot AS idLotLib,
    v.ETAT AS ETAT,
    CASE v.ETAT
        WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
        WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM vaccinationPoussin v
         LEFT JOIN lot l ON v.idLot = l.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDEP_GRAPH" ("IDPRELEVEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDPOMPISTE", "NOMUSER", "IDPOMPE", "NOMMAGASIN", "VENTECARBURANT", "ENTREE", "DATY") AS
(
SELECT
pe.IDPRELEVEMENT,
pe.IDENCAISSEMENT,
p.IDPOMPISTE,
p.NOMUSER,
p.IDPOMPE,

el.VENTECARBURANT,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETAILS_AVEC_MONTANT" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "TVA", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "PUTOTAL", "PUREVIENT", "MONTANTRESTE", "MONTANTPAYE") AS
SELECT 
	v."ID",v."IDVENTE",v."IDVENTELIB",v."IDPRODUIT",v."IDPRODUITLIB",v."IDORIGINE",v."QTE",v."PU",v."MONTANT",v."IDDEVISE",v."TAUXDECHANGE",v."TVA",v."IDCLIENT",v."IDCLIENTLIB",
	v.pu*v.qte*nvl(v.tauxdechange,0) AS putotal,
	v.pu*v.qte AS 	purevient,
	vcm.montantreste,
	vcm.montantpaye
FROM VENTE_DETAILS_CPL v
JOIN VENTE_CPL_AVEC_MONTANT vcm ON vcm.id=v.IDVENTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETAILS_GRP" ("IDVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTC") AS
SELECT 
vd.IDVENTE,
vd.idDevise ,
sum(nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,0) ) AS TAUXDECHANGE,
sum( nvl((vd.TAUXDECHANGE* vd.QTE * vd.PU ),0) + nvl((vd.TAUXDECHANGE* vd.QTE * vd.PU ),0) * nvl(vd.TVA,0)/100 )  AS montanttc
FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd 
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE,idDevise;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETCALC" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDREMISE", "REMISEMONTANT", "PHOTO", "QTE_TMP", "REFERENCE", "MONTANT", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "ETAT") AS
select vd."ID",vd."IDVENTE",vd."IDPRODUIT",vd."IDORIGINE",vd."QTE",vd."IDDEVISE",vd."TAUXDECHANGE",vd."DESIGNATION",vd."COMPTE",vd."IDBCFILLE",vd."UNITE",vd."POIDS",vd."RISTOURNE",vd."IDPREVISION",vd."PU",vd."REMISE",vd."TVA",vd."PUACHAT",vd."PUVENTE",vd."PUREVIENT",vd."IDREMISE",vd."REMISEMONTANT",vd."PHOTO",vd."QTE_TMP",vd."REFERENCE",vd."MONTANT",vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM , vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM,
       cast(vd.QTE * vd.pu as number(30, 2))                                     as montantNonRemise,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.pu *((nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) + nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0)) / 100)) + vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) as number(30, 2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *
             (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM))as number(30, 2) )                 as montantHT,
       cast((vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *
            (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100)) -(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) as number(30, 2))                 as puRemise,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) as number(30, 2))                            as montantHTAr,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) * nvl(vd.tva, 0) /
            100 as number(30, 2))                                                as montantTva,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)- vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) * nvl(vd.tva, 0) /
            100 as number(30, 2))                                                as montantTvaAr,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100)) as number(30, 2))                       as montantTTC,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTCAr,
       cast(nvl(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE, 0) as number(30, 2))                      as montantRevient,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)- vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) -
            nvl(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE, 0) as number(30, 2))                    as margeBrute,v.ETAT
from VENTE_DETAILS vd join vente v on v.id=vd.IDVENTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETCALCREMGLOVISE" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "SUM_QTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "COMPTE", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDREMISE", "REMISEMONTANT", "PHOTO", "QTE_TMP", "REFERENCE", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDPROVINCE", "IDPROVINCELIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANT_TOTAL", "PUTOTAL", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MONTANTLIVRAISON", "TOTAL_ACHAT", "MARGEBRUTE", "REMISEGLOBAL", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MOIS", "LIBELLE_MOIS", "ANNEE") AS
select vd.ID,
       IDVENTE,
       vd.DESIGNATION as idventeLib,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       ing.LIBELLE as idProduitLib,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       QTE,
       qte as sum_qte,
       IDDEVISE,
       TAUXDECHANGE,
       vd.DESIGNATION,
       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT as idcategorie,
       cat.VAL as idCategorieLib,
       v.DATY,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       mag.VAL as idmagasinLib,
       mag.IDPOINT,
       p1.VAL as idpointLib,
       vd.IDDEVISE as idDeviseLib,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       vd.COMPTE,
       IDBCFILLE,
       vd.UNITE,
       POIDS,
       RISTOURNE,
       IDPREVISION,
       vd.PU,
       vd.REMISE,
       vd.TVA,
       PUACHAT,
       PUVENTE,
       PUREVIENT,
       IDREMISE,
       vd.REMISEMONTANT,
       vd.PHOTO,
       QTE_TMP,
       vd.REFERENCE,
       ing.TYPEPRODUIT,tp.VAL as TYPEPRODUITLIB,
       cli.IDPROVINCE,pro.VAL as IDPROVINCELIB,
       MONTANT,
       montantNonRemise,
       montantRemiseSansTva,
       montantHT,
       puRemise,
       montantHTAr,
       montantTva,
       montantTvaAr,
       montantTTC,
       montantTTCAr,
       montantTTCAr as montantTotal,
       montantTTCAr as montant_Total,
       cast((montantHTAr - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0))*(1+(nvl(vd.TVA,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as putotal,
       montantRevient,
       cast((NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0))*(1+(nvl(vd.TVA,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantlivraison,
       montantRevient as total_achat,
       cast(margeBrute as number(30,2)) as margeBrute,v.REMISE as remiseGlobal,v.IDCLIENT,cli.NOM as idclientlib,
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.DATY) AS mois,
       TO_CHAR(v.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = FRENCH') AS libelle_mois,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.DATY)  AS annee
from VenteDetCalc vd
         join vente v on v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on vd.IDPRODUIT=ing.id
         left join categorieIngredient cat on ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT=cat.id
         left join magasin2 mag on mag.ID=v.IDMAGASIN
         left join point p1 on mag.IDPOINT=p1.ID
         left join CLIENT cli on cli.id=v.IDCLIENT
         left join PROVINCE pro on pro.ID=cli.IDPROVINCE
         left join TYPE_PRODUIT tp on tp.id=ing.TYPEPRODUIT
where v.ETAT>=11 order by annee desc,EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.DATY) desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETMERECATINGRCATCLIENT" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDREMISE", "IDCLIENT", "CATCLIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTS", "IDPOINT") AS

    left join vente v on v.id=vd.IDVENTE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIB" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT 
v.ID ,
v.IDPRODUIT ,
p.VAL AS IDPRODUITLIB,
v.QTE ,
v.PU ,
v.TAUXREMISE ,
v.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
e.DESIGNATION AS IDENCAISSEMENTLIB,
v.IDMAGASIN ,
v.DATY ,
v.REMARQUE ,
v.IDMAGASINLIB,
v.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN v.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN v.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN v.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS ETATLIB ,
CAST(v.QTE * v.PU AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant
FROM VENTELUBRIFIANT v 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON v.IDPRODUIT = p.ID 
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT e ON v.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON  v.IDMAGASIN  = m.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIBANNULE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT 
v."ID",v."IDPRODUIT",v."IDPRODUITLIB",v."QTE",v."PU",v."TAUXREMISE",v."IDENCAISSEMENT",v."IDENCAISSEMENTLIB",v."IDMAGASIN",v."DATY",v."REMARQUE",v."IDMAGASINLIB",v."ETAT",v."ETATLIB"
 FROM VENTELUBRIFIANTLIB v 
 WHERE v.ETAT = 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIBCREE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT 
v."ID",v."IDPRODUIT",v."IDPRODUITLIB",v."QTE",v."PU",v."TAUXREMISE",v."IDENCAISSEMENT",v."IDENCAISSEMENTLIB",v."IDMAGASIN",v."DATY",v."REMARQUE",v."IDMAGASINLIB",v."ETAT",v."ETATLIB"
 FROM VENTELUBRIFIANTLIB v 
 WHERE v.ETAT = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIBVISEE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANT_VALIDEE" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT") AS
SELECT 
v.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
sum( nvl(v.QTE  * v.PU ,0) ) AS ventelubrifiant
FROM VENTELUBRIFIANT v 
WHERE v.ETAT > 1 
GROUP BY v.IDENCAISSEMENT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS
SELECT vd.IDVENTE AS ID,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       sum(FRAIS)                                                                                                    as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -
                                                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) *
                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *
                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *
                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) *
                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -
                ((nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       vd.IDRESERVATION
FROM VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS vd
--         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
--         left join AS_INGREDIENTS vp on vp.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, vd.IDRESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEMONTANTLEGER" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS") AS
SELECT vd.IDVENTE AS ID,

       -- montanttotal : base apres remise % et remise Arbiochem, moins frais
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotal,

       -- montantremise : remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant total de la remise)
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) +
            SUM(nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE) as number(30, 2))                                               AS montantremise,

       cast(sum(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5)   )                                                                                                    as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,

       -- montantTva : calculee sur la base deja reduite de la remise Arbiochem
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,

       -- montantTTC : montantTva + montanttotal (bases deja reduites de la remise Arbiochem)
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                                             as montantTTC,

       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,

       -- montantTTCAR : remise Arbiochem ajoutee en suivant le meme traitement que fraislivraison (structure d'origine conservee)
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -
                                                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                                                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE) *
                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *
                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *
                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                  (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) *
                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -
                ((nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,

       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(ing.CALORIE* vd.QTE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colis
FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION;

SELECT ID,
       DESIGNATION,
       IDMAGASIN,
       IDMAGASINLIB,
       DATY,
       REMARQUE,
       ETAT,
       ETATLIB,
       MONTANTTOTAL,
       IDDEVISE,
       IDCLIENT,
       IDCLIENTLIB,
       MONTANTTVA,
       MONTANTTTC,
       MONTANTTTCAR,
       MONTANTPAYE,
       MONTANTRESTE,
       AVOIR,
       TAUXDECHANGE,
       MONTANTREVIENT,
       MARGEBRUTE,
       IDRESERVATION,
       DATYPREVU,
       MOIS,
       ANNEE,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || DESIGNATION || ' | ' || IDCLIENTLIB || ' | ' || IDDEVISE
           ) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM VENTE_CPL
WHERE ETAT >= 11
  AND MONTANTREMISE = 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "DATYPREVU", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "RESTE", "IDPROVINCE", "PROVINCELIB", "IDORIGINE", "FRAIS", "REFERENCEFACT", "NUMEROFACTURE", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "UPDATED_AT", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDECRITURE", "DATEDELIVRAISON", "MOTSCLESSS") AS SELECT V.ID, V.DESIGNATION, V.IDMAGASIN, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, V.DATY, V.REMARQUE, V.ETAT, CASE WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' END AS ETATLIB, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(NVL(MV.MONTANT, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(NVL(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - NVL(MV.MONTANT, 0) - NVL(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR - ACG.MONTANTPAYEAR, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTRESTE, CAST(NVL(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - V2.MONTANTREVIENT) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, CASE WHEN V.DATYPREVU IS NULL THEN V.DATY ELSE V.DATYPREVU END AS DATYPREVU, RF.REFERENCE AS REFERENCEFACTURE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(NVL(V2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + NVL(V2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANT, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM V.DATY) AS MOIS, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM V.DATY) AS ANNEE, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS POIDS, CAST(V2.COLIS AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS COLIS, V.MODEPAIEMENT, MP.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB, NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(V2.POIDS, 0) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, V.MODELIVRAISON, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, CAST(VR.RESTE AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS RESTE, PV.ID AS IDPROVINCE, PV.VAL AS PROVINCELIB, V.IDORIGINE, CAST(COALESCE(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS FRAIS, V.REFERENCEFACT, V.NUMEROFACTURE, V.LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON, V.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN V.ESTPREVU = 0 THEN 'Non' ELSE 'Oui' END AS ESTPREVULIB, CE.ID AS IDECRITURE, NVL(BLC.DATY, V.DATELIVRAISON) AS DATEDELIVRAISON, ( V.ID || ' | ' || V.DESIGNATION || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || NUMEROFACTURE || ' | ' || PV.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM VENTE V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN PROVINCE PV ON PV.ID = C.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL MV ON V.ID = MV.ID2 LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT_GBVENTE ACG ON ACG.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE RF ON RF.IDFACTURE = V.ID LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT MP ON MP.ID = V.MODEPAIEMENT LEFT JOIN VENTE_RESTE VR ON VR.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT BLC ON BLC.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE CE ON CE.IDOBJET = V.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_ANALYSE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS
SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL   AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'EN ATTENTE LIVRAISON ET PAIEMENT'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 12
               THEN 'LIVRE NON PAYE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 13
               THEN 'PAYE NON LIVRE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 14
               THEN 'PAYE ET LIVRE'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.MONTANTTOTALACHAT,
       p.ID AS IDPOINT,
       p.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL - v2.MONTANTTOTALACHAT AS MONTANTREVIENT,
       v.IDRESERVATION
FROM VENTE v
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT p ON m.IDPOINT = p.ID
         JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_ANALYSEF" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "PUTOTAL", "PUTOTALACHAT", "PUREVIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "DATY") AS
select vd.ID,
       vd.IDVENTE,
       vd.IDVENTELIB,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       ai.libelle as idproduitlib,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       vd.QTE,
       vd.PU,
       vd.PUTOTAL,
       vd.PUTOTALACHAT,
       vd.PUREVIENT,
       ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
       cat.val as idCategorieLib,
       vd.IDMAGASIN,
       vd.IDMAGASINLIB,
       vd.IDPOINT,
       vd.IDPOINTLIB,
       vd.IDDEVISE,
       vd.IDDEVISELIB,
       vd.IDRESERVATION,
       v.DATY
from VENTE_DETAILS_CPL_2 vd
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON cat.id = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
WHERE v.ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_AVEC_MONTANT" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MONTANTTC", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "ENCAISSEMENTCHANGE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDRESERVATION") AS
SELECT
v.ID,v.DESIGNATION,v.IDMAGASIN,v.DATY,v.REMARQUE,v.ETAT,v.IDORIGINE,v.IDCLIENT,
c.NOM AS idClientLib,
m.VAL AS idMagasinLib,
nvl(vg.montanttc,0) AS montanttc,
nvl(vg.montanttc,0) AS montantttc,
nvl(ve.montantpaye*vg.TAUXDECHANGE,0) AS montantpaye,
nvl(ve.montantpaye * vg.TAUXDECHANGE ,0) AS encaissementchange,
nvl(vg.montanttc,0) - nvl(ve.montantpaye*vg.TAUXDECHANGE,0)  AS montantreste,
vg.idDevise,
v.IDRESERVATION
FROM ventedetails_grp vg
LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.id = vg.IDVENTE
LEFT JOIN vente_encaisse ve ON ve.IDVENTE = v.id
LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = v.idclient
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.id  = v.idmagasin;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_AVEC_MONTANT_SANSDEV" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "ENCAISSEMENTCHANGE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDRESERVATION") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_BC_VISEE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "CLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "IDORIGINE", "MONTANTAVOIR") AS
SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
           END
             AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.IDDEVISE,
       v.IDCLIENT,
       c.NOM AS CLIENTLIB,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYEar, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)+nvl(acg.MONTANTPAYEAR,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)  as avoir,
       v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       v.idorigine as IDORIGINE,
       cast(nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)  as NUMBER(30,2)) as montantAvoir
FROM VENTE v
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id=mv.ID2
         LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
         --left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT asbl on asbl.ID = v.IDORIGINE
where v.ETAT = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_CL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "DATYPREVU", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "RESTE", "IDPROVINCE", "PROVINCELIB", "IDORIGINE", "FRAIS", "REFERENCEFACT", "NUMEROFACTURE", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "UPDATED_AT", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDECRITURE", "DATEDELIVRAISON", "ADRESSE") AS SELECT v.ID, v.DESIGNATION, v.IDMAGASIN, m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, v.DATY, v.REMARQUE, v.ETAT, CASE WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE' WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE' WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' END AS ETATLIB, cast(v2.MONTANTTOTAL as number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, v2.IDDEVISE, v.IDCLIENT, c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30, 5)) as MONTANTTVA, cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30, 5)) as montantttc, cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30, 5)) as MONTANTTTCAR, cast(nvl(mv.montant, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS montantpaye, cast(nvl(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - nvl(mv.montant, 0) - nvl(ACG.imputeefactar, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS montantreste, cast(nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0) as number(30, 5)) as avoir, cast(v2.tauxDeChange as number(10, 2)) AS tauxDeChange, cast(v2.MONTANTREVIENT as number(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT , cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20, 5)) as margeBrute, v.IDRESERVATION, case when v.DATYPREVU is null then v.daty else V.DATYPREVU end as datyprevu, rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture, cast(v2.MONTANTREMISE as number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTREMISE, cast(nvl(v2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + nvl(v2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) as number(30, 5)) as montant, extract(month from v.DATY) as mois, extract(year from v.DATY) as annee, CAST(vp.poids as number(30, 5)) as poids, CAST(vp.colis as number(30, 5)) as colis, v.modepaiement, mp.VAL as modepaiementlib, nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vp.poids, 0) as fraislivraison, v.modelivraison, CASE WHEN v.modelivraison = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN v.modelivraison = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS modelivraisonlib, cast(vr.reste as number(30, 5)) AS reste, pv.id as idprovince, pv.val as provincelib, --bl.id as idbl, v.IDORIGINE, CAST(COALESCE(v.FRAISLIVRAISON,0) AS number(30, 5)) as frais, v.REFERENCEFACT, v.NUMEROFACTURE, v.LIEULIVRAISON, v.DATELIVRAISON, v.UPDATED_AT, case when v.ESTPREVU = 0 then 'Non' ELSE 'Oui' END estprevulib, ce.id AS idecriture, nvl(blc.daty,v.DATELIVRAISON) AS datedelivraison, c.ADRESSE FROM VENTE v LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT left join PROVINCE pv on pv.id = c.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2 LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture = v.Id left join vente_poids vp on vp.idvente = v.id left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = v.modepaiement left join vente_reste vr on vr.idvente = v.id LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT blc ON blc.IDVENTE = v.id LEFT JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.idobjet=v.id;

nvl(mv.montant, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantreste, v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange, v2.MONTANTREVIENT, cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20, 2)) as margeBrute, v.IDRESERVATION, case when v.DATYPREVU is null then daty else V.DATYPREVU end as datyprevu, rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture, v2.MONTANTREMISE, nvl(v2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + nvl(v2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) as montant, extract(month from DATY) as mois, extract(year from DATY) as annee, vp.poids, v.modepaiement, mp.VAL as modepaiementlib, nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vp.poids, 0) as fraislivraison, v.modelivraison, CASE WHEN v.modelivraison = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN v.modelivraison = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS modelivraisonlib, vr.reste, pv.id as idprovince, pv.val as provincelib, v.NUMEROFACTURE as numfact FROM VENTE v LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT left join PROVINCE pv on pv.id = c.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2 LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture = v.Id left join vente_poids vp on vp.idvente = v.id left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = v.modepaiement left join vente_reste vr on vr.idvente = v.id;

SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
           END
             AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.IDDEVISE,
       v.IDCLIENT,
       c.NOM AS CLIENTLIB,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0)  as avoir,
       v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       v.IDORIGINE,
       bl.id as idbl

         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON v.id=mv.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
         left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl on bl.IDVENTE = v.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_CPL" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "TVA", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DESIGNATION", "PUREVIENT", "MONTANTREVIENT") AS

          vd.IDVENTE,

          vd.IDPRODUIT,
          p.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,

          vd.QTE,
          VD.pu
             AS PU,
         	CAST((nvl(vd.remise/100,0))*(vd.QTE * vd.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantRemise,
            CAST((1-nvl(vd.remise/100,0))*(vd.QTE * vd.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
          vd.iddevise AS iddevise,
          vd.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,
          vd.tva AS tva,
          v.idclient,
          v.idclientlib,
          vd.designation,

          cast(vd.QTE*vd.PUREVIENT as NUMBER(20,2)) as montantRevient
     FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd

          LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_CPL_2" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "PUTOTAL", "PUTOTALACHAT", "PUREVIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "IDBCFILLE", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDPROVINCE", "IDPROVINCELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.IDVENTE,
       SQ.IDVENTELIB,
       SQ.IDPRODUIT,
       SQ.IDPRODUITLIB,
       SQ.IDORIGINE,
       SQ.QTE,
       SQ.PU,
       SQ.PUTOTAL,
       SQ.PUTOTALACHAT,
       SQ.PUREVIENT,
       SQ.IDCATEGORIE,
       SQ.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.IDMAGASIN,
       SQ.IDMAGASINLIB,
       SQ.IDPOINT,
       SQ.IDPOINTLIB,
       SQ.IDDEVISE,
       SQ.IDDEVISELIB,
       SQ.IDRESERVATION,
       SQ.IDBCFILLE,
       SQ.TYPEPRODUIT,
       SQ.TYPEPRODUITLIB,
       SQ.IDPROVINCE,
       SQ.IDPROVINCELIB,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDVENTE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDVENTELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPRODUIT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPRODUITLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDORIGINE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.QTE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PU), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUTOTAL), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUTOTALACHAT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUREVIENT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDCATEGORIE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDCATEGORIELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDMAGASIN), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDMAGASINLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPOINT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPOINTLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDDEVISE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDDEVISELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDRESERVATION), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDBCFILLE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.TYPEPRODUIT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.TYPEPRODUITLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPROVINCE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPROVINCELIB), '')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT vd.ID,
                vd.IDVENTE,
                v.DESIGNATION                                                      AS IDVENTELIB,
                vd.IDPRODUIT,
                p.LIBELLEVENTE                                                     AS IDPRODUITLIB,
                vd.IDORIGINE,
                vd.QTE,
                NVL(vd.PU, 0)                                                      AS PU,
                -- Formule de PUTOTAL aligne?e sur le MONTANTTTC de la vue de?taille?e
                CAST(
                    -- Partie HT avec de?duction des frais
                        ((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0))
                            +
                            -- Partie TVA applique?e sur cette me?me base HT modifie?e
                        (((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) * NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100)
                    AS NUMBER(30,2)
                )                                                                  AS PUTOTAL,
                CAST(NVL(vd.PUACHAT * vd.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                  AS PUTOTALACHAT,
                CAST(NVL(vd.PU * vd.QTE, 0) - NVL(vd.PUACHAT * vd.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUREVIENT,
                cat.ID                                                             AS IDCATEGORIE,
                cat.VAL                                                            AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
                v.DATY                                                             AS DATY,
                m.ID                                                               AS IDMAGASIN,
                m.VAL                                                              AS IDMAGASINLIB,
                p1.ID                                                              AS IDPOINT,
                p1.VAL                                                             AS IDPOINTLIB,
                vd.IDDEVISE,
                vd.IDDEVISE                                                        AS IDDEVISELIB,
                v.IDRESERVATION,
                vd.IDBCFILLE,
                p.TYPEPRODUIT,
                tp.VAL                                                             AS TYPEPRODUITLIB,
                cli.IDPROVINCE,
                pro.VAL                                                            AS IDPROVINCELIB
         FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
                  LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN POINT p1 ON p1.ID = m.IDPOINT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = cat.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID = p.TYPEPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT cli ON cli.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN PROVINCE pro ON pro.ID = cli.IDPROVINCE
     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS_ING" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "POIDS", "RESTE", "FRAIS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "IDCLIENTLIB", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "IDRESERVATION", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "CALORIE", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE", "UNITE2", "MONTANTREMISER", "IDREMISE", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.IDVENTE,
    p.IDPRODUIT,
    p.IDORIGINE,
    CAST(p.QTE AS NUMBER(38, 2))                                              AS QTE,
    p.PU,
    p.REMISE,
    p.TVA,
    p.PUACHAT,
    p.PUVENTE,
    p.IDDEVISE,
    p.TAUXDECHANGE,
    p.DESIGNATION,
    p.COMPTE,
    p.PUREVIENT,
    p.IDBCFILLE,
    p.UNITE,
    u.VAL                                                                     AS UNITELIB,

    CAST(p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) + (p.pu * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS PUNET,

    -- MONTANTHT : deduction remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant fixe par qte)
    CAST(((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
        - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTHT,

    -- MONTANTTTC : base (avec remise Arbiochem) + TVA calculee sur cette meme base
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTTC,

    -- MONTANTTVA : calculee sur la base HT deja reduite de la remise Arbiochem
    CAST(
            ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTVA,

    -- MONTANTREMISE : remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant total de la remise)
    CAST(((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) + (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTREMISE,

    CAST(p.pu * p.qte AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                       AS MONTANT,

    CAST(NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))                AS POIDS,
    (NVL(p.QTE, 0) - NVL(bl.QUANTITE, 0)) - NVL(avcf.qte, 0)                  AS RESTE,

    CAST(NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS FRAIS,

    nvl(ing.LIBELLEVENTE,ing.libelle)                                                          AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    v.DATY,
    v.DATYPREVU                                                               AS DATYPREVU,
    p.IDDEVISE                                                                AS IDDEVISELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,

    -- PUTOTAL : meme formule que MONTANTTTC (avec remise Arbiochem)
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS PUTOTAL,

    cl.nom                                                                    AS IDCLIENTLIB,
    p.ristourne                                                               AS RISTOURNE,
    p.idprevision,
    v.IDRESERVATION,
    NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0)                                                  AS FRAISLIVRAISON,
    ing.calorie,
    CAST(p.pu / NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                        AS PUINGREDIENT,
    NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1)                                                       AS CONTENUE,
    ing.unite2,

    -- MONTANTREMISER : montant net apres remise % + remise Arbiochem
    (p.pu * p.qte) - ((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte) AS MONTANTREMISER,

    p.IDREMISE,
    nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0)                                                 AS REMISEARBIOCHEM,
    nvl(p.ristourneArbiochem, 0)                                              AS RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM
FROM VENTE_DETAILS p
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v
                   ON v.id = p.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u
                   ON u.id = p.unite
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing
                   ON ing.ID = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT cl
                   ON v.IDCLIENT = cl.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.ID
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
                   ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BL_CLIENT_FILLE_grp_vente bl
                   ON bl.idventedetail = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN avoirfcfille_grp_viseee avcf
                   ON avcf.idventedetails = p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_VIDE" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "FRAIS", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "RISTOURNE", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "POIDS", "IDPREVISION", "CALORIE", "IDRESERVATION", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM", "REMISEARBIOCHEM") AS

       cast(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0) as number(30, 5))                                          as frais,

                                                        NVL(p.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5))                                                  as montantht,
       cast(((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte - nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)) +

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DIRECTE_CPL_PDF" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ADECLARER", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "AVECCOMMISSION", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "MONTANTDONNE", "MONTANTRETOURNER", "HEURESAISIE", "IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ECHEANCEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDORIGINE", "DATYHEURE") AS
SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDMAGASIN","IDMAGASINLIB","DATY","DATYPREVU","REMARQUE","ETAT","ADECLARER","ETATLIB","MONTANTTOTAL","IDDEVISE","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","MONTANTTVA","MONTANTTTC","MONTANTTTCAR","MONTANTPAYE","MONTANTRESTE","AVOIR","TAUXDECHANGE","MONTANTREVIENT","MARGEBRUTE","IDRESERVATION","AVECCOMMISSION","IDMODEPAIEMENT","REFERENCEFACTURE","IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB","MONTANTDONNE","MONTANTRETOURNER","HEURESAISIE","IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT","ECHEANCEPAIEMENTLIB","IDORIGINE","DATYHEURE"
FROM (
         SELECT v.ID,
                v.DESIGNATION,
                v.IDMAGASIN,
                m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
                v.DATY,
                v.DATYPREVU,
                v.REMARQUE,
                v.ETAT,
                ADECLARER,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CRÉÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULÉE'
                    END AS ETATLIB,
                v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
                v2.IDDEVISE,
                v.IDCLIENT,
                c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
                cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
                nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0) as avoir,
                v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,
                v2.MONTANTREVIENT,
                cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2)) as margeBrute,
                v.IDRESERVATION,
                CASE
                    WHEN cm.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Oui'
                    ELSE                        'Non'
                    END AS avecCommission,
                v.idmodepaiement,
                rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture,
                mp.val AS idmodepaiementlib,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.MONTANTDONNE IS NULL OR v.MONTANTDONNE = 0
                        THEN cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    ELSE cast(v.MONTANTDONNE AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    END AS MONTANTDONNE,
                nvl(mv.MONTANTRETOURNER, 0) as montantretourner,
                v.heureSaisie,
                V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
                EP.DESCE AS echeancePaiementLib,
                v.IDORIGINE,
                TO_DATE(v.daty || ' ' || v.heureSaisie, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS DATYHEURE
         FROM VENTE v
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MVTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE_PDF mv ON v.id in mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
             LEFT JOIN COMMISSION cm ON cm.IDFACTURE = v.id
             LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT mp ON mp.id = v.idmodepaiement
             LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture=v.Id
             LEFT JOIN ECHEANCEPAIEMENT EP on EP.ID = V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT
     )
ORDER BY DATYHEURE DESC NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_EDITEES" ("ID", "DATY", "IDRISTOURNE") AS
SELECT v.id,
       v.daty,
       r.idristourne
FROM VENTE_CPL v
JOIN (
    SELECT id as idristourne,
           REGEXP_SUBSTR(idorigine, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS idvente_explose
    FROM ristourne
    CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(idorigine, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
           AND PRIOR id = id
           AND PRIOR SYS_GUID() IS NOT NULL
) r
ON v.id = r.idvente_explose;

v.ID ,

SELECT v.ID,

          v.IDMAGASIN,
          m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
          v.DATY,
          v.REMARQUE,

          CASE
             WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'

             WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
          END
             AS ETATLIB,
          v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
          v2.IDDEVISE,
          v.IDCLIENT,
          c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
          cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,

          v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
          v.IDRESERVATION
     FROM VENTE v

          JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_MF" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDRESERVATION") AS
select vd.ID,vd.IDVENTE,vd.IDPRODUIT,vd.IDORIGINE,vd.QTE,vd.PU,vd.REMISE,vd.TVA,vd.PUACHAT,vd.PUVENTE,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       v.IDCLIENT,
       vd.compte,
       cast((PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))) as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantHT,
       cast((PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100)) *(tva/100)) as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantTVA,
       cast(PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100)) + (PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100)) * (tva/100))  as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantTTC,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE AS tauxdechange,
       v.IDRESERVATION
from VENTE_DETAILS vd
         left outer join VENTE V on V.ID = vd.IDVENTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_RECAP_JOUR" ("DATY", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "NOMBRE", "MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR") AS
WITH BORNES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-06-01' AS DATE_MIN,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATE_MAX
    FROM DUAL
),
CALENDRIER AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
VENTE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS NOMBRE
    FROM VENTE_CPL
    WHERE ETAT = 11
      AND DATY >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY TRUNC(DATY)
)
SELECT
    c.DATY,

    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTTTC, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    CAST(NVL(v.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,5)
    ) AS MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR

FROM CALENDRIER c
LEFT JOIN VENTE_JOUR v
    ON c.DATY = v.DATY;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VESTOCKPRODFINI_CAT_PCENTAGE" ("ID", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "POURCENTAGE", "DATY", "MONTANTRESTE") AS

    typeproduitlib AS idTypeProduitLib ,
    CAST(SUM(quantite) AS NUMBER(30,2))  AS quantite,
    CAST(
            SUM(quantite) * 100.0
                / SUM(SUM(quantite)) OVER ()
        AS NUMBER(10,2))                     AS pourcentage,
    CURRENT_DATE AS DATY,
    CAST(SUM(montantReste) AS NUMBER(30,2))  AS montantReste

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VIREMENTINTRACAISSECPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSEDEPART", "IDCAISSEDEPARTLIB", "IDCAISSEARRIVE", "IDCAISSEARRIVELIB", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS
SELECT
	    v.ID ,
	    v.DESIGNATION ,
	    v.IDCAISSEDEPART ,
	    c.VAL AS IDCAISSEDEPARTLIB ,
	    v.IDCAISSEARRIVE ,
	    c2.VAL AS IDCAISSEARRIVELIB,
	    CAST(v.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANT   ,
	    v.DATY ,
	    v.ETAT ,
	    CASE
	        WHEN v.ETAT = 0
	            THEN 'ANNULÉ'
	        WHEN v.ETAT = 1
	            THEN 'CRÉÉ'
	        WHEN v.ETAT = 11
	            THEN  'VISÉ'
	        END AS ETATLIB
	FROM VIREMENTINTRACAISSE v
	         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = v.IDCAISSEDEPART
	         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c2 ON c2.ID  = v.IDCAISSEARRIVE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_CARTONFILLE_IDMERE" ("IDBCFILLE", "ID_CARTON_MERE") AS
SELECT
  cf.IDBCFILLE,
  MIN(cf.IDMERE) AS ID_CARTON_MERE
FROM CARTONFILLE cf
JOIN CARTON c ON c.ID = cf.IDMERE AND c.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY cf.IDBCFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_CARTONFILLE_SUM" ("IDBCFILLE", "QUANTITE_CARTONFILLE") AS
SELECT
  cf.IDBCFILLE,
  SUM(cf.QUANTITE) AS QUANTITE_CARTONFILLE
FROM CARTONFILLE cf
JOIN CARTON c ON c.ID = cf.IDMERE AND c.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY cf.IDBCFILLE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_CNAPS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "RETENUE") AS
SELECT pe.idpersonnel,
       pe.mois,
       pe.annee,
       pe.retenue
FROM paie_edition pe
WHERE pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_CONTRAT_LIB" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "SEXE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "PERIODE", "DATE_FIN_CONTRAT", "ETAT", "TYPE_CONTRAT") AS
SELECT
    lpf.idpersonnel AS id,
    lpf.matricule,
    lpf.nom,
    lpf.prenom,
    lpf.sexe,
    pip.dateembauche,
    pip.indesirable AS periode,
    CASE
        WHEN pip.indesirable > 0 THEN pip.dateembauche + INTERVAL '1' MONTH * pip.indesirable
        ELSE NULL
        END AS date_fin_contrat,
    lpf.etat,
    tc.val AS type_contrat
FROM
    log_personnel_fin lpf
        JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = lpf.idpersonnel
        JOIN type_contrat tc ON tc.id = pip.typecontrat;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_ID_MATRICULE" ("ID", "PRENOM", "NOM", "MATRICULE", "DIRECTION", "IDDIRECTION", "ETAT") AS
SELECT lp.id,
       lp.prenom,
       lp.nom,
       pip.matricule,
       ld.VAL AS direction,
       ld.ID AS iddirection,
       pip.ETAT
FROM paie_info_personnel pip
         JOIN log_personnel lp ON pip.id = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN LOG_DIRECTION ld ON ld.ID = lp.direction;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_SUIVI_CARTON" ("ID", "IDBC_MERE", "PRODUITLIB", "QUANTITEBCF", "QUANTITECARTONFILLE", "RESTECARTONFILLE") AS
SELECT 
    bcf.ID AS id,
    bcf.IDBC AS idbc_mere,
    ai.LIBELLE AS produitlib,
    NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) AS quantitebcf,
    NVL(SUM(cf.QUANTITE), 0) AS quantitecartonfille,
    NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - NVL(SUM(cf.QUANTITE), 0) AS restecartonfille
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf
LEFT JOIN CARTONFILLE cf ON cf.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID
LEFT JOIN CARTON c ON c.ID = cf.IDMERE AND c.ETAT > 11
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = bcf.PRODUIT
GROUP BY 
    bcf.ID,
    bcf.IDBC,
    ai.LIBELLE,
    bcf.QUANTITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_SUIVI_CARTON_LIVRAISON" ("ID", "IDBC_MERE", "IDCARTONMERE", "PRODUIT", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITE", "QUANTITEBCF", "QUANTITECARTONFILLE", "RESTECARTONFILLE") AS
SELECT 
    bcf.ID AS id,
    bcf.IDBC AS idbc_mere,
    vci.ID_CARTON_MERE AS idCartonMere,
    ai.ID AS produit,
    ai.LIBELLE AS produitlib,
    ai.UNITE AS unite,
    NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) AS quantitebcf,
    NVL(vc.QUANTITE_CARTONFILLE, 0) AS quantitecartonfille,
    NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - NVL(vc.QUANTITE_CARTONFILLE, 0) AS restecartonfille
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = bcf.PRODUIT
LEFT JOIN VUE_CARTONFILLE_SUM vc ON vc.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID
LEFT JOIN VUE_CARTONFILLE_IDMERE vci ON vci.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VW_HS_CUMUL_WEEK" ("IDPERSONNEL", "SEMAINE", "TOTAL_HS") AS
SELECT
    pip.id as IDPERSONNEL,
    TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'IYYY-IW') AS SEMAINE,
    NVL(SUM(hp.HS), 0) AS TOTAL_HS
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hp
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.ID = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATION ress ON ress.id = hp.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.id = ress.IDRESSOURCE

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'IYYY-IW');

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ACCIDENT_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "DATE_DECLARATION", "ID_PERSONNEL", "ID_LIEU", "ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT", "ID_GRAVITE", "ID_MACHINE", "CAUSE", "HEUREACCIDENT", "HORAIREDEBUT", "HORAIREFIN", "ACTIVITE", "LESIONS", "CENTRESOIN", "DETAILSTEMOIN1", "DETAILSTEMOIN2", "ETAT", "ID_MACHINE_LIB", "ID_LIEU_LIB", "ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT_LIB", "ID_GRAVITE_LIB", "ID_PERSONNEL_LIB", "MATRICULE", "ETAT_LIB") AS
SELECT acc."ID",acc."DATY",acc."DATE_DECLARATION",acc."ID_PERSONNEL",acc."ID_LIEU",acc."ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT",acc."ID_GRAVITE",acc."ID_MACHINE",acc."CAUSE",acc."HEUREACCIDENT",acc."HORAIREDEBUT",acc."HORAIREFIN",acc."ACTIVITE",acc."LESIONS",acc."CENTRESOIN",acc."DETAILSTEMOIN1",acc."DETAILSTEMOIN2",acc."ETAT",
       m.VAL AS id_machine_lib,
       lat.val AS id_lieu_lib,
       ta.VAL AS id_type_accident_lib,
       ga.val AS id_gravite_lib,
       lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.prenom AS id_personnel_lib,
       pip.MATRICULE AS matricule,
       CASE
           WHEN acc.etat = 1 THEN 'Cree'
           WHEN acc.etat = 11 THEN 'Declare'
           ELSE 'inconnu'
       END AS etat_lib
FROM Accident acc
         LEFT JOIN MACHINE m ON m.ID = acc.Id_machine
         LEFT JOIN lieu_accident_travail lat ON lat.ID = acc.id_lieu
         LEFT JOIN type_accident ta ON ta.id = acc.id_type_accident
         LEFT JOIN gravite_accident ga ON ga.id = acc.id_gravite
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON lp.ID = acc.ID_PERSONNEL
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.id = acc.ID_PERSONNEL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ACCIDENT_PDF" ("ID", "DATY", "DATE_DECLARATION", "ID_PERSONNEL", "ID_LIEU", "ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT", "ID_GRAVITE", "ID_MACHINE", "CAUSE", "ETAT", "ID_MACHINE_LIB", "ID_LIEU_LIB", "ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT_LIB", "ID_GRAVITE_LIB", "ID_PERSONNEL_LIB", "MATRICULE", "ETAT_LIB", "DETAILSTEMOIN1", "DETAILSTEMOIN2", "HEUREACCIDENT", "HORAIREDEBUT", "HORAIREFIN", "ACTIVITE", "LESIONS", "CENTRESOIN", "NUMERO_CIN", "DATE_NAISSANCE", "FONCTION", "ADRESSE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "NUMERO_CNAPS") AS
SELECT acc."ID",acc."DATY",acc."DATE_DECLARATION",acc."ID_PERSONNEL",acc."ID_LIEU",acc."ID_TYPE_ACCIDENT",acc."ID_GRAVITE",acc."ID_MACHINE",acc."CAUSE",acc."ETAT",
       m.VAL AS id_machine_lib,
       lat.val AS id_lieu_lib,
       ta.VAL AS id_type_accident_lib,
       ga.val AS id_gravite_lib,
       lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.prenom AS id_personnel_lib,
       pip.MATRICULE AS matricule,
       CASE
           WHEN acc.etat = 1 THEN 'Cree'
           WHEN acc.etat = 11 THEN 'Declare'
           ELSE 'inconnu'
           END AS etat_lib,
       acc.DETAILSTEMOIN1,
       acc.DETAILSTEMOIN2,
       acc.HEUREACCIDENT,
       acc.HORAIREDEBUT,
       acc.HORAIREFIN,
       acc.ACTIVITE,
       acc.LESIONS,
       acc.CENTRESOIN,
       lp.NUMERO_CIN,
       lp.DATE_NAISSANCE,
       pf.val as fonction,
       lp.ADRESSE,
       pip.DATEEMBAUCHE,
       pip.NUMERO_CNAPS
FROM Accident acc
         LEFT JOIN MACHINE m ON m.ID = acc.Id_machine
         LEFT JOIN lieu_accident_travail lat ON lat.ID = acc.id_lieu
         LEFT JOIN type_accident ta ON ta.id = acc.id_type_accident
         LEFT JOIN gravite_accident ga ON ga.id = acc.id_gravite
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON lp.ID = acc.ID_PERSONNEL
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.id = acc.ID_PERSONNEL
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf ON pf.id = pip.IDFONCTION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ARRETTRAVAIL_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "DATE_FIN_ARRET", "DATE_DEBUT_ARRET", "ID_ACCIDENT", "NOMBRE_JOUR", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "DATEACCIDENT", "ID_PERSONNEL") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_BALANCE_DETAILS" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "COMPTE", "LIBELLECOMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "COMPTE3", "COMPTE2", "CUMULDEBIT", "CUMULCREDIT") AS
WITH mois_annees AS (
    SELECT
        ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), LEVEL - 25) AS mois
    FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 49
        ),
        base_comptes_periode AS (
        SELECT
        CAST(c.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        c.libelle AS libelleCompte,
        m.mois,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.mois) AS annee,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.mois) AS mois_num
        FROM
        compta_compte c
        CROSS JOIN mois_annees m
        ),
        ecritures_mensuelles AS (
    -- Excludes journal = 'COMP000015'
        SELECT
        CAST(cse.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM') AS mois,
        SUM(cse.debit) AS soldeDebit,
        SUM(cse.credit) AS soldeCredit
        FROM
        compta_sous_ecriture cse
        JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.id = cse.idmere
        WHERE
        cse.daty IS NOT NULL
        AND cse.etat >= 11
        AND cse.journal != 'COMP000015'
        GROUP BY
        cse.compte, TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM')
        ),
        ecritures_mensuelles_cumuls AS (
    -- Includes all journals, including 'COMP000015'
        SELECT
        CAST(cse.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM') AS mois,
        SUM(cse.debit) AS cumulDebit,
        SUM(cse.credit) AS cumulCredit
        FROM
        compta_sous_ecriture cse
        JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.id = cse.idmere
        WHERE
        cse.daty IS NOT NULL
        AND cse.etat >= 11
        GROUP BY
        cse.compte, TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM')
        ),
        fusion_comptes_mois AS (
        SELECT
        b.annee,
        b.mois_num AS mois,
        b.compte,
        b.libelleCompte,
        b.mois AS date_mois,
        NVL(em.soldeDebit, 0) AS soldeDebit,
        NVL(em.soldeCredit, 0) AS soldeCredit,
        NVL(ec.cumulDebit, 0) AS cumulDebit,
        NVL(ec.cumulCredit, 0) AS cumulCredit
        FROM
        base_comptes_periode b
        LEFT JOIN ecritures_mensuelles em ON b.compte = em.compte AND b.mois = em.mois
        LEFT JOIN ecritures_mensuelles_cumuls ec ON b.compte = ec.compte AND b.mois = ec.mois
        )
SELECT
    annee,
    mois,
    compte,
    libelleCompte,
    ROUND(soldeDebit, 2) AS debit,
    ROUND(soldeCredit, 2) AS credit,
    TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(compte, 1, 3)) AS compte3,
    TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(compte, 1, 2)) AS compte2,
    ROUND(
            SUM(cumulDebit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY compte ORDER BY date_mois
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ), 2
    ) AS cumulDebit,
    ROUND(
            SUM(cumulCredit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY compte ORDER BY date_mois
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ), 2
    ) AS cumulCredit
FROM
    fusion_comptes_mois
ORDER BY
    compte, annee, mois;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_BILAN_SECTION_COMPTE_COMPLET" ("ID", "IDBILANSECTION", "EXERCICE", "COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT") AS
SELECT 
bsc.ID ,
bsc.IDBILANSECTION ,
ce.ID AS exercice ,
bsc.COMPTE ,
sum(nvl(cse.DEBIT,0)) AS debit,
sum(nvl(cse.CREDIT,0)) AS credit
FROM BILAN_SECTION_COMPTE bsc
JOIN COMPTA_EXERCICE ce ON 1=1
JOIN BILANSECTION b ON b.ID = bsc.IDBILANSECTION 
LEFT JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse ON cse.COMPTE = bsc.COMPTE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) = ce.id 
GROUP BY bsc.ID,bsc.IDBILANSECTION,ce.ID,bsc.COMPTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_CATEGORIEINGREDIENT" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE") AS
select c.id, val, desce from CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c where ACTIF > 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_CLASSEETFICHE" ("ID", "CLASSE", "FICHE", "LIBELLE") AS
select
    id, classe, fiche,
    nvl(libelle, REGEXP_SUBSTR(classe, '[^\.]+', 1, REGEXP_COUNT(classe, '\.') + 1)) as libelle
from CLASSEETFICHE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_COMPTA_COMPTE" ("ID", "COMPTEINT", "COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "TYPECOMPTE", "CLASSY", "ANALYTIQUE_OBLI", "IDJOURNAL", "CODEIMPOT") AS
SELECT
