CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_COMPTA_ETAT_BALANCE" ("EXERCICE", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOISDEBUT", "MOISFIN", "DEBUTCOMPTE", "FINCOMPTE", "ETAT") AS
select
    CAST(0 AS int) as exercice,
    CAST(' ' AS varchar(1)) as typeCompte,
    CAST(0 AS int) as moisDebut,
    CAST(0 AS int) as moisFin,
    CAST(' ' AS varchar(1)) as debutCompte,
    CAST(' ' AS varchar(1)) as finCompte,
    CAST(0 AS int) as etat
from dual;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_CV_SCORE_GLOBAL" ("IDCV", "IDFICHEPOSTE", "NBCOMPETENCES", "NBCOMPETENCESVALIDES", "NBCOMPETENCESNONVALIDES", "SCORE") AS
SELECT
    v.IDCV                                          AS idCv,
    v.IDFICHEPOSTE                                  AS idFichePoste,
    COUNT(*)                                        AS nbCompetences,
    SUM(v.ESTVALIDE)                                AS nbCompetencesValides,
    COUNT(*) - SUM(v.ESTVALIDE)                     AS nbCompetencesNonValides,
    ROUND((SUM(v.ESTVALIDE) / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2)   AS score
FROM V_MATCHING_CV_FP v
GROUP BY
    v.IDCV,
    v.IDFICHEPOSTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_DETAILSBONCAISSECLIENTRESTE" ("ID", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "RESTE") AS
SELECT
	d.IDCLIENT as ID,
	d.IDCLIENTLIB,
	d.IDCAISSE,
	d.IDCAISSELIB,
	d.IDPOINT,
	d.IDPOINTLIB,
	sum(d.DEBIT) as DEBIT,
	sum(d.CREDIT) as CREDIT,
	sum(d.CREDIT)-sum(d.DEBIT) AS reste
FROM
	DetailsBonCaisseCpl d
GROUP by
	d.IDCAISSE,
	d.IDCAISSELIB,
	d.IDPOINT,
	d.IDPOINTLIB,
	d.IDCLIENT,
	d.IDCLIENTLIB;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_DUREE_AGREGEE_TRAVAUX" ("REFOBJET", "DUREE_REELLE_TOTAL_HEURES", "ECART_ENREGISTRE") AS
SELECT
    REFOBJET,
    SUM(DUREE_HEURES_DECIMALE) AS DUREE_REELLE_TOTAL_HEURES,
    MAX(ECART) AS ECART_ENREGISTRE
FROM V_DUREE_REELLE_TRAVAUX
GROUP BY REFOBJET;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_DUREE_REELLE_TRAVAUX" ("REFOBJET", "OBJET", "ACTION", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "DUREE_HEURES_DECIMALE", "ECART") AS
SELECT
    p.REFOBJET,
    p.OBJET,
    p.ACTION,
    p.DATEHISTORIQUE,
    p.HEURE,
    CASE
        WHEN p.HEURE IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(p.HEURE, 1, INSTR(p.HEURE, ':') - 1)) +
            (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(p.HEURE, INSTR(p.HEURE, ':') + 1)) / 60)
        ELSE NULL
        END AS DUREE_HEURES_DECIMALE,
    p.ECART
FROM PROCESS p
WHERE p.REFOBJET IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_DUREE_TRAVAUX_MACHINE" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "DESCRIPTIONOBJET", "DATY", "ID_TRAVAUX", "DUREE_ESTIMATIVE_HEURES", "DUREE_REELLE_HEURES", "ECART_HEURES", "ECART_POURCENTAGE", "ECART_ENREGISTRE") AS
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN aim.id IS NULL THEN ai.id
        ELSE aim.id
        END AS idIngredients,
    CASE
        WHEN aim.libelle IS NULL THEN ai.descriptionObjet
        ELSE aim.libelle
        END AS DESCRIPTIONOBJET,
    t.DATY,
    t.ID AS ID_TRAVAUX,
    NVL(t.DUREEESTIMATIF, 0) AS DUREE_ESTIMATIVE_HEURES,
    COALESCE(vd.DUREE_REELLE_TOTAL_HEURES, 0) AS DUREE_REELLE_HEURES,
    COALESCE(vd.DUREE_REELLE_TOTAL_HEURES, 0) - COALESCE (t.DUREEESTIMATIF, 0) AS ECART_HEURES,
    CASE
        WHEN t.DUREEESTIMATIF > 0 THEN
            ROUND(((COALESCE(vd.DUREE_REELLE_TOTAL_HEURES, 0) - t.DUREEESTIMATIF) / t.DUREEESTIMATIF) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
        END AS ECART_POURCENTAGE,
    vd.ECART_ENREGISTRE
FROM ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE o
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS aim
                   ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = aim.ID
         LEFT JOIN as_ingredient_maintenance ai
                   ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = ai.ID
         JOIN TRAVAUX t
              ON o.id = t.IDOFFILLE
         LEFT JOIN V_DUREE_AGREGEE_TRAVAUX vd
                   ON vd.REFOBJET = t.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATCAISSE" ("IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "RESTE", "TAUX", "RESTEAR", "DATY", "ID", "DATEDERNIERREPORT", "MONTANTDERNIERREPORT", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDTYPECAISSE", "IDTYPECAISSELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
WITH MAX_INVENTAIRE AS (
    -- Etape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide et la quantite par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT REP.IDCAISSE,
           MAX(REP.DATY)                                             AS MAX_DATY,
           MAX(REP.MONTANT) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY REP.DATY) AS MONTANT_MAX_DATY
    FROM REPORTCAISSEAVECHEURE REP
    WHERE REP.ETAT >= 11 --and rep.DATY<=TO_DATE('27/07/2026','DD-MM-YYYY')
    GROUP BY REP.IDCAISSE),
     TAUXCHANGEMAX
         AS (SELECT MAX(TAU.TAUX) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY TAU.DATY) AS TAUX,
                    TAU.IDDEVISE                                           AS TAUXIDDEVISE,
                    MAX(TAU.DATY)                                          AS TAUXDATY
             FROM TAUXDECHANGE TAU
             GROUP BY IDDEVISE),
     SOMME_PRECALC AS (SELECT C.ID                              AS IDCAISSE,
                              C.VAL                             AS IDCAISSELIB,
                              NVL(SUM(CASE
                                          WHEN MFF.DATY > NVL(INV.MAX_DATY, DATE '2025-01-01') THEN MFF.CREDIT
                                          ELSE 0 END), 0)       AS CREDIT,

                              NVL(SUM(CASE
                                          WHEN MFF.DATY > NVL(INV.MAX_DATY, DATE '2025-01-01') THEN MFF.DEBIT
                                          ELSE 0 END), 0)       AS DEBIT,
                              MAX(INV.MAX_DATY)                 AS DATEDERNIERREPORT,
                              NVL(MAX(INV.MONTANT_MAX_DATY), 0) AS MONTANTDERNIERREPORT,
                              C.IDPOINT,
                              P.VAL                             AS IDPOINTLIB,
                              C.IDTYPECAISSE,
                              TYP.VAL                           AS IDTYPECAISSELIB,
                              C.IDDEVISE,
                              MAX(TAU.TAUX)                     AS TAUX
                       FROM CAISSE C
                                LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEAVECHEURE MFF
                                          ON MFF.IDCAISSE = C.ID AND MFF.ETAT >= 11 AND MFF.IDREPORT IS NOT NULL-- and mff.DATY<=TO_DATE('27/07/2026','DD-MM-YYYY')
                                JOIN MAX_INVENTAIRE INV ON INV.IDCAISSE = C.ID
                                LEFT JOIN TAUXCHANGEMAX TAU ON TAU.TAUXIDDEVISE = C.IDDEVISE
                                LEFT JOIN POINT P ON P.ID = C.IDPOINT
                                LEFT JOIN TYPECAISSE TYP ON TYP.ID = C.IDTYPECAISSE
                       GROUP BY C.ID, C.IDPOINT, P.VAL, C.IDTYPECAISSE, TYP.VAL, C.VAL, C.IDDEVISE)
-- Selection finale
SELECT IDCAISSE,
       IDCAISSELIB || ' (' || NVL(IDDEVISE, 'AR') || ')'                             AS IDCAISSELIB,
       CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                 AS CREDIT,
       CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                  AS DEBIT,
       CAST(MONTANTDERNIERREPORT + CREDIT - DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                  AS RESTE,
       CAST(NVL(TAUX, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                           AS TAUX,
       CAST((MONTANTDERNIERREPORT + CREDIT - DEBIT) * NVL(TAUX, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS RESTEAR,
       DATE '2025-01-01'                                                             AS DATY,
       IDCAISSE                                                                      AS ID,
       DATEDERNIERREPORT,
       CAST(MONTANTDERNIERREPORT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                   AS MONTANTDERNIERREPORT,
       IDPOINT,
       IDPOINTLIB,
       IDTYPECAISSE,
       IDTYPECAISSELIB,
       (IDCAISSELIB || ' | ' || IDPOINTLIB || ' | ' || IDTYPECAISSELIB || ' | ' || DATEDERNIERREPORT) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM SOMME_PRECALC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATCAISSE_CLOTURE" ("ID", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDTYPECAISSE", "IDTYPECAISSELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "DATEDERNIERREPORT", "MONTANTDERNIERREPORT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "RESTE", "DEVISE") AS
SELECT
    r.ID,
    r.IDCAISSE,
    c.val AS idcaisseLib,
    c.idtypecaisse,
    tc.desce AS idtypecaisselib,
    c.idpoint,
    p.desce AS idpointlib,
    r.DATY AS dateDernierReport,
    CAST(NVL(((r.MONTANT + NVL(mvtAv.CREDIT - mvtAv.DEBIT, 0)) * taux.taux), 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantDernierReport,
    CAST(NVL(mvt.debit, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS debit,
    CAST(NVL(mvt.credit, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS credit,
    CAST((NVL(mvt.credit, 0) - NVL(mvt.debit, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS reste,
    'AR' AS devise
FROM REPORTCAISSE_deVISE r,
     (
         SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                 MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
         FROM REPORTCAISSE_deVISE r
         WHERE r.ETAT = 11
           AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
     ) rm,
     (
         SELECT  m.IDCAISSE,
                 SUM(NVL((m.DEBIT * t.taux),0)) AS DEBIT,
                 SUM(NVL((m.CREDIT * t.taux),0)) AS CREDIT
         FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_VISE m,
              (
                  SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                          MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
                  FROM REPORTCAISSE r
                  WHERE r.ETAT = 11
                    AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
              ) rm,
              (
                  SELECT ta.*
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
                       (
                           SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                           FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                           WHERE daty <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                           GROUP BY iddevise
                       ) tmax
                  WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
                    AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
              ) t
         WHERE m.IDDEVISE = t.iddevise(+)
           AND m.IDCAISSE = rm.idcaisse(+)
           AND m.DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
           AND m.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY m.IDCAISSE
     ) mvt,
     (
         SELECT  m.IDCAISSE,
                 SUM(NVL((m.DEBIT * t.taux),0)) AS DEBIT,
                 SUM(NVL((m.CREDIT * t.taux),0)) AS CREDIT
         FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_VISE m,
              (
                  SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                          MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
                  FROM REPORTCAISSE r
                  WHERE r.ETAT = 11
                    AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
              ) rm,
              (
                  SELECT ta.*
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
                       (
                           SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                           FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                           WHERE daty <=TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                           GROUP BY iddevise
                       ) tmax
                  WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
                    AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
              ) t
         WHERE m.IDDEVISE = t.iddevise(+)
           AND m.IDCAISSE = rm.idcaisse(+)
           AND m.DATY >= maxDateReport
           AND m.DATY < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY m.IDCAISSE
     ) mvtAv,
     (
         SELECT ta.*
         FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
              (
                  SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                  WHERE daty <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY iddevise
              ) tmax
         WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
           AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
     ) taux,
     CAISSE c,
     TYPECAISSE tc,
     POINT p
WHERE r.DATY = rm.maxDateReport
  AND r.IDDEVISE = taux.iddevise(+)
  AND r.ETAT = 11
  AND r.IDCAISSE = rm.IDCAISSE
  AND r.IDCAISSE = c.ID(+)
  AND r.IDCAISSE = mvt.idcaisse(+)
  AND r.IDCAISSE = mvtAv.idcaisse(+)
  AND c.IDTYPECAISSE = tc.ID(+)
  AND c.IDPOINT = p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATCAISSE_DEVISE_AR" ("IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "RESTE", "TAUX", "RESTEAR", "DATY", "ID", "DATEDERNIERREPORT", "MONTANTDERNIERREPORT", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDTYPECAISSE", "IDTYPECAISSELIB") AS
select "IDCAISSE","IDCAISSELIB","CREDIT","DEBIT","RESTE","TAUX","RESTEAR","DATY","ID","DATEDERNIERREPORT","MONTANTDERNIERREPORT","IDPOINT","IDPOINTLIB","IDTYPECAISSE","IDTYPECAISSELIB" from v_Etatcaisse;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDTYPEPRODUIT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATEDERNIERINVENTAIRE", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX") AS
SELECT inv.IDPRODUIT AS                                               ID,
       p.desce       AS                                               idproduitLib,
       p.IDTYPEPRODUIT,
       tp.desce      AS                                               idtypeproduitlib,
       inv.idmagasin,
       mag.desce     AS                                               idmagasinlib,
       inv.DATY                                                       dateDernierinventaire,
       CAST(NVL(inv.QUANTITE, 0)  AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                          QUANTITE,
       NVL(mvt.ENTREE, 0)                                             ENTREE,
       NVL(mvt.SORTIE, 0)                                             SORTIE,
       NVL(mvt.ENTREE, 0) + NVL(inv.QUANTITE, 0) - NVL(mvt.SORTIE, 0) reste,
       p.IDUNITE,
       u.desce       AS                                               idunitelib,
       CAST(NVL(p.PUVENTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                       PUVENTE,
       mag.IDPOINT,
       mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
       p.seuilmin,
       p.seuilmax
FROM INVENTAIRE_FILLE_CPL inv,
     (
         SELECT inv.IDPRODUIT,
                inv.IDMAGASIN,
                MAX(inv.DATY) maxDateInventaire
         FROM INVENTAIRE_FILLE_CPL inv
         WHERE inv.ETAT = 11
           AND inv.DATY <= SYSDATE --- dateMin
         GROUP BY inv.IDPRODUIT, inv.IDMAGASIN
     ) invm,
     (
         SELECT m.IDPRODUIT,
                dinv.IDMAGASIN,
                SUM(nvl(m.ENTREE, 0)) ENTREE,
                SUM(nvl(m.SORTIE, 0)) SORTIE
         FROM MVTSTOCKFILLELIB_VISE m,
              (
                  SELECT inv.IDPRODUIT,
                         inv.IDMAGASIN,
                         MAX(inv.DATY) maxDateInventaire
                  FROM INVENTAIRE_FILLE_CPL inv
                  WHERE inv.ETAT = 11
                    AND inv.DATY <= SYSDATE --- dateMin
                  GROUP BY inv.IDPRODUIT, inv.IDMAGASIN
              ) dinv
         WHERE m.IDPRODUIT = dinv.IDPRODUIT(+)
           AND m.IDMAGASIN = dinv.IDMAGASIN(+)
           AND m.DATY > dinv.maxDateInventaire
           AND m.DATY <= SYSDATE -- dateMax
         GROUP BY m.IDPRODUIT, dinv.IDMAGASIN
     ) mvt,
     produit p,
     type_produit tp,
     magasin mag,
     unite u
WHERE inv.DATY = invm.maxDateInventaire
  AND inv.IDMAGASIN = invm.IDMAGASIN
  AND inv.IDPRODUIT = invm.IDPRODUIT
  AND inv.IDPRODUIT = mvt.IDPRODUIT(+)
  AND inv.IDMAGASIN = mvt.IDMAGASIN(+)
  AND inv.IDPRODUIT = p.ID(+)
  AND p.IDTYPEPRODUIT = tp.ID
  AND inv.idmagasin = mag.ID
  AND p.IDUNITE = u.ID(+)
  AND ( mvt.SORTIE > 0 OR mvt.ENTREE > 0 )
  AND inv.ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PU", "DATY", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "DATEACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANTRESTE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDPRODUIT,SQ.IDPRODUITLIB,SQ.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,SQ.IDTYPEPRODUITLIB,SQ.IDMAGASIN,SQ.IDMAGASINLIB,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS quantite,cast(COALESCE(SQ.ENTREE,0) as number(30,5)) as entree,cast(COALESCE(SQ.SORTIE,0) as number(30,5)) as sortie,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.RESTE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS reste,SQ.UNITE,SQ.IDUNITELIB,SQ.PU,SQ.DATY,SQ.IDFOURNISSEUR,SQ.IDFOURNISSEURLIB,SQ.DATEACHAT,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.PUVENTE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTE,SQ.IDPOINT,SQ.IDTYPEMAGASIN,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.SEUILMIN,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMIN,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.SEUILMAX,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMAX ,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.MONTANTENTREE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTENTREE,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.MONTANTSORTIE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTSORTIE ,CAST(COALESCE(SQ.MONTANTRESTE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPRODUITLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CATEGORIEINGREDIENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPEPRODUITLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMAGASIN),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMAGASINLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QUANTITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ENTREE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(RESTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(UNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDUNITELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFOURNISSEUR),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDFOURNISSEURLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATEACHAT,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PUVENTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPOINT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPEMAGASIN),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SEUILMIN),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SEUILMAX),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTENTREE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTSORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTRESTE),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT
             ve.id,
             ai.id AS idproduit,
             ai.libelle AS idproduitlib,
             ai.categorieingredient,
             c.val AS idtypeproduitlib,
             ve.idmagasin,
             m.val AS idmagasinlib,
             CAST(ve.quantite AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS quantite,
             CAST(ve.entree AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS entree,
             CAST(ve.sortie AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS sortie,
             CAST(ve.reste AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS reste,
             ai.unite,
             u.val AS idunitelib,
             ve.pu,
             ve.daty,
             ve.idfournisseur,
             f.NOM AS idfournisseurlib,
             ve.dateAchat,
             CAST(NVL(ai.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS PUVENTE,
             m.IDPOINT,
             m.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
             ai.SEUILMIN,
             ai.SEUILMAX,
             MONTANTENTREE,
             MONTANTSORTIE,
             MONTANTRESTE
         FROM (
                  SELECT
                      x.*,
                      COALESCE(b.idfournisseur, invf.idfournisseur, bb.IDFOURNISSEUR,trs.idfournisseur) AS idfournisseur,
                      f.DATY as dateAchat

                  FROM (
                           SELECT
                               ID,
                               IDMVTSTOCK,
                               IDPRODUIT,
                               ENTREE,
                               SORTIE,
                               IDVENTEDETAIL,
                               IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
                               PU,
                               MVTSRC,
                               DATY,
                               RESTE,
                               QUANTITE,
                               IDMAGASIN,
                               IDINVENTAIREFILLE,
                               MONTANTENTREE,
                               MONTANTSORTIE,
                               MONTANTRESTE
                           FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        mf.ID,
                                        mf.IDMVTSTOCK,
                                        mf.IDPRODUIT,
                                        nvl(mf.ENTREE,0)+nvl(s.ENTREE,0) as entree,
                                        s.SORTIE,
                                        mf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
                                        mf.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
                                        mf.PU,
                                        mf.MVTSRC,
                                        ms.DATY,
                                        NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0)  + NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS RESTE,
                                        NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0) +  NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS QUANTITE,
                                        ms.IDMAGASIN,
                                        mf.idinventairefille,
                                        cast((mf.PU*mf.ENTREE) as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTENTREE,
                                        cast((mf.PU*s.SORTIE) as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTSORTIE,
                                        CAST(NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0)  + NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) * mf.PU AS MONTANTRESTE

                                    FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
                                             LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms ON ms.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
                                             LEFT JOIN (
                                        SELECT mf2.MVTSRC, SUM(mf2.SORTIE) AS SORTIE,SUM(mf2.ENTREE) AS ENTREE
                                        FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf2
                                                 LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms2 ON ms2.id = mf2.IDMVTSTOCK
                                        WHERE ms2.ETAT >= 11
                                          AND mf2.MVTSRC IS NOT NULL
                                        GROUP BY mf2.MVTSRC
                                    ) s ON s.MVTSRC = mf.id
                                    WHERE mf.ENTREE > 0 and (mf.MVTSRC is null or mf.MVTSRC=mf.id)
                                      AND (ms.IDCATEGORIESTOCK IS NULL
                                        OR ms.IDCATEGORIESTOCK <> 'CTGST000003')
                                      AND ms.ETAT >= 11
                                )
                       ) x
                           LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms  ON ms.id = x.IDMVTSTOCK
                           LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON b ON b.ID = ms.IDOBJET
                           LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON bb ON b.ID = ms.IDTRANSFERT
                           LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f on f.id=b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
                           LEFT JOIN INVENTAIREFILLE invf ON invf.id = x.IDINVENTAIREFILLE
                           LEFT JOIN TRANSFERTSTOCKDETAILS trs ON trs.id = x.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL
                  WHERE b.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL OR invf.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL or bb.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL OR trs.idfournisseur is not null

              ) ve

                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ve.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON ve.IDMAGASIN = m.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id

                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON f.ID = ve.idfournisseur

         WHERE ve.PU > 0 AND CAST(ve.reste AS NUMBER(30,5)) != 0
     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_DMDACHAT" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PU", "DATY") AS
SELECT
    ai.id AS ID,
    ai.id AS IDPRODUIT,
    ai.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    c.VAL AS IDTYPEPRODUITLIB,
    ve.IDMAGASIN,
    ai.IDMAGASINLIB,
    CAST(SUM(nvl(ve.QUANTITE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS QUANTITE,
    CAST(SUM(nvl(ve.ENTREE, 0))AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS ENTREE,
    CAST(SUM(nvl(ve.SORTIE, 0))AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SORTIE,
    CAST(SUM(nvl(ve.RESTE, 0))AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS RESTE,
    ai.UNITE,
    u.VAL AS IDUNITELIB,
    CAST(MIN(nvl(ve.PU, 0))AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU,  -- On prend le PU minimal si plusieurs
    MIN(ve.DATY) AS DATY  -- Date representative
FROM

    LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
    LEFT JOIN UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
--WHERE ve.RESTE > 0 AND ve.PU > 0
GROUP BY
    ai.id,

    ve.IDMAGASIN,
    ai.UNITE,
    u.VAL, ai.IDMAGASINLIB;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_STANDARD" ("ID", "DATY", "INVQUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITELIB", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "INVDATY") AS
WITH max_inventaire AS (
    -- ?    tape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide par produit une fois pour toutes
    SELECT
        invff.MVTSRC,
        MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty
    FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
             LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
    WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11
    GROUP BY invff.MVTSRC
),
     inv_final_precalc AS (
         -- ?   tape 2 : On r??cup??re les quantit??s associ??es ?  cette date maximale
         SELECT
             invfff.MVTSRC,
             invfff.QUANTITE,
             imm.DATY AS invdaty
         FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invfff
                  LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imm ON imm.ID = invfff.IDINVENTAIRE
                  INNER JOIN max_inventaire mi ON mi.MVTSRC = invfff.MVTSRC AND imm.DATY = mi.max_daty
         WHERE imm.ETAT >= 11
     ),
     somme_precalc AS (
         -- ?   tape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales (sorties/entr??es) sans sous-requ??te corr??l??e cass??e
         SELECT
             mff.MVTSRC,
             NVL(SUM(mff.ENTREE), 0) AS entree,
             NVL(SUM(mff.SORTIE), 0) AS sortie
         FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
                  LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
                  LEFT JOIN inv_final_precalc inv ON inv.MVTSRC = mff.MVTSRC
         WHERE meref.DATY > nvl(inv.invdaty,to_date('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and meref.ETAT>=11
           AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
         GROUP BY mff.MVTSRC
     ),
     main_data AS (
         -- ?   tape 4 : Requ??te principale avec application exacte des r??gles de calcul d'origine
         SELECT
             mf.ID,
             mere.DATY,
             CAST(NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS invquantite,

             CASE WHEN mere.DATY > NVL(invfinal.invdaty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY'))
                      THEN CAST(NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                  ELSE 0
                 END AS ENTREE,

             CAST(NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS sortie,

             CASE WHEN mere.DATY <= NVL(invfinal.invdaty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY'))
                      THEN CAST((NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) - NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                  ELSE CAST((NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) + mf.ENTREE - NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                 END AS reste,

             ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
             ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
             ai.UNITE,
             ai.TYPESTOCK,
             u.VAL AS idunitelib,
             c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
             mf.PU,
             b.IDFOURNISSEUR,
             b.IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
             mf.IDPRODUIT,
             mere.IDMAGASIN,
             m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
             invfinal.invdaty AS invdaty
         FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
                  LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure mere ON mere.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
                  LEFT JOIN somme_precalc somme ON somme.MVTSRC = mf.id
                  LEFT JOIN inv_final_precalc invfinal ON invfinal.MVTSRC = mf.ID
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mf.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON mere.IDMAGASIN = m.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB b ON b.ID = mere.IDOBJET
         WHERE mf.ENTREE > 0
            AND mere.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
            AND mere.ETAT >= 11
            AND ai.TYPESTOCK != 'CUMP'
     )
SELECT
    ID, DATY, CAST(invquantite AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS invquantite, CAST(entree AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS entree, CAST(sortie AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS sortie, CAST(reste AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS reste,
    CAST(reste AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS quantite,
    CAST(reste * PU AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
    idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK, idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib,
    PU, IDFOURNISSEUR, IDFOURNISSEURLIB, IDPRODUIT, IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib, invdaty
FROM main_data
WHERE reste != 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING" ("ID", "DATY", "INVQUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITELIB", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "INVDATY") AS
SELECT
    '' as id,
    '' as DATY,
    cast(sum(invquantite) as number(30,3)) as invquantite,
    cast(sum(entree) as number(30,3)) as entree,
    cast(sum(sortie) as number(30,3)) as sortie,
    cast(sum(reste) as number(30,3)) as reste,
    cast(sum(quantite) as number(30,3)) as quantite,
    cast(sum(reste)* avg(pu) as number(30,2)) as montantReste,
    idproduitlib,
    CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    UNITE,
    TYPESTOCK,
    idunitelib,
    idtypeproduitlib,
    avg(PU) AS PU,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEUR,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
    IDPRODUIT,
    IDMAGASIN,
    idmagasinlib,
    min(invdaty) as invdaty
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_STANDARD
    union all select * from (
    WITH max_inventaire AS (
        SELECT
            invff.IDPRODUIT,imeref.IDMAGASIN,
            MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty
            ,MAX(invff.QUANTITE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS qte_max_daty,
            MAX(invff.pu) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS pu_max_daty
        FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
        LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
        WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11 and invff.MVTSRC is null
        GROUP BY invff.IDPRODUIT, imeref.IDMAGASIN
    ),
         somme_precalc AS (
             -- Etape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales agregees par COUPLE produit/magasin
             SELECT
                 mff.idproduit as idproduit,
                 meref.idmagasin as idmagasin,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS entree,

                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sortie,
                 ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
            ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
            ai.UNITE as unite,
            ai.TYPESTOCK as typestock,
            u.VAL AS idunitelib,
            c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
                 avg(mff.PU) as pu,
                 null as IDFOURNISSEUR,
                 null as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
                 m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
                 max(inv.max_daty) AS invdaty,
                 nvl(max(inv.qte_max_daty),0)as invquantite,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantEntree,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantSortie,
                 nvl(avg(inv.pu_max_daty*inv.qte_max_daty),0) as montantInv, nvl(max(ai.SEUIL),0) as seuil,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMAX),nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0)+1000) as seuilmax,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0) as seuilMin
             FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
                      LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
        LEFT JOIN max_inventaire inv ON inv.idproduit = mff.idproduit AND inv.idmagasin = meref.idmagasin
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mff.IDPRODUIT
        LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
        LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON meref.IDMAGASIN = m.id
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
        WHERE --meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and
          meref.ETAT >= 11
          AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023' and mff.MVTSRC is null
          and not exists(select 1 from V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_STANDARD  ve where ve.id = mff.id)
        GROUP BY mff.idproduit, meref.idmagasin,ai.LIBELLE,ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,ai.UNITE,ai.TYPESTOCK,u.VAL,c.VAL,m.VAL
         )
    SELECT
        null as ID, null as DATY,  cast(invquantite as number(30,3)) as invquantite,cast(entree as number(30,3)) as entree, cast(sortie as number(30,3)) as sortie,CAST((invquantite)+(ENTREE)-(sortie) AS NUMBER(30,3)) as reste,
        CAST(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS quantite,
        CAST((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)AS NUMBER(30,2))AS montantreste,
        idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK, idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib,
        cast((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)/(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie)  as number(30,2)) as pu,
        IDFOURNISSEUR, IDFOURNISSEURLIB, IDPRODUIT, IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib,invdaty
    FROM somme_precalc
    WHERE (invquantite+ENTREE-sortie) != 0)
) GROUP BY
idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK,
idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib, IDPRODUIT,
IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_INGINFSEUIL" ("ID", "DATY", "INVQUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTRESTE", "PU", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITELIB", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "INVDATY", "SEUIL", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "QTEDEMANDE") AS
select eta."ID",eta."DATY",eta."INVQUANTITE",eta."ENTREE",eta."SORTIE",eta."RESTE",eta."QUANTITE",eta."MONTANTRESTE",eta."PU",eta."IDPRODUITLIB",eta."CATEGORIEINGREDIENT",eta."UNITE",eta."TYPESTOCK",eta."IDUNITELIB",eta."IDTYPEPRODUITLIB",eta."IDFOURNISSEUR",eta."IDFOURNISSEURLIB",eta."IDPRODUIT",eta."IDMAGASIN",eta."IDMAGASINLIB",eta."INVDATY",eta."SEUIL",eta."SEUILMIN",eta."SEUILMAX", cast(seuilMax-reste as number(30,2)) as qteDemande from V_ETATSTOCK_ING_TOUS eta where reste<seuilMin and seuilMin>0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_ALL" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATEDERNIERMOUVEMENT", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTRESTE") AS
SELECT
 p.ID AS ID,
 p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
 p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
 tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
 ms.IDMAGASIN,
 mag.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
 TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS dateDernierMouvement,
 ms.quantite AS QUANTITE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.entree, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS ENTREE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.sortie, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS SORTIE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.quantite, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS reste,
 p.UNITE,
 u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
 CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUVENTE,
 mag.IDPOINT,
 mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
 p.SEUILMIN,
 p.SEUILMAX,
 ms.montantEntree,
 ms.montantSortie,
 p.pu,
 ms.montant as montantReste
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS p
LEFT JOIN MONTANT_STOCK ms ON ms.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_ENG" ("ID", "DATY", "INVQUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITELIB", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "INVDATY") AS
SELECT
    '' as id,
    '' as DATY,
    cast(sum(invquantite) as number(30,3)) as invquantite,
    cast(sum(entree) as number(30,3)) as entree,
    cast(sum(sortie) as number(30,3)) as sortie,
    cast(sum(reste) as number(30,3)) as reste,
    cast(sum(quantite) as number(30,3)) as quantite,
    cast(sum(reste)* avg(pu) as number(30,2)) as montantReste,
    idproduitlib,
    CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    UNITE,
    TYPESTOCK,
    idunitelib,
    idtypeproduitlib,
    avg(PU) AS PU,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEUR,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
    IDPRODUIT,
    IDMAGASIN,
    idmagasinlib,
    min(invdaty) as invdaty
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM V_ETATSTOCK_ING
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(mf.ID)                    AS id,
        TO_CHAR(mere.DATY, 'DD/MM/YYYY')  AS DATY,
        0 AS invquantite,
        mf.entree,
        mf.sortie AS sortie,
        mf.entree - mf.SORTIE AS reste,
        mf.entree - mf.SORTIE AS quantite,
        (mf.entree - mf.SORTIE) * mf.pu AS montantReste,
        ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
        ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
        ai.UNITE,
        ai.TYPESTOCK,
        u.val AS idunitelib,
        c.val AS idtypeproduitlib,
        mf.pu AS PU,
        '' AS IDFOURNISSEUR,
        '' AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
        mf.IDPRODUIT,
        mere.IDMAGASIN,
        m.val AS idmagasinlib,
        NULL AS invdaty
    FROM stock_engage_FILLE mf
        LEFT JOIN stock_engage mere ON mere.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mf.IDPRODUIT
        LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
        LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON mere.IDMAGASIN = m.id
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
) GROUP BY
    idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK,
    idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib, IDPRODUIT,
    IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_ENG_PDF" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "RESTE", "SORTIE", "ENTREE", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "PU", "MONTANTRESTE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_ENG_SOMME" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PU", "LIBELLEVENTE") AS
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
    ms.IDMAGASIN,
    mag.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
    sum(CAST(ms.quantite AS NUMBER(30,5) )) AS QUANTITE,
    sum(CAST(NVL( ms.entree, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)))  AS ENTREE,
    sum(CAST(NVL( ms.sortie, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) ) AS SORTIE,
    sum(CAST(NVL( ms.quantite, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)))  AS reste,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
    CAST(p.pu AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS pu,
    p.LIBELLEVENTE
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS p
         LEFT JOIN MONTANT_STOCK_eng ms ON ms.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
WHERE NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) > 0 OR NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) > 0
group by p.ID, p.LIBELLE, p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, tp.DESCE, ms.IDMAGASIN, mag.VAL, p.UNITE, u.DESCE, mag.IDPOINT, mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN, p.SEUILMIN, p.SEUILMAX, p.pu, p.LIBELLEVENTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_MAGASIN" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATEDERNIERMOUVEMENT", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "IDPOINTLIB") AS
SELECT
    aim.ID AS ID,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
    aim.IDMAGASIN,
    mag.DESCE AS idmagasinlib,
    NVL(MAX(m.DATY),TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY')) AS dateDernierMouvement,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS QUANTITE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ENTREE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS SORTIE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS reste,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
    CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUVENTE,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
    pt.VAL AS idPointLib
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS_MAGASIN aim
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON aim.ID = p.ID
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON aim.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK m ON m.IDMAGASIN = aim.IDMAGASIN AND m.ETAT = 11
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKFILLE f ON f.IDMVTSTOCK = m.ID AND f.IDPRODUIT = aim.ID
LEFT JOIN POINT pt ON pt.ID = mag.IDPOINT
GROUP BY
    aim.ID,
    p.LIBELLE,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE,
    aim.IDMAGASIN,
    mag.DESCE,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE,
    p.PV,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
	pt.VAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_POINT" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "DATEDERNIERMOUVEMENT", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "IDPOINTLIB") AS
SELECT
    aim.ID AS ID,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
    NVL(MAX(m.DATY),TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY')) AS dateDernierMouvement,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS QUANTITE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ENTREE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS SORTIE,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(f.ENTREE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(f.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS reste,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
    CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUVENTE,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
    pt.VAL AS idPointLib
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS_MAGASIN aim
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON aim.ID = p.ID
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON aim.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK m ON m.IDMAGASIN = aim.IDMAGASIN AND m.ETAT = 11
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKFILLE f ON f.IDMVTSTOCK = m.ID AND f.IDPRODUIT = aim.ID
LEFT JOIN POINT pt ON pt.ID = mag.IDPOINT
GROUP BY
    aim.ID,
    p.LIBELLE,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE,
    p.PV,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
  	pt.VAL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_TOUS" ("ID", "DATY", "INVQUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTRESTE", "PU", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITELIB", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "INVDATY", "SEUIL", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX") AS
WITH max_inventaire AS (
    -- Etape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide et la quantite par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT
        invff.idproduit,
        imeref.idmagasin,
        MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty,
        MAX(invff.QUANTITE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS qte_max_daty,
        MAX(invff.pu) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS pu_max_daty
    FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
    LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
    WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11
    GROUP BY invff.idproduit, imeref.idmagasin
),
somme_precalc AS (
    -- Etape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales agregees par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT
        mff.idproduit as idproduit,
        meref.idmagasin as idmagasin,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS entree,

        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sortie,
        ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
        ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
        ai.UNITE as unite,
        ai.TYPESTOCK as typestock,
        u.VAL AS idunitelib,
        c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
        avg(mff.PU) as pu,
        null as IDFOURNISSEUR,
        null as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
        m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
        max(inv.max_daty) AS invdaty,
        nvl(max(inv.qte_max_daty),0)as invquantite,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantEntree,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantSortie,
        nvl(avg(inv.pu_max_daty*inv.qte_max_daty),0) as montantInv, nvl(max(ai.SEUIL),0) as seuil,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMAX),nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0)+1000) as seuilmax,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0) as seuilMin
    FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
    LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
    LEFT JOIN max_inventaire inv ON inv.idproduit = mff.idproduit AND inv.idmagasin = meref.idmagasin
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mff.IDPRODUIT
    LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
    LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON meref.IDMAGASIN = m.id
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
    WHERE --meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and
      meref.ETAT >= 11
      AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
    GROUP BY mff.idproduit, meref.idmagasin,ai.LIBELLE,ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,ai.UNITE,ai.TYPESTOCK,u.VAL,c.VAL,m.VAL
)
-- Selection finale
SELECT
    null as ID, null as DATY,  cast(invquantite as number(30,2)) as invquantite,cast(entree as number(30,2)) as entree, cast(sortie as number(30,2)) as sortie,CAST((invquantite)+(ENTREE)-(sortie) AS NUMBER(30,2)) as reste,
    CAST(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS quantite,
    CAST((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)AS NUMBER(30,2))AS montantreste,
    cast((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)/(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie)  as number(30,2)) as pu,
    idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK, idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib,
     IDFOURNISSEUR, IDFOURNISSEURLIB, IDPRODUIT, IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib,invdaty,cast(seuil as number(30,2))as seuil,cast(seuilMin as number(30,2))as seuilMin,cast(seuilMax as number(30,2))as seuilMax
FROM somme_precalc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_ING_VENTE" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "PHYSIQUE", "ENGAGE", "AFACTURER", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANTRESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PU", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT AI.ID                                                                               AS ID,
       nvl(AI.LIBELLEVENTE,ai.libelle)                                                                     AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       M.ID                                                                                AS IDMAGASIN,
       M.VAL                                                                               AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       CAST(VE.RESTE AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                     AS PHYSIQUE,
       NVL(CAST(STE.SORTIE AS NUMBER(30, 2)), 0)                                           AS ENGAGE,
       NVL(CAST(VE.RESTE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) - NVL(CAST(STE.SORTIE AS NUMBER(30, 2)), 0), 0) AS AFACTURER,
       CAST(NVL(VE.ENTREE * VE.PU, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                    AS MONTANTENTREE,
       CAST(NVL(VE.SORTIE * VE.PU, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                    AS MONTANTSORTIE,
       CAST(NVL((VE.ENTREE * VE.PU) - (VE.SORTIE * VE.PU), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))            AS MONTANTRESTE,
       AI.UNITE,
       U.VAL                                                                               AS IDUNITELIB,
       CASE
           WHEN VE.RESTE != 0
               THEN CAST(NVL(((VE.ENTREE * VE.PU) - (VE.SORTIE * VE.PU)) / NVL(VE.RESTE, 1), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))
           ELSE CAST(AI.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))
           END                                                                             AS PU,
       (
           AI.ID || ' | ' || AI.LIBELLEVENTE || ' | ' || M.VAL
           )                                                                               AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (SELECT MF.IDPRODUIT,
             SUM(MF.ENTREE)                  AS ENTREE,
             SUM(MF.SORTIE)                  AS SORTIE,
             ''                              AS IDVENTEDETAIL,
             ''                              AS IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
             AVG(MF.PU)                      AS PU,
             ''                              AS MVTSRC,
             ''                              AS DATY,
             SUM(MF.ENTREE) - SUM(MF.SORTIE) AS RESTE,
             0                               AS QUANTITE,
             MS.IDMAGASIN                    AS IDMAGASIN
      FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE MF
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK MS ON MS.ID = MF.IDMVTSTOCK
      WHERE MS.ETAT >= 11
      GROUP BY MF.IDPRODUIT, MS.IDMAGASIN) VE
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = VE.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT C ON AI.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = C.ID
         JOIN MAGASINPOINT M ON VE.IDMAGASIN = M.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE U ON AI.UNITE = U.ID
         LEFT JOIN STOCK_ENGAGE_FILLE_GP_MAG STE
                   ON STE.IDPRODUIT = VE.IDPRODUIT
                       AND STE.IDMAGASIN = VE.IDMAGASIN
where ai.ISVENTE = 1 and ai.ACTIF = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_PROD_FINI" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATEDERNIERMOUVEMENT", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTRESTE") AS
SELECT
 p.ID AS ID,
 p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
 p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
 tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
 ms.IDMAGASIN,
 mag.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
 TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS dateDernierMouvement,
 CAST(ms.quantite AS NUMBER(30,5) ) AS QUANTITE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.entree, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS ENTREE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.sortie, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS SORTIE,
 CAST(NVL( ms.quantite, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS reste,
 p.UNITE,
 u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
 CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTE,
 mag.IDPOINT,
 mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
 CAST(COALESCE(p.SEUILMIN,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMIN,
 CAST(COALESCE(p.SEUILMAX,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMAX,
 CAST(ms.montantEntree AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantEntree,
 CAST(ms.montantSortie AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantSortie,
 CAST(p.pu AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS pu,
 CAST(ms.montant AS NUMBER(30,5)) as montantReste
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS p
LEFT JOIN MONTANT_STOCK ms ON ms.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
WHERE NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0)>0 or NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0)>0
AND p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT008';

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_PROD_FINI2" ("ID", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDTYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATEDERNIERMOUVEMENT", "QUANTITE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "RESTE", "UNITE", "IDUNITELIB", "PUVENTE", "IDPOINT", "IDTYPEMAGASIN", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTRESTE", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "DATY") AS
SELECT
    p.ID AS ID,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
    ms.IDMAGASIN,
    mag.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
    TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS dateDernierMouvement,
    CAST(ms.quantite AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS QUANTITE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.entree, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS ENTREE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.sortie, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS SORTIE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.quantite, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS reste,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
    CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUVENTE,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
    CAST(ms.montantEntree AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantEntree,
    CAST(ms.montantSortie AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantSortie,
    CAST(p.pu AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
    CAST(ms.montant AS NUMBER(30,2)) as montantReste,
    p.TYPEPRODUIT,
    tpp.val as typeproduitlib,
    CURRENT_DATE AS DATY
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS p
         LEFT JOIN MONTANT_STOCK ms ON ms.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tpp ON tpp.id = p.TYPEPRODUIT
WHERE (NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) > 0 OR NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) > 0) -- Parentheses ajoutees pour la logique
  AND p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT008'
  AND p.actif = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_ETATSTOCK_PU" ("ID", "RESTE", "IDMAGASIN", "PU", "IDMAGASINLIB", "MVTSRC") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_FORMATION_BILAN_PAR_STATUT" ("ANNEE", "NBREALISE", "NBNONREALISEE") AS
SELECT
    pf.ANNEE,

    SUM(CASE WHEN afl.ESTREALISEELIB = 'OUI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nbRealise,

    SUM(CASE WHEN afl.ESTREALISEELIB = 'NON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nbNonRealisee

FROM ACTION_FORMATION_LIB afl

         LEFT JOIN PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pf
                   ON afl.IDPLANFORMATION = pf.ID

GROUP BY pf.ANNEE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_FORMATION_BILAN_PAR_TYPE" ("ANNEE", "NBINTERNE", "NBEXTERNE") AS
SELECT
    pf.ANNEE,

    SUM(CASE WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nbInterne,

    SUM(CASE WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nbExterne

FROM ACTION_FORMATION af

         LEFT JOIN PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pf
                   ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pf.ID

GROUP BY pf.ANNEE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_FORMATION_CROISE_TYPE_STATUT" ("ANNEE", "NBREALISEINTERNE", "NBREALISEEXTERNE") AS
SELECT
    pf.ANNEE,

    SUM(CASE
            WHEN af.ESTREALISEE = 1
                AND af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '1'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS nbRealiseInterne,

    SUM(CASE
            WHEN af.ESTREALISEE = 1
                AND af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '0'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS nbRealiseExterne

FROM ACTION_FORMATION af

         LEFT JOIN PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pf
                   ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pf.ID

GROUP BY pf.ANNEE;

    f.IDTYPEFOURNISSEUR,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_HIERARCHIE_PROFESSIONNELLE" ("IDFAMILLEPRO", "FAMILLEPRO", "SOUSFAMILLE", "CODEROME", "METIER", "EMPLOIE", "FONCTION") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_HS_FABRICATION_DETAIL" ("IDFABRICATION", "IDPERSONNE", "DATY", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50") AS
SELECT
    hp.IDFABRICATION,
    hp.idPersonne,
    f.daty,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,
    LEAST(SUM(hp.HS), 8) AS hs30,
    GREATEST(SUM(hp.HS) - 8, 0) AS hs50
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hp
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p ON f.daty BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
GROUP BY hp.IDFABRICATION, hp.idPersonne, f.daty, p.annee, p.mois;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_INVENTAIREFILLECAT" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "EXPLICATION", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "ECART", "DATEINV", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "MONTANTREELLE", "ECARTMONTANT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "MVTSRC", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS
SELECT v."ID",v."IDINVENTAIRE",v."IDPRODUIT",v."IDPRODUITLIB",v."EXPLICATION",v."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",v."QUANTITE",v."LIBELLEEXTACTE",v."PU",v."ECART",v."DATEINV",v."MONTANTTHEORIQUE",v."MONTANTREELLE",v."ECARTMONTANT",v."CATEGORIEINGREDIENT",v."MVTSRC",
	c.val AS categorieingredientlib
	FROM V_INVENTAIREFILLECPL v
	LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON c.id=v.categorieingredient;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_INVENTAIREFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "EXPLICATION", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "ECART", "DATEINV", "MONTANTTHEORIQUE", "MONTANTREELLE", "ECARTMONTANT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "MVTSRC", "UNITELIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB") AS
SELECT
    i.ID AS ID,
    i.IDINVENTAIRE AS IDINVENTAIRE,
    i.IDPRODUIT AS IDPRODUIT,
    p.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    i.EXPLICATION AS EXPLICATION,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS QUANTITETHEORIQUE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS QUANTITE,

    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS LIBELLEEXTACTE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS PU,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
                - NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS ECART,

    iv.DATY AS DATEINV,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
                * NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS MONTANTTHEORIQUE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
                * NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS MONTANTREELLE,

    CAST(
            (
                NVL(i.PU, 0)
                    * NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
                )
                -
            (
                NVL(i.PU, 0)
                    * NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
                )
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS ECARTMONTANT,

    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    i.MVTSRC,
    au.val as uniteLib,
    iv.idMagasin,
    m.val as idMagasinLib
FROM INVENTAIREFILLE i

         LEFT JOIN INVENTAIRE iv
                   ON iv.ID = i.IDINVENTAIRE

         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = i.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU on p.UNITE = au.id
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = iv.IDMAGASIN
WHERE iv.ETAT >= 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_JOURS_2016_NOW" ("DATY", "JOUR", "SEMAINEMOIS", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "NUMEROJOURSEMAINE", "JOURLIB") AS
SELECT
    d AS DATY,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) AS JOUR,
    CEIL((TO_CHAR(d, 'DD') + TO_CHAR(TRUNC(d, 'MM'), 'D') - 1) / 7) as semainemois,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d) AS MOIS,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS ANNEE,
    TO_CHAR(d, 'D') as numerojoursemaine,
    TO_CHAR(d, 'Day', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS JOURLIB
FROM (
         SELECT TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1 AS d
         FROM dual
             CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LAST_DAY(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
     );

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_LIAISONPAIEMENT_FACTUREFOURN" ("ID", "ID1", "ID2", "MONTANT", "ETAT", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "DESIGNATION", "DATY") AS
select li."ID",li."ID1",li."ID2",li."MONTANT",li."ETAT",ve.id as idfacturefournisseur, ve.DESIGNATION,ve.daty from LIAISONPAIEMENT li left join FACTUREFOURNISSEUR ve on ve.id=li.ID2;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MATCHING_CV_FP" ("IDCV", "IDFICHEPOSTE", "IDFICHEPOSTECOMPETENCE", "IDTYPECOMPETENCE", "TYPECOMPETENCELIB", "COMPETENCE", "NIVEAUREQUIS", "NIVEAUCANDIDAT", "ECART", "ESTVALIDE", "RESULTAT") AS
SELECT
    cv.ID AS idCv,
    cv.IDFICHEPOSTE AS idFichePoste,
    fpc.ID AS idFichePosteCompetence,
    fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP AS idTypeCompetence,
    typ.VAL AS typeCompetenceLib,
    fpc.DESCRIPTION AS competence,
    fpc.NIVEAU AS niveauRequis,
    cvc.NIVEAU AS niveauCandidat,
    (cvc.NIVEAU - fpc.NIVEAU) AS ecart,
    CASE
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU >= fpc.NIVEAU THEN 1
        ELSE 0
        END AS estValide,
    CASE
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU IS NULL THEN 'NON RENSEIGNE'
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU >= fpc.NIVEAU THEN 'OK'
        ELSE 'INSUFFISANT'
        END AS resultat
FROM CV cv
         JOIN FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES fpc ON fpc.IDFICHEPOSTE = cv.IDFICHEPOSTE
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COMPETENCES_FP typ ON typ.ID = fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP
         LEFT JOIN CV_COMPETENCE cvc ON cvc.IDCV = cv.ID
    AND cvc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP = fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MOIS_ANNEE_DISTINCTS" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB") AS
SELECT

FROM (
         SELECT ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2025-05-01', LEVEL - 1) AS dt
         FROM dual

     )

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MOYENNE_SALAIRE_PARFONCTION" ("ID", "FONCTIONLIB", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "MOYENNE_SALAIRE_BASE") AS
SELECT

    pf.desce as fonctionlib,
    pem.annee,
    pem.mois,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.GAIN), 2) AS moyenne_salaire_base

         LEFT JOIN PAIE_EDITIONMOISANNEE pem ON pem.ID = pe.IDEDITION
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.ID = pe.IDPERSONNEL
         left join PAIE_FONCTION pf ON pf.id = pip.IDFONCTION

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MOYENNE_SALAIRE_PAR_FONCTION" ("IDFONCTION", "FONCTION_LIBELLE", "MOYENNE_SALAIRE") AS

FROM PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL_SB sb

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MVTSTOCKFILLEOFF" ("IDPRODUIT", "IDOFFILLE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT
	mvt.IDPRODUIT,
	fof.IDOFFILLE,
	mvt.LIBELLEEXACTE,
	CAST(sum(mvt.ENTREE ) AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS ENTREE,
	CAST(sum(mvt.SORTIE ) AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS SORTIE,
	ROUND(sum(mvt.PU), 2) AS PU,
	ROUND(SUM(MONTANT), 2) AS MONTANT
FROM
	MVTSTOCKFILLELIB mvt
JOIN FABRICATION_OF fof ON
	mvt.IDOBJET = fof.IDMERE
WHERE
	mvt.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY
	mvt.IDPRODUIT,
	fof.IDOFFILLE,
	mvt.LIBELLEEXACTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_MVTSTOCKFILLERENDEMENT" ("IDPRODUIT", "IDOFFILLE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "ENTREE", "PU", "MONTANT") AS
SELECT
	mvt.IDPRODUIT,
	fof.IDOFFILLE,
	mvt.LIBELLEEXACTE,
	CAST(sum(mvt.ENTREE) AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS ENTREE,
	ROUND(sum(mvt.PU), 2) AS PU,
	ROUND(SUM(MONTANT), 2) AS MONTANT
FROM
	MVTSTOCKFILLELIB mvt
JOIN FABRICATION_OF fof ON
	mvt.IDOBJET = fof.IDMERE
WHERE

	mvt.ETAT >= 11

	mvt.LIBELLEEXACTE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_NEXT_FACTURE_FOURNISSEUR" ("PREFIXE", "DATE_FACTURE", "NEXTNUM") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_NUMEROAVOIR_EN_COURS" ("ANNEE_EN_COURS", "DERNIER_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM_FORMAT") AS
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AS ANNEE_EN_COURS,
    NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) AS DERNIER_NUM,
    NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) + 1 AS PROCHAIN_NUM,
    LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) + 1, 4, '0')
        || '/' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)) AS PROCHAIN_NUM_FORMAT
FROM AVOIRFC
WHERE SUBSTR(numavoir, INSTR(numavoir, '/') + 1) = TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE));

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_NUMEROBC_EN_COURS" ("ANNEE_EN_COURS", "DERNIER_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM_FORMAT") AS
SELECT

    NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(NUMEROBC, 1, INSTR(NUMEROBC, '/') - 1))), 0) + 1 AS PROCHAIN_NUM,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_NUMEROFACTURE_EN_COURS" ("ANNEE_EN_COURS", "DERNIER_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM", "PROCHAIN_NUM_FORMAT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_PAIE_RECAP" ("ID", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "IDEDITION", "SALAIRE", "HS_M", "INDEM", "ANCIEN", "PRIME", "AUTRES", "TOTAL", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "IRSA_E", "IRSA_S", "AV_SPE", "AUTRES2", "A_PAYER") AS
SELECT
    p.idpersonnel AS id,
    p.mois,
    p.annee,
    p.idedition,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 1  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS SALAIRE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 2  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS HS_M,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 3  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS INDEM,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 4  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS ANCIEN,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 5  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS PRIME,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 6  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS AUTRES,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 7  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS TOTAL,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 8  THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS CNAPS,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 9  THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS OSTIE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 10 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS IRSA_E,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 11 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS IRSA_S,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 12 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS AV_SPE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 13 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS AUTRES2,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 14 THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS A_PAYER
FROM
    PAIE_EDITION p
        LEFT JOIN log_personnel l ON l.id = p.idpersonnel
GROUP BY
    p.idedition,p.idpersonnel, p.mois, p.annee;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_POINTAGE_TOTAL_HEURE_SUP" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TOTAL_HEURE_SUP") AS
SELECT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_PROGRAMME_INTEGRATION_LIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "MATRICULE", "IDFONCTION", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDSERVICE", "IDSERVICELIB") AS
SELECT
    p.ID,p.IDPERSONNEL,p.DATY,p.REMARQUE,
    lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom AS idPersonnelLib,
    paie.matricule,
    paie.idfonction,
    f.val AS idFonctionLib,
    lp.service AS idService,
    s.libelle AS idServiceLib
FROM Programme_integration p
         JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON p.idPersonnel = lp.id
         JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL paie ON lp.id = paie.id
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION f ON paie.idfonction = f.id
         LEFT JOIN LOG_SERVICE s ON lp.service = s.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_PROG_INTEGRATION_DETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDPROGRAMEDETAIL", "JOURDELASEMAINE", "HEURE", "DUREE", "ACTIONTHEME", "CONTENUE", "IDINTERVENANT", "IDINTERVENANTLIB", "IDINTERVENANTFONCTION", "IDINTERVENANTFONCTIONLIB", "IDINTERVENANTSERVICE", "IDINTERVENANTSERVICELIB", "DUREE_EFFECTIVE") AS
SELECT
    pd.ID,
    pd.IDPROGRAMEDETAIL,

    CASE
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 1 THEN 'Lundi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 2 THEN 'Mardi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 3 THEN 'Mercredi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 4 THEN 'Jeudi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 5 THEN 'Vendredi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 6 THEN 'Samedi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 7 THEN 'Dimanche'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS JOURDELASEMAINE,

    pd.HEURE,
    pd.DUREE,
    pd.ACTIONTHEME,
    pd.CONTENUE,
    pd.IDINTERVENANT,

    lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom AS idIntervenantLib,

    paie.idfonction AS idIntervenantFonction,
    f.val AS idIntervenantFonctionLib,

    lp.service AS idIntervenantService,
    s.libelle AS idIntervenantServiceLib,

    (pd.Duree * 2) AS Duree_Effective

FROM Programme_integration_detail pd
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp
                   ON pd.idIntervenant = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL paie
                   ON lp.id = paie.id
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION f
                   ON paie.idfonction = f.id
         LEFT JOIN LOG_SERVICE s
                   ON lp.service = s.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_QTE_DISPO_LOT_SEXE_QUALITE" ("ID", "IDSEXE", "IDQUALITE", "QTE") AS
SELECT
    m.IDLOT                     AS id,
    d.IDSEXE                    AS idsexe,
    d.IDQUALITE                 AS idqualite,
    SUM(d.QTE)                  AS qte
FROM TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUETDETAIL d
JOIN TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUET m
    ON d.IDMERE = m.ID
GROUP BY
    m.IDLOT,
    d.IDSEXE,
    d.IDQUALITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_RAPPROCHEMENT_OF" ("IDOBJET", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTSORTIE", "QTETH", "PUTH", "MONTTH", "ECARTQTE", "ECARTMONTANT", "ECARTPU") AS
SELECT
    IDOBJET,
    CAST(SUM(SORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS sortie,
    CAST(SUM(PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
    CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantsortie,
    CAST(SUM(QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS qteth,
    CAST(SUM(PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS puth,
    CAST(SUM(MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
    CAST(SUM(SORTIE - QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS ecartqte,
    CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE - MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartmontant,
    CAST(SUM(PU - PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartpu
FROM
    STOCKETDEPENSEOFFABTHE
GROUP BY
    IDOBJET;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_RAPPROCHEMENT_OF_IA" ("IDOBJET", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTSORTIE", "QTETH", "PUTH", "MONTTH", "ECARTQTE", "ECARTMONTANT", "ECARTPU", "IDPRODUIT", "MOTSCLESSS") AS
SELECT SQ."IDOBJET",SQ."SORTIE",SQ."PU",SQ."MONTANTSORTIE",SQ."QTETH",SQ."PUTH",SQ."MONTTH",SQ."ECARTQTE",SQ."ECARTMONTANT",SQ."ECARTPU",SQ.IDPRODUIT,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(IDOBJET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTSORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTETH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PUTH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTTH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTQTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTMONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTPU),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT
             IDOBJET,
             IDPRODUIT,
             CAST(SUM(SORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS sortie,
             CAST(SUM(PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
             CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantsortie,
             CAST(SUM(QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS qteth,
             CAST(SUM(PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS puth,
             CAST(SUM(MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
             CAST(SUM(SORTIE - QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS ecartqte,
             CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE - MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartmontant,
             CAST(SUM(PU - PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartpu
         FROM
             STOCKETDEPENSEOFFABTHE
         GROUP BY
             IDOBJET,
             IDPRODUIT
     ) SQ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_RAPPROCHEMENT_POURCENTAGE" ("ID", "VAL", "DESCE", "MONTANT", "POURCENTAGE", "DATY") AS
SELECT
    ID,
    VAL,
    DESCE,
    CAST(MONTANT AS NUMBER(15,2)) AS montant,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN MONTANT > 0 THEN
                    MONTANT * 100.0 /
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN MONTANT > 0 THEN MONTANT
                                ELSE 0
                                END
                    ) OVER ()
                ELSE 0
                END
        AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS pourcentage,
    CURRENT_DATE AS DATY
FROM RAPPROCHEMENTGLOBALE_PIE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_RECAP_GLOBAL_FORMATION" ("ANNEE", "REF_FORMATION", "TYPE_FORMATION", "TYPE_FORMATIONLIB", "CATEGORIE", "CATEGORIELIB", "INTITULE", "SEMESTRE", "SEMESTRELIB", "INTERNE_EXTERNE", "FORMATEUR", "FORMATEURLIB", "TYPE_COUT_ID", "TYPE_COUT_LIB", "MONTANT_COUT", "NOMBRE_SESSION", "NB_PARTICIPANT_OUVRIERS", "NB_PARTICIPANT_CADRES", "NB_PARTICIPANT_TOTAL", "DUREE_PAR_STAGIAIRE", "DUREE_TOTALE_HEURE") AS
SELECT
    pfa.ANNEE,

    af.REFERENCE AS REF_FORMATION,

    af.IDTYPEFORMATION AS TYPE_FORMATION,
    tf.VAL AS TYPE_FORMATIONLIB,

    af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION AS CATEGORIE,
    cf.VAL AS CATEGORIELIB,

    af.INTITULE,

    af.IDSEMESTRE AS SEMESTRE,
    s.VAL AS SEMESTRELIB,

    cASE af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE
        WHEN '0' THEN 'INTERNE'
        WHEN '1' THEN 'EXTERNE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE'
    END AS INTERNE_EXTERNE,

    af.FORMATEUR,
    f.LIBELLE AS FORMATEURLIB,

    tcf.ID AS TYPE_COUT_ID,
    tcf.VAL AS TYPE_COUT_LIB,

    NVL(cout.MONTANT,0) AS MONTANT_COUT,

    NVL(sess.NB_SESSION,0) AS NOMBRE_SESSION,

    NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_OUVRIERS,
    NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_CADRES,

    NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) + NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_TOTAL,

    NVL(af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,0) AS DUREE_PAR_STAGIAIRE,

    NVL(af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,0) *
    (NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) + NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0))
        AS DUREE_TOTALE_HEURE

FROM PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pfa

         JOIN ACTION_FORMATION af
              ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pfa.ID

-- ? jointures libelles
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_FORMATION tf
                   ON tf.ID = af.IDTYPEFORMATION

         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_FORMATION cf
                   ON cf.ID = af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION

         LEFT JOIN SEMESTRE s
                   ON s.ID = af.IDSEMESTRE

         LEFT JOIN FORMATEUR f
                   ON f.ID = af.FORMATEUR

-- ? sessions agregees
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        IDACTIONFORMATION,
        COUNT(*) AS NB_SESSION
    FROM SESSION_FORMATION
    GROUP BY IDACTIONFORMATION
) sess
                   ON sess.IDACTIONFORMATION = af.ID

-- ? couts agreges
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        afd.IDACTIONFORMATION,
        afd.IDTYPECOUT,
        SUM(afd.COUT) AS MONTANT
    FROM ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL afd
    GROUP BY afd.IDACTIONFORMATION, afd.IDTYPECOUT
) cout
                   ON cout.IDACTIONFORMATION = af.ID

         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COUT_FORMATION tcf

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V_STATISTIQUE_CA" ("ANNEE", "DATY", "CA_DU_JOUR", "MEILLEUR_CA_SEMAINE", "MEILLEUR_CA_MOIS", "CA_ANNEE", "CA_JANVIER", "CA_FEVRIER", "CA_MARS", "CA_AVRIL", "CA_MAI", "CA_JUIN", "CA_JUILLET", "CA_AOUT", "CA_SEPTEMBRE", "CA_OCTOBRE", "CA_NOVEMBRE", "CA_DECEMBRE") AS
WITH CA_PAR_VENTE AS (
    SELECT
        v.ID AS IDVENTE,
        TRUNC(v.DATY) AS DATY,


        SUM(
                NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)
        ) - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS CA_VENTE

    FROM VENTE v

             JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd
                  ON vd.IDVENTE = v.ID

    WHERE v.DATY IS NOT NULL
      AND v.ETAT >= 11

    GROUP BY
        v.ID,
        TRUNC(v.DATY),
        v.FRAISLIVRAISON
),

     CA_PAR_JOUR AS (
         SELECT
             DATY,
             SUM(CA_VENTE) AS CA
         FROM CA_PAR_VENTE
         GROUP BY DATY
     )

SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AS ANNEE,
    TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATY,

    /* CA du jour */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS CA_DU_JOUR,

    /* Meilleur CA journalier de la semaine */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW')
                            AND DATY < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 7
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS MEILLEUR_CA_SEMAINE,

    /* Meilleur CA journalier du mois */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
                            AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS MEILLEUR_CA_MOIS,

    /* CA total de l'annee */
    NVL(
            SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                            AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12)
                            THEN CA
                        ELSE 0
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS CA_ANNEE,

    /* CA par mois de l'annee courante */
    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JANVIER,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 2)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_FEVRIER,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 2)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_MARS,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 4)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_AVRIL,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 4)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 5)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_MAI,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 5)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 6)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JUIN,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 6)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 7)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JUILLET,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 7)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 8)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_AOUT,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 8)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 9)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_SEPTEMBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 9)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 10)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_OCTOBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 10)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 11)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_NOVEMBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 11)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_DECEMBRE

FROM CA_PAR_JOUR;

SELECT
    a.ID,
    a.DATY,
    a.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.LIBELLE AS libelleproduit,
    a.QTE,
    a.PU,
    a.PU * a.QTE AS montant,
    a.LIBELLE,
    a.IDCLIENT,
    c.NOM AS idclientlib,
    a.IDRESERVATION,
    a.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN a.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,
    ai.COMPTE_ACHAT,
    a.IDPRODUIT as IDCHAMBRE,
    ai.LIBELLE as chambre
FROM ACTE a
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai  ON ai.id = a.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = a.IDCLIENT

SELECT 
al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"
FROM ACTE_LIB al

SELECT

    ab.REFERENCE,

    CAST(abf.montantTVA*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTVA,

    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA - abf.remiseMontant)*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC ,
    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA- abf.remiseMontant) * abf.TAUXDECHANGE*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAriary,
