    am.QUALITEOBJET,
    am.ETATOBJET,
    am.LOCALISATIONOBJET,
    am.PUISSANCEOBJET,
    am.OBSERVATIONOBJET,
    am.TYPERATTACHEMENT,
    am.ESTENGIN,
    am.LIBELLE,
    am.DATEAQUISITION,

    ai.libelle AS INGREDIENTLIB,
    am.IDENTITE AS IDENTITELIB,
    qo.VAL AS QUALITEOBJETLIB,
    eo.VAL AS ETATOBJETLIB,
    ld.val AS localisationObjetLib,

    CASE
        WHEN am.ESTENGIN = 1 THEN 'Oui'
        ELSE 'Non'
        END AS ESTENGINLIB,

    l.id AS idligne,
    l.val AS idlignelib,
    am.pu AS PU,

    (
        NVL(am.ID, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(ai.libelle, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(am.IDENTITE, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(qo.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(eo.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(ld.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(l.val, '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(am.LIBELLE, '')
        ) AS MOTSCLESSS,
    ai.parfums AS iddepartement,
    de.val AS iddepartementlib

FROM AS_INGREDIENTS ai
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE am ON ai.ID = am.IDINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN QUALITESOBJETMAINTENANCE qo ON am.QUALITEOBJET = qo.ID
         LEFT JOIN ETATOBJETMAINTENANCE eo ON am.ETATOBJET = eo.ID
         LEFT JOIN LOG_DEPARTEMENT ld ON am.LOCALISATIONOBJET = ld.ID
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE l ON l.ID = am.IDLIGNE
         LEFT JOIN departement de ON de.id=ai.parfums

       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1)*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,
       cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr from AVOIRAchatFILLE vd

select vdc.IDMERE as idAvoirAchat ,cast(sum(montantNonRemise) as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,cast(sum(montantRemiseSansTva) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr

SELECT
    af.ID,
    af.IDMERE,
    af.IDPRODUIT,
    af.QTE,
    af.PU,
    af.REMISE,
    af.TVA,
    af.IDDEVISE,
    af.TAUX,
    af.DESIGNATION,
    af.IDFACTUREDETAILS,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    d.val AS iddeviseLib,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1 Montant HT brut
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST(af.QTE * af.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montant,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2 Montant remise (appliquee sur HT)
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3 Montant HT net apres remise
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantht,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4 TVA sur montant HT net
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST(((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU))) * af.TVA / 100 AS NUMBER(30, 2))AS montanttva,
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5 Montant TTC net (HT net + TVA)
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    CAST( ((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU))) + ( ((af.QTE * af.PU) - ((NVL(af.REMISE, 0) / 100) * (af.QTE * af.PU)))  * af.TVA / 100  ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc
FROM AVOIRACHATFILLE af
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON af.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
    LEFT JOIN DEVISE d ON af.IDDEVISE = d.ID

SELECT AL.ID,
       AL.DESIGNATION,
       AL.IDMAGASIN,
       AL.IDMAGASINLIB,
       AL.DATY,
       AL.REMARQUE,
       AL.ETAT,
       AL.IDORIGINE,
       AL.IDCLIENT,
       AL.COMPTE,
       AL.IDVENTE,
       AL.IDVENTELIB,
       AL.IDMOTIF,
       AL.IDMOTIFLIB,
       AL.IDCATEGORIE,
       AL.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       AL.IDDEVISE,
       AL.TAUXDECHANGE,
       AL.MONTANTHT,
       AL.MONTANTTVA,
       AL.MONTANTTTC,
       AL.MONTANTHTAR,
       AL.MONTANTTVAAR,
       AL.MONTANTTTCAR,
       NVL(M.MONTANT, 0)                                        AS MONTANTPAYE,
       NVL(M.MONTANT, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)              AS MONTANTPAYEAR,

       NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0)                                  AS MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE,

       NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0)         AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           END                                                  AS RESTE_CALCULE,
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) < 0
               THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                        NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
           ELSE 0
           END                                                  AS EXCEDENT_AR,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - NVL(M.MONTANT, 0)                             AS RESTEAPAYER,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(VC.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(SUM_PRECEDENTS.MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS, 0) -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - (NVL(M.MONTANT, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)) AS RESTEAPAYERAR,
       AL.CLIENTLIB,
       AL.TYPEAVOIR,
       VC.NUMFACT,
       (
           NVL(TO_CHAR(AL.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           AL.ID || ' | ' || CLIENTLIB || ' | ' ||  AL.IDMAGASINLIB || ' | ' || VC.NUMFACT || ' | ' ||
           TYPEAVOIR || ' | ' || IDMOTIFLIB || ' | ' || IDCATEGORIELIB
           )                                                    AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM AVOIRFCLIB AL
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGRPAVOIR_LP M
                   ON AL.ID = M.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_CPL_SANSAVOIR VC
                   ON VC.ID = AL.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT A2.IDVENTE,
                           A2.ID                AS IDCOURANT,
                           SUM(A1.MONTANTTTCAR) AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_PRECEDENTS
                    FROM AVOIRFCLIB A1
                             JOIN AVOIRFCLIB A2 ON A1.IDVENTE = A2.IDVENTE
                    WHERE A1.ETAT <> 0
                      AND (A1.DATY < A2.DATY OR (A1.DATY = A2.DATY AND A1.ID < A2.ID))
                    GROUP BY A2.IDVENTE, A2.ID) SUM_PRECEDENTS
                   ON SUM_PRECEDENTS.IDVENTE = AL.IDVENTE
                       AND SUM_PRECEDENTS.IDCOURANT = AL.ID

       nvl(M.montant, 0)                                        AS MONTANTPAYE,
       NVL(M.montant, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)              AS MONTANTPAYEAR,

       NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)                                  AS MONTANT_RESTE_FACTURE ,

       0         AS MONTANT_AVOIRS_ANTERIEURS,
       -- Cas 1 : facture deja soldee -> chaque avoir = credit direct (exedent)
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           END                                                  AS RESTE_CALCULE,
       -- Excedent a rembourser ou a reporter
       CASE
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
           WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) < 0
               THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                        NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
           ELSE 0
           END                                                  AS EXCEDENT_AR,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - NVL(M.montant, 0)                             AS resteapayer,
       (CASE
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0) = 0 THEN NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)
            WHEN NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  - NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) <
                 0
                THEN ABS(NVL(AL.MONTANTRESTE, 0)  -
                         NVL(AL.MONTANTTTCAR, 0))
            ELSE 0
           END) - (NVL(M.montant, 0) * NVL(AL.TAUXDECHANGE, 0)) AS resteapayerar,
       AL.clientlib,
       AL.Typeavoir,
       AL.NUMFACT

SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                  AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) -
            ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
             (bcf.ristourne / 100)) -
            nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       cast(((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
               100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                               (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                     ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                     100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                                nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                               nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)))*bcf.TAUX as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,bcf.taux,
       bcf.remiseArbiochem,
       bcf.ristourneArbiochem
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC

SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                  AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       -- montantRemise : remise classique (%) + remise Arbiochem (montant fixe par unite)
       cast((((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))+ (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem,0) * bcf.QUANTITE)) as number(30, 2))          as montantdelaremise,

       -- montantristourne : ristourne classique (%) + ristourne Arbiochem (montant fixe par unite)
       cast(
               ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                   + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              as montantristourne,

       -- montantremise : base HT nette = brut - remise% - ristourne% (incl. ristourneArbiochem) - frais transport - remiseArbiochem
       cast(
               NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                   - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                   - (
                   ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                    (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                       + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                   )
                   - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                   - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              as montantremise,

       -- MONTANTTVA : TVA calculee sur le nouveau montantremise (donc corrigee des montants Arbiochem)
       CAST(
               (
                   (NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                       - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                       - (
                        ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                         (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                            + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                        )
                       - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                       - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,

       -- MONTANTTTC : montantremise (corrige) + MONTANTTVA (corrigee)
       cast(
               (
                   NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                       - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                       - (
                       ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                        (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                           + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       )
                       - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                       - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                   )
                   + (
                   (
                       NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                           - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                           - (
                           ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                            (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                               + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           )
                           - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                           - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                   )
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTTC,

       -- MONTANTTTCAR : simplifie, les montants Arbiochem sont deja pris en compte en amont dans montantremise
       cast(
               (
                   (
                       NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                           - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                           - (
                           ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                            (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                               + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           )
                           - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                           - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                       )
                       + (
                       (
                           NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)
                               - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))
                               - (
                               ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
                                (bcf.ristourne / 100))
                                   + (nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                               )
                               - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)
                               - (nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem, 0) * bcf.QUANTITE)
                           ) * (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100)
                       )
                   ) * bcf.TAUX
           as number(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTTCAR,

       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,bcf.taux,
       nvl(bcf.remiseArbiochem,0) as remiseArbiochem,
       nvl(bcf.ristourneArbiochem,0) as ristourneArbiochem,
       cast(nvl(blf.QUANTITE,0) as number(30,2)) as qtelivre, cast(nvl(vdbc.qte,0) as number(30,2)) as qteFacture
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC
         left join as_BLClientFilleGrpBCFille blf on blf.IDBC_FILLE=bcf.id

SELECT
    bcf.ID,
    bcf.PRODUIT,
    bcf.IDBC,
    bcf.QUANTITE,
    bcf.PU,
    (nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100 as montantremise,
    nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-((nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)+((((nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-(nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)*bcf.tva)/100)) as montanttotal,
    bcf.MONTANT as montant,
    bcf.TVA,
    (((nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0)-(nvl(nvl(bcf.QUANTITE,0)*nvl(bcf.PU,0),0)*bcf.REMISE)/100)*bcf.tva)/100) as montanttva,
    bcf.REMISE,
    bcf.IDDEVISE,
    bcf.UNITE,
    un.VAL as unitelib,
    i.LIBELLE AS PRODUITlib,
    i.compte_vente AS compte,
    GREATEST(NVL(bcf.quantite, 0) - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0), 0) AS qtereste
FROM
bondecommande_client_fille bcf
JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
    left join AS_UNITE un on un.id=bcf.UNITE
LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille

SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDBC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                                      AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0)    - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)    AS qtereste,   -- nanova qte reste : atao moins qte vendu  avy aminy vente_details_qte_grp
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,
       CAST((bcf.pu/nvl(eq.QUANTITE,1)) AS NUMBER (30,2)) as puingredient,
       nvl(eq.QUANTITE,1) as contenue,
       i.UNITE2,
       bcf.REMISEARBIOCHEM 
FROM bondecommande_client_fille bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc on bc.id = bcf.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT1=i.ID

SELECT SQ."ID",SQ."IDBC",SQ."IDDEVISE",SQ."MONTANT",SQ."PRODUIT",SQ."PU",SQ."QUANTITE",SQ."REMISE",SQ."TVA",SQ."UNITE",SQ."QTEOF",SQ."QTEOFRESTANTE",SQ."QTEFAB",SQ."QTEFABRESTANTE",SQ."QTELIVRE",SQ."QTENONLIVRE",SQ."LIBELLEPRODUIT",SQ."ETAT",SQ."DATY",SQ."IDCLIENT",
       (NVL(TO_CHAR("ID"),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDBC),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEVISE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QUANTITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMISE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TVA),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(UNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEOF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEOFRESTANTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFAB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFABRESTANTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTELIVRE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTENONLIVRE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLEPRODUIT),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT
             bcf.id,
             bcf.IDBC,
             bcf.IDDEVISE,
             avg(bcf.MONTANT) as montant,
             bcf.PRODUIT,
             avg(bcf.PU) as pu,
             avg(bcf.QUANTITE) as quantite,
             avg(bcf.REMISE) as remise,
             avg(bcf.TVA) as tva,
             ing.UNITE as unite,

             nvl(avg(o.QTE),0) AS QTEOF,
             NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(o.QTE),0), 0) AS QTEOFRESTANTE,

             nvl(avg(f.QTE),0) AS QTEFAB,
             NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(f.QTE),0), 0) AS QTEFABRESTANTE,

             AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE, 0)) AS QTELIVRE,
             NVL(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) - AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE,0)), 0) AS QTENONLIVRE,
             ing.LIBELLE as libelleProduit,
             bccli.ETAT,
             bccli.daty,
             bccli.idclient

         FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf



                  LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bccli ON bccli.id = bcf.IDBC
                  LEFT JOIN OfGroupByIdbc o ON o.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID


                  LEFT JOIN fabrGroupByIdbc f ON f.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID

                  LEFT JOIN BLGroupByIdbc abcf ON abcf.IDBC_FILLE = bcf.ID

                  left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=bcf.PRODUIT

         GROUP BY
             bcf.IDBC,
             bcf.id,
             bcf.IDDEVISE,
             bcf.PRODUIT,
             ing.LIBELLE, ing.UNITE,
             bccli.ETAT,
             bccli.DATY,
             bccli.idclient
     ) SQ

WITH deja AS (

    SUM(montant) AS montant,
    TO_NUMBER(annee) AS annee,
    TO_NUMBER(mois)  AS mois
  FROM ca_annee_anterieur
  GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(annee), TO_NUMBER(mois)
),
recalc AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM daty) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daty) AS mois,
    SUM(putotal) AS montant
  FROM vente_details_cpl_2_visee
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM daty), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daty)
),
manquants AS (
  SELECT r.montant, r.annee, r.mois
  FROM recalc r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM deja d
    WHERE d.annee = r.annee
      AND d.mois  = r.mois
  )
)
SELECT montant, annee, mois FROM deja
UNION ALL

SELECT
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom AS personnel,
    pipl.prenom as prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.direction,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pec.annee,

    NVL(s1.brut, 0) AS mois1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur1,

    NVL(s2.brut, 0) AS mois2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur2,

    NVL(s3.brut, 0) AS mois3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur3,

    (NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0)) AS cotisation_travailleur,
    (NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0)) AS cotisation_employeur

FROM
    paie_edition_cnaps pec
        JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl
             ON TO_CHAR(pipl.id) = TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel)
                 AND pec.mois IN (1, 2, 3)

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 1
    ) s1 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s1.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s1.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 2
    ) s2 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s2.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s2.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 3
    ) s3 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s3.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s3.annee

GROUP BY
    pec.idpersonnel, pipl.matricule, pipl.nom, pipl.prenom ,pipl.numero_cnaps, pipl.direction, pec.annee,
    s1.brut, s1.cnaps_travailleur, s1.cnaps_employeur, pipl.dateembauche,
    s2.brut, s2.cnaps_travailleur, s2.cnaps_employeur,
    s3.brut, s3.cnaps_travailleur, s3.cnaps_employeur

SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                                      AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0) - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)                                                                                                        AS qtereste,
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) -
            ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
             (bcf.ristourne / 100)) -
            nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,

        2)) AS debit,
    CAST(sum(credit) AS NUMBER(30,
        2)) AS credit,
    compte,
    etat,
    libelle_compte,
    typecompte,
    mois,
    annee,
    chiffre3,
    chiffre2
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cse.id,
            cse.debit AS debit,
            cse.credit AS credit,
            cse.analytique AS compte,
            cc.LIBELLE AS libelle_compte,
            cse.daty AS daty,
            cse.etat,
            cc.typecompte AS typecompte,
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cse.daty) AS mois,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS annee,
            substr(analytique, 1, 3)|| substr(analytique, 5, 1) AS chiffre3,
            substr(analytique, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse
                JOIN compta_compte cc ON
                cc.compte = cse.analytique
        WHERE
            cse.journal!='COMP000015'
          AND (cse.debit + cse.credit)>0
          AND cse.etat = 11
          AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT
                rs.id
            FROM
                reportsolde rs
            WHERE
                rs.id = cse.id
        )

        --group by   ce.id, cse.analytique, ce.daty, cse.etat, cc.LIBELLE, cc.typecompte , extract(month from cse.daty),
        --extract(year from cse.daty)
    )
GROUP BY compte,
         etat,

         typecompte,
         mois,
         annee,
         chiffre3,
         chiffre2
ORDER BY
    chiffre3 ASC

SELECT
	cse.id,
	(
	SELECT
		MIN(csec.compte) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST
	ORDER BY
		GREATEST(csec.debit, csec.credit) DESC)
	FROM
		compta_sous_ecriture csec
	WHERE
		csec.idmere = cse.idmere
		AND csec.id <> cse.id
		AND (

            (cse.debit > 0
			AND csec.credit > 0)
		OR

            (cse.credit > 0
			AND csec.debit > 0)

            )

    ) AS contrep,
	t.nom AS compte_auxlib,
	t.compteauxiliaire AS compte,
	cse.debit,
	cse.credit,
	cse.libellepiece,
	cse.remarque,
	cse.idmere,
	cse.analytique AS REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT,
	cse.compte_aux,
	lettre.lettre AS lettrage,
	cj.val AS journal,
	EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS exercice,
	cse.etat,
	cse.daty,
	cse.folio,
	CAST(0 AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS coursdevise,
	CAST(0 AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS montantdevise
FROM
	COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse
LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON
	cse.COMPTE_AUX = t.id
LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL_VIEW cj ON

        2)) AS credit,
    compte,
    etat,
    libelle_compte,
    typecompte,
    mois,
    annee,

    chiffre2

            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS annee,
            CASE
                WHEN substr(cse.compte, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
                ELSE substr(cse.compte, 1, 2)|| substr(cse.compte, 5, 1)
                END AS chiffre3,
            substr(cse.compte, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse
                JOIN compta_compte cc ON
                cc.compte = cse.compte
                JOIN compta_journal cj ON
                cj.id = cse.JOURNAL
        WHERE
            (cse.debit + cse.credit)>0
          AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT
                rs.id
            FROM
                reportsolde rs
            WHERE
                rs.id = cse.id
        )
    )

         etat,

FROM (

SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             cast(nvl(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - nvl(mv.montant, 0) - nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR-acg.MONTANTPAYEAR, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
             v.id as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         		  LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2
                  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
                  
                  UNION ALL
                  
                  
         -- CAS 2 : MOUVEMENTCAISSE ? VENTE
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, mvt.IDORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             0 AS MONTANTRESTE,
             mvt.IDORIGINE as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mvt ON mvt.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VENTE v WHERE v.ID = mvt.IDORIGINE)

         UNION ALL

         -- CAS 3 : FACTURE FOURNISSEUR
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             CAST(nvl((cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS number(30,5)) * cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  number(30,5))),0)  AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS MONTANTRESTE,
             v.ID as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR  v ON v.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON v.ID = f3.id
    			  LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON v.id=mv.IDORIGINE

         UNION ALL

         -- CAS 4 : ECRITURE COMPTABLE SANS LIEN AVEC VENTE NI FACTURE FOURNISSEUR
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             NULL AS MONTANTRESTE,
             NULL AS idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
         WHERE NOT  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VENTE v WHERE v.ID = lib.IDOBJET)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f WHERE f.ID = lib.IDOBJET )
                ) SQ
order by IDVENTE desc

    CSE.ETAT,
    CSE.DATY,

    CSE.ANALYTIQUE,

    CE.ORIGINE,
     CASE
        WHEN NVL(CSE.DEBIT, 0) = 0 THEN CSE.CREDIT

LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE CE
    ON CE.ID = CSE.IDMERE

        cm.IDLIGNE,
        cm.VALEUR,
        cm.ECART,
        cm.IDCATEGORIE,
        cm.IDMAGASIN,
        cm.ETAT,
        cm.ANCIEN,

        cm.IDCATEGORIELIB ,

SELECT
    c.ID,
    c.DATY,
    c.LIGNE,
    c.REMARQUE,
    c.ETAT,
    l.VAL AS LIGNELIB,
    NVL(f.CONSOMMATION, 0) AS CONSOMMATION,
    NVL(f.MONTANT, 0) AS MONTANT,
    CASE
        WHEN c.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Chef de Fabrication'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 3
            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Releveur'
        END AS etatlib
FROM
    COMPTEURELECTRICITEMERE c
        LEFT JOIN LIGNE l
                  ON l.ID = c.LIGNE
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                fe.IDMERE AS ID_MERE,
                SUM(fe.ECART)    AS CONSOMMATION,
                SUM(fe.MONTANT)    AS MONTANT
            FROM
                COMPTEURELECTRICITELIB fe
            GROUP BY
                fe.IDMERE
        ) f ON f.ID_MERE = c.ID

    t.DATY ,
    CAST (tr.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS CoutTotal
FROM TRAVAUX_RECAP tr
         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUX t
                   ON tr.id = t.ID
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE o
                   ON t.IDOFFILLE = o.id
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
                   ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = aim.ID
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE l
                   ON aim.IDLIGNE = l.ID
WHERE o.IDINGREDIENTS IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    base.IDMERE,
    base.DATYBESOIN,
    base.IDINGREDIENTS AS INGREDIENTS,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN base.QTEFABRIQUE = 0 OR base.QTEFABRIQUE IS NULL THEN 0
                ELSE base.MONTANTSORTIE / base.QTEFABRIQUE
            END
        ) , 2
    ) / 1000000 AS COUTDEPRODUCTION
FROM 
    OFFILLELIBSTOCK base
    JOIN OFAB fb ON fb.id = base.idmere AND fb.etat >= 11
GROUP BY 
    base.IDMERE,
    base.DATYBESOIN,
    base.IDINGREDIENTS
ORDER BY 
    base.IDMERE

SELECT SQ.IDMERE,SQ.DATYBESOIN,SQ.INGREDIENTS,CAST(SQ.COUTDEPRODUCTION AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS COUTDEPRODUCTION ,
	  (NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMERE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATYBESOIN,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(INGREDIENTS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COUTDEPRODUCTION),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	  SELECT 
	    base.IDMERE,
	    base.DATYBESOIN,
	    base.IDINGREDIENTS AS INGREDIENTS,
	    ROUND(
	        SUM(montantsortie) , 2
	    )  AS COUTDEPRODUCTION
	FROM 
	    OFFILLELIBSTOCK base
	    JOIN OFAB fb ON fb.id = base.idmere AND fb.etat >= 11
	GROUP BY 
	    base.IDMERE,
	    base.DATYBESOIN,
	    base.IDINGREDIENTS
	ORDER BY 
	    base.IDMERE
	 
	) SQ

SELECT
             de.id,
             de.designation,
             de.datyDebut,
             de.datyFin,
             de.etat,
             CASE
                 WHEN de.etat = 1 THEN 'Cree'
                 WHEN de.etat = 11 THEN 'Valide'
                 ELSE 'Inconnu'
                 END AS etatLib,
             nvl(mv.DEBIT,nvl(fd.MONTANTTTC,0)) as montantpayer,
             case
                 when mv.IDORIGINE is null then case when fd.IDBC='CREDIT' then 'Reporte' else 'Non paye' end
                 else 'Paye'
                 END as payementLib
         FROM DeclarationTVA de left join FACTUREDECLARATIONCPL fd on de.id=fd.IDOBJET left join mouvementcaisse mv on mv.IDORIGINE=fd.id

        WHEN t.ETAT = 1

             e.VAL AS idEntiteLib,

             CASE dmd.ESTEXISTANT

SELECT
    d.ID, d.DATY, d.FOURNISSEUR, d.REMARQUE, d.IDMODEPAIEMENT, d.COMPTECHEQUE, d.ACHETEUR, d.IDMAGASIN, d.IDCATEGORIE, d.ETAT,
    f.NOM AS fournisseurLib,
    m.VAL AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    m2.val AS idMagasinLib,
    c.VAL AS idCategorieLib,
    CASE
        WHEN d.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 3 THEN 'VISÉE par Chef de D&eacutepartement'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 4 THEN 'VISÉE par Directeur de D&eacutepartement'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 5 THEN 'VISÉE par Le Directeur'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE par Contrôle'
        END AS etatlib,
    s.LIBELLE AS serviceLib,
    sec.VAL AS idSectionLib,
    d.service,
    d.idSection,
    (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(df.QUANTITE, 0) * NVL(df.PU, 0)), 0)
     FROM DEPENSEDIVERSFILLE df
     WHERE df.IDMERE = d.ID
    ) AS montantTotal,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
            WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
               OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
            THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(mc.DEBIT, 0)), 0)
                  FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
                  WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
                     OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
                 ) - (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(df.QUANTITE, 0) * NVL(df.PU, 0)), 0)
                      FROM DEPENSEDIVERSFILLE df
                      WHERE df.IDMERE = d.ID)
        ELSE 0
        END AS surplusTotal,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
            WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
               OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
            THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(mc.CREDIT, 0)), 0)
                  FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
                  WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
                     OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
        ELSE 0
        END AS renduTotal
FROM DEPENSEDIVERS d
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON d.FOURNISSEUR = f.ID
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON d.IDMODEPAIEMENT = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m2 ON d.IDMAGASIN = m2.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON d.IDCATEGORIE = c.ID
         LEFT JOIN departementDivers s ON s.id = d.SERVICE
         LEFT JOIN SECTION sec ON sec.ID = d.IDSECTION

SELECT d.idpersonnel AS id,
       o.cturgence_nom_prenom AS nom,
       pf.desce AS poste,

       sum(d.taux) AS taux,
       sum(d.juillet) AS juillet,
       sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) AS indemnitedepresentationbrut,
       sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) AS indemnite_de_transport,
       sum(d.avantages_en_nature) AS avantages_en_nature,
       sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) AS montant_brut,
       sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) AS cnaps,
       sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) AS brutcnaps,
       100 * trunc((sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur)) / 100) AS imposable,
       sum(d.irsa) AS irsa,
       round((sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) - sum(d.irsa)), 1) AS netaprescalcul,
       sum(d.reductionpourpersonnesacharge) AS reductionpourpersonnesacharge,
       sum(d.irsanet) AS irsanet,
       sum(d.net_a_payer) AS net_a_payer,
       d.mois,
       d.annee,
       o.dateembauche,
       o.numero_cnaps,
       o.matricule,
       d.idedition,
       TO_CHAR(
               TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(d.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
               'FMMonth',
               'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
       ) AS moisLib
FROM details_paie_edition_pdf d
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet o ON o.id = d.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = d.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pf.id = pip.idfonction
GROUP BY d.idpersonnel, o.cturgence_nom_prenom, pf.desce, d.mois, d.annee, o.dateembauche, o.numero_cnaps, o.matricule, d.idedition

SELECT paie_edition.idpersonnel,
       paie_edition.idelementpaie,
       paie_edition.gain,
       paie_edition.retenue,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NOT NULL THEN cq2.montant
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NULL THEN cq.montant
           ELSE 0
           END AS salaire_de_base,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NOT NULL THEN cq2.montant
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NULL THEN cq.montant
           ELSE 0
           END / 30 AS taux,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS juillet,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000001' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS indemnite_de_transport,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000021' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS indemnitedepresentationbrut,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000201' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS avantages_en_nature,
       0 AS montant_brut,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN paie_edition.retenue
           ELSE 0
           END AS cnaps_travailleur,
       0 AS brutcnaps,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000181' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS reductionpourpersonnesacharge,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000141' THEN GREATEST(paie_edition.retenue, 3000)
           ELSE 0
           END AS irsa,
       0 AS netaprescalcul,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000141NET' THEN paie_edition.retenue
           ELSE 0
           END AS irsanet,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000210A' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS net_a_payer,
       paie_edition.mois,
       paie_edition.annee,
       paie_edition.idedition
FROM paie_edition
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = paie_edition.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification cq ON cq.idcategorie = pip.idcategorie_paie AND cq.idqualification = pip.idqualification AND cq.remarque = '''' AND cq.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification cq2 ON cq2.idcategorie = pip.idcategorie_paie AND cq2.idqualification = pip.idqualification AND cq2.remarque = paie_edition.idpersonnel AND cq2.remarque = pip.id AND cq2.etat = 1

SELECT
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) as MONTANT,
    SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) as qteLivre,
    SUM(bcg.QTENONLIVRE) as qteNonLivre,
    COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0) as montantPaye,
    COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0) as montantRestant,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 22
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 2
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 111
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 11
        ELSE 1
        END as etat,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Payé'
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 'Accompte'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Livré'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 'non livré en totalité'
        ELSE 'non livré'
        END as etatLib
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_GLOBALE bcg
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_accompte ON mc_accompte.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_paye ON mc_paye.IDORIGINE = v.ID
WHERE bcg.ETAT = 11
GROUP BY
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    bcg.IDBC

    SUM(f.QTE) AS qte
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION m ON m.ID = f.IDMERE
WHERE m.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY f.IDBCFILLE

SELECT 
f.ID,
f.LANCEPAR,
f.CIBLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.LIBELLE,
f.BESOIN,
f.DATY,
f.ETAT,
f.IDBC,
f.IDOFFILLE,
f.IDOF,
f.FABRICATIONPREC,
f.FABRICATIONSUIV,
f.EQUIPE,
CASE 
	WHEN f.LANCEUR IS NOT NULL 
	THEN f.LANCEUR||'---'||lp.nom||' '||lp.prenom 
END AS LANCEUR
FROM FABRICATION f 
LEFT JOIN OFFILLE o ON o.id = f.idOffille
LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON lp.id = f.LANCEUR

SELECT F.ID,
       F.LANCEPAR,
       F.CIBLE,
       F.REMARQUE,
       F.LIBELLE,
       F.BESOIN,
       F.DATY,
       F.IDOFFILLE,
       NVL(F.IDOF, OFF.IDMERE) AS IDOF,
       P.VAL                   AS LANCEPARLIB,
       P2.VAL                  AS CIBLELIB,
       F.ETAT                  AS ETAT,
       F.LANCEUR,
       LP.PRENOM || LP.NOM     AS LANCEURLIB,
       CASE
           WHEN F.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 21 THEN 'ENTAME'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 31 THEN 'BLOQUE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 41 THEN 'TERMINE'
           END                 AS ETATLIB,
       F.FABRICATIONPREC,
       F.FABRICATIONSUIV,
       (
           F.ID || ' | ' || P.VAL || ' | ' || P2.VAL || ' | ' || F.REMARQUE || ' | ' || IDOF || ' | ' || IDOFFILLE
           )                   AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM FABRICATION F
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P ON P.ID = F.LANCEPAR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P2 ON P2.ID = F.CIBLE
         LEFT JOIN OFFILLE OFF ON F.IDOFFILLE = OFF.ID
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL LP ON LP.ID = F.LANCEUR

SELECT 
ID,LANCEPAR,CIBLE,REMARQUE,LIBELLE,BESOIN,DATY,IDOFFILLE,IDOF,LANCEPARLIB,CIBLELIB,ETAT,ETATLIB,FABRICATIONPREC,FABRICATIONSUIV
FROM FABRICATIONCPL f 
WHERE etat = 0

WHERE etat = 31

SELECT

WHERE etat = 41

SELECT

SELECT 
ID,LANCEPAR,CIBLE,REMARQUE,LIBELLE,BESOIN,DATY,IDOFFILLE,IDOF,LANCEPARLIB,CIBLELIB,ETAT,ETATLIB,FABRICATIONPREC,FABRICATIONSUIV

SELECT 
ID,LANCEPAR,CIBLE,REMARQUE,LIBELLE,BESOIN,DATY,IDOFFILLE,IDOF,LANCEPARLIB,CIBLELIB,ETAT,ETATLIB,FABRICATIONPREC,FABRICATIONSUIV

SELECT 
    fab.IDINGREDIENTS, 
    CAST(
        GREATEST(
            NVL(SUM(fab.QTE), 0) - NVL(SUM(mvt.ENTREE), 0), 
            0
        ) 
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FabEncours
FROM fabricationFilleFabriqueVise fab
LEFT JOIN MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE mvt 
    ON mvt.IDFAB = fab.IDMERE 
    AND mvt.IDPRODUIT = fab.IDINGREDIENTS
GROUP BY fab.IDINGREDIENTS

SELECT 
f.ID,
CASE 
	WHEN f.IDINGREDIENTS IS NOT NULL 
	THEN f.IDINGREDIENTS||'---'||ai.libelle 
	ELSE f.IDINGREDIENTS
END AS IDINGREDIENTS ,
f.LIBELLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.IDMERE,
f.DATYBESOIN,
f.IDUNITE,
f.IDBCFILLE,
f.OPERATEUR,
f.NIVEAU,
f.IDMACHINE,
f.PU,
f.QTE
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id =  f.IDINGREDIENTS

SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDINGREDIENTS,
	f.LIBELLE,
	f.REMARQUE,
	f.IDMERE,
	f.DATYBESOIN,
	f.QTE,
	f.IDUNITE,
	f.PU,
	ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
	p.NOM || ' - ' || p.TELEPHONE AS operateur,
	au.val AS IDUNITELIB,
	f.IDBCFILLE ,
	f.IDMACHINE,
	m.descriptionobjet AS IDMACHINELIB,
	ai.ISPETRI ,
	f2.IDOFFILLE ,
	CAST( (f.QTE * f.PU ) AS NUMBER(30,5) ) AS MONTANT 
FROM
	FABRICATIONFILLE f
JOIN FABRICATION f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDMERE 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
	ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS
LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON
	p.ID = f.OPERATEUR
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
	au.id = f.IDUNITE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MACHINE m ON m.ID = f.IDMACHINE

SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDINGREDIENTS,
    f.LIBELLE,
    f.REMARQUE,
    f.IDMERE,
    f.DATYBESOIN,
    f.QTE,
    f.IDUNITE,
    f.PU,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS revient,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
    ff.DATY
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = f.IDINGREDIENTS
JOIN FABRICATION ff ON f.IDMERE = ff.ID
WHERE ETAT >= 11

SELECT 
f.idMere,
f.IDINGREDIENTS,
sum(f.qte) AS qte
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = f.idMere
WHERE fab.etat >=11
GROUP BY f.idMere,
f.IDINGREDIENTS

SELECT
f.ID,f.IDINGREDIENTS,f.LIBELLE,f.REMARQUE,f.IDMERE,f.DATYBESOIN,f.QTE,f.IDUNITE,f.PU,f.IDBCFILLE,f.OPERATEUR,f.NIVEAU,f.IDMACHINE, l.id AS idligne,
        l.VAL AS ligne, fab.daty
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
JOIN fabrication fab ON f.idmere = fab.id
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS  
LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.id = ai.typeproduit
LEFT JOIN LIGNE l ON l.id=tp.IDLIGNE
WHERE ai.ispetri = 1

SELECT 
    idingredient AS idingredients ,
    idingredientlib AS libIngredients,
    IDOFFILLE,
    (sortie - entree) AS qte,
    pu,
    (sortie - entree) * pu AS montant ,
    unite AS idunite ,
    au.val AS idunitelib
FROM 
    mvtstockproduit
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = mvtstockproduit.unite
WHERE 
    (sortie - entree) > 0

from FABRICATIONFILLE f left join AS_INGREDIENTS a on f.IDINGREDIENTS=a.id

	JOIN RELEVEFAB r ON r.IDFAB = f.id

select v."ID",v."IDFOURNISSEUR",v."IDMODEPAIEMENT",v."DATY",v."DESIGNATION",v."DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT",v."ETAT",v."REFERENCE",v."IDBC",v."DEVISE",v."TAUX",v."IDMAGASIN",v."IDDEVISE",v."ESTPREVU",v."DATYPREVU",v."NUMERO",v."TYPEACHAT",v."IDTYPEFACTURE",v."IDOBJET",v."IDREF",v."IDDMDACHAT",v."IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE",v."SERVICE",v."TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",v."ECHEANCEFACTURE",v."REMISE", cast(montantRemiseSansTva+ (montantHT* (nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantRemise, montantNonRemise,
       cast(montantHT*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(montantTva*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(montantTTC*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC, montantTTCAr*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantTTCAr, MONTANTHTAR*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantHtAr
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR v left join FFFilleCalcGroupeFF vdcv on v.id=vdcv.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR

SELECT 
ff.ID,
ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
	THEN ff.IDPRODUIT||'---'||ai.LIBELLE
	ELSE ff.IDPRODUIT
END AS IDPRODUIT,
ff.PU,
ff.REMISES,
ff.IDBCDETAIL,
ff.TVA,
ff.DEVISE,
ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
ff.IDDEVISE,
ff.DESIGNATION,
ff.COMPTE,
ff.MOIS,
ff.ANNEE,
ff.QTE,
ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPREVISION IS NOT NULL 
	THEN ff.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.DESIGNATION  
	ELSE ff.IDPREVISION
END AS IDPREVISION
FROM FactureFournisseurFille ff 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ff.IDPRODUIT 
LEFT JOIN PREVISION p ON p.id = ff.IDPREVISION

SELECT
    f.ID,f.IDCLIENT,f.DATY,f.DESIGNATION,f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,f.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN f.etat=0 THEN 'ANNULE'
        WHEN f.etat=1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN f.etat=11 THEN 'VISEE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE'
        END AS etatlib,
    fm.montanttotal,
    fm.montanttotal - fm.montantTva AS montantHT,
    fm.montantTva,
    fm.montantTTC,
    c.NOM AS idClientLib,
    c.TELEPHONE AS numeroClient,
    nvl(fp.credit,0) as montantPaye,
    f.idreservation,
    (fm.montantTTC - nvl(fp.credit,0)) as resteapayerTTC
FROM FactureClient f
         LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENTMONTANT fm ON fm.id = f.id
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = f.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN factureclientpaye fp ON fp.IDORIGINE = f.ID

SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDFACTURECLIENT,
	f.idacte,
	a.libelle,
	f.QTE,
	f.PU,
	f.REMISES,
	f.TVA,
	f.COMPTE,
	f.IDPRODUIT,
	p.val AS idproduitlib,
	CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) )  AS number(30,2)) + CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(f.tva,0) /100)  AS number(30,2)) AS montant
FROM
	FACTURECLIENTDETAILS f
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON
	p.id = f.idproduit
LEFT JOIN acte a ON a.id = f.idacte

SELECT 
f.id ,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttotal,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttva,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2)) + CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montantttc
FROM FACTURECLIENTDETAILS fc 
LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENT f ON f.id = fc.idfactureclient
GROUP BY f.ID

SELECT
m.IDORIGINE, 
sum(m.credit) AS credit
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m 
WHERE m.ETAT = 11 
GROUP BY m.IDORIGINE

SELECT
             f.ID,
             f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
             f2.NOM AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,

             f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
             m.VAL AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,

             f.DATY,
             f.DESIGNATION,
             f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,

             f.ETAT,
             CASE
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CREE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULEE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
                 END AS ETATLIB,

             f.REFERENCE,
             f.IDBC,
             f.IDMAGASIN,
             f.DEVISE,
             f2.COMPTE,

             NVL(NULLIF(f.TAUX,0),1) AS TAUX,

             p.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,

             f.IDDEVISE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTVA,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTTC,

             CAST(
                     NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) * NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1)
                 AS NUMBER(30,2)
             ) AS MONTANTTTCAR,

             CAST(NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTRESTE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE,

             prev.ID AS IDPREVISION,

             CASE
                 WHEN f.estprevu = 0 THEN 'NON'
                 ELSE 'OUI'
                 END AS ESTPREVULIB,

             f.IDOBJET,
             f.IDREF,
             f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
             tf.VAL AS TYPEFACTURE,
             f.NUMERO,
             f.TYPEACHAT

         FROM FACTUREDECLARATION f
                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
                  LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATIONMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE mv ON f.ID = mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN PREVISION prev ON prev.IDFACTURE = f.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_FACTURE tf ON tf.ID = f.IDTYPEFACTURE

SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)                                          AS fraisaccesoire,

       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte
FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT

SELECT v.ID,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))) as number(30,2)) AS montanttotal,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.REMISES /100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100) as number(30,2)) AS montantTva,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100)+SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0)))as number(30,2))  as montantTTC,
                NVL (vd.IDDEVISE,'AR') AS IDDEVISE,
                nvl (vd.tauxdechange,1) AS tauxdechange
         FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE vd LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATION v ON v.ID = vd.idfacturefournisseur
         GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE,vd.tauxdechange

select ff.COMPTE,
       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       ff.etat,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE) as number(30, 2))                            as montantht,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2))              as montanttva,
       cast(sum((pu * QTE) + pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2)) as montantttc,
       ff.iddevise,
       ff.tauxdechange
from FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECPL ff
group by COMPTE, IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, ff.etat,ff.iddevise,ff.tauxdechange

select ff.ID,

SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
       m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VISEE'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.DEVISE,
       case
           when f.TAUX=0 then 1
           else f.TAUX
           end as taux,
       p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
       f3.IDDEVISE,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       CAST(f3.MONTANTTTC-f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,

        WHEN f.ETAT = 0

            THEN 'VISÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    nvl(f.REFERENCE, reff.reference) as reference,

        else f.TAUX
        end as taux,

    CAST(f.MONTANTHT as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTHT,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC as number(30,5)) as montantttc,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,5)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpaye,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)*nvl(f.TAUX,1) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpayeAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR-((nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0))*nvl(f.TAUX,1)) AS number(30,5)) AS montantresteAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantreste,

    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
    LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
    LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON f.id=mv.ID2
    left join AvoirAChatCalcGroupeOrigine av on av.IDFACTURE=f.ID
    LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id

    LEFT JOIN SERVICE s ON f.SERVICE = s.COMPTE
    LEFT JOIN referencefacture reff ON f.id=reff.idfacture
    LEFT JOIN typefacturefournisseur tff ON tff.id = f.TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ce ON ce.idobjet=f.id

SELECT f."ID",f."IDFOURNISSEUR",f."IDFOURNISSEURLIB",f."IDMODEPAIEMENT",f."IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB",f."DATY",f."DESIGNATION",f."DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT",f."ETAT",f."ETATLIB",f."REFERENCE",f."IDBC",f."IDMAGASIN",f."DEVISE",f."TAUX",f."IDMAGASINLIB"
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL f
WHERE f.ETAT = 11

(
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.COMPTE,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 1 Montant HT brut
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montanttotal,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 2 Montant remise (appliquee sur HT)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 3 Montant HT net apres remise
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 4 TVA sur montant HT net
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 5 Montant TTC net (HT net + TVA)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 6 Frais accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(r.montant, 0)                                                 AS fraisaccesoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 7 Montant total avec frais (TTC + accessoires)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(r.montant, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 8 PU unitaire HT + accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(r.montant, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- Info produit & localisation
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte,
       f.IDPREVISION,
       p2.ID                                                             AS idpoint,
       p2.VAL                                                            AS idpointlib,
       m.ID                                                              AS idmagasin,
       m.VAL                                                             AS idmagasinlib,
       c.ID                                                              AS idcategorie,
       c.VAL                                                             AS idcategorielib,
       f.designation

FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m
                   ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT p2
                   ON p2.ID = m.IDPOINT
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON c.ID = p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN REPARTIRIONPGGROUPEE r
                   ON r.IDFACTUREFILLE = f.ID
    )

    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
FACTURE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,

    CAST(NVL(f.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(f.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE vd

       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr
