SELECT 
f.ID ,
f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
f.IDPRODUIT ,
nvl(i.LIBELLE,p.VAL) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
f.QTE ,
CAST(f.PU AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU ,
CAST(f.REMISES AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS REMISES ,
f.IDBCDETAIL,
CAST(f.TVA AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS TVA,
CAST(nvl(f.QTE*f.PU,0)  AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS MONTANTTOTAL,
CAST(
    nvl(
        ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
        + (((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))) * NVL(f.TVA, 0) / 100)
    , 0) 
AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
p2.ID AS IDPOINT,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
m.ID AS IDMAGASIN,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
c.ID AS IDCATEGORIE,
c.VAL AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
f2.DATY AS daty,
f.IDDEVISE
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON m.IDPOINT = p2.ID  
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE c ON p.IDCATEGORIE = c.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON i.ID = f.IDPRODUIT

    LEAST(SUM(hp.HS), 8) AS hs30,
    GREATEST(SUM(hp.HS) - 8, 0) AS hs50,
    SUM( hp.IF) AS if, sum(hp.JF) as JF, SUM(hp.MN) as MN , SUM( hp.HD) as HD
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hp
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p ON hp.DATEFABRICATION BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
GROUP BY hp.idPersonne, p.annee, p.mois, TO_CHAR(hp.DATEFABRICATION, 'IYYY-IW')

SELECT
    pip.id as idpersonne,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,

    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN SUM(hp.HS)
        ELSE 8
        END AS hs30,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(hp.HS) - 8
        END AS hs50,

    SUM(hp.MONTANT) AS montant_total,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE AS idCategorie

FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hp
         JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p
                   ON f.daty BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATION ress ON ress.id = hp.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = ress.IDRESSOURCE

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW'),
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE

SELECT l.id,

       l.remarque,
       l.id_pers,
       l.nom,
       l.prenom,
       l.date_naissance,
       sex.desce AS sexe,
       l.numero_cin,
       l.date_cin,
       l.date_dupl_cin,
       l.nationalite,
       l.adresse,
       l.fokotany,
       l.acte_naissance,
       d.val AS direction,
       s.libelle AS service,
       s.code_dr,
       TO_CHAR(paie.matricule) AS matricule,
       paie.idcategorie,
       paie.ctg,
       paie.indicegrade,
       paie.indice_fonctionnel,
       paie.statut,
       c.taux AS categorieval,
       '' AS ctgval,
       paie.numero_cnaps,
       paie.numero_ostie,
       CASE
           WHEN paie.temporaire = -1 THEN 'Temporaire'
           WHEN paie.temporaire = 0 THEN 'Permanent'
           WHEN paie.temporaire = 1 THEN 'Cadre'
           ELSE NULL
           END AS temporaire,
       CAST(NVL(sc.PLUS , 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS droit ,
       CAST(NVL(sp.CONGEPRIS , 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS prie,
       CAST(NVL(sc.SOLDE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS resteconge,
       paie.etat,
       l.id AS idpersonnel,
       l.direction AS iddirection,
       dp.id AS idDepartement,
       dp.val AS departementlib,
       qp.id AS idQualification,
       qp.val as qualificationLib,
       CASE
           WHEN paie.etat < 1 THEN 'Debauches'
           WHEN paie.etat = 1 THEN 'A Valider'
           WHEN paie.etat = 11 THEN 'Valides'
           ELSE NULL
           END AS etatLib

         LEFT JOIN log_service s ON l.service = s.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel paie ON paie.id = l.id
         LEFT JOIN sexe sex ON l.sexe = sex.id
         LEFT JOIN log_direction d ON d.id = l.direction
         LEFT JOIN paie_categorie c ON c.id = paie.idcategorie
         LEFT JOIN SOLDECONGEPRIS_PERS sp ON l.id = sp.id
         LEFT JOIN SOLDECONGE_PERS sc ON l.id = sc.idPersonnel
         LEFT JOIN departement dp ON paie.idDepartement = dp.id
         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.id = paie.IDQUALIFICATION

    cast(sum(mf.montantEntree) as number(30,2))  AS montantEntree,
    cast(sum(mf.montantSortie) as number(30,2))  AS montantSortie,
    CAST(NVL(ai.PU, 0) * (SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0))) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    m.IDMAGASIN
FROM
    mvtStockFilleMontant mf
        JOIN MVTSTOCK m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = mf.IDPRODUIT
WHERE
    m.ETAT >= 11
  AND mf.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL

    mf.IDPRODUIT,

        THEN m.DATY + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 1, 2)) / 24)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 4, 2)) / 1440)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 7, 2)) / 86400)
        ELSE m.DATY
    END AS DATY,
    m.ETAT,
    m.IDOP,
    m.IDORIGINE,
    m.IDDEVISE,
    m.IDTIERS,
    m.COMPTE,
    m.IDPREVISION,
    m.IDTRAITE,
    m.ETATVERSEMENT,
    m.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    m.IDMVTCAISSEMERE,
    m.REFERENCE,
    m.UPDATED_AT,
    m.DATYCOMPTABILISATION,
    m.ACQUEREUR,
    m.IDTYPEPAIEMENT,
    m.DEBIT,
    m.CREDIT,
    m.TAUX,
    m.HEURE,
    m.idReport
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m

SELECT m.ID,
       m.DESIGNATION,
       m.IDCAISSE,
       c.VAL   AS IDCAISSELIB,
       m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       m.IDVIREMENT,
       m.DEBIT,
       m.CREDIT,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.credit > 0 THEN NVL(m.CREDIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldecredit,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.debit > 0 THEN NVL(m.DEBIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldedebit,
       m.DATY,
       m.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN m.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CRÉÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VALIDÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 8
               THEN 'À COMPTABILISER'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       vd.IDVENTE,
       m.IDORIGINE as idorigine,
       m.idtiers,

       m.IDBC
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m

           END AS etatlib,
       n.lien,
       CASE
           WHEN ( (SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) < 60

               THEN 'il y a ' || FLOOR(((SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60)) || ' mn'
           WHEN ( (SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) < 86400
               THEN 'il y a ' || FLOOR(((SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24)) || ' h'

SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.IDINGREDIENTS,
       SQ.LIBELLE,
       SQ.REMARQUE,
       SQ.IDMERE,
       SQ.DATYBESOIN,
       SQ.QTE,
       SQ.IDUNITE,
       SQ.QTEFABRIQUE,
       SQ.QTERESTE,
       SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE,
       SQ.PV,
       SQ.MONTANTENTREE,
       SQ.MONTANTSORTIE,
       SQ.POURC,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || IDINGREDIENTS || ' | ' || LIBELLEEXACTE || ' | ' || IDUNITE
           ) AS MOTSCLESSS,
       SQ.DATY
FROM (SELECT OFLL.ID,
             OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS,
             NVL(OFLL.LIBELLE, AI.LIBELLE)                         AS LIBELLE,
             OFLL.REMARQUE,
             OFLL.IDMERE,
             OB.DATY                                               AS DATYBESOIN,
             OFLL.QTE,
             NVL(AU.VAL, 'unite')                                  AS IDUNITE,
             CAST(NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))              AS QTEFABRIQUE,
             CAST(OFLL.QTE - NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))   AS QTERESTE,
             NVL(OFLL.LIBELLE, NVL(AI.LIBELLEEXTACTE, AI.LIBELLE)) AS LIBELLEEXACTE,
             CAST(OFLL.PRIXVENTE AS NUMBER(30, 5))                 AS PV,
             CAST(NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) * AI.PV AS NUMBER(30, 5))      AS MONTANTENTREE,
             CAST(NVL(MVT.MONTANTSORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))      AS MONTANTSORTIE,
             CASE
                 WHEN NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) = 0 OR AI.PV = 0 THEN 0
                 ELSE (1 - (MVT.MONTANTSORTIE / (NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) * AI.PV))) * 100
                 END                                               AS POURC,
             OB.DATY                                               AS DATY
      FROM OFFILLE OFLL
               LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS
               LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON AU.ID = OFLL.IDUNITE
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPEDEP MVT ON OFLL.ID = MVT.IDOFF
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKFILLEOFENTREEPRFINI MV
                         ON MV.IDOFF = OFLL.ID
                             AND MV.IDPRODUIT = OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS
               LEFT JOIN OFAB OB ON OB.ID = OFLL.IDMERE) SQ

SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDPRODUIT,SQ.LIBELLE,SQ.REMARQUE,SQ.IDMERE,SQ.DATYBESOIN,SQ.QTE,SQ.IDUNITE,SQ.QTEFABRIQUE,SQ.QTERESTE,SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE,SQ.PV,SQ.MONTANTENTREE,SQ.MONTANTSORTIE,SQ.POURC, SQ.IDPRODUITLIB,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR("ID"),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMERE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATYBESOIN,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDUNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFABRIQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTERESTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLEEXACTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PV),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTENTREE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTSORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(POURC),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS,daty
FROM (
         SELECT
             ofll.ID,
             ofll.IDINGREDIENTS AS IDPRODUIT,
             nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,ai.LIBELLE)  AS LIBELLE,
             ofll.REMARQUE,
             ofll.IDMERE,
             ob.daty AS  DATYBESOIN,
             ofll.QTE,
             nvl(au.VAL, 'unite') AS IDUNITE,
             cast(nvl(mv.entree,0) as number(30,5)) as qteFabrique,
             cast(ofll.QTE-nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)as number(30,5)) as qteReste,
             nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,nvl(ai.LIBELLEEXTACTE, ai.LIBELLE)) AS libelleexacte,
             ai.pv,
             cast(nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)*ai.pv as number(30,2)) as montantEntree,
             cast(nvl(mvt.montantSortie,0) as number(30,5)) as montantSortie,
             CASE
                 WHEN (nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)=0 or ai.pv=0) THEN 0
                 ELSE (1-(mvt.montantSortie/(nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)*ai.pv)))*100
                 END AS pourc,
             ob.daty,
             ai.libelle AS IDPRODUITLIB
         FROM
             OFFILLE ofll
                 LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
                 ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
                 LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
                 au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
                 left join MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPEDEP mvt on ofll.id=mvt.IDOFf
                 left join mvtStockFilleOfEntreePrFini mv on mv.idoff=ofll.id and mv.IDPRODUIT=ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
                 LEFT JOIN OFAB ob ON ob.id =  ofll.idmere

     ) SQ

SELECT
    pe.idpersonnel,
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.gain), 2) AS brut,
    NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur,
    CASE
        WHEN NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN (
                         SELECT plafond
                         FROM conf_cnaps
                         WHERE conf_cnaps.daty >= pe.datefin
                           AND ROWNUM = 1
                     ) < (SUM(pe.gain) * 0.13) THEN (
                    SELECT plafond
                    FROM conf_cnaps
                    WHERE conf_cnaps.daty >= pe.datefin
                      AND ROWNUM = 1
                )
                ELSE ROUND(LEAST(NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) * 13, SUM(pe.gain) * 0.13), 2)
                END
        END AS cnaps_employeur
FROM paie_edition pe
         JOIN paie_rubrique pr
              ON pe.idelementpaie = pr.id
                  AND pr.typerubrique = 'G'
                  AND pr.imposable = 'I'
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pe_1.idpersonnel,
        pe_1.mois,
        pe_1.annee,
        pe_1.retenue AS cnaps_travailleur
    FROM paie_edition pe_1
    WHERE pe_1.idelementpaie = 'PR000101'
) edc
                   ON pe.idpersonnel = edc.idpersonnel
                       AND pe.mois = edc.mois
                       AND pe.annee = edc.annee
GROUP BY
    pe.idpersonnel, pe.mois, pe.annee, edc.cnaps_travailleur,  pe.datefin

    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.dateembauche)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.dateembauche)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.dateembauche)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusembauche
FROM

    jours_par_mois j
WHERE
    TO_DATE(j.annee || LPAD(j.mois, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM') >=
    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.dateembauche, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')
  AND pip.date_depart IS NULL

SELECT

    pip.dateembauche,
    pip.date_depart,
    j.annee,
    j.mois,
    j.nb_jour,
    j.conge_journalier,
    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.date_depart)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.date_depart)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.date_depart)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusdepart,
    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.dateembauche)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.dateembauche)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.dateembauche)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusembauche
FROM
    paie_info_personnel pip,
    jours_par_mois j
WHERE
    TO_DATE(j.annee || LPAD(j.mois, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM') >=
    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.dateembauche, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')
  AND pip.date_depart IS NOT NULL

      TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.date_depart, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')

       p.annee,
       p.mois,
       p.nb_jour,
       p.conge_journalier,
       p.jourplusdepart,
       p.jourplusembauche,
       CASE
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart > 0 AND p.jourplusembauche = 0 THEN p.jourplusdepart
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart = 0 AND p.jourplusembauche > 0 THEN p.nb_jour - p.jourplusembauche + 1
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart > 0 AND p.jourplusembauche > 0 THEN p.jourplusdepart - p.jourplusembauche
           WHEN p.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sysdate ) AND p.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH  FROM sysdate ) THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM sysdate )

SELECT ppe.id,
       pr.val AS code_rubrique,
       ppe.date_debut,
       ppe.date_fin,
       ppe.gain,
       ppe.retenue,
       ppe.remarque,
       (pip.nom || ' ') || pip.prenom AS idpersonnel,
       ppe.etat,
       ppe.id_objet,
       ppe.iduser,
       ppe.moisregularisation,
       ppe.anneeregularisation,
       (cq.idcategorielib || ' ') || cq.categorie_qualificationlib AS idcategorie_qualification,
       pf.val AS idfonction,
       ppe.pourcentage
FROM paie_personnel_elementpaie ppe
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel pip ON pip.id = ppe.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN categ_quali_libcomplet cq ON ppe.idcategorie_qualification = cq.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON ppe.idfonction = pf.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_rubrique pr ON pr.id = ppe.code_rubrique

SELECT
    ppe.id,
    pip2.matricule,
    pr.id AS id_code_rubrique,
    pr.val AS code_rubrique,
    ppe.date_debut,
    ppe.date_fin,
    ppe.gain,
    ppe.retenue,
    ppe.remarque,
    pip.nom || ' ' || pip.prenom AS idpersonnel,
    ppe.etat,
    ppe.id_objet,
    ppe.iduser,
    ppe.moisregularisation,
    ppe.anneeregularisation,
    pr.VAL as rubrique,

    TO_CHAR(
            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ppe.moisregularisation, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
            'FMMonth',
            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisLib,

    cq.idcategorielib || ' ' || cq.categorie_qualificationlib AS idcategorie_qualification,
    pf.desce AS idfonction,
    ppe.pourcentage,

    CASE
        WHEN ppe.etat = '1' THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN ppe.etat = '11' THEN 'VALIDE'
        WHEN ppe.etat = '0' THEN 'ANNULE'
        ELSE 'INCONNU'
        END AS etatlib

FROM paie_personnel_elementpaie ppe
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel pip
                   ON TO_CHAR(pip.id) = TO_CHAR(ppe.idpersonnel)
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification_libc cq
                   ON TO_CHAR(ppe.idcategorie_qualification) = TO_CHAR(cq.id)
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf
                   ON TO_CHAR(ppe.idfonction) = TO_CHAR(pf.id)
         LEFT JOIN paie_rubrique pr
                   ON TO_CHAR(pr.id) = TO_CHAR(ppe.code_rubrique)
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip2
              ON TO_CHAR(pip.id) = TO_CHAR(pip2.id) WHERE ppe.CODE_RUBRIQUE!='PR0000150HS'

SELECT d."ID",d."IDMERE",d."POIDS",d."NOMBREOISEAUX",
       (d."POIDS" * d."NOMBREOISEAUX")                  AS "POIDSNOMBRE",
       CASE WHEN d."POIDS" >= m."LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE"
           AND d."POIDS" <= m."LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE"
                THEN 'Oui' ELSE 'Non' END                   AS "DANSPLAGEUNIFORMITE",
       CASE WHEN m."NOMBREOISEAUXPESES" > 0
                THEN d."NOMBREOISEAUX" / m."NOMBREOISEAUXPESES" * 100
            ELSE NULL END                                AS "POURCENTAGEOISEAUX"
FROM "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL" d
         LEFT JOIN "PESEEPOUSSIN_LIB" m ON m."ID" = d."IDMERE"

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT "IDMERE",
           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX")                       AS NOMBREOISEAUXPESES,
           SUM("POIDS" * "NOMBREOISEAUX")              AS POIDSTOTAL,
           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX" * "POIDS" * "POIDS")     AS SUM_N_P2,
           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX" * "POIDS")               AS SUM_N_P
    FROM "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL"
    GROUP BY "IDMERE"
),
stats AS (
    SELECT "IDMERE",
           NOMBREOISEAUXPESES,
           POIDSTOTAL,
           CASE WHEN NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 0
                THEN POIDSTOTAL / NOMBREOISEAUXPESES
                ELSE NULL END AS POIDSMOYEN,
           CASE WHEN NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 1
                THEN SQRT( (SUM_N_P2 - (POWER(SUM_N_P,2) / NOMBREOISEAUXPESES)) / (NOMBREOISEAUXPESES - 1) )
                ELSE NULL END AS ECARTTYPE
    FROM agg
),
stats2 AS (
    SELECT s.*,
           CASE WHEN POIDSMOYEN IS NOT NULL AND POIDSMOYEN <> 0
                THEN (ECARTTYPE / POIDSMOYEN) * 100
                ELSE NULL END AS COEFFICIENTVARIATION,
           POIDSMOYEN * 0.90 AS LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE,
           POIDSMOYEN * 1.10 AS LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE
    FROM stats s
),
plage AS (
    SELECT s2."IDMERE",
           SUM(CASE WHEN d."POIDS" >= s2.LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE
                     AND d."POIDS" <= s2.LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE
                    THEN d."NOMBREOISEAUX" ELSE 0 END) AS NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE
    FROM stats2 s2
    JOIN "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL" d ON d."IDMERE" = s2."IDMERE"
    GROUP BY s2."IDMERE"
)
SELECT p."ID",p."DATEPESEE",p."IDTYPEPESEE",p."IDRESPONSABLE",p."IDFERME",p."IDBATIMENT",p."IDLOT",p."IDPARQUET",p."IDSEXE",p."REMARQUE",p."ETAT",
       tp."VAL"                                        AS "IDTYPEPESEELIB",
       lp."NOM" || ' ' || lp."PRENOM"                   AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",
       fm."VAL"                                         AS "IDFERMELIB",
       b."NOMBATIMENT"                                          AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",
       l."NOMLOT"                                       AS "IDLOTLIB",
       pq."VAL"                                         AS "IDPARQUETLIB",
       pz."IDSOUCHELIB"                                 AS "IDSOUCHELIB",
       sx."VAL"                                         AS "IDSEXELIB",
       l."DATEECLOSION"                                 AS "DATEECLOSION",
       (p."DATEPESEE" - l."DATEECLOSION")                AS "AGEJOUR",
       (p."DATEPESEE" - l."DATEECLOSION") / 7             AS "AGESEMAINE",
       s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES                             AS "NOMBREOISEAUXPESES",
       s2.POIDSTOTAL                                     AS "POIDSTOTAL",
       s2.POIDSMOYEN                                     AS "POIDSMOYEN",
       s2.ECARTTYPE                                      AS "ECARTTYPE",
       s2.COEFFICIENTVARIATION                           AS "COEFFICIENTVARIATION",
       s2.LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE                          AS "LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE",
       s2.LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE                          AS "LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE",
       pl.NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE                         AS "NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE",
       CASE WHEN s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 0
                THEN pl.NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE / s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES * 100
            ELSE NULL END                                AS "UNIFORMITE",
       CASE p."ETAT"
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDEE'
           END                                                AS "ETATLIB"
FROM "PESEEPOUSSIN" p
         LEFT JOIN "TYPEPESEE" tp ON tp."ID" = p."IDTYPEPESEE"
         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" lp ON lp."ID" = p."IDRESPONSABLE"
         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" fm ON fm."ID" = p."IDFERME"
         LEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = p."IDBATIMENT"
         LEFT JOIN "LOT" l ON l."ID" = p."IDLOT"
         LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" pq ON pq."ID" = p."IDPARQUET"
         LEFT JOIN "SEXE" sx ON sx."ID" = p."IDSEXE"
         LEFT JOIN "PROGRAMMEZOOTECHNIQUE_LIB" pz ON pz."ID" = l."IDPROGRAMME"
         LEFT JOIN stats2 s2 ON s2."IDMERE" = p."ID"
         LEFT JOIN plage pl ON pl."IDMERE" = p."ID"

       COALESCE(SUM(FFF.PU * FFF.QTE), 0) AS COUT,

       dept.VAL                            AS IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,
       (
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.ID), '') || ' | ' ||

           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.ESTPERIODIQUE), '') || ' | ' ||

                           WHEN P.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉE'

           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.PRIORITELIB), '') || ' | ' ||

           NVL(TO_CHAR(O.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(OTF.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(TR.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(E.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(E.VAL), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(O.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(TR.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(

                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE O.ETAT
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE TR.ETAT
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           WHEN 21 THEN 'Entamee'
                           WHEN 41 THEN 'Terminee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(COALESCE(SUM(FFF.PU * FFF.QTE), 0)), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(AI.PARFUMS), '')
           )                              AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM PLANNING P
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE AIM ON AIM.ID = P.IDMACHINE
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = AIM.IDINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN TYPEMAINTENANCE T ON T.ID = P.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE

  		ELSE 
  		TO_DATE((TO_CHAR(p.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || p.HEURE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')

	WHEN p.ETAT = 22

SELECT
    prc."ID",prc."IDPERSONNEL",prc."IDTRAVAUX",prc."DATEDEBUT",prc."DATEFIN",prc."HEUREDEBUT",prc."HEUREFIN",prc."DATETIME_DEBUT",prc."DATETIME_FIN",
    /* Ecart en secondes */
    ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) AS ecart_seconde,
    /* Ecart format HH:MM:SS */
    LPAD(FLOOR(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) / 3600), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 3600) / 60), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 60), 2, '0')
                                                           AS ecart_hms,
    p.NOM AS idPersonnelLib
FROM (
         SELECT
             prc.*,

             /* Date + Heure debut */
             prc.DATEDEBUT
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_debut,

             /* Date + Heure fin */
             prc.DATEFIN
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_fin

         FROM ProcessMaintenance prc
     ) prc

SELECT
    vd.ID,
    vd.IDPROFORMA,
    vd.IDPRODUIT,
    vd.IDORIGINE,
    vd.QTE,
    vd.PU,
    vd.REMISE,
    vd.TVA,
    vd.PUACHAT,
    vd.PUVENTE,
    v.IDDEVISE,
    vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
    vd.DESIGNATION,
    vd.COMPTE,
    vd.PUREVIENT,
    vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,

    v.DESIGNATION AS IDPROFORMALIB,

    NVL(p.LIBELLEVENTE, p.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,

    CAST(
        vd.QTE * vd.PU
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUTOTAL,

    vd.UNITE,

    au.VAL AS UNITELIB,

    /* REMISE TOTALE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS REMISEMONTANT,

    /* RISTOURNE */
    CAST(
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
        ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE,

    /* FRAIS TRANSPORT */
    CAST(
        NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISTRANSPORT,

    /* MONTANT TOTAL HT */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
        - (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        )
        - (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
            ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        )
        - NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTOTAL,

    /* MONTANT REMISE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTREMISE,

    /* TVA */
    CAST(
        (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100) *
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
            - (
                (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                    - (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                    )
                ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
            )
            - NVL(
                p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                0
            )
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTVA,

    /* TTC */
    CAST(
        (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
                - (
                    (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                        - (
                            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                        )
                    ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
                )
                - NVL(
                    p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                    0
                )
            )
            * (1 + NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100)
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTTC,

    vd.DATEDEBUT,

    CAST(
        NVL(p.CALORIE,0)
        AS NUMBER(10,2)
    ) AS CALORIE,

    vd.RISTOURNE,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSPARKILO,

    CAST(
        v.FRAISLIVRAISON
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISLIVRAISON,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE * vd.QTE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSTOTAL,

    CAST(
        vd.PU / NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUINGREDIENT,

    NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1) AS CONTENUE,

    p.UNITE2,
    vd.remisearbiochem

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd

LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v
    ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA

LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
    ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT

LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au
    ON au.ID = vd.UNITE

LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
    ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.ID

SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM(poidstotal) as number(30, 2))                            AS poidstotal,
       cast(SUM(puTotal) as number(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       cast(SUM(remisemontant) as number(30, 2))                         as montantremise,
       cast(SUM(montantristourne) as number(30, 2))                      as montantristourne,
       cast(SUM(vd.fraistransport) as number(30, 2))                     as fraistransport,
       cast(SUM(montanttotal) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2)) AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(montanttva) as number(30, 2))                            AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(montantttc) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                            AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                      AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM(montantttc * vd.TAUXDECHANGE) as number(30, 2))          as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                 as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION
FROM PROFORMADETAILS_CPL vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION

SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       cast(sum(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5)   )      as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast((SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))*NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) ) as number(30, 2)) as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(vd.QTE*ing.CALORIE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colis,
       cast(sum((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100  * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /100) as number(30, 2)) as montantristourne
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION order by v.id asc

SELECT
    v.ID,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                - (
                (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                    + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                )
                - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotal,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantremise,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(v.fraislivraison,0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE,0) * NVL(vd.QTE,0)) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS frais,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PUACHAT,0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotalachat,

    CAST(SUM(
            NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTva,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC,

    NVL(v.IDDEVISE, 'AR') AS IDDEVISE,

    NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) AS tauxDeChange,

    CAST(
            SUM(
                    (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                        (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                            - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                            - (
                            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                            )
                            - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                        )
            ) * NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAR,

    CAST(SUM(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS montantRevient,

    v.IDRESERVATION,

    NVL(SUM(vd.QTE * ing.CALORIE), 0) AS poids,

    SUM(vd.QTE) AS colis,

    CAST(SUM(
            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantristourne

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, v.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION
ORDER BY v.id ASC

SELECT V.ID, V.DESIGNATION, V.IDMAGASIN, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, V.DATY, V.REMARQUE, V.ETAT, CASE WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 12 THEN 'CLÔTURÉ' END AS ETATLIB, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.CODECLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, C.ADRESSE, C.TELEPHONE AS CONTACT, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS POIDSTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANT, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(V2.MONTANTRISTOURNE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE, CAST(NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, CAST(V2.FRAIS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS FRAISTRANSPORT, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRESTE, 0 AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((COALESCE(V2.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) - COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID

SELECT V.ID, V.DESIGNATION, V.IDMAGASIN, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, V.DATY, V.REMARQUE, V.ETAT, CASE WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 12 THEN 'CLÔTURÉ' END AS ETATLIB, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.CODECLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, C.ADRESSE, C.TELEPHONE AS CONTACT, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS POIDSTOTAL, CAST((V2.MONTANTTOTAL+V2.MONTANTREMISE )AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANT, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(V2.MONTANTRISTOURNE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE, CAST(NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, CAST(V2.FRAIS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS FRAISTRANSPORT, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRESTE, 0 AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((COALESCE(V2.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) - COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER2 V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID

SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDTRAVAUX,SQ.IDPERSONNEL,SQ.IDPERSONNELLIB,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS,SQ.DUREEREEL_HMS,SQ.ECART_HMS,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE,SQ.DUREEREEL_SECONDE,SQ.ECART_SECONDE,SQ.MONTANTESTIMATIF,SQ.MONTANTREEL,SQ.MONTANTECART,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTRAVAUX),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNELLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTESTIMATIF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTREEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTECART),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT
	             '' AS ID,
	             mo.IDTRAVAUX,
	             mo.IDPERSONNEL,
	             mo.idPersonnelLib,
	             mo.dureeEstimatifLib AS dureeEstimatif_hms,
	             pr.dureeReelHMS AS dureeReel_hms,
	             -- Ecart HMS calcule avec ABS pour eviter le signe -
	             LPAD(FLOOR(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 60), 2, '0')
	                 AS ecart_hms,
	             mo.DUREEESTIMATIF AS dureeEstimatif_seconde,
	             pr.dureeReel AS dureeReel_seconde,
	             -- Ecart Seconde en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel) AS ecart_seconde,
	             mo.montant AS montantEstimatif,
	             ((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE AS montantReel,
	             -- Ecart Montant en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.montant - (((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE)) AS montantEcart
	         FROM MOTRAVAUXLIB mo
	                  LEFT JOIN ProcessMaintenanceGlobal pr ON pr.IDPERSONNEL = mo.IDPERSONNEL AND pr.IDTRAVAUX = mo.IDTRAVAUX
	     ) SQ

SELECT
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie IN ('PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001') THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS indemnite,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000201' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS avantage_en_nature,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PRUNI' THEN NVL(pegi.imposable, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire_brut,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000141' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS irsa,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur,

    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE
                       WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000210A' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                       ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS montant_net_payer,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 13, 2) AS cnaps_employeur,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 14, 2) AS cnaps_a_payer,
    pe.idedition AS id

FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_edition_gain_imp pegi
                   ON pe.idpersonnel = pegi.idpersonnel
                       AND pe.mois = pegi.mois
                       AND pe.annee = pegi.annee
                       AND pe.idelementpaie IN (
                                                'PR000041', 'PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001',
                                                'PR000201', 'PRUNI', 'PR000141', 'PR000101', 'PR000210A'
                           )
GROUP BY pe.annee, pe.mois, pe.IDEDITION

SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.JOURNAL,
       SQ.REFERENCE,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.LIBELLE,
       SQ.LETTRE,
       CAST(SQ.DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS DEBIT,
       CAST(SQ.CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS CREDIT,
       SQ.IDCLIENT,
       SQ.CLIENTLIB,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.UPDATED_AT,
       CAST(SQ.SOLDE AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS SOLDE,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || JOURNAL || ' | ' || REFERENCE || ' | ' || CLIENTLIB || ' | ' || LIBELLE || ' | ' || LETTRE
           )                            AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (SELECT RELEVER.ID,
             RELEVER.JOURNAL,
             RELEVER.REFERENCE,
             RELEVER.DATY,
             RELEVER.LIBELLE,
             RELEVER.LETTRE,
             RELEVER.DEBIT,
             RELEVER.CREDIT,
             RELEVER.IDCLIENT,
             T.NOM                           AS CLIENTLIB,
             NVL(RELEVER.COMPTE, T.COMPTE)   AS COMPTE,
             RELEVER.UPDATED_AT,
             RELEVER.SOLDE,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RELEVER.DATY) AS ANNEE,

             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY RELEVER.ID, RELEVER.JOURNAL, RELEVER.REFERENCE, RELEVER.DATY
                 ORDER BY
                     CASE
                         WHEN RELEVER.LETTRE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(RELEVER.LETTRE) IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                         ELSE 1
                         END
                 )                           AS RN

      FROM (

               /* NOTE DE CREDIT / AVOIR CLIENT */
               SELECT AV.ID                        AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')           AS JOURNAL,
                      AV.ID                        AS REFERENCE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS DATY,
                      'NOTE DE CREDIT : ' || AV.ID AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')          AS LETTRE,
                      0                            AS DEBIT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR              AS CREDIT,
                      AV.IDCLIENT                  AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                  AS COMPTE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS UPDATED_AT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR * -1         AS SOLDE
               FROM AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_VISEE AV
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = AV.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* FACTURE / VENTE CLIENT */
               SELECT MCD.ID                            AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')                AS JOURNAL,
                      MCD.NUMEROFACTURE                 AS REFERENCE,
                      MCD.DATY                          AS DATY,
                      NVL(MCD.REFERENCES_PAIEMENT, ' ') AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')               AS LETTRE,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS DEBIT,
                      0                                 AS CREDIT,
                      MCD.IDCLIENT                      AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                       AS COMPTE,
                      MCD.UPDATED_AT                    AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL_UNIQUE MCD
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MCD.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MCD.ETAT >= 7
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* REGLEMENT CLIENT */
               SELECT MC.ID                   AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')      AS JOURNAL,
                      MC.ID                   AS REFERENCE,
                      MC.DATYCOMPTABILISATION AS DATY,
                      MC.DESIGNATION          AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')     AS LETTRE,
                      0                       AS DEBIT,
                      MC.CREDIT               AS CREDIT,
                      MC.IDTIERS              AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE             AS COMPTE,
                      MC.UPDATED_AT           AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MC.CREDIT * -1          AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL MC
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MC.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MC.ETAT > 8
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%') RELEVER
               LEFT JOIN TIERS T ON T.ID = RELEVER.IDCLIENT) SQ
WHERE SQ.RN = 1

SELECT
    ld.id AS direction,
    ld.val AS directionlib,
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN TO_DATE('01-12-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        ELSE TO_DATE('01-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') || '-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        END AS dateval,
    pe.annee || '-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') AS datedesc,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 1 THEN 'Janvier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 3 THEN 'Mars'
        WHEN pe.mois = 4 THEN 'Avril'
        WHEN pe.mois = 5 THEN 'Mai'
        WHEN pe.mois = 6 THEN 'Juin'
        WHEN pe.mois = 7 THEN 'Juillet'
        WHEN pe.mois = 8 THEN 'Aout'
        WHEN pe.mois = 9 THEN 'Septembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 10 THEN 'Octobre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 11 THEN 'Novembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 12 THEN 'Decembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN '13 eme'
        ELSE NULL
        END || '-' || pe.annee AS datelib,
    SUM(pe.gain) AS gain,
    NVL(SUM(rf.montant), 0) AS depense
FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pf ON pf.id = pe.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id = pf.direction
         LEFT JOIN retrait_frais_medicaux rf
                   ON pe.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM rf.daty)
                       AND pe.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rf.daty)
                       AND rf.etat >= 11
WHERE pe.idelementpaie NOT LIKE '%PR000FRM%'
GROUP BY
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    ld.id,
    ld.val

SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.COMPTE,SQ.SERVICE,SQ.MOIS,SQ.ANNEE,SQ.MOISLIB,SQ.BUDGET,SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,SQ.PAIEMENT,SQ.RESTEAPAYER,SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SERVICE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOIS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANNEE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOISLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(BUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTFACTURE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PAIEMENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(RESTEAPAYER),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTFACTUREBUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         select
	             '-' as id,
	             bdsv.COMPTE,
	             IDSERVICELIB as service,
	             bdsv.mois,
	             bdsv.annee,
	             bdsv.moislib,
	             bdsv.depenses as budget,
	             ffc.montant as montantfacture,
	             ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
	             ffc.resteapayer,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
	         from budget_depense_sum_view bdsv
	                  left join (
	             select
	                 SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
	                 mois,
	                 annee,
	                 SERVICE,
	                 sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
	                 sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
	                 sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
	             from facturefournisseurfille_paye ffp
	                      cross join (select distinct COMPTE from budget_depense_sum_view_budget) bdsv_inner
	             where SUBSTR(ffp.compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
	             group by SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee, SERVICE
	         ) ffc
	                            on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
	                                and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
	                                and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
	                                and ffc.SERVICE = bdsv.SERVICE
	     ) SQ

SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.SERVICE,
       SQ.MOIS,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       SQ.MOISLIB,
       SQ.BUDGET,
       SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,
       SQ.PAIEMENT,
       SQ.RESTEAPAYER,
       SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
       SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT
FROM (
  select
    '-' as id,
    bdsv.COMPTE,
    IDSERVICELIB as service,
    bdsv.mois,
    bdsv.annee,
    bdsv.moislib,
    bdsv.depenses as budget,
    ffc.montant as montantfacture,
    ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
    ffc.resteapayer,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW bdsv
    left join (
        select
            SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
            mois,
            annee,
            sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
            sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
            sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
        from VENTE_DETAILS_PAYE ffp
        cross join (select distinct COMPTE from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW) bdsv_inner
        where SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
        group by SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee
    ) ffc
    on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
        and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
        and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
) SQ

    CAST(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) AS NUMBER(20,5)) as quantite,

                    2

    TO_CHAR(

GROUP BY

		ELSE 0
END AS TauxDisponibilite

        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN ai.id IS NULL THEN aim.id
                ELSE ai.id
            END AS idMachine,
            CASE
                WHEN ai.libelle IS NULL THEN aim.descriptionObjet
                ELSE ai.libelle
            END AS nomMachine,
            t.ID AS IDTRAVAUX,
            t.DATY,
            NVL(
                t.DATY - LAG(t.DATY) OVER (PARTITION BY o.IDINGREDIENTS ORDER BY t.DATY),
                0
            ) AS ECART_JOURS
        FROM TRAVAUX t

WITH fac_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantttc, 0)) AS montantChargeExterne
  FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
),
mvt_agg AS (
  SELECT idobjet,
         SUM(NVL(montantsortie, 0)) AS montantPiece
  FROM MVTSTOCKLIB
  GROUP BY idobjet
),
pm_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantreel, 0)) AS montantMainDoeuvre
  FROM RAPPROCHEMENTTRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
)
SELECT t.id,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0) AS montantChargeExterne,
       NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)         AS montantPiece,
       NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantMainDoeuvre,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0)
           + NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)
           + NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantTotal
FROM TRAVAUX t
         LEFT JOIN fac_agg ON fac_agg.idtravaux = t.id
         LEFT JOIN mvt_agg ON mvt_agg.idobjet   = t.id
         LEFT JOIN pm_agg  ON pm_agg.idtravaux  = t.id

select vd."ID",vd."IDVENTE",vd."IDPRODUIT",vd."IDORIGINE",vd."QTE",vd."IDDEVISE",vd."TAUXDECHANGE",vd."DESIGNATION",vd."COMPTE",vd."IDBCFILLE",vd."UNITE",vd."POIDS",vd."RISTOURNE",vd."IDPREVISION",vd."PU",vd."REMISE",vd."TVA",vd."PUACHAT",vd."PUVENTE",vd."PUREVIENT",vd."IDREMISE",vd."REMISEMONTANT",vd."PHOTO",vd."QTE_TMP",vd."REFERENCE",vd."MONTANT",vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM , vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM,
       cast(vd.QTE * vd.pu as number(30, 2))                                     as montantNonRemise,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.pu *((nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) + nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0)) / 100)) + vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) as number(30, 2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *
             (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM))as number(30, 2) )                 as montantHT,
       cast((vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *
            (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100)) -(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) as number(30, 2))                 as puRemise,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) as number(30, 2))                            as montantHTAr,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) * nvl(vd.tva, 0) /
            100 as number(30, 2))                                                as montantTva,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)- vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) * nvl(vd.tva, 0) /
            100 as number(30, 2))                                                as montantTvaAr,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100)) as number(30, 2))                       as montantTTC,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTCAr,
       cast(nvl(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE, 0) as number(30, 2))                      as montantRevient,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)- vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *
            (1 + (nvl(vd.tva, 0) / 100)) *
            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) -
            nvl(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE, 0) as number(30, 2))                    as margeBrute,v.ETAT
from VENTE_DETAILS vd join vente v on v.id=vd.IDVENTE

SELECT vd.IDVENTE AS ID,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       sum(FRAIS)                                                                                                    as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -
                                                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) *
                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *
                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *
                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) *
                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -
                ((nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       vd.IDRESERVATION
FROM VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS vd
--         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
--         left join AS_INGREDIENTS vp on vp.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, vd.IDRESERVATION

SELECT vd.IDVENTE AS ID,

       -- montanttotal : base apres remise % et remise Arbiochem, moins frais
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotal,

       -- montantremise : remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant total de la remise)
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) +
            SUM(nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE) as number(30, 2))                                               AS montantremise,

       cast(sum(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5)   )                                                                                                    as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,

       -- montantTva : calculee sur la base deja reduite de la remise Arbiochem
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,

       -- montantTTC : montantTva + montanttotal (bases deja reduites de la remise Arbiochem)
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                                             as montantTTC,

       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,

       -- montantTTCAR : remise Arbiochem ajoutee en suivant le meme traitement que fraislivraison (structure d'origine conservee)
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -
                                                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                                                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE) *
                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *
                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *
                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -
                  (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) *
                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -
                ((nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,

       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(ing.CALORIE* vd.QTE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colis
FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION

                vd.QTE,
                NVL(vd.PU, 0)                                                      AS PU,
                -- Formule de PUTOTAL aligne?e sur le MONTANTTTC de la vue de?taille?e
                CAST(
                    -- Partie HT avec de?duction des frais
                        ((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0))
                            +
                            -- Partie TVA applique?e sur cette me?me base HT modifie?e
                        (((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) * NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100)
                    AS NUMBER(30,2)

                v.IDRESERVATION,
                vd.IDBCFILLE,
                p.TYPEPRODUIT,
                tp.VAL                                                             AS TYPEPRODUITLIB,
                cli.IDPROVINCE,
                pro.VAL                                                            AS IDPROVINCELIB
         FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
                  LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN POINT p1 ON p1.ID = m.IDPOINT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = cat.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID = p.TYPEPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT cli ON cli.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN PROVINCE pro ON pro.ID = cli.IDPROVINCE
     ) SQ

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.IDVENTE,
    p.IDPRODUIT,
    p.IDORIGINE,
    CAST(p.QTE AS NUMBER(38, 2))                                              AS QTE,
    p.PU,
    p.REMISE,
    p.TVA,
    p.PUACHAT,
    p.PUVENTE,
    p.IDDEVISE,
    p.TAUXDECHANGE,
    p.DESIGNATION,
    p.COMPTE,
    p.PUREVIENT,
    p.IDBCFILLE,
    p.UNITE,
    u.VAL                                                                     AS UNITELIB,

    CAST(p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) + (p.pu * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS PUNET,

    -- MONTANTHT : deduction remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant fixe par qte)
    CAST(((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
        - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTHT,

    -- MONTANTTTC : base (avec remise Arbiochem) + TVA calculee sur cette meme base
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTTC,

    -- MONTANTTVA : calculee sur la base HT deja reduite de la remise Arbiochem
    CAST(
            ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTVA,

    -- MONTANTREMISE : remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant total de la remise)
    CAST(((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) + (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTREMISE,

    CAST(p.pu * p.qte AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                       AS MONTANT,

    CAST(NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))                AS POIDS,
    (NVL(p.QTE, 0) - NVL(bl.QUANTITE, 0)) - NVL(avcf.qte, 0)                  AS RESTE,

    CAST(NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS FRAIS,

    nvl(ing.LIBELLEVENTE,ing.libelle)                                                          AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    v.DATY,
    v.DATYPREVU                                                               AS DATYPREVU,
    p.IDDEVISE                                                                AS IDDEVISELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,

    -- PUTOTAL : meme formule que MONTANTTTC (avec remise Arbiochem)
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS PUTOTAL,

    cl.nom                                                                    AS IDCLIENTLIB,
    p.ristourne                                                               AS RISTOURNE,
    p.idprevision,
    v.IDRESERVATION,
    NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0)                                                  AS FRAISLIVRAISON,
    ing.calorie,
    CAST(p.pu / NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                        AS PUINGREDIENT,
    NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1)                                                       AS CONTENUE,
    ing.unite2,

    -- MONTANTREMISER : montant net apres remise % + remise Arbiochem
    (p.pu * p.qte) - ((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte) AS MONTANTREMISER,

    p.IDREMISE,
    nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0)                                                 AS REMISEARBIOCHEM,
    nvl(p.ristourneArbiochem, 0)                                              AS RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM
FROM VENTE_DETAILS p
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v
                   ON v.id = p.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u
                   ON u.id = p.unite
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing
                   ON ing.ID = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT cl
                   ON v.IDCLIENT = cl.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.ID
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
                   ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BL_CLIENT_FILLE_grp_vente bl
                   ON bl.idventedetail = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN avoirfcfille_grp_viseee avcf
                   ON avcf.idventedetails = p.ID

SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDMAGASIN","IDMAGASINLIB","DATY","DATYPREVU","REMARQUE","ETAT","ADECLARER","ETATLIB","MONTANTTOTAL","IDDEVISE","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","MONTANTTVA","MONTANTTTC","MONTANTTTCAR","MONTANTPAYE","MONTANTRESTE","AVOIR","TAUXDECHANGE","MONTANTREVIENT","MARGEBRUTE","IDRESERVATION","AVECCOMMISSION","IDMODEPAIEMENT","REFERENCEFACTURE","IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB","MONTANTDONNE","MONTANTRETOURNER","HEURESAISIE","IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT","ECHEANCEPAIEMENTLIB","IDORIGINE","DATYHEURE"
FROM (
         SELECT v.ID,
                v.DESIGNATION,
                v.IDMAGASIN,
                m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
                v.DATY,
                v.DATYPREVU,
                v.REMARQUE,
                v.ETAT,
                ADECLARER,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CRÉÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULÉE'
                    END AS ETATLIB,
                v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
                v2.IDDEVISE,
                v.IDCLIENT,
                c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
                cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
                nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0) as avoir,
                v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,
                v2.MONTANTREVIENT,
                cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2)) as margeBrute,
                v.IDRESERVATION,
                CASE
                    WHEN cm.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Oui'
                    ELSE                        'Non'
                    END AS avecCommission,
                v.idmodepaiement,
                rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture,
                mp.val AS idmodepaiementlib,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.MONTANTDONNE IS NULL OR v.MONTANTDONNE = 0
                        THEN cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    ELSE cast(v.MONTANTDONNE AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    END AS MONTANTDONNE,
                nvl(mv.MONTANTRETOURNER, 0) as montantretourner,
                v.heureSaisie,
                V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
                EP.DESCE AS echeancePaiementLib,
                v.IDORIGINE,
                TO_DATE(v.daty || ' ' || v.heureSaisie, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS DATYHEURE
         FROM VENTE v
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MVTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE_PDF mv ON v.id in mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
             LEFT JOIN COMMISSION cm ON cm.IDFACTURE = v.id
             LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT mp ON mp.id = v.idmodepaiement
             LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture=v.Id
             LEFT JOIN ECHEANCEPAIEMENT EP on EP.ID = V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT
     )
ORDER BY DATYHEURE DESC NULLS LAST

WITH BORNES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-06-01' AS DATE_MIN,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATE_MAX
    FROM DUAL
),
CALENDRIER AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
VENTE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS NOMBRE
    FROM VENTE_CPL
    WHERE ETAT = 11
      AND DATY >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY TRUNC(DATY)
)
SELECT

    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTTTC, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    CAST(NVL(v.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,5)
    ) AS MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR

FROM CALENDRIER c
LEFT JOIN VENTE_JOUR v
    ON c.DATY = v.DATY
