WITH mois_annees AS (
    SELECT
        ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), LEVEL - 25) AS mois
    FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 49
        ),
        base_comptes_periode AS (
        SELECT
        CAST(c.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        c.libelle AS libelleCompte,
        m.mois,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.mois) AS annee,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.mois) AS mois_num
        FROM
        compta_compte c
        CROSS JOIN mois_annees m
        ),
        ecritures_mensuelles AS (
    -- Excludes journal = 'COMP000015'
        SELECT
        CAST(cse.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM') AS mois,
        SUM(cse.debit) AS soldeDebit,
        SUM(cse.credit) AS soldeCredit
        FROM
        compta_sous_ecriture cse
        JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.id = cse.idmere
        WHERE
        cse.daty IS NOT NULL
        AND cse.etat >= 11
        AND cse.journal != 'COMP000015'
        GROUP BY
        cse.compte, TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM')
        ),
        ecritures_mensuelles_cumuls AS (
    -- Includes all journals, including 'COMP000015'
        SELECT
        CAST(cse.compte AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS compte,
        TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM') AS mois,
        SUM(cse.debit) AS cumulDebit,
        SUM(cse.credit) AS cumulCredit
        FROM
        compta_sous_ecriture cse
        JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.id = cse.idmere
        WHERE
        cse.daty IS NOT NULL
        AND cse.etat >= 11
        GROUP BY
        cse.compte, TRUNC(cse.daty, 'MM')
        ),
        fusion_comptes_mois AS (
        SELECT
        b.annee,
        b.mois_num AS mois,
        b.compte,
        b.libelleCompte,
        b.mois AS date_mois,
        NVL(em.soldeDebit, 0) AS soldeDebit,
        NVL(em.soldeCredit, 0) AS soldeCredit,
        NVL(ec.cumulDebit, 0) AS cumulDebit,
        NVL(ec.cumulCredit, 0) AS cumulCredit
        FROM
        base_comptes_periode b
        LEFT JOIN ecritures_mensuelles em ON b.compte = em.compte AND b.mois = em.mois
        LEFT JOIN ecritures_mensuelles_cumuls ec ON b.compte = ec.compte AND b.mois = ec.mois
        )
SELECT
    annee,
    mois,
    compte,
    libelleCompte,
    ROUND(soldeDebit, 2) AS debit,
    ROUND(soldeCredit, 2) AS credit,
    TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(compte, 1, 3)) AS compte3,
    TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(compte, 1, 2)) AS compte2,
    ROUND(
            SUM(cumulDebit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY compte ORDER BY date_mois
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ), 2
    ) AS cumulDebit,
    ROUND(
            SUM(cumulCredit) OVER (
            PARTITION BY compte ORDER BY date_mois
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ), 2
    ) AS cumulCredit
FROM
    fusion_comptes_mois
ORDER BY
    compte, annee, mois

WITH MAX_INVENTAIRE AS (
    -- Etape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide et la quantite par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT REP.IDCAISSE,
           MAX(REP.DATY)                                             AS MAX_DATY,
           MAX(REP.MONTANT) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY REP.DATY) AS MONTANT_MAX_DATY
    FROM REPORTCAISSEAVECHEURE REP
    WHERE REP.ETAT >= 11 --and rep.DATY<=TO_DATE('27/07/2026','DD-MM-YYYY')
    GROUP BY REP.IDCAISSE),
     TAUXCHANGEMAX
         AS (SELECT MAX(TAU.TAUX) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY TAU.DATY) AS TAUX,
                    TAU.IDDEVISE                                           AS TAUXIDDEVISE,
                    MAX(TAU.DATY)                                          AS TAUXDATY
             FROM TAUXDECHANGE TAU
             GROUP BY IDDEVISE),
     SOMME_PRECALC AS (SELECT C.ID                              AS IDCAISSE,
                              C.VAL                             AS IDCAISSELIB,
                              NVL(SUM(CASE
                                          WHEN MFF.DATY > NVL(INV.MAX_DATY, DATE '2025-01-01') THEN MFF.CREDIT
                                          ELSE 0 END), 0)       AS CREDIT,

                              NVL(SUM(CASE
                                          WHEN MFF.DATY > NVL(INV.MAX_DATY, DATE '2025-01-01') THEN MFF.DEBIT
                                          ELSE 0 END), 0)       AS DEBIT,
                              MAX(INV.MAX_DATY)                 AS DATEDERNIERREPORT,
                              NVL(MAX(INV.MONTANT_MAX_DATY), 0) AS MONTANTDERNIERREPORT,
                              C.IDPOINT,
                              P.VAL                             AS IDPOINTLIB,
                              C.IDTYPECAISSE,
                              TYP.VAL                           AS IDTYPECAISSELIB,
                              C.IDDEVISE,
                              MAX(TAU.TAUX)                     AS TAUX
                       FROM CAISSE C
                                LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEAVECHEURE MFF
                                          ON MFF.IDCAISSE = C.ID AND MFF.ETAT >= 11 AND MFF.IDREPORT IS NOT NULL-- and mff.DATY<=TO_DATE('27/07/2026','DD-MM-YYYY')
                                JOIN MAX_INVENTAIRE INV ON INV.IDCAISSE = C.ID
                                LEFT JOIN TAUXCHANGEMAX TAU ON TAU.TAUXIDDEVISE = C.IDDEVISE
                                LEFT JOIN POINT P ON P.ID = C.IDPOINT
                                LEFT JOIN TYPECAISSE TYP ON TYP.ID = C.IDTYPECAISSE
                       GROUP BY C.ID, C.IDPOINT, P.VAL, C.IDTYPECAISSE, TYP.VAL, C.VAL, C.IDDEVISE)
-- Selection finale
SELECT IDCAISSE,
       IDCAISSELIB || ' (' || NVL(IDDEVISE, 'AR') || ')'                             AS IDCAISSELIB,
       CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                 AS CREDIT,
       CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                                  AS DEBIT,
       CAST(MONTANTDERNIERREPORT + CREDIT - DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                  AS RESTE,
       CAST(NVL(TAUX, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                           AS TAUX,
       CAST((MONTANTDERNIERREPORT + CREDIT - DEBIT) * NVL(TAUX, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS RESTEAR,
       DATE '2025-01-01'                                                             AS DATY,
       IDCAISSE                                                                      AS ID,
       DATEDERNIERREPORT,
       CAST(MONTANTDERNIERREPORT AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                   AS MONTANTDERNIERREPORT,
       IDPOINT,
       IDPOINTLIB,
       IDTYPECAISSE,
       IDTYPECAISSELIB,
       (IDCAISSELIB || ' | ' || IDPOINTLIB || ' | ' || IDTYPECAISSELIB || ' | ' || DATEDERNIERREPORT) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM SOMME_PRECALC

SELECT
    r.ID,
    r.IDCAISSE,
    c.val AS idcaisseLib,
    c.idtypecaisse,
    tc.desce AS idtypecaisselib,
    c.idpoint,
    p.desce AS idpointlib,
    r.DATY AS dateDernierReport,
    CAST(NVL(((r.MONTANT + NVL(mvtAv.CREDIT - mvtAv.DEBIT, 0)) * taux.taux), 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantDernierReport,
    CAST(NVL(mvt.debit, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS debit,
    CAST(NVL(mvt.credit, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS credit,
    CAST((NVL(mvt.credit, 0) - NVL(mvt.debit, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS reste,
    'AR' AS devise
FROM REPORTCAISSE_deVISE r,
     (
         SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                 MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
         FROM REPORTCAISSE_deVISE r
         WHERE r.ETAT = 11
           AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
     ) rm,
     (
         SELECT  m.IDCAISSE,
                 SUM(NVL((m.DEBIT * t.taux),0)) AS DEBIT,
                 SUM(NVL((m.CREDIT * t.taux),0)) AS CREDIT
         FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_VISE m,
              (
                  SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                          MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
                  FROM REPORTCAISSE r
                  WHERE r.ETAT = 11
                    AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
              ) rm,
              (
                  SELECT ta.*
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
                       (
                           SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                           FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                           WHERE daty <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                           GROUP BY iddevise
                       ) tmax
                  WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
                    AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
              ) t
         WHERE m.IDDEVISE = t.iddevise(+)
           AND m.IDCAISSE = rm.idcaisse(+)
           AND m.DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
           AND m.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY m.IDCAISSE
     ) mvt,
     (
         SELECT  m.IDCAISSE,
                 SUM(NVL((m.DEBIT * t.taux),0)) AS DEBIT,
                 SUM(NVL((m.CREDIT * t.taux),0)) AS CREDIT
         FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_VISE m,
              (
                  SELECT  r.IDCAISSE,
                          MAX(r.DATY) AS maxDateReport
                  FROM REPORTCAISSE r
                  WHERE r.ETAT = 11
                    AND r.DATY <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY r.IDCAISSE
              ) rm,
              (
                  SELECT ta.*
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
                       (
                           SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                           FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                           WHERE daty <=TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                           GROUP BY iddevise
                       ) tmax
                  WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
                    AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
              ) t
         WHERE m.IDDEVISE = t.iddevise(+)
           AND m.IDCAISSE = rm.idcaisse(+)
           AND m.DATY >= maxDateReport
           AND m.DATY < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
         GROUP BY m.IDCAISSE
     ) mvtAv,
     (
         SELECT ta.*
         FROM TAUXDECHANGE ta,
              (
                  SELECT MAX(daty) AS daty, iddevise
                  FROM TAUXDECHANGE t
                  WHERE daty <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                  GROUP BY iddevise
              ) tmax
         WHERE ta.daty = tmax.daty
           AND ta.iddevise = tmax.iddevise
     ) taux,
     CAISSE c,
     TYPECAISSE tc,
     POINT p
WHERE r.DATY = rm.maxDateReport
  AND r.IDDEVISE = taux.iddevise(+)
  AND r.ETAT = 11
  AND r.IDCAISSE = rm.IDCAISSE
  AND r.IDCAISSE = c.ID(+)
  AND r.IDCAISSE = mvt.idcaisse(+)
  AND r.IDCAISSE = mvtAv.idcaisse(+)
  AND c.IDTYPECAISSE = tc.ID(+)
  AND c.IDPOINT = p.ID

         FROM (

                      COALESCE(b.idfournisseur, invf.idfournisseur, bb.IDFOURNISSEUR,trs.idfournisseur) AS idfournisseur,
                      f.DATY as dateAchat

                  FROM (
                           SELECT
                               ID,
                               IDMVTSTOCK,
                               IDPRODUIT,
                               ENTREE,
                               SORTIE,
                               IDVENTEDETAIL,
                               IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
                               PU,
                               MVTSRC,
                               DATY,
                               RESTE,
                               QUANTITE,
                               IDMAGASIN,
                               IDINVENTAIREFILLE,
                               MONTANTENTREE,
                               MONTANTSORTIE,
                               MONTANTRESTE
                           FROM (
                                    SELECT
                                        mf.ID,
                                        mf.IDMVTSTOCK,
                                        mf.IDPRODUIT,
                                        nvl(mf.ENTREE,0)+nvl(s.ENTREE,0) as entree,
                                        s.SORTIE,
                                        mf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
                                        mf.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
                                        mf.PU,
                                        mf.MVTSRC,
                                        ms.DATY,
                                        NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0)  + NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS RESTE,
                                        NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0) +  NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS QUANTITE,
                                        ms.IDMAGASIN,
                                        mf.idinventairefille,
                                        cast((mf.PU*mf.ENTREE) as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTENTREE,
                                        cast((mf.PU*s.SORTIE) as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTSORTIE,
                                        CAST(NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(s.SORTIE, 0)  + NVL(s.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) * mf.PU AS MONTANTRESTE

                                    FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
                                             LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms ON ms.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
                                             LEFT JOIN (
                                        SELECT mf2.MVTSRC, SUM(mf2.SORTIE) AS SORTIE,SUM(mf2.ENTREE) AS ENTREE
                                        FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf2
                                                 LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms2 ON ms2.id = mf2.IDMVTSTOCK
                                        WHERE ms2.ETAT >= 11
                                          AND mf2.MVTSRC IS NOT NULL
                                        GROUP BY mf2.MVTSRC
                                    ) s ON s.MVTSRC = mf.id
                                    WHERE mf.ENTREE > 0 and (mf.MVTSRC is null or mf.MVTSRC=mf.id)
                                      AND (ms.IDCATEGORIESTOCK IS NULL
                                        OR ms.IDCATEGORIESTOCK <> 'CTGST000003')
                                      AND ms.ETAT >= 11
                                )
                       ) x
                           LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK ms  ON ms.id = x.IDMVTSTOCK
                           LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON b ON b.ID = ms.IDOBJET
                           LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON bb ON b.ID = ms.IDTRANSFERT
                           LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f on f.id=b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
                           LEFT JOIN INVENTAIREFILLE invf ON invf.id = x.IDINVENTAIREFILLE
                           LEFT JOIN TRANSFERTSTOCKDETAILS trs ON trs.id = x.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL
                  WHERE b.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL OR invf.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL or bb.IDFOURNISSEUR IS NOT NULL OR trs.idfournisseur is not null

              ) ve

                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ve.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON ve.IDMAGASIN = m.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id

                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON f.ID = ve.idfournisseur

         WHERE ve.PU > 0 AND CAST(ve.reste AS NUMBER(30,5)) != 0
     ) SQ

WITH max_inventaire AS (
    -- ?    tape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide par produit une fois pour toutes
    SELECT
        invff.MVTSRC,
        MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty
    FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
             LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
    WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11
    GROUP BY invff.MVTSRC
),
     inv_final_precalc AS (
         -- ?   tape 2 : On r??cup??re les quantit??s associ??es ?  cette date maximale
         SELECT
             invfff.MVTSRC,
             invfff.QUANTITE,
             imm.DATY AS invdaty
         FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invfff
                  LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imm ON imm.ID = invfff.IDINVENTAIRE
                  INNER JOIN max_inventaire mi ON mi.MVTSRC = invfff.MVTSRC AND imm.DATY = mi.max_daty
         WHERE imm.ETAT >= 11
     ),
     somme_precalc AS (
         -- ?   tape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales (sorties/entr??es) sans sous-requ??te corr??l??e cass??e
         SELECT
             mff.MVTSRC,
             NVL(SUM(mff.ENTREE), 0) AS entree,
             NVL(SUM(mff.SORTIE), 0) AS sortie
         FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
                  LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
                  LEFT JOIN inv_final_precalc inv ON inv.MVTSRC = mff.MVTSRC
         WHERE meref.DATY > nvl(inv.invdaty,to_date('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and meref.ETAT>=11
           AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
         GROUP BY mff.MVTSRC
     ),
     main_data AS (
         -- ?   tape 4 : Requ??te principale avec application exacte des r??gles de calcul d'origine
         SELECT
             mf.ID,
             mere.DATY,
             CAST(NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS invquantite,

             CASE WHEN mere.DATY > NVL(invfinal.invdaty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY'))
                      THEN CAST(NVL(mf.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                  ELSE 0
                 END AS ENTREE,

             CAST(NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS sortie,

             CASE WHEN mere.DATY <= NVL(invfinal.invdaty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY'))
                      THEN CAST((NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) - NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                  ELSE CAST((NVL(invfinal.QUANTITE, 0) + mf.ENTREE - NVL(somme.SORTIE, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,3))
                 END AS reste,

             ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
             ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
             ai.UNITE,
             ai.TYPESTOCK,
             u.VAL AS idunitelib,
             c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
             mf.PU,
             b.IDFOURNISSEUR,
             b.IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
             mf.IDPRODUIT,
             mere.IDMAGASIN,
             m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
             invfinal.invdaty AS invdaty
         FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
                  LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure mere ON mere.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
                  LEFT JOIN somme_precalc somme ON somme.MVTSRC = mf.id
                  LEFT JOIN inv_final_precalc invfinal ON invfinal.MVTSRC = mf.ID
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mf.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON mere.IDMAGASIN = m.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
                  LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB b ON b.ID = mere.IDOBJET
         WHERE mf.ENTREE > 0
            AND mere.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
            AND mere.ETAT >= 11
            AND ai.TYPESTOCK != 'CUMP'
     )

    CAST(reste AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS quantite,

    cast(sum(reste) as number(30,3)) as reste,
    cast(sum(quantite) as number(30,3)) as quantite,
    cast(sum(reste)* avg(pu) as number(30,2)) as montantReste,
    idproduitlib,
    CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    UNITE,
    TYPESTOCK,
    idunitelib,
    idtypeproduitlib,
    avg(PU) AS PU,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEUR,
    '' as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
    IDPRODUIT,
    IDMAGASIN,
    idmagasinlib,
    min(invdaty) as invdaty
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_STANDARD
    union all select * from (
    WITH max_inventaire AS (
        SELECT
            invff.IDPRODUIT,imeref.IDMAGASIN,
            MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty
            ,MAX(invff.QUANTITE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS qte_max_daty,
            MAX(invff.pu) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS pu_max_daty
        FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
        LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
        WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11 and invff.MVTSRC is null
        GROUP BY invff.IDPRODUIT, imeref.IDMAGASIN
    ),
         somme_precalc AS (
             -- Etape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales agregees par COUPLE produit/magasin
             SELECT
                 mff.idproduit as idproduit,
                 meref.idmagasin as idmagasin,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS entree,

                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sortie,
                 ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
            ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
            ai.UNITE as unite,
            ai.TYPESTOCK as typestock,
            u.VAL AS idunitelib,
            c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
                 avg(mff.PU) as pu,
                 null as IDFOURNISSEUR,
                 null as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
                 m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
                 max(inv.max_daty) AS invdaty,
                 nvl(max(inv.qte_max_daty),0)as invquantite,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantEntree,
                 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantSortie,
                 nvl(avg(inv.pu_max_daty*inv.qte_max_daty),0) as montantInv, nvl(max(ai.SEUIL),0) as seuil,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMAX),nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0)+1000) as seuilmax,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0) as seuilMin
             FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
                      LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
        LEFT JOIN max_inventaire inv ON inv.idproduit = mff.idproduit AND inv.idmagasin = meref.idmagasin
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mff.IDPRODUIT
        LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
        LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON meref.IDMAGASIN = m.id
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
        WHERE --meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and
          meref.ETAT >= 11
          AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023' and mff.MVTSRC is null
          and not exists(select 1 from V_ETATSTOCK_ENTREE_STANDARD  ve where ve.id = mff.id)
        GROUP BY mff.idproduit, meref.idmagasin,ai.LIBELLE,ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,ai.UNITE,ai.TYPESTOCK,u.VAL,c.VAL,m.VAL
         )
    SELECT
        null as ID, null as DATY,  cast(invquantite as number(30,3)) as invquantite,cast(entree as number(30,3)) as entree, cast(sortie as number(30,3)) as sortie,CAST((invquantite)+(ENTREE)-(sortie) AS NUMBER(30,3)) as reste,
        CAST(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS quantite,
        CAST((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)AS NUMBER(30,2))AS montantreste,
        idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK, idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib,
        cast((montantInv+montantEntree-montantSortie)/(invquantite+ENTREE-sortie)  as number(30,2)) as pu,
        IDFOURNISSEUR, IDFOURNISSEURLIB, IDPRODUIT, IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib,invdaty
    FROM somme_precalc
    WHERE (invquantite+ENTREE-sortie) != 0)
) GROUP BY
idproduitlib, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, UNITE, TYPESTOCK,
idunitelib, idtypeproduitlib, IDPRODUIT,
IDMAGASIN, idmagasinlib

WITH max_inventaire AS (
    -- Etape 1 : On extrait la date maximale valide et la quantite par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT
        invff.idproduit,
        imeref.idmagasin,
        MAX(imeref.DATY) AS max_daty,
        MAX(invff.QUANTITE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS qte_max_daty,
        MAX(invff.pu) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY imeref.DATY) AS pu_max_daty
    FROM INVENTAIREFILLE invff
    LEFT JOIN inventaireDateHeure imeref ON imeref.ID = invff.IDINVENTAIRE
    WHERE imeref.ETAT >= 11
    GROUP BY invff.idproduit, imeref.idmagasin
),
somme_precalc AS (
    -- Etape 3 : Calcul des sommes globales agregees par COUPLE produit/magasin
    SELECT
        mff.idproduit as idproduit,
        meref.idmagasin as idmagasin,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS entree,

        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sortie,
        ai.LIBELLE AS idproduitlib,
        ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
        ai.UNITE as unite,
        ai.TYPESTOCK as typestock,
        u.VAL AS idunitelib,
        c.VAL AS idtypeproduitlib,
        avg(mff.PU) as pu,
        null as IDFOURNISSEUR,
        null as IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
        m.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
        max(inv.max_daty) AS invdaty,
        nvl(max(inv.qte_max_daty),0)as invquantite,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY >NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.ENTREE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantEntree,
        NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) THEN mff.SORTIE*mff.pu ELSE 0 END), 0) AS montantSortie,
        nvl(avg(inv.pu_max_daty*inv.qte_max_daty),0) as montantInv, nvl(max(ai.SEUIL),0) as seuil,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMAX),nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0)+1000) as seuilmax,nvl(max(ai.SEUILMIN),0) as seuilMin
    FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE mff
    LEFT JOIN mvtStockDateHeure meref ON meref.ID = mff.IDMVTSTOCK
    LEFT JOIN max_inventaire inv ON inv.idproduit = mff.idproduit AND inv.idmagasin = meref.idmagasin
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = mff.IDPRODUIT
    LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.id
    LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON meref.IDMAGASIN = m.id
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON ai.UNITE = u.id
    WHERE --meref.DATY > NVL(inv.max_daty, TO_DATE('01/01/2025','DD-MM-YYYY')) and
      meref.ETAT >= 11
      AND meref.IDTYPEMVSTOCK != 'TPMVST000023'
    GROUP BY mff.idproduit, meref.idmagasin,ai.LIBELLE,ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,ai.UNITE,ai.TYPESTOCK,u.VAL,c.VAL,m.VAL
)
-- Selection finale

       AI.UNITE,
       U.VAL                                                                               AS IDUNITELIB,
       CASE
           WHEN VE.RESTE != 0
               THEN CAST(NVL(((VE.ENTREE * VE.PU) - (VE.SORTIE * VE.PU)) / NVL(VE.RESTE, 1), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))
           ELSE CAST(AI.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))
           END                                                                             AS PU,
       (
           AI.ID || ' | ' || AI.LIBELLEVENTE || ' | ' || M.VAL
           )                                                                               AS MOTSCLESSS

             SUM(MF.ENTREE)                  AS ENTREE,

             ''                              AS IDVENTEDETAIL,
             ''                              AS IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
             AVG(MF.PU)                      AS PU,
             ''                              AS MVTSRC,
             ''                              AS DATY,
             SUM(MF.ENTREE) - SUM(MF.SORTIE) AS RESTE,
             0                               AS QUANTITE,
             MS.IDMAGASIN                    AS IDMAGASIN
      FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE MF
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK MS ON MS.ID = MF.IDMVTSTOCK
      WHERE MS.ETAT >= 11
      GROUP BY MF.IDPRODUIT, MS.IDMAGASIN) VE
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = VE.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT C ON AI.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = C.ID
         JOIN MAGASINPOINT M ON VE.IDMAGASIN = M.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE U ON AI.UNITE = U.ID
         LEFT JOIN STOCK_ENGAGE_FILLE_GP_MAG STE
                   ON STE.IDPRODUIT = VE.IDPRODUIT
                       AND STE.IDMAGASIN = VE.IDMAGASIN
where ai.ISVENTE = 1 and ai.ACTIF = 1

LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
WHERE NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0)>0 or NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0)>0
AND p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT008'

SELECT
    p.ID AS ID,
    p.LIBELLE AS idproduitLib,
    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    tp.DESCE AS idtypeproduitlib,
    ms.IDMAGASIN,
    mag.VAL AS idmagasinlib,
    TO_DATE('01-01-2001', 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS dateDernierMouvement,
    CAST(ms.quantite AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS QUANTITE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.entree, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS ENTREE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.sortie, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS SORTIE,
    CAST(NVL( ms.quantite, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS reste,
    p.UNITE,
    u.DESCE AS idunitelib,
    CAST(NVL(p.PV, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUVENTE,
    mag.IDPOINT,
    mag.IDTYPEMAGASIN,
    p.SEUILMIN,
    p.SEUILMAX,
    CAST(ms.montantEntree AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantEntree,
    CAST(ms.montantSortie AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantSortie,
    CAST(p.pu AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
    CAST(ms.montant AS NUMBER(30,2)) as montantReste,
    p.TYPEPRODUIT,
    tpp.val as typeproduitlib,
    CURRENT_DATE AS DATY
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS p
         LEFT JOIN MONTANT_STOCK ms ON ms.IDPRODUIT = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT tp ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = tp.ID
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT mag ON ms.IDMAGASIN = mag.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON p.UNITE = u.ID
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tpp ON tpp.id = p.TYPEPRODUIT
WHERE (NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) > 0 OR NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) > 0) -- Parentheses ajoutees pour la logique
  AND p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = 'CAT008'
  AND p.actif = 1

SELECT v."ID",v."IDINVENTAIRE",v."IDPRODUIT",v."IDPRODUITLIB",v."EXPLICATION",v."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",v."QUANTITE",v."LIBELLEEXTACTE",v."PU",v."ECART",v."DATEINV",v."MONTANTTHEORIQUE",v."MONTANTREELLE",v."ECARTMONTANT",v."CATEGORIEINGREDIENT",v."MVTSRC",

SELECT
    i.ID AS ID,
    i.IDINVENTAIRE AS IDINVENTAIRE,
    i.IDPRODUIT AS IDPRODUIT,
    p.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    i.EXPLICATION AS EXPLICATION,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS QUANTITETHEORIQUE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS QUANTITE,

    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS LIBELLEEXTACTE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS PU,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
                - NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS ECART,

    iv.DATY AS DATEINV,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
                * NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS MONTANTTHEORIQUE,

    CAST(
            NVL(i.PU, 0)
                * NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS MONTANTREELLE,

    CAST(
            (
                NVL(i.PU, 0)
                    * NVL(i.QUANTITE, 0)
                )
                -
            (
                NVL(i.PU, 0)
                    * NVL(i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE, 0)
                )
        AS NUMBER(30, 6)
    ) AS ECARTMONTANT,

    p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    i.MVTSRC,
    au.val as uniteLib,
    iv.idMagasin,
    m.val as idMagasinLib
FROM INVENTAIREFILLE i

         LEFT JOIN INVENTAIRE iv
                   ON iv.ID = i.IDINVENTAIRE

         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = i.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU on p.UNITE = au.id
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = iv.IDMAGASIN
WHERE iv.ETAT >= 11

SELECT
    d AS DATY,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM d) AS JOUR,
    CEIL((TO_CHAR(d, 'DD') + TO_CHAR(TRUNC(d, 'MM'), 'D') - 1) / 7) as semainemois,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d) AS MOIS,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS ANNEE,
    TO_CHAR(d, 'D') as numerojoursemaine,
    TO_CHAR(d, 'Day', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS JOURLIB
FROM (
         SELECT TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1 AS d
         FROM dual
             CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LAST_DAY(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE('2025-05-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
     )

SELECT
    cv.ID AS idCv,
    cv.IDFICHEPOSTE AS idFichePoste,
    fpc.ID AS idFichePosteCompetence,
    fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP AS idTypeCompetence,
    typ.VAL AS typeCompetenceLib,
    fpc.DESCRIPTION AS competence,
    fpc.NIVEAU AS niveauRequis,
    cvc.NIVEAU AS niveauCandidat,
    (cvc.NIVEAU - fpc.NIVEAU) AS ecart,
    CASE
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU IS NULL THEN 0
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU >= fpc.NIVEAU THEN 1
        ELSE 0
        END AS estValide,
    CASE
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU IS NULL THEN 'NON RENSEIGNE'
        WHEN cvc.NIVEAU >= fpc.NIVEAU THEN 'OK'
        ELSE 'INSUFFISANT'
        END AS resultat
FROM CV cv
         JOIN FICHE_POSTE_COMPETENCES fpc ON fpc.IDFICHEPOSTE = cv.IDFICHEPOSTE
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COMPETENCES_FP typ ON typ.ID = fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP
         LEFT JOIN CV_COMPETENCE cvc ON cvc.IDCV = cv.ID
    AND cvc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP = fpc.IDTYPECOMPETENCESFP

    NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) AS DERNIER_NUM,
    NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) + 1 AS PROCHAIN_NUM,
    LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(numavoir, 1, INSTR(numavoir, '/') - 1))), 0) + 1, 4, '0')
        || '/' || TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)) AS PROCHAIN_NUM_FORMAT

SELECT
    p.idpersonnel AS id,
    p.mois,
    p.annee,
    p.idedition,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 1  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS SALAIRE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 2  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS HS_M,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 3  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS INDEM,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 4  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS ANCIEN,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 5  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS PRIME,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 6  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS AUTRES,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 7  THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS TOTAL,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 8  THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS CNAPS,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 9  THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS OSTIE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 10 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS IRSA_E,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 11 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS IRSA_S,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 12 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS AV_SPE,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 13 THEN p.retenue END, 0)) AS AUTRES2,
    SUM(NVL(CASE WHEN p.regroupement = 14 THEN p.gain END, 0)) AS A_PAYER
FROM
    PAIE_EDITION p
        LEFT JOIN log_personnel l ON l.id = p.idpersonnel
GROUP BY
    p.idedition,p.idpersonnel, p.mois, p.annee

    s.libelle AS idServiceLib

         JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL paie ON lp.id = paie.id

SELECT

    pd.IDPROGRAMEDETAIL,

    CASE
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 1 THEN 'Lundi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 2 THEN 'Mardi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 3 THEN 'Mercredi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 4 THEN 'Jeudi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 5 THEN 'Vendredi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 6 THEN 'Samedi'
        WHEN pd.JOURDELASEMAINE = 7 THEN 'Dimanche'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS JOURDELASEMAINE,

    pd.HEURE,
    pd.DUREE,
    pd.ACTIONTHEME,

    pd.IDINTERVENANT,

    paie.idfonction AS idIntervenantFonction,
    f.val AS idIntervenantFonctionLib,

    (pd.Duree * 2) AS Duree_Effective

         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp
                   ON pd.idIntervenant = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL paie
                   ON lp.id = paie.id
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION f
                   ON paie.idfonction = f.id
         LEFT JOIN LOG_SERVICE s
                   ON lp.service = s.id

SELECT
    IDOBJET,
    CAST(SUM(SORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS sortie,
    CAST(SUM(PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
    CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantsortie,
    CAST(SUM(QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS qteth,
    CAST(SUM(PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS puth,
    CAST(SUM(MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
    CAST(SUM(SORTIE - QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS ecartqte,
    CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE - MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartmontant,
    CAST(SUM(PU - PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartpu
FROM
    STOCKETDEPENSEOFFABTHE

    IDOBJET

SELECT SQ."IDOBJET",SQ."SORTIE",SQ."PU",SQ."MONTANTSORTIE",SQ."QTETH",SQ."PUTH",SQ."MONTTH",SQ."ECARTQTE",SQ."ECARTMONTANT",SQ."ECARTPU",SQ.IDPRODUIT,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(IDOBJET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PU),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTSORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTETH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PUTH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTTH),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTQTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTMONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTPU),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT
             IDOBJET,
             IDPRODUIT,
             CAST(SUM(SORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS sortie,
             CAST(SUM(PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS pu,
             CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS montantsortie,
             CAST(SUM(QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS qteth,
             CAST(SUM(PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS puth,
             CAST(SUM(MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
             CAST(SUM(SORTIE - QTETH) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS ecartqte,
             CAST(SUM(MONTANTSORTIE - MONTTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartmontant,
             CAST(SUM(PU - PUTH) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecartpu
         FROM
             STOCKETDEPENSEOFFABTHE
         GROUP BY
             IDOBJET,
             IDPRODUIT
     ) SQ

SELECT
    ID,
    VAL,
    DESCE,
    CAST(MONTANT AS NUMBER(15,2)) AS montant,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN MONTANT > 0 THEN
                    MONTANT * 100.0 /
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN MONTANT > 0 THEN MONTANT
                                ELSE 0
                                END
                    ) OVER ()
                ELSE 0
                END
        AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS pourcentage,
    CURRENT_DATE AS DATY
FROM RAPPROCHEMENTGLOBALE_PIE

SELECT
    pfa.ANNEE,

    af.REFERENCE AS REF_FORMATION,

    af.IDTYPEFORMATION AS TYPE_FORMATION,
    tf.VAL AS TYPE_FORMATIONLIB,

    af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION AS CATEGORIE,
    cf.VAL AS CATEGORIELIB,

    af.INTITULE,

    af.IDSEMESTRE AS SEMESTRE,
    s.VAL AS SEMESTRELIB,

    cASE af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE
        WHEN '0' THEN 'INTERNE'
        WHEN '1' THEN 'EXTERNE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE'
    END AS INTERNE_EXTERNE,

    af.FORMATEUR,
    f.LIBELLE AS FORMATEURLIB,

    tcf.ID AS TYPE_COUT_ID,
    tcf.VAL AS TYPE_COUT_LIB,

    NVL(cout.MONTANT,0) AS MONTANT_COUT,

    NVL(sess.NB_SESSION,0) AS NOMBRE_SESSION,

    NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_OUVRIERS,
    NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_CADRES,

    NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) + NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0) AS NB_PARTICIPANT_TOTAL,

    NVL(af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,0) AS DUREE_PAR_STAGIAIRE,

    NVL(af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,0) *
    (NVL(af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,0) + NVL(af.NBCADREPREVUE,0))
        AS DUREE_TOTALE_HEURE

FROM PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pfa

         JOIN ACTION_FORMATION af
              ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pfa.ID

-- ? jointures libelles
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_FORMATION tf
                   ON tf.ID = af.IDTYPEFORMATION

         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_FORMATION cf
                   ON cf.ID = af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION

         LEFT JOIN SEMESTRE s
                   ON s.ID = af.IDSEMESTRE

         LEFT JOIN FORMATEUR f
                   ON f.ID = af.FORMATEUR

-- ? sessions agregees
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        IDACTIONFORMATION,
        COUNT(*) AS NB_SESSION
    FROM SESSION_FORMATION
    GROUP BY IDACTIONFORMATION
) sess
                   ON sess.IDACTIONFORMATION = af.ID

-- ? couts agreges
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        afd.IDACTIONFORMATION,
        afd.IDTYPECOUT,
        SUM(afd.COUT) AS MONTANT
    FROM ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL afd
    GROUP BY afd.IDACTIONFORMATION, afd.IDTYPECOUT
) cout
                   ON cout.IDACTIONFORMATION = af.ID

         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COUT_FORMATION tcf
                   ON tcf.ID = cout.IDTYPECOUT

WITH CA_PAR_VENTE AS (
    SELECT
        v.ID AS IDVENTE,
        TRUNC(v.DATY) AS DATY,


        SUM(
                NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)
        ) - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS CA_VENTE

    FROM VENTE v

             JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd
                  ON vd.IDVENTE = v.ID

    WHERE v.DATY IS NOT NULL
      AND v.ETAT >= 11

    GROUP BY
        v.ID,
        TRUNC(v.DATY),
        v.FRAISLIVRAISON
),

     CA_PAR_JOUR AS (
         SELECT
             DATY,
             SUM(CA_VENTE) AS CA
         FROM CA_PAR_VENTE
         GROUP BY DATY
     )

SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) AS ANNEE,
    TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATY,

    /* CA du jour */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS CA_DU_JOUR,

    /* Meilleur CA journalier de la semaine */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW')
                            AND DATY < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 7
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS MEILLEUR_CA_SEMAINE,

    /* Meilleur CA journalier du mois */
    NVL(
            MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
                            AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
                            THEN CA
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS MEILLEUR_CA_MOIS,

    /* CA total de l'annee */
    NVL(
            SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                            AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12)
                            THEN CA
                        ELSE 0
                        END
            ),
            0
    ) AS CA_ANNEE,

    /* CA par mois de l'annee courante */
    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JANVIER,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 2)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_FEVRIER,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 2)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_MARS,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 4)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_AVRIL,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 4)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 5)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_MAI,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 5)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 6)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JUIN,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 6)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 7)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_JUILLET,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 7)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 8)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_AOUT,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 8)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 9)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_SEPTEMBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 9)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 10)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_OCTOBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 10)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 11)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_NOVEMBRE,

    NVL(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN DATY >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 11)
                        AND DATY < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12)
                        THEN CA ELSE 0
                    END
        ), 0) AS CA_DECEMBRE

FROM CA_PAR_JOUR

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "IDCHAMBRE", "CHAMBRE") AS 
  SELECT
    a.ID,
    a.DATY,
    a.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.LIBELLE AS libelleproduit,
    a.QTE,
    a.PU,
    a.PU * a.QTE AS montant,
    a.LIBELLE,
    a.IDCLIENT,
    c.NOM AS idclientlib,
    a.IDRESERVATION,
    a.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN a.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN a.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,
    ai.COMPTE_ACHAT,
    a.IDPRODUIT as IDCHAMBRE,
    ai.LIBELLE as chambre
FROM ACTE a
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai  ON ai.id = a.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = a.IDCLIENT
 ;

al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTE_LIB_C" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "IDRESERVATION", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS

al."ID",al."DATY",al."IDPRODUIT",al."LIBELLEPRODUIT",al."QTE",al."PU",al."MONTANT",al."LIBELLE",al."IDCLIENT",al."IDCLIENTLIB",al."IDRESERVATION",al."ETAT",al."ETATLIB",al."COMPTE_VENTE",al."COMPTE_ACHAT"

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDACTIONFORMATION", "IDTYPECOUT", "COUT", "IDDEVISE", "IDTYPECOUTLIB", "IDDEVISELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    afd.ID,afd.IDACTIONFORMATION,afd.IDTYPECOUT,afd.COUT,afd.IDDEVISE,
    tcf.VAL AS idTypeCoutLib,
    dev.VAL AS idDeviseLib
FROM ACTION_FORMATION_DETAIL afd
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_COUT_FORMATION tcf
                   ON afd.IDTYPECOUT = tcf.ID
         LEFT JOIN DEVISE dev
                   ON afd.IDDEVISE = dev.ID
 
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ACTION_FORMATION_LIB" ("ID", "IDPLANFORMATION", "IDPLANFORMATIONLIB", "IDTYPEFORMATION", "IDTYPEFORMATIONLIB", "IDCATEGORIEFORMATION", "IDCATEGORIEFORMATIONLIB", "FORMATEUR", "REFERENCE", "INTITULE", "TYPEPRESTATAIRE", "IDSEMESTRE", "IDSEMESTRELIB", "NBSESSIONPREVUS", "DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE", "NBOUVRIERSPREVUE", "NBCADREPREVUE", "OBJECTIF", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "ESTREALISEELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    af.ID,
    af.IDPLANFORMATION,
    pf.LIBELLE AS IDPLANFORMATIONLIB,
    af.IDTYPEFORMATION,
    tf.VAL AS IDTYPEFORMATIONLIB,
    af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION,
    cf.VAL AS IDCATEGORIEFORMATIONLIB,
    af.FORMATEUR,
    af.REFERENCE,
    af.INTITULE,
    CASE
        WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '1' THEN 'INTERNE'
        WHEN af.TYPEPRESTATAIRE = '0' THEN 'EXTERNE'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS TYPEPRESTATAIRE,
    af.IDSEMESTRE,
    s.VAL AS IDSEMESTRELIB,
    af.NBSESSIONPREVUS,
    af.DUREESTAGIAIREHEURE,
    af.NBOUVRIERSPREVUE,
    af.NBCADREPREVUE,
    af.OBJECTIF,
    af.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN af.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN af.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN af.ETAT = 0 THEN 'Annule'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS ETATLIB,
     CASE
        WHEN af.estRealisee = '1' THEN 'OUI'
        WHEN af.estRealisee = '0' THEN 'NON'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS estRealiseelib
FROM ACTION_FORMATION af

         LEFT JOIN PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL pf
                   ON af.IDPLANFORMATION = pf.ID

         LEFT JOIN TYPE_FORMATION tf
                   ON af.IDTYPEFORMATION = tf.ID

         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_FORMATION cf
                   ON af.IDCATEGORIEFORMATION = cf.ID

         LEFT JOIN SEMESTRE s
                   ON af.IDSEMESTRE = s.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ALIMENTPOUSSIN_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "IDPRODUITS", "IDINGREDIENTS", "UNITE", "QUANTITE", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "IDUNITE") AS 
  select rec."ID",rec."IDPRODUITS",rec."IDINGREDIENTS",rec."UNITE",rec."QUANTITE", ing.LIBELLE as libIngredients, u.VAL as idUnitefrom AlimentPoussin rec         left join as_ingredients ing on    ing.id=rec.idingredientsleft join as_UNITE u on u.id = rec.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ANOMALIETRANSFERT" ("IDTRANSFERT", "MAGASINDEPART", "MAGASINDEPARTLIB", "MAGASINARRIVE", "MAGASINARRIVELIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "MONTANT", "ENVOYE", "MONTANTENVOYE", "RECU", "MONTANTRECU", "ECART", "MONTANTECART", "RESTE") AS 
  SELECT 
t.id as idTransfert,
t.IDMAGASINDEPART AS magasinDepart,
t.IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB AS  magasinDepartLib,
t.IDMAGASINARRIVE AS magasinArrive,
t.IDMAGASINARRIVELIB AS magasinArriveLib,
t.daty,
t.designation,
td.idproduit,
td.idproduitlib,
CAST(nvl(td.quantite,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS quantite ,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(td.quantite,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montant , 
CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as envoye,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantEnvoye, 
CAST(nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as recu ,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantRecu,
CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) - nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as ecart,
CAST(nvl(td.pu,0)*CAST(nvl(m.sortie,0) - nvl(m.entree,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montantEcart ,
CAST(nvl(td.quantite,0) - nvl(m.sortie,0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as reste
FROM transfertstockdetailscpl td
LEFT JOIN transfertstockcpl t ON t.id = td.idtransfertstock 
LEFT JOIN mvtstockfilletransfert m ON m.idtransfertdetail = td.id 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ASBLCLIENTCPLASINGREDIENTS" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER") AS 
  SELECT
	abcf.ID,
	abcf.PRODUIT,
	abcf.NUMBL,
	abcf.QUANTITE,
	abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
	abcf.UNITE,
	abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
	p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS idproduitlib,
	vd.idvente,
	abc.idbc,
	CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
	CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.id = abcf.produit
LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL 

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BC_FILLE_AVEC_PRIX" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "PU", "TVA", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BC_RESTE_A_FACTURER" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "QTELIVRER", "QTEFACTURER", "FOURNISSEUR", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "DATY") AS

    bc.idbc,
    bc.produitlib,
    bc.unitelib,

    --nvl(ff.qte + ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
    nvl(ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer,
    FOURNISSEUR,
    FOURNISSEURLIB,
    DATY
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL bc

        left join FF_FILLEBC_GRP_MERE ffm on ffm.IDBC = bc.IDBC and ffm.IDPRODUIT = bc.PRODUIT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCF_VENTE_RESTE" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS

v.id,
v.idproduit,
v.qte -nvl(b.quantite,0) AS quantite,

NULL AS unite,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLFILLEGRP_VENTE_CPL_V" ("PRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "DATY", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "ID") AS

	    a.IDPRODUITLIB,

	    abc.id

	GROUP BY a.IDPRODUITLIB,
	         a.IDVENTE,a.PRODUIT,abc.daty
	        , a.UNITE,u.val, abc.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLFILLEGRP_VENTE_CPL_V2" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "DATY", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    a.numbl as id ,
    a.PRODUIT ,
    a.IDPRODUITLIB,
    a.IDVENTE,
    abc.daty,
    nvl( sum(QUANTITE) ,0) AS QUANTITE,
    a.UNITE,
    u.VAL AS unitelib

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BLCLIENTFILLEINSERTION" ("PRODUITLIB", "ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "UNITELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS 
  SELECT
pl.VAL AS PRODUITLIB,
bl.id,
bl.PRODUIT,
bl.NUMBL,
bl.QUANTITE,
pl.IDUNITELIB AS UNITELIB,
bl.IDVENTEDETAIL,
bl.UNITE,
bl.IDBC_FILLE
FROM 
AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE bl
JOIN PRODUIT_LIB pl ON bl.PRODUIT = pl.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENTFILLE_BC_RESTE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE") AS 
  SELECT 
bc.ID,
b.PRODUIT,
b.NUMBL,
nvl((bc.QUANTITE - b.QUANTITE),0) AS QUANTITE,
b.IDVENTEDETAIL,
b.UNITE
FROM BCClient_Fille_GRP bc 
JOIN BLClient_Fille_GRP b ON b.IDBC = bc.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENT_CPL_ASINGREDIENTS" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER") AS 
  SELECT
	abcf.ID,
	abcf.PRODUIT,
	abcf.NUMBL,
	abcf.QUANTITE,
	abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
	abcf.UNITE,
	abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
	p.LIBELLEEXTACTE AS idproduitlib,
	vd.idvente,
	abc.idbc,
	CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
	CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.id = abcf.produit
LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL 

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BL_CLIENT_FILLE_VISE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE") AS 
  select acf."ID",acf."PRODUIT",acf."NUMBL",acf."QUANTITE",acf."IDVENTEDETAIL",acf."UNITE",acf."IDBC_FILLE" from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE acfleft join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc on abc.ID = NUMBLwhere ETAT = 11;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONCOMMANDE_FILLE_AVEC_PRIX" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDMERE", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "PU", "TVA", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT") AS 
  SELECT
    bc.ID,
    bc.PRODUIT,
    bc.IDMERE,

    bc.UNITE,
    CAST(ai.PV AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS pu,
    CAST(ai.TVA AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS tva,
    ai.COMPTE_VENTE,ai.COMPTE_ACHAT
FROM
    BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bC
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
    ON ai.ID = bl.PRODUIT

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDEFILLE_CPL" ("IDBC", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "REMISEMONTANT", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  SELECT
abf.IDBC ,
CAST(nvl(sum(montantht),0) AS NUMBER(30,2))  AS montantHT,
CAST(nvl(sum(montanttva),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttva,
CAST(nvl(sum(remiseMontant),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS remiseMontant,
abf.TAUXDECHANGE
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL abf
GROUP BY abf.IDBC,abf.TAUXDECHANGE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "MONTANT", "PU", "TVA", "UNITE", "REMISE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTHT", "REMISEMONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS 
  select bcf.ID,bcf.PRODUIT,bcf.IDBC,bcf.QUANTITE,bcf.QUANTITE*bcf.PU AS montant,bcf.PU,bcf.TVA,bcf.UNITE,bcf.REMISE,
       ab.DATY,
       ab.ETAT,
       ab.REMARQUE,
       ab.DESIGNATION,
       ab.MODEPAIEMENT,
       ab.FOURNISSEUR,
       ab.REFERENCE,
       p.LIBELLE  as produitlib,
       u.VAL  as unitelib,
       mp.VAL as MODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       F.nom  AS FOURNISSEURLIB,
       CAST (((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttva,
       CAST( (((((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))-(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)))))+(((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100)))) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc,
       CAST (((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantht,
       CAST(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS remiseMontant,
       bcf.iddevise,
       CAST(bcf.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE,
       CAST( (((((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu + (bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100)) - bcf.quantite * bcf.pu * (bcf.tva / 100))-(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)))))+(((bcf.quantite * bcf.pu)-((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.tva / 100))))* bcf.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR
from AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE bcf
         left outer join AS_BONDECOMMANDE AB on AB.ID = bcf.IDBC
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS P on bcf.PRODUIT = P.ID
         left join AS_UNITE u on bcf.UNITE = u.id
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on AB.MODEPAIEMENT = mp.id
         left join fournisseur F on AB.fournisseur = F.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPT" ("ID", "IDBC", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PRODUIT", "QUANTITE", "QTELIVRER", "QTEFACTURER") AS 
  SELECT
    bc.id,
    bc.idbc,
    bc.produitlib,
    bc.unitelib,
    bc.produit,
    nvl(bc.quantite,0) AS quantite,
    nvl(bl.qte,0) AS qtelivrer,
    --nvl(ff.qte + ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
    nvl(ffm.qte,0) AS qtefacturer
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL bc
         LEFT JOIN ff_fillebl_grp bl ON bc.id = bl.IDBC_FILLE
         --LEFT JOIN ff_fillebc_grp ff ON bc.id = ff.IDBCDETAIL
        left join FF_FILLEBC_GRP_MERE ffm on ffm.IDBC = bc.IDBC and ffm.IDPRODUIT = bc.PRODUIT

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "UNITE", "IDUNITE", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "PRODUITLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_LIVRE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDBC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "UNITE", "REMISE", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "QTE_COMMANDE", "QTE_LIVRE", "QTE_RESTE", "PRODUITLIB", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  select bc."ID",bc."PRODUIT",bc."IDBC",bc."QUANTITE",bc."PU",bc."MONTANT",bc."TVA",bc."UNITE",bc."REMISE",bc."DATY",bc."ETAT",bc."REMARQUE",bc."DESIGNATION",bc."MODEPAIEMENT",bc."FOURNISSEUR",bc."REFERENCE",
       BC.QUANTITE as qte_commande,
       nvl(AB.qte_livre, 0)               as qte_livre,
       BC.QUANTITE - nvl(AB.qte_livre, 0) AS QTE_reste,
       p.LIBELLE as produitlib,
       bc.TAUXDECHANGE
from AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MF bc
         left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIVRE AB on AB.IDBC_FILLE = bc.id
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS p on p.id=bc.PRODUIT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MERECPL" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "DATELIMITE", "IDDMDACHAT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCARIARY", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDDEVISE", "ETATLIB", "IDSERVICELIB", "REFPROFORMA", "NB", "SOMMEACOMPTE", "REMISE") AS 
  SELECT
    ab.ID,
    ab.DATY,
    ab.ETAT,
    ab.REMARQUE,
    ab.DESIGNATION,
    ab.MODEPAIEMENT,
    ab.FOURNISSEUR,
    ab.REFERENCE,
    ab.dateLimite,
    ab.iddmdachat AS IDDMDACHAT,
    mp.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    F.NOM AS FOURNISSEURLIB,
    CAST(abf.montantTVA*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTVA,
    cast(abf.montantHT*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,
    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA - abf.remiseMontant)*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC ,
    CAST(nvl((abf.montantHT + abf.montantTVA- abf.remiseMontant) * abf.TAUXDECHANGE*(1-(NVL(ab.REMISE,0)/100)),0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAriary,
    d.val AS idDeviselib,
    d.id AS IDDEVISE,
    CASE
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
        WHEN ab.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    s.VAL AS idServiceLib,
    ab.refproforma,
    1 AS nb,
    vw.TOTAL_DEBIT as sommeAcompte,
    ab.REMISE
FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE AB
    LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT mp ON AB.MODEPAIEMENT = mp.id
    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR F ON AB.FOURNISSEUR = F.id
    LEFT JOIN AS_BONDECOMMANDEFILLE_CPL abf ON abf.IDBC = ab.ID
    LEFT JOIN DEVISE d ON d.id = ab.IDDEVISE
    LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT s ON ab.SERVICE = s.ID
    LEFT JOIN vw_mouvementcaisse_total_debit vw on VW.IDBC = ab.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDECOMMANDE_MERETRAITE" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "FOURNISSEUR", "REFERENCE", "DATELIMITE", "IDDMDACHAT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCARIARY", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDDEVISE", "ETATLIB", "IDSERVICELIB", "REFPROFORMA", "SOMMEACOMPTE", "REMISE", "IDTRAITE", "TRAITE") AS 
  SELECT
    abm."ID",abm."DATY",abm."ETAT",abm."REMARQUE",abm."DESIGNATION",abm."MODEPAIEMENT",abm."FOURNISSEUR",abm."REFERENCE",abm."DATELIMITE",abm."IDDMDACHAT",abm."MODEPAIEMENTLIB",abm."FOURNISSEURLIB",abm."MONTANTTVA",abm."MONTANTHT",abm."MONTANTTTC",abm."MONTANTTTCARIARY",abm."IDDEVISELIB",abm."IDDEVISE",abm."ETATLIB",abm."IDSERVICELIB",abm."REFPROFORMA",
    abm.SOMMEACOMPTE,abm.remise,
    CASE
      WHEN abrcp.totalRecept = 0 THEN '0'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande > abrcp.totalRecept THEN '1'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande = abrcp.totalRecept THEN '2'
      WHEN abrcp.totalCommande < abrcp.totalRecept THEN '3'
      END AS IDTRAITE,
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalRecept = 0 THEN 'Non Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande > abrcp.totalRecept  THEN 'Traité Partiellement'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande = abrcp.totalRecept THEN 'Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totalCommande < abrcp.totalRecept THEN 'Traité avec surplus'
        END AS TRAITE
  FROM As_BonDeCommande_MERECPL abm
  left join AS_BONDECOMMANDE_CPL_RECEPTGRP abrcp on abrcp.idbc = abm.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIB" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  select bl.ID,
       bl.REMARQUE,
       bl.IDBC,
       bl.DATY,
       bl.ETAT,
       bl.MAGASIN,
       m.VAL as MAGASINlib,
       case
           when bl.etat = 1 then 'CREE(E)'
           when bl.etat = 11 then 'VISE(E)'
           end as etatlib
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl
    left join MAGASIN m on bl.MAGASIN = m.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_LIBCPL" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS SELECT AB.ID, AB.REMARQUE, AB.IDVENTE, AB.IDBC, AB.DATY, AB.ETAT, AB.MAGASIN, AB.IDORIGINE, AB.IDCLIENT, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, CASE WHEN AB.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉ' WHEN AB.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN AB.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ' END AS ETATLIB, ( AB.ID || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL || ' | ' || AB.REMARQUE ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT AB LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON AB.MAGASIN = M.ID LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = AB.IDCLIENT ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONCLIENT_lib" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB") AS

from AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONC_LIBCPL_C" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISONC_LIBCPL_V" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "IDORIGINE", "IDCLIENT", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_CPL" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDMAGASIN", "MAGASIN", "IDRESERVATION", "IDCLIENTLIB", "VEHICULE", "CHAUFFEUR", "DESCRIPTION", "IDCLIENT") AS 
  SELECT bl.id, bl.remarque,
v.id AS idvente,
v.designation,
bl.idbc, bl.daty, bl.etat,
m.id AS idmagasin,
m.val AS magasin,
v.IDRESERVATION,
c.nom AS IDCLIENTlib,
bl.vehicule,
bl.chauffeur,

LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON bl.magasin=m.id
LEFT JOIN vente v ON v.id=bl.idvente

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_CPL2" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDMAGASIN", "MAGASIN", "IDRESERVATION", "IDCLIENTLIB", "VEHICULE", "CHAUFFEUR", "DESCRIPTION", "IDCLIENT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE_VIDE" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "PRODUITLIB", "QUANTITE", "UNITE", "NUMBL", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "PU", "DESIGNATION", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  SELECT
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS ID,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS PRODUIT,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS PRODUITLIB ,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS QUANTITE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS UNITE,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS NUMBL,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDBC_FILLE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(200)) AS REMARQUE ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(100)) AS IDBC ,
	    cast(NULL as DATE ) AS DATY ,
	    cast(-1 as int ) AS ETAT,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(500)) AS MAGASIN ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS UNITELIB ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS MAGASINLIB,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS pu ,
	    cast(' ' as varchar(255)) AS designation,
	    cast(-1 as NUMBER(10,2) ) AS tauxdechange
	FROM dual
	 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR") AS

       bl.DATY,

       bl.MAGASIN,
       m.VAL as MAGASINlib,
       case
           when bl.etat = 1 then 'CRÉÉ(E)'

           end as etatlib,
       bl.idfournisseur,
       f.nom AS idfournisseurlib,
       bl.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
from AS_BONDELIVRAISON bl
         left join MAGASIN2 m on bl.MAGASIN = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN fournisseur f ON f.id=bl.idfournisseur
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIBCPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "PRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "DESIGNATION", "MONTANT", "PUAR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR") AS 
  SELECT
	    bl.ID,
	    bl.PRODUIT,
	    bl.NUMBL,
	    bl.QUANTITE,
	    bl.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
	    bl.UNITE,
	    bl.IDBC_FILLE,
	    AB.REMARQUE,
	    AB.IDBC,
	    AB.DATY,
	    AB.ETAT,
	    AB.MAGASIN,
	    p.libelle AS PRODUITlib,
	    u.VAL AS UNITElib,
	    m.VAL AS magasinlib,
	    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
	    bl.pu,
	    bl.DESIGNATION,
	    cast(nvl(bl.QUANTITE*bl.PU,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANT,
	    cast(nvl(bl.tauxdechange*bl.PU,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS PUAR,
	    bl.tauxdechange,
        AB.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR -- nanampy colonne IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR pour rapprochement BL - FF
	FROM
	    As_BonDeLivraison_Fille bl
	        LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON AB ON
	        AB.ID = bl.NUMBL
	        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON
	        bl.PRODUIT = p.ID
	        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE  u ON
	        bl.UNITE = u.ID
	        LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON
	        ab.MAGASIN = m.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONDELIVRAISON_TRAITE" ("ID", "REMARQUE", "IDBC", "DATY", "ETAT", "MAGASIN", "MAGASINLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDTRAITE", "TRAITE") AS 
  SELECT
    abm."ID",abm."REMARQUE",abm."IDBC",abm."DATY",abm."ETAT",abm."MAGASIN",abm."MAGASINLIB",abm."ETATLIB",abm."IDFOURNISSEUR",abm."IDFOURNISSEURLIB",abm."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer > abrcp.totalFacturer THEN '1'
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = abrcp.totallivrer THEN '2'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer < abrcp.totalFacturer THEN '3'
    END AS IDTRAITE,
    CASE
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = 0 THEN 'Non Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer > abrcp.totalFacturer  THEN 'Traité Partiellement'
        WHEN abrcp.totalFacturer = abrcp.totallivrer THEN 'Traité'
        WHEN abrcp.totallivrer < abrcp.totalFacturer THEN 'Traité avec surplus'
    END AS TRAITE
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_LIB abm
         left join RAPPROCHEMENT_FFOURNISSEURGRP abrcp on abrcp.NUMBL = abm.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER", "UNITELIB", "PU", "QTEVENTE") AS 
  SELECT
    abcf.ID,
    abcf.PRODUIT,
    abcf.NUMBL,
    abcf.QUANTITE,
    abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    abcf.UNITE,
    abcf.IDBC_FILLE,
    nvl(p.LIBELLEVENTE,p.libelle) AS idproduitlib,
    vd.idvente,
    abc.idbc,
    CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qtelivree,
    CAST(nvl(abcf.QUANTITE - CAST(nvl(s.qtelivree ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2))  ,0)AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS qteResteALivrer,
    u.val AS uniteLib,
    vd.PU,
    vd.qte as qtevente
FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT_FILLE abcf
         LEFT JOIN as_ingredients p ON p.id = abcf.produit
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.id = abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL and vd.IDPRODUIT = abcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT abc ON abc.id = abcf.numbl
         LEFT JOIN sortiestockfille s ON s.IDPRODUIT = abcf.produit AND s.IDVENTEDETAIL =abcf.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u ON u.id = abcf.UNITE;

where p.ACTIF = 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_INGREDIENTS_LIB" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "PARFUMS", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "COMPOSELIB", "IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "BIENOUSERV", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "PV", "TVA", "TYPESTOCK", "IDUNITE", "REFPOST", "REFQUALIFICATION", "REFPOSTLIB", "REFQUALIFICATIONLIB", "IDFAMILLELIB", "TYPEPRODUIT", "IDLIGNE", "COMPTE_STOCK", "COMPTE_SORTIE_STOCK", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "LIBELLEVENTE", "NBPIECE", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "COMPTE_RISTOURNE", "ISACHAT") AS 
                     WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 1 THEN 'OUI'                   WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 0 THEN 'NON'                   END AS VARCHAR2(100)       ) AS COMPOSELIB,       cating.id AS IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,       catIng.VAL AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS idcategorie,       ing.idfournisseur,       ing.daty,       catIng.desce as bienOuServ,       CASE WHEN ing.id IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )                THEN 'INDISPONIBLE'            WHEN ing.id NOT IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )                THEN 'DISPONIBLE'           END AS etatlib,       ing.COMPTE_VENTE,       ing.COMPTE_ACHAT,       CAST(ing.pv AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS pv,       CAST(ing.tva AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS tva,       ing.TYPESTOCK,       ing.UNITE as idunite,       ing.REFPOST,       ing.REFQUALIFICATION ,       p.VAL AS REFPOSTLIB,       qp.VAL AS REFQUALIFICATIONLIB,       fp.val AS idfamilleLib,       ing.typeProduit,       tp.idligne,       ing.compte_stock,       ing.compte_sortie_stock,       f.nom as idFournisseurLib,       dep.val AS idDepartementLib,       nvl(ing.LIBELLEVENTE,ing.libelle) as LIBELLEVENTE,       eq.QUANTITE as nbpiece,       tp.val AS typeproduitLib,       ing.COMPTE_RISTOURNE,       ing.isAchatFROM as_ingredients ing         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON ing.UNITE = AU.ID         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB catIng                   ON catIng.id = ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT         LEFT JOIN POSTE p ON p.id = ing.REFPOST         LEFT JOIN FAMILLEPRODUIT fp ON fp.id=ing.idfamille         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.id = ing.REFQUALIFICATION         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID=ing.typeProduit         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON ing.idFournisseur = f.id         LEFT JOIN departement dep ON dep.id=ing.parfums         Left join EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq on eq.IDPRODUIT1 = ing.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."AS_INGREDIENTS_LIB2" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "PARFUMS", "SEUIL", "UNITELIB", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "COMPOSELIB", "IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "BIENOUSERV", "ETATLIB", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "PV", "TVA", "TYPESTOCK", "UNITE", "REFPOST", "REFQUALIFICATION", "REFPOSTLIB", "REFQUALIFICATIONLIB") AS 
  SELECT ing.id,
       concat(concat(ing.LIBELLE,' '),ing.PARFUMS) as LIBELLE,
       ing.PARFUMS,
       ing.SEUIL,
       au.VAL AS unitelib,
       ing.QUANTITEPARPACK,
       ing.pu,
       ing.ACTIF,
       ing.PHOTO,
       ing.CALORIE,
       ing.DURRE,
       ing.COMPOSE,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
                   WHEN ing.COMPOSE = 0 THEN 'NON'
                   END AS VARCHAR2(100)
       ) AS COMPOSELIB,
       cating.id AS IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,
       catIng.VAL AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
       ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS idcategorie,
       ing.idfournisseur,
       ing.daty,
       catIng.desce as bienOuServ,
       CASE WHEN ing.id IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
                THEN 'INDISPONIBLE'
            WHEN ing.id NOT IN (SELECT idproduit FROM INDISPONIBILITE i )
                THEN 'DISPONIBLE'
           END AS etatlib,
       ing.COMPTE_VENTE,
       ing.COMPTE_ACHAT,
       ing.pv,
       ing.tva,
       ing.TYPESTOCK,
       ing.UNITE as unite,
       ing.REFPOST,
       ing.REFQUALIFICATION ,
       p.VAL AS REFPOSTLIB,
       qp.VAL AS REFQUALIFICATIONLIB
FROM as_ingredients ing
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON ing.UNITE = AU.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB catIng
                   ON catIng.id = ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN POSTE p ON p.id = ing.REFPOST
         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.id = ing.REFQUALIFICATION
 ;
