CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CNAPS_T1" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "PRENOM", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "DIRECTION", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "ANNEE", "MOIS1", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR1", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR1", "MOIS2", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR2", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR2", "MOIS3", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR3", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR3", "COTISATION_TRAVAILLEUR", "COTISATION_EMPLOYEUR") AS 
  SELECT
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom AS personnel,
    pipl.prenom as prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.direction,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pec.annee,

    NVL(s1.brut, 0) AS mois1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur1,

    NVL(s2.brut, 0) AS mois2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur2,

    NVL(s3.brut, 0) AS mois3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur3,

    (NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0)) AS cotisation_travailleur,
    (NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0)) AS cotisation_employeur

FROM
    paie_edition_cnaps pec
        JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl
             ON TO_CHAR(pipl.id) = TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel)
                 AND pec.mois IN (1, 2, 3)

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 1
    ) s1 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s1.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s1.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 2
    ) s2 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s2.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s2.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 3
    ) s3 ON TO_CHAR(pec.idpersonnel) = TO_CHAR(s3.idpersonnel) AND pec.annee = s3.annee

GROUP BY
    pec.idpersonnel, pipl.matricule, pipl.nom, pipl.prenom ,pipl.numero_cnaps, pipl.direction, pec.annee,
    s1.brut, s1.cnaps_travailleur, s1.cnaps_employeur, pipl.dateembauche,
    s2.brut, s2.cnaps_travailleur, s2.cnaps_employeur,
    s3.brut, s3.cnaps_travailleur, s3.cnaps_employeur
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CNAPS_T2" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "PRENOM", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DIRECTION", "ANNEE", "MOIS1", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR1", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR1", "MOIS2", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR2", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR2", "MOIS3", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR3", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR3", "COTISATION_TRAVAILLEUR", "COTISATION_EMPLOYEUR") AS 
  SELECT
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom AS personnel,
    pipl.prenom as prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pipl.direction,
    pec.annee,

    NVL(s1.brut, 0) AS mois1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur1,
    NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur1,

    NVL(s2.brut, 0) AS mois2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur2,
    NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur2,

    NVL(s3.brut, 0) AS mois3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur3,
    NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0) AS cnaps_employeur3,

    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_travailleur,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_employeur

FROM paie_edition_cnaps pec
         JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl
              ON pipl.id = pec.idpersonnel
                  AND pec.mois IN (4, 5, 6)

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
    FROM paie_edition_cnaps
    WHERE mois = 4
) s1 ON pec.idpersonnel = s1.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s1.annee

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
    FROM paie_edition_cnaps
    WHERE mois = 5
) s2 ON pec.idpersonnel = s2.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s2.annee

         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
    FROM paie_edition_cnaps
    WHERE mois = 6
) s3 ON pec.idpersonnel = s3.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s3.annee

GROUP BY
    pec.idpersonnel, pipl.matricule, pipl.nom, pipl.numero_cnaps, pipl.prenom,    pipl.dateembauche,
    pipl.direction, pec.annee,
    s1.brut, s1.cnaps_travailleur, s1.cnaps_employeur,
    s2.brut, s2.cnaps_travailleur, s2.cnaps_employeur,
    s3.brut, s3.cnaps_travailleur, s3.cnaps_employeur
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CNAPS_T3" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "PRENOM", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DIRECTION", "ANNEE", "MOIS1", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR1", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR1", "MOIS2", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR2", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR2", "MOIS3", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR3", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR3", "COTISATION_TRAVAILLEUR", "COTISATION_EMPLOYEUR") AS 
  SELECT
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom AS personnel,
    pipl.prenom as prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pipl.direction,
    pec.annee,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.brut, 0), 2) AS mois1,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur1,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur1,
    ROUND(NVL(s2.brut, 0), 2) AS mois2,
    ROUND(NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur2,
    ROUND(NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur2,
    ROUND(NVL(s3.brut, 0), 2) AS mois3,
    ROUND(NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur3,
    ROUND(NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur3,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_travailleur,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_employeur
FROM
    paie_edition_cnaps pec
        JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl ON pipl.id = pec.idpersonnel
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 7
    ) s1 ON pec.idpersonnel = s1.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s1.annee
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 8
    ) s2 ON pec.idpersonnel = s2.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s2.annee
        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT idpersonnel, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 9
    ) s3 ON pec.idpersonnel = s3.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s3.annee
WHERE
    pec.mois IN (7, 8, 9)
GROUP BY
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom,
    pipl.prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pipl.direction,
    pec.annee,
    s1.brut, s1.cnaps_travailleur, s1.cnaps_employeur,
    s2.brut, s2.cnaps_travailleur, s2.cnaps_employeur,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CNAPS_T4" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "PRENOM", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DIRECTION", "ANNEE", "MOIS1", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR1", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR1", "MOIS2", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR2", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR2", "MOIS3", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR3", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR3", "COTISATION_TRAVAILLEUR", "COTISATION_EMPLOYEUR") AS 
  SELECT
    pec.idpersonnel,
    pipl.matricule,
    pipl.nom AS personnel,
    pipl.prenom,
    pipl.numero_cnaps,
    pipl.dateembauche,
    pipl.direction,
    pec.annee,

    ROUND(NVL(s1.brut, 0), 2) AS mois1,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur1,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur1,

    ROUND(NVL(s2.brut, 0), 2) AS mois2,
    ROUND(NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur2,
    ROUND(NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur2,

    ROUND(NVL(s3.brut, 0), 2) AS mois3,
    ROUND(NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur3,
    ROUND(NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cnaps_employeur3,

    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_travailleur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_travailleur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_travailleur,
    ROUND(NVL(s1.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s2.cnaps_employeur, 0) + NVL(s3.cnaps_employeur, 0), 2) AS cotisation_employeur

FROM
    paie_edition_cnaps pec
        JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pipl
             ON pipl.id = pec.idpersonnel
                 AND pec.mois IN (10, 11, 12)

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 10
    ) s1 ON pec.idpersonnel = s1.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s1.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 11
    ) s2 ON pec.idpersonnel = s2.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s2.annee

        LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            idpersonnel, mois, annee, brut, cnaps_travailleur, cnaps_employeur
        FROM paie_edition_cnaps
        WHERE mois = 12
    ) s3 ON pec.idpersonnel = s3.idpersonnel AND pec.annee = s3.annee
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMMANDECPL" ("ID", "DATY", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "DESIGNATION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "IDCLIENT", "REFERENCE", "IDDEVISE", "IDMAGASIN", "DATEBESOIN", "IDPROFORMA", "MODELIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "LIEULIVRAISON", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "MONTANTTTC", "MOTSCLESSS") AS WHEN CMD.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE' WHEN CMD.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE' WHEN CMD.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' ELSE 'Inconnu' END AS ETATLIB, CASE WHEN CMD.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN CMD.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, MP.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB, CMM.MONTANTTTC, ( CMD.ID || ' | ' || REFERENCE || ' | ' || CL.NOM || ' | ' || DESIGNATION || ' | ' || CMD.REMARQUE ) AS MOTSCLESSSFROM COMMANDE CMD LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 P ON P.ID = CMD.IDMAGASIN LEFT JOIN CLIENT CL ON CL.ID = CMD.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT MP ON MP.ID = CMD.MODEPAIEMENT LEFT JOIN COMMANDEMONTANT CMM ON CMM.ID = CMD.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMMANDEFILLE_CPL_LIB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "IDC", "QUANTITE", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "REMISE", "IDDEVISE", "UNITE", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "QTERESTE", "UNITELIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTDELAREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "RISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "POIDSTOTAL", "CALORIE") AS 
  SELECT bcf.ID,
       bcf.PRODUIT,
       bcf.IDC,
       bcf.QUANTITE,
       bcf.PU,
       bcf.MONTANT,
       bcf.TVA,
       bcf.REMISE,
       bcf.IDDEVISE,
       bcf.UNITE,
       nvl(i.LIBELLEVENTE,i.libelle)                                                                                                                                      AS PRODUITlib,
       i.compte_vente                                                                                                                                 AS compte,
       NVL(bcf.quantite, 0) - NVL(vdbc.qte, 0)                                                                                                        AS qtereste,
       au.val                                                                                                                                         AS UNITELIB,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) as Number(30, 2))                                                                                   AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       cast(((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) as number(30, 2))                                                          as montantdelaremise,
       cast((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
            (bcf.ristourne / 100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                                   as montantristourne,
       cast(NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) -
            ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) - ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) *
             (bcf.ristourne / 100)) -
            nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                                                    as montantremise,
       CAST(
               (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) -
                 (((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100)) +
                  ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0) -
                    ((NVL(bcf.PU, 0) * NVL(bcf.QUANTITE, 0)) * (bcf.REMISE / 100))) * (bcf.ristourne / 100))) -
                 nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) *
                (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                                                                                              AS MONTANTTVA,
       cast((cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) - ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
              nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) /
              100) - nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(bcf.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                             (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                   ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                   100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                              (cast((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) -
                                                                                    ((bcf.quantite * bcf.PU) * NVL(bcf.remise, 0)) /
                                                                                    100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                               nvl(bcf.ristourne, 0) / 100) -
                                                                              nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       bcf.ristourne,
       nvl(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE * bc.fraislivraison, 0)                                                                                           as fraistransport,
       CAST(NVL(i.CALORIE * bcf.QUANTITE,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS poidstotal,
       i.CALORIE
FROM COMMANDEFILLE bcf
         left JOIN as_ingredients i ON i.id = bcf.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN vente_details_qte_grp vdbc ON bcf.id = vdbc.idbcfille
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = i.unite
         LEFT JOIN COMMANDE bc on bc.id = bcf.IDC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMMANDEMONTANT" ("ID", "POIDSTOTAL", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM(poidstotal) as number(30, 2))                            AS poidstotal,
       cast(SUM(PU) as number(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       cast(SUM(MONTANTREMISE) as number(30, 2))                         as montantremise,
       cast(SUM(montantristourne) as number(30, 2))                      as montantristourne,
       cast(SUM(vd.fraistransport) as number(30, 2))                     as fraistransport,
       cast(SUM(montanttotal) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QUANTITE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2)) AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(montanttva) as number(30, 2))                            AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(vd.MONTANTTTC) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                            AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(1), 1)                                      AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM(MONTANTTTC) as number(30, 2))          as montantTTCAR
FROM COMMANDEFILLE_CPL_LIB vd
         LEFT JOIN COMMANDE v ON v.ID = vd.IDC
GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE
 ;

  SELECT ce.ID,
       ce.DATY,
       ce.DATECOMPTABLE,
       ce.EXERCICE,
       ce.DESIGNATION,
       ce.REMARQUE,
       ce.ETAT,
       ce.HORSEXERCICE,
       ce.JOURNAL,
       ce.OD,
       ce.ORIGINE,
       ce.CREDIT,
       ce.DEBIT,
       ce.IDUSER,
       ce.PERIODE,
       ce.TRIMESTRE,
       ce.ANNEE,
       COALESCE(ce.IDOBJET , '-') as IDOBJET,
       CAST(cm.montant AS NUMBER(38, 2))                        AS montant,

       CASE
           WHEN ce.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Cree'

           ELSE 'Autre'
           END                                                  AS etatlib,
       COALESCE(fc.IDFOURNISSEURLIB, vc.idClientlib, mvc.tiers, '-') AS tierslib,

           WHEN ce.ORIGINE = 'AVR' THEN '-'
           WHEN ce.ORIGINE = 'MTC' THEN COALESCE(vc_mtc.NUMEROFACTURE, fc_mtc.NUMERO, '-')

           END                                AS piece

         JOIN COMPTA_MONTANT cm ON ce.id = cm.IDMERE
         LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL cj ON cj.id = ce.JOURNAL
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL fc ON fc.id = ce.idobjet

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_MOUVEMENT_ANALYTIQUE" ("DEBIT", "CREDIT", "COMPTE", "ETAT", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS 
  SELECT
    CAST(sum(debit) AS NUMBER(30,
        2)) AS debit,
    CAST(sum(credit) AS NUMBER(30,
        2)) AS credit,
    compte,
    etat,
    libelle_compte,
    typecompte,
    mois,
    annee,
    chiffre3,
    chiffre2
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cse.id,
            cse.debit AS debit,
            cse.credit AS credit,
            cse.analytique AS compte,
            cc.LIBELLE AS libelle_compte,
            cse.daty AS daty,
            cse.etat,
            cc.typecompte AS typecompte,
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cse.daty) AS mois,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS annee,
            substr(analytique, 1, 3)|| substr(analytique, 5, 1) AS chiffre3,
            substr(analytique, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse
                JOIN compta_compte cc ON
                cc.compte = cse.analytique

            cse.journal!='COMP000015'
          AND (cse.debit + cse.credit)>0

            SELECT

  SELECT
	cse.id,
	(
	SELECT
		MIN(csec.compte) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST
	ORDER BY
		GREATEST(csec.debit, csec.credit) DESC)
	FROM
		compta_sous_ecriture csec
	WHERE
		csec.idmere = cse.idmere
		AND csec.id <> cse.id
		AND (

            (cse.debit > 0
			AND csec.credit > 0)
		OR

            (cse.credit > 0
			AND csec.debit > 0)

            )

    ) AS contrep,
	t.nom AS compte_auxlib,
	t.compteauxiliaire AS compte,
	cse.debit,
	cse.credit,
	cse.libellepiece,
	cse.remarque,
	cse.idmere,
	cse.analytique AS REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT,
	cse.compte_aux,
	lettre.lettre AS lettrage,
	cj.val AS journal,
	EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS exercice,
	cse.etat,
	cse.daty,
	cse.folio,
	CAST(0 AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS coursdevise,
	CAST(0 AS NUMBER(20, 2)) AS montantdevise
FROM
	COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse
LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON
	cse.COMPTE_AUX = t.id
LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL_VIEW cj ON
	cj.id = cse.journal
LEFT JOIN compta_compte cc ON
	cse.compte = cc.compte
LEFT JOIN compta_type_compte ctc ON
	cc.typecompte = ctc.id
LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE lettre ON
	lettre.id = cse.lettrage
WHERE
	1<2
	AND cj.id <> 'COMP000015'
	AND ((cse.DEBIT>0
		AND cse.credit = 0)
	OR (cse.DEBIT = 0
		AND cse.credit>0))
 



;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_MOUVEMENT_GENERAL" ("DEBIT", "CREDIT", "COMPTE", "ETAT", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS 
  SELECT
    CAST(sum(debit)AS NUMBER(30,
        2)) AS debit,
    CAST(sum(credit) AS NUMBER(30,
        2)) AS credit,
    compte,
    etat,
    libelle_compte,
    typecompte,
    mois,
    annee,
    chiffre3,
    chiffre2
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cse.id,
            cse.debit AS debit,
            cse.credit AS credit,
            cse.compte AS compte,
            cc.LIBELLE AS libelle_compte,
            cse.daty AS daty,
            cse.etat,
            cc.typecompte AS typecompte,
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cse.daty) AS mois,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.daty) AS annee,
            CASE
                WHEN substr(cse.compte, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
                ELSE substr(cse.compte, 1, 2)|| substr(cse.compte, 5, 1)
                END AS chiffre3,
            substr(cse.compte, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse
                JOIN compta_compte cc ON
                cc.compte = cse.compte
                JOIN compta_journal cj ON
                cj.id = cse.JOURNAL
        WHERE
            (cse.debit + cse.credit)>0
          AND NOT EXISTS(
            SELECT
                rs.id
            FROM
                reportsolde rs
            WHERE
                rs.id = cse.id
        )
    )
GROUP BY compte,
         etat,
         libelle_compte,
         typecompte,
         mois,
         annee,
         chiffre3,
         chiffre2
ORDER BY
    chiffre3 ASC
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LETTRE" ("ID", "NUMERO", "COMPTE", "JOURNAL", "IDJOURNAL", "ECRITURE", "DATY", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "DATECOMPTABLE", "EXERCICE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDMERE", "HORSEXERCICE", "OD", "ORIGINE", "TIERS", "LIBELLEPIECE", "COMPTE_AUX", "RAISONSOCIAL", "FOLIO", "LETTRAGE", "ANALYTIQUE", "IDVENTE", "LETTRE", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT
    lib.ID,lib.NUMERO,lib.COMPTE,lib.JOURNAL,lib.IDJOURNAL,lib.ECRITURE,lib.DATY,lib.CREDIT,lib.DEBIT,lib.DATECOMPTABLE,lib.EXERCICE,lib.REMARQUE,lib.ETAT,lib.IDMERE,lib.HORSEXERCICE,lib.OD,lib.ORIGINE,lib.TIERS,lib.LIBELLEPIECE,lib.COMPTE_AUX,lib.RAISONSOCIAL,lib.FOLIO,lib.LETTRAGE,lib.ANALYTIQUE,
    COALESCE(mtc.IDORIGINE, ecr.IDOBJET) AS IDVENTE,CLTR.lettre,
     CASE
        WHEN NVL(lib.DEBIT, 0) = 0 THEN lib.CREDIT
        WHEN NVL(lib.CREDIT, 0) = 0 THEN lib.DEBIT
        ELSE lib.DEBIT - lib.CREDIT
    END AS MONTANT

    COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB lib

order by IDVENTE DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LETTRE2" ("ID", "NUMERO", "COMPTE", "JOURNAL", "IDJOURNAL", "ECRITURE", "DATY", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "DATECOMPTABLE", "EXERCICE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDMERE", "HORSEXERCICE", "OD", "ORIGINE", "TIERS", "LIBELLEPIECE", "COMPTE_AUX", "RAISONSOCIAL", "FOLIO", "LETTRAGE", "ANALYTIQUE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDVENTE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.NUMERO,SQ.COMPTE,SQ.JOURNAL,SQ.IDJOURNAL,SQ.ECRITURE,SQ.DATY,SQ.CREDIT,SQ.DEBIT,SQ.DATECOMPTABLE,SQ.EXERCICE,SQ.REMARQUE,SQ.ETAT,SQ.IDMERE,SQ.HORSEXERCICE,SQ.OD,SQ.ORIGINE,SQ.TIERS,SQ.LIBELLEPIECE,SQ.COMPTE_AUX,SQ.RAISONSOCIAL,SQ.FOLIO,SQ.LETTRAGE,SQ.ANALYTIQUE,SQ.MONTANTRESTE,SQ.IDVENTE,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(NUMERO),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(JOURNAL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDJOURNAL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECRITURE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(CREDIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DEBIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATECOMPTABLE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(EXERCICE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMERE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(HORSEXERCICE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(OD),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ORIGINE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TIERS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLEPIECE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE_AUX),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(RAISONSOCIAL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(FOLIO),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LETTRAGE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANALYTIQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTRESTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDVENTE),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (

SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             cast(nvl(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - nvl(mv.montant, 0) - nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR-acg.MONTANTPAYEAR, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
             v.id as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         		  LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2
                  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
                  
                  UNION ALL
                  
                  
         -- CAS 2 : MOUVEMENTCAISSE ? VENTE
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, mvt.IDORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             0 AS MONTANTRESTE,
             mvt.IDORIGINE as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mvt ON mvt.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VENTE v WHERE v.ID = mvt.IDORIGINE)

         UNION ALL

         -- CAS 3 : FACTURE FOURNISSEUR
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             CAST(nvl((cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS number(30,5)) * cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  number(30,5))),0)  AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS MONTANTRESTE,
             v.ID as idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
                  JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR  v ON v.ID = lib.IDOBJET
                  JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON v.ID = f3.id
    			  LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON v.id=mv.IDORIGINE

         UNION ALL

         -- CAS 4 : ECRITURE COMPTABLE SANS LIEN AVEC VENTE NI FACTURE FOURNISSEUR
         SELECT
             lib.ID, lib.NUMERO, lib.COMPTE, lib.JOURNAL, lib.IDJOURNAL,
             lib.ECRITURE, lib.DATY, lib.CREDIT, lib.DEBIT, lib.DATECOMPTABLE,
             lib.EXERCICE, lib.REMARQUE, lib.ETAT, lib.IDMERE,
             lib.HORSEXERCICE, lib.OD, lib.ORIGINE, lib.TIERS,
             lib.LIBELLEPIECE, lib.COMPTE_AUX, lib.RAISONSOCIAL,
             lib.FOLIO, lib.LETTRAGE, lib.ANALYTIQUE,
             NULL AS MONTANTRESTE,
             NULL AS idVente
         FROM COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_2 lib
         WHERE NOT  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM VENTE v WHERE v.ID = lib.IDOBJET)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f WHERE f.ID = lib.IDOBJET )
                ) SQ
order by IDVENTE desc

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB" ("ID", "NUMERO", "COMPTE", "JOURNAL", "IDJOURNAL", "ECRITURE", "DATY", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "DATECOMPTABLE", "EXERCICE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDMERE", "HORSEXERCICE", "OD", "ORIGINE", "TIERS", "LIBELLEPIECE", "COMPTE_AUX", "RAISONSOCIAL", "FOLIO", "LETTRAGE", "ANALYTIQUE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE", "COMPTE_AUXLIB", "IDOBJET") AS 
  select
    sousecr.id,
    cpt.LIBELLE as numero,
    cpt.COMPTE,
    jrn.val as journal ,
    jrn.id as idjournal,
    sousecr.REMARQUE as ecriture,
    sousecr.DATY,
    sousecr.CREDIT,
    sousecr.DEBIT,
    sousecr.DATY AS DATECOMPTABLE,
    sousecr.EXERCICE,
    sousecr.REMARQUE,
    sousecr.ETAT,
    sousecr.idmere,
    cast(0 as number) AS HORSEXERCICE,
    cast('-' as varchar(50)) AS OD,
    CE.ORIGINE AS ORIGINE,
    cast('' as varchar2(50)) as tiers,
    sousecr.LIBELLEPIECE,
    sousecr.COMPTE_AUX,
    cast('' as varchar(100)) as RAISONSOCIAL ,
    sousecr.folio ,
    sousecr.LETTRAGE ,
    sousecr.ANALYTIQUE,
    te.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE as compteauxiliaire,
    te.NOM as compte_auxlib,
    ce.IDOBJET as idobjet
from
    COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE sousecr
        join COMPTA_COMPTE cpt on  sousecr.COMPTE = cpt.COMPTE
        join COMPTA_JOURNAL jrn on sousecr.JOURNAL = jrn.ID
        left join tiersensemble te on sousecr.COMPTE_AUX=te.id
        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE CE ON CE.ID = sousecr.idMERE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB_J" ("ID", "NUMERO", "COMPTE", "JOURNAL", "IDJOURNAL", "ECRITURE", "DATY", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "DATECOMPTABLE", "EXERCICE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDMERE", "HORSEXERCICE", "OD", "ORIGINE", "TIERS", "LIBELLEPIECE", "COMPTE_AUX", "RAISONSOCIAL", "FOLIO", "LETTRAGE", "ANALYTIQUE", "DESIGNATIONMERE", "JOUR", "MOIS", "ANNEE") AS 
  select cse."ID",cse."NUMERO",cse."COMPTE",cse."JOURNAL",cse."IDJOURNAL",cse."ECRITURE",cse."DATY",cse."CREDIT",cse."DEBIT",cse."DATECOMPTABLE",cse."EXERCICE",cse."REMARQUE",cse."ETAT",cse."IDMERE",cse."HORSEXERCICE",cse."OD",cse."ORIGINE",cse."TIERS",cse."LIBELLEPIECE",cse."COMPTE_AUX",cse."RAISONSOCIAL",cse."FOLIO",cse."LETTRAGE",cse."ANALYTIQUE",ce.DESIGNATION as designationmere,
       EXTRACT(DAY FROM cse.DATY)   AS jour,
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cse.DATY) AS mois,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cse.DATY)  AS annee  from COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_LIB cse join COMPTA_ECRITURE ce on cse.IDMERE=ce.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUSECRITURE_SANSPG" ("ID", "NUMERO", "COMPTE", "JOURNAL", "IDJOURNAL", "ECRITURE", "DATY", "CREDIT", "DEBIT", "DATECOMPTABLE", "EXERCICE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "HORSEXERCICE", "OD", "ORIGINE", "TIERS", "LIBELLEPIECE", "COMPTE_AUX", "RAISONSOCIAL", "FOLIO", "LETTRAGE", "ANALYTIQUE", "IDOBJET", "IDMERE") AS 
  select
    sousecr.id,
    cpt.LIBELLE,
    cpt.COMPTE,
    jrn.val||'| '|| jrn.DESCE ,
    jrn.id,
    sousecr.REMARQUE as DESIGNATION,
    sousecr.DATY,
    sousecr.CREDIT,
    sousecr.DEBIT,
    sousecr.DATY AS DATECOMPTABLE,
    sousecr.EXERCICE,
    sousecr.REMARQUE,
    sousecr.ETAT,
    cast(0 as number) AS HORSEXERCICE,
    cast('-' as varchar(50)) AS OD,
    cast('' as varchar(50)) AS ORIGINE,
    cast('' as varchar2(50)) as tiers,
    sousecr.LIBELLEPIECE,
    sousecr.COMPTE_AUX,
    cast('' as varchar(100)) as RAISONSOCIAL ,
    sousecr.folio ,
    sousecr.LETTRAGE ,
    ANALYTIQUE,
    CASE
        WHEN ce.IDOBJET= pe.id THEN pe.idorigine
        ELSE ce.idobjet
        END
        AS idobjet,
      sousecr.IDMERE
from
    COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE sousecr
        join COMPTA_COMPTE cpt on  sousecr.COMPTE = cpt.COMPTE
        join COMPTA_JOURNAL jrn on sousecr.JOURNAL = jrn.ID
        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ce ON ce.id = sousecr.IDMERE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE_ANAL" ("ID", "COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "LIBELLEPIECE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT", "COMPTE_AUX", "LETTRAGE", "JOURNAL", "EXERCICE", "ETAT", "DATY", "FOLIO") AS 
  SELECT cse.id, cse.analytique as compte, cse.debit, cse.credit,cse.libellepiece, cse.remarque,cse.idMere, cse.reference_engagement, cse.compte_aux, lettre.lettre as lettrage,cj.val as journal,cse.exercice, cse.etat,cse.daty, cse.folio FROM COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse
join COMPTA_JOURNAL_VIEW cj on cj.id = cse.journal
join compta_compte cc on cse.analytique=cc.compte
join compta_type_compte ctc on cc.typecompte=ctc.id
left join COMPTA_LETTRAGE lettre on lettre.id = cse.lettrage
 ;

  SELECT
    cse.ID,

    cse.DEBIT,
    cse.CREDIT,
    cse.REMARQUE,
    cse.LIBELLEPIECE,
    cse.IDMERE,

    t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE AS COMPTE_AUX,

    cse.JOURNAL,

    cse.ETAT,
    cse.DATY,
    cse.FOLIO,

FROM COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE cse

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE_CSEMF" ("ID", "COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLEPIECE", "IDMERE", "REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT", "COMPTE_AUX", "LETTRAGE", "JOURNAL", "EXERCICE", "ETAT", "DATY", "FOLIO", "ANALYTIQUE", "SOURCE", "ORIGINE", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT 
    CSE.ID,
    CSE.COMPTE,
    CSE.DEBIT,
    CSE.CREDIT,
    CSE.REMARQUE,
    CSE.LIBELLEPIECE,
    CSE.IDMERE,
    CSE.REFERENCE_ENGAGEMENT,
    CSE.COMPTE_AUX,
    CSE.LETTRAGE,
    CSE.JOURNAL,
    CSE.EXERCICE,
    CSE.ETAT,
    CSE.DATY,
    CSE.FOLIO,
    CSE.ANALYTIQUE,
    CSE.SOURCE,
    CE.ORIGINE,
     CASE
        WHEN NVL(CSE.DEBIT, 0) = 0 THEN CSE.CREDIT
        WHEN NVL(CSE.CREDIT, 0) = 0 THEN CSE.DEBIT
        ELSE CSE.DEBIT - CSE.CREDIT
    END AS MONTANT
FROM COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE CSE
LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE CE
    ON CE.ID = CSE.IDMERE;

join COMPTA_JOURNAL_VIEW cj on cj.id = cse.journal
join compta_compte cc on cse.compte=cc.compte
join compta_type_compte ctc on cc.typecompte=ctc.id
left join COMPTA_LETTRAGE lettre on lettre.id = cse.lettrage

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURCPL" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLIGNE", "ANCIEN", "VALEUR", "ECART", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDLIGNELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.daty,
    c.idligne,
    c.ancien,
    c.valeur,
    c.ecart,
    c.idcategorie,
    l.val        AS idlignelib,
    cc.libelle       AS idcategorielib,
    c.etat,
       CASE
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 0
	            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 1
	            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 11
	            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Chef de Fabrication'
	        WHEN c.ETAT = 3
	            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Releveur'
	        END AS etatlib,
    c.IDMAGASIN,
    m.VAL AS idMagasinLib
FROM compteurmaintenance c
         LEFT JOIN ligne l
                   ON l.id = c.idligne
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS_CONSOMMABLE cc
                   ON cc.id = c.idcategorie
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = c.IDMAGASIN
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURCPLRECENT" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLIGNE", "VALEUR", "ECART", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ANCIEN", "IDLIGNELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDMAGASINLIB", "RN") AS 
  SELECT "ID","DATY","IDLIGNE","VALEUR","ECART","IDCATEGORIE","IDMAGASIN","ETAT","ANCIEN","IDLIGNELIB","IDCATEGORIELIB","IDMAGASINLIB","RN"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        cm.ID,
        cm.DATY,
        cm.IDLIGNE,
        cm.VALEUR,
        cm.ECART,
        cm.IDCATEGORIE,
        cm.IDMAGASIN,
        cm.ETAT,
        cm.ANCIEN,
        cm.IDLIGNELIB ,
        cm.IDCATEGORIELIB ,
        cm.IDMAGASINLIB ,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cm.IDLIGNE, cm.IDCATEGORIE, cm.IDMAGASIN
            ORDER BY cm.DATY DESC
        ) AS rn
        
    FROM CompteurCPL cm
)
WHERE rn = 1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURCPLRECENTELECTRICITE" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLIGNE", "VALEUR", "ECART", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ANCIEN", "REMARQUE", "HEURE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMERE", "LIGNE", "CATEGORIELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "MACHINELIB", "LIGNELIB", "RN") AS 
  SELECT ID,DATY,IDLIGNE,VALEUR,ECART,IDCATEGORIE,IDMAGASIN,ETAT,ANCIEN,
       REMARQUE,HEURE,IDMACHINE,IDMERE,LIGNE,CATEGORIELIB,MAGASINLIB,
       MACHINELIB,LIGNELIB,RN
FROM (
    SELECT
        cm.ID,
        cm.DATY,
        cm.IDLIGNE,
        cm.VALEUR,
        cm.ECART,
        cm.IDCATEGORIE,
        cm.IDMAGASIN,
        cm.ETAT,
        cm.ANCIEN,
        cm.REMARQUE,
        cm.HEURE,
        cm.IDMACHINE,
        cm.IDMERE,
        cm.LIGNE,
        cm.CATEGORIELIB,
        cm.MAGASINLIB,
        cm.MACHINELIB,
        cm.LIGNELIB,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cm.IDLIGNE, cm.IDCATEGORIE, cm.IDMAGASIN
            ORDER BY cm.DATY DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM COMPTEURELECTRICITECPL cm
)
WHERE rn = 1

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURELECTRICITECPL" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLIGNE", "VALEUR", "ECART", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ANCIEN", "REMARQUE", "HEURE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMERE", "LIGNE", "CATEGORIELIB", "MAGASINLIB", "MACHINELIB", "LIGNELIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURELECTRICITELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLIGNE", "VALEUR", "ECART", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ANCIEN", "REMARQUE", "HEURE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMERE", "IDLIGNELIB", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "PU", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT

    l.VAL AS IdLigneLib,
    m.LIBELLE AS IdMachineLib,
    cat.LIBELLE AS IdCategorieLib,
    cat.pu AS pu,
    cat.pu * ce.ECART AS montant
FROM CompteurElectricite ce
         LEFT JOIN Ligne l ON ce.IdLigne = l.id
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MACHINE m ON ce.IdMachine = m.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COMPTEURELECTRICITEMERELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "LIGNE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "LIGNELIB", "CONSOMMATION", "MONTANT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    c.ID,
    c.DATY,
    c.LIGNE,
    c.REMARQUE,
    c.ETAT,
    l.VAL AS LIGNELIB,
    NVL(f.CONSOMMATION, 0) AS CONSOMMATION,
    NVL(f.MONTANT, 0) AS MONTANT,
    CASE
        WHEN c.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Chef de Fabrication'
        WHEN c.ETAT = 3
            THEN 'VISÉ(E) par Releveur'
        END AS etatlib
FROM
    COMPTEURELECTRICITEMERE c
        LEFT JOIN LIGNE l
                  ON l.ID = c.LIGNE
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                fe.IDMERE AS ID_MERE,
                SUM(fe.ECART)    AS CONSOMMATION,
                SUM(fe.MONTANT)    AS MONTANT
            FROM
                COMPTEURELECTRICITELIB fe
            GROUP BY
                fe.IDMERE
        ) f ON f.ID_MERE = c.ID


 
 ;

    l.VAL AS IDLIGNELIB,
    tr.ID AS idTravaux,
    t.DATY ,
    CAST (tr.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(10,2)) AS CoutTotal
FROM TRAVAUX_RECAP tr
         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUX t
                   ON tr.id = t.ID
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE o
                   ON t.IDOFFILLE = o.id
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
                   ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = aim.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COUT_FAB_PAR_OF" ("IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "INGREDIENTS", "COUTDEPRODUCTION") AS 
  SELECT 
    base.IDMERE,
    base.DATYBESOIN,
    base.IDINGREDIENTS AS INGREDIENTS,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN base.QTEFABRIQUE = 0 OR base.QTEFABRIQUE IS NULL THEN 0
                ELSE base.MONTANTSORTIE / base.QTEFABRIQUE
            END
        ) , 2
    ) / 1000000 AS COUTDEPRODUCTION
FROM 
    OFFILLELIBSTOCK base
    JOIN OFAB fb ON fb.id = base.idmere AND fb.etat >= 11
GROUP BY 
    base.IDMERE,
    base.DATYBESOIN,
    base.IDINGREDIENTS
ORDER BY 
    base.IDMERE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."COUT_FAB_PAR_OF_TEMP" ("IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "INGREDIENTS", "COUTDEPRODUCTION", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.IDMERE,SQ.DATYBESOIN,SQ.INGREDIENTS,CAST(SQ.COUTDEPRODUCTION AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS COUTDEPRODUCTION ,
	  (NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMERE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATYBESOIN,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(INGREDIENTS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COUTDEPRODUCTION),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	  SELECT 
	    base.IDMERE,
	    base.DATYBESOIN,
	    base.IDINGREDIENTS AS INGREDIENTS,
	    ROUND(
	        SUM(montantsortie) , 2
	    )  AS COUTDEPRODUCTION
	FROM 
	    OFFILLELIBSTOCK base
	    JOIN OFAB fb ON fb.id = base.idmere AND fb.etat >= 11
	GROUP BY 
	    base.IDMERE,
	    base.DATYBESOIN,
	    base.IDINGREDIENTS
	ORDER BY 
	    base.IDMERE
	 
	) SQ
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."CV_LIB" ("ID", "NOMCANDIDAT", "PRENOMCANDIDAT", "TITRECV", "RESUMEPROFIL", "DATY", "IDFICHEPOSTE", "IDFICHEPOSTELIB", "ETATLIB") AS

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DECLARATIONTVALIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DATYDEBUT", "DATYFIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTPAYER", "PAYEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
             de.id,
             de.designation,
             de.datyDebut,
             de.datyFin,
             de.etat,
             CASE
                 WHEN de.etat = 1 THEN 'Cree'
                 WHEN de.etat = 11 THEN 'Valide'
                 ELSE 'Inconnu'
                 END AS etatLib,
             nvl(mv.DEBIT,nvl(fd.MONTANTTTC,0)) as montantpayer,
             case
                 when mv.IDORIGINE is null then case when fd.IDBC='CREDIT' then 'Reporte' else 'Non paye' end
                 else 'Paye'
                 END as payementLib
         FROM DeclarationTVA de left join FACTUREDECLARATIONCPL fd on de.id=fd.IDOBJET left join mouvementcaisse mv on mv.IDORIGINE=fd.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DEMANDETRANSFERTCPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASINDEPART", "IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB", "IDMAGASINARRIVE", "IDMAGASINARRIVELIB", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOF", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB", "MONTANTQUANTITE", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    t.ID ,
    t.DESIGNATION ,
    t.IDMAGASINDEPART ,
    m.VAL AS IDMAGASINDEPARTLIB,
    t.IDMAGASINARRIVE ,
    m2.VAL AS IDMAGASINARRIVELIB,
    t.DATY ,
    t.ETAT ,
    t.idof,
    t.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    c.VAL  AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB,
    CAST(dfg.montantQuantite AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantQuantite,
    CASE
        WHEN t.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'Annulé'
        WHEN t.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'Créé'
        WHEN t.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'Visé'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM demandetransfert t
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = t.IDMAGASINDEPART
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m2 ON m2.ID = t.IDMAGASINARRIVE
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON c.ID = t.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN DEMTRANSFILLEGROUPEMERE dfg ON dfg.IDDEMANDETRANSFERT = t.id
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DEMANDETRAVAUX_CPL" ("ID", "IDENTITE", "IDSITUATION", "IDMACHINE", "DATY", "DATEBESOIN", "PRIORITE", "ESTEXISTANT", "DESCRIPTION", "ETAT", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDENTITELIB", "IDSITUATIONLIB", "IDMACHINELIB", "ESTEXISTANTLIB", "ETATLIB", "IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE", "IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCELIB", "PRIORITELIB", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "IDOTFILLE", "IDTYPEMAINTENANCE", "IDTYPEMAINTENANCELIB", "PERSONNELLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDENTITE,SQ.IDSITUATION,SQ.IDMACHINE,SQ.DATY,SQ.DATEBESOIN,SQ.PRIORITE,SQ.ESTEXISTANT,SQ.DESCRIPTION,SQ.ETAT,SQ.IDDEPARTEMENT,SQ.IDENTITELIB,SQ.IDSITUATIONLIB,SQ.IDMACHINELIB,SQ.ESTEXISTANTLIB,SQ.ETATLIB,SQ.IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE,SQ.IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCELIB,SQ.PRIORITELIB,SQ.IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,SQ.IDOTFILLE,SQ.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE,SQ.IDTYPEMAINTENANCELIB,SQ.PERSONNELLIB,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDENTITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDSITUATION),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMACHINE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATEBESOIN,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PRIORITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ESTEXISTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DESCRIPTION),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEPARTEMENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDENTITELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDSITUATIONLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMACHINELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ESTEXISTANTLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETATLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PRIORITELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDDEPARTEMENTLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDOTFILLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPEMAINTENANCE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTYPEMAINTENANCELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PERSONNELLIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT
             dmd.ID, dmd.IDENTITE, dmd.IDSITUATION, dmd.IDMACHINE, dmd.DATY, dmd.DATEBESOIN, dmd.PRIORITE, dmd.ESTEXISTANT, dmd.DESCRIPTION, dmd.ETAT, dmd.IDDEPARTEMENT,
             e.VAL AS idEntiteLib,
             s.VAL AS idSituationLib,
             m.LIBELLE AS idMachineLib,
             CASE dmd.ESTEXISTANT
                 WHEN 0 THEN 'NON'
                 WHEN 1 THEN 'OUI'
                 ELSE 'Non specifie'
                 END AS estExistantLib,
             CASE dmd.ETAT
                 WHEN 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
                 WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDÉE' 
                 ELSE 'CRÉÉE'
                 END AS etatLib,
             d.id AS IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE,
             d.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCELIB,
             pri.val AS prioritelib,
             departement.val AS IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,
             otf.ID AS idOtFille,
             pl.idtypemaintenance AS idtypemaintenance,
             tm.val AS idtypemaintenancelib,
             pers.NOMUSER as personnelLib
         FROM DEMANDETRAVAUX dmd
                  LEFT JOIN ENTITE e ON e.ID = dmd.IDENTITE
                  LEFT JOIN SITUATION s ON s.ID = dmd.IDSITUATION
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m ON m.ID = dmd.IDMACHINE
                  LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE d ON d.ID = dmd.IDDEPARTEMENTMAINTENANCE
                  LEFT JOIN PRIORITE pri ON dmd.priorite = pri.ID
                  LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT departement ON departement.id = dmd.iddepartement
                  LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUX o ON o.IDBC = dmd.ID
                  LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE otf ON otf.IDMERE = o.ID
                  LEFT JOIN PLANNING pl ON pl.id = dmd.idplanning
                  LEFT JOIN TYPEMAINTENANCE tm ON tm.id = pl.idtypemaintenance
                  LEFT JOIN UTILISATEUR pers ON pers.REFUSER = dmd.DEMANDEUR
     ) SQ
     


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DEMANDE_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "IDFONCTION", "FONCTIONLIB", "IDTYPEDEMANDE", "TYPEDEMANDELIB", "TITRE", "HORAIRENORMAL", "HEUREDEPART", "HEUREARRIVE", "IDTYPEABSENCE", "TYPEABSENCELIB", "MOTIF", "NUMERO", "DESCE", "ETAT", "DATY", "DUREE", "DATEDEPART", "DATERETOUR", "OBSERVATION", "REMARQUE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "IDDIRECTION", "DIRECTIONLIB", "ETATLIB", "REFUSER", "RANGUSER", "IDREMPLACENTS", "REMPLACENTS", "MATRICULES", "DATEFIN", "PERSONNEL", "IDSUP", "AVENANT", "ANNULER", "SUPERIEUR", "MOTIFREFU", "WEEKENDDECOMPTELIB", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT d.id,
	       d.idpersonnel,
	       pip.matricule,
	       pip.idfonction,
	       pf.val AS fonctionlib,
	       d.idtypedemande,
	       t.val AS typedemandelib,
	       d.titre,
	       d.horairenormal,
	       d.heuredepart,
	       d.heurearrive,
	       d.idtypeabsence,
	       t2.desce AS typeabsencelib,
	       d.motif,
	       d.numero,
	       d.desce,
	       d.etat,
	       d.daty,
	       d.duree,
	       d.datedepart,
	       d.dateretour,
	       d.observation,
	       d.remarque,
	       lp.nom,
	       lp.prenom,
	       lp.direction AS iddirection,
	       ld.val AS directionlib,
	       CASE
	           WHEN d.etat = 1 THEN 'Cree'
	           WHEN d.etat = 11 THEN 'Valide'
	           WHEN d.etat = -1 THEN 'Refusee'
	           ELSE 'AUTRE'
	           END AS etatlib,
	       u.refuser,
	       r.rang AS ranguser,
	       d.idremplacents,
	       rmp.remplacents,
	       pip.matricule AS matricules,
	       d.datefin,
	       (lp.nom || ' ') || lp.prenom AS personnel,
	       lp.idsup,
	       d.avenant,
	       CASE
	           WHEN d.avenant IS NOT NULL THEN 'OUI'
	           ELSE NULL
	           END AS annuler,
	       (pl.nom || ' ') || pl.prenom AS superieur,
	       d.MOTIFREFU,
	       CASE WHEN
	                WEEKENDDECOMPTE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
	            WHEN WEEKENDDECOMPTE = 0 THEN 'NON'
	           END AS weekendDecompteLib,
	       d.IDDEPARTEMENT,
	       dp.DESCE as departementLib
	FROM demande d
	         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON d.idpersonnel = pip.id
	         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pf.id = pip.idfonction
	         LEFT JOIN typedemande t ON t.id = d.idtypedemande
	         LEFT JOIN typeabsence t2 ON t2.id = d.idtypeabsence
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id = pip.id
	         LEFT JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id = lp.direction
	         LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.refuser = lp.refuser
	         LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.idrole = u.idrole
	         LEFT JOIN demande_remplacents rmp ON rmp.id = d.id
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel pl ON pl.id = lp.idsup
	         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT dp ON dp.id = d.IDDEPARTEMENT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DEPENSEDIVERSLIB" ("ID", "DATY", "FOURNISSEUR", "REMARQUE", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "COMPTECHEQUE", "ACHETEUR", "IDMAGASIN", "IDCATEGORIE", "ETAT", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "ETATLIB", "SERVICELIB", "IDSECTIONLIB", "SERVICE", "IDSECTION", "MONTANTTOTAL", "SURPLUSTOTAL", "RENDUTOTAL") AS 
  SELECT
    d.ID, d.DATY, d.FOURNISSEUR, d.REMARQUE, d.IDMODEPAIEMENT, d.COMPTECHEQUE, d.ACHETEUR, d.IDMAGASIN, d.IDCATEGORIE, d.ETAT,
    f.NOM AS fournisseurLib,
    m.VAL AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    m2.val AS idMagasinLib,
    c.VAL AS idCategorieLib,
    CASE
        WHEN d.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 3 THEN 'VISÉE par Chef de D&eacutepartement'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 4 THEN 'VISÉE par Directeur de D&eacutepartement'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 5 THEN 'VISÉE par Le Directeur'
        WHEN d.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE par Contrôle'
        END AS etatlib,
    s.LIBELLE AS serviceLib,
    sec.VAL AS idSectionLib,
    d.service,
    d.idSection,
    (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(df.QUANTITE, 0) * NVL(df.PU, 0)), 0)
     FROM DEPENSEDIVERSFILLE df
     WHERE df.IDMERE = d.ID
    ) AS montantTotal,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
            WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
               OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
            THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(mc.DEBIT, 0)), 0)
                  FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
                  WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
                     OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
                 ) - (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(df.QUANTITE, 0) * NVL(df.PU, 0)), 0)
                      FROM DEPENSEDIVERSFILLE df
                      WHERE df.IDMERE = d.ID)
        ELSE 0
        END AS surplusTotal,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
            WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
               OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
            THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(mc.CREDIT, 0)), 0)
                  FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc
                  WHERE mc.IDORIGINE = d.ID
                     OR mc.IDORIGINE IN (SELECT b.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR FROM AS_BONDELIVRAISON b WHERE b.IDDEPENSEDIVERS = d.ID)
        )
        ELSE 0
        END AS renduTotal
FROM DEPENSEDIVERS d
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON d.FOURNISSEUR = f.ID
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON d.IDMODEPAIEMENT = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m2 ON d.IDMAGASIN = m2.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON d.IDCATEGORIE = c.ID
         LEFT JOIN departementDivers s ON s.id = d.SERVICE
         LEFT JOIN SECTION sec ON sec.ID = d.IDSECTION

 ;

left join OFFILLE ofile on fabb.IDOFFILLE=ofile.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DEPENSE_MAT_PREM" ("DATY", "ID", "DESIGNATION", "QUANTITE", "PU", "DEPENSE") AS 
  SELECT 
	f.DATY ,
	ff.idproduit AS id,
	ai.LIBELLE AS designation,
	nvl(sum(ff.qte),0) AS quantite,
	nvl(avg(ff.pu),0) AS pu,
	nvl(sum(ff.qte)*avg(ff.pu),0) AS depense
FROM 
FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f 
ON f.ID = ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai 
ON ai.ID = ff.idproduit
WHERE f.etat >=11
GROUP BY 
	ff.idproduit, 
	ai.LIBELLE,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DERNIER_DEBAUCHE_BY_EMPLOYE" ("IDLOGPERS", "DATEAPPLICATION", "IDTYPEDEBAUCHE", "DATE_DECISION", "DATE_REINTEGRATION", "RK", "DATEFIN") AS 
  WITH summary AS (
    SELECT
        p.idlogpers,
        p.dateapplication,
        p.idtypedebauche,
        p.date_decision,
        p.date_reintegration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.idlogpers ORDER BY p.date_decision DESC) AS rk,
        p.datefin
    FROM log_personnel_non_valide p
    WHERE p.idtypedebauche IN (
                               'TYD000013', 'TYD000002', 'TYD000003', 'TYD000004',
                               'TYD000012', 'TYD000014', 'TYD000001'
        )
      AND p.etat >= 11
)
SELECT
    s.idlogpers,
    s.dateapplication,
    s.idtypedebauche,
    s.date_decision,
    s.date_reintegration,
    s.rk,
    s.datefin
FROM summary s
WHERE s.rk = 1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DETAILS_PAIE_EDITION_FINALPDF" ("ID", "NOM", "POSTE", "SALAIRE_DE_BASE", "TAUX", "JUILLET", "INDEMNITEDEPRESENTATIONBRUT", "INDEMNITE_DE_TRANSPORT", "AVANTAGES_EN_NATURE", "MONTANT_BRUT", "CNAPS", "BRUTCNAPS", "IMPOSABLE", "IRSA", "NETAPRESCALCUL", "REDUCTIONPOURPERSONNESACHARGE", "IRSANET", "NET_A_PAYER", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "MATRICULE", "IDEDITION", "MOISLIB") AS 
  SELECT d.idpersonnel AS id,
       o.cturgence_nom_prenom AS nom,
       pf.desce AS poste,
       sum(d.salaire_de_base) AS salaire_de_base,
       sum(d.taux) AS taux,
       sum(d.juillet) AS juillet,
       sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) AS indemnitedepresentationbrut,
       sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) AS indemnite_de_transport,
       sum(d.avantages_en_nature) AS avantages_en_nature,
       sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) AS montant_brut,
       sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) AS cnaps,
       sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) AS brutcnaps,
       100 * trunc((sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur)) / 100) AS imposable,
       sum(d.irsa) AS irsa,
       round((sum(d.juillet) + sum(d.indemnitedepresentationbrut) + sum(d.indemnite_de_transport) + sum(d.avantages_en_nature) - sum(d.cnaps_travailleur) - sum(d.irsa)), 1) AS netaprescalcul,
       sum(d.reductionpourpersonnesacharge) AS reductionpourpersonnesacharge,
       sum(d.irsanet) AS irsanet,
       sum(d.net_a_payer) AS net_a_payer,
       d.mois,
       d.annee,
       o.dateembauche,
       o.numero_cnaps,
       o.matricule,
       d.idedition,
       TO_CHAR(
               TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(d.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
               'FMMonth',
               'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
       ) AS moisLib
FROM details_paie_edition_pdf d
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet o ON o.id = d.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = d.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pf.id = pip.idfonction
GROUP BY d.idpersonnel, o.cturgence_nom_prenom, pf.desce, d.mois, d.annee, o.dateembauche, o.numero_cnaps, o.matricule, d.idedition
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DETAILS_PAIE_EDITION_PDF" ("IDPERSONNEL", "IDELEMENTPAIE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "SALAIRE_DE_BASE", "TAUX", "JUILLET", "INDEMNITE_DE_TRANSPORT", "INDEMNITEDEPRESENTATIONBRUT", "AVANTAGES_EN_NATURE", "MONTANT_BRUT", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "BRUTCNAPS", "REDUCTIONPOURPERSONNESACHARGE", "IRSA", "NETAPRESCALCUL", "IRSANET", "NET_A_PAYER", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "IDEDITION") AS 
  SELECT paie_edition.idpersonnel,
       paie_edition.idelementpaie,
       paie_edition.gain,
       paie_edition.retenue,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NOT NULL THEN cq2.montant
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NULL THEN cq.montant
           ELSE 0
           END AS salaire_de_base,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NOT NULL THEN cq2.montant
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' AND cq2.montant IS NULL THEN cq.montant
           ELSE 0
           END / 30 AS taux,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS juillet,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000001' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS indemnite_de_transport,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000021' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS indemnitedepresentationbrut,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000201' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS avantages_en_nature,
       0 AS montant_brut,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN paie_edition.retenue
           ELSE 0
           END AS cnaps_travailleur,
       0 AS brutcnaps,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000181' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS reductionpourpersonnesacharge,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000141' THEN GREATEST(paie_edition.retenue, 3000)
           ELSE 0
           END AS irsa,
       0 AS netaprescalcul,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000141NET' THEN paie_edition.retenue
           ELSE 0
           END AS irsanet,
       CASE
           WHEN paie_edition.idelementpaie = 'PR000210A' THEN paie_edition.gain
           ELSE 0
           END AS net_a_payer,
       paie_edition.mois,
       paie_edition.annee,
       paie_edition.idedition
FROM paie_edition
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = paie_edition.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification cq ON cq.idcategorie = pip.idcategorie_paie AND cq.idqualification = pip.idqualification AND cq.remarque = '''' AND cq.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification cq2 ON cq2.idcategorie = pip.idcategorie_paie AND cq2.idqualification = pip.idqualification AND cq2.remarque = paie_edition.idpersonnel AND cq2.remarque = pip.id AND cq2.etat = 1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DMDACHATLIB" ("ID", "DATY", "FOURNISSEUR", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "REMARQUE", "DATELIMITE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDOBJET", "IDSERVICELIB", "IDPROVENANCE", "IDPROVENANCELIB", "SERVICE") AS 
  SELECT
    da.id,
    da.daty,
    da.fournisseur,
    f.nom AS fournisseurlib,
    da.remarque,
    da.dateLimite,
    m.val AS idMagasinLib,
    ci.val AS idCategorieLib,
    da.etat,
    CASE
        WHEN da.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN da.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CREEE'
        WHEN da.ETAT = 3
            THEN 'VISEE par Chef de departement'
        WHEN da.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS etatlib,
    da.idObjet,
    d.VAL AS idServiceLib,
    da.idProvenance,
    pr.val AS idProvenanceLib,
    da.SERVICE
FROM DMDACHAT da
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f ON f.ID = da.fournisseur
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON da.idMagasin = m.ID
         LEFT JOIN categorieIngredient ci ON da.idCategorie = ci.id
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT d ON da.SERVICE = d.id
         LEFT JOIN provenance pr ON da.idProvenance=pr.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DMDACHATLIB_TRAITE" ("ID", "DATY", "FOURNISSEUR", "FOURNISSEURLIB", "REMARQUE", "DATELIMITE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDOBJET", "IDSERVICELIB", "SERVICE", "IDTRAITE", "TRAITE", "IDPROVENANCE", "IDPROVENANCELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    d.ID,
    d.DATY,
    d.FOURNISSEUR,
    d.FOURNISSEURLIB,
    d.REMARQUE,
    d.DATELIMITE,
    d.IDMAGASINLIB,
    d.IDCATEGORIELIB,
    d.ETAT,
    d.ETATLIB,
    d.IDOBJET,
    d.IDSERVICELIB,
    d.service,
    CASE
        WHEN suivi.totalCommande = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN suivi.totalReste = 0 THEN '2'
        WHEN suivi.totalReste > 0 AND suivi.totalCommande > 0 THEN '1'
        ELSE '3'
        END AS IDTRAITE,
    CASE
        WHEN suivi.totalCommande = 0 THEN 'Non Traité'
        WHEN suivi.totalReste = 0 THEN 'Traité'
        WHEN suivi.totalReste > 0 AND suivi.totalCommande > 0 THEN 'Traité Partiellement'
        ELSE 'Traité avec surplus'
        END AS TRAITE,
    d.idProvenance,
    d.IDPROVENANCELIB
FROM DMDACHATLIB d
LEFT JOIN DMDACHATSUIVICOMMANDEGROUPEE suivi ON d.id = suivi.iddmdachat;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DMDACHATSUIVICOMMANDE" ("PRODUIT", "PRODUITDESIGNATION", "IDDMDACHAT", "QUANTITEDEMANDE", "QUANTITEDEJACOMMANDE", "RESTEACOMMANDER") AS 
  SELECT
    df.IDPRODUIT AS produit,
    df.DESIGNATION AS produitDesignation,
    df.IDMERE AS idDmdAchat,
    df.QUANTITE AS quantiteDemande,
    NVL(bcf_sum.quantiteCommande, 0) AS quantiteDejaCommande,
    df.QUANTITE - NVL(bcf_sum.quantiteCommande, 0) AS resteACommander
FROM DMDACHATFILLE df
LEFT JOIN DMDACHAT d
    ON d.ID = df.IDMERE
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        bc.IDDMDACHAT,
        bcf.PRODUIT,
        SUM(bcf.QUANTITE) AS quantiteCommande
    FROM AS_BONDECOMMANDE bc
    INNER JOIN AS_BONDECOMMANDE_FILLE bcf
        ON bcf.IDBC = bc.ID
    WHERE bc.IDDMDACHAT IS NOT NULL
      AND bcf.PRODUIT IS NOT NULL
      AND bc.ETAT <> 0
    GROUP BY bc.IDDMDACHAT, bcf.PRODUIT
) bcf_sum
    ON bcf_sum.IDDMDACHAT = df.IDMERE
   AND bcf_sum.PRODUIT = df.IDPRODUIT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."DUREE_CYCLE_FAB" ("IDMERE", "TEMPS") AS

FROM 
    PROCESS p
    JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.id = p.refobjet AND fab.etat >= 11
    JOIN OFFILLE off ON off.id = fab.IDOFFILLE
    JOIN OFAB o ON o.id = off.IDMERE

  SELECT logp.id,
       logp.nom,
       logp.prenom,
       logp.id_pers,
       paie.initiale,
       paie.matricule,
       logp.date_naissance,
       paie.lieu_naissance_commune,
       logp.sexe,
       logp.numero_cin,
       logp.date_cin,

       paie.idconjoint,
       logp.service,
       paie.idfonction,
       paie.ctg,
       paie.idcategorie,
       paie.classee,
       paie.indicegrade,
       paie.indice_fonctionnel,
       paie.matricule_patron,
       paie.statut,
       paie.mode_paiement,
       paie.code_agence_banque,
       paie.banque_numero_compte,

       logp.permis_conduire,

       paie.cturgence_nom_prenom,
       paie.cturgence_telephone1,
       paie.cturgence_telephone2,
       paie.cturgence_telephone3,
       paie.dateembauche,
       paie.datesaisie,
       serv.code_dr,
       trs.val AS banque_code,
       paie.echelon,
       paie.etat,
       paie.vehiculee,
       tab.date_dernierpromo,
       paie.droit_hs,
       paie.heurejournalier,
       paie.heurehebdomadaire,
       paie.heuremensuel,
       paie.numero_cnaps,
       paie.numero_ostie,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENTCPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDPOINT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DATY", "IDORIGINE", "IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT", "IDTYPEENCAISSEMENTLIB", "MONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX") AS 
  SELECT 
e.ID ,
e.DESIGNATION ,
e.IDCAISSE ,
c.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
c.IDPOINT ,
e.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN e.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
e.DATY ,
e.IDORIGINE,
e.IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT,
te.val AS IDTYPEENCAISSEMENTLIB,
e.montant,
nvl(e.iddevise,'AR') AS iddevise,
e.taux
FROM ENCAISSEMENT e 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID  = e.IDCAISSE 
LEFT JOIN TYPE_ENCAISSEMENT te ON te.id = e.IDTYPEENCAISSEMENT

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENTVENTE" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "VENTECARBURANT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_LIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DATY", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPISTELIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDCATEGORIECAISSE", "VENTECARBURANT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT", "DEPENSE", "TOTALRECETTE", "TOTALENCAISSEMENT", "TOTALVERSEMENT", "ECART", "TOTALESPECE", "TOTALORANGEMONEY") AS 
  SELECT 
e.ID ,
e.DESIGNATION ,
e.IDCAISSE ,
c.VAL AS IDCAISSELIB,
e.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN e.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
	WHEN e.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
END AS ETATLIB, 
e.DATY ,
c.IDPOMPISTE ,
p.NOMUSER AS IDPOMPISTELIB,
c.IDPOINT ,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB ,
c.IDCATEGORIECAISSE ,
nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) AS ventecarburant ,
nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) AS ventelubrifiant ,
nvl(dv.depense,0) AS depense ,
nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) + nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) AS totalrecette ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) AS totalencaissement ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) - nvl(dv.depense,0) AS totalversement ,
nvl(ev2.totalencaissement,0) - ( nvl(ev.ventecarburant,0) + nvl(vv.ventelubrifiant,0) ) AS ecart ,
nvl(ee.montantcategorie , 0) AS totalEspece,
nvl(eo.montantcategorie , 0) AS totalOrangeMoney
FROM ENCAISSEMENT e 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = e.IDCAISSE 
LEFT JOIN POMPISTELIB p ON p.REFUSER = c.IDPOMPISTE 
LEFT JOIN encaissementvente ev ON ev.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID 
LEFT JOIN ventelubrifiant_validee vv ON vv.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN depense_validee dv ON dv.IDORIGINE = e.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_validee ev2 ON ev2.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON p2.ID = c.IDPOINT 
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT_ESPECES ee ON ee.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT_ORANGEMONEY eo ON eo.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ENCAISSEMENT_RESUME" ("ID", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "DATY", "VENTECARBURANT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT", "BON", "CHEQUE", "MVOLA", "ESPECES", "ORANGEMONEY", "FANILO", "TPE", "VISA", "DEPENSE", "TOTALRECETTE", "TOTALENCAISSEMENT", "TOTALVERSEMENT") AS 
  SELECT

el.IDPOINT,
el.IDPOINTLIB ,
el.DATY,
el.ventecarburant,
el.ventelubrifiant,
nvl(eb.montantcategorie,0) AS bon ,
nvl(ec.montantcategorie,0) AS cheque ,
nvl(em.montantcategorie,0) AS mvola ,
nvl(ee.montantcategorie,0) AS especes ,
nvl(eo.montantcategorie,0) AS orangemoney ,
nvl(ef.montantcategorie,0) AS fanilo,
nvl(et.montantcategorie,0) AS tpe ,
nvl(ev.montantcategorie,0) AS visa ,
el.depense ,
el.totalrecette ,
el.totalencaissement ,
el.totalversement 
FROM ENCAISSEMENT_LIB el 
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIECAISSE c ON c.ID = el.IDCATEGORIECAISSE 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_bon eb ON eb.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_cheque ec ON ec.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_mvola em ON em.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_especes ee ON ee.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID 
LEFT JOIN encaissement_orangemoney eo ON eo.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_fanilo ef ON ef.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_tpe et ON et.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID
LEFT JOIN encaissement_visa ev ON ev.IDENCAISSEMENT = el.ID

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ETATRECAPITULATIFCOMMANDE" ("IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DATY", "MONTANT", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTANT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) as MONTANT,
    SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) as qteLivre,
    SUM(bcg.QTENONLIVRE) as qteNonLivre,
    COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0) as montantPaye,
    COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0) as montantRestant,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 22
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 2
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 111
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 11
        ELSE 1
        END as etat,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0)) >= SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Payé'
        WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(bcg.pu * bcg.QUANTITE), 0) - COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(mc_accompte.CREDIT), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(mc_paye.CREDIT), 0), 0)) > 0 THEN 'Accompte'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) = SUM(bcg.QUANTITE) THEN 'Livré'
        WHEN SUM(bcg.QTELIVRE) > 0 THEN 'non livré en totalité'
        ELSE 'non livré'
        END as etatLib
FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_GLOBALE bcg
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_accompte ON mc_accompte.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.IDORIGINE = bcg.IDBC
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE mc_paye ON mc_paye.IDORIGINE = v.ID
WHERE bcg.ETAT = 11
GROUP BY
    bcg.IDCLIENT,
    bcg.IDCLIENTLIB,
    bcg.DATY,
    bcg.IDBC
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ETAT_VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "POIDS", "RESTE", "FRAIS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "IDCLIENTLIB", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "IDCLIENT", "IDPROVINCE", "ETAT", "IDPROVINCELIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB") AS 
  SELECT V.ID,
       V.IDVENTE,
       V.IDPRODUIT,
       V.IDORIGINE,
       CAST(V.QTE AS NUMBER(38, 2))        AS QTE,
       V.PU,
       V.REMISE,
       V.TVA,
       V.PUACHAT,
       V.PUVENTE,
       V.IDDEVISE,
       V.TAUXDECHANGE,
       V.DESIGNATION,
       V.COMPTE,
       V.PUREVIENT,
       V.IDBCFILLE,
       V.UNITE,
       V.UNITELIB,
       V.PUNET,
       V.MONTANTHT,
       CAST(V.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC,
       CAST(V.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA,
       V.MONTANTREMISE,
       V.MONTANT,
       V.POIDS,
       VC.RESTE                            AS RESTE,
       V.FRAIS                             AS FRAIS,
       V.IDPRODUITLIB,
       V.DATY,
       V.DATYPREVU                         AS DATYPREVU,
       V.IDDEVISE                          AS IDDEVISELIB,
       V.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       V.CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,
       MONTANTTTC                          AS PUTOTAL,
       V.IDCLIENTLIB,
       V.RISTOURNE                         AS RISTOURNE,
       V.IDPREVISION,
       VE.IDCLIENT,
       C.IDPROVINCE,
       VE.ETAT,
       PRO.VAL                             AS IDPROVINCELIB,

       M.ID                                AS IDMAGASIN,
       M.VAL                               AS IDMAGASINLIB,

       P1.ID                               AS IDPOINT,
       P1.VAL                              AS IDPOINTLIB,

       TP.ID                               AS TYPEPRODUIT,
       TP.VAL                              AS TYPEPRODUITLIB

FROM VENTE_DETAILS_VIDE V
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCE E
                   ON E.IDPRODUIT = V.IDPRODUIT
                       AND E.IDUNITE = V.UNITE

         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS_RESTE VC
                   ON VC.ID = V.ID

         LEFT JOIN VENTE VE
                   ON VE.ID = V.IDVENTE

         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS P
                   ON P.ID = V.IDPRODUIT

         LEFT JOIN CLIENT C
                   ON C.ID = VE.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN PROVINCE PRO ON PRO.ID = C.IDPROVINCE
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = VE.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT P1 ON P1.ID = M.IDPOINT
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT TP ON TP.ID = P.TYPEPRODUIT
 ;

f.CIBLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.LIBELLE,
f.BESOIN,
f.DATY,
f.ETAT,
f.IDBC,
f.IDOFFILLE,
f.IDOF,
f.FABRICATIONPREC,
f.FABRICATIONSUIV,
f.EQUIPE,
CASE 
	WHEN f.LANCEUR IS NOT NULL

END AS LANCEUR

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONCPL" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "LANCEUR", "LANCEURLIB", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT F.ID,
       F.LANCEPAR,
       F.CIBLE,
       F.REMARQUE,
       F.LIBELLE,
       F.BESOIN,
       F.DATY,
       F.IDOFFILLE,
       NVL(F.IDOF, OFF.IDMERE) AS IDOF,
       P.VAL                   AS LANCEPARLIB,
       P2.VAL                  AS CIBLELIB,
       F.ETAT                  AS ETAT,
       F.LANCEUR,
       LP.PRENOM || LP.NOM     AS LANCEURLIB,
       CASE
           WHEN F.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 21 THEN 'ENTAME'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 31 THEN 'BLOQUE'
           WHEN F.ETAT = 41 THEN 'TERMINE'
           END                 AS ETATLIB,
       F.FABRICATIONPREC,
       F.FABRICATIONSUIV,
       (
           F.ID || ' | ' || P.VAL || ' | ' || P2.VAL || ' | ' || F.REMARQUE || ' | ' || IDOF || ' | ' || IDOFFILLE
           )                   AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM FABRICATION F
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P ON P.ID = F.LANCEPAR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P2 ON P2.ID = F.CIBLE
         LEFT JOIN OFFILLE OFF ON F.IDOFFILLE = OFF.ID
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL LP ON LP.ID = F.LANCEUR
 ;

    CAST(
        GREATEST(
            NVL(SUM(fab.QTE), 0) - NVL(SUM(mvt.ENTREE), 0), 
            0
        ) 
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FabEncours
FROM fabricationFilleFabriqueVise fab
LEFT JOIN MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE mvt 
    ON mvt.IDFAB = fab.IDMERE 
    AND mvt.IDPRODUIT = fab.IDINGREDIENTS

  SELECT 
f.ID,
CASE 
	WHEN f.IDINGREDIENTS IS NOT NULL 
	THEN f.IDINGREDIENTS||'---'||ai.libelle 
	ELSE f.IDINGREDIENTS
END AS IDINGREDIENTS ,
f.LIBELLE,
f.REMARQUE,
f.IDMERE,
f.DATYBESOIN,
f.IDUNITE,
f.IDBCFILLE,
f.OPERATEUR,
f.NIVEAU,
f.IDMACHINE,
f.PU,
f.QTE
FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id =  f.IDINGREDIENTS 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "OPERATEUR", "IDUNITELIB", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "ISPETRI", "IDOFFILLE", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDINGREDIENTS,
	f.LIBELLE,
	f.REMARQUE,
	f.IDMERE,
	f.DATYBESOIN,
	f.QTE,
	f.IDUNITE,
	f.PU,
	ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
	p.NOM || ' - ' || p.TELEPHONE AS operateur,
	au.val AS IDUNITELIB,
	f.IDBCFILLE ,
	f.IDMACHINE,
	m.descriptionobjet AS IDMACHINELIB,
	ai.ISPETRI ,
	f2.IDOFFILLE ,
	CAST( (f.QTE * f.PU ) AS NUMBER(30,5) ) AS MONTANT 
FROM
	FABRICATIONFILLE f
JOIN FABRICATION f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDMERE 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
	ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS
LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON
	p.ID = f.OPERATEUR
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
	au.id = f.IDUNITE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MACHINE m ON m.ID = f.IDMACHINE  

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLECPL2" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "REVIENT", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "DATY") AS

    f.IDINGREDIENTS,
    f.LIBELLE,
    f.REMARQUE,
    f.IDMERE,
    f.DATYBESOIN,
    f.QTE,

FROM FABRICATIONFILLE f
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = f.IDINGREDIENTS

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEFABRIQUEVISE" ("IDMERE", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QTE") AS

f.idMere,
f.IDINGREDIENTS,
sum(f.qte) AS qte

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEPETRI" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDBCFILLE", "OPERATEUR", "NIVEAU", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "LIGNE", "DATY") AS

f.ID,f.IDINGREDIENTS,f.LIBELLE,f.REMARQUE,f.IDMERE,f.DATYBESOIN,f.QTE,f.IDUNITE,f.PU,f.IDBCFILLE,f.OPERATEUR,f.NIVEAU,f.IDMACHINE, l.id AS idligne,
        l.VAL AS ligne, fab.daty

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEPRATIQUE" ("IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBINGREDIENTS", "IDOFFILLE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANT", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB") AS

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONFILLEPU" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDBCFILLE", "OPERATEUR") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FABRICATIONRATTACHE" ("IDFAB", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDBCFILLE", "OPERATEUR", "NIVEAU", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "LIGNE", "DATY", "ID", "IDRELEVE", "POURCENTAGE") AS
