CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTFOURNISSEURCALC" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASIN", "IDDEVISE", "ESTPREVU", "DATYPREVU", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDDMDACHAT", "IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE", "SERVICE", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ECHEANCEFACTURE", "REMISE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTHTAR") AS 
  select v."ID",v."IDFOURNISSEUR",v."IDMODEPAIEMENT",v."DATY",v."DESIGNATION",v."DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT",v."ETAT",v."REFERENCE",v."IDBC",v."DEVISE",v."TAUX",v."IDMAGASIN",v."IDDEVISE",v."ESTPREVU",v."DATYPREVU",v."NUMERO",v."TYPEACHAT",v."IDTYPEFACTURE",v."IDOBJET",v."IDREF",v."IDDMDACHAT",v."IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE",v."SERVICE",v."TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",v."ECHEANCEFACTURE",v."REMISE", cast(montantRemiseSansTva+ (montantHT* (nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantRemise, montantNonRemise,
       cast(montantHT*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(montantTva*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(montantTTC*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC, montantTTCAr*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantTTCAr, MONTANTHTAR*(1-(nvl(v.REMISE,0)/100)) as montantHtAr
from FACTUREFOURNISSEUR v left join FFFilleCalcGroupeFF vdcv on v.id=vdcv.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTFRNSFILLEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION") AS 
  SELECT 
ff.ID,
ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
	THEN ff.IDPRODUIT||'---'||ai.LIBELLE
	ELSE ff.IDPRODUIT
END AS IDPRODUIT,
ff.PU,
ff.REMISES,
ff.IDBCDETAIL,
ff.TVA,
ff.DEVISE,
ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
ff.IDDEVISE,
ff.DESIGNATION,
ff.COMPTE,
ff.MOIS,
ff.ANNEE,
ff.QTE,
ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN,
CASE 
	WHEN ff.IDPREVISION IS NOT NULL 
	THEN ff.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.DESIGNATION  
	ELSE ff.IDPREVISION
END AS IDPREVISION
FROM FactureFournisseurFille ff 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = ff.IDPRODUIT 
LEFT JOIN PREVISION p ON p.id = ff.IDPREVISION 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTCPL" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDCLIENTLIB", "NUMEROCLIENT", "MONTANTPAYE", "IDRESERVATION", "RESTEAPAYERTTC") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID,f.IDCLIENT,f.DATY,f.DESIGNATION,f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,f.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN f.etat=0 THEN 'ANNULE'
        WHEN f.etat=1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN f.etat=11 THEN 'VISEE'
        ELSE 'AUTRE'
        END AS etatlib,
    fm.montanttotal,
    fm.montanttotal - fm.montantTva AS montantHT,
    fm.montantTva,
    fm.montantTTC,
    c.NOM AS idClientLib,
    c.TELEPHONE AS numeroClient,
    nvl(fp.credit,0) as montantPaye,
    f.idreservation,
    (fm.montantTTC - nvl(fp.credit,0)) as resteapayerTTC
FROM FactureClient f
         LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENTMONTANT fm ON fm.id = f.id
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = f.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN factureclientpaye fp ON fp.IDORIGINE = f.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTDETAILSLIB" ("ID", "IDFACTURECLIENT", "IDACTE", "LIBELLE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "TVA", "COMPTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT
	f.ID,
	f.IDFACTURECLIENT,
	f.idacte,
	a.libelle,
	f.QTE,
	f.PU,
	f.REMISES,
	f.TVA,
	f.COMPTE,
	f.IDPRODUIT,
	p.val AS idproduitlib,
	CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) )  AS number(30,2)) + CAST(  f.qte * f.pu * (1  - CAST( (f.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(f.tva,0) /100)  AS number(30,2)) AS montant
FROM
	FACTURECLIENTDETAILS f
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON
	p.id = f.idproduit
LEFT JOIN acte a ON a.id = f.idacte 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC") AS 
  SELECT 
f.id ,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttotal,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montanttva,
CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) ) AS number(30,2)) + CAST( sum( fc.qte * fc.pu * (1  - CAST( (fc.remises /100) AS number(30,2)) ) * (nvl(fc.tva,0) /100) ) AS number(30,2))  AS montantttc
FROM FACTURECLIENTDETAILS fc 
LEFT JOIN FACTURECLIENT f ON f.id = fc.idfactureclient
GROUP BY f.ID 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURECLIENTPAYE" ("IDORIGINE", "CREDIT") AS 
  SELECT
m.IDORIGINE, 
sum(m.credit) AS credit
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m 
WHERE m.ETAT = 11 
GROUP BY m.IDORIGINE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONCPL" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "COMPTE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT") AS 
  SELECT
             f.ID,
             f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
             f2.NOM AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,

             f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
             m.VAL AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,

             f.DATY,
             f.DESIGNATION,
             f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,

             f.ETAT,
             CASE
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CREE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULEE'
                 WHEN f.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
                 END AS ETATLIB,

             f.REFERENCE,
             f.IDBC,
             f.IDMAGASIN,
             f.DEVISE,
             f2.COMPTE,

             NVL(NULLIF(f.TAUX,0),1) AS TAUX,

             p.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,

             f.IDDEVISE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTVA,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(f3.MONTANTTVA,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTTTC,

             CAST(
                     NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) * NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1)
                 AS NUMBER(30,2)
             ) AS MONTANTTTCAR,

             CAST(NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
             CAST(NVL(f3.MONTANTTTC,0) - NVL(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANTRESTE,

             CAST(NVL(f3.tauxdechange,1) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE,

             prev.ID AS IDPREVISION,

             CASE
                 WHEN f.estprevu = 0 THEN 'NON'
                 ELSE 'OUI'
                 END AS ESTPREVULIB,

             f.IDOBJET,
             f.IDREF,
             f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
             tf.VAL AS TYPEFACTURE,
             f.NUMERO,
             f.TYPEACHAT

         FROM FACTUREDECLARATION f
                  LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
                  LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATIONMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE mv ON f.ID = mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN PREVISION prev ON prev.IDFACTURE = f.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_FACTURE tf ON tf.ID = f.IDTYPEFACTURE

    
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "FRAISACCESOIRE", "MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "LIBELLEEXACTE") AS 
  SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)                                          AS fraisaccesoire,

       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(MONTANTPERTEGAIN, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte
FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT


                       
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATIONMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))) as number(30,2)) AS montanttotal,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.REMISES /100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100) as number(30,2)) AS montantTva,
                cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100)+SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0)))as number(30,2))  as montantTTC,
                NVL (vd.IDDEVISE,'AR') AS IDDEVISE,
                nvl (vd.tauxdechange,1) AS tauxdechange
         FROM FACTUREDECLARATIONFILLE vd LEFT JOIN FACTUREDECLARATION v ON v.ID = vd.idfacturefournisseur
         GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE,vd.tauxdechange

    
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECOMPTE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  select ff.COMPTE,
       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       ff.etat,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE) as number(30, 2))                            as montantht,
       cast(sum(pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2))              as montanttva,
       cast(sum((pu * QTE) + pu * QTE * (tva / 100)) as number(30, 2)) as montantttc,
       ff.iddevise,
       ff.tauxdechange
from FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECPL ff
group by COMPTE, IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, ff.etat,ff.iddevise,ff.tauxdechange


    
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "PRODUITLIB", "COMPTE", "ETAT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS

       ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       ff.IDPRODUIT,
       ff.QTE,
       ff.PU,
       ff.REMISES,
       ff.IDBCDETAIL,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLE_VISE" ("COMPTE", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS

from FACTUREDECLARATION_FILLECOMPTE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURAVECMACHINE" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDOBJETLIB", "IDENTITE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB") AS 
  SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
       f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
       m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VISEE'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.DEVISE,
       case
           when f.TAUX=0 then 1
           else f.TAUX
           end as taux,
       p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
       f3.IDDEVISE,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       CAST(f3.MONTANTTTC-f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
       prev.id as idPrevision,
       CASE
           WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
           ELSE 'OUI'
           END
           AS estprevulib,
       f.IDOBJET,
       f.IDREF,
       machine.LIBELLE AS idObjetLib,
       machine.IDENTITE,
       ligne.id AS idligne,
       ligne.val AS idlignelib
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.id
         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON f.id=mv.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE machine ON machine.ID = f.IDOBJET
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE ligne ON ligne.id=machine.idLIGNE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTPAYEAR", "MONTANTRESTEAR", "MONTANTRESTE", "MONTANTAVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDFACTUREPRINCIPALE", "IDSERVICELIB", "SERVICE", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDECRITURE", "TYPEACHATLIB", "REMISE") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
    f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
    f.DATY,
    f.DESIGNATION,
    f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
    f.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VISÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    nvl(f.REFERENCE, reff.reference) as reference,
    f.IDBC,
    f.IDMAGASIN,
    f.DEVISE,
    case
        when f.TAUX=0 then 1
        else f.TAUX
        end as taux,
    p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
    f.IDDEVISE,
    cast(f.MONTANTTVA as number(30,5)) as MONTANTTVA,
    CAST(f.MONTANTHT as number(30,5)) AS MONTANTHT,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC as number(30,5)) as montantttc,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,5)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpaye,
    cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)*nvl(f.TAUX,1) AS number(30,5)) AS montantpayeAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTCAR-((nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0))*nvl(f.TAUX,1)) AS number(30,5)) AS montantresteAr,
    cast(f.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(av.montantTTC,0) AS number(30,5)) AS montantreste,
    cast(av.montantTTC as number(30,2)) as montantAvoir,
    cast(f.TAUX AS  number(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
    prev.id as idPrevision,
    CASE
        WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
        ELSE 'OUI'
        END
        AS estprevulib,
    f.IDOBJET,
    f.IDREF,
    f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
    tf.VAL as typefacture,
    f.numero,
    f.typeachat,
    f.idfactureprincipale,
    s.libelle AS idServiceLib,
    f.SERVICE,
    f.TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    tff.DESCE AS TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEURLIB,
    ce.id AS idecriture,
    ta.VAL AS typeachatlib,
    f.REMISE
FROM FactFournisseurCalc f
    LEFT JOIN TYPEACHAT ta ON ta.DESCE = f.TYPEACHAT
    LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
    LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
    LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON f.id=mv.ID2
    left join AvoirAChatCalcGroupeOrigine av on av.IDFACTURE=f.ID
    LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
    left join type_facture tf on tf.id = f.IDTYPEFACTURE
    LEFT JOIN SERVICE s ON f.SERVICE = s.COMPTE
    LEFT JOIN referencefacture reff ON f.id=reff.idfacture
    LEFT JOIN typefacturefournisseur tff ON tff.id = f.TYPEFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
    LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ce ON ce.idobjet=f.id;

       m.VAL                                                                       AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
       f.DATY,
       f.DESIGNATION,
       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
       f.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN f.ETAT = 9
               THEN 'ENCAISEE'
           END                                                                     AS ETATLIB,
       f.REFERENCE,
       f.IDBC,
       f.IDMAGASIN,
       f.DEVISE,
       f.TAUX,
       p.VAL                                                                       AS idMagasinLib,
       cast(mon.montant as NUMBER(30, 2))                                          as montant,
       cast(nvl(m.montantapayer, 0) as NUMBER(30, 2))                              as montantpayer,
       case
           when mon.montant < nvl(m.montantapayer, 0) then 0
           else cast((mon.montant - nvl(m.montantapayer, 0)) as NUMBER(30, 2)) end as montantreste
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
         left join FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_montant mon on mon.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR = f.id
         LEFT JOIN montantapayer m ON f.ID = m.idfacturefournisseur
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TRAVAUX" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "DEVISE", "TAUX", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDDEVISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDPREVISION", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "IDTYPEFACTURE", "TYPEFACTURE", "NUMERO", "TYPEACHAT", "IDTRAVAUX") AS 
  SELECT f.ID,
	       f.IDFOURNISSEUR,
	       f2.NOM  AS IDFOURNISSEURLIB,
	       f.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
	       m.VAL   AS IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB,
	       f.DATY,
	       f.DESIGNATION,
	       f.DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
	       f.ETAT,
	       CASE
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 1
	               THEN 'CREEE'
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 0
	               THEN 'ANNULEE'
	           WHEN f.ETAT = 11
	               THEN 'VISEE'
	           END AS ETATLIB,
	       f.REFERENCE,
	       f.IDBC,
	       f.IDMAGASIN,
	       f.DEVISE,
	       case
	           when f.TAUX=0 then 1
	           else f.TAUX
	           end as taux,
	       p.VAL   AS idMagasinLib,
	       f3.IDDEVISE,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
	       CAST(f3.MONTANTTTC-f3.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) AS MONTANTHT,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC*f3.tauxdechange as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
	       cast(nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
	       cast(f3.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.debit,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
	       cast(nvl(f3.tauxdechange,0) AS  NUMBER(30,2)) AS tauxdechange,
	       prev.id as idPrevision,
	       CASE
	           WHEN f.estprevu=0 THEN 'NON'
	           ELSE 'OUI'
	           END
	           AS estprevulib,
	       f.IDOBJET,
	       f.IDREF,
	       f.IDTYPEFACTURE,
	       tf.VAL as typefacture,
	       f.numero,
	       f.typeachat,
	       t.id AS idTravaux
	FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f
	         LEFT JOIN FOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFOURNISSEUR
	         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m ON m.ID = f.IDMODEPAIEMENT
	         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p ON p.ID = f.IDMAGASIN
	         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT f3 ON f.ID = f3.id
	         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON f.id=mv.IDORIGINE
	         LEFT JOIN prevision prev ON prev.idfacture=f.id
	         left join type_facture tf on tf.id = f.IDTYPEFACTURE
	         LEFT JOIN dmdAchat d ON f.idDmdAchat = d.id
	         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUX t ON d.idObjet = t.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "FRAISACCESOIRE", "MONTANTAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "PUAVECFRAISACCESSOIRE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DESIGNATION") AS 
  (
SELECT f.ID,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE                                                         AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       f.QTE,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       f.COMPTE,
       f.IDDEVISE,
       f2.DATY,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 1 Montant HT brut
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30, 2))                               AS montanttotal,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 2 Montant remise (appliquee sur HT)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantRemise,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 3 Montant HT net apres remise
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))
           AS NUMBER(30, 2))                                             AS montantht,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 4 TVA sur montant HT net
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   * f.TVA / 100
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montanttva,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 5 Montant TTC net (HT net + TVA)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                   + (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
                       * f.TVA / 100
                   )
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantttc,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 6 Frais accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(r.montant, 0)                                                 AS fraisaccesoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 7 Montant total avec frais (TTC + accessoires)
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                   )
                   + NVL(r.montant, 0)
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS montantavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- 8 PU unitaire HT + accessoires
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       CAST(
               (
                   (
                       ((f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TAUXDECHANGE)))
                       )
                       + NVL(r.montant, 0)
                   ) / f.QTE
           AS NUMBER(30, 2)
       )                                                                 AS puavecfraisaccessoire,

       ----------------------------------------------------------
       -- Info produit & localisation
       ----------------------------------------------------------
       NVL(p.LIBELLEEXTACTE, p.LIBELLE)                                  AS libelleexacte,
       f.IDPREVISION,
       p2.ID                                                             AS idpoint,
       p2.VAL                                                            AS idpointlib,
       m.ID                                                              AS idmagasin,
       m.VAL                                                             AS idmagasinlib,
       c.ID                                                              AS idcategorie,
       c.VAL                                                             AS idcategorielib,
       f.designation

FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2
                   ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m
                   ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT p2
                   ON p2.ID = m.IDPOINT
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
                   ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON c.ID = p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN REPARTIRIONPGGROUPEE r
                   ON r.IDFACTUREFILLE = f.ID
    );

	       FFF.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,

	       FFF.QTE,
	       FFF.PU,
	       FFF.REMISES,
	       FFF.IDBCDETAIL,

	       FFF.MOIS,
	       FFF.ANNEE,
	       FF.DATY,
	       FF.MONTANTPAYE * 100 / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)                                                     AS pourcentagepaye,
	       (FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)                                    AS MontantFillePaye,
	       (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU) - ((FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU))             AS resteapayerfille,
	       ((FF.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(FF.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)) * FFF.TAUXDECHANGE               AS MontantFillePayeAr,
	       (FFF.QTE * FFF.PU)                                                                                   AS montantfille,
	       FF.SERVICE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEURMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))) as number(30,2)) AS montanttotal, 
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.REMISES /100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100) as number(30,2)) AS montantTva,
            cast(SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0))* (NVL (VD.TVA , 0))/100)+SUM ((1-nvl(vd.remises/100,0))* (NVL (vd.QTE, 0) * NVL (vd.PU, 0)))as number(30,2))  as montantTTC,
            NVL (vd.IDDEVISE,'AR') AS IDDEVISE,
            nvl (vd.tauxdechange,1) AS tauxdechange
            FROM FactureFournisseurFille vd LEFT JOIN facturefournisseur v ON v.ID = vd.idfacturefournisseur
   GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE,vd.tauxdechange
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_RECAP_JOUR" ("DATY", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "NOMBRE", "MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR") AS 
  WITH BORNES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-06-01' AS DATE_MIN,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATE_MAX
    FROM DUAL
),
CALENDRIER AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
FACTURE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS NOMBRE
    FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TOUS_FAE
    WHERE IDTYPEFACTURE = 'TPF0002'
      AND ETAT = 11
      AND DATY >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY TRUNC(DATY)
)
SELECT
    c.DATY,

    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTTTC, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    CAST(NVL(f.MONTANTRESTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    CAST(NVL(f.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(f.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,5)
    ) AS MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR

FROM CALENDRIER c
LEFT JOIN FACTURE_JOUR f
    ON c.DATY = f.DATY

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FACTURESTANDARD" ("ID", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "IDFOURNISSEURLIB", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "DATEECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ETATLIB", "REFERENCE", "IDBC", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DEVISE", "IDDEVISE", "ETAT", "TAUX", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "IDOBJET", "IDREF", "TYPEACHAT", "IDECRITURE", "COMPTE", "NUMERO") AS 
  SELECT
    fcpl.id,
    fcpl.idfournisseur,
    fcpl.idfournisseurlib,
    fcpl.idmodepaiement,
    fcpl.idmodepaiementlib,
    fcpl.daty,
    fcpl.designation,
    fcpl.dateecheancepaiement,
    fcpl.etatlib,
    fcpl.reference,
    fcpl.idbc,
    fcpl.idmagasin,
    fcpl.idmagasinlib,
    fcpl.devise,
    fcpl.iddevise,
    fcpl.etat,
    fcpl.taux,
    fcpl.montanttva,
    fcpl.montantht,
    fcpl.tauxdechange,
    fcpl.montantttc AS MONTANTTTC,
    nvl((fcpl.montantpaye * fcpl.TAUXDECHANGE), 0) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    nvl((fcpl.montantreste * fcpl.TAUXDECHANGE), 0) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    fcpl.IDOBJET,
    fcpl.IDREF,
    fcpl.typeachat,
    ce.id AS idecriture,
    '-' AS compte,
    fcpl.numero AS numero
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL fcpl
        LEFT JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON
        ce.idobjet = fcpl.id
/*  LEFT JOIN compta_compte cc ON cc.idjournal=ce.journal */
WHERE
    fcpl.typeachat = 'PS'
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFAVECPERTE_FF" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "DATY", "PUPERTEGAIN", "MONTANTAVECPERTEGAIN", "LIBELLEPRODUIT") AS 
  SELECT
    ff.ID,
    ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.IDPRODUIT,
    ff.QTE,
    ff.PU,
    ff.REMISES,
    ff.IDBCDETAIL,
    ff.TVA,
    ff.DEVISE,
    ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
    ff.IDDEVISE,
    ff.DESIGNATION,
    ff.COMPTE,
    CAST(nvl(rep.montant,0) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN ,
    ff.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.ETAT,ff.DATY,
    CAST(((ff.PUREMISE*TAUXDECHANGE)+(nvl(rep.MONTANT,0)/qte)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS pupertegain ,
    CAST(((qte*ff.PUREMISE*TAUXDECHANGE)+nvl(rep.montant,0)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantavecpertegain,
    asi.LIBELLE AS LIBELLEPRODUIT
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_mf ff
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS asi ON ASI.ID = ff.IDPRODUIT
        left join RepartirionPG rep on rep.IDFACTUREFILLE=ff.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFAVECPERTE_FF_IDPG" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "ETAT", "DATY", "PUPERTEGAIN", "MONTANTAVECPERTEGAIN", "LIBELLEPRODUIT") AS 
  SELECT
    ff.ID,
    ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.IDPRODUIT,
    ff.QTE,
    ff.PU,
    ff.REMISES,
    p.IDBCDETAIL as IDBCDETAIL,
    ff.TVA,
    ff.DEVISE,
    ff.TAUXDECHANGE,
    ff.IDDEVISE,
    ff.DESIGNATION,
    ff.COMPTE,
    CAST( nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),(p.montantAr*qte*p.TAUX*ff.pu/fg.montanttotal)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS MONTANTPERTEGAIN ,
    ff.IDFOURNISSEUR,
    ff.ETAT,ff.DATY,
    CAST( (qte*ff.pu*TAUXDECHANGE+nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),0))/qte AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS pupertegain ,
    CAST( (qte*ff.pu*TAUXDECHANGE+nvl((CASE WHEN fg.MONTANTPERTEGAIN =0 THEN NULL ELSE  ff.MONTANTPERTEGAIN end),0)) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantavecpertegain,
    asi.LIBELLE AS LIBELLEPRODUIT
FROM
    FACTUREFOURNISSEUR_mf ff
        left JOIN perte_grporigine_fact p ON p.idorigine=ff.idfacturefournisseur
        LEFT JOIN ff_grpmere fg ON fg.idfacturefournisseur=ff.idfacturefournisseur
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS asi ON ASI.ID = ff.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECALC" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "DEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDDEVISE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "QTE", "MONTANTPERTEGAIN", "IDPREVISION", "REMISE", "RISTOURNE", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS 
  select vd."ID",vd."IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR",vd."IDPRODUIT",vd."PU",vd."REMISES",vd."IDBCDETAIL",vd."TVA",vd."DEVISE",vd."TAUXDECHANGE",vd."IDDEVISE",vd."DESIGNATION",vd."COMPTE",vd."MOIS",vd."ANNEE",vd."QTE",vd."MONTANTPERTEGAIN",vd."IDPREVISION",vd."REMISE",vd."RISTOURNE",cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*((nvl(vd.REMISE,0)+nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0))/100) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,
cast(vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as puRemise,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1)*nvl(vd.tva,0)/100 as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100)) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,
cast(vd.QTE*vd.pu*(1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100))*(1-(nvl(vd.RISTOURNE,0)/100))*(1+(nvl(vd.tva,0)/100))*nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE,1) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr from FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE vd;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECALCGROUPEFF" ("IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTCAR") AS 
  select vdc.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,cast(sum(montantNonRemise) as number(30,2)) as montantNonRemise,cast(sum(montantRemiseSansTva) as number(30,2)) as montantRemiseSansTva,
       cast(sum(montantHT) as number(30,2)) as montantHT,cast(sum(montantTTC) as number(30,2)) as montantTTC,cast(sum(montantTva) as number(30,2)) as montantTva,
       cast(sum(montantHTAr) as number(30,2)) as montantHTAr,cast(sum(montantTvaAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTvaAr,cast(sum(montantTTCAr) as number(30,2)) as montantTTCAr
from FFFilleCalc vdc group by vdc.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECPL_MONTANT" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTTC", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDDEVISE") AS 
  SELECT 
f.ID ,
f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
f.IDPRODUIT ,
nvl(i.LIBELLE,p.VAL) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
f.QTE ,
CAST(f.PU AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU ,
CAST(f.REMISES AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS REMISES ,
f.IDBCDETAIL,
CAST(f.TVA AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS TVA,
CAST(nvl(f.QTE*f.PU,0)  AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS MONTANTTOTAL,
CAST(
    nvl(
        ((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU)))
        + (((f.QTE * f.PU) - ((NVL(f.remises, 0) / 100) * (f.QTE * f.PU))) * NVL(f.TVA, 0) / 100)
    , 0) 
AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
p2.ID AS IDPOINT,
p2.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
m.ID AS IDMAGASIN,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
c.ID AS IDCATEGORIE,
c.VAL AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
f2.DATY AS daty,
f.IDDEVISE
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f 
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = f2.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN POINT p2 ON m.IDPOINT = p2.ID  
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE c ON p.IDCATEGORIE = c.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON i.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLECPL_VISEE" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDDEVISE", "DATY", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "IDPREVISION") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID ,
    f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR ,
    f.IDPRODUIT ,
    nvl(i.LIBELLE,p.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    f.QTE ,
    f.PU ,
    f.REMISES ,
    f.IDBCDETAIL ,
    f.TVA ,
    f.IDDEVISE,
    f2.DATY,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantht,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU + (f.QTE * f.PU * f.TVA/100) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantttc,
    CAST(f.QTE * f.PU * f.TVA/100 AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttva,
    CAST((nvl(f.remises/100,0))*(f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantRemise,
    CAST((1-nvl(f.remises/100,0))*(f.QTE * f.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    f.idprevision
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f2 ON f2.ID = f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS i ON i.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
where f2.ETAT >= 11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLERESTEALIVRER" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDUNITE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "UNITELIB", "PUPERTEGAIN") AS 
  SELECT f.id,
       f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       cast(f.QTE - nvl(sum(abf.QUANTITE), 0) as number(38, 2)) AS qte,
       f.PU,
       f.REMISES,
       f.IDBCDETAIL,
       f.TVA,
       au.id as idunite,
       ai.LIBELLE as idproduitlib,
       au.val as unitelib,
       cast(fac.PUPERTEGAIN as number(38, 2)) as PUPERTEGAIN
FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_FILLE abf ON f.ID = abf.IDBC_FILLE
    LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai on ai.id = f.idproduit
    LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au on au.id = ai.UNITE
    LEFT JOIN FFAVECPERTE_ff fac on fac.id = f.id
GROUP BY f.id, f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR, f.IDPRODUIT, f.QTE, f.PU, f.REMISES, f.IDBCDETAIL, f.TVA, ai.LIBELLE, au.val, au.id, ai.id, fac.PUPERTEGAIN
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FFFILLERESTEALIVRERLIB" ("ID", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "REMISES", "IDBCDETAIL", "TVA", "IDUNITE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FICHE_POSTE_LIB" ("ID", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDTYPECONTRAT", "TITRE", "REFERENCE", "DESCRIPTION", "MISSIONS", "EXIGENCEPOSTE", "SALAIREMIN", "SALAIREMAX", "ETAT", "DATY", "LIEUTRAVAIL", "MATERIELDOCUMENT", "OUTILS", "CONDITIONTRAVAIL", "MODECONTROLE", "IDNIVEAUFORMATION", "IDPERMIS", "IDFONCTION", "IDBU", "AUTRE", "IDCATEGORIEPAIE", "IDQUALIFICATIONPAIE", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "IDTYPECONTRATLIB", "IDFONCTIONLIB", "IDNIVEAUFORMATIONLIB", "IDPERMISLIB", "IDBULIB", "IDCATEGORIEPAIELIB", "IDQUALIFICATIONPAIELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDFAMILLEPROFESSIONELLIB", "IDMETIERLIB", "IDEMPLOILIB", "IDCODEROMELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID,f.IDDEPARTEMENT,f.IDTYPECONTRAT,f.TITRE,f.REFERENCE,f.DESCRIPTION,f.MISSIONS,f.EXIGENCEPOSTE,f.SALAIREMIN,f.SALAIREMAX,f.ETAT,f.DATY,f.LIEUTRAVAIL,f.MATERIELDOCUMENT,f.OUTILS,f.CONDITIONTRAVAIL,f.MODECONTROLE,f.IDNIVEAUFORMATION,f.IDPERMIS,f.IDFONCTION,f.IDBU,f.AUTRE,f.IDCATEGORIEPAIE,f.IDQUALIFICATIONPAIE,
    d.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,
    t.VAL AS IDTYPECONTRATLIB,
    pf.VAL AS IDFONCTIONLIB,
    nf.DESCE AS idNiveauFormationLib,
    p.DESCE AS idPermisLib,
    bu.VAL AS idBuLib,
    cp.VAL AS idCategoriePaieLib,
    qp.VAL AS idQualificationPaieLib,

    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT = '1'  THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN f.ETAT = '11' THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN f.ETAT = '0'  THEN 'Annule'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    fp.val AS idFamilleProfessionelLib,
    m.val AS idMetierLib,
    em.val AS idEmploiLib,
    cr.code AS idCodeRomeLib
FROM FICHE_POSTE f
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT d ON d.ID = f.IDDEPARTEMENT
         LEFT JOIN TYPE_CONTRAT t ON t.ID = f.IDTYPECONTRAT
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf ON pf.ID = f.IDFONCTION
         LEFT JOIN FORMATION_DIPLOME nf ON nf.ID = f.idNiveauFormation
         LEFT JOIN PERMIS p ON p.ID = f.idPermis
         LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_UNITE bu ON bu.ID = f.idBu
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE cp ON cp.ID = f.idCategoriePaie
         LEFT JOIN QUALIFICATION_PAIE qp ON qp.ID = f.idQualificationPaie
         LEFT JOIN FAMILLE_PROFESSIONNELLE fp ON fp.id = f.idFamilleProfessionel
         LEFT JOIN METIER m ON m.id = f.idMetier
         LEFT JOIN emploi em ON em.id = f.idEmploi
         LEFT JOIN code_rome cr ON cr.id = f.idCodeRome

 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FRAIS_MEDICAUXMOIS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TOTAL_BRUT", "FRAIS_MEDICAUX") AS 
  SELECT pe.idpersonnel,
       pe.mois,
       pe.annee,
       sum(pe.gain) AS total_brut,
       COALESCE(prfrm.gain, 0) AS frais_medicaux
FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_edition prfrm ON pe.idpersonnel = prfrm.idpersonnel AND pe.mois = prfrm.mois AND pe.annee = prfrm.annee AND prfrm.idelementpaie = 'PR000FRM'
WHERE (pe.idelementpaie IN ( SELECT pr.id
                             FROM paie_rubrique pr
                             WHERE pr.typerubrique = 'G' AND (pr.id NOT IN ('PR000210A', 'PR000FRM', 'PR000181'))))
GROUP BY pe.idpersonnel, pe.mois, pe.annee, prfrm.gain
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FRAIS_MEDICAUX_ALL" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "POSTE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "NUMERO_CNAPS", "TOTAL_BRUT", "FRAIS_MEDICAUX", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TEST", "MOISLIB") AS 
  SELECT pip.id,
       pip.matricule,
       lp.nom || lp.prenom AS nom,
       pf.desce AS poste,
       pip.dateembauche,
       pip.numero_cnaps,
       frm.total_brut,
       frm.frais_medicaux,
       frm.mois,
       frm.annee AS annee,
       (frm.total_brut * 0.06) AS test,
       mo.val AS moislib
FROM paie_info_personnel pip
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pip.idfonction = pf.id
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id = pip.id
         LEFT JOIN frais_medicauxmois frm ON frm.idpersonnel = pip.id
         LEFT JOIN moiscp mo ON mo.id = frm.mois
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."FUMIGATION_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDNUMEROVAGUE", "IDOPERATEUR", "IDLOT", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "NOMBREOAC", "HEUREDEBUTFUMIGATION", "HEUREFINFUMIGATION", "HEUREDEBUTEXTRACTION", "HEUREFINEXTRACTION", "IDPRODUIT", "QTE", "TEMPERATUREMIN", "TEMPERATUREMAX", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROVAGUELIB", "IDOPERATEURLIB", "IDLOTLIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT f.ID,
       f.DATY,
       f.IDNUMEROVAGUE,
       f.IDOPERATEUR,
       f.IDLOT,
       f.IDBATIMENT,
       f.IDPARQUET,
       f.NOMBREOAC,
       f.HEUREDEBUTFUMIGATION,
       f.HEUREFINFUMIGATION,
       f.HEUREDEBUTEXTRACTION,
       f.HEUREFINEXTRACTION,
       f.IDPRODUIT,
       f.QTE,
       f.TEMPERATUREMIN,
       f.TEMPERATUREMAX,
       f.ETAT,
       nc.VAL                          AS IDNUMEROVAGUELIB,
       op.NOM || ' ' || op.PRENOM    AS IDOPERATEURLIB,
       l.NOMLOT                        AS IDLOTLIB,
       b.NOMBATIMENT                   AS IDBATIMENTLIB,
       p.VAL                           AS IDPARQUETLIB,
       ai.LIBELLE                      AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       CASE f.ETAT
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'
           END                                AS ETATLIB
FROM FUMIGATION f
         LEFT JOIN NUMEROCOLLECTE nc ON nc.ID = f.IDNUMEROVAGUE
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL op ON op.ID = f.IDOPERATEUR
         LEFT JOIN LOT l ON l.ID = f.IDLOT
         LEFT JOIN BATIMENT b ON b.ID = f.IDBATIMENT
         LEFT JOIN PARQUET p ON p.ID = f.IDPARQUET
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = f.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HEURENORMALE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "DATEFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "MONTANT", "IDQUALIFICATION", "MONTANTJF", "MONTANTHD", "MONTANTIF", "MONTANTMN", "MONTANTHN", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB", "POSTE", "POSTELIB", "DATEIMPORT", "MONTANTHEURESUPP") AS 
  SELECT
    h.ID,h.IDRESSPARFAB,h.HEURENORMALE ,h.HS,h.MN,h.JF,h.HD,h.IF,h.ETAT,h.REMARQUE,
    p.id AS  idPersonne,
    h.idFabrication,
    h.daty as dateFabrication,
    CASE
        WHEN h.etat=0
            THEN 'ANNULE'
        WHEN h.etat=1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN h.etat=11
            THEN 'VISE'
        END AS etatlib,
    pm.NOM || ' ' || pm.PRENOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    h.TAUXHORAIRE,
    CAST(nvl(c.montant,0)/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    p.temporaire,
    h.MONTANT,
    r.IDQUALIFICATION,
    NVL(h.montantJF, 0) as montantJF,
    NVL(h.montantHD, 0) as montantHD,
    NVL(h.montantIF,0) as montantIF,
    NVL(h.montantMN, 0) as montantMN,
    NVL(h.MONTANTHN, 0) as montantHN,
    p.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    d.val as departementLib,
    h.poste,
    pf.val as PosteLib,
    h.DATEIMPORT,
    h.MONTANTHEURESUPP
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c
                   ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = r.IDQUALIFICATION
                       AND c.IDCATEGORIE = r.IDCATEGORIE
                       AND (
                          (c.REMARQUE IS NULL)
                              OR (c.REMARQUE = r.IDRESSOURCE)
                          ) AND c.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT d on d.id = p.IDDEPARTEMENT
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_FONCTION pf on pf.id = h.poste
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL_VISEE" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HEURENORMALE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "DATEFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDQUALIFICATION", "VALEURJF", "VALEURHD", "VALEURIF", "VALEURMN", "VALEURHN", "VALEURHS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    hs.ID,

    hs.JF,
    hs.HD,
    hs.IF,

    hs.IDPERSONNE,

    hs.IDPERSONNELIB,
    hs.MATRICULE,
    CAST(hs.TAUXHORAIRE AS NUMBER(30,2)) as TAUXHORAIRE,
    hs.TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    hs.TEMPORAIRE,
    CAST(hs.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTotal,
    hs.IDQUALIFICATION,
    hs.MONTANTJF AS valeurJF,
    hs.MONTANTHD AS valeurHD,
    hs.MONTANTIF AS valeurIF,
    hs.MONTANTMN AS valeurMN,
    hs.MONTANTHN AS valeurHN,
    hs.MONTANTHEURESUPP AS valeurHS,
    hs.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    hs.DEPARTEMENTLIB
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hs
WHERE hs.ETAT = 11


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_CUMUL" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "SEMAINE", "JOUR", "HEUREJOUR", "HEUREDEJACUMULEES") AS 
  SELECT
    p.id AS idPersonne,
    pm.NOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    h.daty AS jour,
    SUM(h.HS) AS heureJour,
    SUM(SUM(h.HS)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.id, TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW')
        ORDER BY h.daty
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) - SUM(h.HS) AS heureDejaCumulees
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL_MATRICULE pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
WHERE h.ETAT >= 11
GROUP BY p.id, pm.NOM, p.MATRICULE, h.daty


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HEURESUPFABRICATION_TOTAL" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDPERSONNELIB", "MATRICULE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE", "TEMPORAIRE", "SEMAINE", "TOTALHEURESEMAINE") AS 
  SELECT
    p.id AS idPersonne,
    pm.NOM AS idPersonnelib,
    p.MATRICULE,
    r.TAUXHORAIRE,
    CAST(NVL(c.montant,0)/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS TAUXHORAIREEFFECTIVE,
    p.temporaire,
    TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    SUM(h.HS) AS totalHeureSemaine
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION h
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET r ON r.id = h.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = p.IDQUALIFICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL_MATRICULE pm ON pm.id = r.IDRESSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION fab ON fab.ID = h.IDFABRICATION
GROUP BY p.id, pm.NOM, p.MATRICULE, r.TAUXHORAIRE, p.temporaire,
         TO_CHAR(h.daty, 'IYYY-IW'), c.montant

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTOINSERTVUE" ("IDHISTORIQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEURE", "OBJET", "ACTION", "IDUTILISATEUR", "REFOBJET", "REMARQUE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEINSPECTIONLIB" ("ID", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDINSPECTEUR", "IDELEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDINSPECTEURLIB", "IDELEMENTLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HISTORIQUEPRIXLIB" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "DATY", "PV", "IDPRODUIT", "IDFACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT 
  	h.ID,
  	ing.LIBELLE AS produit,
	h.DATY,
	h.PV,
	h.idProduit,
	h.idFacturefournisseurfille,
	h.REMARQUE,
	h.ETAT,
	CASE
		WHEN h.ETAT=1
		THEN 'CRÉÉ'
		WHEN h.ETAT=11
		THEN 'VALIDÉ'
		WHEN h.ETAT=0
		THEN 'ANNULÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=21
		THEN 'ENTAMÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=31
		THEN 'BLOQUÉ'
	    WHEN h.ETAT=41
		THEN 'TERMINÉ'
	END AS ETATLIB
FROM HISTORIQUEPRIX h 
	LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = h.idProduit
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HSMOIS_CPL" ("ID", "IDCATEGORIE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "DATY", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "ETAT", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    hs."ID",hs."IDCATEGORIE",hs."MOIS",hs."ANNEE",
    TO_CHAR(

            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(hs.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),

            'FMMonth',

            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'

    ) AS moisLib,
    hs."DATY",hs."IDDEPARTEMENT",hs."ETAT",
    c.val AS idCategorieLib,
    d.val AS idDepartementLib,
    CASE
        WHEN hs.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN hs.etat = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
        ELSE 'INCONNU'
        END AS etatLib
FROM
    HSMOIS hs
        LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE c ON hs.idCategorie = c.id
        LEFT JOIN departement d ON hs.idDepartement = d.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FABBRICATION_SEMAINECPL" ("ID", "IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "SEMAINE", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "MATRICULE", "NOMPERSONNEL", "DATEDEBUTSEMAINE", "DATEFINSEMAINE", "IF", "JF", "MN", "HD", "HS") AS 
  SELECT
    hs."IDPERSONNE" as id, hs."IDPERSONNE",hs."ANNEE",hs."MOIS",hs."SEMAINE",hs."HS_TOTAL",hs."HS30",hs."HS50",
    pip.matricule,
    log.nom || ' ' || log.prenom as nomPersonnel,
    CAST(
            TRUNC(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 1, 4) || '-01-04', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'IW')
                + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 6, 2)) - 1) * 7
        AS DATE
    ) AS DATEDEBUTSEMAINE,
    CAST(
            TRUNC(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 1, 4) || '-01-04', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'IW')
                + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(hs.SEMAINE, 6, 2)) - 1) * 7
                + 6
        AS DATE
    ) AS DATEFINSEMAINE,
    hs.IF AS IF,
    hs.JF AS JF,
    hs.MN AS MN,
    hs.HD AS HD,
    hs.hs_total AS HS
FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs

         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip ON pip.id = hs.IDPERSONNE

         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL log ON log.id = hs.IDPERSONNE


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE" ("IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "SEMAINE", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "IF", "JF", "MN", "HD") AS 
  SELECT
    hp.idPersonne,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    TO_CHAR(hp.DATEFABRICATION, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,
    LEAST(SUM(hp.HS), 8) AS hs30,
    GREATEST(SUM(hp.HS) - 8, 0) AS hs50,
    SUM( hp.IF) AS if, sum(hp.JF) as JF, SUM(hp.MN) as MN , SUM( hp.HD) as HD
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hp
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p ON hp.DATEFABRICATION BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
GROUP BY hp.idPersonne, p.annee, p.mois, TO_CHAR(hp.DATEFABRICATION, 'IYYY-IW')

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_FAB_SEMAINE_PARTRANCHE" ("IDPERSONNE", "IDRESSPARFAB", "SEMAINE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS_TOTAL", "HS30", "HS50", "MONTANT_TOTAL", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS 
  SELECT
    pip.id as idpersonne,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW') AS semaine,
    p.annee,
    p.mois,

    SUM(hp.HS) AS hs_total,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN SUM(hp.HS)
        ELSE 8
        END AS hs30,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(hp.HS) <= 8 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(hp.HS) - 8
        END AS hs50,

    SUM(hp.MONTANT) AS montant_total,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE AS idCategorie

FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION hp
         JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = hp.IDFABRICATION
         LEFT JOIN PERIODEPAIE p
                   ON f.daty BETWEEN p.datedebut AND p.datefin
         LEFT JOIN RESSOURCEPARFABRICATION ress ON ress.id = hp.IDRESSPARFAB
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = ress.IDRESSOURCE

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    hp.IDRESSPARFAB,
    TO_CHAR(f.daty, 'IYYY-IW'),
    p.annee,
    p.mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_GROUPE" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "RETENUE", "REMARQUE", "NOMPERSONNEL", "ETAT", "ID_OBJET", "IDUSER", "MOISREGULARISATION", "ANNEEREGULARISATION", "IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION", "IDFONCTION", "POURCENTAGE", "ETATLIB", "HS_30_NI", "HS_30_I", "HS_50_NI", "HS_50_I") AS 
  SELECT "ID","MATRICULE","DATE_DEBUT","DATE_FIN","RETENUE","REMARQUE","NOMPERSONNEL","ETAT","ID_OBJET","IDUSER","MOISREGULARISATION","ANNEEREGULARISATION","IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION","IDFONCTION","POURCENTAGE","ETATLIB","HS_30_NI","HS_30_I","HS_50_NI","HS_50_I"
FROM (
         SELECT
             p.idpersonnel as id,
             p.matricule,
             p.id_code_rubrique,
--         p.nomRubrique,
             p.date_debut,
             p.date_fin,
             p.gain,
             p.retenue,
             p.remarque,
             p.nomPersonnel,
             p.etat,
             p.id_objet,
             p.iduser,
             p.moisregularisation,
             p.anneeregularisation,
             p.idcategorie_qualification,
             p.idfonction,
             p.pourcentage,
             p.etatLib
         FROM PAIEPERS_ELP_CPL p
     )
         PIVOT (
                SUM(gain)
    FOR id_code_rubrique IN (
        'PR0000130'  AS "HS_30_NI",
        'PR0000130I' AS "HS_30_I",
        'PR0000150'  AS "HS_50_NI",
        'PR0000150I' AS "HS_50_I"
        )
        ) ORDER BY matricule ASC
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_MOIS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS30_MOIS", "HS50_MOIS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS 
  SELECT
    IDPERSONNE as idPersonnel,
    annee,
    mois,
    SUM(hs30) AS hs30_mois,
    SUM(hs50) AS hs50_mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE as idCategorie
FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip on pip.id = hs.idPersonne
GROUP BY idPersonne, annee, mois, pip.IDDEPARTEMENT, pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_MOIS_PARTRANCHE" ("IDPERSONNE", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "HS30_MOIS", "HS50_MOIS", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDCATEGORIE") AS 
  SELECT
    idPersonne,
    annee,
    mois,

    SUM(hs30) AS hs30_mois,
    SUM(hs50) AS hs50_mois,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE AS idCategorie

FROM HS_FABRICATION_SEMAINE hs
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = hs.idPersonne

GROUP BY
    idPersonne,
    annee,
    mois,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pip.IDCATEGORIE_PAIE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_NON_PAYE" ("ID", "IDRESSPARFAB", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETAT", "IDPERSONNE", "IDFABRICATION", "ETATLIB", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MONTANTJF", "MONTANTHD", "TOTAL", "MATRICULE") AS 
  SELECT hs.ID,hs.IDRESSPARFAB,hs.HS,hs.MN,hs.JF,hs.HD,hs.IF,hs.ETAT,hs.IDPERSONNE,hs.IDFABRICATION,hs.ETATLIB,hs.IDPERSONNELIB AS nomPersonnel,hsf.MONTANTJF ,hsf.MONTANTHD ,hsf.MONTANTJF+hsf.MONTANTHD AS total,hsf.MATRICULE
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL_VISEE hs
         LEFT JOIN HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL hsf ON hsf.id=hs.id

    SELECT IDHS

    WHERE IDHS IS NOT NULL
)
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."HS_PAR_OFFILLE" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIE", "MONTANTPERSONNEL") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTOAC" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDPROVENANCELIB") AS 
  SELECT rl."ID",       rl."DATERECEPTION",       rl."DATEPONTE",       rl."DATECOLLECTE",       rl."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",       rl."HEUREDEPARTFERME",       rl."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",       rl."IDRESPONSABLE",       rl."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",       rl."IDCHAUFFEUR",       rl."IDVEHICULE",       rl."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",       rl."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",       rl."IDPROVENANCE",       rl."ETAT",       rl."IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",       rl."IDRESPONSABLELIB",       rl."IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",       rl."IDCHAUFFEURLIB",       rl."IDVEHICULELIB",       rl."ETATLIB",       o."VAL" AS "IDPROVENANCELIB"FROM "IMPORTRECEPTIONOAC" rl         LEFT JOIN "ORIGINELOT" o ON o."ID" = rl."IDPROVENANCE"WHERE rl."IDPROVENANCE" IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTOAC_LIB" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB") AS 
  SELECT r."ID",       r."DATERECEPTION",       r."DATEPONTE",       r."DATECOLLECTE",       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",       r."IDRESPONSABLE",       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",       r."IDVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",       r."IDPROVENANCE",       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB"FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE" WHERE r.IDPROVENANCE IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."IMPORTRECEPTIONOAC" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT r."ID",       r."DATERECEPTION",       r."DATEPONTE",       r."DATECOLLECTE",       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",       r."IDRESPONSABLE",       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",       r."IDVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",       r."IDPROVENANCE",       r."ETAT",       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB",       CASE r."ETAT"            WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'            WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'            WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'       END                                AS "ETATLIB"FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE";

    0 AS montant,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INFOSAUTOLIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENT", "DESCRIPTION", "NUMERODEPARC", "DATEPREMIEREMISEENCIRCULATION", "IMMATRICULATION", "NOTE", "FOURNISSEUR", "NUMERO", "VOLUME", "MONTANT", "TYPE", "VIN", "MARQUE", "MODELE", "ANNEE", "NOMBREDEPLACES", "NOMBREDEPORTES", "PUISSANCEFISCALE", "BAILLEUR", "VALEURINITIALE", "DATEDEBUT", "DURREEENMOIS", "MENSUALITE", "VENDEUR", "PRIX", "DATEDACHAT", "NUMERODIMMOBILISATION", "DUREEDAMORTISSEMENTENMOIS", "PNEUS", "BATTERIE", "HUILEMOTEUR", "HUILEBOITEDEVITESSE", "TYPEDECARBURANT", "CONSOMMATION", "UNITEDECONSOMMATION", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "TYPEDECARBURANTLIB", "UNITEDECONSOMMATIONLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INSPECTIONFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDELEMENT", "IDETATINSPECTION", "IDETATINSPECTIONLIB", "IDELEMENTLIB", "REMARQUE", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB") AS 
  select 
    ifl.id,
    ifl.idMere,
    ifl.idElement ,
    ifl.idEtatInspection,
    ifl.idEtatInspectionlib ,
    ifl.idElementLib,
    ifl.remarque,
    ifl.idMachineLib,
    ifl.idMachine,
    l.id AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib
from inspectionFIlleLib ifl 
join inspectionMere im on ifl.idMere = im.id
join as_ingredient_Maintenance am on im.IDELEMENT = am.id
left join ligne l on am.IDLIGNE = l.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INSPECTIONFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDELEMENT", "IDELEMENTLIB", "IDETATINSPECTION", "REMARQUE", "IDETATINSPECTIONLIB", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB") AS 
  (
SELECT
    ifi.id,
    ifi.idmere,
    ifi.idElement,
    eis.val     AS idElementlib,
    ifi.idEtatInspection,
    ifi.remarque,
    ei.val    AS idEtatInspectionlib,
    m.libelle AS idMachinelib,
    m.id AS idMachine,
     l.id AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib
FROM InspectionFille ifi
         LEFT JOIN ElementInspection eis
                   ON ifi.idElement = eis.id
         LEFT JOIN ElementInspectionMachine ai
                   ON ai.idelementinspection = ifi.idelement
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m
                   ON ai.idMachine = m.id
         LEFT JOIN EtatInspection ei
                   ON ifi.idEtatInspection = ei.id
         left join ligne l on m.IDLIGNE = l.id)
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY") AS 
  SELECT

    CASE
        WHEN inf.idproduit IS NOT NULL
            THEN inf.idproduit||'---'||ai.libelle
        END AS idproduit,
    inf.explication AS explication,
    inf.idjauge,
    inf.quantitetheorique,

    inf.mvtsrc,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLECOMPLET" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "PU", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSRC", "IDMAGASIN", "RESTE", "MVTENTREE") AS

	i."ID",i."IDINVENTAIRE",i."IDPRODUIT",i."EXPLICATION",i."IDJAUGE",i."PU",i."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",i."QUANTITE",i."MVTSRC",i."IDMAGASIN",
	vee.RESTE , vee.MVTSRC AS mvtentree

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "EXPLICATION", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "LIBELLEEXTACTE", "PU", "ECART", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    i.ID ,
    i.IDINVENTAIRE ,
    i.IDPRODUIT ,
    p.libelle AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    i.EXPLICATION ,
    i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE ,
    i.QUANTITE,
    p.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
    i.pu,
    cast((i.QUANTITE - i.QUANTITETHEORIQUE) as decimal(30,2)) AS ecart,
    i.ETAT,
    CASE
        WHEN i.ETAT = 0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'
        WHEN i.ETAT = 11
            THEN 'VALIDÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB
FROM INVENTAIREFILLE i
     LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS  p ON p.ID  = i.IDPRODUIT;

	i."ID",i."IDINVENTAIRE",i."IDPRODUIT",i."EXPLICATION",i."IDJAUGE",i."PU",i."QUANTITETHEORIQUE",i."QUANTITE",i."MVTSRC",
	i2.IDMAGASIN
FROM
	INVENTAIREFILLE i
JOIN INVENTAIRE i2 ON
	i.IDINVENTAIRE = i2.ID 
WHERE ETAT>0
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIREFILLEVIDE" ("ID", "IDINVENTAIRE", "IDPRODUIT", "EXPLICATION", "IDJAUGE", "QUANTITETHEORIQUE", "QUANTITE", "MVTSOURCE", "PU", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY") AS 
  select 'invvidef'||mfv.ID as id,'invVide' as idinventaire,mfv.IDPRODUIT,'inv Auto Vide' as explication,null as idjauge,cast( 0 as number(30,10)) as QUANTITETHEORIQUE,cast(0 as number(30,10)) as quantite,mfv.ID as mvtsource
         ,cast(1 as number(30,5)) as pu,null as idfournisseur, null as daty from mvtStockFilleSansInventaire mfv

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."INVENTAIRELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "HEURE", "ETATLIB", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "MOTSCLESSS", "REMARQUE", "MONTANTQUANTITE") AS 
              THEN 'ANNULÉ'        WHEN i.ETAT = 1            THEN 'CRÉÉ'        WHEN i.ETAT = 11            THEN 'VALIDÉ'        END AS ETATLIB,    i.idcategorie,    c.VAL AS idcategorieLib,    UPPER(            NVL(i.DESIGNATION, '') || ' ' ||            NVL(m.VAL, '') || ' ' ||            NVL(c.VAL, '') || ' ' ||            NVL(i.ID, '') || ' ' ||            TO_CHAR(i.DATY, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' ' ||            NVL(                    CASE                        WHEN i.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉ'                        WHEN i.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ'                        WHEN i.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ'                        END                , '')    ) AS MOTSCLESSS,    i.REMARQUE,    CAST(ifgm.montantQuantite AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS montantQuantiteFROM INVENTAIRE i         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = i.IDMAGASIN         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c ON c.id = i.idcategorie         LEFT JOIN INVENTAIREFILLEGROUPEMERE ifgm ON ifgm.IDINVENTAIRE = i.idorder by daty desc;

j.IDMAGASIN ,

j.DATY ,

	WHEN j.ETAT = 11

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."JAUGE_LIB_VALIDEE" ("ID", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "QTE", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."JOURS_PAR_MOIS" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "NB_JOUR", "CONGE_JOURNALIER") AS 
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)) AS mois,
    TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)), 'DD')) AS nb_jour,
    ROUND(2.5 / TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1)), 'DD')), 6) AS conge_journalier
FROM dual
    CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2019-01-01', LEVEL - 1) < SYSDATE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LISTECOLONNETABLE" ("OWNER", "TABLE_NAME", "COLUMN_NAME", "DATA_TYPE", "DATA_TYPE_MOD", "DATA_TYPE_OWNER", "DATA_LENGTH", "DATA_PRECISION", "DATA_SCALE", "NULLABLE", "COLUMN_ID", "DEFAULT_LENGTH", "DATA_DEFAULT", "NUM_DISTINCT", "LOW_VALUE", "HIGH_VALUE", "DENSITY", "NUM_NULLS", "NUM_BUCKETS", "LAST_ANALYZED", "SAMPLE_SIZE", "CHARACTER_SET_NAME", "CHAR_COL_DECL_LENGTH", "GLOBAL_STATS", "USER_STATS", "AVG_COL_LEN", "CHAR_LENGTH", "CHAR_USED", "V80_FMT_IMAGE", "DATA_UPGRADED", "HISTOGRAM") AS 
  select 'a' as owner , ua."TABLE_NAME",ua."COLUMN_NAME",ua."DATA_TYPE",ua."DATA_TYPE_MOD",ua."DATA_TYPE_OWNER",ua."DATA_LENGTH",ua."DATA_PRECISION",ua."DATA_SCALE",ua."NULLABLE",ua."COLUMN_ID",ua."DEFAULT_LENGTH",ua."DATA_DEFAULT",ua."NUM_DISTINCT",ua."LOW_VALUE",ua."HIGH_VALUE",ua."DENSITY",ua."NUM_NULLS",ua."NUM_BUCKETS",ua."LAST_ANALYZED",ua."SAMPLE_SIZE",ua."CHARACTER_SET_NAME",ua."CHAR_COL_DECL_LENGTH",ua."GLOBAL_STATS",ua."USER_STATS",ua."AVG_COL_LEN",ua."CHAR_LENGTH",ua."CHAR_USED",ua."V80_FMT_IMAGE",ua."DATA_UPGRADED",ua."HISTOGRAM" from USER_TAB_COLUMNS ua union all
select tc.OWNER,syn.SYNONYM_NAME as table_name, tc.COLUMN_NAME,tc.DATA_TYPE,tc.DATA_TYPE_MOD,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LOG_PERS_NON_VALIDE_LIB" ("ID", "IDLOGPERS", "SEXE", "DATEAPPLICATION", "IDTYPEDEBAUCHE", "ETAT", "IDUSER", "MATRICULE", "DATE_DECISION", "REFDECISION", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
	    lpnv.id,
	    lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom AS idlogpers,
	    lp.sexe,
	    lpnv.dateapplication,
	    td.val AS idtypedebauche,
	    lpnv.etat,
	    lpnv.iduser,
	    pif.matricule,
	    lpnv.date_decision,
	    lpnv.refdecision,
	    CASE
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 1 THEN
	            'Cree'
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 11 THEN
	            'Valide'
	        WHEN lpnv.etat = 0 THEN
	            'Annule'
	        ELSE
	            'Inconnu'
	        END AS etatLib
	FROM log_personnel_non_valide lpnv
	         LEFT JOIN type_depart td
	                   ON td.id = lpnv.idtypedebauche
	         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pif
	                   ON pif.id = lpnv.idlogpers
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp
	                   ON lp.id = lpnv.idlogpers
	WHERE lpnv.date_reintegration IS NULL
	
 ;

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LOG_SERVICE_LIBELLE" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "CODE_DR", "DR_RATTACHE", "CODE_SERVICE") AS

       ls.libelle,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."LOT_LIB" ("ID", "NOMLOT", "REFERENCE", "DATEECLOSION", "DATEARRIVEE", "SOURCE", "IDFERME", "IDARTICLE", "IDORIGINE", "IDPROGRAMME", "ETAT", "IDFERMELIB", "IDARTICLELIB", "IDORIGINELIB", "IDPROGRAMMELIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETATLIB", "IDCATEGORIELOTLIB", "DATECLOTURE", "AGEJOUR", "AGESEMAINE") AS 
  SELECT l.ID,l.NOMLOT,l.REFERENCE,l.DATEECLOSION,l.DATEARRIVEE,l.SOURCE,l.IDFERME,l.IDARTICLE,l.IDORIGINE,l.IDPROGRAMME,l.ETAT,
       m.VAL      AS IDFERMELIB,
       ai.LIBELLE AS IDARTICLELIB,
       o.VAL      AS IDORIGINELIB,
       pz.CODE || '-' || pz.IDSOUCHELIB AS IDPROGRAMMELIB,
       s.val AS idsouchelib,
       CASE l.ETAT
           WHEN 1  THEN 'CRÉÉ'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDÉ'
           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLÉ'
           WHEN 17  THEN 'CLÔTURÉ'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       cl.val AS idcategorielotlib,
       l.datecloture AS datecloture,
       TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(dateEclosion) + 1 AS ageJour,
       FLOOR((TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(dateEclosion) + 1 - 1) / 7) + 1 AS ageSemaine
FROM LOT l
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = l.IDFERME
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = l.IDARTICLE
         LEFT JOIN ORIGINELOT o ON o.ID = l.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN PROGRAMMEZOOTECHNIQUE_LIB pz ON pz.ID = l.IDPROGRAMME
         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE s ON s.id=l.idsouche
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIELOT cl ON cl.id=l.idcategorielot;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANT_STOCK" ("IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDMAGASIN") AS 
  SELECT
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) AS ENTREE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS SORTIE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS quantite,
    cast(sum(mf.montantEntree) as number(30,2))  AS montantEntree,
    cast(sum(mf.montantSortie) as number(30,2))  AS montantSortie,
    CAST(NVL(ai.PU, 0) * (SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0))) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    m.IDMAGASIN
FROM
    mvtStockFilleMontant mf
        JOIN MVTSTOCK m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = mf.IDPRODUIT
WHERE
    m.ETAT >= 11
  AND mf.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.PU,m.IDMAGASIN
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MONTANT_STOCK_ENG" ("IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "QUANTITE", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMVTSTOCK") AS 
  SELECT
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) AS ENTREE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS SORTIE,
    SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0)) AS quantite,
    cast(sum(mf.montantEntree) as number(30,2))  AS montantEntree,
    cast(sum(mf.montantSortie) as number(30,2))  AS montantSortie,
    CAST(NVL(ai.PU, 0) * (SUM(NVL(mf.ENTREE,0)) - SUM(NVL(mf.SORTIE,0))) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
    m.IDMAGASIN,
    MAX(mf.IDMVTSTOCK) AS IDMVTSTOCK
FROM
    mvtStockFilleMontant_eng mf
        JOIN MVTstock_eng m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
        JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = mf.IDPRODUIT
WHERE
    m.ETAT >= 11
  AND mf.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.PU,m.IDMAGASIN

 ;
