CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOTRAVAUXLIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTRAVAUX", "DUREEESTIMATIF", "TAUXHORAIRE", "DUREEESTIMATIFLIB", "MONTANT", "IDPERSONNELLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    mo."ID",mo."IDPERSONNEL",mo."IDTRAVAUX",mo."DUREEESTIMATIF",mo."TAUXHORAIRE",
    LPAD(FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF), 60), 2, '0')
                                               AS dureeEstimatifLib,
    ((mo.DUREEESTIMATIF/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE AS montant,
    p.NOM AS idPersonnelLib
FROM MOTRAVAUX mo
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON p.ID = mo.IDPERSONNEL
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "UPDATED_AT", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "ACQUEREUR", "IDTYPEPAIEMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TAUX", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "IDCAISSIER", "MONTANTRETOURNER") AS 
  SELECT
    mc.ID,
    mc.DESIGNATION,
    mc.IDCAISSE,
    mc.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    mc.IDVIREMENT,
    mc.DATY,
    mc.ETAT,
    mc.IDOP,
    mc.IDORIGINE,
    mc.IDDEVISE,
    CASE
        WHEN mc.IDTIERS IS NOT NULL
            THEN mc.IDTIERS||'---'||c.nom
        END AS IDTIERS,
    mc.COMPTE,
    CASE
        WHEN mc.IDPREVISION IS NOT NULL
            THEN mc.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.designation
        END AS IDPREVISION,
    mc.IDTRAITE,
    mc.ETATVERSEMENT,
    mc.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    mc.IDMVTCAISSEMERE,
    mc.REFERENCE,
    mc.UPDATED_AT,
    mc.DATYCOMPTABILISATION,
    mc.ACQUEREUR,
    mc.IDTYPEPAIEMENT,
    mc.DEBIT,
    mc.CREDIT,
    mc.TAUX,
    mc.HEURE,
    mc.idReport,
    mc.idCaissier,
    mc.montantRetourner
FROM mouvementcaisse mc
     LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id=mc.IDTIERS
     LEFT JOIN prevision p ON p.id=mc.IDPREVISION
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSEAVECHEURE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDPREVISION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "UPDATED_AT", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "ACQUEREUR", "IDTYPEPAIEMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TAUX", "HEURE", "IDREPORT") AS 
  SELECT
    m.ID,
    m.DESIGNATION,
    m.IDCAISSE,
    m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
    m.IDVIREMENT,
    CASE
        WHEN m.HEURE IS NOT NULL AND m.HEURE != '00:00:00'
        THEN m.DATY + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 1, 2)) / 24)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 4, 2)) / 1440)
                   + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.HEURE, 7, 2)) / 86400)
        ELSE m.DATY
    END AS DATY,
    m.ETAT,
    m.IDOP,
    m.IDORIGINE,
    m.IDDEVISE,
    m.IDTIERS,
    m.COMPTE,
    m.IDPREVISION,
    m.IDTRAITE,
    m.ETATVERSEMENT,
    m.IDMODEPAIEMENT,
    m.IDMVTCAISSEMERE,
    m.REFERENCE,
    m.UPDATED_AT,
    m.DATYCOMPTABILISATION,
    m.ACQUEREUR,
    m.IDTYPEPAIEMENT,
    m.DEBIT,
    m.CREDIT,
    m.TAUX,
    m.HEURE,
    m.idReport
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESSS", "IDECRITURE", "IDBC") AS 
  SELECT m.ID,
       m.DESIGNATION,
       m.IDCAISSE,
       c.VAL   AS IDCAISSELIB,
       m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       m.IDVIREMENT,
       m.DEBIT,
       m.CREDIT,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.credit > 0 THEN NVL(m.CREDIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldecredit,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.debit > 0 THEN NVL(m.DEBIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldedebit,
       m.DATY,
       m.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN m.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CRÉÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VALIDÉE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 8
               THEN 'À COMPTABILISER'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       vd.IDVENTE,
       m.IDORIGINE as idorigine,
       m.idtiers,
       t.NOM AS tiers,
       m.idPrevision,
       m.idOP,
       m.taux,
       m.COMPTE,
       m.IDDEVISE,
       m.idtraite,
       mp.VAL as idModePaiementLib,
       m.idmvtcaissemere,
       m.reference,
       m.datycomptabilisation,
       m.UPDATED_AT, m.heure,
       m.IDREPORT,
       m.ID || '' || m.DATY || '' || m.DESIGNATION || '' || t.NOM || '' || m.IDCAISSE || '' || c.VAL AS MOTSCLESS,
       ce.id as idecriture,
       m.IDBC
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = m.IDCAISSE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.ID = m.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.ID = m.idtiers
         left join liaisonpaiementmvtcaissegrp l on l.idmvtcaisse=m.id
         left join modepaiement mp on m.idmodepaiement = mp.id
         left join COMPTA_ECRITURE ce on ce.IDOBJET=m.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL_A" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT
	    ID,DESIGNATION,IDCAISSE,IDCAISSELIB,IDVENTEDETAIL,IDVIREMENT,DEBIT,CREDIT,DATY,ETAT,ETATLIB,IDVENTE,IDORIGINE,IDTIERS,TIERS,MOTSCLESSS
	FROM
	    MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL m
	WHERE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL_UNIQUE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "NUMEROFACTURE", "UPDATED_AT", "TOTALIMPUTE", "REFERENCES_PAIEMENT") AS 
  SELECT
    v.ID,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MTBFDETAIL" ("ID", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "DATY", "ECART") AS 
  select
    otf.id,
    otf.IDINGREDIENTS as idMachine,
    ai.LIBELLE as idMachineLib,
    ot.DATY,
    nvl(
            ot.DATY - lead(ot.DATY) over (
                partition by otf.IDINGREDIENTS
                order by ot.DATY desc
                ),
            0
    ) as ecart
from ORDRETRAVAUX ot
         left join ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE otf
                   on otf.IDMERE = ot.ID
         left join AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai
                   on ai.ID = otf.IDINGREDIENTS;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTCAISSECPLORIGINE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDECREDIT", "SOLDEDEBIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "TIERS", "IDPREVISION", "IDOP", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "IDDEVISE", "IDTRAITE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDMVTCAISSEMERE", "REFERENCE", "DATYCOMPTABILISATION", "UPDATED_AT", "HEURE", "IDREPORT", "MOTSCLESS", "IDECRITURE") AS 
  SELECT m.ID,
       m.DESIGNATION,
       m.IDCAISSE,
       c.VAL   AS IDCAISSELIB,
       m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       m.IDVIREMENT,
       m.DEBIT,
       m.CREDIT,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.credit > 0 THEN NVL(m.CREDIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldecredit,
       CAST(
               CASE
                   WHEN m.debit > 0 THEN NVL(m.DEBIT, 0) - NVL(l.MONTANT, 0)
                   ELSE 0
                   END AS NUMBER(36,5)
       ) AS soldedebit,
       m.DATY,
       m.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN m.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'VALIDEE'
           WHEN m.ETAT = 8
               THEN 'A COMPTABILISER'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       vd.IDVENTE,
       lp.ID2 as idorigine,
       m.idtiers,
       t.NOM AS tiers,
       m.idPrevision,
       m.idOP,
       m.taux,
       m.COMPTE,
       m.IDDEVISE,
       m.idtraite,
       mp.VAL as idModePaiementLib,
       m.idmvtcaissemere,
       m.reference,
       m.datycomptabilisation,
       m.UPDATED_AT, m.heure,
       m.IDREPORT,
       m.ID || '' || m.DATY || '' || m.DESIGNATION || '' || t.NOM || '' || m.IDCAISSE || '' || c.VAL AS MOTSCLESS,
       cr.id as idecriture
FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE m
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.ID = m.IDCAISSE
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS vd ON vd.ID = m.IDVENTEDETAIL
         LEFT JOIN tiers t ON t.ID = m.idtiers
         left join liaisonpaiementmvtcaissegrp l on l.idmvtcaisse=m.id
         left join modepaiement mp on m.idmodepaiement = mp.id
         LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE cr on cr.IDOBJET=m.id
         JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENT lp ON lp.ID1 = m.ID

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITEV" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATEECHEANCE", "REFERENCE", "TIERS", "CODECLIENT", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "ETATLIB", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "FINALEDESTINATIONLIB", "FACTURE") AS 
  SELECT
    mic.ID,mic.DATY,mic.CAISSEDEPART,mic.CAISSEARRIVEE,mic.MONTANT,mic.MODEPAIEMENT,mic.REMARQUE,mic.ETAT,mic.DESIGNATION,mic.IDTRAITE,mic.ETATVERSEMENT,mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.Dateecheance,t.reference,t.tiers,t.CDCLT AS codeclient,
    c1.val AS caissedepartlib,
    c2.val AS caissearriveelib,
    m.Desce as modepaiementlib,
    case
        when mic.etat = 1 then 'CREE'
        when mic.etat >= 11 then 'VISE'
        else '' end                           as etatlib,
    case
        when mic.etatversement = -2 then 'encaissee'
        when mic.etatversement = 11 then 'versee'
        else '' end                           as etatversementlib,
    c3.val AS finaledestinationlib,
    grp.code AS facture
from mvtintracaisse mic
         JOIN traite_lib t on t.id = mic.idtraite
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE C1 on C1.id = mic.caissedepart
         LEFT JOIN CAISSE C2 on C2.id = mic.caissearrivee
         LEFT JOIN caisse C3 ON c3.id= mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION
         LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT m on m.id = mic.modepaiement
         LEFT JOIN TRAITELIB_GRP grp ON mic.IDTRAITE = grp.idTraite
where mic.etatversement = 11 AND mic.IDTRAITE NOT IN (SELECT IDTRAITE FROM mvtintracaisse WHERE ETATVERSEMENT  = -2)
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSETRAITEVCAISSE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION", "IDTRAITE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "IDFINALEDESTINATION", "DATEECHEANCE") AS

    mic.ID,
    mic.DATY,
    mic.CAISSEDEPART,
    mic.CAISSEARRIVEE,
    CAST(mic.MONTANT AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS MONTANT,
    mic.MODEPAIEMENT,
    mic.REMARQUE,
    mic.ETAT,
    mic.DESIGNATION,
    mic.IDTRAITE,
    mic.ETATVERSEMENT,
    mic.IDFINALEDESTINATION,
    t.DATEECHEANCE
FROM
    mvtintracaisse mic
        JOIN traite t ON
        t.id = mic.idtraite
WHERE
    mic.etatversement IN (11, -2)
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "DESIGNATION") AS

       daty,
       mv.CAISSEDEPART  as caissedepartlib,
       mv.CAISSEARRIVEE as caissearriveelib,
       ca.VAL as caissedepart,
       ca1.VAL as caissearrivee,
       montant,
       mp.VAL as modepaiement,
       remarque,
       etat ,
       mv.designation

         left join CAISSE ca1 on ca1.id=mv.caissearrivee
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id=mv.modepaiement
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIBCOMPLET" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "CAISSEDEPARTLIB", "CAISSEARRIVEELIB", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB") AS

       ca.VAL  as caissedepartlib,
       ca1.VAL as caissearriveelib,
       mp.VAL  as modepaiementlib
from mvtintracaisse mv
         left join CAISSE ca on ca.id = mv.caissedepart
         left join CAISSE ca1 on ca1.id = mv.caissearrivee
         left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = mv.modepaiement
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB_CREE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT") AS

from mvtintracaisse_lib
where ETAT=1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTINTRACAISSE_LIB_VISEE" ("ID", "DATY", "CAISSEDEPART", "CAISSEARRIVEE", "MONTANT", "MODEPAIEMENT", "REMARQUE", "ETAT") AS 
  select ID,DATY,CAISSEDEPART,CAISSEARRIVEE,MONTANT,MODEPAIEMENT,REMARQUE,ETAT
from mvtintracaisse_lib
where ETAT=11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE" ("IDFAB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "LIBELLE") AS 
  select idfab,cast(sum(ENTREE) as number(30,2)) as entree,cast(sum(sortie) as number(30,2)) as sortie,
           cast(sum(nvl(pu*ENTREE,0)) as number(30,2)) as montant, IDPRODUIT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,LIBELLE
    from MVTSTOCKFILLEFABOFCATVISE
    group by idfab,IDPRODUIT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,LIBELLE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTFILLEOFCATVISEGROUPE" ("IDOF", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "MONTANT", "IDPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "LIBELLE") AS 
  select idOf,cast(sum(ENTREE) as number(30,2)) as entree,cast(sum(sortie) as number(30,2)) as sortie,
    cast(sum(nvl(pu*ENTREE,0)) as number(30,2)) as montant     ,IDPRODUIT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,LIBELLE
    from MVTSTOCKFILLEFABOFCATVISE
    group by idOf,IDPRODUIT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,LIBELLE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPE" ("IDOFF", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "MONTANT", "MONTANTSORTIE", "PV") AS 
  select m.idoff,cast(sum(m.ENTREE) as number(30,2)) as entree,cast(sum(m.sortie) as number(30,2)) as sortie,
           sum(m.montantEntree) as montant,sum(m.montantSortie) as montantSortie, cast(avg(m.pv) as number(30,2)) as pv
    from MVTSTOCKFILLEFABOFCATVISE m
    group by m.idoff
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDVENTE", "IDTRANSFERT", "IDTYPEMVSTOCK", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDPOINT", "IDOBJET", "FABPRECEDENT", "IDCATEGORIESTOCK") AS 
  SELECT
m.ID,
m.DESIGNATION,
m.IDMAGASIN,
m.IDVENTE,
m.IDTRANSFERT,
m.IDTYPEMVSTOCK,
m.DATY,
m.ETAT,
m.IDPOINT,
m.IDOBJET,
CASE 
	WHEN m.FABPRECEDENT IS NOT NULL 
	THEN m.FABPRECEDENT||'---'||f.LIBELLE 
	ELSE m.FABPRECEDENT
END AS FABPRECEDENT,
m.IDCATEGORIESTOCK
FROM MVTSTOCK m 
LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = m.FABPRECEDENT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKENTREEAVECRESTE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "DATY", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "IDMAGASIN", "IDINVENTAIREFILLE", "IDOBJET", "IDTRANSFERT") AS 
  SELECT
	m.ID,
	m.IDMVTSTOCK,
	m.IDPRODUIT,
	m.ENTREE,
	s.SORTIE,
	m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
	m.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
	m.PU,
	m.MVTSRC,
	mp.DATY,
	NVL(m.entree,0)- NVL(s.sortie, 0) AS reste,
	NVL(m.entree,0)- NVL(s.sortie, 0) AS quantite,
	--ity no reste miasa any
 mp.IDMAGASIN,
 m.IDINVENTAIREFILLE,
 mp.IDOBJET,
 mp.IDTRANSFERT
FROM
	MVTSTOCKFILLE m
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK mp ON
	mp.id = m.IDMVTSTOCK
LEFT JOIN sortieEntree s ON
	s.MVTSRC = m.id 
WHERE
	m.ENTREE >0
	AND mp.ETAT >= 11
 
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKENTREEAVECRESTE2" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "DATY", "RESTE", "QUANTITE", "IDMAGASIN") AS 
  SELECT
	"ID","IDMVTSTOCK","IDPRODUIT","ENTREE","SORTIE","IDVENTEDETAIL","IDTRANSFERTDETAIL","PU","MVTSRC","DATY","RESTE","QUANTITE","IDMAGASIN"
FROM
	MVTSTOCKENTREEAVECRESTE
WHERE
	QUANTITE >0
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKENTREEAVECRESTEGROUPE" ("IDINGREDIENT", "QUANTITE") AS 
  SELECT 
m.IDPRODUIT AS idingredient,
sum(nvl(m.reste,m.ENTREE)) AS quantite
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE m 
LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK mp ON mp.id = m.IDMVTSTOCK
WHERE m.ENTREE > 0
GROUP BY m.IDPRODUIT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEAUTOCOMPLETE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "MVTSRC", "DESIGNATION", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "RESTE", "IDINVENTAIREFILLE", "DATEINVENTAIRE", "QTEINVENTAIRE") AS 
  SELECT 
m.ID,
m.IDMVTSTOCK,
CASE 
	WHEN m.IDPRODUIT IS NOT NULL 
	THEN m.IDPRODUIT||'---'||a.libelle 
END AS IDPRODUIT,
m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
m.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
m.MVTSRC,
m.DESIGNATION,
m.ENTREE,
m.SORTIE,
m.PU,
m.RESTE,
m.IDINVENTAIREFILLE,
m.DATEINVENTAIRE,
m.QTEINVENTAIRE
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE m 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS a ON a.id = m.IDPRODUIT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEAVECSOURCE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "MVTSRC", "DESIGNATION", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "RESTE") AS 
  select mf.ID,
    mf.IDMVTSTOCK,
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    mf.IDVENTEDETAIL ,
    mf.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
    nvl(mf.MVTSRC,mf.id) as MVTSRC,
    mf.DESIGNATION,
    mf.ENTREE,
    mf.SORTIE,
    mf.PU,
    mf.RESTE
    from MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEENTREEFAB" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB") AS 
  select st.ID,st.IDMVTSTOCK,st.IDPRODUIT,ai.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,st.ENTREE,st.SORTIE,st.IDVENTEDETAIL,st.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,st.PU,st.MVTSRC,st.RESTE,st.DESIGNATION,st.IDFAB 
from MVTSTOCKFILLEFAB st
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
ON st.IDPRODUIT = ai.id
WHERE st.SORTIE <= 0
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEFABOFCATVISE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDOF", "LIBELLE", "IDOFF", "PV", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS 
  select m."ID",m."IDMVTSTOCK",m."IDPRODUIT",m."ENTREE",m."SORTIE",m."IDVENTEDETAIL",m."IDTRANSFERTDETAIL",m."PU",m."MVTSRC",m."RESTE",m."DESIGNATION",m."IDFAB",cat.VAL as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,fille.IDMERE as idOf,ing.LIBELLE,fille.id as idoff,ing.pv, cast(nvl(m.ENTREE*m.PU,0) as number(30,2)) as montantEntree ,cast(nvl(m.sortie*m.PU,0) as number(30,2)) as montantSortie
    from MVTSTOCKFILLEFABVISE m left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on m.IDPRODUIT=ing.ID
left join CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat on ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT=cat.id
left join fabrication fab on m.IDFAB=fab.id
left join OFFILLE fille on fab.IDOFFILLE=fille.ID
where ing.COMPOSE=0
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEFABOFCATVISETOUS" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDOF", "LIBELLE", "IDOFF", "PV", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS 
  select m."ID",m."IDMVTSTOCK",m."IDPRODUIT",m."ENTREE",m."SORTIE",m."IDVENTEDETAIL",m."IDTRANSFERTDETAIL",m."PU",m."MVTSRC",m."RESTE",m."DESIGNATION",m."IDFAB",cat.VAL as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,fille.IDMERE as idOf,ing.LIBELLE,fille.id as idoff,ing.pv, cast(nvl(m.ENTREE*m.PU,0) as number(30,2)) as montantEntree ,cast(nvl(m.sortie*m.PU,0) as number(30,2)) as montantSortie
    from MVTSTOCKFILLEFABVISE m left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on m.IDPRODUIT=ing.ID
left join CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat on ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT=cat.id
left join fabrication fab on m.IDFAB=fab.id
left join OFFILLE fille on fab.IDOFFILLE=fille.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEFABVISE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB") AS 
  select st."ID",st."IDMVTSTOCK",st."IDPRODUIT",st."ENTREE",st."SORTIE",st."IDVENTEDETAIL",st."IDTRANSFERTDETAIL",st."PU",st."MVTSRC",st."RESTE",st."DESIGNATION",m.IDOBJET as idFab
from MVTSTOCKFILLE st left join MVTSTOCK m on st.IDMVTSTOCK=m.ID  where m.etat>=11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEGROUPEMERE" ("IDMVTSTOCK", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS 
  select f.IDMVTSTOCK,cast(sum(nvl(f.pu*f.ENTREE,0)) as number(30,2)) as montantEntree,
    cast(sum(nvl(f.pu*f.sortie,0)) as number(30,2)) as montantSortie
           from MVTSTOCKFILLE f group by f.IDMVTSTOCK
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEGRP" ("IDMVTSTOCK", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "COMPTE_STOCK", "COMPTE_SORTIE_STOCK") AS 
  SELECT
    f.IDMVTSTOCK,
    SUM(f.ENTREE * f.PU) AS entree,
    SUM(f.SORTIE * f.PU) AS SORTIE,
    ing.compte_stock,
    compte_sortie_stock
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY f.IDMVTSTOCK, ing.compte_stock,compte_sortie_stock
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEGRPVARIATION" ("IDMVTSTOCK", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "COMPTE_STOCK", "COMPTE_SORTIE_STOCK") AS 
  SELECT
    f.IDMVTSTOCK,
    SUM(f.ENTREE * f.PU) AS entree,
    SUM(f.SORTIE * f.PU) AS SORTIE,
     null as compte_stock,
    ing.compte_sortie_stock
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE f
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = f.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY f.IDMVTSTOCK, ing.compte_sortie_stock
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTEDETAILLIB", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "MVTSRC", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "DATESQL", "IDOBJET", "IDTYPEMVSTOCK", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDUNITE", "IDUNITELIB") AS 
      '' AS IDVENTEDETAILLIB,    m.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL ,    '' AS IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB,    m2.DATY ,    m2.IDMAGASIN ,    m3.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,    m.pu,    cast(m.pu*m.ENTREE+(m.pu*m.sortie) as number(20,5)) as montant,    p.LIBELLE,    m.MVTSRC,    p.libelle AS libelleexacte,    m2.DATY AS dateSql,    m2.idobjet,    m2.IDTYPEMVSTOCK,    m2.etat,    CASE        WHEN m2.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ'        WHEN m2.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉ'        WHEN m2.ETAT = 11 THEN 'ANNULÉ'        END    AS ETATLIB,    p.UNITE AS idunite,    asu.VAL AS idunitelibFROM MVTSTOCKFILLE m         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS  p ON p.ID = m.IDPRODUIT         LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK m2 ON m2.ID = m.IDMVTSTOCK         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m3 ON m3.ID = m2.IDMAGASIN         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE asu ON asu.ID = p.UNITE;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLELIB_ENG" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTEDETAILLIB", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "PU", "MONTANT", "LIBELLE", "MVTSRC", "LIBELLEEXACTE") AS 
  SELECT
    m.ID ,
    m.IDMVTSTOCK ,
    m.IDPRODUIT ,
    p.libelle  AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    m.ENTREE ,
    m.SORTIE ,
    m.IDVENTEDETAIL ,
    '' AS IDVENTEDETAILLIB,
    m.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL ,
    '' AS IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB,
    m2.DATY ,
    m2.IDMAGASIN ,
    m3.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
    m.pu,
    cast(m.pu*m.ENTREE+(m.pu*m.sortie) as number(20,5)) as montant,
    p.LIBELLE,
    m.MVTSRC,
    p.libelle AS libelleexacte
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE_ENG m
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS  p ON p.ID = m.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK_ENG m2 ON m2.ID = m.IDMVTSTOCK
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m3 ON m3.ID = m2.IDMAGASIN
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLELIB_VISE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTEDETAILLIB", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB") AS 
  SELECT m.ID,
       m.IDMVTSTOCK,
       m.IDPRODUIT,
       p.LIBELLE  AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       m.ENTREE,
       m.SORTIE,
       m.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       ''     AS IDVENTEDETAILLIB,
       m.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
       ''     AS IDTRANSFERTDETAILLIB,
       m2.DATY,
       m2.IDMAGASIN,
       m3.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB
FROM MVTSTOCKFILLE m
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS  p ON p.ID = m.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK m2 ON m2.ID = m.IDMVTSTOCK
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m3 ON m3.ID = m2.IDMAGASIN
where m2.ETAT=11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEMONTANT_ENG" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE") AS 
  select mf.ID,
       mf.IDMVTSTOCK,
       mf.IDPRODUIT,
       mf.ENTREE,
       mf.SORTIE,
       mf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       mf.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
       mf.PU,
       mf.MVTSRC,
       mf.RESTE,
       mf.DESIGNATION,
       cast(mf.PU * mf.ENTREE as number(30, 5)) as montantEntree,
       cast(mf.PU * mf.SORTIE as number(30, 5)) as montantSortie
from MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
union all
select mf.ID,
       mf.IDMVTSTOCK,
       mf.IDPRODUIT,
       mf.ENTREE,
       mf.SORTIE,
       mf.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       mf.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,
       mf.PU,
       mf.MVTSRC,
       mf.RESTE,
       mf.DESIGNATION,
       cast(mf.PU * mf.ENTREE as number(30, 5)) as montantEntree,
       cast(mf.PU * mf.SORTIE as number(30, 5)) as montantSortie
from stock_engage_FILLE mf
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLEPARDATE" ("DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE") AS 
  select
    m.daty,
    m.IDMAGASIN,
    mf.IDPRODUIT,
    cast(nvl(sum(mf.ENTREE),0) as number(30,3)) as entree,
    CAST(NVL(SUM(mf.SORTIE), 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS sortie
from MVTSTOCKFILLE mf
left join mvtstock m ON m.id = mf.IDMVTSTOCK
where m.ETAT >= 11
group by m.daty, mf.IDPRODUIT, m.IDMAGASIN;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLERESIDUFAB" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "PU", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB") AS 
  SELECT
    entree.ID ,
    entree.IDPRODUIT,
    entree.IDPRODUITLIB,
    entree.ENTREE,
    entree.PU AS PU,
    entree.RESTE AS RESTE,
    entree.DESIGNATION,
    entree.IDFAB
FROM
    MVTSTOCKFILLEENTREEFAB entree
JOIN
    MVTSTOCKFILLESORITEFAB sortie
ON
    entree.IDPRODUIT = sortie.IDPRODUIT
AND
    entree.IDFAB = sortie.IDFAB
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLERESIDUOF" ("IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "PU", "RESTE", "IDOF") AS 
  SELECT mf.IDPRODUIT, mf.IDPRODUITLIB, sum(nvl(mf.ENTREE,0)) AS ENTREE, sum(nvl(mf.PU ,0)) AS PU,sum(nvl(mf.RESTE ,0)) AS RESTE, o.IDMERE AS IDOF
FROM 
	MVTSTOCKFILLERESIDUFAB mf
JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.ID = mf.IDFAB 
JOIN OFFILLE o ON f.IDOFFILLE = o.id
GROUP BY mf.IDPRODUIT, mf.IDPRODUITLIB,o.IDMERE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLESANSINVENTAIRE" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "MVTSRC", "DESIGNATION", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "RESTE", "IDINVENTAIREFILLE") AS 
  select mf."ID",mf."IDMVTSTOCK",mf."IDPRODUIT",mf."IDVENTEDETAIL",mf."IDTRANSFERTDETAIL",mf."MVTSRC",mf."DESIGNATION",mf."ENTREE",mf."SORTIE",mf."PU",mf."RESTE",mf."IDINVENTAIREFILLE" from mvtStockFille mf
    left join mvtStock m on m.id=mf.IDMVTSTOCK
    where m.ETAT>=11 and mf.entree>0
      and not exists(select invf.id from INVENTAIREFILLE invf left join INVENTAIRE im on im.ID=invf.IDINVENTAIRE where invf.IDPRODUIT=mf.IDPRODUIT and invf.MVTSRC=mf.id and im.IDMAGASIN=m.IDMAGASIN)
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."MVTSTOCKFILLESORITEFAB" ("ID", "IDMVTSTOCK", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDTRANSFERTDETAIL", "PU", "MVTSRC", "RESTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDFAB") AS 
  select st.ID,st.IDMVTSTOCK,st.IDPRODUIT,ai.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,st.ENTREE,st.SORTIE,st.IDVENTEDETAIL,st.IDTRANSFERTDETAIL,st.PU,st.MVTSRC,st.RESTE,st.DESIGNATION,st.idFab
from MVTSTOCKFILLEFAB st
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
ON st.IDPRODUIT = ai.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."NOTIFICATIONLIBCPLT" ("ID", "RECEIVER", "RECEIVERLIB", "MESSAGE", "DATY", "HEURE", "ETAT", "REF", "REFLIB", "ETATLIB", "LIEN", "ECARTDATE") AS 
  SELECT n.id,
       n.receiver,
       u.nomuser AS receiverlib,
       n.message,
       n.daty,
       n.heure,
       n.etat,
       n.ref,
       '' AS reflib,
       CASE
           WHEN n.etat = 11 THEN 'LU'
           WHEN n.etat = 1 THEN 'NON LU'
           ELSE NULL
           END AS etatlib,
       n.lien,
       CASE
           WHEN ( (SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) < 60
               THEN 'il y a moins d''une minute'
           WHEN ( (SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) < 3600
               THEN 'il y a ' || FLOOR(((SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60)) || ' mn'
           WHEN ( (SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) < 86400
               THEN 'il y a ' || FLOOR(((SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) * 24)) || ' h'
           ELSE 'il y a ' || FLOOR((SYSDATE - (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(n.daty,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || n.heure, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')))) || ' jrs'
           END AS ecartdate
FROM notification2 n
         LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.refuser = n.receiver order by DATY desc
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."NOTIFICATIONLIBNONLU" ("ID", "RECEIVER", "MESSAGE", "DATY", "HEURE", "ETAT", "REF", "ETATLIB", "RECEIVERLIB", "LIEN", "ECARTDATE", "LIEN_HTML") AS SELECT n.id, n.receiver, n.message, n.daty, n.heure, n.etat, n.ref, n.etatlib, n.receiverlib, n.lien, n.ecartdate, '' || n.ref || '' AS lien_html FROM notificationlibcplt n WHERE n.etat = 1 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFABLIB" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "ETAT", "LANCEUR", "LANCEURLIB", "ETATLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT OFL.ID,
       P1.VAL     AS LANCEPAR,
       P2.VAL     AS CIBLE,
       OFL.REMARQUE,
       OFL.LIBELLE,
       OFL.BESOIN,
       OFL.DATY,
       OFL.ETAT,
       OFL.LANCEUR,
       LP.NOMUSER AS LANCEURLIB,
       CASE
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Créé'
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Validé'
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 0 THEN 'Annulé'
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 21 THEN 'Entamé'
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 31 THEN 'Bloqué'
           WHEN OFL.ETAT = 41 THEN 'Terminé'
           END    AS ETATLIB,
       (
           OFL.id || ' | ' || libelle || ' | ' ||  besoin || ' | ' || LP.NOMUSER || ' | ' || ' | ' || P2.VAL || ' | ' ||  remarque
           )      AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM OFAB OFL
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P1 ON P1.ID = OFL.LANCEPAR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT P2 ON P2.ID = OFL.CIBLE
         LEFT JOIN UTILISATEUR LP ON LP.REFUSER = OFL.LANCEUR;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEEXACTE") AS 
  SELECT
	ofll.ID,
	ofll.IDINGREDIENTS,
	nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,ai.LIBELLE)  AS LIBELLE,
	ofll.REMARQUE,
	ofll.IDMERE,
	ofll.DATYBESOIN,
	ofll.QTE,
	nvl(au.VAL, 'unite') AS IDUNITE,
	fmf.qte AS qteFabrique,
	(ofll.qte-nvl(fmf.qte, 0)) AS qteReste,
	nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,nvl(ai.LIBELLEEXTACTE, ai.LIBELLE)) AS libelleexacte
FROM
	OFFILLE ofll
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
	ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
	au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
LEFT JOIN FabricationMereFille fmf ON
	fmf.IDOFFILLE = ofll.ID
	AND fmf.IDINGREDIENTS = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
	AND fmf.IDBCFILLE = OFLL.IDBCFILLE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFFILLELIBQTERESTE" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEMERE", "DATY", "IDBCFILLE") AS 
  SELECT
	ofll.ID,
	ofll.IDINGREDIENTS,
	ai.LIBELLE ||' '|| ofll.LIBELLE as LIBELLE,
	ai.LIBELLE as remarque,
	ofll.IDMERE,
	ofll.DATYBESOIN,
	(ofll.qte-nvl(fmf.qte,0)) as QTE,
	nvl(au.ID,'UNT00005') AS IDUNITE,
-- 	au.id as lele,
	fmf.qte AS qteFabrique,(ofll.qte-fmf.qte) AS qteReste,
	ofa.LIBELLE as libelleMere,fmf.daty,
	ofll.IDBCFILLE

FROM OFFILLE ofll
	LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
	LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
    LEFT JOIN FabricationMereFille fmf on fmf.IDOF=ofll.IDMERE and fmf.IDINGREDIENTS=ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
left join OFAB ofa on ofa.id=ofll.IDMERE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFFILLELIBSTOCK" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "PV", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "POURC", "MOTSCLESSS", "DATY") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.IDINGREDIENTS,
       SQ.LIBELLE,
       SQ.REMARQUE,
       SQ.IDMERE,
       SQ.DATYBESOIN,
       SQ.QTE,
       SQ.IDUNITE,
       SQ.QTEFABRIQUE,
       SQ.QTERESTE,
       SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE,
       SQ.PV,
       SQ.MONTANTENTREE,
       SQ.MONTANTSORTIE,
       SQ.POURC,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || IDINGREDIENTS || ' | ' || LIBELLEEXACTE || ' | ' || IDUNITE
           ) AS MOTSCLESSS,
       SQ.DATY
FROM (SELECT OFLL.ID,
             OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS,
             NVL(OFLL.LIBELLE, AI.LIBELLE)                         AS LIBELLE,
             OFLL.REMARQUE,
             OFLL.IDMERE,
             OB.DATY                                               AS DATYBESOIN,
             OFLL.QTE,
             NVL(AU.VAL, 'unite')                                  AS IDUNITE,
             CAST(NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))              AS QTEFABRIQUE,
             CAST(OFLL.QTE - NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))   AS QTERESTE,
             NVL(OFLL.LIBELLE, NVL(AI.LIBELLEEXTACTE, AI.LIBELLE)) AS LIBELLEEXACTE,
             CAST(OFLL.PRIXVENTE AS NUMBER(30, 5))                 AS PV,
             CAST(NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) * AI.PV AS NUMBER(30, 5))      AS MONTANTENTREE,
             CAST(NVL(MVT.MONTANTSORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))      AS MONTANTSORTIE,
             CASE
                 WHEN NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) = 0 OR AI.PV = 0 THEN 0
                 ELSE (1 - (MVT.MONTANTSORTIE / (NVL(MV.ENTREE, 0) * AI.PV))) * 100
                 END                                               AS POURC,
             OB.DATY                                               AS DATY
      FROM OFFILLE OFLL
               LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS
               LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE AU ON AU.ID = OFLL.IDUNITE
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPEDEP MVT ON OFLL.ID = MVT.IDOFF
               LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCKFILLEOFENTREEPRFINI MV
                         ON MV.IDOFF = OFLL.ID
                             AND MV.IDPRODUIT = OFLL.IDINGREDIENTS
               LEFT JOIN OFAB OB ON OB.ID = OFLL.IDMERE) SQ


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFFILLELIBSTOCKIA" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "PV", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "POURC", "IDPRODUITLIB", "MOTSCLESSS", "DATY") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDPRODUIT,SQ.LIBELLE,SQ.REMARQUE,SQ.IDMERE,SQ.DATYBESOIN,SQ.QTE,SQ.IDUNITE,SQ.QTEFABRIQUE,SQ.QTERESTE,SQ.LIBELLEEXACTE,SQ.PV,SQ.MONTANTENTREE,SQ.MONTANTSORTIE,SQ.POURC, SQ.IDPRODUITLIB,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR("ID"),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPRODUIT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDMERE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATYBESOIN,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDUNITE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTEFABRIQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(QTERESTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(LIBELLEEXACTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PV),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTENTREE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTSORTIE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(POURC),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS,daty
FROM (
         SELECT
             ofll.ID,
             ofll.IDINGREDIENTS AS IDPRODUIT,
             nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,ai.LIBELLE)  AS LIBELLE,
             ofll.REMARQUE,
             ofll.IDMERE,
             ob.daty AS  DATYBESOIN,
             ofll.QTE,
             nvl(au.VAL, 'unite') AS IDUNITE,
             cast(nvl(mv.entree,0) as number(30,5)) as qteFabrique,
             cast(ofll.QTE-nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)as number(30,5)) as qteReste,
             nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,nvl(ai.LIBELLEEXTACTE, ai.LIBELLE)) AS libelleexacte,
             ai.pv,
             cast(nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)*ai.pv as number(30,2)) as montantEntree,
             cast(nvl(mvt.montantSortie,0) as number(30,5)) as montantSortie,
             CASE
                 WHEN (nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)=0 or ai.pv=0) THEN 0
                 ELSE (1-(mvt.montantSortie/(nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)*ai.pv)))*100
                 END AS pourc,
             ob.daty,
             ai.libelle AS IDPRODUITLIB
         FROM
             OFFILLE ofll
                 LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON
                 ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
                 LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
                 au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
                 left join MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPEDEP mvt on ofll.id=mvt.IDOFf
                 left join mvtStockFilleOfEntreePrFini mv on mv.idoff=ofll.id and mv.IDPRODUIT=ofll.IDINGREDIENTS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OFRATTACHE" ("ID", "IDOFFILLE", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "QTEPETRI", "IDLIGNE", "LIGNE", "IDRELEVE", "POURCENTAGE") AS 
  SELECT

    ofn.IDPRODUITLIB,
    ofn.QTE,
    ofn.QTEPETRI,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ORDRETRAVAUXFILLELIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEEXACTE") AS 
  SELECT
    ofll.ID,
    ofll.IDINGREDIENTS,
    nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,ai.LIBELLE)  AS LIBELLE,
    ofll.REMARQUE,
    ofll.IDMERE,
    ofll.DATYBESOIN,
    ofll.QTE,
    nvl(au.VAL, 'unite') AS IDUNITE,
    fmf.qte AS qteFabrique,
    (ofll.qte-nvl(fmf.qte, 0)) AS qteReste,
    nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,nvl(ai.LIBELLE, ai.LIBELLE)) AS libelleexacte
FROM
    ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE ofll
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai ON
        ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
        au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
        LEFT JOIN TRAVAUXMEREFILLE fmf ON
        fmf.IDOFFILLE = ofll.ID
            AND fmf.IDINGREDIENTS = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
            AND fmf.IDBCFILLE = OFLL.IDBCFILLE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ORGANIGRAMMELIB" ("ID", "DESCE", "VAL", "NOMPERSONNE", "MATRICULE", "POSTE") AS

       o.desce,
       lp.id AS val,
       (lp.nom || ' ') || lp.prenom AS nompersonne,
       lp.matricule,
       pf.desce AS poste
FROM log_personnel_fin_valide lp
         LEFT JOIN organigramme o ON lp.id = o.val
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON pf.id = pip.idfonction
ORDER BY o.desce DESC NULLS LAST
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OTRAVFILLELIBSTOCK" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE", "LIBELLEEXACTE", "PV", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "POURC") AS 
  SELECT
    ofll.ID,
    ofll.IDINGREDIENTS,
    nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,ai.LIBELLE)  AS LIBELLE,
    ofll.REMARQUE,
    ofll.IDMERE,
    ob.daty AS  DATYBESOIN,
    ofll.QTE,
    nvl(au.VAL, 'unite') AS IDUNITE,
    cast(nvl(mv.entree,0) as number(30,2)) as qteFabrique,
    cast(ofll.QTE-nvl(mv.ENTREE,0)as number(30,2)) as qteReste,
    nvl(ofll.LIBELLE,nvl(ai.LIBELLE, ai.LIBELLE)) AS libelleexacte,
    0 AS pv,
    cast(0 as number(30,2)) as montantEntree,
    mvt.montantSortie,
    0 AS pourc
FROM
    ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE ofll
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai ON
        ai.ID = ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
        au.ID = ofll.IDUNITE
        left join MVTSTFILLEOFFCATVISEGROUPEDEP mvt on ofll.id=mvt.IDOFf
        left join mvtStockFilleOfEntreePrFini mv on mv.idoff=ofll.id and mv.IDPRODUIT=ofll.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN OFAB ob ON ob.id =  ofll.idmere
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OTRAVFILLERESTELIB" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "QTEFABRIQUE", "QTERESTE") AS 
  SELECT o."ID",
       o."IDINGREDIENTS",
       o."LIBELLE",
       o."REMARQUE",
       o."IDMERE",
       o."DATYBESOIN",
       o."QTE",
       o."IDUNITE",
       fmf.qte           AS qteFabrique,
       (o.qte - fmf.qte) AS qteReste
FROM TRAVAUXMEREFILLE fmf
         JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLELIB o ON fmf.idof = o.IDMERE AND fmf.IDINGREDIENTS = o.IDINGREDIENTS
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."OTRAVLIB" ("ID", "IDBC", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT ofl.ID,
       ofl.IDBC,
       p1.VAL  AS LANCEPAR,
       p2.VAL  AS CIBLE,
       ofl.REMARQUE,
       ofl.LIBELLE,
       ofl.BESOIN,
       ofl.DATY,
       ofl.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=1
               THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=11
               THEN 'VALIDE'
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=0
               THEN 'ANNULE'
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=21
               THEN 'ENTAME'
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=31
               THEN 'BLOQUE'
           WHEN ofl.ETAT=41
               THEN 'TERMINE'
           END AS ETATLIB
FROM ORDRETRAVAUX ofl
         LEFT JOIN ENTITE p1 ON p1.ID = ofl.LANCEPAR
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p2 ON p2.ID = ofl.CIBLE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_EDITIONMOISANNEE_LIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "IDUSER", "IDDIRECTION", "DATY", "MOIS_STRING", "ETAT", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT pae.id,
       (log.nom || ' ') || log.prenom AS idpersonnel,
       pae.mois,
       pae.annee,
       pae.gain,
       pae.retenue,
       u.nomuser AS iduser,
       dir.val AS iddirection,
       pae.daty,
       CASE
           WHEN pae.mois = 1 THEN 'Janvier'
           WHEN pae.mois = 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
           WHEN pae.mois = 3 THEN 'Mars'
           WHEN pae.mois = 4 THEN 'Avril'
           WHEN pae.mois = 5 THEN 'Mai'
           WHEN pae.mois = 6 THEN 'Juin'
           WHEN pae.mois = 7 THEN 'Juillet'
           WHEN pae.mois = 8 THEN 'Aout'
           WHEN pae.mois = 9 THEN 'Septembre'
           WHEN pae.mois = 10 THEN 'Octobre'
           WHEN pae.mois = 11 THEN 'Novembre'
           WHEN pae.mois = 12 THEN 'Decembre'
           WHEN pae.mois = 13 THEN '13eme MOIS'
           WHEN pae.mois = 14 THEN '13eme MOIS BIS'
           ELSE NULL
           END AS mois_string,
       pae.etat,
       CAST(round(net.montant, 2) AS NUMBER(15,2)) AS montant
FROM paie_editionmoisannee pae
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel log ON log.id_pers = pae.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN log_direction dir ON dir.id = pae.iddirection
         LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.refuser = pae.iduser
         LEFT JOIN net_moisannee net ON pae.mois = net.mois AND pae.annee = net.annee
ORDER BY pae.annee DESC, pae.mois DESC
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_EDITION_CNAPS" ("IDPERSONNEL", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "BRUT", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR") AS 
  SELECT
    pe.idpersonnel,
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.gain), 2) AS brut,
    NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) AS cnaps_travailleur,
    CASE
        WHEN NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN (
                         SELECT plafond
                         FROM conf_cnaps
                         WHERE conf_cnaps.daty >= pe.datefin
                           AND ROWNUM = 1
                     ) < (SUM(pe.gain) * 0.13) THEN (
                    SELECT plafond
                    FROM conf_cnaps
                    WHERE conf_cnaps.daty >= pe.datefin
                      AND ROWNUM = 1
                )
                ELSE ROUND(LEAST(NVL(edc.cnaps_travailleur, 0) * 13, SUM(pe.gain) * 0.13), 2)
                END
        END AS cnaps_employeur
FROM paie_edition pe
         JOIN paie_rubrique pr
              ON pe.idelementpaie = pr.id
                  AND pr.typerubrique = 'G'
                  AND pr.imposable = 'I'
         LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pe_1.idpersonnel,
        pe_1.mois,
        pe_1.annee,
        pe_1.retenue AS cnaps_travailleur
    FROM paie_edition pe_1
    WHERE pe_1.idelementpaie = 'PR000101'
) edc
                   ON pe.idpersonnel = edc.idpersonnel
                       AND pe.mois = edc.mois
                       AND pe.annee = edc.annee
GROUP BY
    pe.idpersonnel, pe.mois, pe.annee, edc.cnaps_travailleur,  pe.datefin
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_INFO_JOURS_MOIS" ("ID", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DATE_DEPART", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "NB_JOUR", "CONGE_JOURNALIER", "JOURPLUSDEPART", "JOURPLUSEMBAUCHE") AS 
  SELECT
    pip.id,
    pip.dateembauche,
    pip.date_depart,
    j.annee,
    j.mois,
    j.nb_jour,
    j.conge_journalier,
    0 AS jourplusdepart,
    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.dateembauche)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.dateembauche)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.dateembauche)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusembauche
FROM
    paie_info_personnel pip,
    jours_par_mois j
WHERE
    TO_DATE(j.annee || LPAD(j.mois, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM') >=
    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.dateembauche, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')
  AND pip.date_depart IS NULL

UNION

SELECT
    pip.id,
    pip.dateembauche,
    pip.date_depart,
    j.annee,
    j.mois,
    j.nb_jour,
    j.conge_journalier,
    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.date_depart)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.date_depart)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.date_depart)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusdepart,
    CASE
        WHEN j.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pip.dateembauche)
            AND j.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pip.dateembauche)
            THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM pip.dateembauche)
        ELSE 0
        END AS jourplusembauche
FROM
    paie_info_personnel pip,
    jours_par_mois j
WHERE
    TO_DATE(j.annee || LPAD(j.mois, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM') >=
    TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.dateembauche, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')
  AND pip.date_depart IS NOT NULL
  AND TO_DATE(j.annee || LPAD(j.mois, 2, '0'), 'YYYYMM') <=
      TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pip.date_depart, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYYMM')
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_INFO_JOURS_MOIS2" ("ID", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DATE_DEPART", "ANNEE", "MOIS", "NB_JOUR", "CONGE_JOURNALIER", "JOURPLUSDEPART", "JOURPLUSEMBAUCHE", "NBJOURSVRAI") AS 
  SELECT p.id,
       p.dateembauche,
       p.date_depart,
       p.annee,
       p.mois,
       p.nb_jour,
       p.conge_journalier,
       p.jourplusdepart,
       p.jourplusembauche,
       CASE
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart > 0 AND p.jourplusembauche = 0 THEN p.jourplusdepart
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart = 0 AND p.jourplusembauche > 0 THEN p.nb_jour - p.jourplusembauche + 1
           WHEN p.jourplusdepart > 0 AND p.jourplusembauche > 0 THEN p.jourplusdepart - p.jourplusembauche
           WHEN p.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sysdate ) AND p.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH  FROM sysdate ) THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM sysdate )
           ELSE p.nb_jour
           END AS nbjoursvrai
FROM paie_info_jours_mois p
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_PERSONNEL_ELEMENTPAIE_LIB" ("ID", "CODE_RUBRIQUE", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNEL", "ETAT", "ID_OBJET", "IDUSER", "MOISREGULARISATION", "ANNEEREGULARISATION", "IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION", "IDFONCTION", "POURCENTAGE") AS 
  SELECT ppe.id,
       pr.val AS code_rubrique,
       ppe.date_debut,
       ppe.date_fin,
       ppe.gain,
       ppe.retenue,
       ppe.remarque,
       (pip.nom || ' ') || pip.prenom AS idpersonnel,
       ppe.etat,
       ppe.id_objet,
       ppe.iduser,
       ppe.moisregularisation,
       ppe.anneeregularisation,
       (cq.idcategorielib || ' ') || cq.categorie_qualificationlib AS idcategorie_qualification,
       pf.val AS idfonction,
       ppe.pourcentage
FROM paie_personnel_elementpaie ppe
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel pip ON pip.id = ppe.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN categ_quali_libcomplet cq ON ppe.idcategorie_qualification = cq.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf ON ppe.idfonction = pf.id
         LEFT JOIN paie_rubrique pr ON pr.id = ppe.code_rubrique
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PAIE_PERS_ELTPAIE_LIB2" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "ID_CODE_RUBRIQUE", "CODE_RUBRIQUE", "DATE_DEBUT", "DATE_FIN", "GAIN", "RETENUE", "REMARQUE", "IDPERSONNEL", "ETAT", "ID_OBJET", "IDUSER", "MOISREGULARISATION", "ANNEEREGULARISATION", "RUBRIQUE", "MOISLIB", "IDCATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION", "IDFONCTION", "POURCENTAGE", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    ppe.id,
    pip2.matricule,
    pr.id AS id_code_rubrique,
    pr.val AS code_rubrique,
    ppe.date_debut,
    ppe.date_fin,
    ppe.gain,
    ppe.retenue,
    ppe.remarque,
    pip.nom || ' ' || pip.prenom AS idpersonnel,
    ppe.etat,
    ppe.id_objet,
    ppe.iduser,
    ppe.moisregularisation,
    ppe.anneeregularisation,
    pr.VAL as rubrique,

    TO_CHAR(
            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ppe.moisregularisation, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
            'FMMonth',
            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisLib,

    cq.idcategorielib || ' ' || cq.categorie_qualificationlib AS idcategorie_qualification,
    pf.desce AS idfonction,
    ppe.pourcentage,

    CASE
        WHEN ppe.etat = '1' THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN ppe.etat = '11' THEN 'VALIDE'
        WHEN ppe.etat = '0' THEN 'ANNULE'
        ELSE 'INCONNU'
        END AS etatlib

FROM paie_personnel_elementpaie ppe
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel pip
                   ON TO_CHAR(pip.id) = TO_CHAR(ppe.idpersonnel)
         LEFT JOIN categorie_qualification_libc cq
                   ON TO_CHAR(ppe.idcategorie_qualification) = TO_CHAR(cq.id)
         LEFT JOIN paie_fonction pf
                   ON TO_CHAR(ppe.idfonction) = TO_CHAR(pf.id)
         LEFT JOIN paie_rubrique pr
                   ON TO_CHAR(pr.id) = TO_CHAR(ppe.code_rubrique)
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip2
              ON TO_CHAR(pip.id) = TO_CHAR(pip2.id) WHERE ppe.CODE_RUBRIQUE!='PR0000150HS'
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PERTEGAINIMPREVUELIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDTYPEGAINPERTE", "PERTE", "GAIN", "IDORIGINE", "DATY", "ETAT", "TVA", "TIERS", "TYPE", "COMPTE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "TIERSLIB", "TIERSCOMPTE", "COMPTEAUXILIAIRE") AS 
  SELECT pgi.ID,pgi.DESIGNATION,pgi.IDTYPEGAINPERTE,pgi.PERTE,pgi.GAIN,pgi.IDORIGINE,pgi.DATY,pgi.ETAT,pgi.TVA,pgi.TIERS,
       tgp.val                                                                             AS TYPE,
       tgp.desce                                                                           AS compte,
       case when perte > 0 then perte * tva / 100 else gain * tva / 100 end                as montanttva,
       case when perte > 0 then perte else gain end                                        as montantht,
       case when perte > 0 then perte + perte * tva / 100 else gain + gain * tva / 100 end as montantttc,
       t.nom as TIERSLIB,
       t.COMPTE as tierscompte,
       t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE
FROM pertegainimprevue pgi
         LEFT JOIN typegainperte tgp on pgi.idtypegainperte = tgp.id
         LEFT JOIN tiers t on t.id = pgi.tiers
    
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "POIDS", "NOMBREOISEAUX", "POIDSNOMBRE", "DANSPLAGEUNIFORMITE", "POURCENTAGEOISEAUX") AS 
  SELECT d."ID",d."IDMERE",d."POIDS",d."NOMBREOISEAUX",       (d."POIDS" * d."NOMBREOISEAUX")                  AS "POIDSNOMBRE",       CASE WHEN d."POIDS" >= m."LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE"           AND d."POIDS" <= m."LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE"                THEN 'Oui' ELSE 'Non' END                   AS "DANSPLAGEUNIFORMITE",       CASE WHEN m."NOMBREOISEAUXPESES" > 0                THEN d."NOMBREOISEAUX" / m."NOMBREOISEAUXPESES" * 100            ELSE NULL END                                AS "POURCENTAGEOISEAUX"FROM "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL" d         LEFT JOIN "PESEEPOUSSIN_LIB" m ON m."ID" = d."IDMERE";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PESEEPOUSSIN_LIB" ("ID", "DATEPESEE", "IDTYPEPESEE", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDFERME", "IDBATIMENT", "IDLOT", "IDPARQUET", "IDSEXE", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDTYPEPESEELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDFERMELIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDLOTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "IDSEXELIB", "DATEECLOSION", "AGEJOUR", "AGESEMAINE", "NOMBREOISEAUXPESES", "POIDSTOTAL", "POIDSMOYEN", "ECARTTYPE", "COEFFICIENTVARIATION", "LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE", "LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE", "NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE", "UNIFORMITE", "ETATLIB") AS 
      SELECT "IDMERE",           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX")                       AS NOMBREOISEAUXPESES,           SUM("POIDS" * "NOMBREOISEAUX")              AS POIDSTOTAL,           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX" * "POIDS" * "POIDS")     AS SUM_N_P2,           SUM("NOMBREOISEAUX" * "POIDS")               AS SUM_N_P    FROM "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL"    GROUP BY "IDMERE"),stats AS (    SELECT "IDMERE",           NOMBREOISEAUXPESES,           POIDSTOTAL,           CASE WHEN NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 0                THEN POIDSTOTAL / NOMBREOISEAUXPESES                ELSE NULL END AS POIDSMOYEN,           CASE WHEN NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 1                THEN SQRT( (SUM_N_P2 - (POWER(SUM_N_P,2) / NOMBREOISEAUXPESES)) / (NOMBREOISEAUXPESES - 1) )                ELSE NULL END AS ECARTTYPE    FROM agg),stats2 AS (    SELECT s.*,           CASE WHEN POIDSMOYEN IS NOT NULL AND POIDSMOYEN <> 0                THEN (ECARTTYPE / POIDSMOYEN) * 100                ELSE NULL END AS COEFFICIENTVARIATION,           POIDSMOYEN * 0.90 AS LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE,           POIDSMOYEN * 1.10 AS LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE    FROM stats s),plage AS (    SELECT s2."IDMERE",           SUM(CASE WHEN d."POIDS" >= s2.LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE                     AND d."POIDS" <= s2.LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE                    THEN d."NOMBREOISEAUX" ELSE 0 END) AS NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE    FROM stats2 s2    JOIN "PESEEPOUSSINDETAIL" d ON d."IDMERE" = s2."IDMERE"    GROUP BY s2."IDMERE")SELECT p."ID",p."DATEPESEE",p."IDTYPEPESEE",p."IDRESPONSABLE",p."IDFERME",p."IDBATIMENT",p."IDLOT",p."IDPARQUET",p."IDSEXE",p."REMARQUE",p."ETAT",       tp."VAL"                                        AS "IDTYPEPESEELIB",       lp."NOM" || ' ' || lp."PRENOM"                   AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",       fm."VAL"                                         AS "IDFERMELIB",       b."NOMBATIMENT"                                          AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",       l."NOMLOT"                                       AS "IDLOTLIB",       pq."VAL"                                         AS "IDPARQUETLIB",       pz."IDSOUCHELIB"                                 AS "IDSOUCHELIB",       sx."VAL"                                         AS "IDSEXELIB",       l."DATEECLOSION"                                 AS "DATEECLOSION",       (p."DATEPESEE" - l."DATEECLOSION")                AS "AGEJOUR",       (p."DATEPESEE" - l."DATEECLOSION") / 7             AS "AGESEMAINE",       s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES                             AS "NOMBREOISEAUXPESES",       s2.POIDSTOTAL                                     AS "POIDSTOTAL",       s2.POIDSMOYEN                                     AS "POIDSMOYEN",       s2.ECARTTYPE                                      AS "ECARTTYPE",       s2.COEFFICIENTVARIATION                           AS "COEFFICIENTVARIATION",       s2.LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE                          AS "LIMITEBASSEUNIFORMITE",       s2.LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE                          AS "LIMITEHAUTEUNIFORMITE",       pl.NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE                         AS "NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE",       CASE WHEN s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES > 0                THEN pl.NOMBREOISEAUXDANSPLAGE / s2.NOMBREOISEAUXPESES * 100            ELSE NULL END                                AS "UNIFORMITE",       CASE p."ETAT"           WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDEE'           END                                                AS "ETATLIB"FROM "PESEEPOUSSIN" p         LEFT JOIN "TYPEPESEE" tp ON tp."ID" = p."IDTYPEPESEE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" lp ON lp."ID" = p."IDRESPONSABLE"         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" fm ON fm."ID" = p."IDFERME"         LEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = p."IDBATIMENT"         LEFT JOIN "LOT" l ON l."ID" = p."IDLOT"         LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" pq ON pq."ID" = p."IDPARQUET"         LEFT JOIN "SEXE" sx ON sx."ID" = p."IDSEXE"         LEFT JOIN "PROGRAMMEZOOTECHNIQUE_LIB" pz ON pz."ID" = l."IDPROGRAMME"         LEFT JOIN stats2 s2 ON s2."IDMERE" = p."ID"         LEFT JOIN plage pl ON pl."IDMERE" = p."ID";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PIECEMACHINELIB" ("ID", "IDPIECE", "IDMACHINE", "IDPIECELIB", "IDMACHINELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    pm."ID",pm."IDPIECE",pm."IDMACHINE",
    p.LIBELLE AS IDPIECELIB,
    m.LIBELLE AS IDMACHINELIB
FROM PIECEMACHINE pm
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE p
              ON p.ID = pm.IDPIECE
         JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE m
              ON m.ID = pm.IDMACHINE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PLANFORMATIONANNUELLELIB" ("ID", "ANNEE", "LIBELLE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "BUDGETTOTALPREVISIONEL", "DATY") AS 
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.ANNEE,
    p.LIBELLE,
    p.ETAT,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.ETAT = 1 THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN p.ETAT = 11 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN p.ETAT = 0 THEN 'Annule'
        ELSE 'Inconnu'
    END AS ETATLIB,

    p.BUDGETTOTALPREVISIONEL,
    p.DATY
FROM PLAN_FORMATION_ANNUEL p
 
 
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PLANNINGFACTURE" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "DESIGNATION", "DATY", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTRESTE", "MONTANTPAYE", "ETATPLANNING", "ETATPAIEMENT") AS 
  SELECT
    v.ID,
    v.IDCLIENT,
    v.DESIGNATION,
    v.DATYPREVU AS DATY,
    v.MONTANTTTC AS MONTANTTOTAL,
    v.MONTANTRESTE,
    v.MONTANTPAYE,
    CASE
        WHEN v.DATYPREVU < SYSDATE THEN 1
        ELSE 0
        END etatPlanning,
    CASE
        WHEN v.MONTANTRESTE = 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
        END etatPaiement
FROM VENTE_CPL v
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PLANNINGFACTURELIB" ("ID", "IDCLIENT", "DESIGNATION", "DATY", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTRESTE", "MONTANTPAYE", "ETATPLANNING", "ETATPAIEMENT", "ETATPAIEMENTLIB", "IDCLIENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT p."ID",p."IDCLIENT",p."DESIGNATION",p."DATY",p."MONTANTTOTAL",p."MONTANTRESTE",p."MONTANTPAYE",p."ETATPLANNING",p."ETATPAIEMENT",
       CASE
           WHEN p.etatPaiement = 1 THEN 'Payé'
           ELSE 'Impayé'
           END etatPaiementLib,
       c.NOM AS idClientLib
FROM PLANNINGFACTURE p
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON p.IDCLIENT = c.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PLANNING_CPL" ("ID", "REFOBJET", "ESTPERIODIQUE", "IDTYPEMAINTENANCE", "IDMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB", "IDSITUATION", "IDSITUATIONLIB", "UNITE", "FREQUENCE", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "DUREE", "ETAT", "HEURE", "IDSOURCE", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDTYPEMAINTENANCELIB", "ESTPERIODIQUELIB", "ETATLIB", "UNITELIB", "PRIORITE", "PRIORITELIB", "IDDEMANDETRAVAUX", "IDORDRETRAVAUX", "IDORDRETRAVAUXFILLE", "IDTRAVAUX", "IDENTITE", "IDENTITELIB", "ETATDEMANDETRAVAUX", "ETATORDRETRAVAUX", "ETATTRAVAUX", "ETATDEMANDETRAVAUXLIB", "ETATORDRETRAVAUXLIB", "ETATTRAVAUXLIB", "COUT", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "IDDEPARTEMENTLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT P.ID,
       P.REFOBJET,
       P.ESTPERIODIQUE,
       P.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE,
       P.IDMACHINE,
       P.IDLIGNE,
       li.VAL as IDLIGNELIB,
       P.IDSITUATION,
       sit.VAL AS IDSITUATIONLIB,
       P.UNITE,
       P.FREQUENCE,
       P.DATEDEBUT,
       P.DATEFIN,
       P.DUREE,
       P.ETAT,
       P.HEURE,
       P.IDSOURCE,
       AI.LIBELLE                         AS IDMACHINELIB,
       T.VAL                              AS IDTYPEMAINTENANCELIB,
       CASE
           WHEN P.ESTPERIODIQUE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
           ELSE 'NON'
           END                               ESTPERIODIQUELIB,
       CASE
           WHEN P.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉE'
           ELSE 'CRÉE'
           END                               ETATLIB,
       U.VAL                              AS UNITELIB,
       D.PRIORITE,
       D.PRIORITELIB,
       D.ID                               AS IDDEMANDETRAVAUX,
       O.ID                               AS IDORDRETRAVAUX,
       OTF.ID                             AS IDORDRETRAVAUXFILLE,
       TR.ID                              AS IDTRAVAUX,
       E.ID                               AS IDENTITE,
       E.VAL                              AS IDENTITELIB,
       D.ETAT                             AS ETATDEMANDETRAVAUX,
       O.ETAT                             AS ETATORDRETRAVAUX,
       TR.ETAT                            AS ETATTRAVAUX,
       CASE D.ETAT
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
           ELSE 'Aucun'
           END                            AS ETATDEMANDETRAVAUXLIB,
       CASE O.ETAT
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
           ELSE 'Aucun'
           END                            AS ETATORDRETRAVAUXLIB,
       CASE TR.ETAT
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
           WHEN 21 THEN 'Entamee'
           WHEN 41 THEN 'Terminee'
           ELSE 'Aucun'
           END                            AS ETATTRAVAUXLIB,
       COALESCE(SUM(FFF.PU * FFF.QTE), 0) AS COUT,
       AI.PARFUMS                         AS IDDEPARTEMENT,
       dept.VAL                            AS IDDEPARTEMENTLIB,
       (
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.REFOBJET), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.ESTPERIODIQUE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.IDMACHINE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.UNITE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.FREQUENCE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.DATEDEBUT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.DATEFIN, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.DUREE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.HEURE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(P.IDSOURCE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(AI.LIBELLE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(T.VAL), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE
                           WHEN P.ESTPERIODIQUE = 1 THEN 'OUI'
                           ELSE 'NON'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE
                           WHEN P.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VALIDÉE'
                           ELSE 'CRÉE'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(U.VAL), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.PRIORITE), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.PRIORITELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(O.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(OTF.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(TR.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(E.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(E.VAL), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(D.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(O.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(TR.ETAT), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE D.ETAT
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE O.ETAT
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(
                       CASE TR.ETAT
                           WHEN 1 THEN 'Creee'
                           WHEN 11 THEN 'Visee'
                           WHEN 21 THEN 'Entamee'
                           WHEN 41 THEN 'Terminee'
                           ELSE 'Aucun'
                           END
               ), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(COALESCE(SUM(FFF.PU * FFF.QTE), 0)), '') || ' | ' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(AI.PARFUMS), '')
           )                              AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM PLANNING P
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE AIM ON AIM.ID = P.IDMACHINE
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI ON AI.ID = AIM.IDINGREDIENT
         LEFT JOIN TYPEMAINTENANCE T ON T.ID = P.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE
         LEFT JOIN UNITEMAINTENANCE U ON U.ID = P.UNITE
         LEFT JOIN DEMANDETRAVAUX_CPL D ON D.ID = P.IDSOURCE
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUX O ON O.IDBC = D.ID
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE OTF ON OTF.IDMERE = O.ID
         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUX TR ON TR.IDOFFILLE = OTF.ID
         LEFT JOIN TRAVAUXFILLE TRF ON TRF.IDMERE = TR.ID
         LEFT JOIN ENTITE E ON E.ID = AIM.IDENTITE
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR F ON F.IDREF = TR.ID
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE FFF ON FFF.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR = F.ID
         LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT dept ON dept.ID = AI.PARFUMS
         LEFT JOIN SITUATION sit ON sit.ID = P.IDSITUATION
         LEFT JOIN LIGNE li ON li.ID = P.IDLIGNE
GROUP BY P.ID, P.REFOBJET, P.ESTPERIODIQUE, P.IDTYPEMAINTENANCE, P.IDMACHINE, P.UNITE,
         P.FREQUENCE, P.DATEDEBUT, P.DATEFIN, P.DUREE, P.ETAT, P.HEURE, P.IDSOURCE,
         AI.LIBELLE, T.VAL, U.VAL,
         D.PRIORITE, D.PRIORITELIB, D.ID, D.ETAT,
         O.ID, O.ETAT,
         OTF.ID,
         TR.ID, TR.ETAT,
         E.ID, E.VAL, AI.PARFUMS, dept.VAL, sit.VAL, li.VAL, P.IDLIGNE, P.IDSITUATION
ORDER BY P.DATEDEBUT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PLANNING_DUREENONPROGRAMME" ("DATEDEBUT", "ID", "IDMACHINELIB", "DUREE", "DUREENONPROGRAMME") AS 
  SELECT
    PC.DATEDEBUT,
    PC.IDMACHINE AS ID,
    PC.IDMACHINELIB,
    SUM(PC.DUREE) AS DUREE,
    COALESCE((
         SELECT SUM(T.DUREEESTIMATIF)
         FROM TRAVAUX T
                  LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE OT ON T.IDOFFILLE = OT.ID
         WHERE T.ETAT = 11
           AND PC.IDMACHINE = OT.IDINGREDIENTS
           AND T.DATY = PC.DATEDEBUT
    ),0) AS DUREENONPROGRAMME
FROM PLANNING_CPL PC
GROUP BY PC.DATEDEBUT, PC.IDMACHINE, PC.IDMACHINELIB
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."POINTAGECANTINE_CPL" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "NOMBRE", "DATY", "ETAT", "MOISLIB", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "DEPARTEMENTLIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    pt.ID,
    pt.IDPERSONNEL,
    pt.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    pt.MOIS,
    pt.ANNEE,
    pt.NOMBRE,
    pt.DATY,
    pt.ETAT,

    TO_CHAR(
        TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pt.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
        'FMMonth',
        'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
    ) AS moisLib,

    log.nom || ' ' || log.prenom AS nomPersonnel,
    pip.matricule,
    dp.val AS departementLib,

    CASE
        WHEN pt.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN pt.etat = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
        WHEN pt.etat = 0 THEN 'ANNULE'
        ELSE 'INCONNU'
    END AS etatLib

FROM POINTAGECANTINE pt
LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL log
ON log.id = pt.idpersonnel

LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
ON pip.id = pt.idpersonnel

LEFT JOIN DEPARTEMENT dp
ON dp.id = pt.iddepartement
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."POINTAGEVISEE_VISA_MULTIPLE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "MOISLIB", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "HEURENORMAL", "HEURESUPNORMAL", "HEURESUPNUIT", "HEURESUPFERIE", "HEURESUPWEEKEND", "ABSENCE", "ETAT", "DIRECTION", "DIRECTIONLIB") AS 
  SELECT pp.id as id,pp.IDPERSONNEL,lpad(pif.matricule, 5, '0') as matricule, lg.nom || ' ' || lg.prenom as personnel,
       case
           when pp.mois=1 then
               'Janvier'
           when pp.mois=2
               then
               'Fevrier'
           when pp.mois=3
               then
               'Mars'
           when pp.mois=4
               then
               'Avril'
           when pp.mois=5
               then
               'Mai'
           when pp.mois=6
               then
               'Juin'
           when pp.mois=7
               then
               'Juillet'
           when pp.mois=8
               then
               'Aout'
           when pp.mois=9
               then
               'Septembre'
           when pp.mois=10
               then
               'Octobre'
           when pp.mois=11
               then
               'Novembre'
           when pp.mois=12
               then
               'Decembre'
           end as moisLib,
       pp.mois as mois,
       pp.annee,
       sum(nvl(pp.HEURENORMAL,0)) as HEURENORMAL,
       sum(nvl(pp.HEURESUPNORMAL,0)) as HEURESUPNORMAL,
       sum(nvl(pp.HEURESUPNUIT,0)) as HEURESUPNUIT,
       sum(nvl(pp.HEURESUPFERIE,0)) as HEURESUPFERIE,
       sum(nvl(pp.HEURESUPWEEKEND,0)) as HEURESUPWEEKEND,
       sum(nvl(pp.ABSENCE,0)) as ABSENCE,
       pp.etat,
       lg.direction,
       ld.VAL AS directionLib
FROM LOG_PERSONNEL lg
         JOIN Pointage pp ON lg.id = pp.idpersonnel
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pif ON pif.id = lg.id
         LEFT JOIN LOG_DIRECTION ld ON ld.id = pp.DIRECTION
GROUP BY lpad(pif.matricule, 5, '0'), lg.nom || ' ' || lg.prenom, pp.mois, pp.annee, pp.etat,pp.ID,pp.IDPERSONNEL,pp.mois,lg.direction, ld.val

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."POINTAGEVISEE_VISA_MULTIPLE_1" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "PERSONNEL", "MOISLIB", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "HEURENORMAL", "HEURESUPNORMAL", "HEURESUPNUIT", "HEURESUPFERIE", "HEURESUPWEEKEND", "ABSENCE", "ETAT", "DIRECTION") AS 
  SELECT
    pp.id AS id,
    pp.IDPERSONNEL,
    pif.matricule AS matricule,
    CAST(lg.nom || ' ' || lg.prenom AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS personnel,
    CASE
        WHEN pp.mois = 1 THEN 'Janvier'
        WHEN pp.mois = 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
        WHEN pp.mois = 3 THEN 'Mars'
        WHEN pp.mois = 4 THEN 'Avril'
        WHEN pp.mois = 5 THEN 'Mai'
        WHEN pp.mois = 6 THEN 'Juin'
        WHEN pp.mois = 7 THEN 'Juillet'
        WHEN pp.mois = 8 THEN 'Aout'
        WHEN pp.mois = 9 THEN 'Septembre'
        WHEN pp.mois = 10 THEN 'Octobre'
        WHEN pp.mois = 11 THEN 'Novembre'
        WHEN pp.mois = 12 THEN 'Decembre'
        END AS moisLib,
    pp.mois AS mois,
    pp.annee,
    SUM(NVL(pp.HEURENORMAL, 0)) AS HEURENORMAL,
    SUM(NVL(pp.HEURESUPNORMAL, 0)) AS HEURESUPNORMAL,
    SUM(NVL(pp.HEURESUPNUIT, 0)) AS HEURESUPNUIT,
    SUM(NVL(pp.HEURESUPFERIE, 0)) AS HEURESUPFERIE,
    SUM(NVL(pp.HEURESUPWEEKEND, 0)) AS HEURESUPWEEKEND,
    SUM(NVL(pp.ABSENCE, 0)) AS ABSENCE,
    pp.etat,
    lg.direction
FROM
    LOG_PERSONNEL lg
        JOIN
    Pointage pp ON lg.id = pp.idpersonnel
        JOIN
    paie_info_personnel pif ON pif.id = lg.id
GROUP BY
    pif.matricule,
    CAST(lg.nom || ' ' || lg.prenom AS VARCHAR2(4000)),
    pp.mois,
    pp.annee,
    pp.etat,
    pp.ID,
    pp.IDPERSONNEL,
    lg.direction

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTCPL" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDCAISSE", "IDMAGASIN", "IDPRODUIT", "PUVENTE", "MAXPOMPE") AS 
  SELECT 
p.ID ,
p.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR ,
p.COMPTEUR ,
p.DATY ,
p.HEURE ,
p.IDPOMPISTE ,
p.IDPOMPE ,
p.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN p.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
c.ID AS IDCAISSE,
p2.IDMAGASIN ,
p3.ID AS IDPRODUIT , 
p3.PUVENTE,
p2.MAX AS maxPompe
FROM PRELEVEMENT p 
LEFT JOIN CAISSE c ON c.IDPOMPISTE =  p.IDPOMPISTE 
LEFT JOIN POMPE p2 ON p2.ID = p.IDPOMPE 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = p2.IDMAGASIN 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p3 ON p3.ID  = m.IDPRODUIT 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENTLIB" ("ID", "IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR", "COMPTEUR", "DATY", "HEURE", "IDPOMPISTE", "IDPOMPE", "NOMUSER", "IDROLE", "NOMMAGASIN", "DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "DESIGNATION") AS 
  SELECT 
    p.ID AS ID,
    p.IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR AS IDPRELEVEMENTANTERIEUR,
    p.COMPTEUR AS COMPTEUR,
    CASE 
  		WHEN p.HEURE IS NULL AND p.DATY IS NOT NULL  
  		THEN TO_DATE((TO_CHAR(p.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ||' '||'00:00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')  
  		ELSE 
  		TO_DATE((TO_CHAR(p.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || p.HEURE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
    END AS DATY,
    p.HEURE AS HEURE,
    p.IDPOMPISTE AS IDPOMPISTE,
    p.IDPOMPE AS IDPOMPE,
    u.NOMUSER AS NOMUSER,
    u.IDROLE AS IDROLE,
    m.VAL AS NOMMAGASIN,
    m.DESCE AS DESCRIPTIONMAGASIN,
    p.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN p.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VALIDEE'
	WHEN p.ETAT = 22 
	THEN 'ENCAISSEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
p.DESIGNATION 
FROM 
    PRELEVEMENT p
JOIN 
    UTILISATEUR u ON u.REFUSER = p.IDPOMPISTE
JOIN 
    POMPE p2 ON p2.ID = p.IDPOMPE 
JOIN 
    MAGASINLIB m ON m.ID = p2.IDMAGASIN 
WHERE 
    u.IDROLE = 'pompiste'
   
   
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PRELEVEMENT_POMPISTE" ("INDEXF", "INDEXO", "VENTE", "PRODUIT", "PU", "MONTANT", "ID") AS 
  SELECT 
p2.compteur AS indexF,
p.compteur AS indexO,
p.compteur - p2.compteur AS vente ,
pro.val AS produit,
pro.puvente AS pu,
(p.compteur - p2.compteur) * pro.puvente AS montant,
pe.IDENCAISSEMENT AS ID
FROM PRELEVEMENT p 
JOIN PRELEVEMENT p2 ON p2.id = p.idprelevementanterieur 
JOIN POMPE po ON po.id = p.idpompe 
JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.id = po.idmagasin
JOIN PRODUIT pro ON pro.id = m.idproduit
JOIN PRELEVEMENT_ENCAISSE pe ON pe.IDPRELEVEMENT = p.ID

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONAVECMVTCAISSE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "COMPTE", "IDFACTURE", "EFFECTIFDEB", "EFFECTIFCRED") AS

  p."TAUX",p."IDTIERS",p."COMPTE",p."IDFACTURE",nvl(m.montantMere*nvl(m.taux,1),0) AS effectifdeb,nvl(m.montantCredit*nvl(m.taux,1),0) AS effectifCred

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONFERMELIB" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMVTSTOCKFILLE", "PU", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDORIGINE", "IDTIERS", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDTIERSLIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "SORTIEEFFECTIVE", "ENTREEEFFECTIVE", "ECARTENTREE", "ECARTSORTIE") AS 
  select
    p.ID,
    p.DESIGNATION,
    p.IDMAGASIN,
    p.IDMVTSTOCKFILLE,
    p.PU,
    p.IDPRODUIT,
    p.ENTREE,
    p.SORTIE,
    p.DATY,
    p.ETAT,
    p.IDORIGINE,
    p.IDTIERS,
    m.VAL AS idMagasinLib,
    t.NOM as idTiersLib,
    ai.LIBELLE as idProduitLib,
    CAST(NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS SortieEffective,
    CAST(NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EntreeEffective,
    CAST(NVL(p.ENTREE, 0) - NVL(ms.ENTREE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EcartEntree,
    CAST(NVL(p.SORTIE, 0) - NVL(ms.SORTIE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,3)) AS EcartSortie
FROM PREVISIONFERME p
LEFT JOIN magasin2 m ON m.id = p.IDMAGASIN
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ai.id = p.idProduit
LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON t.id = p.IDTIERS
LEFT JOIN MvtStockFilleParDate ms ON ms.DATY = p.DATY AND ms.IDMAGASIN = p.IDMAGASIN AND ms.IDPRODUIT = p.IDPRODUIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISIONGROUPE" ("IDFACTURE", "REFERENCE", "DATY", "DEBIT", "CREDIT") AS 
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.id, ff.idFactureFournisseur) AS idFacture,
    CASE
        WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'vente/vente-fiche.jsp&id=' || v.id
        WHEN ff.idFactureFournisseur IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'facturefournisseur/facturefournisseur-fiche.jsp&id=' || ff.idFactureFournisseur
        ELSE NULL
        END AS reference,
    p.daty,
    SUM(p.debit)  AS debit,
    SUM(p.credit) AS credit

FROM prevision p

         LEFT JOIN vente v
                   ON v.id = p.idfacture

         LEFT JOIN facturefournisseurfille ff
                   ON ff.idFactureFournisseur = p.idfacture

GROUP BY
    v.id,
    ff.idFactureFournisseur,
    p.daty
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PREVISION_COMPLET_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDCAISSE", "IDCAISSELIB", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDVIREMENT", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDOP", "IDOPLIB", "IDORIGINE", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "TAUX", "IDTIERS", "IDTIERSLIB", "COMPTE", "EFFECTIFDEBIT", "EFFECTIFCREDIT", "DEPENSEECART", "RECETTEECART", "IDFACTURE", "IDFACTUREMERE") AS 
  SELECT p.ID,
       p.DESIGNATION,
       p.IDCAISSE,
       p.IDCAISSELIB,
       p.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       p.IDVENTE,
       p.IDVENTELIB,
       p.IDVIREMENT,
       p.DEBIT,
       p.CREDIT,
       p.DATY,
       p.ETAT,
       p.IDOP,
       p.IDOPLIB,
       p.IDORIGINE,
       p.IDDEVISE,
       p.IDDEVISELIB,
       p.TAUX,
       p.IDTIERS,
       t.NOM                                                     as IDTIERSLIB,
       p.COMPTE,
       cast(NVL(pe.effectifDeb, 0) as number(30, 2))             AS effectifDebit,
       cast(NVL(pe.effectifCred, 0) as number(30, 2))            AS effectifCredit,
       cast(p.debit - NVL(pe.effectifDeb, 0) as number(30, 2))   AS depenseEcart,
       cast(p.credit - nVL(pe.effectifCred, 0) as number(30, 2)) AS recetteEcart,
       p.idfacture,
       COALESCE(v.IDVENTE, f.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR)               AS idfacturemere
FROM PREVISION_CPL p
         LEFT JOIN PrevisionAvecMvtCaisse pe ON pe.id = p.id
         LEFT JOIN VENTE_DETAILS v ON v.id = p.idfacture
         LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE f ON f.id = p.idfacture
         LEFT JOIN TIERS t ON t.id = p.IDTIERS
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSMAINTENANCEGLOBAL" ("IDTRAVAUX", "IDPERSONNEL", "DUREEREEL", "DUREEREELHMS") AS
