    pr.IDPERSONNEL,
    sum(pr.ecart_seconde) as dureeReel,
    LPAD(FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(TO_NUMBER(sum(pr.ecart_seconde)), 60), 2, '0')
                          AS dureeReelHMS
FROM PROCESSMAINTENANCELIB pr
group by pr.IDTRAVAUX, pr.IDPERSONNEL
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROCESSMAINTENANCELIB" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTRAVAUX", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "HEUREDEBUT", "HEUREFIN", "DATETIME_DEBUT", "DATETIME_FIN", "ECART_SECONDE", "ECART_HMS", "IDPERSONNELLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    prc."ID",prc."IDPERSONNEL",prc."IDTRAVAUX",prc."DATEDEBUT",prc."DATEFIN",prc."HEUREDEBUT",prc."HEUREFIN",prc."DATETIME_DEBUT",prc."DATETIME_FIN",
    /* Ecart en secondes */
    ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) AS ecart_seconde,
    /* Ecart format HH:MM:SS */
    LPAD(FLOOR(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400) / 3600), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 3600) / 60), 2, '0')
        || ':' ||
    LPAD(MOD(ROUND((prc.datetime_fin - prc.datetime_debut) * 86400), 60), 2, '0')
                                                           AS ecart_hms,
    p.NOM AS idPersonnelLib
FROM (
         SELECT
             prc.*,

             /* Date + Heure debut */
             prc.DATEDEBUT
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREDEBUT, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_debut,

             /* Date + Heure fin */
             prc.DATEFIN
                 + (TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')
                 - TRUNC(TO_DATE(prc.HEUREFIN, 'HH24:MI:SS')))
                 AS datetime_fin

         FROM ProcessMaintenance prc
     ) prc
         LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON p.ID = prc.IDPERSONNEL
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "RESTEBC", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS 
  SELECT vd.ID,
       vd.IDPROFORMA,
       vd.IDPRODUIT,
       vd.IDORIGINE,
       vd.QTE,
       vd.PU,
       vd.REMISE,
       vd.TVA,
       vd.PUACHAT,
       vd.PUVENTE,
       v.IDDEVISE,
       vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
       vd.DESIGNATION,
       vd.COMPTE,
       vd.PUREVIENT,
       vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,
       v.DESIGNATION                                                                                       AS IDPROFORMALIB,
       nvl(p.LIBELLEVENTE,p.libelle)                                                                                           AS IDPRODUITLIB,
       cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) as NUMBER(30, 2))                                                             AS puTotal,
       vd.unite,
       au.val                                                                                              AS uniteLib,
       cast(((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2))                                 AS remisemontant,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
             100) as number(30, 2))                                                                                               as montantristourne,
       cast(nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30, 2))                                as fraistransport,
       cast((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
             (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
              100)) -
            nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) as number(30 ,2))                                                       as montanttotal,
       cast((nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
            ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) -
             nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) as number(30,2))                                                     as montanttva,
       cast(((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
              (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
               nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /
               100)) - nvl(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)) + (nvl(vd.TVA, 0) / 100) *
                                                                        ((cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) -
                                                                          (cast((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100 as NUMBER(30, 2)) *
                                                                           nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)) -
                                                                         p.CALORIE * vd.QTE *
                                                                         v.fraislivraison) as number(30, 2))                      as montantttc,
       vd.datedebut,
       cast(nvl(p.calorie, 0) as number(10,2))                                                                                   as CALORIE,
       vd.ristourne                                                                                        as ristourne,
       cast(p.CALORIE as number(30, 2))                                                                    as poidsparkilo,
       cast(v.fraislivraison as number(30, 2))                                                             as fraislivraison,
       cast(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE as number(30, 2))                                                           as poidstotal,
       ((nvl(vd.qte,0) - nvl(pfc.QUANTITE,0) ) +  nvl(bcr.QUANTITE,0) )as restebc,
       vd.remiseArbiochem,
       vd.ristourneArbiochem
--       d2.id AS idDevis
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = vd.unite
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMACOMMADER pfc on pfc.IDPROFORMA=v.ID and vd.IDPRODUIT=pfc.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDEFACTURER bcr on v.id=bcr.IDPROFORMA and bcr.PRODUIT=vd.IDPRODUIT
order by p.LIBELLEVENTE asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL2" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "RESTEBC", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS

               + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantristourne,
       CAST(NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS fraistransport,
       CAST((
           (vd.QTE * vd.PU)

               - (
               ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
                   + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
               )
               - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)

                       + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
                   )
                   - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
               )
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montanttva,
       CAST((
           (
               (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                   - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))
                   - (
                   ((vd.QTE * vd.PU - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.remise, 0) / 100) + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne, 0) / 100)
                       + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0))
                   )
                   - NVL(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
               ) * (1 + NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100)
           ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantttc,
       vd.datedebut,
       CAST(NVL(p.calorie, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS CALORIE,
       vd.ristourne AS ristourne,
       CAST(p.CALORIE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS poidsparkilo,
       CAST(v.fraislivraison AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS fraislivraison,
       CAST(p.CALORIE * vd.QTE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS poidstotal,
       ((NVL(vd.qte, 0) - NVL(pfc.QUANTITE, 0)) + NVL(bcr.QUANTITE, 0)) AS restebc,
       CAST(NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS remiseArbiochem,
       CAST(NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS ristourneArbiochem
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON au.id = vd.unite
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMACOMMADER pfc ON pfc.IDPROFORMA = v.ID AND vd.IDPRODUIT = pfc.PRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDEFACTURER bcr ON v.id = bcr.IDPROFORMA AND bcr.PRODUIT = vd.IDPRODUIT
ORDER BY p.LIBELLEVENTE ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMADETAILS_CPL_ING_PDF" ("ID", "IDPROFORMA", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE", "IDPROFORMALIB", "IDPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "REMISEMONTANT", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "DATEDEBUT", "CALORIE", "RISTOURNE", "POIDSPARKILO", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "POIDSTOTAL", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE", "UNITE2", "REMISEARBIOCHEM") AS 
  SELECT
    vd.ID,
    vd.IDPROFORMA,
    vd.IDPRODUIT,
    vd.IDORIGINE,
    vd.QTE,
    vd.PU,
    vd.REMISE,
    vd.TVA,
    vd.PUACHAT,
    vd.PUVENTE,
    v.IDDEVISE,
    vd.TAUXDECHANGE,
    vd.DESIGNATION,
    vd.COMPTE,
    vd.PUREVIENT,
    vd.IDDEMANDEPRIXFILLE,

    v.DESIGNATION AS IDPROFORMALIB,

    NVL(p.LIBELLEVENTE, p.LIBELLE) AS IDPRODUITLIB,

    CAST(
        vd.QTE * vd.PU
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUTOTAL,

    vd.UNITE,

    au.VAL AS UNITELIB,

    /* REMISE TOTALE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS REMISEMONTANT,

    /* RISTOURNE */
    CAST(
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
        ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE,

    /* FRAIS TRANSPORT */
    CAST(
        NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISTRANSPORT,

    /* MONTANT TOTAL HT */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
        - (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        )
        - (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
            ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
        )
        - NVL(
            p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
            0
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTOTAL,

    /* MONTANT REMISE */
    CAST(
        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTREMISE,

    /* TVA */
    CAST(
        (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100) *
        (
            (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
            - (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
            )
            - (
                (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                    - (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                        + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                    )
                ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
            )
            - NVL(
                p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                0
            )
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTVA,

    /* TTC */
    CAST(
        (
            (
                (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                - (
                    (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                    + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                )
                - (
                    (
                        (vd.QTE * vd.PU)
                        - (
                            (vd.QTE * vd.PU * NVL(vd.REMISE,0) / 100)
                            + (vd.QTE * NVL(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM,0))
                        )
                    ) * NVL(vd.RISTOURNE,0) / 100
                )
                - NVL(
                    p.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.FRAISLIVRAISON,
                    0
                )
            )
            * (1 + NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100)
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS MONTANTTTC,

    vd.DATEDEBUT,

    CAST(
        NVL(p.CALORIE,0)
        AS NUMBER(10,2)
    ) AS CALORIE,

    vd.RISTOURNE,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSPARKILO,

    CAST(
        v.FRAISLIVRAISON
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS FRAISLIVRAISON,

    CAST(
        p.CALORIE * vd.QTE
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS POIDSTOTAL,

    CAST(
        vd.PU / NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS PUINGREDIENT,

    NVL(eq.QUANTITE,1) AS CONTENUE,

    p.UNITE2,
    vd.remisearbiochem

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd

LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v
    ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA

LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p
    ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT

LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au
    ON au.ID = vd.UNITE

LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
    ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANT2" ("ID", "POIDSTOTAL", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM(poidstotal) as number(30, 2))                            AS poidstotal,
       cast(SUM(puTotal) as number(30, 2))                               AS montant,
       cast(SUM(remisemontant) as number(30, 2))                         as montantremise,
       cast(SUM(montantristourne) as number(30, 2))                      as montantristourne,
       cast(SUM(vd.fraistransport) as number(30, 2))                     as fraistransport,
       cast(SUM(montanttotal) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2)) AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(montanttva) as number(30, 2))                            AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(montantttc) as number(30, 2))                            as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                            AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                      AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM(montantttc * vd.TAUXDECHANGE) as number(30, 2))          as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                 as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION
FROM PROFORMADETAILS_CPL vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
GROUP BY v.ID, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MONTANTRISTOURNE") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       cast(sum(nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5)   )      as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast((SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))*NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) ) as number(30, 2)) as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(vd.QTE*ing.CALORIE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colis,
       cast(sum((vd.QTE * vd.PU) - ((vd.QTE * vd.PU) * NVL(vd.remise, 0)) / 100  * nvl(vd.ristourne, 0) /100) as number(30, 2)) as montantristourne
FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION order by v.id asc
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER2" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MONTANTRISTOURNE") AS 
  SELECT
    v.ID,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                - (
                (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                    + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                )
                - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotal,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantremise,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(v.fraislivraison,0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE,0) * NVL(vd.QTE,0)) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS frais,

    CAST(SUM(NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PUACHAT,0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montanttotalachat,

    CAST(SUM(
            NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTva,

    CAST(SUM(
            (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                    - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                    - (
                    (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                        + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                    )
                    - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                )
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTC,

    NVL(v.IDDEVISE, 'AR') AS IDDEVISE,

    NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1) AS tauxDeChange,

    CAST(
            SUM(
                    (NVL(vd.TVA,0) / 100 + 1) * (
                        (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0))
                            - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))
                            - (
                            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
                            )
                            - NVL(ing.CALORIE * vd.QTE * v.fraislivraison, 0)
                        )
            ) * NVL(AVG(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)
        AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantTTCAR,

    CAST(SUM(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) AS NUMBER(20,2)) AS montantRevient,

    v.IDRESERVATION,

    NVL(SUM(vd.QTE * ing.CALORIE), 0) AS poids,

    SUM(vd.QTE) AS colis,

    CAST(SUM(
            (((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0)) - ((NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.PU,0) * NVL(vd.remise,0) / 100) + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.remiseArbiochem,0)))) * NVL(vd.ristourne,0) / 100)
                + (NVL(vd.QTE,0) * NVL(vd.ristourneArbiochem,0))
         ) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantristourne

FROM PROFORMA_DETAILS vd
         LEFT JOIN PROFORMA v ON v.ID = vd.IDPROFORMA
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing ON ing.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY v.id, v.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION
ORDER BY v.id ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROFORMA_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "CODECLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "ADRESSE", "CONTACT", "POIDSTOTAL", "MONTANT", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANTRISTOURNE", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "FRAISTRANSPORT", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "IDORIGINE", "REMISE", "NUMEROPROFORMA", "IDCOMMANDE", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "REFERENCE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS SELECT V.ID, V.DESIGNATION, V.IDMAGASIN, M.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, V.DATY, V.REMARQUE, V.ETAT, CASE WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉ' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 12 THEN 'CLÔTURÉ' END AS ETATLIB, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.CODECLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, C.ADRESSE, C.TELEPHONE AS CONTACT, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS POIDSTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANT, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(V2.MONTANTRISTOURNE AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRISTOURNE, CAST(NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, CAST(V2.FRAIS AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS FRAISTRANSPORT, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(0 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS MONTANTRESTE, 0 AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((COALESCE(V2.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) - COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSS FROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID ;

COALESCE(V2.MONTANTREVIENT, 0)) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, V.IDORIGINE, NVL(V.REMISE, 0) AS REMISE, V.NUMEROPROFORMA, V.IDCOMMANDE, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, V.LIEULIVRAISON AS LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON AS DATELIVRAISON, V.REFERENCE, ( V.ID || ' | ' || NUMEROPROFORMA || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || M.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSSFROM PROFORMA V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN PROFORMAMONTANTLEGER2 V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."PROGRAMMEZOOTECHNIQUEDT_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "AGE", "IDSEXE", "ALIMENT", "POIDS", "MORTALITE", "PONTEHEBDOMADAIRE", "PONTECUMULEE", "OEUFCUMULE", "OACPOURCENTAGE", "OACHH", "POIDSOEUF", "TAUXECLOSION", "POUSSINS", "CONSOALIMENTFEMELLE", "FEMELLEBW", "MALEBW", "RATIOPRODUCTION", "FERTILITE", "IDSEXELIB", "CONSOMMATIONEAU", "TEMPERATUREMIN", "TEMPERATUREMAX", "HUMIDITEMIN", "HUMIDITEMAX", "DUREEECLAIRAGE", "UNIFORMITECIBLE", "CVMAX") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENTTRAVAUX" ("ID", "IDTRAVAUX", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS", "DUREEREEL_HMS", "ECART_HMS", "DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE", "DUREEREEL_SECONDE", "ECART_SECONDE", "MONTANTESTIMATIF", "MONTANTREEL", "MONTANTECART", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDTRAVAUX,SQ.IDPERSONNEL,SQ.IDPERSONNELLIB,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS,SQ.DUREEREEL_HMS,SQ.ECART_HMS,SQ.DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE,SQ.DUREEREEL_SECONDE,SQ.ECART_SECONDE,SQ.MONTANTESTIMATIF,SQ.MONTANTREEL,SQ.MONTANTECART,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDTRAVAUX),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDPERSONNELLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_HMS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEESTIMATIF_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DUREEREEL_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECART_SECONDE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTESTIMATIF),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTREEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTECART),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         SELECT
	             '' AS ID,
	             mo.IDTRAVAUX,
	             mo.IDPERSONNEL,
	             mo.idPersonnelLib,
	             mo.dureeEstimatifLib AS dureeEstimatif_hms,
	             pr.dureeReelHMS AS dureeReel_hms,
	             -- Ecart HMS calcule avec ABS pour eviter le signe -
	             LPAD(FLOOR(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)) / 3600), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(FLOOR(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 3600) / 60), 2, '0') || ':' ||
	             LPAD(MOD(ABS(TO_NUMBER(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel)), 60), 2, '0')
	                 AS ecart_hms,
	             mo.DUREEESTIMATIF AS dureeEstimatif_seconde,
	             pr.dureeReel AS dureeReel_seconde,
	             -- Ecart Seconde en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.DUREEESTIMATIF - pr.dureeReel) AS ecart_seconde,
	             mo.montant AS montantEstimatif,
	             ((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE AS montantReel,
	             -- Ecart Montant en valeur absolue
	             ABS(mo.montant - (((pr.dureeReel/60)/60)*mo.TAUXHORAIRE)) AS montantEcart
	         FROM MOTRAVAUXLIB mo
	                  LEFT JOIN ProcessMaintenanceGlobal pr ON pr.IDPERSONNEL = mo.IDPERSONNEL AND pr.IDTRAVAUX = mo.IDTRAVAUX
	     ) SQ
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_BF_CLIENT" ("ID", "PRODUIT", "NUMBL", "QUANTITE", "IDVENTEDETAIL", "UNITE", "IDBC_FILLE", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDVENTE", "IDBC", "QTELIVREE", "QTERESTEALIVRER", "QTESORTIE", "RESTEASORTIR", "PU", "UNITELIB") AS 
  SELECT abcc.ID,
       abcc.PRODUIT,
       abcc.NUMBL,
       abcc.QUANTITE,
       abcc.IDVENTEDETAIL,
       abcc.UNITE,
       abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
       abcc.IDPRODUITLIB,
       abcc.IDVENTE,
       abcc.IDBC,
       abcc.QTELIVREE,
       abcc.QTERESTEALIVRER,
       nvl(m.qteSortie, 0)                 AS qteSortie,
       least(abcc.qtevente - nvl(m.qteSortie, 0), abcc.QUANTITE) AS resteASortir,
       abcc.pu,
       au.val AS unitelib
FROM AS_BONLIVRFILLE_CLIENT_CPL abcc
         LEFT JOIN SORTIEPRODUITparventegrp m ON m.idproduit = abcc.produit and m.IDVENTE = abcc.idvente
         LEFT JOIN MVTSTOCK mv ON mv.idobjet = abcc.numbl
         LEFT JOIN as_unite au ON au.id = abcc.UNITE 
 
 ;

  SELECT
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,

    GROUP BY 
        abcc.ID,
        abcc.PRODUIT,
        abcc.NUMBL,
        abcc.QUANTITE,
        abcc.IDDETAILSFACTUREFOURNISSEUR,
        abcc.UNITE,
        abcc.IDBC_FILLE,
        abcc.REMARQUE,
        abcc.IDBC,
        abcc.DATY,
        abcc.ETAT,
        abcc.MAGASIN,
        abcc.PRODUITLIB,
        abcc.UNITELIB,
        abcc.MAGASINLIB,
        abcc.LIBELLEEXTACTE,
        abcc.pu,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RAPPROCHEMENT_COMPLET" ("IDMERE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDCATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "MONTANTSORTIE", "MONTTH", "ECART") AS 
  SELECT
    st.idmere,
    st.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieIngredient,
    st.idcategorieingredient,
    CAST(SUM(montantsortie) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantSortie,
    CAST(SUM(montth) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montth,
    CAST(SUM(montth)-SUM(montantsortie) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS ecart
FROM stockEtDepenseOfFabTheCat st
GROUP BY st.idmere, st.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, st.idcategorieingredient

UNION ALL

    'Charge personnelle' as CATEGORIE,

    hs.montantPersonnel AS montantSortie,

    -hs.montantPersonnel AS ecart
FROM HS_PAR_OF hs
 ;

       recap_sal_all.salaire_brut AS salaire_brut,
       recap_sal_all.irsa AS irsa,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_travailleur AS cnaps_travailleur,
       CAST(recap_sal_all.montant_net_payer AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montant_net_payer,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_employeur AS cnaps_employeur,
       recap_sal_all.cnaps_a_payer AS cnaps_a_payer,
       recap_sal_all.id
FROM recap_sal_all
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECAP_SAL_ALL" ("MOIS", "ANNEE", "SALAIRE", "INDEMNITE", "AVANTAGE_EN_NATURE", "SALAIRE_BRUT", "IRSA", "CNAPS_TRAVAILLEUR", "MONTANT_NET_PAYER", "CNAPS_EMPLOYEUR", "CNAPS_A_PAYER", "ID") AS 
  SELECT
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000041' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie IN ('PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001') THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS indemnite,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000201' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS avantage_en_nature,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PRUNI' THEN NVL(pegi.imposable, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS salaire_brut,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000141' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS irsa,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS cnaps_travailleur,

    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE
                       WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000210A' THEN NVL(pe.gain, 0)
                       ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS NUMBER(30, 2))  AS montant_net_payer,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 13, 2) AS cnaps_employeur,

    ROUND(SUM(CASE
                  WHEN pe.idelementpaie = 'PR000101' THEN NVL(pe.retenue, 0)
                  ELSE 0
        END) * 14, 2) AS cnaps_a_payer,
    pe.idedition AS id

FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_edition_gain_imp pegi
                   ON pe.idpersonnel = pegi.idpersonnel
                       AND pe.mois = pegi.mois
                       AND pe.annee = pegi.annee
                       AND pe.idelementpaie IN (
                                                'PR000041', 'PR000021', 'PR000061', 'PR000081', 'PR000001',
                                                'PR000201', 'PRUNI', 'PR000141', 'PR000101', 'PR000210A'
                           )
GROUP BY pe.annee, pe.mois, pe.IDEDITION
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONOACDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDLOT", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUF", "QTERECUS", "IDLOTLIB", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDQUALITETRIAGEOEUFLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECEPTIONOAC_LIB" ("ID", "DATERECEPTION", "DATEPONTE", "DATECOLLECTE", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTE", "HEUREDEPARTFERME", "HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR", "IDRESPONSABLE", "IDCHAMBREFROIDE", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE", "TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE", "IDPROVENANCE", "ETAT", "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB", "IDRESPONSABLELIB", "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT r."ID",       r."DATERECEPTION",       r."DATEPONTE",       r."DATECOLLECTE",       r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE",       r."HEUREDEPARTFERME",       r."HEUREARRIVEECOUVOIR",       r."IDRESPONSABLE",       r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE",       r."IDCHAUFFEUR",       r."IDVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMINVEHICULE",       r."TEMPERATUREMAXVEHICULE",       r."IDPROVENANCE",       r."ETAT",       nc."VAL"                          AS "IDNUMEROCOLLECTELIB",       resp."NOM" || ' ' || resp."PRENOM" AS "IDRESPONSABLELIB",       cf."VAL"                          AS "IDCHAMBREFROIDELIB",       chf."NOM" || ' ' || chf."PRENOM"  AS "IDCHAUFFEURLIB",       v."VAL"                           AS "IDVEHICULELIB",       CASE r."ETAT"            WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'            WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'            WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'       END                                AS "ETATLIB"FROM "RECEPTIONOAC" r         LEFT JOIN "NUMEROCOLLECTE" nc ON nc."ID" = r."IDNUMEROCOLLECTE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" resp ON resp."ID" = r."IDRESPONSABLE"         LEFT JOIN "MAGASIN2" cf ON cf."ID" = r."IDCHAMBREFROIDE"         LEFT JOIN "LOG_PERSONNEL" chf ON chf."ID" = r."IDCHAUFFEUR"         LEFT JOIN "VEHICULE" v ON v."ID" = r."IDVEHICULE" WHERE r.IDPROVENANCE IS NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RECLAMATIONLIB" ("ID", "IDVENTEFILLE", "DATY", "IDTYPE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDTYPELIB", "IDVENTE", "QTE") AS

    r.ID,

    r.daty,

    r.etat,

    CASE r.etat
        WHEN 1  THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Valide'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Cloture'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Rejete'
        ELSE 'Autre'
        END AS etatLib,

    tr.VAL AS idTypeLib,
    vd.IDVENTE,
    r.qte
FROM reclamation r

                   ON tr.ID = r.idType

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVECLIENT" ("ID", "JOURNAL", "REFERENCE", "DATY", "LIBELLE", "LETTRE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "IDCLIENT", "CLIENTLIB", "COMPTE", "UPDATED_AT", "SOLDE", "ANNEE", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.JOURNAL,
       SQ.REFERENCE,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.LIBELLE,
       SQ.LETTRE,
       CAST(SQ.DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS DEBIT,
       CAST(SQ.CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS CREDIT,
       SQ.IDCLIENT,
       SQ.CLIENTLIB,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.UPDATED_AT,
       CAST(SQ.SOLDE AS NUMBER(30, 5))  AS SOLDE,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       (
           ID || ' | ' || JOURNAL || ' | ' || REFERENCE || ' | ' || CLIENTLIB || ' | ' || LIBELLE || ' | ' || LETTRE
           )                            AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (SELECT RELEVER.ID,
             RELEVER.JOURNAL,
             RELEVER.REFERENCE,
             RELEVER.DATY,
             RELEVER.LIBELLE,
             RELEVER.LETTRE,
             RELEVER.DEBIT,
             RELEVER.CREDIT,
             RELEVER.IDCLIENT,
             T.NOM                           AS CLIENTLIB,
             NVL(RELEVER.COMPTE, T.COMPTE)   AS COMPTE,
             RELEVER.UPDATED_AT,
             RELEVER.SOLDE,
             EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RELEVER.DATY) AS ANNEE,

             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY RELEVER.ID, RELEVER.JOURNAL, RELEVER.REFERENCE, RELEVER.DATY
                 ORDER BY
                     CASE
                         WHEN RELEVER.LETTRE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(RELEVER.LETTRE) IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                         ELSE 1
                         END
                 )                           AS RN

      FROM (

               /* NOTE DE CREDIT / AVOIR CLIENT */
               SELECT AV.ID                        AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')           AS JOURNAL,
                      AV.ID                        AS REFERENCE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS DATY,
                      'NOTE DE CREDIT : ' || AV.ID AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')          AS LETTRE,
                      0                            AS DEBIT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR              AS CREDIT,
                      AV.IDCLIENT                  AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                  AS COMPTE,
                      AV.DATY                      AS UPDATED_AT,
                      AV.MONTANTTTCAR * -1         AS SOLDE
               FROM AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_VISEE AV
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = AV.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* FACTURE / VENTE CLIENT */
               SELECT MCD.ID                            AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')                AS JOURNAL,
                      MCD.NUMEROFACTURE                 AS REFERENCE,
                      MCD.DATY                          AS DATY,
                      NVL(MCD.REFERENCES_PAIEMENT, ' ') AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')               AS LETTRE,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS DEBIT,
                      0                                 AS CREDIT,
                      MCD.IDCLIENT                      AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE                       AS COMPTE,
                      MCD.UPDATED_AT                    AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MCD.MONTANTTTCAR                  AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSE_DETAIL_UNIQUE MCD
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MCD.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MCD.ETAT >= 7
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%'

               UNION ALL

               /* REGLEMENT CLIENT */
               SELECT MC.ID                   AS ID,
                      NVL(CJ.DESCE, ' ')      AS JOURNAL,
                      MC.ID                   AS REFERENCE,
                      MC.DATYCOMPTABILISATION AS DATY,
                      MC.DESIGNATION          AS LIBELLE,
                      NVL(CL.LETTRE, ' ')     AS LETTRE,
                      0                       AS DEBIT,
                      MC.CREDIT               AS CREDIT,
                      MC.IDTIERS              AS IDCLIENT,
                      SOUS.COMPTE             AS COMPTE,
                      MC.UPDATED_AT           AS UPDATED_AT,
                      MC.CREDIT * -1          AS SOLDE
               FROM MOUVEMENTCAISSECPL MC
                        JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE ECR ON ECR.IDOBJET = MC.ID
                        JOIN COMPTA_SOUS_ECRITURE SOUS ON SOUS.IDMERE = ECR.ID
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_LETTRAGE CL ON CL.ID = SOUS.LETTRAGE
                        LEFT JOIN COMPTA_JOURNAL CJ ON CJ.ID = SOUS.JOURNAL
               WHERE MC.ETAT > 8
                 AND SOUS.COMPTE LIKE '411%') RELEVER
               LEFT JOIN TIERS T ON T.ID = RELEVER.IDCLIENT) SQ
WHERE SQ.RN = 1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILNR" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATYVALEUR", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE") AS 
  SELECT
    rd.ID,
    rd.DESIGNATION,
    rd.DEBIT,
    rd.CREDIT,
    rd.DATYVALEUR,
    r.IDCAISSE, cai.COMPTE
FROM RELEVERDETAIL rd
         JOIN RELEVER r ON r.ID = rd.IDMERE
         left join CAISSE cai on cai.id=r.IDCAISSE
WHERE
    r.ETAT >= 11
  AND rd.ID NOT IN (
    SELECT rpf.IDRELEVERDETAIL
    FROM RAPPROCHEMENTBC rpf join RAPPROCHEMENTBCMERE rp on rpf.idmere=rp.id
    WHERE rpf.IDRELEVERDETAIL IS NOT NULL AND rp.ETAT>=11
)
    
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVERDETAILNRMVT" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "DATYVALEUR", "IDCAISSE", "COMPTE", "MOUVEMENT") AS 
  SELECT
    ID,
    DESIGNATION,
    CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(32,2)) AS DEBIT,
    CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(32,2)) AS CREDIT,
    DATYVALEUR,
    IDCAISSE,
    COMPTE,
    CASE
        WHEN DEBIT > 0 THEN 1
        WHEN CREDIT > 0 THEN 2
        ELSE 0
        END AS MOUVEMENT
FROM RELEVERDETAILNR
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RELEVER_CLIENT_OPT" ("DATY", "COMPTE_AUX", "LIBELLE", "SOLDE_INITIAL", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "SOLDE_FINAL") AS

    0                        AS solde_initial,
    se.DEBIT                 AS debit,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMBOURSEMENTLIB" ("ID", "IDAVANCE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MONTANT", "REMARQUE", "DATY", "ETAT", "PERSONNEL", "TYPEAVANCELIB", "ETATLIB", "MATRICULE", "MOISLIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.IDAVANCE,SQ.MOIS,SQ.ANNEE,SQ.MONTANT,SQ.REMARQUE,SQ.DATY,SQ.ETAT,SQ.PERSONNEL,SQ.TYPEAVANCELIB,SQ.ETATLIB,SQ.MATRICULE,SQ.MOISLIB,
	  (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(IDAVANCE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOIS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANNEE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(REMARQUE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(DATY,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETAT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PERSONNEL),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(TYPEAVANCELIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ETATLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MATRICULE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOISLIB),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	  SELECT pr.id,
	       pr.idavance,
	       pr.mois,
	       pr.annee,
	       pr.montant,
	       pr.remarque,
	       pr.daty,
	       pr.etat,
	       lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom  AS personnel,
	       t.val AS typeavancelib,
	       CASE
	           WHEN pr.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
	           WHEN pr.etat = 11 THEN 'VALIDE'
	           ELSE NULL
	           END AS etatlib,
	       pip.matricule,
	       TO_CHAR(
	               TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(pr.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
	               'FMMonth',
	               'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'
	       ) AS moisLib
	FROM remboursement pr
	         LEFT JOIN avance a ON a.id = pr.idavance
	         LEFT JOIN typeavance t ON t.id = a.idtypeavance
	         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id = a.idpersonnel
	         LEFT JOIN log_personnel lp ON lp.id=a.idpersonnel
	 
	) SQ
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLELIB" ("ID", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDCATEGORIECLIENTLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDREMISE") AS 
  SELECT 
	rf.id,
	rf.remise,
	rf.idCategorieClient,
	tp.val AS idCategorieClientlib,
	rf.idProduit,
	ai.libelle,
	rf.cateGorieProduit,
	cti.val AS CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,
	rf.idPoint,
	p.val AS idPointLib,
	rf.idRemise

LEFT JOIN typeclient tp ON tp.id = rf.idCategorieClient
LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai ON ai.id = rf.idProduit
LEFT JOIN point p ON p.id = rf.idPoint
LEFT JOIN categorieingredient cti ON cti.id = rf.CATEGORIEPRODUIT

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISEFILLEMERELIB" ("IDMERE", "IDFILLE", "DATY", "NOM", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "REMISE", "IDCATEGORIECLIENT", "IDCATEGORIECLIENTLIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB") AS 
  SELECT 
r.id AS idmere,
rf.id AS idfille,
r.daty,
r.nom,
r.datedebut,
r.datefin,
r.etat,
rf.remise,
rf.idCategorieClient,
tp.val AS idCategorieClientLib,
rf.idProduit,
ai.libelle AS idProduitLib,
rf.cateGorieProduit,
cti.val AS cateGorieProduitLib,
rf.idPoint,
p.val AS idPointLib
FROM Remise r 
LEFT JOIN RemiseFille rf ON r.id = rf.idRemise
LEFT JOIN typeclient tp ON tp.id = rf.idCategorieClient
LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai ON ai.id = rf.idProduit

LEFT JOIN categorieingredient cti ON cti.id = rf.CATEGORIEPRODUIT

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REMISELIB" ("ID", "DATY", "NOM", "DATEDEBUT", "DATEFIN", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT
	rem.ID , 
	rem.DATY , 
	rem.NOM, 
	rem.DATEDEBUT , 
	rem.DATEFIN , 
	rem.ETAT,
	CASE
		WHEN rem.ETAT = 1
            THEN 'CRÉÉE'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_ANALYTIQUE" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "DATY", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS 
  SELECT
    COMPTE,
    LIBELLE,
    CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30,
                         2)),
    CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30,
                          2)),
    TYPECOMPTE,
    daty,
    CHIFFRE3,
    CHIFFRE2
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            cse.ANALYTIQUE AS COMPTE,
            cc.libelle,
            sum(cse.debit) AS DEBIT,
            sum(cse.credit) AS CREDIT,
            cc.typecompte,
            cse.daty,
            substr(analytique, 1, 3)|| substr(analytique, 5, 1) AS chiffre3,
            substr(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2) AS chiffre2
        FROM
            compta_sous_ecriture cse,
            compta_compte cc,
            compta_journal jrn
        WHERE
            cc.COMPTE = cse.ANALYTIQUE
          AND cse.etat = 11

            cc.libelle,

    )

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_AUX_V1" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "DATY", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS 
  SELECT
	COMPTE,
	LIBELLE,
	CAST(DEBIT AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS debit,
	CAST(CREDIT AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS credit,
	TYPECOMPTE,
	daty,
	CHIFFRE3,
	CHIFFRE2
FROM
	(
	SELECT
		t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE AS COMPTE,
		t.NOM AS LIBELLE,
		SUM(cse.debit) AS debit,
		SUM(cse.credit) AS credit,
		cc.typecompte,
		cse.daty,
		CASE
			WHEN SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
			ELSE SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 5, 1)
		END AS CHIFFRE3,
		SUBSTR(t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE, 1, 2) AS CHIFFRE2
	FROM
		compta_sous_ecriture cse
	JOIN compta_compte cc ON
		cc.COMPTE = cse.compte
	JOIN compta_journal jrn ON
		cse.JOURNAL = jrn.id
	JOIN TIERS t ON
		t.id = cse.COMPTE_AUX
	WHERE
		cse.etat = 11
	GROUP BY
		t.COMPTEAUXILIAIRE,
		t.NOM,
		cc.typecompte,
		cse.daty

    )
 
    ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_GENERAL" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."REPORTSOLDE_JANVIER" ("COMPTE", "LIBELLE_COMPTE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "TYPECOMPTE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "CHIFFRE3", "CHIFFRE2") AS 
  SELECT COMPTE,
       LIBELLE,
       CAST(sum(DEBIT) AS NUMBER(30, 2)),
       CAST(sum(CREDIT) AS NUMBER(30, 2)),
       TYPECOMPTE,
       MOIS,
       ANNEE,
       CHIFFRE3,
       CHIFFRE2
FROM (SELECT cse.COMPTE,
             cc.libelle,
             cse.debit,
             cse.credit,
             cc.typecompte,
             EXTRACT(MONTH from cse.daty)                                      AS MOIS,
             EXTRACT(YEAR from cse.daty)                                       AS ANNEE,
             CASE
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 3 THEN SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 3) || SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 5, 1)
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 1 AND SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 4) = '4007' THEN '407'
                 ELSE SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(CSE.COMPTE, 5, 1) END as chiffre3,
             substr(cse.compte, 1, 2)                                          as chiffre2
      from compta_sous_ecriture cse,
           compta_compte cc,
           compta_journal jrn
      where cc.COMPTE = cse.compte
        and cse.journal = 'COMP000015'
        AND cse.etat = 11
        AND jrn.id = cse.journal
      UNION
      SELECT cse.ANALYTIQUE,
             cc.libelle,
             cse.debit                                                                 as debit,
             cse.credit                                                                as credit,
             cc.typecompte,
             EXTRACT(MONTH from cse.daty),
             EXTRACT(YEAR from cse.daty),
             CASE
                 WHEN TYPECOMPTE = 3 THEN SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 3) || SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 5, 1)
                 ELSE SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2) || SUBSTR(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 5, 1) END as chiffre3,
             substr(cse.ANALYTIQUE, 1, 2)                                              as chiffre2
      from compta_sous_ecriture cse,
           compta_compte cc,
           compta_journal jrn
      where cc.COMPTE = cse.analytique
        and cse.journal = 'COMP000015'
        and cse.etat = 11
        and jrn.id = cse.journal)
group by COMPTE, LIBELLE, TYPECOMPTE, MOIS, ANNEE, CHIFFRE3, CHIFFRE2
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESERVATIONDETAILS_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "QTE", "DATY", "IDPRODUIT", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "CATEGORIEPRODUIT", "PU", "MONTANT", "TVA", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "HEURE") AS 
  SELECT
r.ID,
r.IDMERE,
r.QTE,
r.DATY,
r.IDPRODUIT,
ai.LIBELLE AS libelleproduit,
ai.idCATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieproduit,
r.PU,
r.QTE * r.PU AS  montant,
ai.tva as tva,
cast(r.qte*r.pu*(nvl(ai.tva,0)/100) as number(20,2)) as montantTva,
cast((r.QTE * r.PU)+(r.qte*r.pu*(nvl(ai.tva,0)/100)) as number(20,2)) as montantttc,
ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT AS categorieproduitlib,
r.heure AS heure

avg(r.PU) as pu,

avg(r.tva) as tva,

r.categorieproduitlib AS categorieproduitlib,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPOSTEDEFAUT", "IDRESSOURCE", "MATRICULE", "IDOF", "ETAT", "TEMPORAIRE", "IDQUALIFICATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDPOSTE", "IDPOSTELIB", "IDQUALIFICATIONEFFECTIVE", "TAUXHORAIRE", "HS", "MN", "JF", "HD", "IF", "ETATLIB", "IDRESSOURCELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    r.id,
    r.daty,
    r.idFabrication,
    r.idPoste AS idPosteDefaut,
    r.idRessource,
    p.matricule,
    f.IDOF,
    r.etat ,
    p.TEMPORAIRE,
    p.IDQUALIFICATION AS IdQualification,
    c.IDCATEGORIE,
    c.idPoste ,
    po.VAL AS idPostelib,
    p.IDQUALIFICATION AS IdQualificationEffective,
    CAST(c.montant/((40*52)/12) AS NUMBER(30,2) ) AS tauxhoraire,
    h.HS ,
    h.MN ,
    h.JF ,
    h.HD ,
    h.IF ,
    CASE
        WHEN r.etat = 0
            THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN r.etat = 1
            THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN r.etat = 11
            THEN 'VISEE'
        END AS etatlib,
    p.MATRICULE AS idRessourcelib
FROM ressourceParFabrication r
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL p ON p.id = r.idRessource
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_QUALIFICATION c
                   ON c.IDQUALIFICATION = r.IDQUALIFICATION
                       AND c.IDCATEGORIE = p.IDCATEGORIE
                       AND (
                          (c.REMARQUE IS NULL)
                              OR (c.REMARQUE = r.IDRESSOURCE)
                          ) AND c.etat = 1
         LEFT JOIN FABRICATION f ON f.id = r.idFabrication
         LEFT JOIN heureSupFabrication h ON h.idRessParFab = r.id
         LEFT JOIN POSTE po ON po.id =  c.idPoste


 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESSOURCEPARFAB_CPL_RECTIF" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPOSTEDEFAUT", "IDRESSOURCE", "MATRICULE", "IDPOSTE", "IDPOSTELIB", "ETATLIB") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RESULTATFABRICATION" ("ID", "IDOFFILLE", "IDFABRICATION", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "IDINGREDIENTS", "QTEINGREDIENTS", "IDLIGNE", "DATY", "ENTREEDECHET") AS

    OFF.QTE AS QTE,
    FF.IDINGREDIENTS,

    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ENTREE)
              FROM MVTSTFILLEFABCATVISEGROUPE WHERE IDFAB = F.ID AND ENTREE > 0 and CATEGORIEINGREDIENT ='Dechets'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RETRAIT_FRAIS_MEDICAUX_ANALYSE" ("DIRECTION", "DIRECTIONLIB", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "DATEVAL", "DATEDESC", "DATELIB", "GAIN", "DEPENSE") AS 
  SELECT
    ld.id AS direction,
    ld.val AS directionlib,
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN TO_DATE('01-12-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        ELSE TO_DATE('01-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') || '-' || pe.annee, 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        END AS dateval,
    pe.annee || '-' || LPAD(pe.mois, 2, '0') AS datedesc,
    CASE
        WHEN pe.mois = 1 THEN 'Janvier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
        WHEN pe.mois = 3 THEN 'Mars'
        WHEN pe.mois = 4 THEN 'Avril'
        WHEN pe.mois = 5 THEN 'Mai'
        WHEN pe.mois = 6 THEN 'Juin'
        WHEN pe.mois = 7 THEN 'Juillet'
        WHEN pe.mois = 8 THEN 'Aout'
        WHEN pe.mois = 9 THEN 'Septembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 10 THEN 'Octobre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 11 THEN 'Novembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 12 THEN 'Decembre'
        WHEN pe.mois = 13 THEN '13 eme'
        ELSE NULL
        END || '-' || pe.annee AS datelib,
    SUM(pe.gain) AS gain,
    NVL(SUM(rf.montant), 0) AS depense
FROM paie_edition pe
         LEFT JOIN paie_info_personnel_libcomplet pf ON pf.id = pe.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id = pf.direction
         LEFT JOIN retrait_frais_medicaux rf
                   ON pe.mois = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM rf.daty)
                       AND pe.annee = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rf.daty)
                       AND rf.etat >= 11
WHERE pe.idelementpaie NOT LIKE '%PR000FRM%'
GROUP BY
    pe.mois,
    pe.annee,
    ld.id,
    ld.val
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."RETRAIT_FRAIS_MEDICAUX_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDPERSONNEL", "DESCRIPTION", "MONTANT", "ETAT", "IDPERSONNELLIB", "ETATLIB", "MATRICULE") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATIONDEMANDE" ("ID", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDTYPEDEMANDE", "TITRE", "HORAIRENORMAL", "HEUREDEPART", "HEUREARRIVE", "IDTYPEABSENCE", "MOTIF", "NUMERO", "DESCE", "ETAT", "DATY", "DUREE", "DATEDEPART", "DATERETOUR", "OBSERVATION", "REMARQUE", "DATEHISTORIQUE", "HEUREHISTORIQUE", "VALETATHIERARCHIE", "RANG") AS 
  SELECT d.id,
       d.idpersonnel,
       d.idtypedemande,
       d.titre,
       d.horairenormal,
       d.heuredepart,
       d.heurearrive,

       BC.QUANTITE - nvl(AB.qte_livre,0) AS QTE_reste

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_DEPENSES" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,SQ.COMPTE,SQ.SERVICE,SQ.MOIS,SQ.ANNEE,SQ.MOISLIB,SQ.BUDGET,SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,SQ.PAIEMENT,SQ.RESTEAPAYER,SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT,
	       (NVL(TO_CHAR(ID),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(COMPTE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(SERVICE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOIS),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ANNEE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MOISLIB),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(BUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(MONTANTFACTURE),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(PAIEMENT),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(RESTEAPAYER),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTFACTUREBUDGET),'') || ' | ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT),'')) AS MOTSCLESSS
	FROM (
	         select
	             '-' as id,
	             bdsv.COMPTE,
	             IDSERVICELIB as service,
	             bdsv.mois,
	             bdsv.annee,
	             bdsv.moislib,
	             bdsv.depenses as budget,
	             ffc.montant as montantfacture,
	             ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
	             ffc.resteapayer,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
	             bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
	         from budget_depense_sum_view bdsv
	                  left join (
	             select
	                 SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
	                 mois,
	                 annee,
	                 SERVICE,
	                 sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
	                 sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
	                 sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
	             from facturefournisseurfille_paye ffp
	                      cross join (select distinct COMPTE from budget_depense_sum_view_budget) bdsv_inner
	             where SUBSTR(ffp.compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
	             group by SUBSTR(compteregr, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee, SERVICE
	         ) ffc
	                            on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
	                                and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
	                                and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
	                                and ffc.SERVICE = bdsv.SERVICE
	     ) SQ
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_BUDGET_RECETTES" ("ID", "COMPTE", "SERVICE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "MOISLIB", "BUDGET", "MONTANTFACTURE", "PAIEMENT", "RESTEAPAYER", "ECARTFACTUREBUDGET", "ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.COMPTE,
       SQ.SERVICE,
       SQ.MOIS,
       SQ.ANNEE,
       SQ.MOISLIB,
       SQ.BUDGET,
       SQ.MONTANTFACTURE,
       SQ.PAIEMENT,
       SQ.RESTEAPAYER,
       SQ.ECARTFACTUREBUDGET,
       SQ.ECARTBUDGETPAIEMENT
FROM (
  select
    '-' as id,
    bdsv.COMPTE,
    IDSERVICELIB as service,
    bdsv.mois,
    bdsv.annee,
    bdsv.moislib,
    bdsv.depenses as budget,
    ffc.montant as montantfacture,
    ffc.montantpaye as paiement,
    ffc.resteapayer,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montant as ecartfacturebudget,
    bdsv.depenses - ffc.montantpaye as ecartbudgetpaiement
from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW bdsv
    left join (
        select
            SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) as compteregr_groupe,
            mois,
            annee,
            sum(montantfille * TAUXDECHANGE)     as montant,
            sum(MontantFillePaye * TAUXDECHANGE) as montantpaye,
            sum(resteapayerfille * TAUXDECHANGE) as resteapayer
        from VENTE_DETAILS_PAYE ffp
        cross join (select distinct COMPTE from BUDGET_RECETTE_SUM_VIEW) bdsv_inner
        where SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)) = bdsv_inner.COMPTE
        group by SUBSTR(ffp.compte, 1, LENGTH(bdsv_inner.COMPTE)), mois, annee
    ) ffc
    on ffc.compteregr_groupe like bdsv.COMPTE||'%'
        and ffc.mois = bdsv.mois
        and ffc.annee = bdsv.annee
) SQ
 ;

  SELECT
    idpersonnel,
    idedition,
    mois,
    annee,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000130'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp30ni,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000130I' THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp30i,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000150'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp50ni,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000150I'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS heuresupp50i,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000221' THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majnuit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000222'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majferie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR0000223'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS majweekend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IDELEMENTPAIE = 'PR000181'  THEN gain ELSE 0 END) AS abbatement
FROM PAIE_EDITION pe
GROUP BY

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SITUATION_SALAIRE_COMPLET" ("MATRICULE", "NOM", "ID", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "IDEDITION", "SALAIRE", "HS_M", "INDEM", "ANCIEN", "PRIME", "AUTRES", "TOTAL", "CNAPS", "OSTIE", "IRSA_E", "IRSA_S", "AV_SPE", "AUTRES2", "A_PAYER", "HEURESUPP30NI", "HEURESUPP30I", "HEURESUPP50NI", "HEURESUPP50I", "MAJNUIT", "MAJFERIE", "MAJWEEKEND", "ABBATEMENT", "MOISLIB") AS 
  SELECT se.MATRICULE,se.NOM,(se.ID||'//'||sa.idedition) AS id,se.MOIS,se.ANNEE,se.IDEDITION,se.SALAIRE,se.HS_M,se.INDEM,se.ANCIEN,se.PRIME,se.AUTRES,se.TOTAL,se.CNAPS,se.OSTIE,se.IRSA_E,se.IRSA_S,se.AV_SPE,se.AUTRES2,se.A_PAYER,sa.heuresupp30ni,heuresupp30i,heuresupp50ni,heuresupp50i,majnuit,majferie,majweekend,abbatement,
	       CASE se.MOIS
	           WHEN 1 THEN 'Janvier'
	           WHEN 2 THEN 'Fevrier'
	           WHEN 3 THEN 'Mars'
	           WHEN 4 THEN 'Avril'
	           WHEN 5 THEN 'Mai'
	           WHEN 6 THEN 'Juin'
	           WHEN 7 THEN 'Juillet'
	           WHEN 8 THEN 'Aout'
	           WHEN 9 THEN 'Septembre'
	           WHEN 10 THEN 'Octobre'
	           WHEN 11 THEN 'Novembre'
	           WHEN 12 THEN 'Decembre'
	           END AS MOISLIB

	         LEFT JOIN SITUATION_SALAIRE_AUTRE sa
	                   ON se.idedition =sa.idedition
	                       AND se.id = sa.idpersonnel

         GROUP BY
             idpersonnel,
             mois,
             annee) net_a_payer
                   ON
                       net_a_payer.idpersonnel = lp.id
                           AND net_a_payer.annee = pe.annee
                           AND net_a_payer.mois = pe.mois
         LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
             idpersonnel,
             sum(gain) AS gain,
             mois,
             annee
         FROM
             paie_edition pe
         WHERE
             (regroupement != 100
                 OR regroupement IS NULL)
         GROUP BY
             idpersonnel,
             mois,
             annee) salaire_brute
                   ON
                       salaire_brute.idpersonnel = lp.id
                           AND salaire_brute.annee = pe.annee
                           AND salaire_brute.mois = pe.mois
         LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
             idpersonnel,
             sum(retenue) AS retenue,
             mois,
             annee
         FROM
             paie_edition pe
         GROUP BY
             idpersonnel,
             mois,
             annee) total_retenue
                   ON
                       total_retenue.idpersonnel = lp.id
                           AND total_retenue.annee = pe.annee
                           AND total_retenue.mois = pe.mois
         LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
             idpersonnel,
             sum(gain) AS gain,
             mois,
             annee
         FROM
             paie_edition pe,
             paie_rubrique pr
         WHERE
             pr.id = pe.idelementpaie
           AND pr.imposable = 'I'
         GROUP BY
             idpersonnel,
             mois,
             annee) montant_brute_imposable
                   ON
                       montant_brute_imposable.idpersonnel = lp.id
                           AND montant_brute_imposable.annee = pe.annee
                           AND montant_brute_imposable.mois = pe.mois
         LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
             idpersonnel,
             sum(gain) AS gain,
             mois,
             annee
         FROM
             PAIE_EDITION_LIBCOMPLET pe
         WHERE
             CODERUBRIQUE IN ('205')
         GROUP BY
             idpersonnel,
             mois,
             annee) indemnite_logement
                   ON
                       indemnite_logement.idpersonnel = lp.id
                           AND indemnite_logement.annee = pe.annee
                           AND indemnite_logement.mois = pe.mois
GROUP BY
    lp.ID,
    lpad(pe.MATRICULE, 5, '0'),
    pc.id,
    trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.NOM),
    trim(TRAILING ' ' FROM lp.PRENOM),
    lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM ,
    pf.DESCE,
    pf.id,
    pc.VAL ,
    ld.ID,
    ld.VAL,
    ls.ID,
    ls.CODE_SERVICE,
    ls.LIBELLE,
    pe.temporaire,
    nvl(SALAIREDEBASE.salairedebase, 0),

    pip.id,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(mvt.plus, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congedroit,
    CAST(SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0)) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS congepris,
    CAST(
            SUM(NVL(mvt.plus, 0)) - SUM(NVL(mvt.moins, 0))
        AS NUMBER(30,2)
    ) AS congereste,
    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,

    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL AS IDDEPARTEMENTLib
FROM PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTABSENCE mvt
                   ON mvt.IDPERSONNEL = pip.id
                       AND mvt.IDTYPE = 'TYP000004'
         LEFT JOIN log_personnel_v log
                   ON log.id = pip.id

                   ON dep.id = pip.IDDEPARTEMENT
GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    log.NOM,
    log.PRENOM,
    pip.MATRICULE,
    pip.IDDEPARTEMENT,
    dep.VAL
 ;

    pip.MATRICULE,

         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTABSENCE mvt

         LEFT JOIN log_personnel_v log

GROUP BY
    pip.id,
    mvt.ANNEE,

    dep.VAL
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STAT_DEPENSE_CAT" ("DATY", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB", "MOISINT", "MOISSTRING", "ANNEE", "DEPENSE") AS 
  SELECT
	    ffc.daty,
	    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT ,
	    cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB,
	    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ffc.daty) as MOISINT,
	    TRIM(TO_CHAR(ffc.daty, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH')) AS MOISSTRING,
	    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ffc.daty) as ANNEE,
	    CAST(sum(ffc.montant) / 1000000 AS NUMERIC(30,2)) AS depense
	FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLECPL  ffc
	         JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR fc on fc.id = ffc.idfacturefournisseur and etat >= 11
	         JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON ffc.IDPRODUIT = ai.id
	         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT  = cat.id
	GROUP BY
	    ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
	    ffc.daty,
	    cat.val
	ORDER BY ANNEE, MOISINT
 ;

	EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY) AS moisInt,
	TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS mois,
	ff.idproduit AS id,
	ai.LIBELLE AS designation,
	CAST(nvl(sum(ff.qte*ff.pu),0) AS NUMBER(30,5))  AS depense
FROM 
FACTUREFOURNISSEURFILLE ff
LEFT JOIN FACTUREFOURNISSEUR f 
ON f.ID = ff.IDFACTUREFOURNISSEUR 
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai 
ON ai.ID = ff.idproduit
WHERE f.etat >=11
GROUP BY 
	ff.idproduit, 
	ai.LIBELLE,
	EXTRACT (YEAR FROM f.DATY),
	EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY),
	TO_CHAR(f.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH')
ORDER BY EXTRACT (MONTH FROM f.DATY) asc
 
 ;

  select idobjet,IDPRODUIT,cast(entree as number(30,5)) as entree,cast(sortie as number(30,5)) as sortie,cast(pu as number(30,5)) as pu,
       cast(montantentree as number(30,5)) as montantentree,cast(montantsortie as number(30,5)) as montantsortie,IDMERE,id, CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from STOCKETDEPENSEFABNC
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STOCKETDEPENSEFABNC" ("IDOBJET", "IDPRODUIT", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "IDMERE", "ID", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB") AS 
  select mvt.IDOBJET, fille.IDPRODUIT,cast(sum(ENTREE) as number(15,2)) as entree, cast(sum(SORTIE) as number(15,2)) as sortie, cast(avg(fille.pu) as number(30,2)) as pu,
cast(nvl(avg(fille.pu)*sum(entree),0) as number(30,3)) as montantentree,cast(nvl(avg(fille.pu)*sum(sortie),0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie,ofille.IDMERE,ofille.id, cat.id AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from MVTSTOCKFILLE fille
left join MvtStockLib mvt on fille.IDMVTSTOCK=mvt.ID
left join FABRICATION fab on mvt.IDOBJET=fab.ID
left join OFFILLE ofille on fab.IDOFFILLE=ofille.ID
left join AS_INGREDIENTS ai on fille.IDPRODUIT=ai.id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON cat.id = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT 
where mvt.ETAT>=11  and ai.COMPOSE=0
group by fille.IDPRODUIT,mvt.IDOBJET,ofille.IDMERE,ofille.id,ai.COMPOSE, cat.id, cat.val
union all
select c.IDFABRICATION as idobjet,c.IDINGREDIENTS as IDPRODUIT,cast(0 as number(15,2)) as entree,cast(1 as number (15,2)) as sortie,cast(c.montant as number(30,2)) as pu,cast(0 as number(30,3)) as montantentree,cast(nvl(sum(c.montant),0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie
,ofile.IDMERE,ofile.id, cat.id AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENT, cat.val AS CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from chargemontant c
left join fabrication fabb on c.IDFABRICATION=fabb.id
left join OFFILLE ofile on fabb.IDOFFILLE=ofile.ID
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai ON c.IDINGREDIENTS = ai.id
LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON cat.id = ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT 
where c.etat>=11 group by c.IDFABRICATION, c.IDINGREDIENTS,ofile.IDMERE,ofile.id, cat.id, cat.val,c.montant
UNION all
select 
    rsfab.IDFABRICATION as idobjet,
    'IG000364' as IDPRODUIT,
    cast(0 as number(15,2)) as entree,
    CAST(
        NVL(
            CASE 
                WHEN h.TEMPORAIRE = 0 THEN h.MN + h.JF + h.HD + h.IF + h.HEURENORMALE
                ELSE h.HS + h.MN + h.JF + h.HD + h.IF
            END,
        0) AS NUMBER(15,2)
    ) AS sortie,
    cast(rsfab.TAUXHORAIRE as number(30,2)) as pu,
    cast(0 as number(30,3)) as montantentree,
    cast(nvl(h.MONTANT, 0) as number(30,3)) as montantsortie,
    off.IDMERE,
    off.ID,
    'CATING000001' as CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,
    'Charge personnelle' as CATEGORIEINGREDIENTLIB
from HEURESUPFABRICATION h
left join RESSOURCEPARFABRICATIONCOMPLET rsfab ON rsfab.IDRESSOURCE = h.IDRESSPARFAB
left join FABRICATION f on rsfab.idfabrication = f.ID
left join OFFILLE off on f.IDOFFILLE = off.ID
where h.ETAT >= 11 

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."STOCKETDEPENSEFABTHE" ("IDOBJET", "IDPRODUIT", "DESIGNATION", "ENTREE", "SORTIE", "PU", "MONTANTENTREE", "MONTANTSORTIE", "IDMERE", "ID", "QTETH", "PUTH", "MONTTH", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT") AS 
  SELECT
    sed.IDOBJET,
    sed.IDPRODUIT,
    ai.libelle AS designation,
    cast(sed.ENTREE as number(30,5)) as entree ,
    cast(sed.SORTIE as number(30,5)) as sortie,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0)
                END
        as number(30,2)) AS PU,
    cast(sed.MONTANTENTREE as number(30,5)) as MONTANTENTREE,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu * sed.SORTIE
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0) * sed.SORTIE
                END
        as number(30,2)) as MONTANTSORTIE ,
    sed.IDMERE,
    sed.ID,
    CAST(nvl(recFab.QUANTITE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,
                                           10)) AS qteTh,
    CAST(nvl(recFab.QTEAV, sed.pu) AS NUMBER(30,
                                             5)) AS puth,
    CAST(nvl(recFab.QUANTITE, 0)* nvl(recFab.QTEAV, 0) AS NUMBER(30,
                                                                 5)) AS montTh,
    recFab.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT
FROM
    stockEtDepenseFab sed
        FULL OUTER JOIN as_recFabLibGroupe recFab
                        ON
                            sed.IDOBJET = recFab.IDPRODUITS
                                AND sed.IDPRODUIT = recFab.IDINGREDIENTS 
        LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai ON ai.id = sed.idproduit
 
 ;

    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0)
                END
        as number(30,2)) AS PU,
    CAST(sed."MONTANENTREE" as number(30,5)) AS MONTANENTREE ,
    CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN nvl(sed."PU",0) = 0 THEN recFab.pu * sed."SORTIE"
                ELSE nvl(sed."PU",0) * sed."SORTIE"
                END
        as number(30,2))  AS MONTANTSORTIE,

  select ar.id,
       ar.code,
       ar.designation,
       ar.seuil,
       uni.val as unite,
       ar.presentation,
       ta.VAL        as type,
       ga.VAL        as groupee,
       sga.VAL       as sousgroupe,
       ar.classee,
       ar.codemnemonique,
       ar.PUGROS,
       ar.PUDONATION

         left join ST_TYPE_ARTICLE ta on ta.id = ar.TYPE
         left join ST_GROUPE_ARTICLE ga on ga.id = ar.GROUPEE
         left join ST_SOUSGROUPE_ARTICLE sga on sga.id = ar.SOUSGROUPE
         left join st_unite uni on ar.UNITE = uni.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ST_INGREDIENTSAUTO" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "COMPTE", "UNITELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    ai.ID,ai.LIBELLE,CAST(ai.SEUIL AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS SEUIL ,au.val AS UNITE,CAST(ai.QUANTITEPARPACK AS NUMBER(10,5)) AS QUANTITEPARPACK,CAST(ai.PU AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PU,ai.ACTIF,ai.PHOTO,ai.CALORIE,ai.DURRE,ai.COMPOSE,ai.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT,ai.IDFOURNISSEUR,ai.DATY,CAST(ai.QTELIMITE AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS QTELIMITE,CAST(ai.PV AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PV,ai.LIBELLEVENTE,CAST(COALESCE(ai.SEUILMIN,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMIN,CAST(COALESCE(ai.SEUILMAX,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS SEUILMAX,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUACHATUSD,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATUSD,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUACHATEURO,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATEURO,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUACHATAUTREDEVISE,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUVENTEUSD,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEUSD,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUVENTEEURO,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEEURO,CAST(COALESCE(ai.PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE,0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE,ai.ISVENTE,ai.ISACHAT,ai.COMPTE_VENTE,ai.COMPTE_ACHAT,
    CASE
        WHEN ai.COMPTE_VENTE IS NOT NULL THEN ai.COMPTE_VENTE
        ELSE ai.COMPTE_ACHAT
    END AS compte,
    au.VAL AS UNITELIB
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS ai
LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au  ON au.id = ai.UNITE 
 WHERE ai.actif = 1
 ;

    ai."ID",ai."LIBELLE",ai."SEUIL",ai."UNITE",ai."QUANTITEPARPACK",ai."PU",ai."ACTIF",ai."PHOTO",ai."CALORIE",ai."DURRE",ai."COMPOSE",ai."CATEGORIEINGREDIENT",ai."IDFOURNISSEUR",ai."DATY",ai."QTELIMITE",ai."PV",ai."LIBELLEVENTE",ai."SEUILMIN",ai."SEUILMAX",ai."PUACHATUSD",ai."PUACHATEURO",ai."PUACHATAUTREDEVISE",ai."PUVENTEUSD",ai."PUVENTEEURO",ai."PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE",ai."ISVENTE",ai."ISACHAT",ai."COMPTE_VENTE",ai."COMPTE_ACHAT",
    CASE
        WHEN ai.COMPTE_VENTE IS NOT NULL THEN ai.COMPTE_VENTE
        ELSE ai.COMPTE_ACHAT
    END AS compte
FROM AS_INGREDIENTS ai where ai.pv>0
and CATEGORIEINGREDIENT='CAT002'
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."ST_INGREDIENTSVENTEPOS" ("ID", "LIBELLE", "SEUIL", "UNITE", "QUANTITEPARPACK", "PU", "ACTIF", "PHOTO", "CALORIE", "DURRE", "COMPOSE", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENT", "IDFOURNISSEUR", "DATY", "QTELIMITE", "PV", "LIBELLEVENTE", "SEUILMIN", "SEUILMAX", "PUACHATUSD", "PUACHATEURO", "PUACHATAUTREDEVISE", "PUVENTEUSD", "PUVENTEEURO", "PUVENTEAUTREDEVISE", "ISVENTE", "ISACHAT", "COMPTE_VENTE", "COMPTE_ACHAT", "TVA", "TAUX", "COMPTE", "LIBELLECOMPOSANT", "COULEUR", "TAILLE", "CODEBARRE", "REFERENCE", "CODEGROS", "PVGROS", "UNITELIB", "DESIGNATION", "TYPESTOCK") AS

    ai.PU,
    ai.ACTIF,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVICHAMBREFROIDEDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDRESPONSABLE", "HEURE", "TEMPERATURE", "HUMIDITE", "REMARQUE", "IDRESPONSABLELIB") AS 
  SELECT
	scfd.id,
	scfd.idmere,
	scfd.idresponsable,
	scfd.heure,
	scfd.temperature,
	scfd.humidite,
	scfd.remarque,
	lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM AS idResponsableLib
FROM 
  suiviChambreFroideDetail scfd
LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp ON scfd.idresponsable = lp.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVICHAMBREFROIDE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUF", "IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUFLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
  SELECT 
	sqf.id,
	sqf.daty,
	sqf.IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUF,
	m.VAL AS idSalleStockageOeufLib,
	sqf.etat,
    CASE
        WHEN sqf.etat = 1 THEN 'CREE'
        WHEN sqf.etat = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
        WHEN sqf.etat = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
    END AS etatLib
FROM
	suiviChambreFroide sqf
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON sqf.IDSALLESTOCKAGEOEUF = m.ID ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVIJOURNALIERDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "AGEJOUR", "ENTREE", "TRI", "MORTALITE", "CULLS", "CONSIGNESURALIMENT", "EAU", "TEMPERATUREMIN", "TEMPERATUREMAX", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB") AS 
  SELECT d."ID",d."IDMERE",d."IDBATIMENT",d."IDPARQUET",d."AGEJOUR",d."ENTREE",d."TRI",d."MORTALITE",d."CULLS",d."CONSIGNESURALIMENT",d."EAU",d."TEMPERATUREMIN",d."TEMPERATUREMAX",       b."NOMBATIMENT" AS "IDBATIMENTLIB",       p."VAL" AS "IDPARQUETLIB"FROM "SUIVIJOURNALIERDETAIL" dLEFT JOIN "BATIMENT" b ON b."ID" = d."IDBATIMENT"LEFT JOIN "PARQUET" p ON p."ID" = d."IDPARQUET";

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVIJOURNALIER_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDFERME", "IDLOT", "IDFERMELIB", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
             WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'           WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'           WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'           END AS ETATLIBFROM SUIVIJOURNALIER s         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = s.IDFERME         LEFT JOIN LOT l ON l.ID = s.IDLOT         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE so ON so.id=l.idsouche;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVI_PRESENCE_FILLE_LIB" ("ID", "IDSUIVIPRESENCEMERE", "IDPARTICIPATIONFORMATION", "IDPERSONNEL", "IDACTIONFORMATION", "DATESEANCE", "PRESENCE", "NBHEUREEFFECTUE", "PERSONNELLIB", "MATRICULE", "CATEGORIEEMPLOYE", "ACTIONFORMATIONLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    spf.ID,spf.IDSUIVIPRESENCEMERE,spf.IDPARTICIPATIONFORMATION,spf.IDPERSONNEL,spf.IDACTIONFORMATION,spf.DATESEANCE,spf.PRESENCE,spf.NBHEUREEFFECTUE,
    lp.nom || ' ' || lp.prenom AS personnelLib,
    pip.matricule,
    cp.val AS categorieEmploye,
    af.intitule AS actionFormationLib
FROM SUIVI_PRESENCE_FILLE spf
         LEFT JOIN LOG_PERSONNEL lp
                   ON lp.id = spf.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN PAIE_INFO_PERSONNEL pip
                   ON pip.id = spf.idpersonnel
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIE_PAIE cp
                   ON pip.idcategorie_paie = cp.id
         LEFT JOIN ACTION_FORMATION af
                   ON af.id = spf.idactionformation
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUIVI_PRESENCE_MERE_LIB" ("ID", "IDSESSIONFORMATION", "SESSIONFORMATIONLIB", "DATY", "ACTIONFORMATIONLIB") AS

FROM SUIVI_PRESENCE_MERE spm
