CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_DAY" ("JOUR", "AVG_HS_PER_DAY", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    dateFabrication AS jour,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_day,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL
GROUP BY dateFabrication, IDDEPARTEMENT, departementLib
ORDER BY dateFabrication
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_MONTH" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "AVG_HS_PER_MONTH", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication) AS mois,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_month,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL
GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication),
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
ORDER BY annee, mois
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_MONTH_LIB" ("ANNEE", "MOIS", "MONTHLIB", "AVG_HS_PER_MONTH", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication) AS annee,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication) AS mois,
    TO_CHAR(dateFabrication, 'Month YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH') AS monthLib,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_month,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL
GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dateFabrication),
    TO_CHAR(dateFabrication, 'Month YYYY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'),
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
ORDER BY
    annee,
    mois
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."SUM_HS_YEAR" ("ANNEE", "AVG_HS_PER_YEAR", "IDDEPARTEMENT", "DEPARTEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication) AS annee,
    SUM(HS) AS avg_hs_per_year,
    IDDEPARTEMENT,
    departementLib
FROM HEURESUPFABRICATION_CPL
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dateFabrication),IDDEPARTEMENT,
         departementLib
ORDER BY annee
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TABLEAUBORDBC" ("PRODUIT", "MONTANT", "PU", "QUANTITE", "REMISE", "TVA", "UNITE", "QTEOF", "QTEOFRESTANTE", "QTEFAB", "QTEFABRESTANTE", "QTELIVRE", "QTENONLIVRE", "LIBELLEPRODUIT", "DATY") AS 
  SELECT
 	bcf.PRODUIT,
    CAST(avg(bcf.MONTANT) AS NUMBER(30,5))  as montant,
    CAST(avg(bcf.PU) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as pu,
    CAST(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) AS NUMBER(20,5)) as quantite,
    CAST(avg(bcf.REMISE) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as remise,
    CAST(avg(bcf.TVA) AS NUMBER(30,5)) as tva,
    ing.UNITE as unite,
    CAST(nvl(avg(o.QTE),0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEOF,
    CAST(NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(o.QTE),0), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEOFRESTANTE,

    CAST(nvl(avg(f.QTE),0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEFAB,
    CAST(NVL(sum(bcf.QUANTITE) - nvl(avg(f.QTE),0), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTEFABRESTANTE,

    CAST(AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE, 0)) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTELIVRE,
	CAST(NVL(avg(bcf.QUANTITE) - AVG(NVL(abcf.QUANTITE,0)), 0) AS NUMBER(20,5)) AS QTENONLIVRE,
	ing.LIBELLE as libelleProduit,
	bc.DATY 

FROM BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT_FILLE bcf

LEFT JOIN BONDECOMMANDE_CLIENT bc ON bc.ID = bcf.IDBC 

LEFT JOIN OfGroupByIdbc o ON o.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID


LEFT JOIN fabrGroupByIdbc f ON f.IDBCFILLE = bcf.ID

LEFT JOIN BLGroupByIdbc abcf ON abcf.IDBC_FILLE = bcf.ID

left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id=bcf.PRODUIT

GROUP BY
    bcf.PRODUIT,
    ing.LIBELLE, ing.UNITE,bc.DATY
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_LIB" ("ID", "IDTYPECLIENT", "IDINGREDIENT", "DATY", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT TI.ID,
       TI.IDTYPECLIENT,
       TI.IDINGREDIENT,
       TI.DATY,
       TI.PRIXUNITAIRE,
       T.VAL      AS IDTYPECLIENTLIB,
       AI.LIBELLE AS IDINGREDIENTLIB,
       TI.UNITE,
       U.VAL      AS UNITELIB,
       (
           TI.ID || ' | ' || T.VAL || ' | ' || AI.LIBELLE || ' | ' || U.VAL
           )      AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM TARIF_INGREDIENTS TI
         LEFT JOIN TYPECLIENT T
                   ON TI.IDTYPECLIENT = T.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS AI
                   ON TI.IDINGREDIENT = AI.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE U
                   ON U.ID = TI.UNITE

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN") AS 
  WITH ranked_tarifs AS (
    SELECT
        IDINGREDIENT,
        UNITE,
        IDTYPECLIENT,
        CAST(PRIXUNITAIRE AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS PRIXUNITAIRE,
        DATY,
        IDMAGASIN,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IDINGREDIENT, UNITE, IDTYPECLIENT, IDMAGASIN ORDER BY DATY DESC) as rn
    FROM TARIF_INGREDIENTS
)
SELECT
    IDINGREDIENT,
    UNITE,
    IDTYPECLIENT,
    PRIXUNITAIRE,
    DATY,
    IDMAGASIN
FROM ranked_tarifs
WHERE rn = 1
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_LIB" ("IDTYPECLIENT", "IDINGREDIENT", "DATY", "PRIXUNITAIRE", "IDTYPECLIENTLIB", "IDINGREDIENTLIB", "UNITE", "UNITELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    ti."IDTYPECLIENT",ti."IDINGREDIENT",ti."DATY",ti."PRIXUNITAIRE" ,
    t.VAL AS idtypeclientlib,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientlib,
    ti.UNITE,
    u.VAL as unitelib
FROM TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX ti
         LEFT JOIN TYPECLIENT t
                   ON ti.IDTYPECLIENT = t.ID
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ai
                   ON ti.IDINGREDIENT = ai.ID
         left join AS_UNITE u on u.id=ti.UNITE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_MN" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "PRIXUNITAIRE") AS 
  select timd."IDINGREDIENT",timd."UNITE",timd."IDTYPECLIENT",timd."DATY",timd."IDMAGASIN", ti.PRIXUNITAIRE
from TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_date_mn timd
         left join (select * from TARIF_INGREDIENTS where idmagasin is null) ti
              on ti.DATY = timd.daty and timd.IDINGREDIENT = ti.IDINGREDIENT and timd.UNITE = ti.UNITE and timd.IDTYPECLIENT = ti.IDTYPECLIENT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_MNN" ("IDINGREDIENT", "UNITE", "IDTYPECLIENT", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "PRIXUNITAIRE") AS 
  select timd."IDINGREDIENT",timd."UNITE",timd."IDTYPECLIENT",timd."DATY",timd."IDMAGASIN", ti.PRIXUNITAIRE
from TARIF_INGREDIENTS_MAX_date_mnn timd
         left join (select * from TARIF_INGREDIENTS where idmagasin is not null) ti
              on ti.DATY = timd.daty and timd.IDINGREDIENT = ti.IDINGREDIENT and timd.UNITE = ti.UNITE and ti.idmagasin = timd.idmagasin and timd.IDTYPECLIENT = ti.IDTYPECLIENT
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TAUXABSENTEISME" ("HEURETHEORIQUE", "HEUREABSENCE", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "TAUXABSENCE", "MOISLIB", "IDDIRECTION") AS 
  SELECT
    CAST(nb.NBPERSONNELVALIDE * 173.33 AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS heuretheorique,
    CAST(NVL(SUM(p.ABSENCE), 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS heureabsence,
    p.mois,
    p.ANNEE,
    CAST(
            ROUND(
                    (NVL(SUM(p.ABSENCE), 0) / (nb.NBPERSONNELVALIDE * 173.33)) * 100,
                    2
            ) AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    ) AS tauxAbsence,
    TO_CHAR(
            TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(p.mois, 'FM00'), 'MM'),
            'FMMonth',
            'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=FRENCH'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TAUXDISPONIBILITEMACHINE" ("IDMACHINE", "NOMMACHINE", "IDLIGNE", "IDLIGNELIB", "TAUXDISPONIBILITE") AS 
  SELECT
    m.IDMACHINE ,
    m.NOMMACHINE ,
    l.ID AS idLigne,
    l.VAL AS idLigneLib,
    CASE
        WHEN m2.ECARTJOURS != 0 AND m.MOYENNEDUREE !=0 THEN (m2.ECARTJOURS * 24)/((m2.ECARTJOURS * 24)/m.MOYENNEDUREE)
		ELSE 0
END AS TauxDisponibilite
FROM MOYENNETRAVAUXMACHINE m
LEFT JOIN MOYENNEPANNESTRAVAUX m2
ON m.IDMACHINE = m2.IDMACHINE
LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
ON m.IDMACHINE = aim.ID
LEFT JOIN LIGNE l
ON aim.IDLIGNE = l.ID 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TEMPSMOYENPANNES" ("IDMACHINE", "NOMMACHINE", "IDTRAVAUX", "DATY", "ECART_JOURS") AS 
  WITH ECARTS AS (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN ai.id IS NULL THEN aim.id
                ELSE ai.id
            END AS idMachine,
            CASE
                WHEN ai.libelle IS NULL THEN aim.descriptionObjet
                ELSE ai.libelle
            END AS nomMachine,
            t.ID AS IDTRAVAUX,
            t.DATY,
            NVL(
                t.DATY - LAG(t.DATY) OVER (PARTITION BY o.IDINGREDIENTS ORDER BY t.DATY),
                0
            ) AS ECART_JOURS
        FROM TRAVAUX t
        LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE o
            ON t.IDOFFILLE = o.ID
        LEFT JOIN as_ingredients ai
            ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = ai.id
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE aim
            ON o.IDINGREDIENTS = aim.id
    )
SELECT "IDMACHINE","NOMMACHINE","IDTRAVAUX","DATY","ECART_JOURS"
FROM ECARTS
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TEMPSOUVERTURELIB" ("ID", "IDMACHINE", "TEMPS", "CAPACITE", "IDUNITE", "IDMACHINELIB", "IDUNITELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT
    t.ID,t.IDMACHINE,t.TEMPS,t.CAPACITE,t.IDUNITE,
    aim.LIBELLE AS idmachinelib,
    au.VAL as idunitelib,
    
    t.ID || t.IDMACHINE || t.TEMPS || t.CAPACITE || t.IDUNITE ||

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TOUSLESDATE" ("DATY") AS 
  SELECT
    (TO_DATE('01/01/2000', 'DD/MM/YYYY') + level - 1) AS daty
FROM dual
CONNECT BY level <= 1 + (ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 120) - TO_DATE('01/01/2000', 'DD/MM/YYYY'));

where idtraite is not null
  and ETATVERSEMENT = 11
  and IDTRAITE not in
      (select IDTRAITE from MVTINTRACAISSE where IDTRAITE is not null and ETATVERSEMENT = -2 group by IDTRAITE)
group by idtraite
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITELIB_GRP" ("IDTRAITE", "CODE") AS 
  SELECT  IDTRAITE,LISTAGG(CODE , ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CODE) AS CODE FROM TRAITE_FCLIB tf
GROUP BY IDTRAITE

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMENT_PAIE_LIB" ("IDPERSONNEL", "NOMPERSONNEL", "MATRICULE", "NETAPAYER", "IDEDITION", "MODEPAIEMENT", "NUMEROCOMPTE") AS 
  SELECT
    ec.id AS idpersonnel ,
    ec.nom || ' ' || ec.PRENOM AS nomPersonnel,
    ec.MATRICULE ,
    pe.GAIN AS netapayer,
    pe.IDEDITION ,
    ec.MODE_PAIEMENT AS modepaiement,
    ec.BANQUE_NUMERO_COMPTE AS numeroCompte
FROM PAIE_EDITION pe
         LEFT JOIN EMPLOYE_COMPLET ec ON ec.id = pe.IDPERSONNEL
WHERE pe.IDELEMENTPAIE ='PR000210A' AND pe.etat >= 11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTFC" ("ID", "MONTANTENLEVETRAITE") AS 
  SELECT
    t.ID,
    cast(nvl(sum(f.montant),0) as number(30,2)) AS montantenlevetraite
FROM traite t
         LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENT f ON t.ID = f.ID2
GROUP BY t.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTRESTE" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "MONTANTRESTE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT t.ID,
       t.DATY,
       t.TIERS,
       t.BANQUE,
       t.DATEECHEANCE,
       t.ETAT,
       CAST(nvl(t.MONTANT,0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                          AS montant,
       t.ESCOMPTE,
       CAST(nvl(t.TOTAL,0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                            AS total,
       t.REFERENCE,
       CAST((nvl(t.total,0) - nvl(tf.montantenlevetraite, 0)) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantreste,
       t.cdclt,
       t.idbanque,
       t.idtypepiece,
       t.typepiece,
       nvl(te.etatversement, 1)                                  as etatversement,
       case
           when te.etatversement = -2 then 'Encaissee'
           when te.etatversement = 11 then 'Versee'
           else
               'Non Versee' end                                  as etatversementlib
FROM TRAITE_LIBMTT t
         LEFT JOIN traitemttfc tf ON tf.id = t.id
         LEFT JOIN traiteetatversement te on te.IDTRAITE = t.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITEMTTRESTE_NONVERSEE" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "MONTANTRESTE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE") AS 
  SELECT ID,DATY,TIERS,BANQUE,DATEECHEANCE,ETAT,MONTANT,ESCOMPTE,TOTAL,REFERENCE,MONTANTRESTE,CDCLT,IDBANQUE FROM (
	SELECT t.ID,t.DATY,t.TIERS,t.BANQUE,t.DATEECHEANCE,t.ETAT,t.MONTANT,t.ESCOMPTE,t.TOTAL,t.REFERENCE,
 (t.total-tf. montantenlevetraite) AS montantreste, t.cdclt, t.idbanque
 FROM TRAITE_LIBMTT t 
 LEFT JOIN traitemttfc tf ON tf.id=t.id
) tmttrst WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT idtraite FROM MVTINTRACAISSE m WHERE m.idtraite IS NOT NULL AND m.ETATVERSEMENT = 11)

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_FC" ("ID", "IDTRAITE", "IDFC", "MONTANTFACTURE", "MONTANTJC", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "CODE", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "FACTURECLIENTLIB", "TIERSLIB", "ETATLIB") AS 
  select
    fc.ID,tl.id AS IDTRAITE,fc.id AS IDFC, FC.MONTANTTTC as MONTANTFACTURE, j.CREDIT as MONTANTJC, pf.MONTANT,fc.DATY,fc.ETAT,'' as CODE,
    tl.tiers,
    tl.banque,
    fc.designation as factureclientlib,
    fc.IDCLIENTLIB as TIERSLIB,
    CASE
        WHEN j.etat = 1
            THEN 'Cree'
        WHEN j.ETAT >= 11
            THEN 'visee'
        WHEN j.ETAT =0
            THEN 'Annulee'
        END AS etatlib
from LIAISONPAIEMENT pf
         LEFT JOIN MOUVEMENTCAISSE j ON j.ID  = pf.id2
         JOIN traite tl on tl.id = j.idtraite
         left join VENTE_CPL fc on pf.id1  = fc.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_FCSUM" ("ID", "FACTURECLIENTLIB", "TIERSLIB", "DATY", "MONTANTFACTURE", "ETATLIB", "IDTRAITE", "MONTANTTRAITE") AS

    t.id,
    t.factureclientlib,
    t.tierslib,
    t.daty,
    cast(t.montantfacture as number(30,2)),
    t.etatLib,
    t.idTraite,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_JC" ("ID", "IDTRAITE", "MONTANT", "DATY", "ETAT", "IDJC", "DATESAISIE", "DATEEFFET", "FOLIO", "CAISSE", "NUMPIECE", "LIBELLE", "DEBIT", "CREDIT", "REMARQUE", "ETATJC", "TIERS", "IDTYPECHEQUE", "DESIGNATION", "IDORDRE", "IDDEVISE", "IDMODE", "NUMCHEQUE", "TYPEMVT", "IDPLACEMENT", "IDBANQUE", "IDPLACEMENTVRAI", "ETATVERSEMENT", "ETATLIB", "ETATVERSEMENTLIB", "VALCAISSE") AS 
  select
    jc.id,fc.ID AS idtraite,fc.MONTANT,fc.DATY,fc.ETAT,jc.id AS IDJC,
    jc.daty as datesaisie,
    jc.daty as DATEEFFET,
    '' as FOLIO,
    jc.IDCAISSE as caisse,
    '' as NUMPIECE,
    jc.DESIGNATION as libelle ,
    jc.DEBIT,
    jc.CREDIT,
    jc.DESIGNATION as REMARQUE,
    jc.ETAT AS etatjc,
    jc.IDTIERS as TIERS,
    '' as IDTYPECHEQUE,
    jc.DESIGNATION,
    '' as IDORDRE,
    jc.IDDEVISE,
    '' as IDMODE,
    '' as NUMCHEQUE,
    '' as TYPEMVT,
    '' as IDPLACEMENT,
    fc.BANQUE as IDBANQUE,
    '' as IDPLACEMENTVRAI,
    jc.ETATVERSEMENT,
    case
        when jc.etat = 1 then 'CREEE'
        when jc.etat >= 11 then 'VISEE'
        else '' end                           as etatlib,
    case
        when jc.etatversement = -2 then 'Encaissee'
        when jc.etatversement = 11 then 'Versee'
        else '' end                           as etatversementlib,
    c.VAL AS valcaisse
from MOUVEMENTCAISSE jc
         join traite fc on fc.id = jc.IDTRAITE
          LEFT JOIN caisse c ON c.id = jc.IDCAISSE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "REFERENCE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE") AS 
  select
    tr.id,
    tr.daty,
    ti.nom as tiers,
    ba.val as banque,
    tr.dateEcheance,
    tr.etat,
    tr.montant,
    tr.REFERENCE,
    '' as CDCLT,
    ba.ID AS idbanque,
    IDTYPEPIECE ,
    tp.val AS typepiece
from traite tr
         left join client ti on tr.tiers = ti.id
         left join banque ba on tr.banque = ba.id
         LEFT JOIN type_piece tp ON tp.id=tr.IDTYPEPIECE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAITE_LIBMTT" ("ID", "DATY", "TIERS", "BANQUE", "DATEECHEANCE", "ETAT", "MONTANT", "ESCOMPTE", "TOTAL", "REFERENCE", "CDCLT", "IDBANQUE", "IDTYPEPIECE", "TYPEPIECE") AS 
  select t.ID,t.DATY,t.TIERS,t.BANQUE,t.DATEECHEANCE,t.ETAT,t.MONTANT,
       sum(nvl(e.FRAIS,0)) AS escompte,
       montant - sum(nvl(e.FRAIS, 0)) AS total, t.reference,
       t.CDCLT,
       t.idbanque,
       t.idtypepiece,
       t.typepiece
from traite_lib t
         LEFT JOIN ESCOMPTE_LIBV e ON e.IDTRAITE = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.DATY ,t.TIERS ,t.BANQUE ,t.DATEECHEANCE ,t.ETAT ,t.MONTANT,t.REFERENCE, t.CDCLT, t.idbanque,t.idtypepiece,

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTPOULETDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDSEXE", "IDFERMEDEPART", "IDBATIMENTDEPART", "IDPARQUETDEPART", "QTE", "IDFERMEARRIVE", "IDBATIMENTARRIVE", "IDPARQUETARRIVE", "IDCONTROLEUR", "IDCHAUFFEUR", "IDVEHICULE", "IDSEXELIB", "IDFERMEDEPARTLIB", "IDBATIMENTDEPARTLIB", "IDPARQUETDEPARTLIB", "IDFERMEARRIVELIB", "IDBATIMENTARRIVELIB", "IDPARQUETARRIVELIB", "IDCONTROLEURLIB", "IDCHAUFFEURLIB", "IDVEHICULELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    td."ID",td."IDMERE",td."IDSEXE",td."IDFERMEDEPART",td."IDBATIMENTDEPART",td."IDPARQUETDEPART",td."QTE",td."IDFERMEARRIVE",td."IDBATIMENTARRIVE",td."IDPARQUETARRIVE",td."IDCONTROLEUR",td."IDCHAUFFEUR",td."IDVEHICULE",
    s.val                              AS idSexeLib,
    mFermeDep.val                      AS idFermeDepartLib,
    bDep.nomBatiment                   AS idBatimentDepartLib,
    pDep.val                           AS idParquetDepartLib,
    mFermeArr.val                      AS idFermeArriveLib,
    bArr.nomBatiment                   AS idBatimentArriveLib,
    pArr.val                           AS idParquetArriveLib,
    (ctrl.nom || ' ' || ctrl.prenom)   AS idControleurLib,
    (chauf.nom || ' ' || chauf.prenom) AS idChauffeurLib,
    v.val                              AS idVehiculeLib
FROM transfertPouletDetail td
     LEFT JOIN sexe s              ON td.idSexe = s.id
     LEFT JOIN magasin2 mFermeDep  ON td.idFermeDepart = mFermeDep.id
     LEFT JOIN batiment bDep       ON td.idBatimentDepart = bDep.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet pDep        ON td.idParquetDepart = pDep.id
     LEFT JOIN magasin2 mFermeArr  ON td.idFermeArrive = mFermeArr.id
     LEFT JOIN batiment bArr       ON td.idBatimentArrive = bArr.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet pArr        ON td.idParquetArrive = pArr.id
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel ctrl  ON td.idControleur = ctrl.id
     LEFT JOIN log_personnel chauf ON td.idChauffeur = chauf.id
     LEFT JOIN vehicule v          ON td.idVehicule = v.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRANSFERTPOULET_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLOT", "REMARQUE", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS 
      t."ID",t."DATY",t."IDLOT",t."REMARQUE",    l.nomLot AS idLotLib,    so.val AS idsouchelib,    t.ETAT AS ETAT,    CASE t.ETAT        WHEN 1  THEN 'CREE'        WHEN 11 THEN 'VALIDE'        WHEN 0  THEN 'ANULLE'        END AS ETATLIBFROM transfertPoulet t         LEFT JOIN lot l ON t.idLot = l.id         LEFT JOIN SOUCHE so ON so.id=l.idsouche;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXCPL" ("ID", "LANCEPAR", "CIBLE", "REMARQUE", "LIBELLE", "BESOIN", "DATY", "IDOFFILLE", "IDOF", "LANCEPARLIB", "CIBLELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "FABRICATIONPREC", "FABRICATIONSUIV", "IDINGREDIENTMAINTENANCE", "INGREDIENTMAINTENANCELIB") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID,f.LANCEPAR,f.CIBLE,f.REMARQUE,f.LIBELLE,f.BESOIN,f.DATY,f.idOffille,nvl(f.idof, off.idmere) AS idof,
    p.val AS lanceparLib,
    p2.val AS cibleLib,
    f.etat AS etat,
    CASE
        WHEN f.ETAT=1
            THEN 'CRÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=11
            THEN 'VALIDÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=0
            THEN 'ANNULÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=21
            THEN 'ENTAMÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=31
            THEN 'BLOQUÉE'
        WHEN f.ETAT=41
            THEN 'TERMINÉE'
        END AS ETATLIB,
    f.FABRICATIONPREC,
    f.FABRICATIONSUIV,
    off.idIngredients AS idIngredientMaintenance,
    off.remarque AS ingredientMaintenanceLib
FROM TRAVAUX f
         LEFT JOIN ENTITE p ON p.id = f.lancepar
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN p2 ON p2.id = f.cible
         LEFT JOIN ORDRETRAVAUXFILLE off ON f.idoffille = off.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUXFILLECPL" ("ID", "IDINGREDIENTS", "LIBELLE", "REMARQUE", "IDMERE", "DATYBESOIN", "QTE", "IDUNITE", "PU", "IDINGREDIENTSLIB", "OPERATEUR", "IDUNITELIB", "IDBCFILLE", "IDMACHINE", "IDMACHINELIB", "OPERATEURLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    f.ID,
    f.IDINGREDIENTS,
    f.LIBELLE,
    f.REMARQUE,
    f.IDMERE,
    f.DATYBESOIN,
    f.QTE,
    f.IDUNITE,
    f.PU,
    ai.LIBELLE AS idingredientsLib,
    p.NOM || ' - ' || p.TELEPHONE AS operateur,
    au.val AS IDUNITELIB,
    f.IDBCFILLE ,
    f.IDMACHINE,
    m.val AS IDMACHINELIB,
    p2.NOM AS OPERATEURLiB
FROM
    TRAVAUXFILLE f
        LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENT_MAINTENANCE ai ON
        ai.id = f.IDINGREDIENTS
        LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p ON
        p.ID = f.OPERATEUR
        LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE au ON
        au.id = f.IDUNITE

        LEFT JOIN PERSONNEL p2 ON

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRAVAUX_RECAP" ("ID", "MONTANTCHARGEEXTERNE", "MONTANTPIECE", "MONTANTMAINDOEUVRE", "MONTANTTOTAL") AS 
  WITH fac_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantttc, 0)) AS montantChargeExterne
  FROM FACTUREFOURNISSEURCPL_TRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
),
mvt_agg AS (
  SELECT idobjet,
         SUM(NVL(montantsortie, 0)) AS montantPiece
  FROM MVTSTOCKLIB
  GROUP BY idobjet
),
pm_agg AS (
  SELECT idtravaux,
         SUM(NVL(montantreel, 0)) AS montantMainDoeuvre
  FROM RAPPROCHEMENTTRAVAUX
  GROUP BY idtravaux
)
SELECT t.id,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0) AS montantChargeExterne,
       NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)         AS montantPiece,
       NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantMainDoeuvre,
       NVL(fac_agg.montantChargeExterne, 0)
           + NVL(mvt_agg.montantPiece, 0)
           + NVL(pm_agg.montantMainDoeuvre, 0)    AS montantTotal
FROM TRAVAUX t
         LEFT JOIN fac_agg ON fac_agg.idtravaux = t.id
         LEFT JOIN mvt_agg ON mvt_agg.idobjet   = t.id
         LEFT JOIN pm_agg  ON pm_agg.idtravaux  = t.id
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."TRIAGEBATIMENTPARQUET_LIB" ("ID", "DATY", "IDLOT", "DISPOMALE", "DISPOFEMELLE", "IDLOTLIB", "IDSOUCHELIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "ECARTFEMELLE", "ECARTMALE") AS

    t.DATY,
    t.HEUREDEPART,
    t.IDOPERATEUR,
    t.IDNUMEROCOLLECTE,
    t.IDBATIMENT,
    t.IDPARQUET,
    t.OEUFTOTAL,
    t.POIDSMOYENOEUFS,
 
    lp.NOM || ' ' || lp.PRENOM AS IDOPERATEURLIB,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V1_OSTIE_AFFICHE_T1" ("NUMERO", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOMS", "SEXE", "DATE_NAISSANCE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DATE_DEPART", "FONCTION", "CNAPS", "CIN", "MOIS1", "MOIS2", "MOIS3", "SALAIRES_NON_PLAFONNES", "SALAIRES_PLAFONNES", "EMPLOYEUR", "TRAVAILLEUR", "TOTAL", "ANNEE", "DIRECTION") AS 
  SELECT
    rownum as numero,
    lpad(pip.matricule,5,'0') as matricule,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.NOM)) as nom,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.prenom)) as prenoms,
    sexe.val as sexe,
    lp.date_naissance,
    pip.dateembauche,
    case
        when extract(year from pip.date_depart)=nvl(s3.annee,nvl(s2.annee,nvl(s1.annee,0)))
            and (
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 1
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 2
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 3
                 ) then pip.date_depart
        else
            null
        end as date_depart,
    upper(paf.desce) as fonction,
    upper(pip.NUMERO_CNAPS) as cnaps,
    lp.numero_cin as cin,
    nvl(s1.salairebase,0) as mois1,
    nvl(s2.salairebase,0) as mois2,
    nvl(s3.salairebase,0) as mois3,
    (nvl(s1.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s2.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s3.salairebase, 0)) as salaires_non_plafonnes,
    (
        case
            when nvl(s1.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s1.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s2.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s2.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s3.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s3.salairebase,0)
            end
        ) as salaires_plafonnes,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5 as employeur,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as travailleur,
    (nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5)+nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as total,
    ostie.annee,
    ostie.direction
FROM log_personnel lp
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=lp.id
         JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id=lp.direction
         JOIN paie_fonction paf ON paf.id = pip.idfonction
         JOIN sexe ON sexe.id = lp.sexe
         LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT sum(round(retenue,0)) as retenue,idpersonnel,annee,direction FROM paie_edition WHERE
         (mois = 1 or mois=2 or mois =3) AND etat=11 AND IDELEMENTPAIE ='PRU000I710'
      group by idpersonnel,annee,direction) ostie
     ON ostie.idpersonnel = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 1) s1
     ON lp.id = s1.idpersonnel and ostie.annee= s1.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 2) s2
     ON lp.id = s2.idpersonnel and ostie.annee = s2.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 3) s3
     ON lp.id = s3.idpersonnel and ostie.annee=s3.annee
WHERE nvl(ostie.retenue,0)!=0
ORDER BY annee,pip.matricule
 ;

    (

            when nvl(s3.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s3.salairebase,0)
            end
        ) as salaires_plafonnes,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5 as employeur,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as travailleur,
    (nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5)+nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as total,
    ostie.annee,
    ostie.direction
FROM log_personnel lp
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=lp.id
         JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id=lp.direction
         JOIN paie_fonction paf ON paf.id = pip.idfonction
         JOIN sexe ON sexe.id = lp.sexe
         LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT sum(round(retenue,0)) as retenue,idpersonnel,annee,direction FROM paie_edition WHERE
         (mois = 7 or mois=8 or mois =9) AND etat=11 AND IDELEMENTPAIE ='PRU000I710'
      group by idpersonnel,annee,direction) ostie
     ON ostie.idpersonnel = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 7) s1
     ON lp.id = s1.idpersonnel and ostie.annee= s1.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 8) s2
     ON lp.id = s2.idpersonnel and ostie.annee = s2.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 9) s3
     ON lp.id = s3.idpersonnel and ostie.annee=s3.annee
WHERE nvl(ostie.retenue,0)!=0
ORDER BY annee,pip.matricule
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."V1_OSTIE_AFFICHE_T4" ("NUMERO", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOMS", "SEXE", "DATE_NAISSANCE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "DATE_DEPART", "FONCTION", "CNAPS", "CIN", "MOIS1", "MOIS2", "MOIS3", "SALAIRES_NON_PLAFONNES", "SALAIRES_PLAFONNES", "EMPLOYEUR", "TRAVAILLEUR", "TOTAL", "ANNEE", "DIRECTION") AS 
  SELECT
    rownum as numero,
    lpad(pip.matricule,5,'0') as matricule,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.NOM)) as nom,
    Upper(trim(trailing ' ' from lp.prenom)) as prenoms,
    sexe.val as sexe,
    lp.date_naissance,
    pip.dateembauche,
    case
        when extract(year from pip.date_depart)=nvl(s3.annee,nvl(s2.annee,nvl(s1.annee,0)))
            and (
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 10
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 11
                     or
                 extract(month from pip.date_depart) = 12
                 ) then pip.date_depart
        else
            null
        end as date_depart,
    upper(paf.desce) as fonction,
    upper(pip.NUMERO_CNAPS) as cnaps,
    lp.numero_cin as cin,
    nvl(s1.salairebase,0) as mois1,
    nvl(s2.salairebase,0) as mois2,
    nvl(s3.salairebase,0) as mois3,
    (nvl(s1.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s2.salairebase, 0)+nvl(s3.salairebase, 0)) as salaires_non_plafonnes,
    (
        case
            when nvl(s1.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s1.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s2.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s2.salairebase,0)
            end
        )+
    (
        case
            when nvl(s3.salairebase,0) >= (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
                then (select cast(valmin as number) as maximum from configuration where id = 'CONF000140')
            else
                nvl(s3.salairebase,0)
            end
        ) as salaires_plafonnes,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5 as employeur,
    nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as travailleur,
    (nvl(ostie.retenue,0)*5)+nvl(ostie.retenue,0) as total,
    ostie.annee,
    ostie.direction
FROM log_personnel lp
         JOIN paie_info_personnel pip ON pip.id=lp.id
         JOIN log_direction ld ON ld.id=lp.direction
         JOIN paie_fonction paf ON paf.id = pip.idfonction
         JOIN sexe ON sexe.id = lp.sexe
         LEFT JOIN
     (SELECT sum(round(retenue,0)) as retenue,idpersonnel,annee,direction FROM paie_edition WHERE
         (mois = 10 or mois=11 or mois =12) AND etat=11 AND IDELEMENTPAIE ='PRU000I710'
      group by idpersonnel,annee,direction) ostie
     ON ostie.idpersonnel = lp.id
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 10) s1
     ON lp.id = s1.idpersonnel and ostie.annee= s1.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 11) s2
     ON lp.id = s2.idpersonnel and ostie.annee = s2.annee
         LEFT JOIN
     (select * from salairebasemois where mois = 12) s3
     ON lp.id = s3.idpersonnel and ostie.annee=s3.annee
WHERE nvl(ostie.retenue,0)!=0
ORDER BY annee,pip.matricule
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VACCINATIONPOUSSINDETAIL_LIB" ("ID", "IDMERE", "IDBATIMENT", "IDPARQUET", "IDTYPEVACCINATION", "IDMALADIEPOUSSIN", "IDVACCIN", "IDMODEADMINISTRATION", "QTEDOSE", "HEUREDEBUT", "HEUREFIN", "DATEEXPIRATION", "IDBATIMENTLIB", "IDPARQUETLIB", "IDTYPEVACCINATIONLIB", "IDMALADIEPOUSSINLIB", "IDVACCINLIB", "IDMODEADMINISTRATIONLIB") AS 
  SELECT
    vd."ID",vd."IDMERE",vd."IDBATIMENT",vd."IDPARQUET",vd."IDTYPEVACCINATION",vd."IDMALADIEPOUSSIN",vd."IDVACCIN",vd."IDMODEADMINISTRATION",vd."QTEDOSE",vd."HEUREDEBUT",vd."HEUREFIN",vd."DATEEXPIRATION",
    b.nomBatiment  AS idBatimentLib,
    p.val          AS idParquetLib,
    tv.val         AS idTypeVaccinationLib,
    mp.val         AS idMaladiePoussinLib,
    vp.val         AS idVaccinLib,
    ma.val         AS idModeAdministrationLib
FROM vaccinationPoussinDetail vd
     LEFT JOIN batiment b               ON vd.idBatiment = b.id
     LEFT JOIN parquet p                ON vd.idParquet = p.id
     LEFT JOIN typeVaccination tv       ON vd.idTypeVaccination = tv.id
     LEFT JOIN maladiePoussin mp        ON vd.idMaladiePoussin = mp.id
     LEFT JOIN VaccinPoussin vp         ON vd.idVaccin = vp.id
     LEFT JOIN modeAdministrationVaccin ma ON vd.idModeAdministration = ma.id;

(nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *             (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM))as number(30, 2) )                 as montantHT,       cast((vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) *            (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100)) -(vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) as number(30, 2))                 as puRemise,       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - (nvl(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * (1 - (nvl(vd.RISTOURNE, 0) / 100))- NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(vd.POIDS, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0) - vd.QTE * (vd.REMISEARBIOCHEM + vd.RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM)) *            nvl(vd.TAUXDECHANGE, 1) as number(30, 2))                            as montantHTAr,       cast((vd.QTE * vd.pu * (1 - CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETCALCREMGLOVISE" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "SUM_QTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "COMPTE", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDREMISE", "REMISEMONTANT", "PHOTO", "QTE_TMP", "REFERENCE", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDPROVINCE", "IDPROVINCELIB", "MONTANT", "MONTANTNONREMISE", "MONTANTREMISESANSTVA", "MONTANTHT", "PUREMISE", "MONTANTHTAR", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTVAAR", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANT_TOTAL", "PUTOTAL", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MONTANTLIVRAISON", "TOTAL_ACHAT", "MARGEBRUTE", "REMISEGLOBAL", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MOIS", "LIBELLE_MOIS", "ANNEE") AS 
         TO_CHAR(v.DATY, 'Month', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE = FRENCH') AS libelle_mois,       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.DATY)  AS anneefrom VenteDetCalc vd         join vente v on v.ID = vd.IDVENTE         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on vd.IDPRODUIT=ing.id         left join categorieIngredient cat on ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT=cat.id         left join magasin2 mag on mag.ID=v.IDMAGASIN         left join point p1 on mag.IDPOINT=p1.ID         left join CLIENT cli on cli.id=v.IDCLIENT         left join PROVINCE pro on pro.ID=cli.IDPROVINCE         left join TYPE_PRODUIT tp on tp.id=ing.TYPEPRODUITwhere v.ETAT>=11 order by annee desc,EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.DATY) desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEDETMERECATINGRCATCLIENT" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDREMISE", "IDCLIENT", "CATCLIENT", "CATEGORIEINGREDIENTS", "IDPOINT") AS

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIB" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANT") AS 
  SELECT 
v.ID ,
v.IDPRODUIT ,
p.VAL AS IDPRODUITLIB,
v.QTE ,
v.PU ,
v.TAUXREMISE ,
v.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
e.DESIGNATION AS IDENCAISSEMENTLIB,
v.IDMAGASIN ,
v.DATY ,
v.REMARQUE ,
v.IDMAGASINLIB,
v.ETAT ,
CASE 
	WHEN v.ETAT = 0 
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
	WHEN v.ETAT = 1 
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN v.ETAT = 11 
	THEN 'VISEE'
END AS ETATLIB ,
CAST(v.QTE * v.PU AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant
FROM VENTELUBRIFIANT v 
LEFT JOIN PRODUIT p ON v.IDPRODUIT = p.ID 
LEFT JOIN ENCAISSEMENT e ON v.IDENCAISSEMENT = e.ID 
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON  v.IDMAGASIN  = m.ID 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANTLIB_CV" ("ID", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "QTE", "PU", "TAUXREMISE", "IDENCAISSEMENT", "IDENCAISSEMENTLIB", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "IDMAGASINLIB", "ETAT", "ETATLIB") AS

FROM venteLubrifiantLib v

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTELUBRIFIANT_VALIDEE" ("IDENCAISSEMENT", "VENTELUBRIFIANT") AS 
  SELECT 
v.IDENCAISSEMENT ,
sum( nvl(v.QTE  * v.PU ,0) ) AS ventelubrifiant
FROM VENTELUBRIFIANT v 
WHERE v.ETAT > 1 
GROUP BY v.IDENCAISSEMENT 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEMONTANT" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS 
  SELECT vd.IDVENTE AS ID,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          AS montanttotal,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) -
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0))) as number(30, 2))                  AS montantremise,
       sum(FRAIS)                                                                                                    as frais,
       cast(SUM((NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PuAchat, 0))) as number(30, 2))                                             AS montanttotalachat,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) /
                100) as number(30, 2))                                                                               AS montantTva,
       cast(SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) * (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0)) -
                (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) as number(30, 2))                          as montantTTC,
       NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,
       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,
       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -
                                                 (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) *
                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *
                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +
            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *
                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE)) *
                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -
                ((nvl(vd.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vd.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,
       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,
       vd.IDRESERVATION
FROM VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS vd
--         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
--         left join AS_INGREDIENTS vp on vp.id = vd.IDPRODUIT
GROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, vd.IDRESERVATION
 
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTEMONTANTLEGER" ("ID", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTREMISE", "FRAIS", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION", "POIDS", "COLIS") AS 
         NVL(vd.IDDEVISE, 'AR')                                                                                        AS IDDEVISE,       NVL(avg(vd.tauxDeChange), 1)                                                                                  AS tauxDeChange,       -- montantTTCAR : remise Arbiochem ajoutee en suivant le meme traitement que fraislivraison (structure d'origine conservee)       cast(SUM((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) * (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) -                                                 (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -                                                 (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE) *                                                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) *                (NVL(VD.TVA, 0)) / 100) +            SUM(((1 - nvl(vd.remise / 100, 0)) *                 (NVL(vd.QTE, 0) * NVL(vd.PU, 0) - (nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE) -                  (nvl(vd.remiseArbiochem, 0) * vd.QTE)) *                 NVL(VD.TAUXDECHANGE, 1)) -                ((nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(ing.CALORIE, 0) * vd.QTE))) as number(30, 2))                        as montantTTCAR,       cast(sum(vd.PUREVIENT * vd.QTE) as number(20, 2))                                                             as montantRevient,       v.IDRESERVATION,nvl(sum(ing.CALORIE* vd.QTE),0) as poids,sum(vd.QTE) as colisFROM VENTE_DETAILS vd         LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE         left join AS_INGREDIENTS ing on ing.id = vd.IDPRODUITGROUP BY vd.IDVENTE, vd.IDDEVISE, v.IDRESERVATION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "DATYPREVU", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "RESTE", "IDPROVINCE", "PROVINCELIB", "IDORIGINE", "FRAIS", "REFERENCEFACT", "NUMEROFACTURE", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "UPDATED_AT", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDECRITURE", "DATEDELIVRAISON", "MOTSCLESSS") AS WHEN V.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE' WHEN V.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' END AS ETATLIB, CAST(V2.MONTANTTOTAL AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, V2.IDDEVISE, V.IDCLIENT, C.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, CAST(V2.MONTANTTVA AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTVA, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTC AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTTC, CAST(V2.MONTANTTTCAR AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTTCAR, CAST(NVL(MV.MONTANT, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTPAYE, CAST(NVL(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - NVL(MV.MONTANT, 0) - NVL(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR - ACG.MONTANTPAYEAR, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTRESTE, CAST(NVL(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS AVOIR, CAST(V2.TAUXDECHANGE AS NUMBER(10, 2)) AS TAUXDECHANGE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREVIENT AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT, CAST((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - V2.MONTANTREVIENT) AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS MARGEBRUTE, V.IDRESERVATION, CASE WHEN V.DATYPREVU IS NULL THEN V.DATY ELSE V.DATYPREVU END AS DATYPREVU, RF.REFERENCE AS REFERENCEFACTURE, CAST(V2.MONTANTREMISE AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANTREMISE, CAST(NVL(V2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + NVL(V2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS MONTANT, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM V.DATY) AS MOIS, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM V.DATY) AS ANNEE, CAST(V2.POIDS AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS POIDS, CAST(V2.COLIS AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS COLIS, V.MODEPAIEMENT, MP.VAL AS MODEPAIEMENTLIB, NVL(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(V2.POIDS, 0) AS FRAISLIVRAISON, V.MODELIVRAISON, CASE WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN V.MODELIVRAISON = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS MODELIVRAISONLIB, CAST(VR.RESTE AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS RESTE, PV.ID AS IDPROVINCE, PV.VAL AS PROVINCELIB, V.IDORIGINE, CAST(COALESCE(V.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5)) AS FRAIS, V.REFERENCEFACT, V.NUMEROFACTURE, V.LIEULIVRAISON, V.DATELIVRAISON, V.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN V.ESTPREVU = 0 THEN 'Non' ELSE 'Oui' END AS ESTPREVULIB, CE.ID AS IDECRITURE, NVL(BLC.DATY, V.DATELIVRAISON) AS DATEDELIVRAISON, ( V.ID || ' | ' || V.DESIGNATION || ' | ' || C.NOM || ' | ' || NUMEROFACTURE || ' | ' || PV.VAL ) AS MOTSCLESSSFROM VENTE V LEFT JOIN CLIENT C ON C.ID = V.IDCLIENT LEFT JOIN PROVINCE PV ON PV.ID = C.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT M ON M.ID = V.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER V2 ON V2.ID = V.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL MV ON V.ID = MV.ID2 LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT_GBVENTE ACG ON ACG.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE RF ON RF.IDFACTURE = V.ID LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT MP ON MP.ID = V.MODEPAIEMENT LEFT JOIN VENTE_RESTE VR ON VR.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT BLC ON BLC.IDVENTE = V.ID LEFT JOIN COMPTA_ECRITURE CE ON CE.IDOBJET = V.ID;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_ANALYSE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANTTOTALACHAT", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "MONTANTREVIENT", "IDRESERVATION") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL   AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1
               THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11
               THEN 'EN ATTENTE LIVRAISON ET PAIEMENT'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0
               THEN 'ANNULEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 12
               THEN 'LIVRE NON PAYE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 13
               THEN 'PAYE NON LIVRE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 14
               THEN 'PAYE ET LIVRE'
           END AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.MONTANTTOTALACHAT,
       p.ID AS IDPOINT,
       p.VAL AS IDPOINTLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL - v2.MONTANTTOTALACHAT AS MONTANTREVIENT,
       v.IDRESERVATION
FROM VENTE v
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         LEFT JOIN POINT p ON m.IDPOINT = p.ID
         JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
 ;

  SELECT
v.ID,v.DESIGNATION,v.IDMAGASIN,v.DATY,v.REMARQUE,v.ETAT,v.IDORIGINE,v.IDCLIENT,
c.NOM AS idClientLib,
m.VAL AS idMagasinLib,
nvl(vg.montanttc,0) AS montanttc,
nvl(vg.montanttc,0) AS montantttc,
nvl(ve.montantpaye*vg.TAUXDECHANGE,0) AS montantpaye,
nvl(ve.montantpaye * vg.TAUXDECHANGE ,0) AS encaissementchange,

v.IDRESERVATION

LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.id = vg.IDVENTE
LEFT JOIN vente_encaisse ve ON ve.IDVENTE = v.id
LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.id = v.idclient
LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.id  = v.idmagasin
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_BC_VISEE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "CLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "IDORIGINE", "MONTANTAVOIR") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
           END
             AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.IDDEVISE,
       v.IDCLIENT,
       c.NOM AS CLIENTLIB,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYEar, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.MONTANT,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)+nvl(acg.MONTANTPAYEAR,0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)  as avoir,
       v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       v.idorigine as IDORIGINE,
       cast(nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTCAR, 0)  as NUMBER(30,2)) as montantAvoir
FROM VENTE v
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN VENTEMONTANTLEGER v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id=mv.ID2
         LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCMONTANT ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
         --left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT asbl on asbl.ID = v.IDORIGINE
where v.ETAT = 11

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_CL" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "DATYPREVU", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "POIDS", "COLIS", "MODEPAIEMENT", "MODEPAIEMENTLIB", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISON", "MODELIVRAISONLIB", "RESTE", "IDPROVINCE", "PROVINCELIB", "IDORIGINE", "FRAIS", "REFERENCEFACT", "NUMEROFACTURE", "LIEULIVRAISON", "DATELIVRAISON", "UPDATED_AT", "ESTPREVULIB", "IDECRITURE", "DATEDELIVRAISON", "ADRESSE") AS SELECT v.ID, v.DESIGNATION, v.IDMAGASIN, m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB, v.DATY, v.REMARQUE, v.ETAT, CASE WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CRÉÉE' WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE' WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULÉE' END AS ETATLIB, cast(v2.MONTANTTOTAL as number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTTOTAL, v2.IDDEVISE, v.IDCLIENT, c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB, cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30, 5)) as MONTANTTVA, cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30, 5)) as montantttc, cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30, 5)) as MONTANTTTCAR, cast(nvl(mv.montant, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS montantpaye, cast(nvl(V2.MONTANTTTC, 0) - nvl(mv.montant, 0) - nvl(ACG.imputeefactar, 0) AS number(30, 5)) AS montantreste, cast(nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0) as number(30, 5)) as avoir, cast(v2.tauxDeChange as number(10, 2)) AS tauxDeChange, cast(v2.MONTANTREVIENT as number(20, 5)) AS MONTANTREVIENT , cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20, 5)) as margeBrute, v.IDRESERVATION, case when v.DATYPREVU is null then v.daty else V.DATYPREVU end as datyprevu, rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture, cast(v2.MONTANTREMISE as number(30, 5)) AS MONTANTREMISE, cast(nvl(v2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + nvl(v2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) as number(30, 5)) as montant, extract(month from v.DATY) as mois, extract(year from v.DATY) as annee, CAST(vp.poids as number(30, 5)) as poids, CAST(vp.colis as number(30, 5)) as colis, v.modepaiement, mp.VAL as modepaiementlib, nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vp.poids, 0) as fraislivraison, v.modelivraison, CASE WHEN v.modelivraison = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN v.modelivraison = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS modelivraisonlib, cast(vr.reste as number(30, 5)) AS reste, pv.id as idprovince, pv.val as provincelib, --bl.id as idbl, v.IDORIGINE, CAST(COALESCE(v.FRAISLIVRAISON,0) AS number(30, 5)) as frais, v.REFERENCEFACT, v.NUMEROFACTURE, v.LIEULIVRAISON, v.DATELIVRAISON, v.UPDATED_AT, case when v.ESTPREVU = 0 then 'Non' ELSE 'Oui' END estprevulib, ce.id AS idecriture, nvl(blc.daty,v.DATELIVRAISON) AS datedelivraison, c.ADRESSE FROM VENTE v LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT left join PROVINCE pv on pv.id = c.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2 LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture = v.Id left join vente_poids vp on vp.idvente = v.id left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = v.modepaiement left join vente_reste vr on vr.idvente = v.id LEFT JOIN AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT blc ON blc.IDVENTE = v.id LEFT JOIN compta_ecriture ce ON ce.idobjet=v.id ;

nvl(mv.montant, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS montantreste, v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange, v2.MONTANTREVIENT, cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR - v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20, 2)) as margeBrute, v.IDRESERVATION, case when v.DATYPREVU is null then daty else V.DATYPREVU end as datyprevu, rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture, v2.MONTANTREMISE, nvl(v2.MONTANTTOTAL, 0) + nvl(v2.MONTANTREMISE, 0) as montant, extract(month from DATY) as mois, extract(year from DATY) as annee, vp.poids, v.modepaiement, mp.VAL as modepaiementlib, nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * nvl(vp.poids, 0) as fraislivraison, v.modelivraison, CASE WHEN v.modelivraison = 1 THEN 'LIVRAISON' WHEN v.modelivraison = 2 THEN 'RECUPERATION' END AS modelivraisonlib, vr.reste, pv.id as idprovince, pv.val as provincelib, v.NUMEROFACTURE as numfact FROM VENTE v LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT left join PROVINCE pv on pv.id = c.IDPROVINCE LEFT JOIN MAGASINPOINT m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID LEFT JOIN LIAISONPAIEMENTTOTAL mv ON v.id = mv.id2 LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture = v.Id left join vente_poids vp on vp.idvente = v.id left join MODEPAIEMENT mp on mp.id = v.modepaiement left join vente_reste vr on vr.idvente = v.id ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_CPL_VISEE" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "CLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "IDORIGINE", "IDBL") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
       v.DESIGNATION,
       v.IDMAGASIN,
       m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
       v.DATY,
       v.REMARQUE,
       v.ETAT,
       CASE
           WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
           WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
           END
             AS ETATLIB,
       v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
       v2.IDDEVISE,
       v.IDCLIENT,
       c.NOM AS CLIENTLIB,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
       cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
       cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
       nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0)  as avoir,
       v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
       v.IDRESERVATION,
       v.IDORIGINE,
       bl.id as idbl
FROM VENTE v
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
         LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
         JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
         LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON v.id=mv.IDORIGINE
         LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
         left join AS_BONDELIVRAISON_CLIENT bl on bl.IDVENTE = v.id
where v.ETAT = 11
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_CPL" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "TVA", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "DESIGNATION", "PUREVIENT", "MONTANTREVIENT") AS 
  SELECT vd.ID,
          vd.IDVENTE,
          v.DESIGNATION AS IDVENTELIB,
          vd.IDPRODUIT,
          p.LIBELLE AS IDPRODUITLIB,
          v.IDORIGINE,
          vd.QTE,
          VD.pu
             AS PU,
         	CAST((nvl(vd.remise/100,0))*(vd.QTE * vd.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantRemise,
            CAST((1-nvl(vd.remise/100,0))*(vd.QTE * vd.PU) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montant,
          vd.iddevise AS iddevise,
          vd.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,
          vd.tva AS tva,
          v.idclient,
          v.idclientlib,
          vd.designation,
          vd.PUREVIENT,
          cast(vd.QTE*vd.PUREVIENT as NUMBER(20,2)) as montantRevient
     FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
          LEFT JOIN VENTE_LIB v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
          LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_CPL_2" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "PUTOTAL", "PUTOTALACHAT", "PUREVIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "IDBCFILLE", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDPROVINCE", "IDPROVINCELIB", "MOTSCLESSS") AS 
  SELECT SQ.ID,
       SQ.IDVENTE,
       SQ.IDVENTELIB,
       SQ.IDPRODUIT,
       SQ.IDPRODUITLIB,
       SQ.IDORIGINE,
       SQ.QTE,
       SQ.PU,
       SQ.PUTOTAL,
       SQ.PUTOTALACHAT,
       SQ.PUREVIENT,
       SQ.IDCATEGORIE,
       SQ.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       SQ.DATY,
       SQ.IDMAGASIN,
       SQ.IDMAGASINLIB,
       SQ.IDPOINT,
       SQ.IDPOINTLIB,
       SQ.IDDEVISE,
       SQ.IDDEVISELIB,
       SQ.IDRESERVATION,
       SQ.IDBCFILLE,
       SQ.TYPEPRODUIT,
       SQ.TYPEPRODUITLIB,
       SQ.IDPROVINCE,
       SQ.IDPROVINCELIB,
       (NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.ID), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDVENTE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDVENTELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPRODUIT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPRODUITLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDORIGINE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.QTE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PU), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUTOTAL), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUTOTALACHAT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.PUREVIENT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDCATEGORIE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDCATEGORIELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.DATY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDMAGASIN), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDMAGASINLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPOINT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPOINTLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDDEVISE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDDEVISELIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDRESERVATION), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDBCFILLE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.TYPEPRODUIT), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.TYPEPRODUITLIB), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPROVINCE), '') || ' | ' ||
        NVL(TO_CHAR(SQ.IDPROVINCELIB), '')) AS MOTSCLESSS
FROM (
         SELECT vd.ID,
                vd.IDVENTE,
                v.DESIGNATION                                                      AS IDVENTELIB,
                vd.IDPRODUIT,
                p.LIBELLEVENTE                                                     AS IDPRODUITLIB,
                vd.IDORIGINE,
                vd.QTE,
                NVL(vd.PU, 0)                                                      AS PU,
                -- Formule de PUTOTAL aligne?e sur le MONTANTTTC de la vue de?taille?e
                CAST(
                    -- Partie HT avec de?duction des frais
                        ((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0))
                            +
                            -- Partie TVA applique?e sur cette me?me base HT modifie?e
                        (((NVL(vd.PU, 0) * (1 - NVL(vd.REMISE, 0) / 100)) * vd.QTE
                            - NVL(v.FRAISLIVRAISON, 0) * NVL(p.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(vd.QTE, 0)) * NVL(vd.TVA, 0) / 100)
                    AS NUMBER(30,2)
                )                                                                  AS PUTOTAL,
                CAST(NVL(vd.PUACHAT * vd.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                  AS PUTOTALACHAT,
                CAST(NVL(vd.PU * vd.QTE, 0) - NVL(vd.PUACHAT * vd.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 2)) AS PUREVIENT,
                cat.ID                                                             AS IDCATEGORIE,
                cat.VAL                                                            AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
                v.DATY                                                             AS DATY,
                m.ID                                                               AS IDMAGASIN,
                m.VAL                                                              AS IDMAGASINLIB,
                p1.ID                                                              AS IDPOINT,
                p1.VAL                                                             AS IDPOINTLIB,
                vd.IDDEVISE,
                vd.IDDEVISE                                                        AS IDDEVISELIB,
                v.IDRESERVATION,
                vd.IDBCFILLE,
                p.TYPEPRODUIT,
                tp.VAL                                                             AS TYPEPRODUITLIB,
                cli.IDPROVINCE,
                pro.VAL                                                            AS IDPROVINCELIB
         FROM VENTE_DETAILS vd
                  LEFT JOIN VENTE v ON v.ID = vd.IDVENTE
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN2 m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS p ON p.ID = vd.IDPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN POINT p1 ON p1.ID = m.IDPOINT
                  LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT cat ON p.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = cat.ID
                  LEFT JOIN TYPE_PRODUIT tp ON tp.ID = p.TYPEPRODUIT
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT cli ON cli.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN PROVINCE pro ON pro.ID = cli.IDPROVINCE
     ) SQ
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_CPL_2_VISEE" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "PUTOTAL", "PUTOTALACHAT", "PUREVIENT", "IDCATEGORIE", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "DATY", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "IDPOINT", "IDPOINTLIB", "IDDEVISE", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDRESERVATION", "IDBCFILLE", "SUM_QTE", "MONTANTTOTAL", "MONTANT_TOTAL", "IDCLIENT", "TOTAL_ACHAT", "TYPEPRODUIT", "TYPEPRODUITLIB", "IDPROVINCE", "IDPROVINCELIB") AS 
  SELECT VD.ID,
       VD.IDVENTE,
       VD.IDVENTELIB,
       VD.IDPRODUIT,
       VD.IDPRODUITLIB,
       VD.IDORIGINE,
       VD.QTE,
       VD.PU,
       VD.PUTOTAL,
       VD.PUTOTALACHAT,
       VD.PUREVIENT,
       VD.IDCATEGORIE,
       VD.IDCATEGORIELIB,
       VD.DATY,
       VD.IDMAGASIN,
       VD.IDMAGASINLIB,
       VD.IDPOINT,
       VD.IDPOINTLIB,
       VD.IDDEVISE,
       VD.IDDEVISELIB,
       VD.IDRESERVATION,
       VD.IDBCFILLE,
       SUM(VD.QTE) OVER ()                            AS SUM_QTE,
       SUM(VD.PUTOTAL) OVER ()                        AS MONTANTTOTAL,
       SUM(VD.PUTOTAL) OVER ()                        AS MONTANT_TOTAL,
       V.IDCLIENT,
       SUM(VD.PUTOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY V.IDCLIENT) AS TOTAL_ACHAT,
       VD.TYPEPRODUIT,
       VD.TYPEPRODUITLIB,
       VD.IDPROVINCE,
       VD.IDPROVINCELIB
FROM VENTE_DETAILS_CPL_2 VD
         LEFT JOIN VENTE V ON V.ID = VD.IDVENTE

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_LIB" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDVENTELIB", "IDPRODUIT", "IDPRODUITLIB", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "PUTOTAL", "PUACHAT", "IDRESERVATION") AS

       p.LIBELLE            AS IDPRODUITLIB,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_PAYE" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "POIDS", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "MOIS", "ANNEE", "POURCENTAGEPAYE", "MONTANTFILLEPAYE", "RESTEAPAYERFILLE", "MONTANTFILLEPAYEAR", "MONTANTFILLE") AS 
  SELECT
    VD.ID,
    VD.IDVENTE,
    VD.IDPRODUIT,
    VD.IDORIGINE,
    VD.QTE,
    VD.PU,
    VD.REMISE,
    VD.TVA,
    VD.PUACHAT,
    VD.PUVENTE,
    VD.IDDEVISE,
    VD.TAUXDECHANGE,
    VD.DESIGNATION,
    VD.COMPTE,
    VD.PUREVIENT,
    VD.IDBCFILLE,
    VD.UNITE,
    VD.POIDS,
    VD.RISTOURNE,
    VD.IDPREVISION,
    V.MOIS,
    V.ANNEE,
    V.MONTANTPAYE * 100 / NULLIF(V.MONTANTTTC,0) AS  pourcentagepaye,
    (V.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(V.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (VD.QTE * VD.PU) AS MontantFillePaye,
    (VD.QTE * VD.PU) - ((V.MONTANTPAYE / NULLIF(V.MONTANTTTC, 0)) * (VD.QTE * VD.PU))   AS resteapayerfille,

    (VD.QTE * VD.PU) AS montantfille
FROM VENTE_DETAILS VD
    LEFT JOIN VENTE_CPL V ON V.ID = VD.IDVENTE
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DETAILS_POIDS_ING" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "IDDEVISE", "TAUXDECHANGE", "DESIGNATION", "COMPTE", "PUREVIENT", "IDBCFILLE", "UNITE", "UNITELIB", "PUNET", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTREMISE", "MONTANT", "POIDS", "RESTE", "FRAIS", "IDPRODUITLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "IDDEVISELIB", "IDCATEGORIELIB", "CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB", "PUTOTAL", "IDCLIENTLIB", "RISTOURNE", "IDPREVISION", "IDRESERVATION", "FRAISLIVRAISON", "CALORIE", "PUINGREDIENT", "CONTENUE", "UNITE2", "MONTANTREMISER", "IDREMISE", "REMISEARBIOCHEM", "RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM") AS 
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.IDVENTE,
    p.IDPRODUIT,
    p.IDORIGINE,
    CAST(p.QTE AS NUMBER(38, 2))                                              AS QTE,
    p.PU,
    p.REMISE,
    p.TVA,
    p.PUACHAT,
    p.PUVENTE,
    p.IDDEVISE,
    p.TAUXDECHANGE,
    p.DESIGNATION,
    p.COMPTE,
    p.PUREVIENT,
    p.IDBCFILLE,
    p.UNITE,
    u.VAL                                                                     AS UNITELIB,

    CAST(p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) + (p.pu * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS PUNET,

    -- MONTANTHT : deduction remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant fixe par qte)
    CAST(((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
        - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTHT,

    -- MONTANTTTC : base (avec remise Arbiochem) + TVA calculee sur cette meme base
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTTC,

    -- MONTANTTVA : calculee sur la base HT deja reduite de la remise Arbiochem
    CAST(
            ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS MONTANTTVA,

    -- MONTANTREMISE : remise % + remise Arbiochem (montant total de la remise)
    CAST(((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) + (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS MONTANTREMISE,

    CAST(p.pu * p.qte AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                       AS MONTANT,

    CAST(NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30, 5))                AS POIDS,
    (NVL(p.QTE, 0) - NVL(bl.QUANTITE, 0)) - NVL(avcf.qte, 0)                  AS RESTE,

    CAST(NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
        AS NUMBER(30, 5))                                                    AS FRAIS,

    nvl(ing.LIBELLEVENTE,ing.libelle)                                                          AS IDPRODUITLIB,
    v.DATY,
    v.DATYPREVU                                                               AS DATYPREVU,
    p.IDDEVISE                                                                AS IDDEVISELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS IDCATEGORIELIB,
    c.VAL                                                                     AS CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,

    -- PUTOTAL : meme formule que MONTANTTTC (avec remise Arbiochem)
    CAST(
            ((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte))
                + ((((p.pu * p.qte) - (p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte)
                - NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)
                - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte)) * p.tva / 100)
        AS NUMBER(30, 2)
    )                                                                         AS PUTOTAL,

    cl.nom                                                                    AS IDCLIENTLIB,
    p.ristourne                                                               AS RISTOURNE,
    p.idprevision,
    v.IDRESERVATION,
    NVL(v.fraislivraison, 0)                                                  AS FRAISLIVRAISON,
    ing.calorie,
    CAST(p.pu / NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1) AS NUMBER(30, 2))                        AS PUINGREDIENT,
    NVL(eq.QUANTITE, 1)                                                       AS CONTENUE,
    ing.unite2,

    -- MONTANTREMISER : montant net apres remise % + remise Arbiochem
    (p.pu * p.qte) - ((p.pu * p.remise / 100) * p.qte) - (nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0) * p.qte) AS MONTANTREMISER,

    p.IDREMISE,
    nvl(p.remiseArbiochem, 0)                                                 AS REMISEARBIOCHEM,
    nvl(p.ristourneArbiochem, 0)                                              AS RISTOURNEARBIOCHEM
FROM VENTE_DETAILS p
         LEFT JOIN VENTE v
                   ON v.id = p.IDVENTE
         LEFT JOIN AS_UNITE u
                   ON u.id = p.unite
         LEFT JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS ing
                   ON ing.ID = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN CLIENT cl
                   ON v.IDCLIENT = cl.ID
         LEFT JOIN CATEGORIEINGREDIENT c
                   ON ing.CATEGORIEINGREDIENT = c.ID
         LEFT JOIN EQUIVALENCEVENTE eq
                   ON eq.IDPRODUIT1 = p.IDPRODUIT
         LEFT JOIN BL_CLIENT_FILLE_grp_vente bl
                   ON bl.idventedetail = p.ID
         LEFT JOIN avoirfcfille_grp_viseee avcf
                   ON avcf.idventedetails = p.ID;

                                                        NVL(p.QTE, 0)) as number(30, 5))                                                  as montantht,
       cast(((p.pu - (p.pu * p.remise / 100)) * p.qte - nvl(v.fraislivraison, 0) * NVL(ing.CALORIE, 0) * NVL(p.QTE, 0)) +

             100) as number(30, 5))                                                                                                   as montantttc,

                                                                 NVL(p.QTE, 0)) * p.tva / 100) as number(30, 5))                                            as montanttva,

          ELSE v.IDPRODUIT||'---'||a.LIBELLE        END AS IDPRODUIT,    v.IDORIGINE,    v.QTE,    v.PU,    v.REMISE,    v.TVA,    v.PUACHAT,    v.PUVENTE,    v.IDDEVISE,    v.TAUXDECHANGE,    v.DESIGNATION,    v.COMPTE,    v.PUREVIENT,    v.IDBCFILLE,    v.UNITE,    v.UNITELIB,    v.PUNET,    v.FRAIS,    v.MONTANTHT,    v.MONTANTTTC,    v.MONTANTTVA,    v.MONTANTREMISE,    v.MONTANT,    v.RISTOURNE,    v.IDCLIENTLIB,    v.DATY,    v.DATYPREVU,    v.IDPRODUITLIB,    v.IDCATEGORIELIB,    v.CATEGORIEPRODUITLIB,    v.POIDS,    CASE        WHEN v.IDPREVISION IS NULL            THEN v.IDPREVISION        ELSE v.IDPREVISION||'---'||p.DESIGNATION        END AS IDPREVISION ,    v.CALORIE,    v.IDRESERVATION,    v.FRAISLIVRAISON,    v.ristourneArbiochem,    v.remiseArbiochemFROM VENTE_DETAILS_VIDE v         LEFT  JOIN AS_INGREDIENTS a ON a.id = v.IDPRODUIT         LEFT JOIN PREVISION p ON p.ID = v.IDPREVISION;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_DIRECTE_CPL_PDF" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "DATYPREVU", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ADECLARER", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION", "AVECCOMMISSION", "IDMODEPAIEMENT", "REFERENCEFACTURE", "IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB", "MONTANTDONNE", "MONTANTRETOURNER", "HEURESAISIE", "IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT", "ECHEANCEPAIEMENTLIB", "IDORIGINE", "DATYHEURE") AS 
  SELECT "ID","DESIGNATION","IDMAGASIN","IDMAGASINLIB","DATY","DATYPREVU","REMARQUE","ETAT","ADECLARER","ETATLIB","MONTANTTOTAL","IDDEVISE","IDCLIENT","IDCLIENTLIB","MONTANTTVA","MONTANTTTC","MONTANTTTCAR","MONTANTPAYE","MONTANTRESTE","AVOIR","TAUXDECHANGE","MONTANTREVIENT","MARGEBRUTE","IDRESERVATION","AVECCOMMISSION","IDMODEPAIEMENT","REFERENCEFACTURE","IDMODEPAIEMENTLIB","MONTANTDONNE","MONTANTRETOURNER","HEURESAISIE","IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT","ECHEANCEPAIEMENTLIB","IDORIGINE","DATYHEURE"
FROM (
         SELECT v.ID,
                v.DESIGNATION,
                v.IDMAGASIN,
                m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
                v.DATY,
                v.DATYPREVU,
                v.REMARQUE,
                v.ETAT,
                ADECLARER,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 1  THEN 'CRÉÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISÉE'
                    WHEN v.ETAT = 0  THEN 'ANNULÉE'
                    END AS ETATLIB,
                v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
                v2.IDDEVISE,
                v.IDCLIENT,
                c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
                cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
                cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
                nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0) as avoir,
                v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,
                v2.MONTANTREVIENT,
                cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2)) as margeBrute,
                v.IDRESERVATION,
                CASE
                    WHEN cm.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Oui'
                    ELSE                        'Non'
                    END AS avecCommission,
                v.idmodepaiement,
                rf.REFERENCE as referencefacture,
                mp.val AS idmodepaiementlib,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.MONTANTDONNE IS NULL OR v.MONTANTDONNE = 0
                        THEN cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    ELSE cast(v.MONTANTDONNE AS NUMBER(30,2))
                    END AS MONTANTDONNE,
                nvl(mv.MONTANTRETOURNER, 0) as montantretourner,
                v.heureSaisie,
                V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT,
                EP.DESCE AS echeancePaiementLib,
                v.IDORIGINE,
                TO_DATE(v.daty || ' ' || v.heureSaisie, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS DATYHEURE
         FROM VENTE v
                  LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
                  LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
                  JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
                  LEFT JOIN MVTCAISSEGROUPEFACTURE_PDF mv ON v.id in mv.IDORIGINE
                  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
             LEFT JOIN COMMISSION cm ON cm.IDFACTURE = v.id
             LEFT JOIN MODEPAIEMENT mp ON mp.id = v.idmodepaiement
             LEFT JOIN REFERENCEFACTURE rf ON rf.idfacture=v.Id
             LEFT JOIN ECHEANCEPAIEMENT EP on EP.ID = V.IDECHEANCEPAIEMENT
     )
ORDER BY DATYHEURE DESC NULLS LAST

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_LIB" ("IDORIGINE", "ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB") AS 
  SELECT
  v.IDORIGINE ,
v.ID ,
v.DESIGNATION ,
v.IDMAGASIN ,
m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
v.DATY ,
v.REMARQUE ,
v.ETAT ,
CASE
	WHEN v.ETAT = 1
	THEN 'CREE'
	WHEN v.ETAT = 11

	WHEN v.ETAT = 0
	THEN 'ANNULEE'
END AS ETATLIB,
v.IDCLIENT ,
c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_LIB_BC" ("ID", "DESIGNATION", "IDORIGINE", "IDMAGASIN", "IDMAGASINLIB", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "ETATLIB", "MONTANTTOTAL", "IDDEVISE", "IDCLIENT", "IDCLIENTLIB", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTTTCAR", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "AVOIR", "TAUXDECHANGE", "MONTANTREVIENT", "MARGEBRUTE", "IDRESERVATION") AS 
  SELECT v.ID,
          v.DESIGNATION,
          v.IDORIGINE,
          v.IDMAGASIN,
          m.VAL AS IDMAGASINLIB,
          v.DATY,
          v.REMARQUE,
          v.ETAT,
          CASE
             WHEN v.ETAT = 1 THEN 'CREE'
             WHEN v.ETAT = 11 THEN 'VISEE'
             WHEN v.ETAT = 0 THEN 'ANNULEE'
          END
             AS ETATLIB,
          v2.MONTANTTOTAL,
          v2.IDDEVISE,
          v.IDCLIENT,
          c.NOM AS IDCLIENTLIB,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTVA as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTVA,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTC as number(30,2)) as montantttc,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTCAR as number(30,2)) as MONTANTTTCAR,
          cast(nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantpaye,
          cast(V2.MONTANTTTC-nvl(mv.credit,0)-nvl(ACG.resteapayer_avr, 0) AS NUMBER(30,2)) AS montantreste,
          nvl(ACG.MONTANTTTC_avr, 0)  as avoir,
          v2.tauxDeChange AS tauxDeChange,v2.MONTANTREVIENT,cast((V2.MONTANTTTCAR-v2.MONTANTREVIENT) as number(20,2))  as margeBrute,
          v.IDRESERVATION
     FROM VENTE v
          LEFT JOIN CLIENT c ON c.ID = v.IDCLIENT
          LEFT JOIN MAGASIN m ON m.ID = v.IDMAGASIN
          JOIN VENTEMONTANT v2 ON v2.ID = v.ID
          LEFT JOIN mouvementcaisseGroupeFacture mv ON v.id=mv.IDORIGINE
		  LEFT JOIN AVOIRFCLIB_CPL_GRP ACG on ACG.IDVENTE = v.ID
 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_MF" ("ID", "IDVENTE", "IDPRODUIT", "IDORIGINE", "QTE", "PU", "REMISE", "TVA", "PUACHAT", "PUVENTE", "DESIGNATION", "IDMAGASIN", "DATY", "REMARQUE", "ETAT", "IDCLIENT", "COMPTE", "MONTANTHT", "MONTANTTVA", "MONTANTTTC", "TAUXDECHANGE", "IDRESERVATION") AS

       cast(PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100)) + (PU * qte* (1-(nvl(vd.REMISE,0)/100)) * (tva/100))  as NUMBER(30, 2)) as montantTTC,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VENTE_RECAP_JOUR" ("DATY", "MONTANTTTC", "MONTANTPAYE", "MONTANTRESTE", "NOMBRE", "MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR") AS 
  WITH BORNES AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-06-01' AS DATE_MIN,
        TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DATE_MAX
    FROM DUAL
),
CALENDRIER AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_MIN + LEVEL - 1 AS DATY
    FROM BORNES
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= DATE_MAX - DATE_MIN + 1
),
VENTE_JOUR AS (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(DATY) AS DATY,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTTTC, 0)) AS MONTANTTTC,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTPAYE, 0)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
        SUM(NVL(MONTANTRESTE, 0)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
        COUNT(*) AS NOMBRE
    FROM VENTE_CPL
    WHERE ETAT = 11
      AND DATY >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY TRUNC(DATY)
)
SELECT
    c.DATY,

    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTTTC, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTTTC,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTPAYE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTPAYE,
    CAST(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0) AS NUMBER(30,5)) AS MONTANTRESTE,
    CAST(NVL(v.NOMBRE, 0) AS NUMBER(10,0)) AS NOMBRE,

    CAST(
        SUM(NVL(v.MONTANTRESTE, 0))
        OVER (
            ORDER BY c.DATY
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        )
        AS NUMBER(30,5)
    ) AS MONTANTRESTEACEJOUR

FROM CALENDRIER c
LEFT JOIN VENTE_JOUR v
    ON c.DATY = v.DATY

 ;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ARBIOCHEMSTANDARD"."VUE_CONTRAT_LIB" ("ID", "MATRICULE", "NOM", "PRENOM", "SEXE", "DATEEMBAUCHE", "PERIODE", "DATE_FIN_CONTRAT", "ETAT", "TYPE_CONTRAT") AS

    lpf.matricule,
    lpf.nom,
    lpf.prenom,
    lpf.sexe,
    pip.dateembauche,
    pip.indesirable AS periode,
    CASE
        WHEN pip.indesirable > 0 THEN pip.dateembauche + INTERVAL '1' MONTH * pip.indesirable
